manifest.title: A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture

inputs.abstract:
We formalize in Lean OpenAI's counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture. For arbitrarily large $m$, we construct an $m$-vertex graph $G$ with independence number at most two and $h(G)<26m/75+2/3<m/2\le\chi_f(G)\le\chi(G)$, where $h(G)$ and $\chi_f(G)$ denote its Hadwiger number and fractional chromatic number.

We reuse OpenAI's partial Lean formalization of the matching-minor bound and its chromatic consequence, together with their later formalization of the graph construction. We adapt these proofs to Lax and prove the fractional version.

concepts.description: Conditional event identities and finite family unions charge small accepted sets once and retain the actual accepting-pair mass.

import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Lax342547.RetainedImages

/-!
---
title: Finite accepting-family losses
type: lemma
---
Conditional event identities and finite family unions charge small accepted sets once and retain the actual accepting-pair mass.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AcceptingFamilies

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

axiom conditional_event_mass {A : Type} [Fintype A] (α : A → ℝ) (C F : A → Prop) :
    cellMass (conditionalLaw α C) F = cellMass α (fun a => C a ∧ F a) / cellMass α C

axiom conditional_probability {A : Type} [Fintype A] (α : A → ℝ) (C : A → Prop)
    (hα : Probability α) (hC : 0 < cellMass α C) : Probability (conditionalLaw α C)

axiom accepting_family_loss {A B I : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (C : I → A → Prop) (key : B → I) (F : B → A → Prop)
    (η τ U : ℝ) (hα : Probability α) (hβ : Probability β)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hU : 0 ≤ U)
    (hex : ∀ i, τ ≤ cellMass α (C i) →
      cellMass β (fun b => η ≤ cellMass (conditionalLaw α (C i)) (F b)) ≤ U) :
    (∑ b, β b * cellMass α (fun a => C (key b) a ∧ F b a)) ≤
      η * (∑ b, β b * cellMass α (C (key b))) + τ + Fintype.card I * U

end Lax342547.AcceptingFamilies

concepts.title: Actual finite accepting-pair injection
concepts.description: Greedy pin probes and whole-unit protected spaces give a finite accepting-pair loss bound for the entire accepting family, with raw primal avoidance and retained masses.

import Lax342547.FiniteInjection
import Lax342547.AcceptingFamilies
import Lax342547.UnitSpanAvoidance
import Lax342547.GreedySpaces

/-!
---
title: Actual finite accepting-pair injection
type: lemma
---
Greedy pin probes and whole-unit protected spaces give a finite accepting-pair loss bound for the entire accepting family, with raw primal avoidance and retained masses.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AcceptingInjection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.FiniteInjection
open Lax342547.RawFrames
open scoped BigOperators

axiom accepting_family_injection {A B I N H : Type}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype H]
    [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq H]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (C : I → A → Prop) (key : B → I)
    (V : A → Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) (Y : B → Matrix N H Binary)
    (S : B → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (K ℓ : ℕ) (L η δ τ : ℝ)
    (hα : Probability α) (hβ : Probability β) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hgap : δ < η)
    (hV : ∀ a,Module.finrank Binary (V a) ≤ K)
    (hS : ∀ b,Module.finrank Binary (S b) ≤ K)
    (hcap : ∀ y,push β Y y ≤ L*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) y)
    (havoid : ∀ i,τ ≤ cellMass α (C i) → ∀ j,j < ℓ → ∀ t : Fin j → A,
      cellMass (conditionalLaw α (C i)) (fun a => ¬ Disjoint (V a) (⨆ k : Fin j,V (t k))) ≤ δ) :
    (∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => C (key b) a ∧ pinFailure (V a) (Y b) (S b))) ≤
      η*(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (C (key b))) + τ +
      Fintype.card I*((L*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*K+2*K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*ℓ)))/(η-δ)^ℓ)

axiom primal_accepting_family_injection {A B I P N H : Type}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I] [Fintype P] [Fintype N] [Fintype H]
    [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq H]
    (E : Matrix P P Binary) [Nonempty (Frame P H N E)]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (C : I → A → Prop) (key : B → I)
    (image : A → Frame P H N E) (V : A → Submodule Binary (N → Binary))
    (Y : B → Matrix N H Binary) (S : B → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (K ℓ : ℕ) (M L η τ : ℝ)
    (hα : Probability α) (hβ : Probability β) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hN : Fintype.card P+Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hV : ∀ a,V a ≤ LinearMap.range (image a).P.mulVecLin)
    (hdV : ∀ a,Module.finrank Binary (V a) ≤ K)
    (hS : ∀ b,Module.finrank Binary (S b) ≤ K)
    (hAcap : ∀ f,push α image f ≤ M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E)) f)
    (hBcap : ∀ y,push β Y y ≤ L*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) y)
    (hgap : (M/τ)*(2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card P+Fintype.card H+K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)) < η) :
    (∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => C (key b) a ∧ pinFailure (V a) (Y b) (S b))) ≤
      η*(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (C (key b))) + τ +
      Fintype.card I*((L*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*K+2*K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*ℓ)))/
        (η-(M/τ)*(2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card P+Fintype.card H+K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)))^ℓ)

end Lax342547.AcceptingInjection

/-!
---
title: Actual gradient-realized cells in the collision averaging law
type: lemma
---
The checked retained-cell theorem is expressed in the ambient conditional laws used by finite record averaging. All targets are constructed from actual recipes, and both cell caps come from the original PMF leaf min-entropy.

      leftRecord W Q refB o = leftRecord W Q refB refA)
    (hD : ∀ o, D o → o ∈ Q.event observation ∧ rightTuple W o = rightTuple W refB ∧
      rightRecord W P refA o = rightRecord W P refA refB)

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedSpans
import Lax342547.GreedyTails

/-!
---
title: Actual projected span deficit
type: lemma
---
The projected-space dimension deficit equals the greedy tail statistic, so the small-tail conclusion concerns actual quotient spaces.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ActualDeficits

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.GreedyTails
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def projectedDeficit {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) : ℝ :=
    (l.map (fun i => (Module.finrank K ((S i).map W.mkQ) : ℝ))).sum-
      Module.finrank K (l.toFinset.sup (fun i => (S i).map W.mkQ) : Submodule K (V ⧸ W))

axiom map_finset_sup {K V U ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (f : V →ₗ[K] U) (I : Finset ι) :
    (I.sup S).map f = I.sup (fun i => (S i).map f)

axiom projected_deficit_eq {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) :
    projectedDeficit S W l = deficit S W l

axiom small_projected_tail {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)

concepts.description: Uniform counting of every bounded-dimensional protected space controls the actual channel event even when that space depends on the random matrix.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProtectedChannels
import Lax342547.SmallSubspaceCount
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns
import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames

/-!
---
title: Channel bounds with adaptive protected coefficient spaces
type: lemma
---
Uniform counting of every bounded-dimensional protected space controls the actual channel event even when that space depends on the random matrix.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AdaptiveProtection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators

axiom adaptive_protected_probability {I H N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (S : Matrix N H Binary → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (K : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ Y,Module.finrank Binary (S Y) ≤ K) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)))
      (fun Y => ∀ i,(fun h => (Y.transpose*D) h i) ∈ S Y) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*K+K*Fintype.card I)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*Fintype.card I)

end Lax342547.AdaptiveProtection

concepts.title: Sampling after exposed coordinates
concepts.description: For independent product samples, a cylinder event defined by exposed coordinates has the exact averaged power probability and the uniform power bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoordinateRestrictions

/-!
---
title: Sampling after exposed coordinates
type: lemma
---
For independent product samples, a cylinder event defined by exposed coordinates has the exact averaged power probability and the uniform power bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AdaptiveSampling

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom adaptive_cylinder_probability {J K Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : (J → Ω) → Ω → Prop) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : J ⊕ K => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ k, A (fun j => sample (.inl j)) (sample (.inr k))) =
      ∑ exposed : J → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : J => μ) exposed*(cellMass μ (A exposed))^Fintype.card K

axiom adaptive_cylinder_bound {J K Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : (J → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp : ∀ exposed, cellMass μ (A exposed) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : J ⊕ K => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ k, A (fun j => sample (.inl j)) (sample (.inr k))) ≤ p^Fintype.card K

end Lax342547.AdaptiveSampling

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq K] (μ : Ω → Real) (A : (J → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    (∀ (exposed : J → Ω), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (A exposed)) p) →
      Real.instLE.le
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
          ∀ (k : K), A (fun j => sample (Sum.inl j)) (sample (Sum.inr k)))
        (instHPow.hPow p (Fintype.card K))

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq K] (μ : Ω → Real) (A : (J → Ω) → Ω → Prop),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
      ∀ (k : K), A (fun j => sample (Sum.inl j)) (sample (Sum.inr k)))

concepts.title: Adaptive sampling on disjoint coordinate sets
concepts.description: Arbitrary disjoint exposed and tested index sets inherit the conditional product-law power bound through an explicit sum embedding.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AdaptiveSampling

/-!
---
title: Adaptive sampling on disjoint coordinate sets
type: lemma
---
Arbitrary disjoint exposed and tested index sets inherit the conditional product-law power bound through an explicit sum embedding.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AdaptiveSets

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom embedding_adaptive_bound {E J ι Ω : Type} [Fintype E] [Fintype J] [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq E] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (a : E ⊕ J ↪ ι) (A : (E → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hA : ∀ exposed, cellMass μ (A exposed) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ j, A (fun e => sample (a (.inl e))) (sample (a (.inr j)))) ≤ p^Fintype.card J

noncomputable def disjointEmbedding {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] (E J : Finset ι)
    (h : Disjoint E J) : E ⊕ J ↪ ι :=
  { toFun := Sum.elim Subtype.val Subtype.val
    inj' := by
      intro x y hxy
      cases x with
      | inl e =>
        cases y with
        | inl e' => exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext hxy)
        | inr j =>
          dsimp at hxy
          exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp h) e.property (hxy.symm ▸ j.property))
      | inr j =>
        cases y with
        | inl e =>
          dsimp at hxy
          exact False.elim ((Finset.disjoint_left.mp h) e.property (hxy ▸ j.property))
        | inr j' => exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext hxy) }

axiom disjoint_adaptive_bound {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (E J : Finset ι) (h : Disjoint E J)
    (A : (E → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hA : ∀ exposed, cellMass μ (A exposed) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ j ∈ J, A (fun e => sample e.val) (sample j)) ≤ p^J.card

end Lax342547.AdaptiveSets

  Disjoint E J →
    ∀ (A : ((Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem E x) → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : Real),
      Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
        (∀ (exposed : (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem E x) → Ω),
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (A exposed)) p) →
          Real.instLE.le

              ∀ (j : ι), SetLike.instMembership.mem J j → A (fun e => sample e.val) (sample j))
            (instHPow.hPow p J.card)

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    (∀ (exposed : E → Ω), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (A exposed)) p) →
      Real.instLE.le
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>

concepts.description: All disjoint exposed and tested index sets have the finite union bound four to the number of coordinates times the cover mass to the number of tests.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AdaptiveSets

/-!
---
title: Union over adaptive component covers
type: lemma
---
All disjoint exposed and tested index sets have the finite union bound four to the number of coordinates times the cover mass to the number of tests.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AdaptiveUnion

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom adaptive_cover_union {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : ∀ E : Finset ι, (E → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hA : ∀ E exposed, cellMass μ (A E exposed) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ∃ E J : Finset ι, Disjoint E J ∧ k ≤ J.card ∧
        ∀ j ∈ J, A E (fun e => sample e.val) (sample j)) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι*p^k

end Lax342547.AdaptiveUnion

  (A : (E : Finset ι) → ((Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem E x) → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (p : Real) (k : Nat),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 p →
      Real.instLE.le p 1 →
        (∀ (E : Finset ι) (exposed : (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem E x) → Ω),
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (A E exposed)) p) →
          Real.instLE.le
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
              Exists fun E =>
                Exists fun J =>
                  And (Disjoint E J)
                    (And (instLENat.le k J.card)
                      (∀ (j : ι), SetLike.instMembership.mem J j → A E (fun e => sample e.val) (sample j))))
            (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 4 (Fintype.card ι)) (instHPow.hPow p k))

concepts.title: Exact-image bounds for independent affine columns
concepts.description:
Every column may have its own affine translation space, provided they
all contain one common subspace S. An injective nominal coefficient
matrix of rank t then has at least t dim(S) uniform image bits. The
estimate is valid for every t, with no bounded-rank assumption.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

/-!
---
title: Exact-image bounds for independent affine columns
type: lemma
---
Every column may have its own affine translation space, provided they
all contain one common subspace S. An injective nominal coefficient
matrix of rank t then has at least t dim(S) uniform image bits. The
estimate is valid for every t, with no bounded-rank assumption.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AffineImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

variable {J T V : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype T]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]

def evaluation (S : J → Submodule Binary V) (C : Matrix J T Binary) :
    (∀ j, S j) →ₗ[Binary] (T → V) where
  toFun x t := ∑ j, C j t • (x j).val
  map_add' x y := by ext t; simp [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c x := by ext t; simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, mul_comm]

def columnMap (v : J → V) : (J → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] V where
  toFun c := ∑ j, c j • v j
  map_add' c d := by simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' s c := by simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

noncomputable def law [DecidableEq J] (S : J → Submodule Binary V) [∀ j, Fintype (S j)]
    (C : Matrix J T Binary) (a : J → V) : PMF (T → V) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ j, S j)).map
    (fun x => (fun t => ∑ j, C j t • a j) + evaluation S C x)

axiom evaluation_rank [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (S : J → Submodule Binary V) (S₀ : Submodule Binary V)
    (hS : ∀ j, S₀ ≤ S j) (C : Matrix J T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) :
    Fintype.card T * Module.finrank Binary S₀ ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (evaluation S C))

axiom image_bound [DecidableEq J] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (S : J → Submodule Binary V) [∀ j, Fintype (S j)]
    (S₀ : Submodule Binary V) (hS : ∀ j, S₀ ≤ S j)
    (C : Matrix J T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (a : J → V) (y : T → V) :
    law S C a y ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card T * Module.finrank Binary S₀)

axiom dependence_bound [DecidableEq J] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (S : J → Submodule Binary V) [∀ j, Fintype (S j)]
    (S₀ : Submodule Binary V) (hS : ∀ j, S₀ ≤ S j) (a : J → V) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ j, S j)).toOuterMeasure
      {x | ¬ Function.Injective (columnMap (fun j => a j + (x j).val))} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card J / 2 ^ Module.finrank Binary S₀

axiom extension_dependence_bound {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U] [Module Binary U] [Fintype U]
    [DecidableEq J] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (P : U →ₗ[Binary] V) (hP : Function.Injective P)
    (S : J → Submodule Binary V) [∀ j, Fintype (S j)]
    (S₀ : Submodule Binary V) (hS : ∀ j, S₀ ≤ S j) (a : J → V) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ j, S j)).toOuterMeasure
      {x | ¬ Function.Injective (fun z : U × (J → Binary) =>
        P z.1 + columnMap (fun j => a j + (x j).val) z.2)} ≤
      (Fintype.card U : ℝ≥0∞) * 2 ^ Fintype.card J / 2 ^ Module.finrank Binary S₀

end Lax342547.AffineImages

concepts.title: Independent nominal affine slices from the free block
concepts.description:
Two affine maps have the same constant-coordinate value on their translation
columns. Subtracting those columns leaves an independent uniform free matrix
with 2d+1 columns. This pays nominal dependence without falsely identifying
the two translation directions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GramNormalization
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

/-!
---
title: Independent nominal affine slices from the free block
type: lemma
---
Two affine maps have the same constant-coordinate value on their translation
columns. Subtracting those columns leaves an independent uniform free matrix
with 2d+1 columns. This pays nominal dependence without falsely identifying
the two translation directions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open scoped ENNReal

def affineColumns {D N : Type} (Z : Matrix N (Option D) Binary) :
    Matrix (Option N) (Option D) Binary
  | none,none => 1
  | none,some _ => 0
  | some n,j => Z n j

def joinedFree {D N : Type} (Z : Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary) :
    Matrix N (Option (D ⊕ D)) Binary
  | n,none => Z.1 n none+Z.2 n none
  | n,some (Sum.inl d) => Z.1 n (some d)
  | n,some (Sum.inr d) => Z.2 n (some d)

def joinedFreeMap {D N : Type} :
    (Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary) →ₗ[Binary]
      Matrix N (Option (D ⊕ D)) Binary where
  toFun := joinedFree
  map_add' Z W := by
    ext n j
    cases j with
    | some j => cases j <;> rfl
    | none => change (Z.1 n none+W.1 n none)+(Z.2 n none+W.2 n none) =
                (Z.1 n none+Z.2 n none)+(W.1 n none+W.2 n none)
              ring
  map_smul' c Z := by
    ext n j
    cases j with
    | some j => cases j <;> rfl
    | none => change c*(Z.1 n none)+c*(Z.2 n none) = c*(Z.1 n none+Z.2 n none)
              ring

def pairMap {D N : Type} [Fintype D] (Z : Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary) :
    ((Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary)) →ₗ[Binary] (Option N → Binary) where
  toFun v := (affineColumns Z.1).mulVec v.1+(affineColumns Z.2).mulVec v.2
  map_add' _ _ := by simp only [Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,Matrix.mulVec_add]; abel
  map_smul' c v := by
    change (affineColumns Z.1).mulVec (c • v.1)+(affineColumns Z.2).mulVec (c • v.2) = _
    simp [Matrix.mulVec_smul,smul_add]

axiom pairMap_injective_of_joined {D N : Type} [Fintype D] [Fintype N]
    (Z : Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary)
    (hZ : Function.Injective (joinedFree Z).mulVec) : Function.Injective (pairMap Z)

axiom joinedFree_uniform {D N : Type} [Fintype D] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableEq N] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary)).map joinedFree =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N (Option (D ⊕ D)) Binary)

axiom affine_pair_failure {D N : Type} [Fintype D] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableEq N] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N (Option D) Binary × Matrix N (Option D) Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {Z | ¬ Function.Injective (pairMap Z)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^Fintype.card N

/-- Coefficients of the actual affine point map at a fixed selector. -/
def pointColumns {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) : Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Option D) Binary :=
  fun c j => selectorEval s c.1 * match c.2 with
    | none => match j with | none => 1 | some _ => 0
    | some a => V a j

def freePart {k n : ℕ} {D : Type} (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary := fun i j => V (free i) j

def eraseFree {k n : ℕ} {D : Type} (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary
  | Sum.inr (q,i),j => if q = 2 then 0 else V (Sum.inr (q,i)) j
  | Sum.inl a,j => V (Sum.inl a) j

def setFree {k n : ℕ} {D : Type} (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary) : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary
  | Sum.inr (q,i),j => if q = 2 then Z i j else V (Sum.inr (q,i)) j
  | Sum.inl a,j => V (Sum.inl a) j

axiom point_pair_independent {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (V W : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)
    (hZ : Function.Injective (joinedFree (freePart V,freePart W)).mulVec) :
    Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
      (pointColumns (degree := degree) s V).mulVec uv.1+
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s W).mulVec uv.2)

axiom pointColumns_eraseFree {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    (changeZ (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)).toMatrix' * pointColumns (degree := degree) s V =
      pointColumns s (eraseFree V)

axiom point_gram_ignores_free {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (V W : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    (pointColumns s V).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s W =
      (pointColumns s (eraseFree V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (eraseFree W)

axiom point_gram_setFree {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (V W : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)
    (Z T : Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary) :
    (pointColumns s (setFree V Z)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (setFree W T) =
      (pointColumns s V).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s W

axiom point_pair_failure {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (V W : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {Z | ¬ Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (setFree V Z.1)).mulVec uv.1+
          (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (setFree W Z.2)).mulVec uv.2)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^n

end Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence

  ENNReal.instLE.le

concepts.title: Uniform quantitative thresholds for affine-slice variance
concepts.description:
The variance budget is bounded by a fixed constant times 2^(-floor(n/2))
whenever the ambient dimension is at least n. One threshold supplies every
Gram comparison margin and any requested positive error, before choosing
coefficient laws, prescribed Grams, or common tests.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AffineSliceVariance

/-!
---
title: Uniform quantitative thresholds for affine-slice variance
type: lemma
---
The variance budget is bounded by a fixed constant times 2^(-floor(n/2))
whenever the ambient dimension is at least n. One threshold supplies every
Gram comparison margin and any requested positive error, before choosing
coefficient laws, prescribed Grams, or common tests.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AffineSliceScales
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.RawFrameComparison

def budget (S D : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype D] (N n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*errorBound N (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D)+
      4*(((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/β^2)

def scale (S D : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype D] (β : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*Lax342547.RawFrameComparison.scale (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D)+
      4*((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/β^2)

axiom budget_decay (S D : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype D] (N n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    budget S D N n β ≤ scale S D β/(2 : ℝ)^(n/2)

axiom uniform_threshold (S D : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype D] (β ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ,∀ n ≥ n₀,∀ N ≥ n,
      Fintype.card (Option D)+Fintype.card (Option D)+1 ≤ N ∧
      ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))*
          ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤
        1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D))+1) ∧
      budget S D N n β ≤ ε

end
end Lax342547.AffineSliceScales

statements.signature:
budget_decay : ∀ (S D : Type) [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype D] (N n : Nat) (β : Real),
  instLENat.le n N →
    Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.AffineSliceScales.budget S D N n β)
      (instHDiv.hDiv (Lax342547.AffineSliceScales.scale S D β) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv n 2)))

uniform_threshold : ∀ (S D : Type) [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype D] (β ε : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    Exists fun n₀ =>
      ∀ (n : Nat),
        GE.ge n n₀ →
          ∀ (N : Nat),
            GE.ge N n →
              And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card (Option D)) (Fintype.card (Option D))) 1) N)
                (And
                  (Real.instLE.le
                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHPow.hPow 2
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Option D)) (Fintype.card (Option D))) 2))
                        (instHPow.hPow 2
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Option D)) (Fintype.card (Option D))) 2)))
                      (instHPow.hPow 2 N).sqrt)
                    (instHDiv.hDiv 1
                      (instHPow.hPow 2
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D)))
                          1))))
                  (Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.AffineSliceScales.budget S D N n β) ε))

concepts.title: Conditioned affine-slice variance under the actual raw law
concepts.description:
The actual one-batch orbit law and grouped two-batch comparison discharge the
finite empirical-variance hypotheses. The coefficient law may have arbitrary
other coordinates and an independent uniform free block. Conditioning on a
positive-mass prescribed Gram event retains its explicit squared mass cost.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConditionedAffineColumns
import Lax342547.RawGroupedComparison
import Lax342547.EmpiricalVariance

/-!
---
title: Conditioned affine-slice variance under the actual raw law
type: lemma
---
The actual one-batch orbit law and grouped two-batch comparison discharge the
finite empirical-variance hypotheses. The coefficient law may have arbitrary
other coordinates and an independent uniform free block. Conditioning on a
positive-mass prescribed Gram event retains its explicit squared mass cost.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AffineSliceVariance
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.RawFrames
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence
open Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

def referenceMean {S D : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (n : ℕ) (G : S → Matrix D D Binary) [∀ s,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) (G s))]
    (test : (S → (Fin n × (D ⊕ D) → Binary)) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
    ∑ z : ∀ s,Orbit (Fin n) (G s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) z*
      test (fun s => batchEquiv (z s).val)

axiom reference_mean {S B H D : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (n : ℕ) (E : S → Matrix B B Binary) (G : S → Matrix D D Binary)
    [∀ s,Nonempty (Frame B H (Fin n) (E s))] [∀ s,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) (G s))]
    (C : Matrix B D Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec)
    (hG : ∀ s,C.transpose*E s*C = G s)
    (test : (S → (Fin n × (D ⊕ D) → Binary)) → ℝ) :
    (∑ o : ∀ s,Frame B H (Fin n) (E s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
      test (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C,(o s).Q*C))) =
    ∑ z : ∀ s,Orbit (Fin n) (G s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) z*
      test (fun s => batchEquiv (z s).val)

axiom coefficient_variance {S B H D A : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [Fintype A]
    (n : ℕ) (E : S → Matrix B B Binary) (G : S → Matrix D D Binary)
    [∀ s,Nonempty (Frame B H (Fin n) (E s))] [∀ s,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) (G s))]
    (C : A → Matrix B D Binary) (κ : A → ℝ) (hκ : Probability κ)
    (hGram : ∀ a,κ a ≠ 0 → ∀ s,(C a).transpose*E s*C a = G s)
    (test : (S → (Fin n × (D ⊕ D) → Binary)) → ℝ) (htest : ∀ z,|test z| ≤ 1)
    (δ : ℝ) (hbad : Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun ab : A × A => κ ab.1*κ ab.2)
      (fun ab => ¬ Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (C ab.1) (C ab.2)).mulVec) ≤ δ)
    (hN : Fintype.card D+Fintype.card D+1 ≤ n)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card D*Fintype.card D+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card D*Fintype.card D+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots D D D D)+1)) :
    (∑ o : ∀ s,Frame B H (Fin n) (E s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
      ((∑ a,κ a*test (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C a,(o s).Q*C a)))-
        referenceMean n G test)^2) ≤
      (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*Lax342547.RawFrameComparison.errorBound n D D D D+4*δ

def GramEvent {S D : Type} {k n b degree : ℕ} [Fintype D]
    (sel : Fin b → Binary) (E : S → Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Coordinate k n b degree) Binary)
    (G : S → Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary)
    (V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) : Prop :=
    ∀ i,(pointColumns sel V).transpose*E i*pointColumns sel V = G i

axiom affine_slice_variance {S H D : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    [Fintype H] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (N : ℕ) (sel : Fin b → Binary)
    (E : S → Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Coordinate k n b degree) Binary)
    (G : S → Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary)
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i))]
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin N) (G i))]
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hGram : β ≤ cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)))
      (GramEvent sel E G))
    (test : (S → (Fin N × (Option D ⊕ Option D) → Binary)) → ℝ) (htest : ∀ z,|test z| ≤ 1)
    (hN : Fintype.card (Option D)+Fintype.card (Option D)+1 ≤ N)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D))+1)) :
    (∑ o : ∀ i,Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
      ((∑ V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary,
        conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) (GramEvent sel E G) V*
          test (fun i => batchEquiv ((o i).P*pointColumns sel V,(o i).Q*pointColumns sel V)))-
            referenceMean N G test)^2) ≤
      (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*Lax342547.RawFrameComparison.errorBound N (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D)+
        4*(((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/β^2)

axiom independent_free_pair_bound {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (hα : Probability α) (_hβ : Probability β)
    (bad : (A × B) × (A × B) → Prop) (δ : ℝ)
    (hbad : ∀ a : A × A,cellMass (fun z : B × B => β z.1*β z.2)
      (fun z => bad ((a.1,z.1),(a.2,z.2))) ≤ δ) :

concepts.title: Finite amplified-test averaging
concepts.description: Finite Fubini transfers a pointwise amplified-test upper bound to an exception bound for arbitrary whole-unit predicates.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling

/-!
---
title: Finite amplified-test averaging
type: lemma
---
Finite Fubini transfers a pointwise amplified-test upper bound to an exception bound for arbitrary whole-unit predicates.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AmplifiedTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

axiom test_fubini {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (T : A → B → Prop) :
    (∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => T a b)) =
      ∑ a,α a*cellMass β (T a)

axiom amplified_bad_mass {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (T : A → B → Prop) (bad : B → Prop) (c U : ℝ)
    (hα : Probability α) (hβ : ∀ b,0 ≤ β b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hlower : ∀ b,bad b → c ≤ cellMass α (fun a => T a b))
    (hupper : ∀ a,cellMass β (T a) ≤ U) : cellMass β bad ≤ U/c

end Lax342547.AmplifiedTests

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability α →
    (∀ (b : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (β b)) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
        (∀ (b : B), bad b → Real.instLE.le c (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a => T a b)) →
          (∀ (a : A), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β (T a)) U) →
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β bad) (instHDiv.hDiv U c)

concepts.title: Independent free-direction spaces at distinct selector labels
concepts.description:
The linear variation of a point input when a single base block varies.
For distinct labels the two direction spaces are independent, because
the empty selector and a separating singleton selector recover both
sets of input coefficients. This is the geometric input to the ordered
binary mixer tests in Lemma 5.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.ColumnRowPartitioned

/-!
---
title: Independent free-direction spaces at distinct selector labels
type: lemma
---
The linear variation of a point input when a single base block varies.
For distinct labels the two direction spaces are independent, because
the empty selector and a separating singleton selector recover both
sets of input coefficients. This is the geometric input to the ordered
binary mixer tests in Lemma 5.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AtomDirections

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

noncomputable def blockDirections {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (c : Fin n → Base k n) : Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin n) Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun i j => if i.2 = some (c j) then selectorEval s i.1 else 0

noncomputable def varyBlock {k n : ℕ} (z : Base k n → Binary) (c : Fin n → Base k n)
    (v : Fin n → Binary) : Base k n → Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun i => z i + ∑ j, if c j = i then v j else 0

axiom point_varyBlock {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (c : Fin n → Base k n) (v : Fin n → Binary) :
    point (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (varyBlock z c v) =
      point selectorEval s z + (blockDirections s c).mulVec v

axiom blockDirections_injective {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (c : Fin n → Base k n) (hc : Function.Injective c) :
    Function.Injective (blockDirections (degree := degree) s c).mulVec

axiom distinct_directions_injective {k n b degree : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (s t : Fin b → Binary) (hst : s ≠ t) (c : Fin n → Base k n) (hc : Function.Injective c) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (blockDirections (degree := degree) s c)
      (blockDirections t c)).mulVec

end Lax342547.AtomDirections

      ((Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections s c).mulVec v))

concepts.title: Actual point atoms determine cut-space functionals
concepts.description: Ambient extension realizes every atom evaluation as a local tensor functional, with actual base degree two and point-atom extensionality on the whole concrete cut space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CommonAtoms
import Lax342547.PointQuadratics
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas

/-!
---
title: Actual point atoms determine cut-space functionals
type: lemma
---
Ambient extension realizes every atom evaluation as a local tensor functional, with actual base degree two and point-atom extensionality on the whole concrete cut space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AtomFunctionals

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def starMatrixMap {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) :
    Moment k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] (Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) := by
  classical
  exact { toFun := fun M e => if l ∈ e.val then M else 0
          map_add' := by intro x y; funext e; by_cases h : l ∈ e.val <;> simp [h]
          map_smul' := by intro c x; funext e; by_cases h : l ∈ e.val <;> simp [h] }

axiom atom_local_functional {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) :
    ∃ ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Moment k n b degree),∀ s z
      (hz : ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0),
      φ (atom (degree := degree) l s z hz) = ψ (pointMoment selectorEval s z)

axiom cut_star_sum {k n b degree : ℕ} (w : Tag k → Moment k n b degree) :
    cutMap w = ∑ l,starMatrixMap l (w l)

axiom atom_functional_ext {k n b degree : ℕ} (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree))
    (hφ : ∀ l s z (hz : ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0),
      φ (atom (degree := degree) l s z hz) = 0) : φ = 0

axiom atom_base_degree {k n b degree r : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree))
    (z : (Fin r → Binary) → Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ x i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z x i = 0)
    (hdegree : ∀ i,(fun x => z x i) ∈ selectorSpan r 1) :
    (fun x => φ (atom (degree := degree) l s (z x) (hz x))) ∈ selectorSpan r 2

end Lax342547.AtomFunctionals

statements.signature:
atom_base_degree : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (φ :
    Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x))
  (z : (Fin r → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (hz :
    ∀ (x : Fin r → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
      Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z x i) 0),
  (∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan r 1) fun x => z x i) →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan r 2) fun x =>
      LinearMap.instFunLike.coe φ (Lax342547.Atoms.atom l s (z x) ⋯)

atom_functional_ext : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat}
  (φ :
    Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x)),
  (∀ (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (hz :
        ∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
          Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z i) 0),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe φ (Lax342547.Atoms.atom l s z hz)) 0) →
    Eq φ 0

atom_local_functional : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)
  (φ :
    Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x)),
  Exists fun ψ =>
    ∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (hz :
        ∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
          Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z i) 0),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe φ (Lax342547.Atoms.atom l s z hz))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ψ (Lax342547.MomentSpace.pointMoment Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s z))

cut_star_sum : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (w : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun l => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.AtomFunctionals.starMatrixMap l) (w l))

concepts.title: Actual finite atom parameterization and degrees
concepts.description: Every flavor is parameterized by its retained binary coordinates; generic parameters cover all allowed base points, and actual atom/base/selector degrees are checked.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AtomFunctionals
import Lax342547.PolynomialTensors

/-!
---
title: Actual finite atom parameterization and degrees
type: lemma
---
Every flavor is parameterized by its retained binary coordinates; generic parameters cover all allowed base points, and actual atom/base/selector degrees are checked.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AtomParameters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation

noncomputable def ParameterSize {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :=
  Fintype.card {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f}

noncomputable def parameterBase {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (x : Fin (ParameterSize n l f) → Binary) (i : Base k n) : Binary := by
  classical
  exact if hi : i ∈ retained l f then x ((Fintype.equivFin _).toFun ⟨i,hi⟩) else 0

noncomputable def parameterAtom {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (f : Flavor k)
    (x : Fin (ParameterSize n l f) → Binary) : Profile k n b degree :=
  atom l s (parameterBase l f x) (by
    classical
    intro i hi
    have hn : i ∉ retained l f := by
      rintro hf
      apply hi
      cases i with
      | inl j => exact hf.1
      | inr j => trivial
    simp [parameterBase,hn])

axiom parameter_coordinate_degree {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (i : Base k n) :
    (fun x => parameterBase l f x i) ∈ selectorSpan (ParameterSize n l f) 1

axiom generic_parameters_cover {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) :
    ∃ x : Fin (ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic) → Binary,parameterBase l Flavor.generic x = z

axiom parameter_atom_degree {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (f : Flavor k)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) :
    (fun x => φ (parameterAtom (degree := degree) l s f x)) ∈ selectorSpan (ParameterSize n l f) 2

axiom atom_selector_degree {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree))
    (z : Base k n → Binary) (hz : ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) :
    (fun s => φ (atom (degree := degree) l s z hz)) ∈ selectorSpan b (degree+degree)

axiom parameter_tensor_degree {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (f : Flavor k)
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Moment k n b degree)) :
    (fun x => ψ (pointMoment selectorEval s (parameterBase l f x))) ∈ selectorSpan (ParameterSize n l f) 2

end Lax342547.AtomParameters

atom_selector_degree : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)
  (φ :
    Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x))
  (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (hz :
    ∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
      Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z i) 0),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b (instHAdd.hAdd degree degree)) fun s =>
    LinearMap.instFunLike.coe φ (Lax342547.Atoms.atom l s z hz)

generic_parameters_cover : ∀ {k n : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
      Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z i) 0) →
    Exists fun x => Eq (Lax342547.AtomParameters.parameterBase l Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor.generic x) z

parameter_atom_degree : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k)
  (φ :
    Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x)),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem
    (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan (Lax342547.AtomParameters.ParameterSize n l f) 2) fun x =>
    LinearMap.instFunLike.coe φ (Lax342547.AtomParameters.parameterAtom l s f x)

parameter_coordinate_degree : ∀ {k n : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k) (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem
    (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan (Lax342547.AtomParameters.ParameterSize n l f) 1) fun x =>
    Lax342547.AtomParameters.parameterBase l f x i

parameter_tensor_degree : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k)
  (ψ : Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem
    (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan (Lax342547.AtomParameters.ParameterSize n l f) 2) fun x =>
    LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ψ
      (Lax342547.MomentSpace.pointMoment Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s
        (Lax342547.AtomParameters.parameterBase l f x))

concepts.title: Ordered atom products in the actual gradient form
concepts.description:
Atom-pair mixing is exactly the product sum indexed by the two incident
stars. Thus matching prescribed distinct-atom bits gives the prescribed
gradient entries. No claim of occurrence or independence of those bits
is part of this deterministic identity.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.WitnessAtoms

/-!
---
title: Ordered atom products in the actual gradient form
type: lemma
---
Atom-pair mixing is exactly the product sum indexed by the two incident
stars. Thus matching prescribed distinct-atom bits gives the prescribed
gradient entries. No claim of occurrence or independence of those bits
is part of this deterministic identity.
-/

namespace Lax342547.AtomProducts

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.WitnessAtoms
open Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions

noncomputable def evaluatedBits {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (M : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (x y : PointAtom k n b degree) (t : ProductIndex k J) : Binary := by
  classical
  exact if x.tag ∈ t.2.1.val ∧ y.tag ∈ t.2.2.val then
    (M t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' x.vector y.vector else 0

axiom mixing_atoms {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (x y : PointAtom k n b degree) :
    mixingForm L R x.profile y.profile = productSum (evaluatedBits L) (evaluatedBits R) x y

axiom gradient_atoms {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (x y : PointAtom k n b degree) :
    gradient D L R x.profile y.profile = testerEntry (x.numerical hr) (y.numerical hr) +
      productSum (evaluatedBits L) (evaluatedBits R) x y +
      productSum (evaluatedBits L) (evaluatedBits R) y x

axiom gradient_of_prescriptions {I : Type} {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (atoms : I → PointAtom k n b degree) (lbits rbits : I → I → ProductIndex k J → Binary)
    (hzero : ∀ x y t, ¬ allowedIndex ((atoms x).numerical hr) ((atoms y).numerical hr) t →
      lbits x y t = 0 ∧ rbits x y t = 0)
    (hbits : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → ∀ t,
      allowedIndex ((atoms x).numerical hr) ((atoms y).numerical hr) t →
      (L t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (atoms x).vector (atoms y).vector = lbits x y t ∧
      (R t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (atoms x).vector (atoms y).vector = rbits x y t) :
    ∀ x y, gradient D L R (atoms x).profile (atoms y).profile =
      testerEntry ((atoms x).numerical hr) ((atoms y).numerical hr) +
        productSum lbits rbits x y + productSum lbits rbits y x

end Lax342547.AtomProducts

statements.signature:
gradient_atoms : ∀ {k n b degree r J : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
  (L R :
    Fin J →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
  (x y : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom k n b degree),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) x.profile) y.profile)
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.testerEntry (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr x)
          (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr y))
        (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits L)
          (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits R) x y))
      (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits L)
        (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits R) y x))

gradient_of_prescriptions : ∀ {I : Type} {k n b degree r J : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
  (L R :
    Fin J →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
  (atoms : I → Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom k n b degree)
  (lbits rbits : I → I → Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.ProductIndex k J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (x y : I) (t : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.ProductIndex k J),
      Not
          (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.allowedIndex (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms x))
            (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms y)) t) →
        And (Eq (lbits x y t) 0) (Eq (rbits x y t) 0)) →
    (∀ (x y : I),
        Ne x y →
          ∀ (t : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.ProductIndex k J),
            Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.allowedIndex (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms x))
                (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms y)) t →
              And
                (Eq
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.toBilin' (L t.fst t.snd.fst t.snd.snd))
                      (atoms x).vector)
                    (atoms y).vector)
                  (lbits x y t))
                (Eq
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.toBilin' (R t.fst t.snd.fst t.snd.snd))
                      (atoms x).vector)
                    (atoms y).vector)
                  (rbits x y t))) →
      ∀ (x y : I),
        Eq
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) (atoms x).profile) (atoms y).profile)
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.testerEntry (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms x))
                (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms y)))
              (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum lbits rbits x y))
            (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum lbits rbits y x))

mixing_atoms : ∀ {k n b degree J : Nat}
  (L R :
    Fin J →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
  (x y : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom k n b degree),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.mixingForm L R) x.profile) y.profile)
    (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits L)
      (Lax342547.AtomProducts.evaluatedBits R) x y)

concepts.title: Point atoms and finite flavor distributions
concepts.description:
Definition 5.4 on the concrete cut space. Each atom has a single nonzero
moment representative. Generic, shared-only, and pure flavors retain
exactly their specified coordinates, and always retain the # and Z blocks.
Their parameter law samples all retained bits independently and uniformly.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConcreteCut
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import Mathlib.Tactic.DeriveFintype

/-!
---
title: Point atoms and finite flavor distributions
type: lemma
---
Definition 5.4 on the concrete cut space. Each atom has a single nonzero
moment representative. Generic, shared-only, and pure flavors retain
exactly their specified coordinates, and always retain the # and Z blocks.
Their parameter law samples all retained bits independently and uniformly.
-/

namespace Lax342547.Atoms

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.ConcreteCut

noncomputable def atomRepresentation {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k)
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) : Representation k n b degree := by
  classical
  refine ⟨Pi.single l (pointMoment selectorEval s z), ?_⟩
  intro t _
  by_cases ht : l = t
  · subst t
    simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨s, z, hz, rfl⟩
  · simp [ht]

noncomputable def atom {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) : Profile k n b degree :=
  (representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict (atomRepresentation l s z hz)

inductive Flavor (k : ℕ) where
  | generic
  | sharedOnly
  | pure (blocks : Finset (Tag k × Tag k))
  deriving Fintype

def retained {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : Set (Base k n)
  | Sum.inl ((d, t), _) => l ∈ interval k d ∧ match f with
      | .generic => True
      | .sharedOnly => False
      | .pure blocks => (d, t) ∈ blocks
  | Sum.inr (q, _) => match f with
      | .pure _ => q ≠ 0
      | _ => True

abbrev Parameters {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :=
  {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f} → Binary

noncomputable instance {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    Fintype {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f} := Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable instance {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : Fintype (Parameters n l f) := by
  classical
  exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype ({i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f} → Binary))

noncomputable def parameterValue {k n : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} (p : Parameters n l f)
    (i : Base k n) : Binary := by
  classical
  exact if hi : i ∈ retained l f then p ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0

noncomputable def parameterLaw {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    PMF (Parameters n l f) := PMF.uniformOfFintype _

def testerSummary {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary) : Option (Tag k × Tag k) → Binary
  | none => blockTester (degree := degree) hr shared (pointMoment selectorEval s z)
  | some (d, t) => blockTester (degree := degree) hr (ordinary d t) (pointMoment selectorEval s z)

axiom atom_component {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (atom (degree := degree) l s z hz).val e = if l ∈ e.val then pointMoment selectorEval s z else 0

axiom flavor_coordinates {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    retained (n := n) l f ⊆ allowedBase k n l ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, sharp i ∈ retained l f) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, free i ∈ retained l f)

axiom parameterLaw_product {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (p : Parameters n l f) :
    parameterLaw n l f p = ∏ i : {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f}, PMF.uniformOfFintype Binary (p i)

end Lax342547.Atoms

statements.signature:
atom_component : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (hz :
    ∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
      Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) → Eq (z i) 0)

    (And (∀ (i : Fin n), Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.Atoms.retained l f) (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.sharp i))

concepts.title: Sparse unselected primal vectors in barred spaces lie in the pins
concepts.description:
Fresh selected keys cannot appear in a pin decomposition of an unselected
sparse vector. Once the keys vanish, protected/private channel
complements force the private part to vanish as well. This establishes
the pin membership needed before testing the derivative table maps.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ResidualLabels
import Lax342547.SparseKeyCoefficients

/-!
---
title: Sparse unselected primal vectors in barred spaces lie in the pins
type: lemma
---
Fresh selected keys cannot appear in a pin decomposition of an unselected
sparse vector. Once the keys vanish, protected/private channel
complements force the private part to vanish as well. This establishes
the pin membership needed before testing the derivative table maps.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BarredElimination

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ResidualLabels
open Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.SparsePins

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

axiom individual_keys_zero {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hL : L.card ≤ R) (v : (Fin b → Binary) → Option (Base k n) → Binary)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (hfresh : ∀ z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (q : Vector k n b degree) (hq : q ∈ individualKeys W i a.1)
    (hpin : (∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (v s)) - q ∈ projected P i a) :
    q = 0

axiom private_primal_pin {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (a : Comp × Bool)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsCompl (protectedChannel P i a) (U i))
    (v : (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) (hv : v ∈ primal)
    (h : v ∈ P.space a ⊔ ⨆ i, (U i).map (channelEmbedding i)) :
    v ∈ P.space a

axiom sparse_barred {R : ℕ} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsCompl (protectedChannel P i a) (U i))
    (L : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : ∀ i, (L i).card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i, Disjoint (L i) (chosenLabels W i))
    (c : Fin 2 → (Fin b → Binary) → Option (Base k n) → Binary)
    (v : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary) (hv : v ∈ primal)
    (hvec : ∀ i, primalProjection i v = ∑ s ∈ L i, labelTensor selectorEval s (c i s))
    (h : v ∈ barred W P U a) : v ∈ P.space a

end Lax342547.BarredElimination

            (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max (P.space a)
              (iSup fun i => Submodule.map (Lax342547.TableSpaces.channelEmbedding i) (U i)))

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :

      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A R →
    (∀ (i z : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z)), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (A i) (W.left i z t).label)) →
      ∀ (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
        (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool),
        (∀ (i : Fin 2), IsCompl (Lax342547.TableSpaces.protectedChannel P i a) (U i)) →
          ∀ (L : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
            (∀ (i : Fin 2), instLENat.le (L i).card R) →
              (∀ (i : Fin 2), Disjoint (L i) (Lax342547.ResidualLabels.chosenLabels W i)) →
                ∀
                  (c :
                    Fin 2 →
                      (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) →

                  (v :

                    (∀ (i : Fin 2),

                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P U a) v →

concepts.title: Barred response spaces and the actual obstruction rank budget
concepts.description:
Quotient the nominal spaces by frozen pins, selected incident keys, and
private channel directions. Individual primal projections have kernel
budget K+14, giving the paper's component obstruction bound 2K+28.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
import Lax342547.PairedKeys

/-!
---
title: Barred response spaces and the actual obstruction rank budget
type: lemma
---
Quotient the nominal spaces by frozen pins, selected incident keys, and
private channel directions. Individual primal projections have kernel
budget K+14, giving the paper's component obstruction bound 2K+28.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BarredSpaces

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedKeys
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

noncomputable def individualDirection (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (x : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) : Vector k n b degree := by
  classical
  exact if (W.left i x.1 x.2).tag ∈ e.val then (W.left i x.1 x.2).vector else 0

def individualKeys (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    Submodule Binary (Vector k n b degree) :=
  Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (individualDirection W i e))

def barred (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) :
    Submodule Binary (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H) :=
  P.space a ⊔ keys (H := H) W a.1 ⊔ ⨆ z, (U z).map (channelEmbedding z)

axiom individual_key_dimension (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) : Module.finrank Binary (individualKeys W i e) ≤ 14

axiom barred_projection (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    (barred W P U a).map (primalProjection i) ≤ projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1

axiom annihilator_component_rank [Fintype H] {K : ℕ}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M (barred W P U (e, true)) (barred W P V (e, false))) :
    ∀ i, (M i).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28

end Lax342547.BarredSpaces

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    ∀ (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
      (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))
      (M : Fin 2 → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
      Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates M
          (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P U { fst := e, snd := Bool.true })
          (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P V { fst := e, snd := Bool.false }) →
        ∀ (i : Fin 2), instLENat.le (Matrix.rank (M i)) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28)

barred_projection : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool) (i : Fin 2),
  Submodule.instPartialOrder.le
    (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P U a))
    (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i a)
      (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.individualKeys W i a.fst))

individual_key_dimension : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2)
  (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  instLENat.le
    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.individualKeys W i e) x))
    14

concepts.title: Compression preserving allowed point moments and the actual cut domain
concepts.description:
A projection can fix a prescribed vector space and preserve observations,
with rank bounded by the fixed-space dimension plus the observation rank.
Blockwise base maps fix the constant coordinate and selector factor, send
allowed points to allowed points, and preserve the actual cut-profile
space. Their ranks and the transformation of target matrices are checked.
The choice fixing every pin and residual target is treated separately.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ResponseMatrices
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Bilinear
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace

/-!
---
title: Compression preserving allowed point moments and the actual cut domain
type: lemma
---
A projection can fix a prescribed vector space and preserve observations,
with rank bounded by the fixed-space dimension plus the observation rank.
Blockwise base maps fix the constant coordinate and selector factor, send
allowed points to allowed points, and preserve the actual cut-profile
space. Their ranks and the transformation of target matrices are checked.
The choice fixing every pin and residual target is treated separately.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BaseCompression

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles

axiom fixing_observed_projection {V X : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (U : Submodule Binary V) (L : V →ₗ[Binary] X) :
    ∃ p : V →ₗ[Binary] V, (∀ v ∈ U, p v = v) ∧ L.comp p = L ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range p) ≤
        Module.finrank Binary U + Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range L)

def liftBase {Coord Base : Type}
    (f : (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base → Binary)) :
    (Coord × Option Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Coord × Option Base → Binary) where
  toFun v c := match c.2 with
    | none => v (c.1, none)
    | some b => f (fun b => v (c.1, some b)) b
  map_add' v w := by
    ext ⟨a, c⟩
    cases c with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => exact congrFun (f.map_add _ _) b
  map_smul' c v := by
    ext ⟨a, q⟩
    cases q with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => exact congrFun (f.map_smul c _) b

axiom liftBase_point {Label Coord Base : Type}
    (f : (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base → Binary))
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) (z : Base → Binary) :
    liftBase (Coord := Coord) f (point p s z) = point p s (f z)

noncomputable def tensorMap {B : Type} [Fintype B] (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) :
    Matrix B B Binary →ₗ[Binary] Matrix B B Binary := by
  classical
  exact (mulRightLinearMap B Binary (LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose).comp
    (mulLeftLinearMap B Binary (LinearMap.toMatrix' f))

axiom tensorMap_point {Label Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    (f : (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base → Binary))
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) (z : Base → Binary) :
    tensorMap (liftBase f) (pointMoment p s z) = pointMoment p s (f z)

axiom tensorMap_moments {Label Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    (f : (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base → Binary)) (p : Label → Coord → Binary)
    (A : Set Base)
    (hA : ∀ z, (∀ b, b ∉ A → z b = 0) → ∀ b, b ∉ A → f z b = 0) :
    (momentSpace p A).map (tensorMap (liftBase f)) ≤ momentSpace p A

abbrev Block (k : ℕ) := (Tag k × Tag k) ⊕ Fin 3

def blockMap {k n : ℕ} (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) :
    (Base k n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base k n → Binary) where
  toFun z q := match q with
    | Sum.inl ((d, t), i) => A (Sum.inl (d, t)) (fun j => z (Sum.inl ((d, t), j))) i
    | Sum.inr (q, i) => A (Sum.inr q) (fun j => z (Sum.inr (q, j))) i
  map_add' z w := by
    ext q
    rcases q with ⟨⟨d, t⟩, i⟩ | ⟨q, i⟩ <;> exact congrFun (LinearMap.map_add _ _ _) i
  map_smul' c z := by
    ext q
    rcases q with ⟨⟨d, t⟩, i⟩ | ⟨q, i⟩ <;> exact congrFun (LinearMap.map_smul _ c _) i

axiom blockMap_allowed {k n : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) (l : Tag k)
    (z : Base k n → Binary) (hz : ∀ q, q ∉ allowedBase k n l → z q = 0) :
    ∀ q, q ∉ allowedBase k n l → blockMap A z q = 0

axiom blockMap_tagSpace {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) (l : Tag k) :
    (tagSpace k n b degree l).map (tensorMap (liftBase (blockMap A))) ≤ tagSpace k n b degree l

def componentMap {Tag V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] V) : (Component Tag → V) →ₗ[Binary] (Component Tag → V) where
  toFun x e := f (x e)
  map_add' x y := by ext e; exact f.map_add _ _
  map_smul' c x := by ext e; exact f.map_smul c _

axiom componentMap_cut {Tag V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] V) (w : Tag → V) :
    componentMap (Tag := Tag) f (cutMap w) = cutMap (fun t => f (w t))

axiom blockMap_profile {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) :
    (Profile k n b degree).map (componentMap (tensorMap (liftBase (blockMap A)))) ≤
      Profile k n b degree

axiom liftBase_rank {Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    (f : (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Base → Binary)) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (liftBase (Coord := Coord) f)) ≤
      Fintype.card Coord * (1 + Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f))

axiom matrixPair_trace {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M W : Matrix B B Binary) :
    Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair M W = Matrix.trace (M.transpose * W)

axiom matrixPair_tensorMap {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (M W : Matrix B B Binary) : by
      classical
      exact Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair M (tensorMap f W) =
        Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair
          ((LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose * M * LinearMap.toMatrix' f) W

axiom tensorMap_target {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (M : Matrix B B Binary)
    (hM : by classical exact (LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose * M * LinearMap.toMatrix' f = M) :
    (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair M).comp (tensorMap f) =
      Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair M

axiom blockMap_rank {k n : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (blockMap A)) ≤
      ∑ q, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (A q))

axiom concrete_compression_rank {k n b degree D : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary))
    (hA : ∀ q, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (A q)) ≤ D) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range
      (liftBase (Coord := SelectorCoordinates b degree) (blockMap A))) ≤
      Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * (1 + ((2 * k + 1)^2 + 3) * D)

end Lax342547.BaseCompression

      LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Fin n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
        (Fin n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (z : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

    ∀ (q : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),

concepts.title: Rank control for the frozen baseline on primal inputs
concepts.description:
Retract the primal inputs before constructing the baseline. Its channel
evaluation factors through the bounded primal retraction and the dual of
the opposite pin space. This separates the two costs and avoids paying
for arbitrary channel-channel entries of the table.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PrimalRetractions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.LinearMap

/-!
---
title: Rank control for the frozen baseline on primal inputs
type: lemma
---
Retract the primal inputs before constructing the baseline. Its channel
evaluation factors through the bounded primal retraction and the dual of
the opposite pin space. This separates the two costs and avoids paying
for arbitrary channel-channel entries of the table.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BaselineRank

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrozenBaselines

variable {V W C : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
  [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] [AddCommGroup C] [Module Binary C]

def retracted {J D Keys : Submodule Binary V} (S : Splitting J D Keys)
    (hD : D ≤ J) (p : V →ₗ[Binary] V) (hfix : ∀ v ∈ J ⊔ Keys, p v = v) :
    Splitting J D Keys where
  frozen := S.frozen.comp p
  table := S.table.comp p
  frozen_fixed v hv := by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfix v ((sup_le_sup hD le_rfl) hv)]
    exact S.frozen_fixed v hv
  table_zero v hv := by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfix v ((sup_le_sup hD le_rfl) hv)]
    exact S.table_zero v hv
  frozen_table v := by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfix v.val ((show J ≤ J ⊔ Keys from le_sup_left) v.property)]
    exact S.frozen_table v
  table_sum v := by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfix v.val ((show J ≤ J ⊔ Keys from le_sup_left) v.property)]
    exact S.table_sum v

axiom channel_rank [FiniteDimensional Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary W]
    (J D Keys U : Submodule Binary V) (J' D' Keys' : Submodule Binary W)
    (hD : D ≤ J) (S : Splitting J D Keys) (S' : Splitting J' D' Keys')
    (p : V →ₗ[Binary] V) (hfix : ∀ v ∈ J ⊔ Keys, p v = v)
    (A : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (T : J →ₗ[Binary] J' →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (q : C →ₗ[Binary] J') :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range
      ((baseline (retracted S hD p hfix) S' A T).compl₁₂ U.subtype (J'.subtype.comp q))) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (p.comp U.subtype)) + Module.finrank Binary D'

axiom bounded_baseline [FiniteDimensional Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary W]
    (J D Keys U : Submodule Binary V) (J' D' Keys' U' : Submodule Binary W)
    (hD : D ≤ J) (hD' : D' ≤ J') (hKeys : Disjoint J Keys) (hKeys' : Disjoint J' Keys')
    (hspan : J ⊔ U = ⊤) (hKeyPrimal : Keys ≤ U)
    (hspan' : J' ⊔ U' = ⊤) (hKeyPrimal' : Keys' ≤ U')
    (A : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (T : J →ₗ[Binary] J' →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (h : Compatible J D J' D' A T) :
    ∃ B : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      ExtendsFrozen D Keys D' Keys' A B ∧ (∀ v : J, ∀ w : J', B v.val w.val = T v w) ∧
      (∀ q : C →ₗ[Binary] J',
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (B.compl₁₂ U.subtype (J'.subtype.comp q))) ≤
          Module.finrank Binary ↥(J ⊓ U) + Module.finrank Binary Keys + Module.finrank Binary D') ∧
      ∀ q : C →ₗ[Binary] J,
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (B.flip.compl₁₂ U'.subtype (J.subtype.comp q))) ≤
          Module.finrank Binary ↥(J' ⊓ U') + Module.finrank Binary Keys' + Module.finrank Binary D

end Lax342547.BaselineRank
