bounded_baseline : ∀ {V W C : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup C]
  [inst_5 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary C] [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] (J D Keys U : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V)
  (J' D' Keys' U' : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W),
  Submodule.instPartialOrder.le D J →
    Submodule.instPartialOrder.le D' J' →
      Disjoint J Keys →
        Disjoint J' Keys' →
          Eq (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J U) Submodule.instTop.top →
            Submodule.instPartialOrder.le Keys U →
              Eq (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J' U') Submodule.instTop.top →
                Submodule.instPartialOrder.le Keys' U' →
                  ∀
                    (A :
                      LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V
                        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) W Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
                    (T :
                      LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J x)
                        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
                          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
                    Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.Compatible J D J' D' A T →
                      Exists fun B =>
                        And (Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.ExtendsFrozen D Keys D' Keys' A B)
                          (And
                            (∀ (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J x)
                              (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x),
                              Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B v.val) w.val)
                                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T v) w))
                            (And
                              (∀
                                (q :
                                  LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) C
                                    (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x)),
                                instLENat.le
                                  (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                    (Subtype fun x =>
                                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (B.compl₁₂ U.subtype (J'.subtype.comp q)).range x))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                                      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Submodule.instMin.min J U) x))
                                      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem Keys x)))
                                    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem D' x))))
                              (∀
                                (q :
                                  LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) C
                                    (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J x)),
                                instLENat.le
                                  (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                    (Subtype fun x =>
                                      SetLike.instMembership.mem (B.flip.compl₁₂ U'.subtype (J.subtype.comp q)).range
                                        x))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                                      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Submodule.instMin.min J' U') x))
                                      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem Keys' x)))
                                    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                                      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem D x))))))

channel_rank : ∀ {V W C : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup C]
  [inst_5 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary C] [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] (J D Keys U : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V)
  (J' D' Keys' : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W) (hD : Submodule.instPartialOrder.le D J)
  (S : Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.Splitting J D Keys) (S' : Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.Splitting J' D' Keys')
  (p : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V V)
  (hfix :
    ∀ (v : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J Keys) v → Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe p v) v)
  (A :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V
      (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) W Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (T :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J x)
      (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x)
        Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (q : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) C (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x)),
  instLENat.le
    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x =>
        SetLike.instMembership.mem
          ((Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.baseline (Lax342547.BaselineRank.retracted S hD p hfix) S' A T).compl₁₂ U.subtype
              (J'.subtype.comp q)).range
          x))
    (instHAdd.hAdd

concepts.title: The exact space of binary base moments
concepts.description:
The first assertion of Lemma 5.1: the span of $(1,z)(1,z)^T$ consists
exactly of the symmetric matrices satisfying $Z_{ii}=Z_{0i}$.
The distinguished constant coordinate is `none`.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace

/-!
---
title: The exact space of binary base moments
type: lemma
---
The first assertion of Lemma 5.1: the span of $(1,z)(1,z)^T$ consists
exactly of the symmetric matrices satisfying $Z_{ii}=Z_{0i}$.
The distinguished constant coordinate is `none`.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BaseMoments

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def baseMoment {Base : Type} (z : Base → Binary) : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary :=
  fun i j => baseEval z i * baseEval z j

def baseMomentSpace (Base : Type) : Submodule Binary (Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (baseMoment (Base := Base)))

def IsBaseMoment {Base : Type} (Z : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary) : Prop :=
  (∀ i j, Z i j = Z j i) ∧ ∀ i, Z i i = Z none i

axiom mem_baseMomentSpace_iff {Base : Type} [Fintype Base]
    (Z : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary) :
    Z ∈ baseMomentSpace Base ↔ IsBaseMoment Z

end Lax342547.BaseMoments

  Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.BaseMoments.baseMomentSpace Base) Z) (Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment Z)

concepts.title: Exact uniform bilinear character mean
concepts.description: The mean binary bilinear character under independent uniform coordinates is exactly two to minus the actual matrix rank, by orthogonality and the kernel cardinality.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BilinearWalsh

/-!
---
title: Exact uniform bilinear character mean
type: lemma
---
The mean binary bilinear character under independent uniform coordinates is exactly two to minus the actual matrix rank, by orthogonality and the kernel cardinality.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BilinearMean

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh
open scoped BigOperators

axiom bilinear_character_average {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary) :
    (∑ x : I → Binary, ∑ y : J → Binary, phase x (A.mulVec y))/
      ((2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card I*2^Fintype.card J) = 1/(2 : ℝ)^A.rank

end Lax342547.BilinearMean

statements.signature:
bilinear_character_average : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J]
  (A : Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (instHDiv.hDiv (Finset.univ.sum fun x => Finset.univ.sum fun y => Lax342547.Walsh.phase x (A.mulVec y))
      (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card I)) (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card J))))
    (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 A.rank))

concepts.title: Walsh operator bounds with explicit bilinear rank
concepts.description:
A rectangular bilinear phase factors through its column-image map.
Grouping the second weight by the fibers of that map costs at most the
kernel cardinality in squared energy. Rank-nullity then gives the exact
rank-dependent Walsh estimate, including bounded-density laws and affine
phases confined to either input group.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Walsh

/-!
---
title: Walsh operator bounds with explicit bilinear rank
type: lemma
---
A rectangular bilinear phase factors through its column-image map.
Grouping the second weight by the fibers of that map costs at most the
kernel cardinality in squared energy. Rank-nullity then gives the exact
rank-dependent Walsh estimate, including bounded-density laws and affine
phases confined to either input group.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BilinearWalsh

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh

noncomputable def correlation {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, ∑ y, f x * g y * phase x (A.mulVec y)

noncomputable def average {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  correlation A f g / (2 ^ Fintype.card I * 2 ^ Fintype.card J)

axiom correlation_sq {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ) :
    (correlation A f g) ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card I + (Fintype.card J - A.rank)) *
      (∑ x, (f x) ^ 2) * ∑ y, (g y) ^ 2

axiom uniform_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) :
    |average A f g| ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ A.rank)

axiom bounded_weight_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ) (C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C₁) (hg : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ C₂) :
    |average A f g| ≤ C₁ * C₂ / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ A.rank)

axiom density_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary)
    (α f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (β g : (J → Binary) → ℝ) (C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x ∧ α x ≤ C₁) (hβ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ β y ∧ β y ≤ C₂)
    (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) :
    |average A (fun x => α x * f x) (fun y => β y * g y)| ≤
      C₁ * C₂ / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ A.rank)

axiom separate_phase_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]

    (f : (I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (J → Binary) → ℝ)
    (u : (I → Binary) → Binary) (v : (J → Binary) → Binary) (c : Binary)

    |(∑ x, ∑ y, f x * g y * sign (dotProduct x (A.mulVec y) + u x + v y + c)) /
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I * 2 ^ Fintype.card J)| ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ A.rank)

axiom conditional_mixture_bound {T : Type} [Fintype T] {I J : T → Type}
    [∀ t, Fintype (I t)] [∀ t, Fintype (J t)]
    [∀ t, DecidableEq (I t)] [∀ t, DecidableEq (J t)]
    (A : ∀ t, Matrix (I t) (J t) Binary)
    (f : ∀ t, (I t → Binary) → ℝ) (g : ∀ t, (J t → Binary) → ℝ)
    (w C₁ C₂ : T → ℝ) (R : ℕ) (hw : ∀ t, 0 ≤ w t)
    (hC₁ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ C₁ t) (hC₂ : ∀ t, 0 ≤ C₂ t)
    (hf : ∀ t x, |f t x| ≤ C₁ t) (hg : ∀ t y, |g t y| ≤ C₂ t)
    (hR : ∀ t, R ≤ (A t).rank) :
    |∑ t, w t * average (A t) (f t) (g t)| ≤
      (∑ t, w t * C₁ t * C₂ t) / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ R)

end Lax342547.BilinearWalsh

concepts.title: Bilinear parts of ordered evaluations on every atom flavor
concepts.description:
The mixed coefficient matrix is defined directly by evaluating the two
point inputs. Its free and sharp submatrices are the corresponding
ambient matrix restrictions, independently of the tags and flavors.
Thus the rank estimates on the always retained blocks imply the required
rank bounds on each full flavor parameter space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Atoms
import Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw
import Lax342547.SharpMixerLaw

/-!
---
title: Bilinear parts of ordered evaluations on every atom flavor
type: lemma
---
The mixed coefficient matrix is defined directly by evaluating the two
point inputs. Its free and sharp submatrices are the corresponding
ambient matrix restrictions, independently of the tags and flavors.
Thus the rank estimates on the always retained blocks imply the required
rank bounds on each full flavor parameter space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BinaryMixer

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.AtomDirections

abbrev ParameterIndex {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :=
  {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained l f}

noncomputable def directions {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (ParameterIndex n l f) Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun i j => if i.2 = some j.val then selectorEval s i.1 else 0

noncomputable def pointInput {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} (p : Parameters n l f) : Vector k n b degree :=
  point selectorEval s (parameterValue p)

noncomputable def mixedMatrix {P Q : Type} [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq Q]
    (f : (P → Binary) → (Q → Binary) → Binary) : Matrix P Q Binary :=
  fun i j => f (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) + f (Pi.single i 1) 0 +
    f 0 (Pi.single j 1) + f 0 0

noncomputable def bilinearPart {k n b degree : ℕ} (A : Moment k n b degree)
    (s t : Fin b → Binary) (l m : Tag k) (f g : Flavor k) :
    Matrix (ParameterIndex n l f) (ParameterIndex n m g) Binary := by
  classical
  exact mixedMatrix (fun p q => A.toBilin' (pointInput s p) (pointInput t q))

def ambientParity {I F : Type} [Fintype F] (L : F → Matrix I I Binary)
    (a b : F → Binary) (E : Matrix I I Binary) (c d : Binary) : Matrix I I Binary :=
  (∑ j, (a j • L j + b j • (L j).transpose)) + c • E + d • E.transpose

axiom ambientParity_eval {I F : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype F]
    (L : F → Matrix I I Binary) (a b : F → Binary) (E : Matrix I I Binary) (c d : Binary)
    (x y : I → Binary) :
    (ambientParity L a b E c d).toBilin' x y =
      (∑ j, (a j * (L j).toBilin' x y + b j * (L j).toBilin' y x)) +
        c * E.toBilin' x y + d * E.toBilin' y x

axiom pointInput_affine {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} (p : Parameters n l f) :
    pointInput (degree := degree) s p = pointInput s (0 : Parameters n l f) +
      (directions s l f).mulVec p

axiom bilinearPart_eq {k n b degree : ℕ} (A : Moment k n b degree)
    (s t : Fin b → Binary) (l m : Tag k) (f g : Flavor k) :
    bilinearPart A s t l m f g = (directions s l f).transpose * A * directions t m g

axiom block_rank_le {k n b degree : ℕ} (A : Moment k n b degree)
    (s t : Fin b → Binary) (l m : Tag k) (f g : Flavor k)
    (c : Fin n → Base k n)
    (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ retained l f) (hd : ∀ i, c i ∈ retained m g) :
    ((blockDirections s c).transpose * A * blockDirections t c).rank ≤
      (bilinearPart A s t l m f g).rank

axiom parity_free_block {k n b degree r : ℕ} {F : Type} [Fintype F]
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (L : F → Moment k n b degree) (a b' : F → Binary)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (c d : Binary) (s t : Fin b → Binary) :
    (blockDirections s free).transpose * ambientParity L a b' (selfGram hr hd M) c d *
      blockDirections t free =
        OrderedMixerLaw.familyParity (blockDirections s free) (blockDirections t free) a b' L

axiom selfGram_parity_sharp_block {k n b degree r : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (c d : Binary) (s t : Fin b → Binary) :
    (blockDirections (k := k) s sharp).transpose *
      (c • selfGram hr hd M + d • (selfGram hr hd M).transpose) * blockDirections t sharp =
      c • SharpMixerLaw.weighted (fun a => s a + t a) M +
        d • (SharpMixerLaw.weighted (fun a => s a + t a) M).transpose

end Lax342547.BinaryMixer

  (L : F → Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (a b : F → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (E : Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (c d : Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)

  (l m : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (f g : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k),
  Eq (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.bilinearPart A s t l m f g)
    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
      (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.directions s l f).transpose A)
      (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.directions t m g))

block_rank_le : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (A : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree) (s t : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (l m : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (f g : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.Atoms.retained l f) (c i)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.Atoms.retained m g) (c i)) →
      instLENat.le
        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections s c).transpose
              A)
            (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections t c)).rank

parity_free_block : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {F : Type} [inst : Fintype F] (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
  (hd : instLENat.le 1 degree) (L : F → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
  (a b' : F → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (c d : Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (s t : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
      (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
        (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections s Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free).transpose
        (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.ambientParity L a b' (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.selfGram hr hd M) c d))
      (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections t Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free))
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
      (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.familyParity
        (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections s Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free)
        (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections t Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free) a b')
      L)

pointInput_affine : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat} (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) {l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k}
  {f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k} (p : Lax342547.Atoms.Parameters n l f),
  Eq (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.pointInput s p)
    (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.BinaryMixer.pointInput s 0) ((Lax342547.BinaryMixer.directions s l f).mulVec p))

  (s t : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

concepts.title: Simultaneous binary mixer estimates for all labels and flavors
concepts.description:
The good events quantify over every pair of distinct selector labels and
every nonzero ordered parity. Finite unions give a failure bound tending
to zero with n. The rank condition is n ≤ 5r, avoiding any rounding of
the paper's n/5 threshold.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BinaryMixer

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous binary mixer estimates for all labels and flavors
type: lemma
---
The good events quantify over every pair of distinct selector labels and
every nonzero ordered parity. Finite unions give a failure bound tending
to zero with n. The rank condition is n ≤ 5r, avoiding any rounding of
the paper's n/5 threshold.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BinaryMixers

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.AtomDirections Lax342547.BinaryMixer

def MixerGood {k n b degree : ℕ} {F : Type} [Fintype F]
    (L : F → Moment k n b degree) : Prop :=
  ∀ s t : Fin b → Binary, s ≠ t → ∀ a b' : F → Binary,
    (∃ j, a j ≠ 0 ∨ b' j ≠ 0) →
      n ≤ 5 * (OrderedMixerLaw.familyParity (blockDirections s free)
        (blockDirections t free) a b' L).rank

def SharpGood {n b : ℕ} (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) : Prop :=
  ∀ s t : Fin b → Binary, s ≠ t → ∀ c d : Binary, (c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0) →
    n ≤ 5 * (c • SharpMixerLaw.weighted (fun a => s a + t a) M +
      d • (SharpMixerLaw.weighted (fun a => s a + t a) M).transpose).rank

def UniformBinary {k n b degree r : ℕ} {F : Type} [Fintype F]
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (L : F → Moment k n b degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) : Prop :=
  ∀ s t : Fin b → Binary, s ≠ t → ∀ l m : Tag k, ∀ f g : Flavor k,
    ∀ a b' : F → Binary, ∀ c d : Binary,
      ((∃ j, a j ≠ 0 ∨ b' j ≠ 0) ∨ c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0) →
        n ≤ 5 * (bilinearPart (ambientParity L a b' (selfGram hr hd M) c d) s t l m f g).rank

abbrev MixerTest (b : ℕ) (F : Type) :=
  (Fin b → Binary) × (Fin b → Binary) × (F → Binary) × (F → Binary)

abbrev SharpTest (b : ℕ) := (Fin b → Binary) × (Fin b → Binary) × Binary × Binary

open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def failureBound (b m n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ := 2 ^ (2 * b + 2 * m) / 2 ^ n

axiom uniform_of_restrictions {k n b degree r : ℕ} {F : Type} [Fintype F]
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (L : F → Moment k n b degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (hL : MixerGood L) (hM : SharpGood M) : UniformBinary hr hd L M

axiom mixer_failure_bound {k n b degree : ℕ} {F : Type} [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (hn : 50 ≤ n) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (F → Moment k n b degree)).toOuterMeasure
      {L | ¬ MixerGood L} ≤ failureBound b (Fintype.card F) n

axiom sharp_failure_bound {n b : ℕ} (hn : 50 ≤ n) :

      {M | ¬ SharpGood M} ≤ failureBound b 1 n

concepts.title: Formal ordered product bits realize symmetric corrections
concepts.description:
For every ordered pair there is at least one allowed product index. One
such term realizes any off-diagonal correction to a symmetric matrix,
while symmetrization keeps its diagonal fixed. These are formal bit
prescriptions; existence of actual parameters satisfying them is a
separate probabilistic assertion.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.ZMod

/-!
---
title: Formal ordered product bits realize symmetric corrections
type: lemma
---
For every ordered pair there is at least one allowed product index. One
such term realizes any off-diagonal correction to a symmetric matrix,
while symmetrization keeps its diagonal fixed. These are formal bit
prescriptions; existence of actual parameters satisfying them is a
separate probabilistic assertion.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def productSum {I Term : Type} [Fintype Term] (L R : I → I → Term → Binary) (x y : I) : Binary :=
  ∑ t, L x y t * R x y t

axiom realize {I Term : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype Term]
    (allowed : I → I → Term → Prop) (hallowed : ∀ x y, ∃ t, allowed x y t)
    (T₀ M : Matrix I I Binary) (hT : ∀ x y, T₀ x y = T₀ y x)
    (hM : ∀ x y, M x y = M y x) (hdiag : ∀ x, M x x = T₀ x x) :
    ∃ L R : I → I → Term → Binary,
      (∀ x y t, ¬ allowed x y t → L x y t = 0 ∧ R x y t = 0) ∧
      ∀ x y, T₀ x y + productSum L R x y + productSum L R y x = M x y

end Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions

statements.signature:
realize : ∀ {I Term : Type} [Fintype I] [inst : Fintype Term] (allowed : I → I → Term → Prop),
  (∀ (x y : I), Exists fun t => allowed x y t) →
    ∀ (T₀ M : Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      (∀ (x y : I), Eq (T₀ x y) (T₀ y x)) →
        (∀ (x y : I), Eq (M x y) (M y x)) →
          (∀ (x : I), Eq (M x x) (T₀ x x)) →
            Exists fun L =>
              Exists fun R =>
                And (∀ (x y : I) (t : Term), Not (allowed x y t) → And (Eq (L x y t) 0) (Eq (R x y t) 0))
                  (∀ (x y : I),
                    Eq
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (T₀ x y) (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum L R x y))
                        (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum L R y x))
                      (M x y))

concepts.title: Bipartite capacity networks
concepts.description: Real flows encode probability laws with two marginal caps and a pointwise pair cap; infeasibility yields a cut of capacity less than one.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FlowCuts
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field

/-!
---
title: Bipartite capacity networks
type: lemma
---
Real flows encode probability laws with two marginal caps and a pointwise pair cap; infeasibility yields a cut of capacity less than one.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BipartiteFlows

open Lax342547.RealFlows
open scoped BigOperators

abbrev Vertex (A B : Type) := Bool ⊕ (A ⊕ B)

def source {A B : Type} : Vertex A B := .inl false
def sink {A B : Type} : Vertex A B := .inl true
def left {A B : Type} (a : A) : Vertex A B := .inr (.inl a)
def right {A B : Type} (b : B) : Vertex A B := .inr (.inr b)

noncomputable def capacity {A B : Type} (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) :
    Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ
  | .inl false, .inr (.inl x) => a x
  | .inr (.inl x), .inr (.inr y) => p x y
  | .inr (.inr y), .inl true => b y
  | _, _ => 0

axiom capacity_nonneg {A B : Type} (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ b y) (hp : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ p x y) :
    ∀ u v, 0 ≤ capacity a b p u v

axiom zero_capacity_flow {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t u v : V)
    (hf : Feasible c f s t) (huv : c u v = 0) (hvu : c v u = 0) : f u v = 0

axiom forward_flow_nonneg {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (f : Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ)
    (hf : Feasible (capacity a b p) f source sink) (x : A) (y : B) : 0 ≤ f (left x) (right y)

axiom left_conservation {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (f : Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ)
    (hf : Feasible (capacity a b p) f source sink) (x : A) :
    (∑ y, f (left x) (right y)) = f source (left x)

axiom right_conservation {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (f : Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ)
    (hf : Feasible (capacity a b p) f source sink) (y : B) :
    (∑ x, f (left x) (right y)) = f (right y) sink

axiom source_flow_total {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (f : Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ)
    (hf : Feasible (capacity a b p) f source sink) :
    divergence f source = ∑ x, ∑ y, f (left x) (right y)

def Law {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p ρ : A → B → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x y, 0 ≤ ρ x y) ∧ (∑ x, ∑ y, ρ x y) = 1 ∧
    (∀ x, (∑ y, ρ x y) ≤ a x) ∧ (∀ y, (∑ x, ρ x y) ≤ b y) ∧ (∀ x y, ρ x y ≤ p x y)

axiom normalized_flow_law {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (f : Vertex A B → Vertex A B → ℝ)
    (hf : Feasible (capacity a b p) f source sink)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ b y) (hp : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ p x y)
    (hv : 1 ≤ divergence f source) : ∃ ρ, Law a b p ρ

axiom infeasible_cut {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hb : ∀ y, 0 ≤ b y) (hp : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ p x y)
    (hn : ¬ ∃ ρ, Law a b p ρ) :
    ∃ Z : Finset (Vertex A B), source ∈ Z ∧ sink ∉ Z ∧
      Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity (capacity a b p) Z < 1

end Lax342547.BipartiteFlows

  (∀ (x : A), Real.instLE.le 0 (a x)) →
    (∀ (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (b y)) →
      (∀ (x : A) (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (p x y)) →

  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source
      Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink →
    ∀ (x : A) (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (f (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x) (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y))

  (∀ (x : A), Real.instLE.le 0 (a x)) →
    (∀ (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (b y)) →
      (∀ (x : A) (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (p x y)) →

          Exists fun Z =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source)
              (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink))

  (f : Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Real),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source
      Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink →
    ∀ (x : A),
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun y => f (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x) (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y))
        (f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x))

normalized_flow_law : ∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (a : A → Real) (b : B → Real) (p : A → B → Real)
  (f : Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Real),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source
      Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink →
    (∀ (x : A), Real.instLE.le 0 (a x)) →
      (∀ (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (b y)) →
        (∀ (x : A) (y : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (p x y)) →
          Real.instLE.le 1 (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source) →
            Exists fun ρ => Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Law a b p ρ

right_conservation : ∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (a : A → Real) (b : B → Real) (p : A → B → Real)
  (f : Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Real),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source
      Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink →
    ∀ (y : B),
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun x => f (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x) (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y))
        (f (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y) Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink)

source_flow_total : ∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (a : A → Real) (b : B → Real) (p : A → B → Real)
  (f : Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B → Real),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source
      Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink →
    Eq (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun y => f (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x) (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y))

zero_capacity_flow : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c f : V → V → Real) (s t u v : V),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t → Eq (c u v) 0 → Eq (c v u) 0 → Eq (f u v) 0

concepts.title: Rank of a lifted tensor sum
concepts.description: A lifted block sum has rank at least its number of nonzero blocks minus the actual column and row span deficits.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RankLoss
import Lax342547.DirectRanks
import Lax342547.SpanDeficits

/-!
---
title: Rank of a lifted tensor sum
type: lemma
---
A lifted block sum has rank at least its number of nonzero blocks minus the actual column and row span deficits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BlockDeficits

open Lax342547.SpanDeficits
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def liftedSum {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
    (M : ∀ i, Module.Dual K (T i) →ₗ[K] S i) : Module.Dual K V →ₗ[K] W := by
  classical
  let B := (LinearMap.lsum K (fun i => T i) K).symm.toLinearMap.comp (addition T).dualMap
  exact (addition S).comp ((LinearMap.piMap M).comp B)

axiom lifted_sum_rank_deficit {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
    (M : ∀ i, Module.Dual K (T i) →ₗ[K] S i) :
    (∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M i))) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (liftedSum S T M)) +
      ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K W)) +
      ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (T i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, T i : Submodule K V))

axiom nonzero_map_rank {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (hM : M ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M)

axiom nonzero_block_count_deficit {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
    (M : ∀ i, Module.Dual K (T i) →ₗ[K] S i) : by
      classical
      exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => M i ≠ 0)).card ≤
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (liftedSum S T M)) +
        ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K W)) +
        ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (T i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, T i : Submodule K V))

end Lax342547.BlockDeficits

  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
  (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
  (M :
    (i : ι) →
      LinearMap (RingHom.id K) (Module.Dual K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i) x))
        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x)),
  instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M i).range x))
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Module.finrank K
          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.BlockDeficits.liftedSum S T M).range x))
        (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
          (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x))))
      (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i) x))
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => T i) x))))

  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
  (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
  (M :
    (i : ι) →
      LinearMap (RingHom.id K) (Module.Dual K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i) x))
        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x)),
  instLENat.le (Finset.filter (fun i => Ne (M i) 0) Finset.univ).card
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Module.finrank K
          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.BlockDeficits.liftedSum S T M).range x))
        (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
          (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x))))
      (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i) x))
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => T i) x))))

nonzero_map_rank : ∀ {K V W : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_4 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K W] (M : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W),
  Ne M 0 → instLENat.le 1 (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem M.range x))

concepts.title: Boolean polynomial nonvanishing and exactification
concepts.description: Finite differences of the actual bounded-degree selector span prove its uniform nonzero mass, exactification below that threshold, and recovery across excluded labels.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation
import Lax342547.Walsh
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling

/-!
---
title: Boolean polynomial nonvanishing and exactification
type: lemma
---
Finite differences of the actual bounded-degree selector span prove its uniform nonzero mass, exactification below that threshold, and recovery across excluded labels.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BooleanWeight

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def flip {b : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (x : Fin b → Binary) : Fin b → Binary :=
  Function.update x i (x i+1)

noncomputable def derivative {b : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) :
    (Fin b → Binary) → Binary := fun x => f x+f (flip i x)

noncomputable def weight {b : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ 0)).card

axiom flip_twice {b : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (x : Fin b → Binary) : flip i (flip i x) = x

axiom derivative_monomial {b : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (S : Finset (Fin b)) :
    derivative i (monomial S) = if i ∈ S then monomial (S.erase i) else 0

axiom derivative_degree {b d : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b (d+1)) : derivative i f ∈ selectorSpan b d

axiom invariant_constant {b : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : ∀ i x, f (flip i x) = f x) : ∀ x y, f x = f y

axiom derivative_weight {b : ℕ} (i : Fin b) (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) :
    weight (derivative i f) ≤ 2*weight f

axiom constant_weight {b : ℕ} (c : Binary) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    weight (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => c) = 2^b

axiom nonzero_weight {b d : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b d) (hne : f ≠ 0) : 2^b ≤ 2^d*weight f

axiom uniform_nonzero_mass {b d : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b d) (hne : f ≠ 0) :
    1/(2 : ℝ)^d ≤ Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b)
      (fun x => f x ≠ 0)

axiom uniform_error_exactification {b d : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b d)
    (herr : Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b)
      (fun x => f x ≠ 0) < 1/(2 : ℝ)^d) : f = 0

axiom excluded_labels_exactification {b d : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b d) (E : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hzero : ∀ x, x ∉ E → f x = 0) (hE : 2^d*E.card < 2^b) : f = 0

end Lax342547.BooleanWeight

constant_weight : ∀ {b : Nat} (c : Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Ne c 0 → Eq (Lax342547.BooleanWeight.weight fun x => c) (instHPow.hPow 2 b)

derivative_degree : ∀ {b d : Nat} (i : Fin b) (f : (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b (instHAdd.hAdd d 1)) f →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b d)
      (Lax342547.BooleanWeight.derivative i f)

  Eq (Lax342547.BooleanWeight.derivative i (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.monomial S))

concepts.title: Bounded allowed derivatives preserving the actual linearized response
concepts.description:
Sections of the observed baseline pairings compress derivative outputs
inside their original perpendicular value spaces. The two actual derivative
families retain their barred domain quotients, preserve the whole response,
and have rank at most 3K+28 in an actual recipe solution. The residual matrix
rank, pure correction and final channel factorization remain separate.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ResponseSolvability
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.LinearMap

/-!
---
title: Bounded allowed derivatives preserving the actual linearized response
type: lemma
---
Sections of the observed baseline pairings compress derivative outputs
inside their original perpendicular value spaces. The two actual derivative
families retain their barred domain quotients, preserve the whole response,
and have rank at most 3K+28 in an actual recipe solution. The residual matrix
rank, pure correction and final channel factorization remain separate.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BoundedDerivatives

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open Lax342547.ChannelChanges
open Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators
open Lax342547.BarredSpaces
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.RawBaselines
open Lax342547.PairedRecipes Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions

axiom observed_projection {V X : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (L : V →ₗ[Binary] X) :
    ∃ p : V →ₗ[Binary] V, L.comp p = L ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range p) ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range L)

axiom allowed_projection {H X : Type} [Fintype H]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (G : X →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    ∃ p : perpendicular S →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S,
      (∀ c x, dotProduct (p c).val (G x) = dotProduct c.val (G x)) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range p) ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range G)

axiom bounded_derivative {D H X : Type} [AddCommGroup D] [Module Binary D]
    [Fintype H] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (G : X →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (δ : D →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) :
    ∃ δ' : D →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S,
      (∀ v x, dotProduct (δ' v).val (G x) = dotProduct (δ v).val (G x)) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range δ') ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range G)

axiom bounded_derivative_covectors {D H X : Type} [AddCommGroup D] [Module Binary D]
    [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (C : X →ₗ[Binary] Module.Dual Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : D →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) :
    ∃ δ' : D →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S,
      (∀ v x, dotProduct (δ' v).val (Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.dualCoordinates (C x)) =
        dotProduct (δ v).val (Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.dualCoordinates (C x))) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range δ') ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range C)

axiom bounded_component {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (z : Fin 2)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (R : ℕ)
    (hplus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.forward e).compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R)
    (hminus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.reverse e).flip.compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R)
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T) :
    ∃ δ' ε', componentResponse F e z D E S T δ' ε' = componentResponse F e z D E S T δ ε ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range δ') ≤ R ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ε') ≤ R

axiom bounded_response {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Bounded F K) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    ∃ δ' ε', response W P Q U V F z δ' ε' = response W P Q U V F z δ ε ∧
      ∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (δ' e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (ε' e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28

axiom bounded_recipe_solution {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (hbounded : Bounded F K)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R (endpointAtoms W i) (oppositeP W oB i))
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) (z : Fin 2) :
    ∃ (β : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
      (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z), fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε =
      ∑ i, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i) ∧
      ∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (δ e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (ε e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28

end Lax342547.BoundedDerivatives

concepts.title: Peeling with bounded new rank and normalized leaf laws

The finite partition construction is quantitative under an absolute
reference image cap. It preserves initial pins, bounds only the added
rank, and records both conditional image probabilities and density costs.

import Lax342547.LeafPartition
import Lax342547.PeelingBudget
import Lax342547.Conditioning

/-!
---
title: Peeling with bounded new rank and normalized leaf laws
type: lemma
---
The finite partition construction is quantitative under an absolute
reference image cap. It preserves initial pins, bounds only the added
rank, and records both conditional image probabilities and density costs.
-/

namespace Lax342547.BoundedPeeling

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.LeafPartition
open scoped ENNReal

def LawBound {Ω Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] (p μ : PMF Ω)
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (S : Set Ω) (α c : ℝ≥0∞) : Prop :=
  ∃ hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support,
    (∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q)) ∧
    (∀ o, (p.filter S hS) o ≤ c * μ o) ∧
    ∀ o, p.toOuterMeasure S * (p.filter S hS) o = S.indicator p o

axiom bounded_partition {Ω Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p μ : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (R : Finset Ω) (hR : (R : Set Ω) ⊆ P₀.event A)
    (D ζ ε : ℝ) (n K : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) (hε : ε ≤ ζ / 4) (hK : 4 * (D + 1) / ζ ≤ K)
    (hdensity : ∀ o, p o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * n) * μ o)
    (hreference : ∀ P : Pin Axis I N,
      μ.toOuterMeasure (P.event A) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ε) * P.rank * n))) :
    ∃ L : Finset (Finset Ω × Pin Axis I N),
      Partition p A P₀ R ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * n))) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * n))) L ∧
      ∀ z ∈ L, z.2.rank - P₀.rank ≤ K ∧
        LawBound p μ A z.2 z.1 ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * n)))
          ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K + 1) * n))

end Lax342547.BoundedPeeling

concepts.title: Actual-mass averaging over retained record-cell pairs
concepts.description: The product of conditional cell laws recovers each original rectangle after multiplication by both cell masses. Disjoint record partitions sum these rectangle estimates without counting an orientation pair more than once.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws
import Lax342547.KeyMeasures
import Lax342547.CollisionPruning

/-!
---
title: Actual-mass averaging over retained record-cell pairs
type: lemma
---
The product of conditional cell laws recovers each original rectangle after multiplication by both cell masses. Disjoint record partitions sum these rectangle estimates without counting an orientation pair more than once.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CellAveraging

open Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CollisionPruning

noncomputable def pairEventMass {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ a, ∑ b, if H a b then α a * β b else 0

noncomputable def rectangleMass {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (C : ΩA → Prop) (D : ΩB → Prop)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) : ℝ := pairEventMass α β (fun a b => C a ∧ D b ∧ H a b)

axiom conditional_rectangle_mass {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (C : ΩA → Prop) (D : ΩB → Prop)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) :
    pairEventMass (conditionalLaw α C) (conditionalLaw β D) H =
      rectangleMass α β C D H / (cellMass α C * cellMass β D)

axiom conditional_rectangle_lower {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (C : ΩA → Prop) (D : ΩB → Prop)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) (ε : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 < cellMass α C) (hD : 0 < cellMass β D)
    (h : ε ≤ pairEventMass (conditionalLaw α C) (conditionalLaw β D) H) :
    ε * (cellMass α C * cellMass β D) ≤ rectangleMass α β C D H

axiom partition_rectangle_mass {ΩA ΩB C D : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (recordA : ΩA → C) (recordB : ΩB → D)
    (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop) (valid : C → D → Prop)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ c, ∑ d, if valid c d then
        rectangleMass α β (fun a => acceptA a ∧ recordA a = c)
          (fun b => acceptB b ∧ recordB b = d) H else 0) =
        pairEventMass α β (fun a b => acceptA a ∧ acceptB b ∧ valid (recordA a) (recordB b) ∧ H a b)

noncomputable def recordMass {Ω C : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop) (c : C) : ℝ :=
  cellMass ρ (fun ω => accept ω ∧ record ω = c)

noncomputable def retainedPairs {C D : Type} [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (massA : C → ℝ) (massB : D → ℝ) (valid : C → D → Prop) (τ : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ c, ∑ d, if valid c d ∧ τ ≤ massA c ∧ τ ≤ massB d then massA c * massB d else 0

axiom pair_event_mass_nonneg {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop)
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b) : 0 ≤ pairEventMass α β H

axiom retained_cell_pair_lower {ΩA ΩB C D : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (recordA : ΩA → C) (recordB : ΩB → D)
    (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop) (valid : C → D → Prop)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) (τ ε : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hloc : ∀ c d, valid c d → τ ≤ recordMass α recordA acceptA c →
      τ ≤ recordMass β recordB acceptB d → ε ≤
        pairEventMass (conditionalLaw α (fun a => acceptA a ∧ recordA a = c))
          (conditionalLaw β (fun b => acceptB b ∧ recordB b = d)) H) :
    ε * retainedPairs (recordMass α recordA acceptA) (recordMass β recordB acceptB) valid τ ≤
      pairEventMass α β H

end Lax342547.CellAveraging

conditional_rectangle_lower : ∀ {ΩA ΩB : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] (α : ΩA → Real) (β : ΩB → Real) (C : ΩA → Prop)
  (D : ΩB → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) (ε : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α C) →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β D) →
      Real.instLE.le ε
          (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw α C)
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw β D) H) →
        Real.instLE.le
          (instHMul.hMul ε
            (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α C) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β D)))
          (Lax342547.CellAveraging.rectangleMass α β C D H)

  (D : ΩB → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw α C)
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw β D) H)
    (instHDiv.hDiv (Lax342547.CellAveraging.rectangleMass α β C D H)
      (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α C) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β D)))

pair_event_mass_nonneg : ∀ {ΩA ΩB : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] (α : ΩA → Real) (β : ΩB → Real) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop),
  (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le 0 (α a)) →
    (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le 0 (β b)) → Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass α β H)

partition_rectangle_mass : ∀ {ΩA ΩB C D : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype D] (α : ΩA → Real)
  (β : ΩB → Real) (recordA : ΩA → C) (recordB : ΩB → D) (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop)
  (valid : C → D → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun c =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun d =>
        ite (valid c d)
          (Lax342547.CellAveraging.rectangleMass α β (fun a => And (acceptA a) (Eq (recordA a) c))
            (fun b => And (acceptB b) (Eq (recordB b) d)) H)
          0)
    (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass α β fun a b =>
      And (acceptA a) (And (acceptB b) (And (valid (recordA a) (recordB b)) (H a b))))

retained_cell_pair_lower : ∀ {ΩA ΩB C D : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype D] (α : ΩA → Real)
  (β : ΩB → Real) (recordA : ΩA → C) (recordB : ΩB → D) (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop)
  (valid : C → D → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) (τ ε : Real),
  (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le 0 (α a)) →
    (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le 0 (β b)) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 τ →
        (∀ (c : C) (d : D),
            valid c d →
              Real.instLE.le τ (Lax342547.CellAveraging.recordMass α recordA acceptA c) →
                Real.instLE.le τ (Lax342547.CellAveraging.recordMass β recordB acceptB d) →
                  Real.instLE.le ε
                    (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass
                      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw α fun a => And (acceptA a) (Eq (recordA a) c))
                      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw β fun b => And (acceptB b) (Eq (recordB b) d)) H)) →
          Real.instLE.le
            (instHMul.hMul ε
              (Lax342547.CellAveraging.retainedPairs (Lax342547.CellAveraging.recordMass α recordA acceptA)
                (Lax342547.CellAveraging.recordMass β recordB acceptB) valid τ))
            (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass α β H)

concepts.title: Positive representatives of original retained cells
concepts.description: Every retained cell of positive actual mass has a positive-weight orientation representative. A pair of unchanged retained cells therefore supplies representatives for selecting the actual gradient target.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws

/-!
---
title: Positive representatives of original retained cells
type: lemma
---
Every retained cell of positive actual mass has a positive-weight orientation representative. A pair of unchanged retained cells therefore supplies representatives for selecting the actual gradient target.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CellRepresentatives

open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.RetainedImages

axiom positive_cell_member {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) (hC : 0 < cellMass ρ C) :
    ∃ ω, C ω ∧ 0 < ρ ω

axiom retained_cell_representatives {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (C : ΩA → Prop) (D : ΩB → Prop)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hC : τ ≤ cellMass α C) (hD : τ ≤ cellMass β D) :
    ∃ a b, C a ∧ D b ∧ 0 < α a ∧ 0 < β b

end Lax342547.CellRepresentatives

statements.signature:
positive_cell_member : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (C : Ω → Prop),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C) → Exists fun ω => And (C ω) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ ω))

retained_cell_representatives : ∀ {ΩA ΩB : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] (α : ΩA → Real) (β : ΩB → Real) (C : ΩA → Prop)
  (D : ΩB → Prop) (τ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 τ →
    Real.instLE.le τ (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α C) →
      Real.instLE.le τ (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β D) →
        Exists fun a => Exists fun b => And (C a) (And (D b) (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 (α a)) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (β b))))

concepts.title: Simultaneous assembly of opposite endpoints and reciprocal unit roles
concepts.description: The two cross forms assemble all four families of barred channel changes. Each updated primal-to-channel map receives precisely its own correction; opposite endpoint channels and reciprocal-role changes contribute zero. The exact formulas cover both cross orientations and their flips.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RecipeChannels

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous assembly of opposite endpoints and reciprocal unit roles
type: lemma
---
The two cross forms assemble all four families of barred channel changes. Each updated primal-to-channel map receives precisely its own correction; opposite endpoint channels and reciprocal-role changes contribute zero. The exact formulas cover both cross orientations and their flips.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelAssembly

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.ChannelChanges
open Lax342547.ResponseMatrices Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.PairedKeys

noncomputable def assemble {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i) :
    CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H :=
  { forward := fun e => F.forward e +
      (∑ z, channelChange (barred W P (U e) (e, true))
        (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ z e) z) +
      ∑ i, (channelChange (barred (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q (V' e) (e, false))
        (protectedChannel P i (e, true)) (ε' i e) i).flip
    reverse := fun e => F.reverse e +
      (∑ i, channelChange (barred (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q (U' e) (e, true))
        (protectedChannel P i (e, false)) (δ' i e) i) +
      ∑ z, (channelChange (barred W P (V e) (e, false))
        (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε z e) z).flip }

axiom channel_change_coordinate {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (z j : Fin 2)
    (v : Nominal B H) (h : H) : by
      classical
      exact channelChange D S δ z v (channelEmbedding j (Pi.single h 1)) =
        if z = j then (δ (D.mkQ v)).val h else 0

axiom assembled_plus {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    fullPlus (assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε') e i z = fullPlus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ z e) i

axiom assembled_minus {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    fullMinus (assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε') e i z = fullMinus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε z e) i

axiom reciprocal_plus {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    fullPlus (assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε').flip e z i = fullPlus F.flip e z i +
      restriction (barred (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q (U' e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel P i (e, false)) (δ' i e) z

axiom reciprocal_minus {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    fullMinus (assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε').flip e z i = fullMinus F.flip e z i +
      restriction (barred (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q (V' e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel P i (e, true)) (ε' i e) z

end Lax342547.ChannelAssembly

assembled_minus : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H]
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P Q :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (U V U' V' :
    Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
      Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (F :
    Lax342547.TableContractions.CrossForms (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))
      (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)
  (δ : (z : Fin 2) → Lax342547.DerivativeResponses.PlusParameters W P Q U z)

concepts.title: Allowed channel changes and the actual table injection tests
concepts.description:
Channel changes factor through a frozen nominal quotient and take values
orthogonal to the opposite protected channel. They preserve the frozen
entries and vanish on opposite primal inputs. Orthogonal channel tests
and the actual table injection flags force a pinned primal vector to zero.
`DerivativeResponses` derives these tests from the full derivative response.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PrimalContractions
import Lax342547.TableContractions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Orthogonal

/-!
---
title: Allowed channel changes and the actual table injection tests
type: lemma
---
Channel changes factor through a frozen nominal quotient and take values
orthogonal to the opposite protected channel. They preserve the frozen
entries and vanish on opposite primal inputs. Orthogonal channel tests
and the actual table injection flags force a pinned primal vector to zero.
`DerivativeResponses` derives these tests from the full derivative response.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelChanges

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.PrimalContractions Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

def perpendicular {H : Type} [Fintype H] (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :
    Submodule Binary (H → Binary) :=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.orthogonal (dotProductBilin Binary Binary) S

def channelChange {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (z : Fin 2) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Nominal B H) :=
  (dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂
    (((perpendicular S).subtype.comp δ).comp D.mkQ) (channelProjection z)

axiom frozen {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (z : Fin 2)
    (v w : Nominal B H) (h : v ∈ D ∨ channelProjection z w ∈ S) :
    channelChange D S δ z v w = 0

axiom opposite_primal {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (z j : Fin 2)
    (v : Nominal B H) (w : B → Binary) :
    channelChange D S δ z v (primalEmbedding j w) = 0

axiom pin_frozen {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (a : Comp × Bool) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular (protectedChannel P z a))
    (v w : Nominal B H) (hw : w ∈ P.space a) :
    channelChange D (protectedChannel P z a) δ z v w = 0

axiom perpendicular_detects {H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (v : H → Binary)
    (h : ∀ c ∈ perpendicular S, dotProduct v c = 0) : v ∈ S

axiom row_injection_zero {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (hT : Injecting T) (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (hF : Extends F T)
    (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) (d : pinnedPrimal P i (e, true))
    (h : ∀ c ∈ perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)),
      dotProduct (fullPlus F e i z d.val) c = 0) : d.val = 0

axiom column_injection_zero {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (hT : Injecting T) (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (hF : Extends F T)
    (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) (d : pinnedPrimal P i (e, false))
    (h : ∀ c ∈ perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)),
      dotProduct (fullMinus F e i z d.val) c = 0) : d.val = 0

axiom channel_entry {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (z : Fin 2)
    (v : Nominal B H) (h : H) : by
      classical
      exact channelChange D S δ z v (channelEmbedding z (Pi.single h 1)) =
        (δ (D.mkQ v)).val h

end Lax342547.ChannelChanges

  (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q),
  Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T →
    ∀ (F : Lax342547.TableContractions.CrossForms Comp B H),
      Lax342547.TableContractions.Extends F T →
        ∀ (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2)
          (d :
            Subtype fun x =>
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TableSpaces.pinnedPrimal P i { fst := e, snd := Bool.false }) x),
          (∀ (c : H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem
                  (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular
                    (Lax342547.TableSpaces.protectedChannel Q z { fst := e, snd := Bool.false }))
                  c →
                Eq (dotProduct (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TableContractions.fullMinus F e i z) d.val) c) 0) →
            Eq d.val 0

  (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H))
  (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (δ :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H) D)
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular S) x))
  (z : Fin 2) (v w : Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H),
  Or (SetLike.instMembership.mem D v)
      (SetLike.instMembership.mem S (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TableSpaces.channelProjection z) w)) →
    Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.channelChange D S δ z) v) w) 0

opposite_primal : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype H]
  (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H))
  (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (δ :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H) D)
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular S) x))
  (z j : Fin 2) (v : Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H) (w : B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.channelChange D S δ z) v)
      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TableSpaces.primalEmbedding j) w))
    0

perpendicular_detects : ∀ {H : Type} [inst : Fintype H] (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (v : H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (c : H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular S) c → Eq (dotProduct v c) 0) →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem S v

pin_frozen : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H] (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N)
  (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H)) (a : Prod Comp Bool)
  (z : Fin 2)
  (δ :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H) D)
      (Subtype fun x =>
        SetLike.instMembership.mem
          (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular (Lax342547.TableSpaces.protectedChannel P z a)) x))
  (v w : Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem (P.space a) w →
    Eq
      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
          (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.channelChange D (Lax342547.TableSpaces.protectedChannel P z a) δ z) v)
        w)

row_injection_zero : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H] {P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N}
  (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q),
  Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T →
    ∀ (F : Lax342547.TableContractions.CrossForms Comp B H),
      Lax342547.TableContractions.Extends F T →
        ∀ (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2)
          (d :
            Subtype fun x =>
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TableSpaces.pinnedPrimal P i { fst := e, snd := Bool.true }) x),

              SetLike.instMembership.mem

concepts.title: Independent binary channel characters
concepts.description: Actual independent uniform channel pairs have the exact rank character mean; multiplication over channels and sampled tensors gives the mean of their actual matrix sum.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BilinearMean
import Lax342547.FiniteMoments
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field

/-!
---
title: Independent binary channel characters
type: lemma
---
Actual independent uniform channel pairs have the exact rank character mean; multiplication over channels and sampled tensors gives the mean of their actual matrix sum.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelCharacters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def channelLaw {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (_ : (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) : ℝ :=
    1/((2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card I*2^Fintype.card J)

noncomputable def character {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (c : (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) : ℝ := phase c.1 (A.mulVec c.2)

noncomputable def channelCharacter {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (h : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (c : Fin h → (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) : ℝ :=
    ∏ i, character A (c i)

axiom channel_probability {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] :
    Probability (channelLaw (I := I) (J := J))

axiom character_average {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary) :
    (∑ c, channelLaw c*character A c) = 1/(2 : ℝ)^A.rank

axiom character_add {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A B : Matrix I J Binary) (c : (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) :
    character (A+B) c = character A c*character B c

axiom character_sum {I J ι : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix I J Binary) (c : (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) :
    character (∑ i, A i) c = ∏ i, character (A i) c

axiom repeated_character_average {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : Matrix I J Binary) (h : ℕ) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : Fin h => channelLaw) c*channelCharacter h A c) =
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*A.rank)

axiom product_channel_characters {I J ι : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix I J Binary) (h : ℕ) (c : Fin h → (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) :
    (∏ i, channelCharacter h (A i) c) = channelCharacter h (∑ i, A i) c

end Lax342547.ChannelCharacters

channel_probability : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J],
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelLaw

character_add : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (A B : Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (c : Prod (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character (instHAdd.hAdd A B) c)
    (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character A c) (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character B c))

character_average : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J]
  (A : Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun c =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelLaw c) (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character A c))
    (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 A.rank))

character_sum : ∀ {I J ι : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : Fintype ι]
  (A : ι → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (c : Prod (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character (Finset.univ.sum fun i => A i) c)
    (Finset.univ.prod fun i => Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.character (A i) c)

  (A : ι → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (h : Nat)
  (c : Fin h → Prod (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.prod fun i => Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelCharacter h (A i) c)
    (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelCharacter h (Finset.univ.sum fun i => A i) c)

repeated_character_average : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I] [inst_3 : DecidableEq J]
  (A : Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (h : Nat),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun c =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw (fun x => Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelLaw) c)
        (Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelCharacter h A c))
    (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul h A.rank)))
