import Lax342547.ChannelDensity
import Lax342547.NoCoverMoments
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws

/-!
---
title: Actual raw frame channel phase tails
type: lemma
---
Reindexing the actual frame channels transfers independent channel character tails to the raw frame law with the explicit joint density factor.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelColumns

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ChannelDensity Lax342547.ChannelCharacters
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.TensorCharacters
open Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.ComponentSpaces Lax342547.ComponentDuals Lax342547.CoverProjection
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def columnsEquiv {e N : Type} (h : ℕ) :
    (e → Matrix N (Fin h) Binary × Matrix N (Fin h) Binary) ≃
      (e × Fin h → (N → Binary) × (N → Binary)) where
  toFun z := fun a => (fun i => (z a.1).1 i a.2,fun i => (z a.1).2 i a.2)
  invFun c := fun a => (fun i j => (c (a,j)).1 i,fun i j => (c (a,j)).2 i)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

axiom columns_uniform_weights {e N : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (h : ℕ)
    (z : e → Matrix N (Fin h) Binary × Matrix N (Fin h) Binary) :
    weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (e → Matrix N (Fin h) Binary × Matrix N (Fin h) Binary)) z =
      productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw) (columnsEquiv h z)

axiom pmf_weights_map {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → X) (x : X) :
    weights (p.map f) x = push (weights p) f x

axiom push_cell_mass {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype X]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (f : Ω → X) (P : X → Prop) :
    cellMass (push ρ f) P = cellMass ρ (fun o => P (f o))

axiom raw_channel_point_cap {e B N : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (h : ℕ) (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (z : e → Matrix N (Fin h) Binary × Matrix N (Fin h) Binary) :
    weights ((Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E).map (fun o a => channels (o a))) z ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card e*(h*h+2))*
        productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw) (columnsEquiv h z)

axiom raw_channel_event_cap {e B N : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (h : ℕ) (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (P : (e × Fin h → (N → Binary) × (N → Binary)) → Prop) :
    cellMass (weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E))
      (fun o => P (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (o a)))) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card e*(h*h+2))*cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw)) P

axiom no_cover_raw_phase_tail {e B N Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix N N Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p θ : ℝ)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → N → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → N → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E))
      (fun o => θ ≤ |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (A x) (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (o a)))|) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card e*(h*h+2))*
        (((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(100*r+12))))/θ^(2*t))

end Lax342547.ChannelColumns

concepts.description:

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
import Lax342547.GramNormalization

/-!
---
title: Joint channel law and its independent-column density
type: lemma
---
The raw joint channel law is constant on each individually injective
Gram orbit. Gram normalization bounds its density relative to completely
independent channel columns by 2^(h²+2), independently of the primal
dimension. The bound multiplies over the fixed set of components.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelDensity

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames
open scoped ENNReal

variable {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

def channels {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) :
    Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary := (F.X, F.Y)

noncomputable def jointLaw (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] :
    PMF (Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map channels

axiom same_gram_mass [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] (A A' B B' : Matrix N H Binary)
    (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) (hA' : Function.Injective A'.mulVec)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) (hB' : Function.Injective B'.mulVec)
    (hG : A.transpose * B = A'.transpose * B') :
    jointLaw E (A, B) = jointLaw E (A', B')

axiom point_density [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H + Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (z : Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary) :
    jointLaw E z ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card H * Fintype.card H + 2) *
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary) z

axiom event_density [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H + Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (S : Set (Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary)) :
    (jointLaw E).toOuterMeasure S ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card H * Fintype.card H + 2) *
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary)).toOuterMeasure S

axiom all_components_density {Comp : Type} [Fintype Comp] [DecidableEq Comp]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H + Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (z : Comp → Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary) :
    (RawLaw.uniformLaw E).map (fun o e => channels (o e)) z ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card Comp * (Fintype.card H * Fintype.card H + 2)) *
        PMF.uniformOfFintype (Comp → Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary) z

end Lax342547.ChannelDensity

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq Comp] [inst_5 : DecidableEq H] [inst_6 : DecidableEq N]
  (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) [inst_7 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (z : Comp → Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (PMF.instFunLike.coe
          (PMF.map (fun o e => Lax342547.ChannelDensity.channels (o e)) (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E)) z)
        (instHMul.hMul

            (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Comp) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 2)))

              (Comp → Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
            z))

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  [inst_5 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (S : Set (Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))),
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (Lax342547.ChannelDensity.jointLaw E).toOuterMeasure S)
        (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 2))
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype
                (Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
                  (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))).toOuterMeasure
            S))

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  [inst_5 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (z : Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelDensity.jointLaw E) z)
        (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card H)) 2))
          (PMF.instFunLike.coe
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype
              (Prod (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
            z))

same_gram_mass : ∀ {B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
  (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) [inst_4 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)]
  (A A' B_1 B' : Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective A.mulVec →
    Function.Injective A'.mulVec →
      Function.Injective B_1.mulVec →
        Function.Injective B'.mulVec →
          Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A.transpose B_1)
              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A'.transpose B') →
            Eq (PMF.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelDensity.jointLaw E) { fst := A, snd := B_1 })
              (PMF.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelDensity.jointLaw E) { fst := A', snd := B' })

concepts.title: Rank-controlled factorization through allowed orthogonal channels
concepts.description: A pure quotient form factors through the actual dot pairing whenever its rank fits. Orthogonality to protected channels, baseline values and bounded derivative values costs at most K+2R on each side. The resulting allowed maps realize the pure form exactly and have all required vanishing cross pairings; simultaneous gradient assembly and target routing remain separate.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CompressedResidual
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Free
import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective

/-!
---
title: Rank-controlled factorization through allowed orthogonal channels
type: lemma
---
A pure quotient form factors through the actual dot pairing whenever its rank fits. Orthogonality to protected channels, baseline values and bounded derivative values costs at most K+2R on each side. The resulting allowed maps realize the pure form exactly and have all required vanishing cross pairings; simultaneous gradient assembly and target routing remain separate.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelFactorization

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ChannelChanges
open Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.ResponseMatrices

axiom factor_through_pairing {X Y U V : Type}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module Binary Y]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module Binary U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary Y] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (β : X →ₗ[Binary] Y →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (π : U →ₗ[Binary] V →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hr : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range π)) :
    ∃ f : X →ₗ[Binary] U, ∃ g : Y →ₗ[Binary] V, π.compl₁₂ f g = β

axiom factor_in_channel_spaces {X Y H : Type} [Fintype H]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module Binary Y]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary Y]
    (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (β : X →ₗ[Binary] Y →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hr : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) ≤ Module.finrank Binary
      (LinearMap.range ((dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ S.subtype T.subtype))) :
    ∃ f : X →ₗ[Binary] S, ∃ g : Y →ₗ[Binary] T,
      (dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ (S.subtype.comp f) (T.subtype.comp g) = β

axiom perpendicular_dimension {H : Type} [Fintype H] (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :
    Module.finrank Binary S + Module.finrank Binary (perpendicular S) = Fintype.card H

axiom channel_pairing_rank {H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) {cS cT : ℕ}
    (hS : Fintype.card H ≤ Module.finrank Binary S + cS)
    (hT : Fintype.card H ≤ Module.finrank Binary T + cT) :
    Fintype.card H ≤ Module.finrank Binary
      (LinearMap.range ((dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ S.subtype T.subtype)) + cS + cT

noncomputable def remainingValues {A B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A] [AddCommGroup B] [Module Binary B]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (G : A →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (D : B →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) : Submodule Binary (H → Binary) :=
  perpendicular (S ⊔ LinearMap.range G ⊔ LinearMap.range D)

axiom remaining_values_dimension {A B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A] [AddCommGroup B] [Module Binary B]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (G : A →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (D : B →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) {K R : ℕ}
    (hS : Module.finrank Binary S ≤ K)
    (hG : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range G) ≤ R)
    (hD : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range D) ≤ R) :
    Fintype.card H ≤ Module.finrank Binary (remainingValues S G D) + (K + 2 * R)

concepts.title: Actual endpoint character products
concepts.description: Reindexing the actual channels identifies endpoint group products and their binary channel value.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorCharacters
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns
import Lax342547.Walsh

/-!
---
title: Actual endpoint character products
type: lemma
---
Reindexing the actual channels identifies endpoint group products and their binary channel value.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelGroups

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.TensorCharacters
open Lax342547.ChannelCharacters Lax342547.ChannelColumns
open scoped BigOperators

axiom sign_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (z : ι → Binary) : sign (∑ i, z i) = ∏ i,sign (z i)

axiom tensor_character_groups {e d I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype d] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : e → Matrix I J Binary) (h : ℕ)
    (c : (e × d) × Fin h → (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) :
    tensorCharacter h (fun i : e × d => A i.1) c =
      ∏ j : d,tensorCharacter h A (fun i => c ((i.1,j),i.2))

noncomputable def channelValue {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (h : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (X : Matrix I (Fin h) Binary) (Y : Matrix J (Fin h) Binary) : Binary :=
  ∑ k,dotProduct (fun i => X i k) (A.mulVec (fun j => Y j k))

axiom tensor_character_value {e N : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype N] (h : ℕ)
    (A : e → Matrix N N Binary)
    (z : e → Matrix N (Fin h) Binary × Matrix N (Fin h) Binary) :
    tensorCharacter h A (columnsEquiv h z) = sign (∑ i,channelValue h (A i) (z i).1 (z i).2)

end Lax342547.ChannelGroups

import Lax342547.ChannelCharacters
import Lax342547.MomentTails

/-!
---
title: Actual channel moments and phase tails
type: lemma
---
The checked moment expansion and exact channel character mean bound arbitrary bounded unit-side signs by the rank of the actual sampled matrix sum, and yield the explicit Markov phase tail.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ChannelMoments

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.ChannelCharacters
open scoped BigOperators

axiom channel_even_moment_bound {I J Ω : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (h t : ℕ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : Fin h => channelLaw) c*
      |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*channelCharacter h (A x) c|^(2*t)) ≤
      ∑ sample : Fin (2*t) → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2*t) => μ) sample/
        (2 : ℝ)^(h*(∑ i, A (sample i)).rank)

axiom channel_phase_tail {I J Ω : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (h t : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin h => channelLaw))
      (fun c => θ ≤ |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*channelCharacter h (A x) c|) ≤
      (∑ sample : Fin (2*t) → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2*t) => μ) sample/
        (2 : ℝ)^(h*(∑ i, A (sample i)).rank))/θ^(2*t)

end Lax342547.ChannelMoments

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq J] (μ : Ω → Real) (A : Ω → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (ψ : Ω → Real) (h t : Nat),
  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (μ x)) →
    (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le (abs (ψ x)) 1) →
      Real.instLE.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun c =>
          instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw (fun x => Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelLaw) c)
            (instHPow.hPow

concepts.title: Clique minors and the Hadwiger number
concepts.description:
A $K_t$ minor is a family of $t$ nonempty connected, pairwise disjoint branch
sets, with an edge joining every two distinct branch sets. The Hadwiger
number $h(G)$ is the largest such $t$ for a finite graph.
concepts.sourceText:
/-
Adapted from OpenAI, openai/math, commit
adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a (Apache-2.0).
Changes: Lax package separation, namespaces, explicit variables, and archive annotations.
-/
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Connectivity.Connected
import Mathlib.Order.Lattice.Nat

/-!
---
title: Clique minors and the Hadwiger number
type: definition
---
A $K_t$ minor is a family of $t$ nonempty connected, pairwise disjoint branch
sets, with an edge joining every two distinct branch sets. The Hadwiger
number $h(G)$ is the largest such $t$ for a finite graph.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CliqueMinor

def HasCliqueMinor {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B : Fin t → Set V,
    (∀ i, (G.induce (B i)).Connected) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (B i) (B j)) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∃ v ∈ B i, ∃ w ∈ B j, G.Adj v w)

noncomputable def hadwigerNumber {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
  sSup {t : ℕ | HasCliqueMinor G t}


end Lax342547.CliqueMinor

concepts.title: Coefficient phases as dot products of rank-factor images
concepts.description: A binary coefficient tensor contracted with a cross Gram matrix is the dot product of its two rank-factor image tuples, flattened over rank positions and ambient coordinates.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TargetMatrices
import Lax342547.GramTests

/-!
---
title: Coefficient phases as dot products of rank-factor images
type: lemma
---
A binary coefficient tensor contracted with a cross Gram matrix is the dot product of its two rank-factor image tuples, flattened over rank positions and ambient coordinates.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoefficientPhase

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh

noncomputable def coefficientPair {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (X : Matrix N I Binary) (Y : Matrix N J Binary) : Binary :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, C i j * (X.transpose * Y) i j

noncomputable def factorImage {I R N : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : Matrix I R Binary) (X : Matrix N I Binary) : R × N → Binary :=
  fun rn => (X * A) rn.2 rn.1

axiom coefficient_trace {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (X : Matrix N I Binary) (Y : Matrix N J Binary) :
    coefficientPair C X Y = Matrix.trace (C.transpose * (X.transpose * Y))

axiom independent_factor_phase {I J R N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype R] [Fintype N]
    (A : Matrix I R Binary) (B : Matrix J R Binary) (X : Matrix N I Binary) (Y : Matrix N J Binary) :
    coefficientPair (A * B.transpose) X Y = dotProduct (factorImage A X) (factorImage B Y)

end Lax342547.CoefficientPhase

  (Y : Matrix N J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (Lax342547.CoefficientPhase.coefficientPair C X Y)
    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C.transpose
        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul X.transpose Y)).trace

  (A : Matrix I R Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B : Matrix J R Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (X : Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Y : Matrix N J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

concepts.title: Quantitative collision and squared restriction exponents
concepts.description: Explicit scale conditions put pruning below half the accepted overlap. The surviving key collision and scalar agreement yield a proved exponential lower bound, and squared restriction recovery preserves the original-law cost.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CollisionExponents
import Lax342547.PairRecovery

/-!
---
title: Quantitative collision and squared restriction exponents
type: lemma
---
Explicit scale conditions put pruning below half the accepted overlap. The surviving key collision and scalar agreement yield a proved exponential lower bound, and squared restriction recovery preserves the original-law cost.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CollisionCosts



axiom pruning_half_overlap (η N overlap : ℝ)
    (hscale : 1 ≤ (1/200-η)*N) (hoverlap : (2:ℝ)^(-η*N) ≤ overlap) :
    (2:ℝ)^(-N/200) ≤ overlap/2

axiom collision_exponential_lower (k η N keys overlap error agreement holes : ℝ)
    (hkeys : 0 < keys) (hkeybound : keys ≤ (2:ℝ)^(k*N))
    (hoverlap : (2:ℝ)^(-η*N) ≤ overlap)
    (herror : error ≤ (2:ℝ)^(-N/200)) (hscale : 1 ≤ (1/200-η)*N)
    (hagreement : (2:ℝ)^(-N/50) ≤ agreement)
    (hholes : agreement*(overlap-error)/keys ≤ holes) :
    (2:ℝ)^(-((k+1/50+η)*N)-1) ≤ holes

axiom restriction_exponential_lower (k η N mass restricted original : ℝ)
    (hmass : (2:ℝ)^(-η*N) ≤ mass)
    (hrestricted : (2:ℝ)^(-((k+1/50+η)*N)-1) ≤ restricted)
    (hrecovery : mass^2*restricted ≤ original) :
    (2:ℝ)^(-((k+1/50+3*η)*N)-1) ≤ original

end Lax342547.CollisionCosts

concepts.title: Explicit pruning and scalar agreement exponent margins
concepts.description: The numerical bounds in the collision argument have explicit scale conditions. Original-cell pruning is exponentially smaller than overlap, and the actual scalar tests cost at most .02N when their bit count is at most .01N.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RetainedImages

/-!
---
title: Explicit pruning and scalar agreement exponent margins
type: lemma
---
The numerical bounds in the collision argument have explicit scale conditions. Original-cell pruning is exponentially smaller than overlap, and the actual scalar tests cost at most .02N when their bit count is at most .01N.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CollisionExponents



axiom pruning_power_identity (k Cn N : ℝ) :
    2 * (2 : ℝ)^(k*N) * (2 : ℝ)^Cn * (2 : ℝ)^(-(k+1/100)*N) =
      (2 : ℝ)^(1+Cn-N/100)

axiom pruning_overlap_bound (keyCount cellCount k Cn N : ℝ)
    (_hkey0 : 0 ≤ keyCount) (hcell0 : 0 ≤ cellCount)
    (hkey : keyCount ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(k*N)) (hcell : cellCount ≤ (2 : ℝ)^Cn)
    (hscale : 1+Cn ≤ N/200) :
    2 * keyCount * cellCount * (2 : ℝ)^(-(k+1/100)*N) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-N/200)

axiom scalar_agreement_power (s : ℕ) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ)^(s+1) = (2 : ℝ)^(-((s : ℝ)+1))

axiom paper_scalar_smallness (s : ℕ) (N : ℝ) (hs : (s : ℝ) ≤ N/100) (hN : 100 ≤ N) :
    (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*N) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^(s+1)

axiom paper_scalar_cost (s : ℕ) (N : ℝ) (hs : (s : ℝ) ≤ N/100) (hN : 100 ≤ N) :
    (2 : ℝ)^(-N/50) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^(s+1)

axiom collision_lower_from_overlap (overlap retained error keys agreement holes : ℝ)
    (hkeys : 0 < keys) (hagreement : 0 ≤ agreement)
    (hpruning : overlap - keys * retained ≤ error)
    (hholes : agreement * retained ≤ holes) :
    agreement * (overlap-error) / keys ≤ holes

end Lax342547.CollisionExponents

concepts.title: Pruning small unary record cells
concepts.description: The collision loss is bounded by the two cell counts times the threshold. Independent parameter averaging permits dependence of each record partition on opposite parameters.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PrimalRecords
import Lax342547.Walsh

/-!
---
title: Pruning small unary record cells
type: lemma
---
The collision loss is bounded by the two cell counts times the threshold. Independent parameter averaging permits dependence of each record partition on opposite parameters.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CollisionPruning



noncomputable def retained {C : Type} [Fintype C] (a : C → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ c, if τ ≤ a c then a c else 0

axiom retained_nonneg {C : Type} [Fintype C] (a : C → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (ha : ∀ c, 0 ≤ a c) :
    0 ≤ retained a τ

axiom retained_le {C : Type} [Fintype C] (a : C → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (ha : ∀ c, 0 ≤ a c) :
    retained a τ ≤ ∑ c, a c

axiom retained_loss {C : Type} [Fintype C] (a : C → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    (∑ c, a c) - retained a τ ≤ Fintype.card C * τ

axiom paired_pruning {Q C D : Type} [Fintype Q] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (a : Q → C → ℝ) (b : Q → D → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (ha : ∀ q c, 0 ≤ a q c) (hb : ∀ q d, 0 ≤ b q d)
    (hasum : (∑ q, ∑ c, a q c) ≤ 1) (hbsum : (∑ q, ∑ d, b q d) ≤ 1) :
    (∑ q, (∑ c, a q c) * (∑ d, b q d)) -
      (∑ q, retained (a q) τ * retained (b q) τ) ≤
        (Fintype.card C + Fintype.card D : ℝ) * τ

axiom averaged_pruning {A B Q C D : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype Q] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (pA : A → ℝ) (pB : B → ℝ)
    (a : A → B → Q → C → ℝ) (b : B → A → Q → D → ℝ) (τ : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hpA : ∀ x, 0 ≤ pA x) (hpB : ∀ y, 0 ≤ pB y)
    (hsA : ∑ x, pA x = 1) (hsB : ∑ y, pB y = 1)
    (ha : ∀ x y q c, 0 ≤ a x y q c) (hb : ∀ y x q d, 0 ≤ b y x q d)
    (haSum : ∀ x y, (∑ q, ∑ c, a x y q c) ≤ 1)
    (hbSum : ∀ y x, (∑ q, ∑ d, b y x q d) ≤ 1) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, pA x * pB y *
      ((∑ q, (∑ c, a x y q c) * (∑ d, b y x q d)) -
        (∑ q, retained (a x y q) τ * retained (b y x q) τ))) ≤
      (Fintype.card C + Fintype.card D : ℝ) * τ

end Lax342547.CollisionPruning

import Lax342547.CollisionCosts

/-!
---
title: Uniform collision scales and bounded numerical options
type: lemma
---
A fixed ambient multiplier pays linear record and scalar bit costs. An explicit overlap threshold controls pruning, and a finite option sum has a witnessed option with its precise exponent cost.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CollisionScales



axiom record_scale (C M₀ n : ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hM : 200*(C+1) ≤ M₀) :
    1+C*n ≤ M₀*n/200

    (s : ℕ) (hs : (s:ℝ) ≤ c*n) : (s:ℝ) ≤ M₀*n/100

    ∃ N₀ : ℝ, ∀ N : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N → 100 ≤ N ∧ 1 ≤ (1/200-η)*N

    (f : O → ℝ) (overlap : ℝ) (h : overlap ≤ ∑ o, f o) :
    ∃ o, overlap / Fintype.card O ≤ f o

    (hoptions : 0 < options) (hcount : options ≤ (2:ℝ)^(δ*N))
    (hprobability : (2:ℝ)^(-cost*N)/options ≤ probability) :
    (2:ℝ)^(-(cost+δ)*N) ≤ probability

concepts.description: Products of the two mode spaces have additive dimensions, gains, and deficits, allowing one greedy exposed set to control both modes.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ActualDeficits
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Prod

/-!
---
title: Combined column and row mode exposure
type: lemma
---
Products of the two mode spaces have additive dimensions, gains, and deficits, allowing one greedy exposed set to control both modes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CombinedSpans

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.GreedyTails
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def productSpaceEquiv {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (C : Submodule K V) (R : Submodule K W) :
    (C.prod R) ≃ₗ[K] C × R :=
  { toFun := fun v => (⟨v.val.1,v.property.1⟩,⟨v.val.2,v.property.2⟩)
    invFun := fun v => ⟨(v.1.val,v.2.val),v.1.property,v.2.property⟩
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := fun _ => rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
    map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }

axiom product_space_dimension {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (C : Submodule K V) (R : Submodule K W) :
    Module.finrank K (C.prod R) = Module.finrank K C+Module.finrank K R

axiom gain_product {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (U C : Submodule K V) (Z R : Submodule K W) :
    gain (U.prod Z) (C.prod R) = gain U C+gain Z R

    (U : Submodule K V) (Z : Submodule K W) (l : List ι) :
    spanAfter (fun i => (C i).prod (R i)) (U.prod Z) l =
      (spanAfter C U l).prod (spanAfter R Z l)

axiom sum_gain_product {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (C : ι → Submodule K V) (R : ι → Submodule K W)
    (U : Submodule K V) (Z : Submodule K W) (l : List ι) :
    (l.map (fun i => gain (U.prod Z) ((C i).prod (R i)))).sum =
      (l.map (fun i => gain U (C i))).sum+(l.map (fun i => gain Z (R i))).sum

axiom deficit_product {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (C : ι → Submodule K V) (R : ι → Submodule K W)
    (U : Submodule K V) (Z : Submodule K W) (l : List ι) :
    deficit (fun i => (C i).prod (R i)) (U.prod Z) l = deficit C U l+deficit R Z l

end Lax342547.CombinedSpans

import Lax342547.Atoms

/-!
---
title: Common star atoms eliminate the diagonal predictor coefficient
type: lemma
---
Actual equal shared atoms sum to zero across the odd tag star; a linear cut functional constant on those atoms must have constant zero.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CommonAtoms

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles
open scoped BigOperators

axiom common_atom_sum_zero {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ l i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) :
    (∑ l : Tag k, atom (degree := degree) l s z (hz l)) = 0

axiom common_atom_constant_zero {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ l i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary)
    (heq : ∀ l, φ (atom (degree := degree) l s z (hz l)) = γ) : γ = 0

end Lax342547.CommonAtoms

concepts.title: Exact common predictions on retained mass
concepts.description: An actual average-error bound retains a large set of units; Boolean polynomial nonvanishing turns their approximate predictions into one exact common function.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BooleanWeight
import Lax342547.MomentTails
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling

/-!
---
title: Exact common predictions on retained mass
type: lemma
---
An actual average-error bound retains a large set of units; Boolean polynomial nonvanishing turns their approximate predictions into one exact common function.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CommonExactification

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators

axiom discrepancy_mass_union {X : Type} [Fintype X]
    (α : X → ℝ) (f p q : X → Binary) (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x) :
    cellMass α (fun x => p x ≠ q x) ≤
      cellMass α (fun x => p x ≠ f x)+cellMass α (fun x => q x ≠ f x)

axiom common_prediction_exact {b d : ℕ}
    (f p q : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hp : p ∈ selectorSpan b d) (hq : q ∈ selectorSpan b d)
    (herr : cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b) (fun x => p x ≠ f x)+
      cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b) (fun x => q x ≠ f x) < 1/(2 : ℝ)^d) : p = q

axiom prediction_good_mass {U X : Type} [Fintype U] [Fintype X]
    (β : U → ℝ) (α : X → ℝ) (f : X → Binary) (p : U → X → Binary) (ε a : ℝ)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x) (ha : 0 < a)
    (herror : (∑ u, β u*cellMass α (fun x => p u x ≠ f x)) ≤ ε) :
    1-ε/a ≤ cellMass β (fun u => cellMass α (fun x => p u x ≠ f x) < a)

axiom retained_common_prediction {U : Type} [Fintype U] {b d : ℕ}
    (β : U → ℝ) (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (p : U → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) (ε a : ℝ)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hp : ∀ u, p u ∈ selectorSpan b d)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hε : ε < a) (hdegree : 2*a ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^d)
    (herror : (∑ u, β u*cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b)
      (fun x => p u x ≠ f x)) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ u₀ : U, 1-ε/a ≤ cellMass β (fun u => p u = p u₀)

end Lax342547.CommonExactification

  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b d) p →
    SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b d) q →
      Real.instLT.lt
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun x => instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 b)) fun x => Ne (p x) (f x))
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun x => instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 b)) fun x => Ne (q x) (f x)))
          (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 d)) →
        Eq p q

      (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun x => Ne (p x) (f x))
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun x => Ne (q x) (f x)))

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability β →
    (∀ (x : X), Real.instLE.le 0 (α x)) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 a →
        Real.instLE.le
            (Finset.univ.sum fun u =>
              instHMul.hMul (β u) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun x => Ne (p u x) (f x)))
            ε →
          Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv ε a))
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β fun u =>
              Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun x => Ne (p u x) (f x)) a)

  (f : (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (p : U → (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (ε a : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability β →
    (∀ (u : U), SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation.selectorSpan b d) (p u)) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 a →
        Real.instLT.lt ε a →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 a) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 d)) →
            Real.instLE.le
                (Finset.univ.sum fun u =>
                  instHMul.hMul (β u)
                    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun x => instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 b)) fun x =>
                      Ne (p u x) (f x)))

              Exists fun u₀ =>
                Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv ε a))
                  (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β fun u => Eq (p u) (p u₀))

concepts.title: Marginal transfer of common affine-slice tests
concepts.description:
A bounded marginal density transfers raw empirical variance to a quantitative
comparison with the common reference mean. Near-certain empirical success
therefore forces near-certain reference success, with the original density
cost retained. This is the probability transfer used in Lemma 9.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.EmpiricalVariance

/-!
---
title: Marginal transfer of common affine-slice tests
type: lemma
---
A bounded marginal density transfers raw empirical variance to a quantitative
comparison with the common reference mean. Near-certain empirical success
therefore forces near-certain reference success, with the original density
cost retained. This is the probability transfer used in Lemma 9.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CommonTestTransfer
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators

axiom mean_comparison {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ σ F : Ω → ℝ)
    (hσ : Probability σ) (L ε m : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcap : ∀ o,σ o ≤ L*ρ o)
    (hvar : (∑ o,ρ o*(F o-m)^2) ≤ ε) :
    |(∑ o,σ o*F o)-m| ≤ Real.sqrt (L*ε)

axiom success_transfer {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ σ F : Ω → ℝ)
    (hσ : Probability σ) (L ε m η : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcap : ∀ o,σ o ≤ L*ρ o)
    (hvar : (∑ o,ρ o*(F o-m)^2) ≤ ε)
    (hsuccess : 1-η ≤ ∑ o,σ o*F o) :
    1-η-Real.sqrt (L*ε) ≤ m

end Lax342547.CommonTestTransfer

        (∀ (o : Ω), Real.instLE.le (σ o) (instHMul.hMul L (ρ o))) →
          Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun o => instHMul.hMul (ρ o) (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub (F o) m) 2)) ε →
            Real.instLE.le (abs (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun o => instHMul.hMul (σ o) (F o)) m))
              (instHMul.hMul L ε).sqrt

        (∀ (o : Ω), Real.instLE.le (σ o) (instHMul.hMul L (ρ o))) →

concepts.title: Joint retained-cell characters across all components
concepts.description: Componentwise quotient projections and rank factors combine into one joint Walsh image. No independence between components or nominal orientations is imposed; rank sums control the complete character.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RetainedCharacters

/-!
---
title: Joint retained-cell characters across all components
type: lemma
---
Componentwise quotient projections and rank factors combine into one joint Walsh image. No independence between components or nominal orientations is imposed; rank sums control the complete character.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentCharacters

open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.CoefficientPhase
open Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.RetainedCharacters

noncomputable def blockImage {Axis N : Type} {I R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (A : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (R a) Binary) (X : ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) :
    ((Σ a, R a) × N) → Binary := fun v => factorImage (A v.1.1) (X v.1.1) (v.1.2,v.2)

axiom block_factor_pair {Axis N : Type} {I R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)] [∀ a, Fintype (R a)]
    (A B : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (R a) Binary) (X Y : ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) :
    (∑ a, coefficientPair (A a * (B a).transpose) (X a) (Y a)) =
      dotProduct (blockImage A X) (blockImage B Y)

axiom block_factor_phase {Axis N : Type} {I R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)] [∀ a, Fintype (R a)]
    (A B : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (R a) Binary) (X Y : ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) :
    sign (∑ a, coefficientPair (A a * (B a).transpose) (X a) (Y a)) =
      phase (blockImage A X) (blockImage B Y)

axiom block_image_dimension {Axis N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (R a)] :
    Fintype.card ((Σ a, R a) × N) = (∑ a, Fintype.card (R a)) * Fintype.card N

axiom component_character_bound {ΩA ΩB Axis N : Type} {I R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N]
    [∀ a, Fintype (I a)] [∀ a, Fintype (R a)]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (X : ΩA → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) (Y : ΩB → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary)
    (A B : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (R a) Binary) (c : Binary)
    (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x) (hβ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ β y)
    (hαsum : ∑ x, α x ≤ 1) (hβsum : ∑ y, β y ≤ 1)
    (hcapA : ∀ x, push α (fun ω => blockImage A (X ω)) x ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, Fintype.card (R a))*Fintype.card N)))
    (hcapB : ∀ y, push β (fun ω => blockImage B (Y ω)) y ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, Fintype.card (R a))*Fintype.card N))) :
    |∑ x, ∑ y, α x * β y * sign ((∑ a,
      coefficientPair (A a * (B a).transpose) (X x a) (Y y a)) + c)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, Fintype.card (R a))*Fintype.card N))

axiom retained_component_character_dichotomy {ΩA ΩB Axis N : Type} {I : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (X : ΩA → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) (Y : ΩB → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary)
    (D E : ∀ a, Submodule Binary (I a → Binary))
    (T : ∀ a, LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I a → Binary))
    (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x) (hβ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ β y)
    (hαsum : ∑ x, α x = 1) (hβsum : ∑ y, β y = 1)
    (hD : ∀ x y a v, v ∈ D a → ∀ w, actualForm (X x a) (Y y a) v w = T a v w)
    (hE : ∀ x y a v w, w ∈ E a → actualForm (X x a) (Y y a) v w = T a v w)
    (hcapA : ∀ (r : Axis → ℕ) (A : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (Fin (r a)) Binary),
      (∀ a, Function.Injective ((D a).mkQ.comp (A a).mulVecLin)) →
      ∀ x, push α (fun ω => blockImage A (X ω)) x ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, r a)*Fintype.card N)))
    (hcapB : ∀ (r : Axis → ℕ) (B : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (Fin (r a)) Binary),
      (∀ a, Function.Injective ((E a).mkQ.comp (B a).mulVecLin)) →
      ∀ y, push β (fun ω => blockImage B (Y ω)) y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, r a)*Fintype.card N)))
    (C : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary) : by
      classical
      let mean := ∑ x, ∑ y, α x * β y * sign (∑ a,
        (coefficientPair (C a) (X x a) (Y y a) +
          matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (T a)) (C a)))
      exact mean = 1 ∨ |mean| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card N)

end Lax342547.ComponentCharacters

import Lax342547.ComponentSpaces

/-!
---
title: Rows of diagonal tensor maps
type: lemma
---
Dualizing a componentwise tensor map preserves its componentwise row spaces through the finite product dual equivalence; these row cover spaces are closed under joins.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentDuals

def DualComponentwise {K e : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K (∀ i, V i))) : Prop :=
    Componentwise (T.map (LinearMap.lsum K V K).symm.toLinearMap)

axiom dual_componentwise_join_closed {K e : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e]
    {V : e → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)] :
    JoinClosed (DualComponentwise (K := K) (V := V))

axiom diagonal_dual_identity {K e : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e]
    {V W : e → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)] (M : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) :
    (LinearMap.piMap M).dualMap.comp (LinearMap.lsum K W K).toLinearMap =
      (LinearMap.lsum K V K).toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (M i).dualMap))

axiom diagonal_dual_range {K e : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e]
    {V W : e → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)] (M : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) :
    (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap M).dualMap).map (LinearMap.lsum K V K).symm.toLinearMap =
      coordinateSpace (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap)

end Lax342547.ComponentDuals

import Lax342547.TensorCharacters
import Lax342547.MomentTails

/-!
---
title: Moment estimates for actual component tensor phases
type: lemma
---
The finite high moment and Markov tail are bounded by the actual summed component rank under independent uniform component channels, with arbitrary bounded unit-side signs.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentMoments

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.ChannelCharacters Lax342547.TensorCharacters
open scoped BigOperators

axiom component_even_moment_bound {e I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (h t : ℕ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw) c*
      |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (A x) c|^(2*t)) ≤
      ∑ sample : Fin (2*t) → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2*t) => μ) sample/
        (2 : ℝ)^(h*∑ a : e, (∑ i, A (sample i) a).rank)

axiom component_phase_tail {e I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (h t : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw))
      (fun c => θ ≤ |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (A x) c|) ≤
      (∑ sample : Fin (2*t) → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2*t) => μ) sample/
        (2 : ℝ)^(h*∑ a : e, (∑ i, A (sample i) a).rank))/θ^(2*t)

end Lax342547.ComponentMoments

concepts.title: Componentwise no-cover rank growth
concepts.description: At the paper rank and dyadic size budgets, the full no-cover rank bound applies to actual diagonal component tensors, with the sum of their component ranks and componentwise exposed mode spaces.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.NoCoverRank
import Lax342547.ComponentDuals

/-!
---
title: Componentwise no-cover rank growth
type: lemma
---
At the paper rank and dyadic size budgets, the full no-cover rank bound applies to actual diagonal component tensors, with the sum of their component ranks and componentwise exposed mode spaces.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentRankGrowth

open Lax342547.ComponentSpaces Lax342547.ComponentDuals Lax342547.CoverProjection
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom component_no_cover_rank {K e Ω : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e] [Fintype Ω]
    {V W : e → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (V i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (W i)]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (M : Ω → ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) (r k : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hM : ∀ x, ∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M x i)) ≤ r)
    (hk : 100*r+10 ≤ k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule K (∀ i, W i), ∀ T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K (∀ i, V i)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank K S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*2^k →
      (Module.finrank K T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*2^k →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (M x)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2^k) => μ))
      (fun sample => ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ j : Fin (2^k), M (sample j) i))) : ℝ) <
        (2^(k-(100*r+10)) : ℝ)/4) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^(2^k)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))

end Lax342547.ComponentRankGrowth

  [inst_7 : (i : e) → Module K (W i)] [∀ (i : e), FiniteDimensional K (V i)] [∀ (i : e), FiniteDimensional K (W i)]
  (μ : Ω → Real) (M : Ω → (i : e) → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) (V i) (W i)) (r k : Nat) (p : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 p →
      Real.instLE.le p 1 →
        instLENat.le 1 r →
          (∀ (x : Ω),
              instLENat.le
                (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                  Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x_1 => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M x i).range x_1))
                r) →
            instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 100 r) 10) k →
              (∀ (S : Submodule K ((i : e) → W i)) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K ((i : e) → V i))),
                  Lax342547.ComponentSpaces.Componentwise S →
                    Lax342547.ComponentDuals.DualComponentwise T →
                      Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)).cast
                          (instHMul.hMul r.cast (instHPow.hPow 2 k)) →
                        Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)).cast
                            (instHMul.hMul r.cast (instHPow.hPow 2 k)) →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x =>
                              Eq (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection (LinearMap.piMap (M x)) S T) 0)

                      (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 100 r) 10))) 4))

concepts.title: Componentwise mode spaces and diagonal tensors
concepts.description: Coordinatewise mode subspaces form a join-stable cover class, and the range of a diagonal tensor map is the product of its component ranges.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoverClasses
import Lax342547.DirectRanks

/-!
---
title: Componentwise mode spaces and diagonal tensors
type: lemma
---
Coordinatewise mode subspaces form a join-stable cover class, and the range of a diagonal tensor map is the product of its component ranges.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentSpaces

open Lax342547.CoverClasses
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def coordinateSpace {K e : Type} [Field K] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)] (S : ∀ i, Submodule K (V i)) :
    Submodule K (∀ i, V i) where
  carrier := {v | ∀ i, v i ∈ S i}
  zero_mem' := fun i => (S i).zero_mem
  add_mem' := fun h g i => (S i).add_mem (h i) (g i)
  smul_mem' := fun c _ h i => (S i).smul_mem c (h i)

def Componentwise {K e : Type} [Field K] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    (T : Submodule K (∀ i, V i)) : Prop := ∃ S, T = coordinateSpace S

axiom coordinate_space_bot {K e : Type} [Field K] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)] :
    coordinateSpace (fun i => (⊥ : Submodule K (V i))) = ⊥

axiom coordinate_space_sup {K e : Type} [Field K] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    (S T : ∀ i, Submodule K (V i)) :
    coordinateSpace S ⊔ coordinateSpace T = coordinateSpace (fun i => S i ⊔ T i)

axiom componentwise_join_closed {K e : Type} [Field K] {V : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)] : JoinClosed (Componentwise (K := K) (V := V))

axiom diagonal_range {K e : Type} [Field K] {V W : e → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)] (M : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) :
    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap M) = coordinateSpace (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i))

end Lax342547.ComponentSpaces

concepts.title: Simultaneous scalar Gram agreement across components
concepts.description: A complete scalar test family expands to componentwise coefficient characters. Joint retained-cell image caps and frozen agreement imply simultaneous equality at cost two to the number of tests plus one.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ComponentCharacters
import Lax342547.ScalarGramAgreement

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous scalar Gram agreement across components
type: lemma
---
A complete scalar test family expands to componentwise coefficient characters. Joint retained-cell image caps and frozen agreement imply simultaneous equality at cost two to the number of tests plus one.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ComponentTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CoefficientPhase Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.RetainedCharacters
open Lax342547.ComponentCharacters Lax342547.FourierTests

noncomputable def coefficient {Axis S : Type} {I : Axis → Type} [Fintype S]
    (tests : S → ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary) (t : S → Binary)
    (a : Axis) : Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary := ∑ s, t s • tests s a

noncomputable def actualBits {Axis S N : Type} {I : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (tests : S → ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary)
    (X Y : ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) : S → Binary :=
  fun s => ∑ a, coefficientPair (tests s a) (X a) (Y a)

noncomputable def targetBits {Axis S : Type} {I : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (tests : S → ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary)
    (T : ∀ a, LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I a → Binary)) : S → Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun s => ∑ a, matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (T a)) (tests s a)

axiom coefficient_character {Axis S N : Type} {I : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype S] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (tests : S → ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary) (t : S → Binary)
    (X Y : ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary)
    (T : ∀ a, LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I a → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact phase t (actualBits tests X Y) * phase t (targetBits tests T) =
        sign (∑ a, (coefficientPair (coefficient tests t a) (X a) (Y a) +
          matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (T a)) (coefficient tests t a)))

axiom component_scalar_agreement {ΩA ΩB Axis N : Type} {I : Axis → Type} {S : Type}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N] [∀ a, Fintype (I a)]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (X : ΩA → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary) (Y : ΩB → ∀ a, Matrix N (I a) Binary)
    (D E : ∀ a, Submodule Binary (I a → Binary))
    (T : ∀ a, LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I a → Binary))
    (hα : ∀ x, 0 ≤ α x) (hβ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ β y)
    (hαsum : ∑ x, α x = 1) (hβsum : ∑ y, β y = 1)
    (hD : ∀ x y a v, v ∈ D a → ∀ w, actualForm (X x a) (Y y a) v w = T a v w)
    (hE : ∀ x y a v w, w ∈ E a → actualForm (X x a) (Y y a) v w = T a v w)
    (hcapA : ∀ (r : Axis → ℕ) (A : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (Fin (r a)) Binary),
      (∀ a, Function.Injective ((D a).mkQ.comp (A a).mulVecLin)) →
      ∀ x, push α (fun ω => blockImage A (X ω)) x ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, r a)*Fintype.card N)))
    (hcapB : ∀ (r : Axis → ℕ) (B : ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (Fin (r a)) Binary),
      (∀ a, Function.Injective ((E a).mkQ.comp (B a).mulVecLin)) →
      ∀ y, push β (fun ω => blockImage B (Y ω)) y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, r a)*Fintype.card N)))
    (tests : S → ∀ a, Matrix (I a) (I a) Binary)
    (hsmall : (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card N) ≤
      1 / (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card S + 1)) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card S + 1) ≤
      patternMass (fun ab : ΩA × ΩB => α ab.1 * β ab.2)
        (fun ab => actualBits tests (X ab.1) (Y ab.2)) (targetBits tests T)

end Lax342547.ComponentTests

  [inst_3 : (a : Axis) → Fintype (I a)] (tests : S → (a : Axis) → Matrix (I a) (I a) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (t : S → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (X Y : (a : Axis) → Matrix N (I a) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)

import Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression

/-!
---
title: A bounded-rank pure correction for the actual scalar recipe
type: lemma
---
The actual unrestricted pure remainder is precomposed with chosen block compression maps on both barred quotients. Its response on the full cut-profile pair space is unchanged and its component rank is at most the paper quotient bound. The genuine recipe wrapper retains the bounded derivative families and the exact recipe residual response.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CompressedResidual

open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses

noncomputable def quotientBound (k b degree K R : ℕ) : ℕ :=

    (1 + ((2 * k + 1)^2 + 3) * blockBound k b degree K R) + 2 * K

concepts.title: Concrete cut-space testers and the ordered mixer form
concepts.description:
The profile space is the image of the restricted cut map. The tester
functionals descend from actual allowed moment representatives. The
mixer sum retains the ordered component indices e,f in equation (2.9).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
import Lax342547.RawFrames

/-!
---
title: Concrete cut-space testers and the ordered mixer form
type: lemma
---
The profile space is the image of the restricted cut map. The tester
functionals descend from actual allowed moment representatives. The
mixer sum retains the ordered component indices e,f in equation (2.9).
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConcreteCut

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles

noncomputable instance (k : ℕ) : Fintype (Component (Tag k)) := by
  classical
  exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype {e : Finset (Tag k) // e.card = 2})

noncomputable instance (k : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Component (Tag k)) := Classical.decEq _

def tagSpace (k n b degree : ℕ) (l : Tag k) : Submodule Binary (Moment k n b degree) :=
  momentSpace selectorEval (allowedBase k n l)

abbrev Representation (k n b degree : ℕ) := representatives (tagSpace k n b degree)

def representationCut (k n b degree : ℕ) :
    Representation k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] (Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) :=
  cutMap.comp (representatives (tagSpace k n b degree)).subtype

abbrev Profile (k n b degree : ℕ) := LinearMap.range (representationCut k n b degree)

def representativeAt {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) :
    Representation k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Moment k n b degree :=
  (LinearMap.proj l).comp (representatives (tagSpace k n b degree)).subtype

def ordinarySum {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (t : Tag k) :
    Representation k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ l : Tag k, ∑ d : Tag k, (blockTester hr (ordinary d t)).comp (representativeAt l)

noncomputable def sharedSum {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (t : Tag k) :
    Representation k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary := by
  classical
  exact ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (blockTester hr shared).comp (representativeAt l)

/-- Unlike a and b, this quantity belongs to a specified representation. -/
def chiStar {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) :
    Representation k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ l : Tag k, (eta hr).comp (representativeAt l)

structure Testers {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) where
  aTag : Tag k → Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary
  bTag : Tag k → Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary
  ordinary_formula : ∀ t w, aTag t ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict w) = ordinarySum hr t w
  shared_formula : ∀ t w, bTag t ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict w) = sharedSum hr t w

def Testers.role {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) :
    Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary := ∑ t, D.aTag t

def profileAt {k n b degree : ℕ} (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Moment k n b degree :=
  (LinearMap.proj e).comp (LinearMap.range (representationCut k n b degree)).subtype

def matrixPairing {I : Type} [Fintype I] : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Matrix I I Binary) where
  toFun := matrixPair
  map_add' x y := by
    ext w
    simp [matrixPair, Matrix.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  map_smul' a x := by
    ext w
    simp [matrixPair, Matrix.smul_apply, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]

noncomputable def mixingForm {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Profile k n b degree) :=
  ∑ j, ∑ e, ∑ f, matrixPairing.comp (profileAt e)
    ((RawFrames.sandwich (L j e f) (R j e f)).comp (profileAt f))

noncomputable def gradient {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Profile k n b degree) :=
  GradientForm.form D.role D.aTag D.bTag (mixingForm L R)

axiom exists_testers {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) :
    Nonempty (Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)

axiom gradient_properties {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) :
    (∀ x y, gradient D L R x y = gradient D L R y x) ∧
      ∀ x, gradient D L R x x = D.role x

end Lax342547.ConcreteCut

statements.signature: exists_testers : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n), Nonempty (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)

gradient_properties : ∀ {k n b degree r J : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
  (L R :
    Fin J →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
  And
    (∀ (x y : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) x) y)
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) y) x))
    (∀ (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) x) x)
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe D.role x))

concepts.title: Concrete coordinates, quadratic testers, and the self-Gram form
concepts.description:
The coordinate realization of §2.3. The three common blocks are indexed
by 0 (S), 1 (#), and 2 (Z). Tester pairs use coordinates 2ρ and 2ρ+1
in zero-based indexing. The self-Gram matrix has the ordered tester
part and the selector-dependent # part; it has no Z entries.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TagGeometry
import Lax342547.GradientForm
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-!
---
title: Concrete coordinates, quadratic testers, and the self-Gram form
type: lemma
---
The coordinate realization of §2.3. The three common blocks are indexed
by 0 (S), 1 (#), and 2 (Z). Tester pairs use coordinates 2ρ and 2ρ+1
in zero-based indexing. The self-Gram matrix has the ordered tester
part and the selector-dependent # part; it has no Z entries.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry

abbrev Coordinate (k n b degree : ℕ) := SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option (Base k n)
noncomputable instance (k n b degree : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Coordinate k n b degree) := Classical.decEq _
abbrev Vector (k n b degree : ℕ) := Coordinate k n b degree → Binary
abbrev Moment (k n b degree : ℕ) := Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Coordinate k n b degree) Binary

def ordinary {k n : ℕ} (d t : Tag k) (i : Fin n) : Base k n := Sum.inl ((d, t), i)
def shared {k n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Base k n := Sum.inr (0, i)
def sharp {k n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Base k n := Sum.inr (1, i)
def free {k n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Base k n := Sum.inr (2, i)

def emptySelector (b degree : ℕ) : SelectorCoordinates b degree := ⟨∅, Nat.zero_le _⟩
def bitSelector {b degree : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ degree) (a : Fin b) : SelectorCoordinates b degree :=
  ⟨{a}, by simpa using h⟩

def pairLeft {n r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) (ρ : Fin r) : Fin n := ⟨2 * ρ.val, by omega⟩
def pairRight {n r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) (ρ : Fin r) : Fin n := ⟨2 * ρ.val + 1, by omega⟩

def matrixEntry {I : Type} (i j : I) : Matrix I I Binary →ₗ[Binary] Binary where
  toFun w := w i j
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def blockTester {k n b degree r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) (c : Fin n → Base k n) :
    Moment k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ ρ : Fin r, matrixEntry (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairLeft h ρ)))
    (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairRight h ρ)))

def etaO {k n b degree r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) : Moment k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ d : Tag k, ∑ t : Tag k, blockTester h (ordinary d t)

def eta {k n b degree r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) : Moment k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  etaO h + blockTester h shared

def blockForm {k n b degree r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) (c : Fin n → Base k n) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Vector k n b degree) :=
  ∑ ρ : Fin r, GradientForm.rankOne
    (LinearMap.proj (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairLeft h ρ))))
    (LinearMap.proj (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairRight h ρ))))

def testerForm {k n b degree r : ℕ} (h : 2 * r ≤ n) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Vector k n b degree) :=
  (∑ d : Tag k, ∑ t : Tag k, blockForm h (ordinary d t)) + blockForm h shared

def sharpForm {k n b degree : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Vector k n b degree) :=
  ∑ a : Fin b, ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, M a i j •
    (GradientForm.rankOne (LinearMap.proj (bitSelector h a, some (sharp i)))
      (LinearMap.proj (emptySelector b degree, some (sharp j))) +
    GradientForm.rankOne (LinearMap.proj (emptySelector b degree, some (sharp i)))
      (LinearMap.proj (bitSelector h a, some (sharp j))))

noncomputable def selfGram {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) : Moment k n b degree :=
  (testerForm hr + sharpForm hd M).toMatrix'

def matrixPair {I : Type} [Fintype I] (E : Matrix I I Binary) :
    Matrix I I Binary →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, E i j • matrixEntry i j

/-- The action on all coefficient vectors induced by a common Z-coordinate change. -/
def changeZ {k n b degree : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) :
    Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Vector k n b degree where
  toFun v c := match c.2 with
    | some (Sum.inr (q, i)) => if q = 2 then ∑ j, A i j * v (c.1, some (free j)) else v c
    | _ => v c
  map_add' v w := by
    ext ⟨S, c⟩
    cases c with
    | none => rfl
    | some c =>
      cases c with
      | inl c => rfl
      | inr c =>
        rcases c with ⟨q, i⟩
        by_cases hq : q = 2 <;> simp [hq, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' a v := by
    ext ⟨S, c⟩
    cases c with
    | none => rfl
    | some c =>
      cases c with
      | inl c => rfl
      | inr c =>
        rcases c with ⟨q, i⟩
        by_cases hq : q = 2 <;> simp [hq, Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm]

    (changeZ A).toMatrix'.transpose * selfGram (k := k) (b := b) hr hd M *
      (changeZ A).toMatrix' = selfGram hr hd M

concepts.title: The concrete finite frame model and its sampled graphs
concepts.description:
Assemble the actual moment coordinates, cut-profile space, descended
testers, ordered mixer form, self-Gram matrix, frame tensors, and uniform
raw law. This algebraic construction works for arbitrary mixers. It does
not assert a connected-matching bound for those arbitrary choices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConcreteCut
import Lax342547.RawLaw
import Lax342547.SampledGraph

/-!
---
title: The concrete finite frame model and its sampled graphs
type: lemma
---
Assemble the actual moment coordinates, cut-profile space, descended
testers, ordered mixer form, self-Gram matrix, frame tensors, and uniform
raw law. This algebraic construction works for arbitrary mixers. It does
not assert a connected-matching bound for those arbitrary choices.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConcreteModel

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.RawFrames
open Lax342547.HoleRelation Lax342547.SampledGraph
open scoped ENNReal

abbrev RawVertex {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (h N : ℕ) :=
  Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M)

abbrev Ambient (k N : ℕ) := Component (Tag k) → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) Binary

structure Model {k n b degree r J h N : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) where
  testers : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr
  frame : Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M)
  holes : HoleData (RawVertex (k := k) hr hd M h N) (Profile k n b degree) (Ambient k N)
  role_eq : holes.a = testers.role
  gradient_eq : holes.T = gradient testers L R
  embedding_eq : ∀ o, holes.U o = (profileMap o).comp (Profile k n b degree).subtype
  contraction_eq : ∀ o, holes.u o = profileContraction o
  hole_symmetric : ∀ {i j}, Hole holes i j → Hole holes j i
  law : PMF (RawVertex (k := k) hr hd M h N)
  law_uniform : ∀ o, law o = (Fintype.card (RawVertex (k := k) hr hd M h N) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

noncomputable def graph {k n b degree r J h N m : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {hd : 1 ≤ degree}
    {M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary}
    {L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree}
    (D : Model (h := h) (N := N) hr hd M L R) (sample : Fin m → RawVertex (k := k) hr hd M h N) :
    SimpleGraph (Fin m) := sampleGraph (Hole D.holes) (fun {_ _} hij => D.hole_symmetric hij) sample

axiom exists_model {k n b degree r J h N : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h) ≤ N) :
    Nonempty (Model (h := h) (N := N) hr hd M L R)

axiom graph_indepNum_le_two {k n b degree r J h N m : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {hd : 1 ≤ degree}
    {M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary}
    {L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree}
    (D : Model (h := h) (N := N) hr hd M L R) (sample : Fin m → RawVertex (k := k) hr hd M h N) :
    (graph D sample).indepNum ≤ 2

end Lax342547.ConcreteModel

  (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (L R :
    Fin J →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
  instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree)) h))
      N →

concepts.title: Numerical recipes prescribe the concrete gradients on witness atoms
concepts.description:
The bit prescriptions are chosen using only tags, tester summaries, and
opposite role/p bits. They work for every later choice of actual atoms and
mixers realizing that data and those distinct-atom evaluations. This is
the deterministic prescription assertion of Lemma 6.2(iii), without an
assumption of independence or occurrence of fixed-point evaluations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AtomProducts
import Lax342547.RecipeRows

/-!
---
title: Numerical recipes prescribe the concrete gradients on witness atoms
type: lemma
---
The bit prescriptions are chosen using only tags, tester summaries, and
opposite role/p bits. They work for every later choice of actual atoms and
mixers realizing that data and those distinct-atom evaluations. This is
the deterministic prescription assertion of Lemma 6.2(iii), without an
assumption of independence or occurrence of fixed-point evaluations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.WitnessAtoms

def RecipeGradients {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {k n b degree r copies : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (atoms : I ⊕ J → PointAtom k n b degree) (p : I ⊕ J → Binary) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : I, D.role (atoms (.inl i)).profile +
    gradient D L R (∑ t : I, (atoms (.inl t)).profile) (atoms (.inl i)).profile = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : J, D.role (atoms (.inr j)).profile +
    gradient D L R (∑ t : I, (atoms (.inl t)).profile) (atoms (.inr j)).profile = p (.inr j)) ∧
  (∀ j : J, D.role (atoms (.inr j)).profile +
    gradient D L R (∑ t : J, (atoms (.inr t)).profile) (atoms (.inr j)).profile = 0) ∧
  (∀ i : I, D.role (atoms (.inl i)).profile +
    gradient D L R (∑ t : J, (atoms (.inr t)).profile) (atoms (.inl i)).profile = p (.inl i))

axiom prescribe {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J]
    {k copies : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hcopies : 0 < copies)
    (data : I ⊕ J → Numerical k) (opposite p : I ⊕ J → Binary)
    (hrole₁ : (∑ i : I, (data (Sum.inl i)).role) + (∑ i : I, opposite (Sum.inl i)) = 1)
    (hrole₂ : (∑ j : J, (data (Sum.inr j)).role) + (∑ j : J, opposite (Sum.inr j)) = 1)
    (hcoupled : (∑ i : I, (p (Sum.inl i) + opposite (Sum.inl i))) =
      ∑ j : J, (p (Sum.inr j) + opposite (Sum.inr j))) :
    ∃ lbits rbits : (I ⊕ J) → (I ⊕ J) → ProductIndex k copies → Binary,
      (∀ x y t, ¬ allowedIndex (data x) (data y) t → lbits x y t = 0 ∧ rbits x y t = 0) ∧
      ∀ (n b degree r : ℕ) (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
        (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
        (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
        (atoms : I ⊕ J → PointAtom k n b degree),
        (∀ x, (atoms x).numerical hr = data x) →
        (∀ x y, x ≠ y → ∀ t, allowedIndex (data x) (data y) t →
          (L t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (atoms x).vector (atoms y).vector = lbits x y t ∧
          (R t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (atoms x).vector (atoms y).vector = rbits x y t) →
        RecipeGradients D L R atoms p

end Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes
