prescribe : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J] {k copies : Nat},
  instLTNat.lt 0 k →
    instLTNat.lt 0 copies →
      ∀ (data : Sum I J → Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.Numerical k) (opposite p : Sum I J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
        Eq
            (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (data (Sum.inl i)).role)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i => opposite (Sum.inl i)))
            1 →
          Eq
              (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun j => (data (Sum.inr j)).role)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun j => opposite (Sum.inr j)))
              1 →
            Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inl i)) (opposite (Sum.inl i)))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inr j)) (opposite (Sum.inr j))) →
              Exists fun lbits =>
                Exists fun rbits =>
                  And
                    (∀ (x y : Sum I J) (t : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.ProductIndex k copies),
                      Not (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.allowedIndex (data x) (data y) t) →
                        And (Eq (lbits x y t) 0) (Eq (rbits x y t) 0))
                    (∀ (n b degree r : Nat) (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
                      (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
                      (L R :
                        Fin copies →
                          Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
                            Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
                              Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
                      (atoms : Sum I J → Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom k n b degree),
                      (∀ (x : Sum I J), Eq (Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.PointAtom.numerical hr (atoms x)) (data x)) →
                        (∀ (x y : Sum I J),
                            Ne x y →
                              ∀ (t : Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.ProductIndex k copies),
                                Lax342547.WitnessAtoms.allowedIndex (data x) (data y) t →
                                  And
                                    (Eq
                                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                                          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.toBilin' (L t.fst t.snd.fst t.snd.snd))
                                          (atoms x).vector)
                                        (atoms y).vector)
                                      (lbits x y t))
                                    (Eq
                                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                                          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.toBilin' (R t.fst t.snd.fst t.snd.snd))
                                          (atoms x).vector)
                                        (atoms y).vector)
                                      (rbits x y t))) →
                          Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R atoms p)

concepts.title: Conditional independence of the two channel frames
concepts.description:
At fixed primal matrices P,Q, the valid X and Y completions form a
Cartesian product: their annihilator and injectivity conditions are
separate. Uniform conditioning therefore gives independent uniform
channel completions, with the actual finite normalizing factors.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
import Lax342547.GramColumns

/-!
---
title: Conditional independence of the two channel frames
type: lemma
---
At fixed primal matrices P,Q, the valid X and Y completions form a
Cartesian product: their annihilator and injectivity conditions are
separate. Uniform conditioning therefore gives independent uniform
channel completions, with the actual finite normalizing factors.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConditionalChannels

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames
open scoped ENNReal

variable {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

abbrev PlusCompletion (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) :=
  {X : Matrix N H Binary // X.transpose * Q = 0 ∧ Function.Injective
    (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) => P.mulVec z.1 + X.mulVec z.2)}

abbrev MinusCompletion (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) :=
  {Y : Matrix N H Binary // P.transpose * Y = 0 ∧ Function.Injective
    (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) => Q.mulVec z.1 + Y.mulVec z.2)}

abbrev Fiber (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) :=
  {F : Frame B H N E // F.P = P ∧ F.Q = Q}

noncomputable instance (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) : Fintype (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q) := by
  classical exact Subtype.fintype _

noncomputable instance (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) : Fintype (MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q) := by
  classical exact Subtype.fintype _

noncomputable instance (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) :
    Fintype (Fiber (H := H) E P Q) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

def channels {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary} (F : Fiber (H := H) E P Q) :
    PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q × MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q :=
  (⟨F.val.X, by
      simpa [← F.property.1, ← F.property.2] using
        And.intro F.val.plus_annihilator F.val.plus_injective⟩,
   ⟨F.val.Y, by
      simpa [← F.property.1, ← F.property.2] using
        And.intro F.val.minus_annihilator F.val.minus_injective⟩)

def assemble {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary} (hgram : P.transpose * Q = E)
    (X : PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q) (Y : MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q) :
    Fiber (H := H) E P Q :=
  ⟨{ P := P, Q := Q, X := X.val, Y := Y.val,
     plus_injective := X.property.2, minus_injective := Y.property.2,
     gram := hgram, plus_annihilator := X.property.1, minus_annihilator := Y.property.1 },
    rfl, rfl⟩

def channelEquiv {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary} (hgram : P.transpose * Q = E) :
    Fiber (H := H) E P Q ≃ (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q × MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q) where
  toFun := channels
  invFun z := assemble hgram z.1 z.2
  left_inv F := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply frameData_injective
    exact Prod.ext F.property.1.symm (Prod.ext F.property.2.symm rfl)
  right_inv z := by cases z; rfl

axiom conditional_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary}
    (hgram : P.transpose * Q = E) [Nonempty (Fiber (H := H) E P Q)]
    [Nonempty (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q)] [Nonempty (MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fiber (H := H) E P Q)).map channels =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q × MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q)

axiom conditional_point {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary}
    (hgram : P.transpose * Q = E) [Nonempty (Fiber (H := H) E P Q)]
    [Nonempty (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q)] [Nonempty (MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q)]
    (X : PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q) (Y : MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fiber (H := H) E P Q)).map channels (X, Y) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q) X *
        PMF.uniformOfFintype (MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q) Y

axiom raw_conditioning {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Binary}
    (hgram : P.transpose * Q = E) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    [Nonempty (Fiber (H := H) E P Q)]
    [Nonempty (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q)] [Nonempty (MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q)]
    (h : ∃ F ∈ {F : Frame B H N E | F.P = P ∧ F.Q = Q},
      F ∈ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).support) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).filter {F | F.P = P ∧ F.Q = Q} h).map
      (fun F => (F.X, F.Y)) =
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (PlusCompletion (H := H) P Q × MinusCompletion (H := H) P Q)).map
      (fun z => (z.1.val, z.2.val))

axiom channel_rank_failures [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) (hP : Function.Injective P.mulVec) (hQ : Function.Injective Q.mulVec)
    [Nonempty (GramColumns.GramFiber Q (0 : Matrix B H Binary))]
    [Nonempty (GramColumns.GramFiber P (0 : Matrix B H Binary))] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (GramColumns.GramFiber Q (0 : Matrix B H Binary))).toOuterMeasure
        {X | ¬ Function.Injective (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) =>
          P.mulVec z.1 + X.val.mulVec z.2)} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (2 * Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N ∧
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (GramColumns.GramFiber P (0 : Matrix B H Binary))).toOuterMeasure
        {Y | ¬ Function.Injective (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) =>
          Q.mulVec z.1 + Y.val.mulVec z.2)} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (2 * Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N

end Lax342547.ConditionalChannels

  [DecidableEq N] (P Q : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective P.mulVec →
    Function.Injective Q.mulVec →
      ∀ [inst_6 : Nonempty (Lax342547.GramColumns.GramFiber Q 0)]
        [inst_7 : Nonempty (Lax342547.GramColumns.GramFiber P 0)],
        And

            (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe

            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card B)) (Fintype.card H)))
              (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N))))
          (ENNReal.instLE.le
            (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
              (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.GramColumns.GramFiber P 0)).toOuterMeasure
              (Set.ofPred fun Y =>
                Not (Function.Injective fun z => instHAdd.hAdd (Q.mulVec z.fst) (Y.val.mulVec z.snd))))
            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card B)) (Fintype.card H)))
              (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N))))

conditional_point : ∀ {B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary},
  Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul P.transpose Q) E →
    ∀ [inst_3 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.Fiber E P Q)]
      [inst_4 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q)]
      [inst_5 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q)]
      (X : Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q) (Y : Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q),
      Eq
        (PMF.instFunLike.coe
          (PMF.map Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.channels
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.Fiber E P Q)))
          { fst := X, snd := Y })
        (instHMul.hMul (PMF.instFunLike.coe (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q)) X)
          (PMF.instFunLike.coe (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q)) Y))

conditional_uniform : ∀ {B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary},
  Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul P.transpose Q) E →
    ∀ [inst_3 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.Fiber E P Q)]
      [inst_4 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q)]
      [inst_5 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q)],
      Eq
        (PMF.map Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.channels
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.Fiber E P Q)))
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype
          (Prod (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q) (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q)))

raw_conditioning : ∀ {B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} {P Q : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary},
  Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul P.transpose Q) E →
    ∀ [inst_3 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)] [Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.Fiber E P Q)]
      [inst_5 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q)]
      [inst_6 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q)]
      (h :
        Exists fun F =>
          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Set.ofPred fun F => And (Eq F.P P) (Eq F.Q Q)) F)
            (Set.instMembership.mem (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).support F)),
      Eq
        (PMF.map (fun F => { fst := F.X, snd := F.Y })
          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).filter
            (Set.ofPred fun F => And (Eq F.P P) (Eq F.Q Q)) h))
        (PMF.map (fun z => { fst := z.fst.val, snd := z.snd.val })
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype
            (Prod (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.PlusCompletion P Q)
              (Lax342547.ConditionalChannels.MinusCompletion P Q))))

concepts.title: The affine minus-column law at a fixed plus frame
concepts.description:
With P,X fixed, the Q columns have prescribed evaluations against [P,X]
and the Y columns have zero evaluations against P. These two independent
affine column families are conditioned only on joint minus injectivity.
The failure probability before that conditioning is at most 2^(2(d+h)-N).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
import Lax342547.GramColumns

/-!
---
title: The affine minus-column law at a fixed plus frame
type: lemma
---
With P,X fixed, the Q columns have prescribed evaluations against [P,X]
and the Y columns have zero evaluations against P. These two independent
affine column families are conditioned only on joint minus injectivity.
The failure probability before that conditioning is at most 2^(2(d+h)-N).
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConditionalMinus

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.GramColumns
open scoped ENNReal

variable {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

abbrev ColumnProduct (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :=
  GramFiber (Matrix.fromCols P X) (Matrix.fromRows E 0) × GramFiber P (0 : Matrix B H Binary)

def Good {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (z : ColumnProduct E P X) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (fun w : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) =>
    z.1.val.mulVec w.1 + z.2.val.mulVec w.2)

abbrev Completion (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :=
  {z : ColumnProduct E P X // Good z}

abbrev Fiber (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :=
  {F : Frame B H N E // F.P = P ∧ F.X = X}

noncomputable instance (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :
    Fintype (Completion E P X) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

noncomputable instance (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :
    Fintype (Fiber E P X) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

omit [Fintype N] in
theorem combined_injective_iff (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec ↔
      Function.Injective (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) => P.mulVec z.1 + X.mulVec z.2) := by
  constructor
  · intro h z w he
    have h' := h (a₁ := Sum.elim z.1 z.2) (a₂ := Sum.elim w.1 w.2)
      (by simpa only [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec_sumElim] using he)
    exact Prod.ext (funext (fun b => congrFun h' (Sum.inl b)))
      (funext (fun j => congrFun h' (Sum.inr j)))
  · intro h z w he
    have h' := h (a₁ := (z ∘ Sum.inl, z ∘ Sum.inr)) (a₂ := (w ∘ Sum.inl, w ∘ Sum.inr))
      (by simpa only [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec] using he)
    funext j
    cases j with
    | inl b => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h') b
    | inr j => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h') j

def columns {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (F : Fiber E P X) : Completion E P X :=
  ⟨(⟨F.val.Q, by
       simp only [← F.property.1, ← F.property.2, Matrix.transpose_fromCols,
         Matrix.fromRows_mul, F.val.gram, F.val.plus_annihilator]⟩,
    ⟨F.val.Y, by simpa only [← F.property.1] using F.val.minus_annihilator⟩), F.val.minus_injective⟩

def assemble {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec) (z : Completion E P X) : Fiber E P X :=
  ⟨{ P := P, X := X, Q := z.val.1.val, Y := z.val.2.val,
      plus_injective := (combined_injective_iff P X).mp hPX,
      minus_injective := z.property,
      gram := (Matrix.fromRows_inj (by
        simpa only [Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul] using z.val.1.property)).1,
      plus_annihilator := (Matrix.fromRows_inj (by
        simpa only [Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul] using z.val.1.property)).2,
      minus_annihilator := z.val.2.property }, rfl, rfl⟩

def completionEquiv {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec) : Fiber E P X ≃ Completion E P X where
  toFun := columns
  invFun := assemble hPX
  left_inv F := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply frameData_injective
    exact Prod.ext F.property.1.symm (Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext F.property.2.symm rfl))
  right_inv z := by cases z; rfl

axiom conditional_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Fiber E P X)] [Nonempty (Completion E P X)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fiber E P X)).map columns = PMF.uniformOfFintype (Completion E P X)

axiom rank_failure [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary)
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec) [Nonempty (ColumnProduct E P X)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ColumnProduct E P X)).toOuterMeasure {z | ¬ Good z} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N

axiom raw_conditioning {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Matrix N B Binary} {X : Matrix N H Binary}
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [Nonempty (Fiber E P X)] [Nonempty (Completion E P X)]
    (h : ∃ F ∈ {F : Frame B H N E | F.P = P ∧ F.X = X},
      F ∈ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).support) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).filter {F | F.P = P ∧ F.X = X} h).map
      (fun F => (F.Q, F.Y)) =
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Completion E P X)).map (fun z => (z.val.1.val, z.val.2.val))

axiom completion_event_bound [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Matrix N B Binary) (X : Matrix N H Binary)
    (hPX : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols P X).mulVec)
    [Nonempty (ColumnProduct E P X)] [Nonempty (Completion E P X)]
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (S : Set (ColumnProduct E P X)) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Completion E P X)).toOuterMeasure {z | z.val ∈ S} ≤
      2 * (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ColumnProduct E P X)).toOuterMeasure S

end Lax342547.ConditionalMinus

  [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (P : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (X : Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} {P : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  {X : Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary},
  Function.Injective (P.fromCols X).mulVec →
    ∀ [inst_3 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.Fiber E P X)]

      Eq (PMF.map Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.columns (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.Fiber E P X)))
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.Completion E P X))

  (X : Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective (P.fromCols X).mulVec →
    ∀ [inst_6 : Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.ColumnProduct E P X)],
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.ColumnProduct E P X)).toOuterMeasure
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Not (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.Good z)))
        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))))

      Eq

concepts.description: The normalized subtype product event equals the product event of the ambient conditional laws, so actual retained-cell hole bounds feed the record-cell averaging theorem.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws
import Lax342547.PairRecovery
import Lax342547.CellAveraging

/-!
---
title: Conditional pair laws on original cells
type: lemma
---
The normalized subtype product event equals the product event of the ambient conditional laws, so actual retained-cell hole bounds feed the record-cell averaging theorem.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConditionalPairs

open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PairRecovery Lax342547.CellAveraging Lax342547.RetainedImages

axiom subtype_pair_event {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (C : ΩA → Prop) (D : ΩB → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) : by
    classical
    exact pairMass (subtypeWeights α C) (subtypeWeights β D) (fun a b => H a.val b.val) =
      pairEventMass (conditionalLaw α C) (conditionalLaw β D) H

end Lax342547.ConditionalPairs

  (D : ΩB → Prop) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.subtypeWeights α C)
      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.subtypeWeights β D) fun a b => H a.val b.val)
    (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw α C)
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw β D) H)

concepts.title: Actual conditioned affine coefficient dependence bounds
concepts.description:
The free parts of two independent full affine coefficient maps remain a
uniform matrix pair. This pays nominal dependence before conditioning;
conditioning each coefficient draw on an event of mass at least beta
increases that failure bound by at most beta to the power minus two.

import Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws

/-!
---
title: Actual conditioned affine coefficient dependence bounds
type: lemma
---
The free parts of two independent full affine coefficient maps remain a
uniform matrix pair. This pays nominal dependence before conditioning;
conditioning each coefficient draw on an event of mass at least beta
increases that failure bound by at most beta to the power minus two.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConditionedAffineColumns
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

def freePairMap {k n : ℕ} {D : Type} :
    (Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) →ₗ[Binary]
      (Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary) where
  toFun V := (freePart V.1,freePart V.2)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

axiom freePair_uniform {k n : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)).map
      (freePairMap (k := k) (n := n) (D := D)) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary)

axiom nominal_pair_failure {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (s : Fin b → Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {V | ¬ Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s V.1).mulVec uv.1+
          (pointColumns (degree := degree) s V.2).mulVec uv.2)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^n

axiom conditioning_pair_bound {A : Type} [Fintype A] (ρ : A → ℝ) (C : A → Prop)
    (bad : A × A → Prop) (β δ : ℝ) (hρ : ∀ a,0 ≤ ρ a) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hC : β ≤ cellMass ρ C)
    (hbad : cellMass (fun z : A × A => ρ z.1*ρ z.2) bad ≤ δ) :
    cellMass (fun z : A × A => conditionalLaw ρ C z.1*conditionalLaw ρ C z.2) bad ≤ δ/β^2

axiom conditioned_nominal_pair_failure {k n b degree : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (C : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary → Prop) (β : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 < β) (hC : β ≤ cellMass
      (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary))) C) :
    cellMass (fun V : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary =>
        conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) C V.1*
          conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) C V.2)
      (fun V => ¬ Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s V.1).mulVec uv.1+
          (pointColumns (degree := degree) s V.2).mulVec uv.2)) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/β^2

end
end Lax342547.ConditionedAffineColumns

  (C : Matrix (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n) (Option D) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary → Prop) (β : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 β →
    Real.instLE.le β
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
          (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n) (Option D) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))

          Not

              instHAdd.hAdd ((Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence.pointColumns s V.fst).mulVec uv.fst)
                ((Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence.pointColumns s V.snd).mulVec uv.snd)))
        (instHDiv.hDiv
          (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card D)) 1)) (instHPow.hPow 2 n))
          (instHPow.hPow β 2))

concepts.title: Exact finite conditioning of separated Fourier tests
concepts.description:
Fourier inversion controls signed test integrals and their normalization
separately. Division by the actual conditioning mass gives a quantitative
comparison, uniform over bounded tests.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FourierTests
import Lax342547.RelativeEntropy

/-!
---
title: Exact finite conditioning of separated Fourier tests
type: lemma
---
Fourier inversion controls signed test integrals and their normalization
separately. Division by the actual conditioning mass gives a quantitative
comparison, uniform over bounded tests.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConditionedMixing

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.FourierTests
open scoped BigOperators

axiom signed_pattern_error {Ω S : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → S → Binary) (target : S → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hchar : ∀ t : S → Binary,t ≠ 0 → |characterMean w bits target t| ≤ ε) :
    |patternMass w bits target-(∑ ω,w ω)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card S| ≤ ε

axiom conditional_test_comparison {Ω S : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (ρ f : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → S → Binary) (target : S → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (htotal : ∑ ω,ρ ω = 1) (hmean : |∑ ω,ρ ω*f ω| ≤ 1)
    (hraw : ∀ t : S → Binary,t ≠ 0 → |characterMean ρ bits target t| ≤ ε)
    (htest : ∀ t : S → Binary,t ≠ 0 → |characterMean (fun ω => ρ ω*f ω) bits target t| ≤ ε)
    (hmass : 0 < patternMass ρ bits target) :
    |patternMass (fun ω => ρ ω*f ω) bits target/patternMass ρ bits target-
      (∑ ω,ρ ω*f ω)| ≤ 2*ε/patternMass ρ bits target

axiom bounded_integral_deletion {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ f : Ω → ℝ)
    (C : Ω → Prop) (hρ : Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hC : 0 < Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C) : by
    classical
    exact |(∑ x,if C x then ρ x*f x else 0)/Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C-
        (∑ x,ρ x*f x)| ≤ 2*(1-Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C)

end Lax342547.ConditionedMixing

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →

concepts.title: Exact conditioning costs and recovery of finite probability masses
concepts.description:
Conditioning divides event probabilities and point densities by the
retained mass. Multiplying a conditional law by that actual mass recovers
the original unnormalized restriction pointwise.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Constructions
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Union

/-!
---
title: Exact conditioning costs and recovery of finite probability masses
type: lemma
---
Conditioning divides event probabilities and point densities by the
retained mass. Multiplying a conditional law by that actual mass recovers
the original unnormalized restriction pointwise.
-/

namespace Lax342547.Conditioning

open scoped ENNReal

axiom filter_event {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) :
    (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T = p.toOuterMeasure (S ∩ T) / p.toOuterMeasure S

axiom filter_event_bound {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (c : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : p.toOuterMeasure (S ∩ T) ≤ c * p.toOuterMeasure S) :
    (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T ≤ c

axiom filter_density {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : ∀ o, p o ≤ c * μ o) :
    ∀ o, (p.filter S hS) o ≤ (c / p.toOuterMeasure S) * μ o

axiom weighted_filter {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (o : Ω) :
    p.toOuterMeasure S * (p.filter S hS) o = S.indicator p o

axiom disjoint_mixture {Ω J : Type} [DecidableEq Ω] (p : PMF Ω)
    (L : Finset J) (S : J → Finset Ω)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i ∈ L, ∀ j ∈ L, i ≠ j → Disjoint (S i) (S j))
    (hS : ∀ j ∈ L, ∃ o ∈ (S j : Set Ω), o ∈ p.support) (o : Ω) :
    (∑ j : {j // j ∈ L}, p.toOuterMeasure (S j.val) * (p.filter (S j.val) (hS j.val j.property)) o) =
      (L.biUnion S : Set Ω).indicator p o

end Lax342547.Conditioning

statements.signature:
disjoint_mixture : ∀ {Ω J : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (L : Finset J) (S : J → Finset Ω),
  (∀ (i : J),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem L i → ∀ (j : J), SetLike.instMembership.mem L j → Ne i j → Disjoint (S i) (S j)) →
    ∀
      (hS :
        ∀ (j : J),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem L j →
            Exists fun o =>
              And (Set.instMembership.mem (Finset.instSetLike.coe (S j)) o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o))
      (o : Ω),
      Eq
        (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
          instHMul.hMul
            (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Finset.instSetLike.coe (S j.val)))
            (PMF.instFunLike.coe (p.filter (Finset.instSetLike.coe (S j.val)) ⋯) o))
        ((Finset.instSetLike.coe (L.biUnion S)).indicator (PMF.instFunLike.coe p) o)

filter_density : ∀ {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (c : ENNReal),
  (∀ (o : Ω), ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe p o) (instHMul.hMul c (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))) →
    ∀ (o : Ω),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (p.filter S hS) o)
        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv c (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S))
          (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))

filter_event : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)),
  Eq (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T)
    (instHDiv.hDiv (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Set.instInter.inter S T))
      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S))

filter_event_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (c : ENNReal),
  ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Set.instInter.inter S T))
      (instHMul.hMul c (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S)) →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T) c

weighted_filter : ∀ {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (o : Ω),
  Eq
    (instHMul.hMul (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S)
      (PMF.instFunLike.coe (p.filter S hS) o))
    (S.indicator (PMF.instFunLike.coe p) o)

concepts.title: Connected matchings
concepts.description:
A connected matching is a matching whose distinct edges are joined by an edge.
Its maximum size is the connected-matching number $\mathrm{cm}(G)$.
concepts.sourceText:
/-
Adapted from OpenAI, openai/math, commit
adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a (Apache-2.0).
Changes: Lax package separation, namespaces, explicit variables, and archive annotations.
-/
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique

/-!
---
title: Connected matchings
type: definition
---
A connected matching is a matching whose distinct edges are joined by an edge.
Its maximum size is the connected-matching number $\mathrm{cm}(G)$.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConnectedMatching

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- A finite matching whose edges are pairwise touching: each member is a
two-vertex clique, and distinct members are disjoint and joined by an edge. -/
def IsTouchingMatching (G : SimpleGraph V) (M : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ M, e.card = 2 ∧ G.IsClique (e : Set V)) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ M, ∀ f ∈ M, e ≠ f → Disjoint e f) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ M, ∀ f ∈ M, e ≠ f →
    ∃ v ∈ e, ∃ w ∈ f, G.Adj v w)

/-- The supremum of the cardinalities of pairwise touching matchings.
For finite vertex types, this supremum is attained. -/
noncomputable def connectedMatchingNumber (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
  sSup {n : ℕ | ∃ M : Finset (Finset V), IsTouchingMatching G M ∧ M.card = n}

end Lax342547.ConnectedMatching

concepts.title: Compression that fixes pin/key vectors and preserves target matrices
concepts.description: Block maps are chosen from the actual projected pin/key spaces and the row/column observations of each residual matrix. They fix all required vectors, preserve every target functional, and have the paper block-rank bound independent of the base dimension.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QuotientCompression

/-!
---
title: Compression that fixes pin/key vectors and preserves target matrices
type: lemma
---
Block maps are chosen from the actual projected pin/key spaces and the row/column observations of each residual matrix. They fix all required vectors, preserve every target functional, and have the paper block-rank bound independent of the base dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.BaseCompression
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.ResponseMatrices
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces

def baseAt {k n : ℕ} (q : Block k) (j : Fin n) : Base k n := match q with
  | Sum.inl (d, t) => Sum.inl ((d, t), j)
  | Sum.inr q => Sum.inr (q, j)

def blockSlice {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (q : Block k) :
    Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary) where
  toFun v j := v (s, some (baseAt q j))
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

noncomputable def blockEmbed {k n b degree : ℕ} (s : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (q : Block k) :
    (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Vector k n b degree := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun v c => if c.1 = s then match c.2 with
        | none => 0
        | some (Sum.inl ((d, t), j)) => if q = Sum.inl (d, t) then v j else 0
        | some (Sum.inr (q', j)) => if q = Sum.inr q' then v j else 0
      else 0
      map_add' := by
        intro v w
        ext ⟨a, c⟩
        cases c with
        | none => simp
        | some c =>
          rcases c with ⟨⟨d, t⟩, j⟩ | ⟨q', j⟩ <;>
            simp only [Pi.add_apply] <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all
      map_smul' := by
        intro c v
        ext ⟨a, q'⟩
        cases q' with
        | none => simp
        | some q' =>
          rcases q' with ⟨⟨d, t⟩, j⟩ | ⟨q', j⟩ <;>
            simp only [Pi.smul_apply] <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all }

def constantPart {k n b degree : ℕ} (v : Vector k n b degree) : Vector k n b degree :=
  fun c => match c.2 with
    | none => v (c.1, none)
    | some _ => 0

axiom vector_decomposition {k n b degree : ℕ} (v : Vector k n b degree) :
    v = constantPart v + ∑ s, ∑ q, blockEmbed s q (blockSlice s q v)

axiom lifted_decomposition {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary)) (v : Vector k n b degree) :
    liftBase (blockMap A) v = constantPart v + ∑ s, ∑ q, blockEmbed s q (A q (blockSlice s q v))

axiom pi_range_rank {I V X : Type} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (L : I → V →ₗ[Binary] X) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.pi L)) ≤
      ∑ i, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (L i))

noncomputable def fixedSlices {I : Type} [Fintype I] {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (S : I → Submodule Binary (Vector k n b degree)) (q : Block k) :
    (∀ j : I × SelectorCoordinates b degree, S j.1) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact LinearMap.lsum Binary _ Binary (fun j => (blockSlice j.2 q).comp (S j.1).subtype)

axiom fixedSlices_mem {I : Type} [Fintype I] {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (S : I → Submodule Binary (Vector k n b degree)) (q : Block k)
    (i : I) (s : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (v : Vector k n b degree) (hv : v ∈ S i) :
    blockSlice s q v ∈ LinearMap.range (fixedSlices S q)

axiom fixedSlices_rank {I : Type} [Fintype I] {k n b degree B : ℕ}
    (S : I → Submodule Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hS : ∀ i, Module.finrank Binary (S i) ≤ B) (q : Block k) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (fixedSlices S q)) ≤
      Fintype.card I * Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * B

noncomputable def observations {I X : Type} {k n b degree : ℕ} [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    (T : I → Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] X) (q : Block k) :
    (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I × SelectorCoordinates b degree → X) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun j => (T j.1).comp (blockEmbed j.2 q))

axiom observations_rank {I X : Type} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary X] {k n b degree R : ℕ}
    (T : I → Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] X)
    (hT : ∀ i, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (T i)) ≤ R) (q : Block k) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (observations T q)) ≤
      Fintype.card I * Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * R

axiom exists_block_compression {I X : Type} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary X] {k n b degree B R : ℕ}
    (S : I → Submodule Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hS : ∀ i, Module.finrank Binary (S i) ≤ B)
    (T : I → Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] X)
    (hT : ∀ i, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (T i)) ≤ R) :
    ∃ A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary),
      (∀ q, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (A q)) ≤
        Fintype.card I * Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * (B + R)) ∧
      (∀ i v, v ∈ S i → liftBase (blockMap A) v = v) ∧
      ∀ i, (T i).comp (liftBase (blockMap A)) = T i

axiom preserved_matrix {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (M : Matrix B B Binary)
    (hrow : M.mulVecLin.comp f = M.mulVecLin)
    (hcol : M.transpose.mulVecLin.comp f = M.transpose.mulVecLin) : by
      classical
      exact (LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose * M * LinearMap.toMatrix' f = M

axiom actual_block_compression {k n b degree r K R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (i : Fin 2) (M : Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (hM : ∀ e, (M e).rank ≤ R) :
    ∃ A : Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary),
      (∀ q, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (A q)) ≤
        2 * Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) *
          (K + 14 + R)) ∧
      (∀ a v, v ∈ projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1 → liftBase (blockMap A) v = v) ∧
      ∀ e, by
        classical
        exact
        (LinearMap.toMatrix' (liftBase (Coord := SelectorCoordinates b degree) (blockMap A))).transpose *
          M e * LinearMap.toMatrix' (liftBase (blockMap A)) = M e

end Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    ∀ (i : Fin 2)
      (M :
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
      (∀ (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)), instLENat.le (Matrix.rank (M e)) R) →
        Exists fun A =>
          And
            (∀ (q : Lax342547.BaseCompression.Block k),
              instLENat.le
                (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                  (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (A q).range x))
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree)))
                    (Fintype.card (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))))
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd K 14) R)))
            (And
              (∀ (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
                (v : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem
                    (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i a)
                      (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.individualKeys W i a.fst))
                    v →
                  Eq
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                      (Lax342547.BaseCompression.liftBase (Lax342547.BaseCompression.blockMap A)) v)
                    v)
              (∀ (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
                Eq
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                      (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix'
                          (Lax342547.BaseCompression.liftBase (Lax342547.BaseCompression.blockMap A))).transpose
                      (M e))
                    (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix'
                      (Lax342547.BaseCompression.liftBase (Lax342547.BaseCompression.blockMap A))))

  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X] {k n b degree B R : Nat}
  (S : I → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree)),
  (∀ (i : I),
      instLENat.le (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
        B) →
    ∀ (T : I → LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree) X),
      (∀ (i : I),
          instLENat.le
            (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i).range x))
            R) →
        Exists fun A =>
          And
            (∀ (q : Lax342547.BaseCompression.Block k),
              instLENat.le

            (And
              (∀ (i : I) (v : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) v →
                  Eq
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                      (Lax342547.BaseCompression.liftBase (Lax342547.BaseCompression.blockMap A)) v)

  (A :

        (Fin n → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (v : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.BaseCompression.liftBase (Lax342547.BaseCompression.blockMap A)) v)
    (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.constantPart v)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun s =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
          LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.blockEmbed s q)
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (A q)
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.blockSlice s q) v))))

observations_rank : ∀ {I X : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup X] [inst_2 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X]
  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X] {k n b degree R : Nat}
  (T : I → LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree) X),
  (∀ (i : I),
      instLENat.le
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i).range x)) R) →
    ∀ (q : Lax342547.BaseCompression.Block k),
      instLENat.le
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.observations T q).range x))
        (instHMul.hMul
          (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree))) R)

pi_range_rank : ∀ {I V X : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup X] [inst_4 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X]
  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X]
  (L : I → LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V X),

    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (L i).range x))

preserved_matrix : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : Fintype B]
  (f :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (M : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

    Eq (M.transpose.mulVecLin.comp f) M.transpose.mulVecLin →

          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose
            M)
          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' f))
        M

  Eq v
    (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.constantPart v)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun s =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
          LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.blockEmbed s q)
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConstrainedCompression.blockSlice s q) v)))

concepts.title: Subexponential container counts at the paper sample scale
concepts.description: The logarithmic fingerprint count is bounded by a degree-three polynomial times 2^(100gN). Its ratio to 2^(1000gN) tends to zero, with an actual eventual strict exponent margin.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
---
title: Subexponential container counts at the paper sample scale
type: lemma
---
The logarithmic fingerprint count is bounded by a degree-three polynomial times 2^(100gN). Its ratio to 2^(1000gN) tends to zero, with an actual eventual strict exponent margin.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics

open Filter Asymptotics

def exponentBudget (A g N : ℕ) : ℕ := (2*A*N^2+1)*(4000*g*N*2^(100*g*N)+2)

axiom container_exponent_little_o (A g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    (fun N : ℕ => (exponentBudget A g N : ℝ)) =o[atTop] fun N => (2 : ℝ)^(1000*g*N)

axiom eventually_container_exponent (A g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, exponentBudget A g N+2 < 2^(1000*g*N)

end Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics

statements.signature:
container_exponent_little_o : ∀ (A g : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 g →
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun N => (Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics.exponentBudget A g N).cast) fun N =>
      instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 1000 g) N)

eventually_container_exponent : ∀ (A g : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 g →
    Filter.Eventually
      (fun N =>
        instLTNat.lt (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics.exponentBudget A g N) 2)
          (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 1000 g) N)))
      Filter.atTop

concepts.title: Entropy progress for residual pair laws
concepts.description: Residual feasible families retain compactness and convexity. Supersaturation selects a heavy neighborhood, and deleting it increases the minimum entropy by the exact negative log support cost.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.UnitLaws

/-!
---
title: Entropy progress for residual pair laws
type: lemma
---
Residual feasible families retain compactness and convexity. Supersaturation selects a heavy neighborhood, and deleting it increases the minimum entropy by the exact negative log support cost.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ContainerLaws

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def residual {U : Type} [Fintype U] (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (R : Finset U) : Set (U → ℝ) :=
  {ρ | ρ ∈ P ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ R → ρ x = 0}

noncomputable def neighborMass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop) (v : U) : ℝ :=
  cellMass ρ (H v)

noncomputable def conflictMass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v, ρ v * neighborMass ρ H v

axiom residual_mono {U : Type} [Fintype U] (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (R T : Finset U)
    (hTR : T ⊆ R) : residual P T ⊆ residual P R

axiom residual_compact {U : Type} [Fintype U] (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (R : Finset U)
    (hP : IsCompact P) : IsCompact (residual P R)

axiom residual_convex {U : Type} [Fintype U] (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (R : Finset U)
    (hP : Convex ℝ P) : Convex ℝ (residual P R)

axiom supported_mass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (R : Finset U)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hs : ∀ x, x ∉ R → ρ x = 0) : cellMass ρ (fun x => x ∈ R) = 1

axiom positive_support {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (hρ : Probability ρ) :
    ∃ x, 0 < ρ x

axiom mass_complement {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (S : U → Prop)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) : cellMass ρ (fun x => ¬ S x) = 1-cellMass ρ S

axiom support_mass_positive {U : Type} [Fintype U]
    (ρ σ : U → ℝ) (S : U → Prop) (hρ : Probability ρ) (hσ : Probability σ)
    (hs : ∀ x, ¬ S x → σ x = 0) (hfull : ∀ x, 0 < σ x → 0 < ρ x) :
    0 < cellMass ρ S

axiom heavy_neighbor {U : Type} [Fintype U] (ρ : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop)
    (R : Finset U) (ε : ℝ) (hρ : Probability ρ) (hs : ∀ x, x ∉ R → ρ x = 0)
    (_hε : 0 < ε) (hmass : ε ≤ conflictMass ρ H) :
    ∃ v ∈ R, ε ≤ neighborMass ρ H v

axiom minimum_mono {U : Type} [Fintype U] (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (q ρ σ : U → ℝ)
    (R T : Finset U) (hTR : T ⊆ R) (hσ : σ ∈ residual P T)
    (hmin : ∀ τ ∈ residual P R, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy τ q) : entropy ρ q ≤ entropy σ q

axiom recording_entropy_increment {U : Type} [Fintype U]
    (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (q ρ σ : U → ℝ) (R : Finset U) (H : U → U → Prop) (v : U) (ε : ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ τ ∈ P, Probability τ) (hconv : Convex ℝ P)
    (hρ : ρ ∈ residual P R) (hmin : ∀ τ ∈ residual P R, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy τ q)
    (hσ : σ ∈ residual P R ∧ ∀ x, H v x → σ x = 0)
    (_hε : ε < 1) (hheavy : ε ≤ neighborMass ρ H v) :
    -Real.log (1-ε) ≤ entropy σ q-entropy ρ q

end Lax342547.ContainerLaws

statements.signature:
heavy_neighbor : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ : U → Real) (H : U → U → Prop) (R : Finset U) (ε : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    (∀ (x : U), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem R x) → Eq (ρ x) 0) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
        Real.instLE.le ε (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.conflictMass ρ H) →
          Exists fun v =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem R v) (Real.instLE.le ε (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.neighborMass ρ H v))

mass_complement : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ : U → Real) (S : U → Prop),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    Eq (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ fun x => Not (S x))
      (instHSub.hSub 1 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ S))

minimum_mono : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (q ρ σ : U → Real) (R T : Finset U),
  Finset.instPartialOrder.le T R →
    Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P T) σ →
      (∀ (τ : U → Real),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) τ →
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy τ q)) →
        Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy σ q)

positive_support : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ : U → Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ → Exists fun x => Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x)

recording_entropy_increment : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (q ρ σ : U → Real) (R : Finset U) (H : U → U → Prop) (v : U)
  (ε : Real),
  (∀ (τ : U → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P τ → Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability τ) →
    Convex Real P →
      Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) ρ →
        (∀ (τ : U → Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) τ →
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy τ q)) →
          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) σ) (∀ (x : U), H v x → Eq (σ x) 0) →
            Real.instLT.lt ε 1 →
              Real.instLE.le ε (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.neighborMass ρ H v) →
                Real.instLE.le (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log (instHSub.hSub 1 ε)))
                  (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy σ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q))

residual_compact : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (R : Finset U),
  IsCompact P → IsCompact (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R)

residual_convex : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (R : Finset U),
  Convex Real P → Convex Real (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R)

residual_mono : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (R T : Finset U),
  Finset.instPartialOrder.le T R →
    Set.instLE.le (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P T) (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R)

support_mass_positive : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ σ : U → Real) (S : U → Prop),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability σ →
      (∀ (x : U), Not (S x) → Eq (σ x) 0) →
        (∀ (x : U), Real.instLT.lt 0 (σ x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x)) →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ S)

supported_mass : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ : U → Real) (R : Finset U),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    (∀ (x : U), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem R x) → Eq (ρ x) 0) →
      Eq (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem R x) 1

concepts.title: Finite deterministic container recursion
concepts.description: The fingerprint procedure preserves every independent residual set, terminates by strict cardinality decrease, and reconstructs its terminal set from its ordered fingerprint. A stepwise entropy increase bounds the fingerprint length.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
---
title: Finite deterministic container recursion
type: lemma
---
The fingerprint procedure preserves every independent residual set, terminates by strict cardinality decrease, and reconstructs its terminal set from its ordered fingerprint. A stepwise entropy increase bounds the fingerprint length.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ContainerRun



noncomputable def next {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U) : Finset U := by
  classical
  exact if v ∈ I then R.filter (fun w => ¬ H v w) else R.erase v

noncomputable def run {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I : Finset U) : ℕ → Finset U → Finset U × List U := by
  classical
  exact fun fuel R => match fuel with
  | 0 => (R,[])
  | n+1 => if active R then
      let v := pick R
      let result := run active pick H I n (next H I R v)
      (result.1,if v ∈ I then v::result.2 else result.2)
    else (R,[])

noncomputable def replay {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) : ℕ → Finset U → List U → Finset U := by
  classical
  exact fun fuel R record => match fuel with
  | 0 => R
  | n+1 => if active R then
      let v := pick R
      if record.head? = some v then
        replay active pick H n (R.filter (fun w => ¬ H v w)) record.tail
      else replay active pick H n (R.erase v) record
    else R

axiom next_subset {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U) : next H I R v ⊆ R

axiom next_preserves {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U)
    (hI : I ⊆ R) (hind : ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, ¬ H x y) : I ⊆ next H I R v

axiom next_card_lt {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U)
    (hv : v ∈ R) (hne : ∃ w ∈ R, H v w) : (next H I R v).card < R.card

axiom recorded_subset {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : ℕ) :
    ∀ v ∈ (run active pick H I fuel R).2, v ∈ I

axiom run_replay {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : ℕ) :
    replay active pick H fuel R (run active pick H I fuel R).2 = (run active pick H I fuel R).1

axiom run_preserves {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : ℕ)
    (hI : I ⊆ R) (hind : ∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, ¬ H x y) :
    I ⊆ (run active pick H I fuel R).1 ∧ (run active pick H I fuel R).1 ⊆ R

axiom run_terminal {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : ℕ)
    (hpick : ∀ T, active T → pick T ∈ T ∧ ∃ w ∈ T, H (pick T) w)
    (hsize : R.card < fuel) : ¬ active (run active pick H I fuel R).1

axiom run_entropy_budget {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U)
    (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : ℕ) (E : Finset U → ℝ) (B δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : ∀ T, active T → E T ≤ B)
    (hstep : by
      classical
      exact ∀ T, active T → active (next H I T (pick T)) →
        E T + (if pick T ∈ I then δ else 0) ≤ E (next H I T (pick T)))
    (hR : active R) :
    (((run active pick H I fuel R).2.length : ℝ)-1)*δ ≤ B-E R

end Lax342547.ContainerRun

statements.signature:
next_card_lt : ∀ {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem R v →
    (Exists fun w => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem R w) (H v w)) →
      instLTNat.lt (Lax342547.ContainerRun.next H I R v).card R.card

next_preserves : ∀ {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U),
  Finset.instPartialOrder.le I R →
    (∀ (x : U), SetLike.instMembership.mem I x → ∀ (y : U), SetLike.instMembership.mem I y → Not (H x y)) →
      Finset.instPartialOrder.le I (Lax342547.ContainerRun.next H I R v)

next_subset : ∀ {U : Type} (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (v : U),
  Finset.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.ContainerRun.next H I R v) R

recorded_subset : ∀ {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U) (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : Nat) (v : U),
  List.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).snd v → SetLike.instMembership.mem I v

run_entropy_budget : ∀ {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U) (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : Nat)
  (E : Finset U → Real) (B δ : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 δ →
    (∀ (T : Finset U), active T → Real.instLE.le (E T) B) →
      (∀ (T : Finset U),
          active T →
            active (Lax342547.ContainerRun.next H I T (pick T)) →
              Real.instLE.le (instHAdd.hAdd (E T) (ite (SetLike.instMembership.mem I (pick T)) δ 0))
                (E (Lax342547.ContainerRun.next H I T (pick T)))) →
        active R →
          Real.instLE.le
            (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).snd.length.cast 1) δ)
            (instHSub.hSub B (E R))

run_preserves : ∀ {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U) (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : Nat),
  Finset.instPartialOrder.le I R →
    (∀ (x : U), SetLike.instMembership.mem I x → ∀ (y : U), SetLike.instMembership.mem I y → Not (H x y)) →
      And (Finset.instPartialOrder.le I (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).fst)
        (Finset.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).fst R)

run_replay : ∀ {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U) (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : Nat),
  Eq (Lax342547.ContainerRun.replay active pick H fuel R (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).snd)
    (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).fst

run_terminal : ∀ {U : Type} (active : Finset U → Prop) (pick : Finset U → U) (H : U → U → Prop) (I R : Finset U) (fuel : Nat),
  (∀ (T : Finset U),
      active T →
        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem T (pick T))
          (Exists fun w => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem T w) (H (pick T) w))) →
    instLTNat.lt R.card fuel → Not (active (Lax342547.ContainerRun.run active pick H I fuel R).fst)

concepts.title: Dimensions of the concrete coefficient space
concepts.description:
The selector dimension counts squarefree monomials by cardinality.
The base coordinates comprise g² ordinary blocks and three common blocks,
each of length n; the coefficient space has one extra constant coordinate.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

/-!
---
title: Dimensions of the concrete coefficient space
type: lemma
---
The selector dimension counts squarefree monomials by cardinality.
The base coordinates comprise g² ordinary blocks and three common blocks,
each of length n; the coefficient space has one extra constant coordinate.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoordinateCounts

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

axiom coordinate_dimensions (k n b degree : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (degree + 1), b.choose j ∧
    Fintype.card (Base k n) = ((2 * k + 1) ^ 2 + 3) * n ∧
    Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (degree + 1), b.choose j) * (1 + ((2 * k + 1) ^ 2 + 3) * n)

end Lax342547.CoordinateCounts

statements.signature:
coordinate_dimensions : ∀ (k n b degree : Nat),
  And
    (Eq (Fintype.card (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree))
      ((Finset.range (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1)).sum fun j => b.choose j))
    (And
      (Eq (Fintype.card (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n))
        (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1) 2) 3) n))
      (Eq (Fintype.card (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree))
        (instHMul.hMul ((Finset.range (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1)).sum fun j => b.choose j)
          (instHAdd.hAdd 1
            (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1) 2) 3) n)))))

concepts.title: Independence of distinct sample positions
concepts.description: An embedding of selected positions extends to a partition of the whole position space. Summing the unused independent coordinates proves the exact product law on the selected positions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Set

/-!
---
title: Independence of distinct sample positions
type: lemma
---
An embedding of selected positions extends to a partition of the whole position space. Summing the unused independent coordinates proves the exact product law on the selected positions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoordinateRestrictions

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def complete {J ι : Type} (a : J ↪ ι) : J ⊕ {i : ι // i ∉ Set.range a} ≃ ι := by
  classical
  exact (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective a a.injective) (Equiv.refl _)).trans
    (Equiv.Set.sumCompl (Set.range a))

axiom complete_left {J ι : Type} (a : J ↪ ι) (j : J) : complete a (.inl j) = a j

concepts.title: The row-corank bound for a uniform binary matrix
concepts.description:
A matrix with row corank at least s admits s independent row relations.
Count the relation matrix first, then require every column to lie in its
kernel. This gives the sharper 2^(ms-sn) probability bound used for the
bounded row lists in Lemma 5.5, written as a ratio of nonnegative powers.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LowRankCounting

/-!
---
title: The row-corank bound for a uniform binary matrix
type: lemma
---
A matrix with row corank at least s admits s independent row relations.
Count the relation matrix first, then require every column to lie in its
kernel. This gives the sharper 2^(ms-sn) probability bound used for the
bounded row lists in Lemma 5.5, written as a ratio of nonnegative powers.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CorankCounting

axiom exists_row_relations {K I J : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (M : Matrix I J K) (s : ℕ) (hs : M.rank + s ≤ Fintype.card I) :
    ∃ C : Matrix (Fin s) I K, Function.Surjective C.mulVec ∧ C * M = 0

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

axiom card_corank {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (s : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {M : Matrix I J Binary // M.rank + s ≤ Fintype.card I} ≤
      2 ^ (s * Fintype.card I + (Fintype.card I - s) * Fintype.card J)

axiom uniform_corank_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (s : ℕ) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I J Binary)).toOuterMeasure {M | M.rank + s ≤ Fintype.card I} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (s * Fintype.card I) / 2 ^ (s * Fintype.card J)

end Lax342547.CorankCounting

  instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun M => instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd M.rank s) (Fintype.card I)))
    (instHPow.hPow 2
      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul s (Fintype.card I))
        (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card I) s) (Fintype.card J))))

  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd M.rank s) (Fintype.card I) →
    Exists fun C => And (Function.Surjective C.mulVec) (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C M) 0)

concepts.title: A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture
concepts.description:
Theorem 1.1 asserts that graphs of arbitrarily large order $m$ have
independence number at most two and connected-matching number less than
$m/100$. Together with Proposition 3.5, this gives graphs of arbitrarily
large order with $h(G)<\chi(G)$.

The proof package establishes the existence assertion by the complete
binary-frame construction, and derives the coloring consequences from it.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
import Lax342547.CliqueMinor
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Coloring.Vertex

/-!
---
title: A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture
type: lemma
---
Theorem 1.1 asserts that graphs of arbitrarily large order $m$ have
independence number at most two and connected-matching number less than
$m/100$. Together with Proposition 3.5, this gives graphs of arbitrarily
large order with $h(G)<\chi(G)$.

The proof package establishes the existence assertion by the complete
binary-frame construction, and derives the coloring consequences from it.
-/

namespace Lax342547.Counterexample

open ConnectedMatching CliqueMinor

/-- Theorem 1.1, with the strict matching bound expressed in natural numbers. -/
axiom arbitrarily_large_small_connected_matching (lowerBound : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, lowerBound ≤ m ∧ ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin m),
      G.indepNum ≤ 2 ∧ 100 * connectedMatchingNumber G < m

/-- The ordinary coloring consequence of Theorem 1.1. -/
axiom arbitrarily_large_hadwiger_counterexample (lowerBound : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, lowerBound ≤ m ∧ 5 ≤ m ∧ ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin m),
      G.indepNum ≤ 2 ∧ hadwigerNumber G < G.chromaticNumber.toNat

end Lax342547.Counterexample

  Exists fun m =>
    And (instLENat.le lowerBound m)
      (And (instLENat.le 5 m)
        (Exists fun G =>
          And (instLENat.le G.indepNum 2)
            (instLTNat.lt (Lax342547.CliqueMinor.hadwigerNumber G) G.chromaticNumber.toNat)))

concepts.title: Rank preservation under mode-cover avoidance
concepts.description: Actual quotient and annihilator restriction preserve rank when the original column and row spaces avoid the cover.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoverProjection

/-!
---
title: Rank preservation under mode-cover avoidance
type: lemma
---
Actual quotient and annihilator restriction preserve rank when the original column and row spaces avoid the cover.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoverAvoidance

open Lax342547.CoverProjection

axiom finrank_map_of_disjoint_kernel {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K V) (h : Disjoint S (LinearMap.ker f)) :
    Module.finrank K (S.map f) = Module.finrank K S

axiom quotient_rank_of_avoidance {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (h : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M) S) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (S.mkQ.comp M)) = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M)

axiom restriction_rank_of_avoidance {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (h : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M.dualMap) T) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype)) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M)

axiom projection_rank_of_avoidance {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (hS : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M) S) (hT : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M.dualMap) T) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (projection M S T)) = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M)

end Lax342547.CoverAvoidance

import Lax342547.ModeBudgets

/-!
---
title: Join-stable classes of mode covers
type: lemma
---
Finite exposed spans remain in any class of mode spaces containing zero and closed under joins, including componentwise classes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoverClasses



def JoinClosed {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (P : Submodule K V → Prop) : Prop :=
    P ⊥ ∧ ∀ S T, P S → P T → P (S ⊔ T)

    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (P : Submodule K V → Prop) (hP : JoinClosed P)
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (I : Finset ι) (hS : ∀ i ∈ I, P (S i)) : P (I.sup S)

end Lax342547.CoverClasses

concepts.description: A low sum rank and a small combined mode deficit force at least the prescribed number of covered tensors among the remaining indices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SmallExposure

/-!
---
title: Count tensors killed by exposure
type: lemma
---
A low sum rank and a small combined mode deficit force at least the prescribed number of covered tensors among the remaining indices.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoverCounts



axiom covered_count_lower_bound {ι : Type} (I : Finset ι) (P : ι → Prop)
    (b t : ℕ) (rank d : ℝ) (hI : I.card = b) (hbt : 2*t ≤ b)
    (hr : rank < (t : ℝ)/4) (hd : d < (b : ℝ)/4)
    (hc : by classical exact ((I.filter P).card : ℝ) ≤ rank+d) : by
      classical
      exact t ≤ (I.filter (fun i => ¬ P i)).card

end Lax342547.CoverCounts

      Real.instLT.lt rank (instHDiv.hDiv t.cast 4) →
        Real.instLT.lt d (instHDiv.hDiv b.cast 4) →
          Real.instLE.le (Finset.filter P I).card.cast (instHAdd.hAdd rank d) →
            instLENat.le t (Finset.filter (fun i => Not (P i)) I).card

concepts.description: Quotienting the exposed columns and restricting to the annihilator of exposed rows gives the actual covered-tensor projection, its mode envelopes, rank monotonicity, and sum identity.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedSpans
import Lax342547.RankLoss

/-!
---
title: Actual exposure cover projection
type: lemma
---
Quotienting the exposed columns and restricting to the annihilator of exposed rows gives the actual covered-tensor projection, its mode envelopes, rank monotonicity, and sum identity.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoverProjection

open Lax342547.GreedySpans
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def projection {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (M : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S) := S.mkQ.comp (M.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype)

axiom cover_restriction_kernel {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    LinearMap.ker T.dualCoannihilator.subtype.dualMap = T

axiom projected_column_envelope {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (M : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    LinearMap.range (projection M S T) ≤ (LinearMap.range M).map S.mkQ

axiom projected_row_envelope {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (M : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    LinearMap.range (projection M S T).dualMap ≤
      (LinearMap.range M.dualMap).map T.dualCoannihilator.subtype.dualMap

axiom projection_rank_le {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (projection M S T)) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M)

axiom projection_zero_of_columns {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (M : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (h : LinearMap.range M ≤ S) :
    projection M S T = 0

axiom projection_sum {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    projection (∑ i, M i) S T = ∑ i, projection (M i) S T

end Lax342547.CoverProjection

concepts.title: Actual tensor cover decomposition and dimension
concepts.description: A checked quotient decomposition of every covered map gives the dimension bound for the whole actual cover space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoverProjection
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Finite.Matrix

/-!
---
title: Actual tensor cover decomposition and dimension
type: lemma
---
A checked quotient decomposition of every covered map gives the dimension bound for the whole actual cover space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CoverSpace

open Lax342547.CoverProjection

noncomputable def coverAssembly {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    ((V →ₗ[K] S) × ((V ⧸ T.dualCoannihilator) →ₗ[K] W)) →ₗ[K] (V →ₗ[K] W) where
  toFun z := S.subtype.comp z.1+z.2.comp T.dualCoannihilator.mkQ
  map_add' _ _ := by simp [LinearMap.comp_add,LinearMap.add_comp]; abel
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp [LinearMap.comp_smul,LinearMap.smul_comp]

noncomputable def coverOperator {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    (V →ₗ[K] W) →ₗ[K] (T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S)) where
  toFun M := projection M S T
  map_add' _ _ := by simp [projection,LinearMap.comp_add,LinearMap.add_comp]
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp [projection,LinearMap.comp_smul,LinearMap.smul_comp]

axiom covered_decomposition {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (hM : projection M S T = 0) :
    M ∈ LinearMap.range (coverAssembly S T)

axiom cover_space_dimension {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (coverOperator S T)) ≤
      Module.finrank K V*Module.finrank K S+Module.finrank K T*Module.finrank K W

end Lax342547.CoverSpace

statements.signature:
cover_space_dimension : ∀ {K V W : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_4 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W] (S : Submodule K W)
  (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)),
  instLENat.le
    (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.CoverSpace.coverOperator S T).ker x))
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHMul.hMul (Module.finrank K V) (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)))
      (instHMul.hMul (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)) (Module.finrank K W)))
