concepts.title: Quantitative comparison after cross-batch Gram conditioning
concepts.description:
The actual cross-slot coefficient matrices give bit rank at least N for
every nontrivial character. Separate bounded-density batch laws and bounded
tests retain a uniform comparison after mutual Gram conditioning.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ConditionedMixing
import Lax342547.SlotWalsh
import Lax342547.RelativeEntropy

/-!
---
title: Quantitative comparison after cross-batch Gram conditioning
type: lemma
---
The actual cross-slot coefficient matrices give bit rank at least N for
every nontrivial character. Separate bounded-density batch laws and bounded
tests retain a uniform comparison after mutual Gram conditioning.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SlotWalsh Lax342547.FourierTests Lax342547.RelativeEntropy

noncomputable def coefficient {I J S : Type} [Fintype S]
    (C : S → Matrix I J Binary) (t : S → Binary) : Matrix I J Binary := ∑ s,t s • C s

def crossBits {I J S : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (C : S → Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ)
    (xy : ((Fin N × I → Binary) × (Fin N × J → Binary))) : S → Binary :=
  fun s => dotProduct xy.1 ((bitMatrix (C s) N).mulVec xy.2)

axiom weighted_character_bound {I J S : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype S]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (C : S → Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ)
    (α f : (Fin N × I → Binary) → ℝ) (β g : (Fin N × J → Binary) → ℝ)
    (target t : S → Binary) (C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ x,0 ≤ α x ∧ α x ≤ C₁/(2 : ℝ)^(N*Fintype.card I))
    (hβ : ∀ y,0 ≤ β y ∧ β y ≤ C₂/(2 : ℝ)^(N*Fintype.card J))
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hC : coefficient C t ≠ 0) :
    |characterMean (fun xy : (Fin N × I → Binary) × (Fin N × J → Binary) =>
      α xy.1*β xy.2*(f xy.1*g xy.2)) (crossBits C N) target t| ≤
      C₁*C₂/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N)

axiom cross_batch_comparison {I J S : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype S]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq S] (C : S → Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ)
    (α f : (Fin N × I → Binary) → ℝ) (β g : (Fin N × J → Binary) → ℝ)
    (target : S → Binary) (C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hα : Probability α) (hβ : Probability β)
    (hcapA : ∀ x,α x ≤ C₁/(2 : ℝ)^(N*Fintype.card I))
    (hcapB : ∀ y,β y ≤ C₂/(2 : ℝ)^(N*Fintype.card J))
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hC : ∀ t : S → Binary,t ≠ 0 → coefficient C t ≠ 0)
    (hsmall : C₁*C₂/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card S+1)) :
    |patternMass (fun xy : (Fin N × I → Binary) × (Fin N × J → Binary) =>
        α xy.1*β xy.2*(f xy.1*g xy.2)) (crossBits C N) target/
        patternMass (fun xy : (Fin N × I → Binary) × (Fin N × J → Binary) =>
          α xy.1*β xy.2) (crossBits C N) target-
        (∑ x,α x*f x)*(∑ y,β y*g y)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card S+2)*(C₁*C₂/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N))

end Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing

concepts.title: Independent characters of actual mutual Gram entries
concepts.description:
The two reciprocal cross Gram blocks occupy disjoint coefficient entries.
Their characters have no duplicate descriptions: every nonzero pattern
gives a nonzero cross-batch matrix and therefore at least N bits of rank.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing

/-!
---
title: Independent characters of actual mutual Gram entries
type: lemma
---
The two reciprocal cross Gram blocks occupy disjoint coefficient entries.
Their characters have no duplicate descriptions: every nonzero pattern
gives a nonzero cross-batch matrix and therefore at least N bits of rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CrossGramBasis

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing
open scoped BigOperators

variable {I J K L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
  [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L]

abbrev Slots (I J K L : Type) := (I × L) ⊕ (J × K)

def tests {I J K L : Type} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] :
    Slots I J K L → Matrix (I ⊕ J) (K ⊕ L) Binary
  | Sum.inl (i,l) => fun a b => if a = Sum.inl i ∧ b = Sum.inr l then 1 else 0
  | Sum.inr (j,k) => fun a b => if a = Sum.inr j ∧ b = Sum.inl k then 1 else 0

axiom coefficient_blocks (t : Slots I J K L → Binary) :
    coefficient tests t = Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (fun i l => t (Sum.inl (i,l)))
      (fun j k => t (Sum.inr (j,k))) 0

axiom nonzero_coefficient (t : Slots I J K L → Binary) (ht : t ≠ 0) : coefficient tests t ≠ 0

axiom mutual_gram_bits (N : ℕ)
    (xy : (Fin N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (Fin N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary)) :
    (∀ i l,crossBits tests N xy (Sum.inl (i,l)) = ∑ a,xy.1 (a,Sum.inl i)*xy.2 (a,Sum.inr l)) ∧
    (∀ j k,crossBits tests N xy (Sum.inr (j,k)) = ∑ a,xy.1 (a,Sum.inr j)*xy.2 (a,Sum.inl k))

end Lax342547.CrossGramBasis

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] [inst_6 : DecidableEq K] [inst_7 : DecidableEq L]
  (t : Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.coefficient Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests t)
    (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (fun i l => t (Sum.inl { fst := i, snd := l })) (fun j k => t (Sum.inr { fst := j, snd := k }))
      0)

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] [inst_6 : DecidableEq K] [inst_7 : DecidableEq L] (N : Nat)
  (xy :
    Prod (Prod (Fin N) (Sum I J) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Prod (Fin N) (Sum K L) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  And
    (∀ (i : I) (l : L),
      Eq (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N xy (Sum.inl { fst := i, snd := l }))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          instHMul.hMul (xy.fst { fst := a, snd := Sum.inl i }) (xy.snd { fst := a, snd := Sum.inr l })))
    (∀ (j : J) (k : K),
      Eq (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N xy (Sum.inr { fst := j, snd := k }))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          instHMul.hMul (xy.fst { fst := a, snd := Sum.inr j }) (xy.snd { fst := a, snd := Sum.inl k })))

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] [inst_6 : DecidableEq K] [inst_7 : DecidableEq L]
  (t : Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Ne t 0 → Ne (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.coefficient Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests t) 0

concepts.title: Well-defined cut functionals
concepts.description:
A tester vanishing on the common kernel gives a well-defined sum over
all representative values. For an odd number of tags, summing any
tester over all tags except a fixed one is also well-defined. These
are precisely the two descent arguments for $a_t,a,b_t$ in (2.7).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CutProfiles
import Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Parity

/-!
---
title: Well-defined cut functionals
type: lemma
---
A tester vanishing on the common kernel gives a well-defined sum over
all representative values. For an odd number of tags, summing any
tester over all tags except a fixed one is also well-defined. These
are precisely the two descent arguments for $a_t,a,b_t$ in (2.7).
-/

namespace Lax342547.CutFunctionals

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.CutProfiles

axiom representative_sums_eq {Tag V : Type} [Fintype Tag] [DecidableEq Tag]
    [Nonempty Tag] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (W : Tag → Submodule Binary V) (ηO ηS : V →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hO : ∀ c ∈ ⨅ t, W t, ηO c = 0) (hodd : Odd (Fintype.card Tag))
    (w v : Tag → V) (hw : ∀ t, w t ∈ W t) (hv : ∀ t, v t ∈ W t)
    (heq : cutMap w = cutMap v) :
    (∑ t, ηO (w t)) = (∑ t, ηO (v t)) ∧
      ∀ t, (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, ηS (w l)) =
        ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, ηS (v l)

end Lax342547.CutFunctionals

  (ηO ηS : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (c : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem (iInf fun t => W t) c → Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ηO c) 0) →

          (∀ (t : Tag), SetLike.instMembership.mem (W t) (v t)) →
            Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w)
                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap v) →
              And
                (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun t => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ηO (w t))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun t => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ηO (v t)))

                    ((Finset.univ.erase t).sum fun l => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ηS (v l)))

concepts.title: Cut profiles and the constant kernel
concepts.description:
A cut profile has one coordinate for each unordered pair of tags, equal
to the sum of its two representative values. In characteristic two,
two representatives of the same profile differ by a constant tuple.
For representatives in restricted spaces, that constant lies in their
intersection. This is the kernel assertion of Lemma 2.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-!
---
title: Cut profiles and the constant kernel
type: lemma
---
A cut profile has one coordinate for each unordered pair of tags, equal
to the sum of its two representative values. In characteristic two,
two representatives of the same profile differ by a constant tuple.
For representatives in restricted spaces, that constant lies in their
intersection. This is the kernel assertion of Lemma 2.3.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CutProfiles

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def Component (Tag : Type) := {e : Finset Tag // e.card = 2}

variable {Tag V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]

def cutMap : (Tag → V) →ₗ[Binary] (Component Tag → V) where
  toFun w e := ∑ t ∈ e.val, w t
  map_add' w v := by ext e; simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c w := by ext e; simp [Finset.smul_sum]

def representatives (W : Tag → Submodule Binary V) : Submodule Binary (Tag → V) :=
  Submodule.pi Set.univ W

def cutSpace (W : Tag → Submodule Binary V) : Submodule Binary (Component Tag → V) :=
  (representatives W).map cutMap

axiom same_cut_iff [Nonempty Tag] (W : Tag → Submodule Binary V)
    (w v : Tag → V) (hw : ∀ t, w t ∈ W t) (hv : ∀ t, v t ∈ W t) :
    cutMap w = cutMap v ↔ ∃ c ∈ ⨅ t, W t, ∀ t, w t + v t = c

end Lax342547.CutProfiles

  (W : Tag → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V) (w v : Tag → V),
  (∀ (t : Tag), SetLike.instMembership.mem (W t) (w t)) →
    (∀ (t : Tag), SetLike.instMembership.mem (W t) (v t)) →
      Iff
        (Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w)
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap v))
        (Exists fun c =>
          And (SetLike.instMembership.mem (iInf fun t => W t) c) (∀ (t : Tag), Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (w t) (v t)) c))

concepts.title: Majority normalization of sparse cut profiles
concepts.description:
Counting unequal unordered tag pairs forces a strict majority whenever
four times the cut support is smaller than the square of the tag count.
Subtracting its common value gives a unique majority-zero representative.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CutProfiles
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-!
---
title: Majority normalization of sparse cut profiles
type: lemma
---
Counting unequal unordered tag pairs forces a strict majority whenever
four times the cut support is smaller than the square of the tag count.
Subtracting its common value gives a unique majority-zero representative.
-/

namespace Lax342547.CutSparsity

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.CutProfiles

variable {Tag V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]

def UnequalPairs (w : Tag → V) := {p : Tag × Tag // w p.1 ≠ w p.2}

def NonzeroCuts (w : Tag → V) := {e : Component Tag // cutMap w e ≠ 0}

noncomputable def cutSize (w : Tag → V) : ℕ := Nat.card (NonzeroCuts w)

noncomputable def valueCount (w : Tag → V) (c : V) : ℕ := Nat.card {t : Tag // w t = c}

noncomputable def supportSize (w : Tag → V) : ℕ := Nat.card {t : Tag // w t ≠ 0}

axiom unequal_card_le [Fintype Tag] (w : Tag → V) :
    Nat.card (UnequalPairs w) ≤ 2 * cutSize w

axiom exists_majority [Fintype Tag] (w : Tag → V)
    (h : 4 * cutSize w < Fintype.card Tag * Fintype.card Tag) :
    ∃ c : V, Fintype.card Tag < 2 * valueCount w c

axiom minority_bound [Fintype Tag] (w : Tag → V) (c : V)
    (h : Fintype.card Tag < 2 * valueCount w c) :
    Fintype.card Tag * Nat.card {t : Tag // w t ≠ c} ≤ 2 * cutSize w

axiom majority_unique [Fintype Tag] [Nonempty Tag] (w v : Tag → V)
    (hcut : cutMap w = cutMap v)
    (hw : Fintype.card Tag < 2 * valueCount w 0)
    (hv : Fintype.card Tag < 2 * valueCount v 0) : w = v

axiom exists_unique_normalized [Fintype Tag] [Nonempty Tag]
    (W : Tag → Submodule Binary V)
    (hW : ∀ S : Finset Tag, Fintype.card Tag < 2 * S.card →
      (⨅ t : {t // t ∈ S}, W t.val) ≤ ⨅ t, W t)
    (w : Tag → V) (hw : ∀ t, w t ∈ W t)
    (h : 4 * cutSize w < Fintype.card Tag * Fintype.card Tag) :
    ∃! v : Tag → V, (∀ t, v t ∈ W t) ∧ cutMap v = cutMap w ∧
      Fintype.card Tag < 2 * valueCount v 0 ∧
      Fintype.card Tag * supportSize v ≤ 2 * cutSize w

end Lax342547.CutSparsity

      (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Tag) (Fintype.card Tag)) →
    Exists fun c => instLTNat.lt (Fintype.card Tag) (instHMul.hMul 2 (Lax342547.CutSparsity.valueCount w c))

concepts.title: Rank-one derivative tests are scalar pairings of residual contractions
concepts.description:
A rank-one change in either channel map contracts to the baseline
evaluation of the corresponding matrix contraction. Transposition
exchanges the two orientations without a symmetry assumption.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorContractions
import Lax342547.PrimalContractions

/-!
---
title: Rank-one derivative tests are scalar pairings of residual contractions
type: lemma
---
A rank-one change in either channel map contracts to the baseline
evaluation of the corresponding matrix contraction. Transposition
exchanges the two orientations without a symmetry assumption.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DerivativeContractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PrimalContractions Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.TensorContractions

axiom right_rank_one {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (B → Binary)) (c : H → Binary) :
    ambient f (ψ.smulRight c) M = dotProduct (f (M.mulVecLin (coordinates ψ))) c

axiom transpose_contraction {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    ambient f g M = ambient g f M.transpose

axiom left_rank_one {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (B → Binary)) (c : H → Binary) :
    ambient (φ.smulRight c) g M = dotProduct c (g (M.transpose.mulVecLin (coordinates φ)))

open Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators

axiom paired_transpose {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M D E) : PairedAnnihilates (fun i => (M i).transpose) E D

end Lax342547.DerivativeContractions

    (dotProduct c

  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H)),

concepts.title: The full linearized response on pairs of actual cut profiles
concepts.description:
The two allowed derivative families factor through the actual barred
nominal quotients and take values perpendicular to the opposite pin's
protected channels. Their contractions with the fixed baseline maps
are added to the independent pure bilinear response.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ChannelChanges
import Lax342547.SelectedRemoval
import Lax342547.ResidualLabels

/-!
---
title: The full linearized response on pairs of actual cut profiles
type: lemma
---
The two allowed derivative families factor through the actual barred
nominal quotients and take values perpendicular to the opposite pin's
protected channels. Their contractions with the fixed baseline maps
are added to the independent pure bilinear response.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DerivativeResponses

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ChannelChanges Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.SelectedRemoval

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]

abbrev PlusParameters (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2) :=
  ∀ e, (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (U e) (e, true)) →ₗ[Binary]
    perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, false))

abbrev MinusParameters (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2) :=
  ∀ e, (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (V e) (e, false)) →ₗ[Binary]
    perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, true))

def restriction {B : Type} (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (i : Fin 2) :
    (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) :=
  (((perpendicular S).subtype.comp δ).comp D.mkQ).comp (primalEmbedding i)

noncomputable def componentResponse {Comp B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (z : Fin 2)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δF : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (δG : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T) :
    (Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ i, (TensorContractions.ambient (fullPlus F e i z) (restriction E T δG i) +
    TensorContractions.ambient (restriction D S δF i) (fullMinus F e i z)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

noncomputable def response (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (δF : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (δG : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    (Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ e, (componentResponse F e z (barred W P (U e) (e, true))
    (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false))
    (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (δF e) (δG e)).comp (PureObstructions.endpointComponent e)

noncomputable def fullResponse (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (β : PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
    (δF : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (δG : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    (Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  PureObstructions.response W P U V β + response W P Q U V F z δF δG

def Annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) : Prop :=
  ∀ β δF δG, fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δF δG x = 0

axiom pure_annihilation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x) :
    Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x

axiom derivative_annihilation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (δF : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (δG : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    response W P Q U V F z δF δG x = 0

axiom atom_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (i : Fin 2) (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) :
    Annihilates W P Q U V F z (Pi.single i (W.left i u.1 u.2).profile)

axiom selected_part_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) :
    Annihilates W P Q U V F z (selectedPart W c)

axiom subtract_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) :
    Annihilates W P Q U V F z (x - selectedPart W c)

axiom component_annihilation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k))
    (δF : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (U e) (e, true)) →ₗ[Binary]
      perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)))
    (δG : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (V e) (e, false)) →ₗ[Binary]
      perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, true))) :
    componentResponse F e z (barred W P (U e) (e, true))
      (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false))
      (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) δF δG (Lax342547.PureObstructions.endpointComponent e x) = 0

axiom unselected_obstruction {K : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∃ c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary,
    ∃ L : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
    ∃ Z : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) →
        Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary,
      Annihilates W P Q U V F z (x - selectedPart W c) ∧
      ∀ i e, (L i e).card ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        (∀ s ∈ L i e, s ∉ Lax342547.ResidualLabels.chosenLabels W i ∧
          Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment (Z i e s)) ∧
        (∑ s ∈ L i e, (Z i e s).rank) ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        ((x - selectedPart W c) i).val e =
          ∑ s ∈ L i e, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z i e s)

axiom right_test (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i : Fin 2)
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i (e, false) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (c : H → Binary) (hc : c ∈ perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, true))) :
    dotProduct (fullPlus F e i z
      (((x i).val e).mulVecLin (Lax342547.PrimalContractions.coordinates ψ))) c = 0

axiom plus_contraction_zero {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i : Fin 2)
    (hU : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (Lax342547.ResidualLabels.chosenLabels W i))
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : (x i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s))
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i (e, false) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    ((x i).val e).mulVecLin (Lax342547.PrimalContractions.coordinates ψ) = 0

axiom left_test (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i : Fin 2)
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i (e, true) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (c : H → Binary) (hc : c ∈ perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z (e, false))) :
    dotProduct (fullMinus F e i z
      (((x i).val e).transpose.mulVecLin (Lax342547.PrimalContractions.coordinates ψ))) c = 0

axiom minus_contraction_zero {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i : Fin 2)
    (hV : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (Lax342547.ResidualLabels.chosenLabels W i))
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : (x i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s))
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i (e, true) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    ((x i).val e).transpose.mulVecLin (Lax342547.PrimalContractions.coordinates ψ) = 0

end Lax342547.DerivativeResponses

concepts.title: Rank of a diagonal family
concepts.description: The range of a coordinatewise linear map is the product of its coordinate ranges, so its rank is the sum of their ranks.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-!
---
title: Rank of a diagonal family
type: lemma
---
The range of a coordinatewise linear map is the product of its coordinate ranges, so its rank is the sum of their ranks.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DirectRanks

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def rangeProductEquiv {K ι : Type} [Field K]
    {V W : ι → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    (M : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) :
    LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap M) ≃ₗ[K] (∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i)) := by
  classical
  let f : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap M) →ₗ[K] (∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i)) :=
    { toFun := fun w i => ⟨w.val i,by obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := w.property; exact ⟨v i,congrFun hv i⟩⟩
      map_add' := by intros; rfl
      map_smul' := by intros; rfl }
  refine LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ?_
  constructor
  · intro w z h
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h i)
  · intro w
    have hex : ∀ i, ∃ v, M i v = (w i).val := fun i => (w i).property
    choose v hv using hex
    refine ⟨⟨fun i => (w i).val,⟨v,?_⟩⟩,?_⟩
    · funext i
      exact hv i
    · rfl

axiom diagonal_rank_sum {K ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    {V W : ι → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (W i)] (M : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap M)) =
      ∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M i))

end Lax342547.DirectRanks

diagonal_rank_sum : ∀ {K ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {V W : ι → Type} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup (V i)]
  [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Module K (V i)] [inst_4 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup (W i)] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → Module K (W i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (W i)] (M : (i : ι) → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) (V i) (W i)),
  Eq (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (LinearMap.piMap M).range x))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M i).range x))

concepts.title: Disjoint pair exception tails
concepts.description: Distinct selected sample positions retain their product law, and grouping them into ordered pairs proves the exact power of the raw pair-exception mass. Union over all position embeddings gives the m^(2k) counting bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoordinateRestrictions
import Lax342547.CellAveraging
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Prod

/-!
---
title: Disjoint pair exception tails
type: lemma
---
Distinct selected sample positions retain their product law, and grouping them into ordered pairs proves the exact power of the raw pair-exception mass. Union over all position embeddings gives the m^(2k) counting bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DisjointSampling

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.CellAveraging
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def pairSamples {J Ω : Type} : (J → Ω × Ω) ≃ (J × Bool → Ω) :=
  (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : J => (Equiv.boolArrowEquivProd Ω).symm)).trans
    (Equiv.curry J Bool Ω).symm

axiom pair_samples_left {J Ω : Type} (sample : J → Ω × Ω) (j : J) :
    pairSamples sample (j,false) = (sample j).1

axiom pair_samples_right {J Ω : Type} (sample : J → Ω × Ω) (j : J) :
    pairSamples sample (j,true) = (sample j).2

axiom paired_product_probability {J Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : J × Bool => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ j, E (sample (j,false)) (sample (j,true))) =
        (pairEventMass μ μ E)^Fintype.card J

axiom disjoint_pair_probability {J ι Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (a : J × Bool ↪ ι) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hμ : Probability μ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ∀ j, E (sample (a (j,false))) (sample (a (j,true)))) =
        (pairEventMass μ μ E)^Fintype.card J

axiom disjoint_pair_exception_bound {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (k : ℕ) (hμ : Probability μ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ∃ a : Fin k × Bool ↪ ι,
        ∀ j, E (sample (a (j,false))) (sample (a (j,true)))) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι)^(2*k)*(pairEventMass μ μ E)^k

end Lax342547.DisjointSampling

  (k : Nat),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
        Exists fun a =>
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            E (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.false }))
              (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.true })))
      (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (Fintype.card ι).cast (instHMul.hMul 2 k))
        (instHPow.hPow (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ E) k))

  (μ : Ω → Real) (a : Function.Embedding (Prod J Bool) ι) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Eq
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
        ∀ (j : J),
          E (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.false }))

  Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Lax342547.DisjointSampling.pairSamples sample { fst := j, snd := Bool.false })
    (sample j).fst

  Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Lax342547.DisjointSampling.pairSamples sample { fst := j, snd := Bool.true })
    (sample j).snd

  Eq
    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
      ∀ (j : J), E (sample { fst := j, snd := Bool.false }) (sample { fst := j, snd := Bool.true }))
    (instHPow.hPow (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ E) (Fintype.card J))

concepts.title: Moments across endpoint channel groups
concepts.description: Copying the same original tensor across endpoint channels multiplies the character rank exponent without changing its original cover space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.NoCoverMoments

/-!
---
title: Moments across endpoint channel groups
type: lemma
---

import Lax342547.DuplicatedMoments
import Lax342547.NoCoverMoments
/-!
---
title: Original-rank no-cover tails for endpoint groups
type: lemma
---
Independent endpoint channels amplify the moment decay while retaining the original tensor rank and original cover hypothesis.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DuplicatedNoCover

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.ChannelCharacters Lax342547.TensorCharacters Lax342547.ComponentSpaces

open scoped BigOperators

axiom no_cover_even_moment {e d I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype d] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq d] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → I → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → J → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : (e × d) × Fin h => channelLaw) c*
      |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (fun i : e × d => A x i.1) c|^(2*t)) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^((Fintype.card d*h)*2^(k-(100*r+12)))

axiom no_cover_phase_tail {e d I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype d] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq d] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → I → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → J → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : (e × d) × Fin h => channelLaw))
      (fun c => θ ≤ |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (fun i : e × d => A x i.1) c|) ≤
      ((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^((Fintype.card d*h)*2^(k-(100*r+12))))/θ^(2*t)

end Lax342547.DuplicatedNoCover

import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset

/-!
---
title: Dyadic span deficit estimates
type: lemma
---
The finite telescoping deficit recurrence yields a common scale with small combined row and column deficit.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DyadicDeficits

open scoped BigOperators

axiom sum_shift (v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, v (j+1)) = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, v j)-v 0+v n

axiom sum_differences (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (f j-f (j+1))) = f 0-f n

axiom deficit_ratio_sum (f v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hrec : ∀ j < n, 2*v j ≤ 2*(f j-f (j+1))+v (j+1))
    (hf0 : f 0 ≤ r) (hfn : 0 ≤ f n) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v 0) (hvn : v n ≤ f n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, v j) ≤ 2*r

axiom two_mode_scale (fC fR vC vR : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ j < n, 2*vC j ≤ 2*(fC j-fC (j+1))+vC (j+1))
    (hR : ∀ j < n, 2*vR j ≤ 2*(fR j-fR (j+1))+vR (j+1))
    (hfC0 : fC 0 ≤ r) (hfR0 : fR 0 ≤ r)
    (hfCn : 0 ≤ fC n) (hfRn : 0 ≤ fR n)
    (hvC0 : 0 ≤ vC 0) (hvR0 : 0 ≤ vR 0)
    (hvCn : vC n ≤ fC n) (hvRn : vR n ≤ fR n) (hn : 16*r < n) :
    ∃ j < n, vC j+vR j < 1/4

end Lax342547.DyadicDeficits

import Lax342547.MomentBudgets
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log

/-!
---
title: Fixed dyadic moment orders at the ambient scale
type: lemma
---
An explicit natural logarithm choice supplies even dyadic moments below N/c and above N/(2*c), with a fixed parameter budget independent of the actual law.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DyadicMoments



axiom exists_dyadic_moment_order (c n N : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hN : c*2^(n+2) ≤ N) :
    ∃ k t : ℕ, n+2 ≤ k ∧ 2*t = 2^k ∧ c*2^k ≤ N ∧ N ≤ (2*c)*2^k

axiom fixed_dyadic_budget (c n a Γ N : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hN : c*2^(n+2) ≤ N) :
    ∃ k t : ℕ, n+2 ≤ k ∧ 2*t = 2^k ∧ c*2^k ≤ N ∧
      (((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(2^n*(2+a+Γ*(2*c)+1)))^(2^(k-n))+
        1/(2 : ℝ)^((4*2^n*(a+Γ*(2*c)+1))*2^(k-(n+2))))/(1/(2 : ℝ)^a)^(2*t)) ≤
          1/(2 : ℝ)^(Γ*N)

    (hN : c*2^(n+2) ≤ N) (hP : 2^n*(2+a+Γ*(2*c)+1) ≤ P)
    (hh : 4*2^n*(a+Γ*(2*c)+1) ≤ h) :
    ∃ k t : ℕ, n+2 ≤ k ∧ 2*t = 2^k ∧ c*2^k ≤ N ∧
      (((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^P)^(2^(k-n))+
        1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(n+2))))/(1/(2 : ℝ)^a)^(2*t)) ≤
          1/(2 : ℝ)^(Γ*N)

import Lax342547.DyadicTails

/-!
---
title: A small dyadic tail scale
type: lemma
---
The actual dyadic recurrence and the total rank budget give a scale with tail deficit ratio less than one quarter.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DyadicScale

open Lax342547.DyadicTails
open scoped BigOperators

axiom single_scale (f v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ)
    (hrec : ∀ j < n, 2*v j ≤ 2*(f j-f (j+1))+v (j+1))
    (hf0 : f 0 ≤ r) (hfn : 0 ≤ f n) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v 0) (hvn : v n ≤ f n)
    (hn : 8*r < n) : ∃ j < n, v j < 1/4

concepts.title: Actual dyadic deficit recurrence
concepts.description: For nonnegative decreasing span increments, tail deficits are nonnegative and satisfy the dyadic averaging recurrence.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.DyadicDeficits
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field

/-!
---
title: Actual dyadic deficit recurrence
type: lemma
---
For nonnegative decreasing span increments, tail deficits are nonnegative and satisfy the dyadic averaging recurrence.
-/

namespace Lax342547.DyadicTails

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def tailSum (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s b : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ Finset.range b, a (s-b+t)
noncomputable def tailDeficit (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s b : ℕ) : ℝ := a (s-b)-tailSum a s b/b

axiom tail_deficit_nonneg (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (s b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    0 ≤ tailDeficit a s b

axiom tail_deficit_le (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ t, 0 ≤ a t) (s b : ℕ) :
    tailDeficit a s b ≤ a (s-b)

axiom dyadic_recurrence (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : Antitone a) (s b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbs : 2*b ≤ s) :
    2*tailDeficit a s (2*b) ≤ 2*(a (s-2*b)-a (s-b))+tailDeficit a s b

end Lax342547.DyadicTails

dyadic_recurrence : ∀ (a : Nat → Real),
  Antitone a →
    ∀ (s b : Nat),
      instLTNat.lt 0 b →
        instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 b) s →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailDeficit a s (instHMul.hMul 2 b)))
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHSub.hSub (a (instHSub.hSub s (instHMul.hMul 2 b))) (a (instHSub.hSub s b))))
              (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailDeficit a s b))

tail_deficit_le : ∀ (a : Nat → Real),
  (∀ (t : Nat), Real.instLE.le 0 (a t)) →
    ∀ (s b : Nat), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailDeficit a s b) (a (instHSub.hSub s b))

  Antitone a → ∀ (s b : Nat), instLTNat.lt 0 b → Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailDeficit a s b)

concepts.title: Dimension and component-rank bounds for effective test spaces
concepts.description:
The tensor space generated by two projected pin spaces has dimension at
most the product of their dimensions. Its matrix ranks are bounded by
either factor. Summing these estimates gives the effective-space bounds
dim C <= K^2 and total component rank <= K from the actual pin budget.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedPins
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions

/-!
---
title: Dimension and component-rank bounds for effective test spaces
type: lemma
---
The tensor space generated by two projected pin spaces has dimension at
most the product of their dimensions. Its matrix ranks are bounded by
either factor. Summing these estimates gives the effective-space bounds
dim C <= K^2 and total component rank <= K from the actual pin budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EffectiveBounds

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins

axiom tensor_dimension {B : Type} [Fintype B] (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)) :
    Module.finrank Binary (tensorSpace S T) ≤ Module.finrank Binary S * Module.finrank Binary T

axiom tensor_rank {B : Type} [Fintype B] (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary))
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (hM : M ∈ tensorSpace S T) :
    M.rank ≤ min (Module.finrank Binary S) (Module.finrank Binary T)

axiom effective_bounds {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary))
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (K : ℕ) (hK : P.rank ≤ K) :
    Module.finrank Binary (effective X P i) ≤ K ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ effective X P i, (∑ e, (x.val e).rank) ≤ K

end Lax342547.EffectiveBounds

statements.signature:
effective_bounds : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype Comp] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [Fintype H]
  (X : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (K : Nat),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    And
      (instLENat.le
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.effective X P i) x))
        (instHPow.hPow K 2))
      (∀ (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem X x),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.effective X P i) x →
          instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun e => (x.val e).rank) K)

tensor_dimension : ∀ {B : Type} [Fintype B] (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  instLENat.le
    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.tensorSpace S T) x))
    (instHMul.hMul (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x))
      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)))

tensor_rank : ∀ {B : Type} [inst : Fintype B] (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (M : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.tensorSpace S T) M →
    instLENat.le M.rank
      (instMinNat.min (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x))
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)))

concepts.title: Full response obstructions are effective profiles plus selected atoms
concepts.description:
The actual two derivative tests force both residual contractions to zero.
Double annihilation gives row and column membership in pin-plus-key spaces.
Unselected sparse support removes the keys. Linear retractions identify
the remaining row/column constraints with tensor-space membership, giving
the actual effective remainder after selected subtraction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.DerivativeResponses

/-!
---
title: Full response obstructions are effective profiles plus selected atoms
type: lemma
---
The actual two derivative tests force both residual contractions to zero.
Double annihilation gives row and column membership in pin-plus-key spaces.
Unselected sparse support removes the keys. Linear retractions identify
the remaining row/column constraints with tensor-space membership, giving
the actual effective remainder after selected subtraction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EffectiveObstructions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.PrimalContractions
open Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions
open Lax342547.SparsePins Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ResidualLabels
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.DerivativeResponses

axiom rows_of_contraction_zero {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary))
    (h : ∀ ψ : Module.Dual Binary (B → Binary), T ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ →
      M.mulVecLin (coordinates ψ) = 0) : ∀ i, (fun j => M i j) ∈ T

axiom tensor_of_columns_rows {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Matrix B B Binary) (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary))
    (hcol : ∀ j, (fun i => M i j) ∈ S) (hrow : ∀ i, (fun j => M i j) ∈ T) :
    M ∈ tensorSpace S T

axiom unselected_vector {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hL : L.card ≤ R) (v : (Fin b → Binary) → Option (Base k n) → Binary)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (hfresh : ∀ z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (h : (∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (v s)) ∈
      projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1) :
    (∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (v s)) ∈ projected P i a

axiom sparse_columns {Label Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (L : Finset Label)
    (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Binary) (j : Coord × Base) :
    ∃ v : Label → Base → Binary,
      (fun a => (∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s (Z s)) a j) =
        ∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor p s (v s)

axiom transpose_blocks {Label Coord Base : Type}
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (L : Finset Label)
    (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Binary) :
    (∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s (Z s)).transpose =
      ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s ((Z s).transpose)

axiom unselected_tensor {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (hfresh : ∀ z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (M : Moment k n b degree) (hM : M = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s))
    (hcol : ∀ j, (fun a => M a j) ∈ projected P i (e, true) ⊔ individualKeys W i e)
    (hrow : ∀ a, (fun j => M a j) ∈ projected P i (e, false) ⊔ individualKeys W i e) :
    M ∈ tensorSpace (projected P i (e, true)) (projected P i (e, false))

axiom effective_component {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (i : Fin 2)
    (hU : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R) (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : (x i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s)) :
    (x i).val e ∈ tensorSpace (projected P i (e, true)) (projected P i (e, false))

axiom obstruction_decomposition {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∃ c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary,
      ∀ i, ((x - Lax342547.SelectedRemoval.selectedPart W c) i) ∈
        effective (Profile k n b degree) P i

end Lax342547.EffectiveObstructions

The affine-slice second-moment step keeps the independent coefficient draws
and the actual bad-pair probability. This finite estimate is also valid for

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling

/-!
---
title: Finite empirical variance from a two-coefficient comparison
type: lemma
---
The affine-slice second-moment step keeps the independent coefficient draws
and the actual bad-pair probability. This finite estimate is also valid for
arbitrary bounded common tests, without polynomial assumptions on them.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EmpiricalVariance
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom empirical_variance {Ω A : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype A]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (κ : A → ℝ) (F : Ω → A → ℝ) (good : A → A → Prop)
    (m ε δ : ℝ) (hρ : Probability ρ) (hκ : Probability κ)
    (hf : ∀ ω a,|F ω a| ≤ 1) (hm : |m| ≤ 1) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hmean : ∀ a b,good a b → (∑ ω,ρ ω*F ω a) = m ∧ (∑ ω,ρ ω*F ω b) = m)
    (hpair : ∀ a b,good a b → |(∑ ω,ρ ω*F ω a*F ω b)-m^2| ≤ ε)
    (hbad : cellMass (fun ab : A × A => κ ab.1*κ ab.2) (fun ab => ¬ good ab.1 ab.2) ≤ δ) :
    (∑ ω,ρ ω*((∑ a,κ a*F ω a)-m)^2) ≤ ε+4*δ

end Lax342547.EmpiricalVariance

/-!

title: Exactification of actual vanishing point predictions
type: lemma
---
Degree-two generic parameter error removes base discrepancies; excluded-selector recovery and an actual common tester-one point force the diagonal coefficient and the whole cut-space residual to vanish.
-/

    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary)
    (herr : cellMass (fun _ : Fin (ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic) → Binary =>
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic))
      (fun x => φ (parameterAtom (degree := degree) l s Flavor.generic x)+
        γ*eta (b := b) (degree := degree) hr (pointMoment selectorEval s (parameterBase l Flavor.generic x)) ≠ 0) < 1/4) :
    ∀ z (hz : ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0),

      1/(2 : ℝ)^(ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic))
      (fun x => φ (parameterAtom (degree := degree) l s Flavor.generic x)+
        γ*eta (b := b) (degree := degree) hr (pointMoment selectorEval s (parameterBase l Flavor.generic x)) ≠ 0) < 1/4) :

concepts.description: Compact convex feasible laws with an entropy budget and uniform conflict supersaturation admit a finite family of infeasible containers covering every independent set. Ordered fingerprints obey the same exponential counting budget as the paper.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.EntropySelectors
import Lax342547.ContainerRun
import Lax342547.FingerprintCounts

/-!
---
title: Entropy bounded container families
type: lemma
---
Compact convex feasible laws with an entropy budget and uniform conflict supersaturation admit a finite family of infeasible containers covering every independent set. Ordered fingerprints obey the same exponential counting budget as the paper.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EntropyContainers

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.ContainerLaws Lax342547.ContainerRun
open scoped BigOperators

axiom entropy_increment_positive (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) : 0 < -Real.log (1-ε)

axiom entropy_fingerprint_length {U : Type} [Fintype U]
    (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (q : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop) (ε B : ℝ)
    (law : Finset U → U → ℝ) (pick : Finset U → U) (I R : Finset U) (fuel L : ℕ)
    (hprob : ∀ ρ ∈ P, Probability ρ) (hc : Convex ℝ P)
    (hb : ∀ ρ ∈ P, 0 ≤ entropy ρ q ∧ entropy ρ q ≤ B)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1)
    (hspec : ∀ T, (residual P T).Nonempty →
      law T ∈ residual P T ∧ (∀ σ ∈ residual P T, entropy (law T) q ≤ entropy σ q) ∧
      pick T ∈ T ∧ ε ≤ neighborMass (law T) H (pick T) ∧ (∃ w ∈ T, H (pick T) w))
    (hL : B/(-Real.log (1-ε))+1 ≤ L) (hactive : (residual P R).Nonempty) :
    (run (fun T => (residual P T).Nonempty) pick H I fuel R).2.length ≤ L

axiom entropy_container_family {U : Type} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (q : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop) (ε B : ℝ) (L : ℕ)
    (hcompact : IsCompact P) (hconvex : Convex ℝ P) (hprob : ∀ ρ ∈ P, Probability ρ)
    (hbudget : ∀ ρ ∈ P, 0 ≤ entropy ρ q ∧ entropy ρ q ≤ B)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1)
    (hL : B/(-Real.log (1-ε))+1 ≤ L)
    (hsuper : ∀ ρ ∈ P, ε ≤ conflictMass ρ H) :
    ∃ C : Finset (Finset U),
      C.card ≤ (Fintype.card U+1)^L ∧
      (∀ R ∈ C, ¬ (residual P R).Nonempty) ∧
      (∀ I : Finset U, (∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, ¬ H x y) → ∃ R ∈ C, I ⊆ R)

end Lax342547.EntropyContainers

  IsCompact P →
    Convex Real P →
      (∀ (ρ : U → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P ρ → Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ) →
        (∀ (ρ : U → Real),

concepts.title: Entropy along feasible mixture lines, including new support
concepts.description: Old occupied coordinates have a finite directional derivative. Newly occupied coordinates give an exact t log t term whose positive coefficient forces the entropy difference quotient to negative infinity.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Slope

/-!
---
title: Entropy along feasible mixture lines, including new support
type: lemma
---
Old occupied coordinates have a finite directional derivative. Newly occupied coordinates give an exact t log t term whose positive coefficient forces the entropy difference quotient to negative infinity.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EntropyLines

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped Topology BigOperators
open Filter

noncomputable def mix {Ω : Type} (ρ ρ' : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : Ω → ℝ :=
  fun x => (1-t)*ρ x+t*ρ' x

noncomputable def coordinate (p q : ℝ) : ℝ := p*Real.log p-p*Real.log q

noncomputable def oldEntropy {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x, if ρ x = 0 then 0 else coordinate (mix ρ ρ' t x) (q x)

noncomputable def oldDerivative {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x, if ρ x = 0 then 0 else (ρ' x-ρ x)*(Real.log (ρ x)+1-Real.log (q x))

noncomputable def newMass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x, if ρ x = 0 then ρ' x else 0

noncomputable def newEntropy {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x, if ρ x = 0 then coordinate (ρ' x) (q x) else 0

axiom mix_derivative {Ω : Type} (ρ ρ' : Ω → ℝ) (x : Ω) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => mix ρ ρ' t x) (ρ' x-ρ x) 0

axiom old_entropy_derivative {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (oldEntropy ρ ρ' q) (oldDerivative ρ ρ' q) 0

axiom entropy_mix_identity {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ)
    (hρ' : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ' x) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    entropy (mix ρ ρ' t) q = oldEntropy ρ ρ' q t + t*newMass ρ ρ'*Real.log t + t*newEntropy ρ ρ' q

axiom old_entropy_zero {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ) :
    oldEntropy ρ ρ' q 0 = entropy ρ q

axiom entropy_new_support_slope {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ)
    (hρ' : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ' x) (hnew : 0 < newMass ρ ρ') :
    Tendsto (fun t => (entropy (mix ρ ρ' t) q-entropy ρ q)/t) (𝓝[>] 0) atBot

end Lax342547.EntropyLines

  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ' x)) →
    ∀ (t : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 t →
        Eq (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy (Lax342547.EntropyLines.mix ρ ρ' t) q)
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.EntropyLines.oldEntropy ρ ρ' q t)
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul t (Lax342547.EntropyLines.newMass ρ ρ')) (Real.log t)))
            (instHMul.hMul t (Lax342547.EntropyLines.newEntropy ρ ρ' q)))

concepts.description: A compact convex feasible family has an entropy minimizer positive on the union of all feasible supports. The exact one-sided variational inequality gives the information-projection bound and the negative log support cost, closing the finite content of Lemma 3.2.

import Lax342547.EntropyLines

/-!
---
title: Full feasible support and finite information projection
type: lemma
---
A compact convex feasible family has an entropy minimizer positive on the union of all feasible supports. The exact one-sided variational inequality gives the information-projection bound and the negative log support cost, closing the finite content of Lemma 3.2.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EntropyProjection

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.EntropyLines
open scoped Topology BigOperators
open Filter

axiom minimizer_full_support {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q ρ : Ω → ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ p ∈ P, Probability p) (hconv : Convex ℝ P) (hρ : ρ ∈ P)
    (hmin : ∀ p ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy p q) :
    ∀ ρ' ∈ P, ∀ x, 0 < ρ' x → 0 < ρ x

axiom minimizer_variational {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q ρ : Ω → ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ p ∈ P, Probability p) (hconv : Convex ℝ P) (hρ : ρ ∈ P)
    (hmin : ∀ p ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy p q) (ρ' : Ω → ℝ) (hρ' : ρ' ∈ P) :
    0 ≤ ∑ x, (ρ' x-ρ x)*(Real.log (ρ x)-Real.log (q x))

axiom projection_inequality {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q ρ : Ω → ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ p ∈ P, Probability p) (hconv : Convex ℝ P) (hρ : ρ ∈ P)
    (hmin : ∀ p ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy p q) (ρ' : Ω → ℝ) (hρ' : ρ' ∈ P) :
    entropy ρ' ρ ≤ entropy ρ' q-entropy ρ q

axiom projection_support_cost {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q ρ : Ω → ℝ)
    (hprob : ∀ p ∈ P, Probability p) (hconv : Convex ℝ P) (hρ : ρ ∈ P)
    (hmin : ∀ p ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy p q) (ρ' : Ω → ℝ) (hρ' : ρ' ∈ P)
    (S : Ω → Prop) (hS : ∀ x, ¬ S x → ρ' x = 0)
    (hmass : 0 < Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ S) :
    -Real.log (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ S) ≤ entropy ρ' q-entropy ρ q

axiom entropy_projection {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q : Ω → ℝ) (hcompact : IsCompact P) (hne : P.Nonempty)
    (hconv : Convex ℝ P) (hprob : ∀ p ∈ P, Probability p) :
    ∃ ρ ∈ P, (∀ ρ' ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy ρ' q) ∧
      (∀ ρ' ∈ P, ∀ x, 0 < ρ' x → 0 < ρ x) ∧
      (∀ ρ' ∈ P, entropy ρ' ρ ≤ entropy ρ' q-entropy ρ q)

end Lax342547.EntropyProjection

  IsCompact P →
    P.Nonempty →

        (∀ (p : Ω → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P p → Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability p) →

                (And

                    Set.instMembership.mem P ρ' → ∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ' x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x))
                  (∀ (ρ' : Ω → Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem P ρ' →

                        (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ' q)
                          (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q)))))

    Convex Real P →
      Set.instMembership.mem P ρ →
        (∀ (p : Ω → Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem P p →
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy p q)) →
          ∀ (ρ' : Ω → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P ρ' → ∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ' x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x)

minimizer_variational : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : Set (Ω → Real)) (q ρ : Ω → Real),
  (∀ (p : Ω → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P p → Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability p) →
    Convex Real P →
      Set.instMembership.mem P ρ →
        (∀ (p : Ω → Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem P p →
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy p q)) →
          ∀ (ρ' : Ω → Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem P ρ' →
              Real.instLE.le 0
                (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
                  instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub (ρ' x) (ρ x)) (instHSub.hSub (Real.log (ρ x)) (Real.log (q x))))

            Set.instMembership.mem P p →

          ∀ (ρ' : Ω → Real),

                (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ' q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q))

concepts.title: Deterministic entropy and neighborhood selections
concepts.description: Compact feasible residual laws have fixed entropy minimizers. Raw supersaturation supplies a deterministic residual unit with positive neighborhood mass, guaranteeing progress of fingerprint deletion.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ContainerLaws

/-!
---
title: Deterministic entropy and neighborhood selections
type: lemma
---
Compact feasible residual laws have fixed entropy minimizers. Raw supersaturation supplies a deterministic residual unit with positive neighborhood mass, guaranteeing progress of fingerprint deletion.
-/

namespace Lax342547.EntropySelectors

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.ContainerLaws Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom heavy_neighbor_nonempty {U : Type} [Fintype U]
    (ρ : U → ℝ) (R : Finset U) (H : U → U → Prop) (v : U)
    (hs : ∀ x, x ∉ R → ρ x = 0) (hm : 0 < neighborMass ρ H v) : ∃ w ∈ R, H v w

axiom entropy_selectors {U : Type} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (P : Set (U → ℝ)) (q : U → ℝ) (H : U → U → Prop) (ε : ℝ)
    (hc : IsCompact P) (hprob : ∀ ρ ∈ P, Probability ρ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hsuper : ∀ ρ ∈ P, ε ≤ conflictMass ρ H) :
    ∃ law : Finset U → U → ℝ, ∃ pick : Finset U → U,
      ∀ R, (residual P R).Nonempty →
        law R ∈ residual P R ∧
        (∀ σ ∈ residual P R, entropy (law R) q ≤ entropy σ q) ∧
        pick R ∈ R ∧ ε ≤ neighborMass (law R) H (pick R) ∧
        (∃ w ∈ R, H (pick R) w)

end Lax342547.EntropySelectors

statements.signature:
entropy_selectors : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (P : Set (U → Real)) (q : U → Real) (H : U → U → Prop) (ε : Real),
  IsCompact P →
    (∀ (ρ : U → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P ρ → Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
        (∀ (ρ : U → Real), Set.instMembership.mem P ρ → Real.instLE.le ε (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.conflictMass ρ H)) →
          Exists fun law =>
            Exists fun pick =>
              ∀ (R : Finset U),
                (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R).Nonempty →
                  And (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) (law R))
                    (And
                      (∀ (σ : U → Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.residual P R) σ →
                          Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy (law R) q)
                            (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy σ q))
                      (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem R (pick R))
                        (And (Real.instLE.le ε (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.neighborMass (law R) H (pick R)))
                          (Exists fun w => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem R w) (H (pick R) w)))))

heavy_neighbor_nonempty : ∀ {U : Type} [inst : Fintype U] (ρ : U → Real) (R : Finset U) (H : U → U → Prop) (v : U),
  (∀ (x : U), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem R x) → Eq (ρ x) 0) →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.neighborMass ρ H v) →
      Exists fun w => And (SetLike.instMembership.mem R w) (H v w)

concepts.title: Exact image pins in nominal coefficient spaces
concepts.description:
A pin stores a subspace at each component/sign and the prescribed linear
image on that subspace. New rank is the sum of dimensions of the tested
spaces in the quotients by the old pins, before any frame is applied.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Isomorphisms

/-!
---
title: Exact image pins in nominal coefficient spaces
type: lemma
---
A pin stores a subspace at each component/sign and the prescribed linear
image on that subspace. New rank is the sum of dimensions of the tested
spaces in the quotients by the old pins, before any frame is applied.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ExactPins

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def Pin (Axis I N : Type) :=
  Σ S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary), ∀ a, S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)

namespace Pin

variable {Axis I N : Type}

def space (P : Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis) : Submodule Binary (I → Binary) := P.1 a
def value (P : Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis) : P.space a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) := P.2 a

def empty : Pin Axis I N := ⟨fun _ => ⊥, fun _ => 0⟩

def Extends (P Q : Pin Axis I N) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : ∀ a, P.space a ≤ Q.space a,
    ∀ a (v : P.space a), Q.value a ⟨v.val, h a v.property⟩ = P.value a v

noncomputable def rank [Fintype Axis] (P : Pin Axis I N) : ℕ :=
  ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (P.space a)

noncomputable def relativeRank [Fintype Axis] (P Q : Pin Axis I N) : ℕ :=
  ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary ((Q.space a).map (P.space a).mkQ)

def event {Ω : Type} (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) : Set Ω :=
  {o | ∀ a (v : P.space a), A o a v.val = P.value a v}

def joinAt {Ω : Type} (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P Q : Pin Axis I N) (o : Ω) : Pin Axis I N :=
  ⟨fun a => P.space a ⊔ Q.space a,
    fun a => (A o a).comp (P.space a ⊔ Q.space a).subtype⟩

noncomputable def basisMatrix [Fintype I] (P : Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis) :
    Matrix I (Fin (Module.finrank Binary (P.space a))) Binary :=
  fun i j => (Module.finBasis Binary (P.space a) j).val i

noncomputable def basisImage [Fintype I] (P : Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis) :
    Matrix N (Fin (Module.finrank Binary (P.space a))) Binary :=
  fun n j => P.value a (Module.finBasis Binary (P.space a) j) n

end Pin

noncomputable instance {Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N] :
    Fintype (Pin Axis I N) := by
  classical
  let : Finite (Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) :=
    Finite.of_injective (fun S : Submodule Binary (I → Binary) => (S : Set (I → Binary))) SetLike.coe_injective
  let : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (I → Binary), Finite (S →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) :=
    fun S => Finite.of_injective (fun f : S →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) => (f : S → N → Binary)) DFunLike.coe_injective
  exact Fintype.ofFinite (Σ S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary), ∀ a, S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))

axiom event_refinement {Ω Axis I N : Type}
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (P Q : Pin Axis I N)
    (o : Ω) (ho : o ∈ P.event A ∩ Q.event A) :
    P.Extends (P.joinAt A Q o) ∧ Q.Extends (P.joinAt A Q o) ∧
      (P.joinAt A Q o).event A = P.event A ∩ Q.event A

axiom rank_refinement {Ω Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (P Q : Pin Axis I N) (o : Ω) :
    (P.joinAt A Q o).rank = P.rank + P.relativeRank Q

axiom rank_mono {Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    (P Q : Pin Axis I N) (h : P.Extends Q) : P.rank ≤ Q.rank

axiom basis_rank {Axis I N : Type} [Fintype I] (P : Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis) :
    (P.basisMatrix a).rank = Module.finrank Binary (P.space a)

axiom event_basis {Ω Axis I N : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : Ω → Axis → Matrix N I Binary) (P : Pin Axis I N) :
    P.event (fun o a => (A o a).mulVecLin) =
      {o | ∀ a, A o a * P.basisMatrix a = P.basisImage a}

end Lax342547.ExactPins

statements.signature:
basis_rank : ∀ {Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype I] (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N) (a : Axis),
  Eq (P.basisMatrix a).rank
    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (P.space a) x))

event_basis : ∀ {Ω Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype I] (A : Ω → Axis → Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N),
  Eq (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event (fun o a => (A o a).mulVecLin) P)
    (Set.ofPred fun o =>
      ∀ (a : Axis), Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (A o a) (P.basisMatrix a)) (P.basisImage a))

event_refinement : ∀ {Ω Axis I N : Type}
  (A :
    Ω →
      Axis →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N) (o : Ω),
  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.instInter.inter (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P) (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A Q))
      o →
    And (P.Extends (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.joinAt A P Q o))
      (And (Q.Extends (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.joinAt A P Q o))
        (Eq (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.joinAt A P Q o))
          (Set.instInter.inter (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P) (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A Q))))

rank_mono : ∀ {Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N),
  P.Extends Q → instLENat.le P.rank Q.rank

rank_refinement : ∀ {Ω Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
  (A :
    Ω →
      Axis →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N) (o : Ω),
  Eq (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.joinAt A P Q o).rank (instHAdd.hAdd P.rank (P.relativeRank Q))

concepts.title: Projection removes the exposed terms
concepts.description: The projection of the actual remaining sum equals the projection of the full sum because the exposed column span kills each exposed term.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PartitionLists
import Lax342547.CoverProjection
import Lax342547.ListDeficits

/-!
---
title: Projection removes the exposed terms
type: lemma
---
The projection of the actual remaining sum equals the projection of the full sum because the exposed column span kills each exposed term.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ExposedSums

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.CoverProjection
open scoped BigOperators

axiom remaining_projection_sum {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) (hI : l.toFinset = Finset.univ) (t : ℕ) :
    let S := spanAfter (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i)) ⊥ (l.take t)
    let T := spanAfter (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap) ⊥ (l.take t)
    projection (∑ i : (l.drop t).toFinset, M i.val) S T = projection (∑ i, M i) S T

end Lax342547.ExposedSums

statements.signature:
remaining_projection_sum : ∀ {K V W ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_4 : Module K V] [inst_5 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_6 : Module K W] (M : ι → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W)
  (l : List ι),
  l.Nodup →
    Eq l.toFinset Finset.univ →
      ∀ (t : Nat),
        let S := Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter (fun i => (M i).range) Submodule.instBot.bot (List.take t l);
        let T := Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter (fun i => (M i).dualMap.range) Submodule.instBot.bot (List.take t l);
        Eq (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i.val) S T)
          (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i) S T)

concepts.title: Finite ordered fingerprint budgets
concepts.description: Padding a fingerprint with absent entries injects all fingerprints of length at most L into words of length L over the raw alphabet with one extra symbol. Thus their number is at most (card U + 1)^L.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic

/-!
---
title: Finite ordered fingerprint budgets
type: lemma
---
Padding a fingerprint with absent entries injects all fingerprints of length at most L into words of length L over the raw alphabet with one extra symbol. Thus their number is at most (card U + 1)^L.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FingerprintCounts



noncomputable def pad {U : Type} (L : ℕ) (l : List U) : List (Option U) :=
  l.map some ++ List.replicate (L-l.length) none

axiom pad_recovers {U : Type} (L : ℕ) (l : List U) : (pad L l).filterMap id = l

axiom pad_injective {U : Type} (L : ℕ) : Function.Injective (pad (U := U) L)

axiom pad_length {U : Type} (L : ℕ) (l : List U) (hl : l.length ≤ L) : (pad L l).length = L

axiom bounded_list_count {U : Type} [Fintype U] (T : Finset (List U)) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ l ∈ T, l.length ≤ L) : T.card ≤ (Fintype.card U+1)^L

end Lax342547.FingerprintCounts

  (∀ (l : List U), SetLike.instMembership.mem T l → instLENat.le l.length L) →
    instLENat.le T.card (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card U) 1) L)
