concepts.title: The paper fingerprint and exception scales
concepts.description: The paper entropy length is bounded by an explicit natural fingerprint length. Coarse binomial counting already gives an exponentially small vertex tail with M = 2^1000, and disjoint pair exceptions obey the corresponding power bound at the paper sample size.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawToGraph
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed

/-!
---
title: The paper fingerprint and exception scales
type: lemma
---
The paper entropy length is bounded by an explicit natural fingerprint length. Coarse binomial counting already gives an exponentially small vertex tail with M = 2^1000, and disjoint pair exceptions obey the corresponding power bound at the paper sample size.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FingerprintScales

open Lax342547.RawToGraph
open Filter

def sampleSize (g N : ℕ) : ℕ := 2^(1000*g*N)
def fingerprintLength (g N : ℕ) : ℕ := 4000*g*N*2^(100*g*N)+2

axiom logarithmic_progress (ε : ℝ) (_hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) : ε ≤ -Real.log (1-ε)

axiom paper_fingerprint_length (g N : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Real.log ((2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N))/(-Real.log (1-1/(2 : ℝ)^(100*g*N)))+1 ≤
      fingerprintLength g N

axiom paper_sample_ceiling (m : ℕ) : 200*((m+199)/200-1) < m ∨ m = 0

axiom vertex_exception_power (m k : ℕ) (hk : m ≤ 200*k) :
    (m.choose k : ℝ)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^1000)^k ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^m

axiom pair_exception_power (g N k : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hk : sampleSize g N ≤ 200*k) :
    (sampleSize g N : ℝ)^(2*k)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N))^k ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^(sampleSize g N)

end Lax342547.FingerprintScales

statements.signature:
logarithmic_progress : ∀ (ε : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε → Real.instLT.lt ε 1 → Real.instLE.le ε (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log (instHSub.hSub 1 ε)))

pair_exception_power : ∀ (g N k : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 g →
    instLTNat.lt 0 N →
      instLENat.le (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N) (instHMul.hMul 200 k) →
        Real.instLE.le
          (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N).cast (instHMul.hMul 2 k))
            (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4000 g) N))) k))
          (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N)))

paper_fingerprint_length : ∀ (g N : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 g →
    instLTNat.lt 0 N →
      Real.instLE.le
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.log (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4000 g) N)))
            (Real.instNeg.neg
              (Real.log (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 100 g) N)))))))
          1)
        (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.fingerprintLength g N).cast

paper_sample_ceiling : ∀ (m : Nat),
  Or (instLTNat.lt (instHMul.hMul 200 (instHSub.hSub (instHDiv.hDiv (instHAdd.hAdd m 199) 200) 1)) m) (Eq m 0)

vertex_exception_power : ∀ (m k : Nat),
  instLENat.le m (instHMul.hMul 200 k) →
    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (m.choose k).cast (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 1000)) k))
      (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 m))

concepts.title: Finite accepted overlap to original hole mass
concepts.description: Independent parameter laws, original key-indexed record partitions and a proved local cell bound give an actual-mass collision inequality. The quantitative discarded-cell term retains the key-space and record counts.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RecordCollision
import Lax342547.ParameterCellAveraging
import Lax342547.CollisionExponents

/-!
---
title: Finite accepted overlap to original hole mass
type: lemma
---
Independent parameter laws, original key-indexed record partitions and a proved local cell bound give an actual-mass collision inequality. The quantitative discarded-cell term retains the key-space and record counts.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FiniteCollision

open Lax342547.RecordCollision Lax342547.KeyMeasures Lax342547.CellAveraging
open Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.ParameterCellAveraging Lax342547.CollisionPruning

noncomputable def acceptedDensity {A Ω Q : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype Ω]
    (p : A → ℝ) (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : A → Ω → Q) (accept : A → Ω → Prop) : Q → ℝ :=
  fun q => ∑ x, p x * keyMass ρ (key x) (accept x) q

axiom average_sub {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (f g : A → B → ℝ) :
    average p q (fun x y => f x y - g x y) = average p q f - average p q g

axiom independent_key_overlap {A B ΩA ΩB Q : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Q] [Nonempty Q]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (keyA : A → ΩA → Q) (keyB : B → ΩB → Q)

concepts.title: Finite pin-injection exception
concepts.description: Greedy independent failure probes, adaptive protected witnesses, and actual finite Fubini give an exception bound for whole-unit channel injection.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SequentialTests
import Lax342547.IndependentSampling
import Lax342547.AmplifiedTests
import Lax342547.UniversalWitnesses
import Lax342547.IndependentWitnesses
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DFinsupp

/-!
---
title: Finite pin-injection exception
type: lemma
---
Greedy independent failure probes, adaptive protected witnesses, and actual finite Fubini give an exception bound for whole-unit channel injection.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FiniteInjection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped BigOperators

def pinFailure {N H : Type} [Fintype N] (V : Submodule Binary (N → Binary))
    (Y : Matrix N H Binary) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) : Prop :=
  ∃ v : V,v.val ≠ 0 ∧ Y.transpose.mulVec v.val ∈ S

axiom finite_injection_exception {A B N H : Type}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq H]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (V : A → Submodule Binary (N → Binary))
    (Y : B → Matrix N H Binary) (S : B → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (K ℓ : ℕ) (L η δ : ℝ) (hα : Probability α) (hβ : Probability β)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hgap : δ < η) (hV : ∀ a,Module.finrank Binary (V a) ≤ K)
    (hS : ∀ b,Module.finrank Binary (S b) ≤ K)
    (hcap : ∀ y,push β Y y ≤ L*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) y)
    (havoid : ∀ j,j < ℓ → ∀ t : Fin j → A,
      cellMass α (fun a => ¬ Disjoint (V a) (⨆ i : Fin j,V (t i))) ≤ δ) :
    cellMass β (fun b => η ≤ cellMass α (fun a => pinFailure (V a) (Y b) (S b))) ≤
      (L*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*K+2*K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*ℓ)))/(η-δ)^ℓ

end Lax342547.FiniteInjection

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq H] (α : A → Real) (β : B → Real)
  (V : A → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (Y : B → Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (S : B → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)) (K ℓ : Nat) (L η δ : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability α →
    Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability β →
      Real.instLE.le 0 L →
        Real.instLT.lt δ η →
          (∀ (a : A),
              instLENat.le
                (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (V a) x)) K) →
            (∀ (b : B),
                instLENat.le
                  (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S b) x))
                  K) →
              (∀ (y : Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                  Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push β Y y)
                    (instHMul.hMul L
                      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
                        y))) →
                (∀ (j : Nat),
                    instLTNat.lt j ℓ →
                      ∀ (t : Fin j → A),
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a => Not (Disjoint (V a) (iSup fun i => V (t i))))
                          δ) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass β fun b =>
                      Real.instLE.le η
                        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a =>
                          Lax342547.FiniteInjection.pinFailure (V a) (Y b) (S b)))
                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                      (instHMul.hMul L
                        (instHDiv.hDiv
                          (instHPow.hPow 2
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) K) (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 K) ℓ)))
                          (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) ℓ))))
                      (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub η δ) ℓ))

concepts.title: Finite linear images and their uniform-law density bounds
concepts.description:
Surjective linear observation cannot increase the codimension of a
subspace. Over the binary field, an image of codimension at most c has
point masses bounded by 2^c times the full-space uniform point mass.
These are the projection and domination steps used for mixer row bits.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Constructions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions

/-!
---
title: Finite linear images and their uniform-law density bounds
type: lemma
---
Surjective linear observation cannot increase the codimension of a
subspace. Over the binary field, an image of codimension at most c has
point masses bounded by 2^c times the full-space uniform point mass.
These are the projection and domination steps used for mixer row bits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

def familyMap {K T : Type} [Field K] {V W : T → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) : (∀ i, V i) →ₗ[K] (∀ i, W i) :=
  LinearMap.pi (fun i => (f i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))

axiom family_codimension {K T : Type} [Field K] [Fintype T] {V W : T → Type}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (V i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (W i)]
    (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) (c : T → ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ i, Module.finrank K (W i) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (f i)) + c i) :
    Module.finrank K (∀ i, W i) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (familyMap f)) + ∑ i, c i

axiom codimension_map_le {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (S : Submodule K V) :
    Module.finrank K W - Module.finrank K (S.map f) ≤ Module.finrank K V - Module.finrank K S

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

axiom uniform_image_bound {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary W]
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] W) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : Module.finrank Binary W ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f) + c) (y : W) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype V).map f y ≤ 2 ^ c * PMF.uniformOfFintype W y

axiom uniform_image_of_surjective {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary W]
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] W) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype V).map f = PMF.uniformOfFintype W

axiom uniform_affine_image_bound {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] [Fintype V]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] W) (a y : W) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : r ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f)) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype V).map (fun x => a + f x) y ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r

end Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

      instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (W i))

    instLENat.le (Module.finrank K ((i : T) → W i))
      (instHAdd.hAdd

    ENNReal.instLE.le

  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W]
  (f : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V W) (c : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W)
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem f.range x)) c) →
    ∀ (y : W),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (PMF.map (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe f) (PMF.uniformOfFintype V)) y)

concepts.title: Finite even moment expansion
concepts.description: An actual finite even moment expands over independent samples. Bounded unit-side signs may be removed whenever the channel character expectation is nonnegative.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset

/-!
---
title: Finite even moment expansion
type: lemma
---
An actual finite even moment expands over independent samples. Bounded unit-side signs may be removed whenever the channel character expectation is nonnegative.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FiniteMoments

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom finite_even_moment {Ω C : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype C]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (ν : C → ℝ) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (χ : Ω → C → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    (∑ c, ν c*|∑ x, μ x*ψ x*χ x c|^(2*t)) =
      ∑ sample : Fin (2*t) → Ω, productLaw (fun _ : Fin (2*t) => μ) sample*

concepts.title: Finite independent sampling and vertex exception tails
concepts.description: Finite product weights form a probability law. Cylinder events factor over sample positions, and a subset union bound gives the binomial estimate for too many positions in a raw vertex exception.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ContainerLaws
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset

/-!
---
title: Finite independent sampling and vertex exception tails
type: lemma
---
Finite product weights form a probability law. Cylinder events factor over sample positions, and a subset union bound gives the binomial estimate for too many positions in a raw vertex exception.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FiniteSampling

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def productLaw {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] (μ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (sample : ι → Ω) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i, μ i (sample i)

axiom product_probability {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ i, Probability (μ i)) : Probability (productLaw μ)

axiom cylinder_probability {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) :
    cellMass (productLaw μ) (fun sample => ∀ i, A i (sample i)) = ∏ i, cellMass (μ i) (A i)

axiom coordinate_set_probability {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) (S : Ω → Prop) (hμ : Probability μ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ)) (fun sample => ∀ i ∈ T, S (sample i)) =
      (cellMass μ S)^T.card

axiom cell_mass_mono {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (S T : Ω → Prop) (hρ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) (hST : ∀ x, S x → T x) :
    cellMass ρ S ≤ cellMass ρ T

axiom cell_mass_union_bound {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (A : J → Ω → Prop) (T : Finset J) (hρ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) :
    cellMass ρ (fun x => ∃ j ∈ T, A j x) ≤ ∑ j ∈ T, cellMass ρ (A j)

axiom exceptional_positions_bound {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (S : Ω → Prop) (k : ℕ) (hμ : Probability μ) : by
      classical
      exact cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
          (fun sample => k ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => S (sample i))).card) ≤
        (Fintype.card ι).choose k*(cellMass μ S)^k

end Lax342547.FiniteSampling

      (T.sum fun j => Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ (A j))

  Eq (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw μ) fun sample => ∀ (i : ι), A i (sample i))
    (Finset.univ.prod fun i => Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (μ i) (A i))

    Real.instLE.le
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun sample =>
        instLENat.le k (Finset.filter (fun i => S (sample i)) Finset.univ).card)

import Lax342547.MultiChannelPhase

/-!
---
title: Fixed-parameter endpoint-group phase bounds
type: lemma
---
Original no-cover rank growth and fixed parameters yield an exponential phase estimate for selected endpoint images with whole-unit marks.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FixedMultiPhase

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ChannelDensity Lax342547.ChannelCharacters

axiom fixed_parameter_marked_unit_phase {e d B N Ω U : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype d] [Nonempty d] [Fintype U] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq d] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix N N Binary) (ψ : (e → Matrix N N Binary) → Ω → ℝ) (r h a c Γ P : ℕ)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ S, (∑ i, (S i).rank) ≤ r → ∀ x, |ψ S x| ≤ 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hscale : c*2^(100*r+12) ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hP : 2^(100*r+10)*(2+a+Γ*(2*c)+1) ≤ P)
    (hh : 4*2^(100*r+10)*(a+Γ*(2*c)+1) ≤ h)
    (β : U → ℝ) (image : U → (e × d) → Frame B (Fin h) N E) (L : ℝ)
    (S : U → e → Matrix N N Binary)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hβcap : ∀ o, push β image o ≤ L*weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E) o)
    (hS : ∀ o, (∑ i, (S o i).rank) ≤ r)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → N → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → N → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N/c) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N/c) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^P) :
    |∑ o, β o*(∑ x, μ x*ψ (S o) x*tensorCharacter h (fun i : e × d => A x i.1) (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (image o a))))| ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^a+L*((r+1 : ℝ)^Fintype.card e*(2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card N*r)*
        (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (e × d)*(h*h+2))/(2 : ℝ)^(Γ*Fintype.card N))

end Lax342547.FixedMultiPhase

                                                  (LinearMap.piMap fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin) S T)
                                                0)
                                            (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 P))) →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (abs
                                    (Finset.univ.sum fun o =>
                                      instHMul.hMul (β o)
                                        (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
                                          instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (μ x) (ψ (S o) x))
                                            (Lax342547.TensorCharacters.tensorCharacter h (A x)
                                              (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ChannelColumns.columnsEquiv h)
                                                fun a => Lax342547.ChannelDensity.channels (o a))))))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 a))
                                    (instHMul.hMul L
                                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                                        (instHMul.hMul
                                          (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd r.cast 1) (Fintype.card e))
                                            (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card N)) r)))
                                          (instHPow.hPow 2
                                            (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card e) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul h h) 2))))

concepts.title: Uniform positive Gram mass from bounded tester prescriptions
concepts.description:
At a fixed selector the sharp mixer contribution vanishes. Prescribing only
retained tester pairs has mass independent of the growing free dimension.
Routing across all retained tester pairs realizes every target slice Gram.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices

/-!
---
title: Uniform positive Gram mass from bounded tester prescriptions
type: lemma
---
At a fixed selector the sharp mixer contribution vanishes. Prescribing only
retained tester pairs has mass independent of the growing free dimension.
Routing across all retained tester pairs realizes every target slice Gram.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices Lax342547.Atoms
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

abbrev TesterBlock (k : ℕ) := Option (Tag k × Tag k)

def testerCoordinate {k n r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n)
    (u : TesterBlock k × Fin r × Bool) : Base k n :=
  let i := if u.2.2 then pairRight hr u.2.1 else pairLeft hr u.2.1
  match u.1 with
  | none => shared i
  | some (d,t) => ordinary d t i

def blockRetained {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : TesterBlock k → Prop
  | none => match f with | .pure _ => False | _ => True
  | some (d,t) => l ∈ interval k d ∧ match f with
      | .generic => True | .sharedOnly => False | .pure blocks => (d,t) ∈ blocks

abbrev Slots {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (r : ℕ) :=
  {q : TesterBlock k // blockRetained l f q} × Fin r × Bool

noncomputable instance {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    Fintype {q : TesterBlock k // blockRetained l f q} := Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable instance {k r : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : Fintype (Slots l f r) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable instance {k r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) : Fintype (Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary) := Fintype.ofFinite _

def slotIndex {k n r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (u : Slots l f r) : {a : Base k n // a ∈ retained l f} :=
  ⟨testerCoordinate hr (u.1.val,u.2), (show testerCoordinate hr (u.1.val,u.2) ∈ retained (n := n) l f ↔ blockRetained l f u.1.val from by
      change retained l f (testerCoordinate hr (u.1.val,u.2)) ↔ _
      cases u.1.val with
      | none => cases f <;> simp [testerCoordinate,shared,retained,blockRetained]
      | some q => cases f <;> simp [testerCoordinate,ordinary,retained,blockRetained]).mpr u.1.property⟩

def restrictTesters {k n r : ℕ} {D : Type} (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    Coefficients n l f D →ₗ[Binary] Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary where
  toFun V := fun u j => V (slotIndex hr l f u) j
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def restrictedGram {k r : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D : Type}
    (X : Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary) : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary :=
  fun i j => ∑ q : {q : TesterBlock k // blockRetained l f q},∑ ρ : Fin r,
    X (q,ρ,false) i*X (q,ρ,true) j

abbrev Pairs {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (r : ℕ) :=
  {q : TesterBlock k // blockRetained l f q} × Fin r

def routing {k r : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D : Type}
    (c : Option D → Pairs l f r) (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun u j => if u.2.2 then Function.extend c (fun i => G i j) 0 (u.1,u.2.1)
    else if (u.1,u.2.1) = c j then 1 else 0

def massFloor {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (r : ℕ) (D : Type) [Fintype D] : ℝ :=
  1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Slots l f r)*Fintype.card (Option D))

axiom same_selector_gram {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type}
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (V W : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary) :
    (pointColumns s V).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s W =
      fun i j => (∑ d : Tag k,∑ t : Tag k,∑ ρ : Fin r,
        V (ordinary d t (pairLeft hr ρ)) i*W (ordinary d t (pairRight hr ρ)) j)+
        ∑ ρ : Fin r,V (shared (pairLeft hr ρ)) i*W (shared (pairRight hr ρ)) j

axiom restriction_uniform {k n r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)).map (restrictTesters hr l f) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary)

axiom prescription_mass {k n r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (X : Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)).toOuterMeasure
      {V | restrictTesters hr l f V = X} =
        1/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Fintype.card (Slots l f r)*Fintype.card (Option D))

axiom gram_restriction {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type}
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (V : Coefficients n l f D) :
    (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) =
      restrictedGram (restrictTesters hr l f V)

axiom routed_gram {k r : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D : Type}
    [Fintype D]
    (c : Option D → Pairs l f r) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) : restrictedGram (routing c G) = G

axiom gram_mass_bound {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (c : Option D → Pairs l f r) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    1/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Fintype.card (Slots l f r)*Fintype.card (Option D)) ≤
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)).toOuterMeasure
        {V | (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) = G}

axiom positive_gram_mass {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (hroom : Fintype.card (Option D) ≤ Fintype.card (Pairs l f r))
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    1/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Fintype.card (Slots l f r)*Fintype.card (Option D)) ≤
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)).toOuterMeasure
        {V | (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) = G}

axiom massFloor_pos {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (r : ℕ) (D : Type) [Fintype D] :
    0 < massFloor l f r D

axiom gram_cell_mass {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (hroom : Fintype.card (Option D) ≤ Fintype.card (Pairs l f r))
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    massFloor l f r D ≤ Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)))
      (fun V => (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) = G)

end
end Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram

concepts.title: Stabilized ranks and the radical quotient
concepts.description:
The flat-level and quotient steps of Lemma 5.2. These statements apply to
arbitrary finite-dimensional symmetric bilinear forms; no positivity is used.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Properties
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Bilinear
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

/-!
---
title: Stabilized ranks and the radical quotient
type: lemma
---
The flat-level and quotient steps of Lemma 5.2. These statements apply to
arbitrary finite-dimensional symmetric bilinear forms; no positivity is used.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FlatRank

axiom exists_flat_level (r : ℕ → ℕ) (A R J : ℕ) (hmono : Monotone r)
    (hbound : ∀ j ≤ J, r j ≤ R) (hroom : A + 2 * R + 2 ≤ J) :
    ∃ j, A ≤ j ∧ j + 2 ≤ J ∧ r j = r (j + 1) ∧ r (j + 1) = r (j + 2)

variable {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]

noncomputable def quotientPairing (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (hB : B.IsSymm) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm K (V ⧸ B.ker) :=
  LinearMap.IsRefl.liftQ₂ B B.ker hB.isRefl le_rfl

axiom quotientPairing_nondegenerate (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (hB : B.IsSymm) :
    (quotientPairing B hB).Nondegenerate

axiom quotient_restriction_surjective [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (hB : B.IsSymm) (U : Submodule K V)
    (hflat : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (B.restrict U)) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B)) :
    Function.Surjective (B.ker.mkQ.comp U.subtype)

axiom exists_commuting_idempotents [FiniteDimensional K V] {ι : Type}
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (hB : B.IsSymm) (U : Submodule K V)
    (hflat : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (B.restrict U)) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B))
    (shift : ι → U →ₗ[K] V)
    (hadj : ∀ a (x y : U), B (shift a x) y = B x (shift a y))
    (hidem : ∀ a (x y : U), B (shift a x) (shift a y) = B (shift a x) y)
    (hcomm : ∀ a c (x y : U), B (shift a x) (shift c y) = B (shift c x) (shift a y)) :
    ∃ M : ι → Module.End K (V ⧸ B.ker),
      (∀ a (x : U), M a (B.ker.mkQ x) = B.ker.mkQ (shift a x)) ∧
      (∀ a x y, quotientPairing B hB (M a x) y = quotientPairing B hB x (M a y)) ∧
      (∀ a, M a * M a = M a) ∧ ∀ a c, M a * M c = M c * M a

end Lax342547.FlatRank

  Eq (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (LinearMap.range (B.restrict U)) x))

        (∀ (a : ι) (x y : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem U x),
            Eq

                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (shift a) y))
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (shift a) x)) y.val)) →
          (∀ (a c : ι) (x y : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem U x),

                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.ker B).mkQ (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (shift a) x)))
                (And
                  (∀ (a : ι) (x y : Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient V (LinearMap.ker B)),
                    Eq
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.FlatRank.quotientPairing B hB)
                          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (M a) x))
                        y)
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.FlatRank.quotientPairing B hB) x)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (M a) y)))
                  (And (∀ (a : ι), Eq (instHMul.hMul (M a) (M a)) (M a))
                    (∀ (a c : ι), Eq (instHMul.hMul (M a) (M c)) (instHMul.hMul (M c) (M a)))))

concepts.title: Affine-slice comparison for every actual atom flavor
concepts.description:
Lemma 9.4 uses independent uniform affine coefficients on exactly the actual
retained coordinates of the chosen flavor. The free projection is exactly
uniform for generic, shared-only and every pure flavor. Conditioning on all
prescribed component Grams has the explicit beta^-2 cost, with no cost for
setting excluded flavor coordinates to zero. Arbitrary bounded common tests
of the actual primal image arrays satisfy the checked variance budget.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AffineSliceVariance
import Lax342547.Atoms

/-!
---
title: Affine-slice comparison for every actual atom flavor
type: lemma
---
Lemma 9.4 uses independent uniform affine coefficients on exactly the actual
retained coordinates of the chosen flavor. The free projection is exactly
uniform for generic, shared-only and every pure flavor. Conditioning on all
prescribed component Grams has the explicit beta^-2 cost, with no cost for
setting excluded flavor coordinates to zero. Arbitrary bounded common tests
of the actual primal image arrays satisfy the checked variance budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open Lax342547.AffineSliceVariance
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

abbrev Coefficients {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (D : Type) :=
    Matrix {i : Base k n // i ∈ retained (k := k) (n := n) l f} (Option D) Binary

 noncomputable instance {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (D : Type) [Fintype D] :
    Fintype (Coefficients n l f D) := Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable def value {k n : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D : Type}
    (V : Coefficients n l f D) : Matrix (Base k n) (Option D) Binary :=
    fun i j => parameterValue (fun a => V a j) i

def freeIndex {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (i : Fin n) :
    {a : Base k n // a ∈ retained (k := k) (n := n) l f} :=
    ⟨free i,by
      cases f with
      | generic => trivial
      | sharedOnly => trivial
      | pure blocks => change (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0; decide⟩

def freePairMap {k n : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D : Type} :
    (Coefficients n l f D × Coefficients n l f D) →ₗ[Binary]
      (Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary) where
  toFun V := (fun i j => V.1 (freeIndex l f i) j,fun i j => V.2 (freeIndex l f i) j)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

axiom free_pair_uniform {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) {D : Type}
    [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D × Coefficients n l f D)).map freePairMap =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Option D) Binary)

axiom nominal_pair_failure {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (s : Fin b → Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D × Coefficients n l f D)).toOuterMeasure
      {V | ¬ Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (value V.1)).mulVec uv.1+
          (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (value V.2)).mulVec uv.2)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^n

axiom conditioned_pair_failure {k n b degree : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (C : Coefficients n l f D → Prop) (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hC : β ≤ cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D))) C) :
    cellMass (fun V : Coefficients n l f D × Coefficients n l f D =>
        conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) C V.1*
          conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) C V.2)
      (fun V => ¬ Function.Injective (fun uv : (Option D → Binary) × (Option D → Binary) =>
        (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (value V.1)).mulVec uv.1+
          (pointColumns (degree := degree) s (value V.2)).mulVec uv.2)) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/β^2

axiom flavor_slice_variance {S H D : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    [Fintype H] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k)
    (N : ℕ) (sel : Fin b → Binary)
    (E : S → Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Coordinate k n b degree) Binary)
    (G : S → Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary)
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i))]
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin N) (G i))]
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hGram : β ≤ cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)))
      (fun V : Coefficients n l f D => GramEvent sel E G (value V)))
    (test : (S → (Fin N × (Option D ⊕ Option D) → Binary)) → ℝ) (htest : ∀ z,|test z| ≤ 1)
    (hN : Fintype.card (Option D)+Fintype.card (Option D)+1 ≤ N)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option D)*Fintype.card (Option D)+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D))+1)) :
    (∑ o : ∀ i,Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
      ((∑ V : Coefficients n l f D,
        conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) (fun V : Coefficients n l f D => GramEvent sel E G (value V)) V*
          test (fun i => batchEquiv ((o i).P*pointColumns (k := k) (n := n) (b := b) (degree := degree) sel (value V),(o i).Q*pointColumns (k := k) (n := n) (b := b) (degree := degree) sel (value V))))-
            referenceMean N G test)^2) ≤
      (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*Lax342547.RawFrameComparison.errorBound N (Option D) (Option D) (Option D) (Option D)+
        4*(((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card D+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/β^2)

end
end Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices

concepts.title: Real max-flow min-cut from residual reachability
concepts.description: Internal skew flow cancels, conservation identifies cut divergence with source value, and the reachable residual cut is saturated. Its real capacity equals the maximum flow value, and every cut bounds every feasible flow.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ResidualFlows

/-!
---
title: Real max-flow min-cut from residual reachability
type: lemma
---
Internal skew flow cancels, conservation identifies cut divergence with source value, and the reachable residual cut is saturated. Its real capacity equals the maximum flow value, and every cut bounds every feasible flow.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FlowCuts

open Lax342547.RealFlows
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def cutCapacity {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (Z : Finset V) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ a ∈ Z, ∑ b ∈ Zᶜ, c a b

axiom cut_indicator {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (Z : Finset V) : by
    classical
    exact cutCapacity c Z = ∑ a, ∑ b, if a ∈ Z ∧ b ∉ Z then c a b else 0

axiom internal_skew_sum {V : Type} (f : V → V → ℝ) (Z : Finset V)
    (hskew : ∀ a b, f a b = -f b a) : (∑ a ∈ Z, ∑ b ∈ Z, f a b) = 0

axiom divergence_cut_sum {V : Type} [Fintype V] (f : V → V → ℝ) (Z : Finset V)
    (hskew : ∀ a b, f a b = -f b a) : by
    classical
    exact (∑ a ∈ Z, divergence f a) = ∑ a ∈ Z, ∑ b ∈ Zᶜ, f a b

axiom conserving_cut_value {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hf : Feasible c f s t) (Z : Finset V) (hs : s ∈ Z) (ht : t ∉ Z) :
    (∑ a ∈ Z, divergence f a) = divergence f s

axiom saturated_cut_value {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hf : Feasible c f s t) (Z : Finset V) (hs : s ∈ Z) (ht : t ∉ Z)
    (hsat : ∀ a ∈ Z, ∀ b ∉ Z, f a b = c a b) :
    divergence f s = cutCapacity c Z

axiom cut_upper_bound {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hf : Feasible c f s t) (Z : Finset V) (hs : s ∈ Z) (ht : t ∉ Z) :
    divergence f s ≤ cutCapacity c Z

axiom real_max_flow_min_cut {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hst : s ≠ t) (hc : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ c a b) :
    ∃ f Z, Feasible c f s t ∧ s ∈ Z ∧ t ∉ Z ∧ divergence f s = cutCapacity c Z ∧
      ∀ g, Feasible c g s t → divergence g s ≤ divergence f s

end Lax342547.FlowCuts

conserving_cut_value : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c f : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t →
    ∀ (Z : Finset V),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem Z s →
        Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z t) →
          Eq (Z.sum fun a => Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f a) (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s)

cut_indicator : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c : V → V → Real) (Z : Finset V),
  Eq (Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity c Z)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z a) (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z b))) (c a b) 0)

cut_upper_bound : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c f : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t →
    ∀ (Z : Finset V),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem Z s →
        Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z t) →
          Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s) (Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity c Z)

divergence_cut_sum : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (f : V → V → Real) (Z : Finset V),
  (∀ (a b : V), Eq (f a b) (Real.instNeg.neg (f b a))) →
    Eq (Z.sum fun a => Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f a)
      (Z.sum fun a => (Finset.booleanAlgebra.compl Z).sum fun b => f a b)

internal_skew_sum : ∀ {V : Type} (f : V → V → Real) (Z : Finset V),
  (∀ (a b : V), Eq (f a b) (Real.instNeg.neg (f b a))) → Eq (Z.sum fun a => Z.sum fun b => f a b) 0

real_max_flow_min_cut : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  Ne s t →
    (∀ (a b : V), Real.instLE.le 0 (c a b)) →
      Exists fun f =>
        Exists fun Z =>
          And (Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t)
            (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z s)
              (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z t))
                (And (Eq (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s) (Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity c Z))
                  (∀ (g : V → V → Real),
                    Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c g s t →
                      Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence g s) (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s)))))

saturated_cut_value : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c f : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t →
    ∀ (Z : Finset V),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem Z s →
        Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z t) →
          (∀ (a : V),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem Z a → ∀ (b : V), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z b) → Eq (f a b) (c a b)) →
            Eq (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s) (Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity c Z)

concepts.title: Polar rank of the formal mixer quadratic
concepts.description:
The formal row variables for each indexed mixer product are disjoint.
The quadratic is a sum of products H_i(u_i,v_i), with each middle form
nonsingular. Its polar rank is exactly twice the sum of the middle
dimensions, including in characteristic two. Affine translations and
constant terms do not change the polar form of the binary function.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Prod
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Properties
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Polar rank of the formal mixer quadratic
type: lemma
---
The formal row variables for each indexed mixer product are disjoint.
The quadratic is a sum of products H_i(u_i,v_i), with each middle form
nonsingular. Its polar rank is exactly twice the sum of the middle
dimensions, including in characteristic two. Affine translations and
constant terms do not change the polar form of the binary function.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FormalQuadratic

variable {K B : Type} [Field K] [Fintype B] {V : B → Type}
  [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]

abbrev Rows (V : B → Type) := ∀ i, V i × V i

def cross (H : ∀ i, LinearMap.BilinForm K (V i)) : LinearMap.BilinForm K (Rows V) :=
  ∑ i, (H i).comp ((LinearMap.fst K (V i) (V i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i))
    ((LinearMap.snd K (V i) (V i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i))

def quadratic (H : ∀ i, LinearMap.BilinForm K (V i)) : QuadraticForm K (Rows V) :=
  (cross H).toQuadraticMap

axiom polar_rank [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (V i)]
    (H : ∀ i, LinearMap.BilinForm K (V i)) (hH : ∀ i, (H i).Nondegenerate) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (quadratic H).polarBilin) =
      2 * ∑ i, Module.finrank K (V i)

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def affinePolar {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U] (f : U → Binary) (u v : U) : Binary :=
  f (u + v) + f u + f v + f 0

def polarMatrix {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (f : (I → Binary) → Binary) : Matrix I I Binary :=
  fun i j => affinePolar f (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)

axiom affine_polar {U W : Type} [AddCommGroup U] [Module Binary U]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] (C : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary W)
    (A : U →ₗ[Binary] W) (w : W) (c : Binary) (u v : U) :
    affinePolar (fun z => c + C (w + A z) (w + A z)) u v = (C + C.flip) (A u) (A v)

axiom affine_polar_matrix_rank {I W : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] (C : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary W)
    (A : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] W) (w : W) (c : Binary) :
    (polarMatrix (fun z => c + C (w + A z) (w + A z))).rank =
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((C + C.flip).comp A A))

end Lax342547.FormalQuadratic

import Lax342547.GradientRealization
import Lax342547.RawContractions

/-!
---
title: Actual gradient agreement and matched keys produce all four cross holes
type: lemma
---
The paired witnesses supply tensor sharing and role parity. Whole-space gradient agreement of actual cross contractions then gives both hole equations for each of the four cross pairs, with the original left and right witness lists.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FourHoles

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.RawFrames
open Lax342547.HoleRelation

axiom four_holes {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (holes : HoleData (Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H N E)
      (Profile k n b degree) (Component (Tag k) → Matrix N N Binary))
    (hrole : holes.a = D.role) (hgradient : holes.T = gradient D L R)
    (hU : ∀ o, holes.U o = (profileMap o).comp (Profile k n b degree).subtype)
    (hu : ∀ o, holes.u o = profileContraction o)
    (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hroles : ∀ i z, D.role (leftWitness W i z) + D.role (rightWitness W i z) = 1)
    (hleft : ∀ i z x, fullContraction (rawForms oA oB) (Profile k n b degree) i z x =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x)
    (hright : ∀ i z x, fullContraction (rawForms oA oB).flip (Profile k n b degree) z i x =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z)) x) :
    ∀ i z, Hole holes (oA i) (oB z)

end Lax342547.FourHoles

      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →

      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x)
      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Matrix N N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq holes.a D.role →
    Eq holes.T (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) →
      (∀
          (o :
            Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
              Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H N E),
          Eq (holes.U o)
            ((Lax342547.RawFrames.profileMap o).comp (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree).subtype)) →
        (∀
            (o :
              Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
                Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H N E),
            Eq (holes.u o) (Lax342547.RawFrames.profileContraction o)) →

                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe D.role (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.rightWitness W i z)))
                  1) →

                  (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
                  Eq
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                      (Lax342547.TableContractions.fullContraction (Lax342547.RawContractions.rawForms oA oB)
                        (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) i z)
                      x)

                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R)

concepts.title: Finite scalar agreement from binary character bounds
concepts.description: Exact Fourier inversion yields simultaneous agreement of all scalar bits without any independence assumption on those bits.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Walsh

/-!
---
title: Finite scalar agreement from binary character bounds
type: lemma
---
Exact Fourier inversion yields simultaneous agreement of all scalar bits without any independence assumption on those bits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FourierTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh

noncomputable def patternMass {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ω, if bits ω = target then ρ ω else 0

noncomputable def characterMean {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target t : I → Binary) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ω, ρ ω * phase t (bits ω) * phase t target

axiom character_zero {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) :
    characterMean ρ bits target 0 = ∑ ω, ρ ω

axiom pattern_inversion {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) :
    (∑ t : I → Binary, characterMean ρ bits target t) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I * patternMass ρ bits target

axiom pattern_lower {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hρ : ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1)
    (hchar : ∀ t : I → Binary, t ≠ 0 → -ε ≤ characterMean ρ bits target t) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I - ε ≤ patternMass ρ bits target

axiom pattern_lower_sharp {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hρ : ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1)
    (hchar : ∀ t : I → Binary, t ≠ 0 → -ε ≤ characterMean ρ bits target t) :
    (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I - 1) * ε) / (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I ≤
      patternMass ρ bits target

axiom four_bit_pattern {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
    (target : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (hρ : ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1)
    (hchar : ∀ t : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary, t ≠ 0 →
      |characterMean ρ bits target t| ≤ 1 / 200) :
    (37 : ℝ) / 640 ≤ patternMass ρ bits target

axiom scalar_agreement_half {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hρ : ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1)
    (hchar : ∀ t : I → Binary, t ≠ 0 → -ε ≤ characterMean ρ bits target t)
    (hsmall : ε ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1)) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1) ≤ patternMass ρ bits target

end Lax342547.FourierTests

concepts.description: Four even-support characters exactly recover the compatible-pair probability; twelve remaining characters contribute an explicit error, preserving inverse-polynomial mass.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FourierTests
import Lax342547.TinyCompatibility

/-!
---
title: Tiny-cover four-bit parity bounds
type: lemma
---
Four even-support characters exactly recover the compatible-pair probability; twelve remaining characters contribute an explicit error, preserving inverse-polynomial mass.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FourPhaseParity

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.FourierTests
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.CellAveraging
open scoped BigOperators

def duplicate (t : Fin 2 → Binary) : Fin 4 → Binary := ![t 0,t 0,t 1,t 1]
def parity (b : Fin 4 → Binary) : Fin 2 → Binary := ![b 0+b 1,b 2+b 3]
abbrev Even (t : Fin 4 → Binary) : Prop := t 0 = t 1 ∧ t 2 = t 3

axiom phase_duplicate (t : Fin 2 → Binary) (b : Fin 4 → Binary) :
    phase (duplicate t) b = phase t (parity b)

axiom duplicate_injective : Function.Injective duplicate

axiom even_iff_duplicate (t : Fin 4 → Binary) :
    Even t ↔ ∃ s, duplicate s = t

axiom even_character_sum {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → Fin 4 → Binary) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter Even, characterMean ρ bits 0 t) =
      4*patternMass ρ (fun ω => parity (bits ω)) 0

axiom odd_character_card : (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin 4 → Binary => ¬ Even t)).card = 12

axiom four_phase_parity_lower {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → Fin 4 → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hodd : ∀ t, ¬ Even t → |characterMean ρ bits 0 t| ≤ ε) :
    patternMass ρ (fun ω => parity (bits ω)) 0/4-3*ε/4 ≤ patternMass ρ bits 0

axiom tiny_four_phase_lower {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (bits : Ω × Ω → Fin 4 → Binary) (d N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0) (hrank : F.rank ≤ d*N)
    (hparity : ∀ a b, parity (bits (a,b)) = ![F a b,F b a])
    (hodd : ∀ t, ¬ Even t → |characterMean (fun ab : Ω × Ω => μ ab.1*μ ab.2) bits 0 t| ≤ ε) :
    1/(16*(1+(d : ℝ)*N)^4)-3*ε/4 ≤
      patternMass (fun ab : Ω × Ω => μ ab.1*μ ab.2) bits 0

axiom tiny_four_phase_positive {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (bits : Ω × Ω → Fin 4 → Binary) (d N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0) (hrank : F.rank ≤ d*N)
    (hparity : ∀ a b, parity (bits (a,b)) = ![F a b,F b a])
    (hodd : ∀ t, ¬ Even t → |characterMean (fun ab : Ω × Ω => μ ab.1*μ ab.2) bits 0 t| ≤ ε)
    (hε : ε ≤ 1/(24*(1+(d : ℝ)*N)^4)) :
    1/(32*(1+(d : ℝ)*N)^4) ≤
      patternMass (fun ab : Ω × Ω => μ ab.1*μ ab.2) bits 0

end Lax342547.FourPhaseParity

statements.signature: duplicate_injective : Function.Injective Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.duplicate

even_character_sum : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (bits : Ω → Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    ((Finset.filter Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.Even Finset.univ).sum fun t =>
      Lax342547.FourierTests.characterMean ρ bits 0 t)
    (instHMul.hMul 4 (Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass ρ (fun ω => Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.parity (bits ω)) 0))

even_iff_duplicate : ∀ (t : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Iff (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.Even t) (Exists fun s => Eq (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.duplicate s) t)

four_phase_parity_lower : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (bits : Ω → Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (ε : Real),
  (∀ (t : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Not (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.Even t) →
        Real.instLE.le (abs (Lax342547.FourierTests.characterMean ρ bits 0 t)) ε) →
    Real.instLE.le
      (instHSub.hSub
        (instHDiv.hDiv (Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass ρ (fun ω => Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.parity (bits ω)) 0) 4)
        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 3 ε) 4))
      (Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass ρ bits 0)
odd_character_card : Eq (Finset.filter (fun t => Not (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.Even t)) Finset.univ).card 12

phase_duplicate : ∀ (t : Fin 2 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (b : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (Lax342547.Walsh.phase (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.duplicate t) b)
    (Lax342547.Walsh.phase t (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.parity b))

tiny_four_phase_lower : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (bits : Prod Ω Ω → Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (d N : Nat) (ε : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    (∀ (a : Ω), Eq (F a a) 0) →
      instLENat.le F.rank (instHMul.hMul d N) →
        (∀ (a b : Ω),
            Eq (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.parity (bits { fst := a, snd := b }))
              (Matrix.vecCons (F a b) (Matrix.vecCons (F b a) Matrix.vecEmpty))) →
          (∀ (t : Fin 4 → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
              Not (Lax342547.FourPhaseParity.Even t) →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (abs (Lax342547.FourierTests.characterMean (fun ab => instHMul.hMul (μ ab.fst) (μ ab.snd)) bits 0 t))
                  ε) →

concepts.title: Ordinary fractional coloring
concepts.description:
A fractional coloring assigns nonnegative real weights to independent sets
so that the weights covering each vertex sum to at least one. The fractional
chromatic number $\chi_f(G)$ is the infimum of the total weight.
For finite graphs with independence number at most two,
$|V(G)|/2\le\chi_f(G)\le\chi(G)$.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Coloring.Vertex
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Hom

/-!
---
title: Ordinary fractional coloring
type: lemma
---
A fractional coloring assigns nonnegative real weights to independent sets
so that the weights covering each vertex sum to at least one. The fractional
chromatic number $\chi_f(G)$ is the infimum of the total weight.
For finite graphs with independence number at most two,
$|V(G)|/2\le\chi_f(G)\le\chi(G)$.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FractionalColoring

open scoped BigOperators

universe u
variable {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

structure Coloring (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  weight : Finset V → ℝ
  nonneg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ weight S
  supported : ∀ (S : Finset V), ¬ G.IsIndepSet (S : Set V) → weight S = 0
  covers : ∀ v, 1 ≤ ∑ S : Finset V, if v ∈ S then weight S else 0

noncomputable def totalWeight {G : SimpleGraph V} (C : Coloring G) : ℝ :=
  ∑ S : Finset V, C.weight S

noncomputable def fractionalChromaticNumber (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℝ :=
  sInf {w : ℝ | ∃ C : Coloring G, totalWeight C = w}

axiom fractional_chromatic_lower_bound (G : SimpleGraph V) (hα : G.indepNum ≤ 2) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2 ≤ fractionalChromaticNumber G

axiom fractional_chromatic_le_chromatic (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    fractionalChromaticNumber G ≤ (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℝ)

end Lax342547.FractionalColoring

import Lax342547.CliqueMinor
import Lax342547.FractionalColoring

/-!
---
title: The fractional-coloring counterexample
type: theorem
---
Corollary 1.2 asserts that there are graphs of arbitrarily large order $m$
with independence number at most two and
$h(G)<26m/75+2/3<m/2\le\chi_f(G)\le\chi(G)$.
Here $h(G)$ refers to ordinary clique minors.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FractionalCounterexample

open CliqueMinor FractionalColoring

axiom arbitrarily_large_fractional_counterexample (lowerBound : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, lowerBound ≤ m ∧ 5 ≤ m ∧ ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin m),
      G.indepNum ≤ 2 ∧
      (hadwigerNumber G : ℝ) < 26 * (m : ℝ) / 75 + 2 / 3 ∧
      26 * (m : ℝ) / 75 + 2 / 3 < (m : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      (m : ℝ) / 2 ≤ fractionalChromaticNumber G ∧
      fractionalChromaticNumber G ≤ (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℝ)

end Lax342547.FractionalCounterexample

concepts.title: Ambient symmetries and frame marginals
concepts.description:
The simultaneous primal and inverse-transpose action preserves all three
raw Gram constraints. Its bijections of completion sets determine the
uniform plus-frame and channel marginals exactly.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawLaw
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.ColumnRowPartitioned

/-!
---
title: Ambient symmetries and frame marginals
type: lemma
---
The simultaneous primal and inverse-transpose action preserves all three
raw Gram constraints. Its bijections of completion sets determine the
uniform plus-frame and channel marginals exactly.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrameSymmetry

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames

variable {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]

structure Change (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] where
  C : Matrix N N Binary
  D : Matrix N N Binary
  CD : C * D = 1
  DC : D * C = 1

def Change.inv (c : Change N) : Change N := ⟨c.D, c.C, c.DC, c.CD⟩

def Change.dual (c : Change N) : Change N where
  C := c.D.transpose
  D := c.C.transpose
  CD := by simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.CD
  DC := by simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC

theorem Change.injective (c : Change N) : Function.Injective c.C.mulVec := by
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg c.D.mulVec h
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, c.DC, Matrix.one_mulVec] using h'

theorem Change.dual_injective (c : Change N) : Function.Injective c.D.transpose.mulVec := by
  have hDC : c.C.transpose * c.D.transpose = 1 := by
    simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg c.C.transpose.mulVec h
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hDC, Matrix.one_mulVec] using h'

def transform (c : Change N) {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) :
    Frame B H N E where
  P := c.C * F.P
  Q := c.D.transpose * F.Q
  X := c.C * F.X
  Y := c.D.transpose * F.Y
  plus_injective := by
    intro x y h
    apply F.plus_injective
    apply c.injective
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h
  minus_injective := by
    intro x y h
    apply F.minus_injective
    apply c.dual_injective
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h
  gram := by
    have hCD : c.C.transpose * c.D.transpose = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc c.C.transpose,
      hCD, Matrix.one_mul] using F.gram
  plus_annihilator := by
    have hCD : c.C.transpose * c.D.transpose = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc c.C.transpose,
      hCD, Matrix.one_mul] using F.plus_annihilator
  minus_annihilator := by
    have hCD : c.C.transpose * c.D.transpose = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
    simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc c.C.transpose,
      hCD, Matrix.one_mul] using F.minus_annihilator

def frameEquiv (c : Change N) {E : Matrix B B Binary} : Frame B H N E ≃ Frame B H N E where
  toFun := transform c
  invFun := transform c.inv
  left_inv F := by
    apply frameData_injective
    have hCD : c.C.transpose * c.D.transpose = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
    simp [frameData, transform, Change.inv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, c.DC, hCD]
  right_inv F := by
    apply frameData_injective
    have hDC : c.D.transpose * c.C.transpose = 1 := by
      simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.CD
    simp [frameData, transform, Change.inv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, c.CD, hDC]

abbrev Injection (I N : Type) [Fintype I] :=
  {A : Matrix N I Binary // Function.Injective A.mulVec}

noncomputable instance {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] :
    Fintype (Injection I N) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

def plus {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) : Injection (B ⊕ H) N :=
  ⟨Matrix.fromCols F.P F.X, by
    intro x y h
    have h' := F.plus_injective (a₁ := (x ∘ Sum.inl, x ∘ Sum.inr))
      (a₂ := (y ∘ Sum.inl, y ∘ Sum.inr)) (by simpa [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec] using h)
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl b => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h') b
    | inr h => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h') h⟩

def minus {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) : Injection (B ⊕ H) N :=
  ⟨Matrix.fromCols F.Q F.Y, by
    intro x y h
    have h' := F.minus_injective (a₁ := (x ∘ Sum.inl, x ∘ Sum.inr))
      (a₂ := (y ∘ Sum.inl, y ∘ Sum.inr)) (by simpa [Matrix.fromCols_mulVec] using h)
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl b => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h') b
    | inr h => exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h') h⟩

def plusChannel {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) : Injection H N :=
  ⟨F.X, by
    intro x y h
    have he := F.plus_injective (a₁ := (0, x)) (a₂ := (0, y)) (by simpa using h)
    exact congrArg Prod.snd he⟩

def minusChannel {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) : Injection H N :=
  ⟨F.Y, by
    intro x y h
    have he := F.minus_injective (a₁ := (0, x)) (a₂ := (0, y)) (by simpa using h)
    exact congrArg Prod.snd he⟩

axiom plus_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    [Nonempty (Injection (B ⊕ H) N)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map plus =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection (B ⊕ H) N)

axiom minus_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    [Nonempty (Injection (B ⊕ H) N)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map minus =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection (B ⊕ H) N)

axiom plusChannel_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    [Nonempty (Injection H N)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map plusChannel =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection H N)

axiom minusChannel_uniform {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    [Nonempty (Injection H N)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map minusChannel =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection H N)

axiom full_frame_orbit {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F G : Frame B H N E)
    (hchannel : F.X.transpose * F.Y = G.X.transpose * G.Y) :
    ∃ c : Change N, transform c F = G

end Lax342547.FrameSymmetry

concepts.description: Swapping primal and dual frame data is an exact transpose equivalence, preserves uniform density caps, and supplies the reciprocal conditioned primal-span avoidance bound.

import Lax342547.UnitSpanAvoidance
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

/-!
---
title: Reciprocal raw-frame orientation and dual pin avoidance
type: lemma
---
Swapping primal and dual frame data is an exact transpose equivalence, preserves uniform density caps, and supplies the reciprocal conditioned primal-span avoidance bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrameTranspose

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

def transposeFrame {P H N : Type} [Fintype P] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix P P Binary} (f : Frame P H N E) : Frame P H N E.transpose where
  P := f.Q
  Q := f.P
  X := f.Y
  Y := f.X
  plus_injective := f.minus_injective
  minus_injective := f.plus_injective
  gram := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.transpose_transpose] using congrArg Matrix.transpose f.gram
  plus_annihilator := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.transpose_transpose,Matrix.transpose_zero] using
      (congrArg Matrix.transpose f.minus_annihilator)
  minus_annihilator := by simpa only [Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.transpose_transpose,Matrix.transpose_zero] using
      (congrArg Matrix.transpose f.plus_annihilator)

def transposeEquiv {P H N : Type} [Fintype P] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] (E : Matrix P P Binary) :
    Frame P H N E ≃ Frame P H N E.transpose where
  toFun := transposeFrame
  invFun := transposeFrame
  left_inv f := by cases f; rfl
  right_inv f := by cases f; rfl

axiom uniform_equiv_push {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (b : B) :
    push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype A)) e b = weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype B) b

axiom capped_transpose_frame {A P H N : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype P] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    (E : Matrix P P Binary) [Nonempty (Frame P H N E)]
    (α : A → ℝ) (image : A → Frame P H N E) (M : ℝ)
    (hcap : ∀ f,push α image f ≤ M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E)) f) :
    letI : Nonempty (Frame P H N E.transpose) := ⟨transposeFrame (Classical.choice inferInstance)⟩
    ∀ f,push α (fun a => transposeFrame (image a)) f ≤
      M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E.transpose)) f

axiom conditioned_dual_span_avoidance {A P H N : Type}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype P] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix P P Binary) [Nonempty (Frame P H N E)]
    (α : A → ℝ) (image : A → Frame P H N E) (V : A → Submodule Binary (N → Binary))
    (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) (C : A → Prop) (M τ : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ a,0 ≤ α a) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hC : τ ≤ cellMass α C)
    (hN : Fintype.card P+Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hV : ∀ a,V a ≤ LinearMap.range (image a).Q.mulVecLin)
    (hcap : ∀ f,push α image f ≤ M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E)) f) :
    cellMass (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw α C) (fun a => ¬ Disjoint (V a) W) ≤
      (M/τ)*(2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card P+Fintype.card H+Module.finrank Binary W)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N))

end Lax342547.FrameTranspose

concepts.title: Uniform tuple images on prescribed Gram orbits
concepts.description:
Independent primal coefficient tuples have the uniform law on their
individually injective realizations with prescribed Gram. Tuples using
channels have the analogous law after conditioning on the self-channel
Gram, including singular Gram matrices and arbitrary tuple dimensions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameSymmetry

/-!
---
title: Uniform tuple images on prescribed Gram orbits
type: lemma
---
Independent primal coefficient tuples have the uniform law on their
individually injective realizations with prescribed Gram. Tuples using
channels have the analogous law after conditioning on the self-channel
Gram, including singular Gram matrices and arbitrary tuple dimensions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrameTuples

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry

abbrev Orbit {I J : Type} (N : Type) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    (G : Matrix I J Binary) :=
  {z : Matrix N I Binary × Matrix N J Binary //
    Function.Injective z.1.mulVec ∧ Function.Injective z.2.mulVec ∧ z.1.transpose * z.2 = G}

noncomputable instance {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    (G : Matrix I J Binary) : Fintype (Orbit N G) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

variable {B H I J N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]

def primalTuple {E : Matrix B B Binary} (C : Matrix B I Binary) (D : Matrix B J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (F : Frame B H N E) : Orbit N (C.transpose * E * D) :=
  ⟨(F.P * C, F.Q * D), by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y h
      apply hC
      have he := F.plus_injective (a₁ := (C.mulVec x, 0)) (a₂ := (C.mulVec y, 0))
        (by simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_zero, add_zero, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h)
      exact congrArg Prod.fst he
    · intro x y h
      apply hD
      have he := F.minus_injective (a₁ := (D.mulVec x, 0)) (a₂ := (D.mulVec y, 0))
        (by simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_zero, add_zero, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h)
      exact congrArg Prod.fst he
    · calc
        _ = C.transpose * (F.P.transpose * F.Q) * D := by
          simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [F.gram]⟩

def fullGram (E : Matrix B B Binary) (G : Matrix H H Binary) : Matrix (B ⊕ H) (B ⊕ H) Binary :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks E 0 0 G

abbrev ChannelFiber (E : Matrix B B Binary) (G : Matrix H H Binary) :=
  {F : Frame B H N E // F.X.transpose * F.Y = G}

noncomputable instance (E : Matrix B B Binary) (G : Matrix H H Binary) :
    Fintype (ChannelFiber (N := N) E G) := by classical exact Subtype.fintype _

theorem combined_gram {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) :
    (plus F).val.transpose * (minus F).val = fullGram E (F.X.transpose * F.Y) := by
  simp only [plus, minus, Matrix.transpose_fromCols, Matrix.fromRows_mul_fromCols,
    F.gram, F.plus_annihilator, F.minus_annihilator, fullGram]

def fullTuple {E : Matrix B B Binary} {G : Matrix H H Binary}
    (C : Matrix (B ⊕ H) I Binary) (D : Matrix (B ⊕ H) J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (F : ChannelFiber (N := N) E G) : Orbit N (C.transpose * fullGram E G * D) :=
  ⟨((plus F.val).val * C, (minus F.val).val * D), by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y h
      apply hC
      apply (plus F.val).property
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h
    · intro x y h
      apply hD
      apply (minus F.val).property
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h
    · calc
        _ = C.transpose * ((plus F.val).val.transpose * (minus F.val).val) * D := by
          simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [combined_gram, F.property]⟩

axiom primal_uniform [DecidableEq N] {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (C : Matrix B I Binary) (D : Matrix B J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (C.transpose * E * D))] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).map (primalTuple C D hC hD) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (C.transpose * E * D))

axiom full_uniform [DecidableEq N] {E : Matrix B B Binary} {G : Matrix H H Binary}
    [Nonempty (ChannelFiber (N := N) E G)]
    (C : Matrix (B ⊕ H) I Binary) (D : Matrix (B ⊕ H) J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (C.transpose * fullGram E G * D))] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ChannelFiber (N := N) E G)).map (fullTuple C D hC hD) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (C.transpose * fullGram E G * D))

axiom raw_full_conditioning [DecidableEq N] {E : Matrix B B Binary} {G : Matrix H H Binary}
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [Nonempty (ChannelFiber (N := N) E G)]
    (C : Matrix (B ⊕ H) I Binary) (D : Matrix (B ⊕ H) J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (C.transpose * fullGram E G * D))]
    (h : ∃ F ∈ {F : Frame B H N E | F.X.transpose * F.Y = G},
      F ∈ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).support) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)).filter {F | F.X.transpose * F.Y = G} h).map
      (fun F => ((plus F).val * C, (minus F).val * D)) =
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (C.transpose * fullGram E G * D))).map Subtype.val

axiom primal_product {Draw : Type} [Fintype Draw] [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (C : Draw → Matrix B I Binary) (D : Draw → Matrix B J Binary)
    (hC : ∀ s, Function.Injective (C s).mulVec) (hD : ∀ s, Function.Injective (D s).mulVec)
    [∀ s, Nonempty (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * E * D s))]
    (z : Draw → Matrix N I Binary × Matrix N J Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Frame B H N E)).map
      (fun o s => ((o s).P * C s, (o s).Q * D s)) z =
    ∏ s, (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * E * D s))).map Subtype.val (z s)

axiom primal_family {Draw : Type} [Fintype Draw] [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq N]
    {K L : Draw → Type} [∀ s, Fintype (K s)] [∀ s, Fintype (L s)]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (C : ∀ s, Matrix B (K s) Binary) (D : ∀ s, Matrix B (L s) Binary)
    (hC : ∀ s, Function.Injective (C s).mulVec) (hD : ∀ s, Function.Injective (D s).mulVec)
    [∀ s, Nonempty (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * E * D s))]
    (z : ∀ s, Matrix N (K s) Binary × Matrix N (L s) Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Frame B H N E)).map
      (fun o s => ((o s).P * C s, (o s).Q * D s)) z =
    ∏ s, (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * E * D s))).map Subtype.val (z s)

axiom full_product {Draw : Type} [Fintype Draw] [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq N]
    {K L : Draw → Type} [∀ s, Fintype (K s)] [∀ s, Fintype (L s)]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (G : Draw → Matrix H H Binary)
    [∀ s, Nonempty (ChannelFiber (N := N) E (G s))]
    (C : ∀ s, Matrix (B ⊕ H) (K s) Binary) (D : ∀ s, Matrix (B ⊕ H) (L s) Binary)
    (hC : ∀ s, Function.Injective (C s).mulVec) (hD : ∀ s, Function.Injective (D s).mulVec)
    [∀ s, Nonempty (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * fullGram E (G s) * D s))]
    (z : ∀ s, Matrix N (K s) Binary × Matrix N (L s) Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ s, ChannelFiber (N := N) E (G s))).map
      (fun o s => ((plus (o s).val).val * C s, (minus (o s).val).val * D s)) z =
    ∏ s, (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N ((C s).transpose * fullGram E (G s) * D s))).map
      Subtype.val (z s)

end Lax342547.FrameTuples

concepts.title: Fresh key directions are independent modulo table spaces
concepts.description:
One bounded exclusion set per endpoint works for all components and both
signs. Any short linear combination of distinct fresh point rays that
belongs to a table space has all its coefficients zero.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TableSpaces
import Lax342547.SparsePins

/-!
---
title: Fresh key directions are independent modulo table spaces
type: lemma
---
One bounded exclusion set per endpoint works for all components and both
signs. Any short linear combination of distinct fresh point rays that
belongs to a table space has all its coefficients zero.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FreshKeys

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces

axiom fresh_points {Base Comp : Type} [Fintype Base] [Fintype Comp] {b degree K R : ℕ}
    (U : Bool → Comp → Submodule Binary (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base → Binary))
    (hdim : ∀ sign e, Module.finrank Binary (U sign e) ≤ K)
    (hdegree : (K + 1) * (R + 14) ≤ degree + 1) :
    ∃ B : Finset (Fin b → Binary),
      B.card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Comp * K * (R + 14) ∧
      ∀ sign e (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (c : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
        (z : (Fin b → Binary) → Base → Binary),
        L.card ≤ R + 14 → Disjoint L B →
        (∑ s ∈ L, c s • point (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (z s)) ∈ U sign e →
        ∀ s ∈ L, c s = 0

axiom fresh_keys {Base Comp H N : Type} [Fintype Base] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype H]
    {b degree K R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hdegree : (K + 1) * (R + 14) ≤ degree + 1) :
    ∃ B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
      (∀ i, (B i).card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Comp * K * (R + 14)) ∧
      ∀ (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
        (c : Fin 2 → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
        (z : Fin 2 → (Fin b → Binary) → Base → Binary),
        (∀ i, (L i).card ≤ R + 14) → (∀ i, Disjoint (L i) (B i)) →
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ s ∈ L i,
          c i s • primalEmbedding i (point (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (z i s))) ∈
            tableSpace P a →
        ∀ i s, s ∈ L i → c i s = 0

end Lax342547.FreshKeys

fresh_keys : ∀ {Base Comp H N : Type} [Fintype Base] [inst : Fintype Comp] [Fintype H] {b degree K R : Nat}
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      Exists fun B =>
        And

import Lax342547.GradientAssembly

/-!
---
title: The simultaneous gradient corrections retain every frozen pin and key entry
type: lemma
---
Barred domains kill frozen pins and keys on the changed side. Opposite pin projections are annihilated by the permitted outputs, and opposite keys have zero channel coordinates. The assembled cross forms therefore retain all frozen entries simultaneously.
-/

    (δ : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P U a) →ₗ[Binary]
      perpendicular (protectedChannel Q z c))
    (v w : Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (h : v ∈ P.space a ⊔ keys W a.1 ∨ w ∈ Q.space c ⊔ keys (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) c.1) :
    channelChange (barred W P U a) (protectedChannel Q z c) δ z v w = 0

axiom assembled_frozen {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    {E : Moment k n b degree} (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (hF : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) : Frozen (assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε') W P Q oA oB

end Lax342547.FrozenAssembly
