concepts.title: Baseline bilinear extensions retaining all frozen rows and columns
concepts.description:
Split each table space into its stored pin part and a complement, retaining
the independent key space. An explicit bilinear formula extends both the
table and every actual row or column through a pin or key. No gradient
solvability or rank bound is assumed in this extension argument.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Projection
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearMap

/-!
---
title: Baseline bilinear extensions retaining all frozen rows and columns
type: lemma
---
Split each table space into its stored pin part and a complement, retaining
the independent key space. An explicit bilinear formula extends both the
table and every actual row or column through a pin or key. No gradient
solvability or rank bound is assumed in this extension argument.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenBaselines

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

variable {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
  [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W]

structure Splitting (J D Keys : Submodule Binary V) where
  frozen : V →ₗ[Binary] V
  table : V →ₗ[Binary] J
  frozen_fixed : ∀ v ∈ D ⊔ Keys, frozen v = v
  table_zero : ∀ v ∈ D ⊔ Keys, table v = 0
  frozen_table : ∀ v : J, frozen v.val ∈ D
  table_sum : ∀ v : J, frozen v.val + (table v.val).val = v.val

def baseline {J D Keys : Submodule Binary V} {J' D' Keys' : Submodule Binary W}
    (S : Splitting J D Keys) (S' : Splitting J' D' Keys')
    (A : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (T : J →ₗ[Binary] J' →ₗ[Binary] Binary) :
    V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  A.compl₁₂ S.frozen LinearMap.id + A.compl₁₂ LinearMap.id S'.frozen -
    A.compl₁₂ S.frozen S'.frozen + T.compl₁₂ S.table S'.table

def Compatible (J D : Submodule Binary V) (J' D' : Submodule Binary W)
    (A : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (T : J →ₗ[Binary] J' →ₗ[Binary] Binary) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : J, ∀ w : J', v.val ∈ D ∨ w.val ∈ D' → T v w = A v.val w.val

def ExtendsFrozen (D Keys : Submodule Binary V) (D' Keys' : Submodule Binary W)
    (A B : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) : Prop :=
  ∀ v w, v ∈ D ⊔ Keys ∨ w ∈ D' ⊔ Keys' → B v w = A v w

axiom splitting_exists (J D Keys : Submodule Binary V) (hD : D ≤ J) (hKeys : Disjoint J Keys) :
    Nonempty (Splitting J D Keys)

axiom baseline_properties (J D Keys : Submodule Binary V) (J' D' Keys' : Submodule Binary W)
    (hD : D ≤ J) (hD' : D' ≤ J')
    (S : Splitting J D Keys) (S' : Splitting J' D' Keys')
    (A : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (T : J →ₗ[Binary] J' →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (h : Compatible J D J' D' A T) :
    ExtendsFrozen D Keys D' Keys' A (baseline S S' A T) ∧
      ∀ v : J, ∀ w : J', baseline S S' A T v.val w.val = T v w

end Lax342547.FrozenBaselines

  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] (J D Keys : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V)
  (J' D' Keys' : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W),

    Submodule.instPartialOrder.le D' J' →

        (A :

            (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) W Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

            (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x)
              Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
        Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.Compatible J D J' D' A T →

            (∀ (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J x)
              (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem J' x),
              Eq
                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.FrozenBaselines.baseline S S' A T) v.val) w.val)
                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T v) w))

concepts.title: Original record cells determine the common frozen gradient target
concepts.description: Exact pin events and equal query keys fix every joined frozen direction image. The two separate actual unary records transfer frozen target agreement from chosen representatives to every pair in their original cells, for both cross orientations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QueryRecordBounds
import Lax342547.RightQueryImages
import Lax342547.PrimalGramTests
import Lax342547.RawBaselines

/-!
---
title: Original record cells determine the common frozen gradient target
type: lemma
---
Exact pin events and equal query keys fix every joined frozen direction image. The two separate actual unary records transfer frozen target agreement from chosen representatives to every pair in their original cells, for both cross orientations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenCellDirections

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TagGeometry
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes Lax342547.QueryReference
open Lax342547.QueryIndependence Lax342547.RawQueryImages Lax342547.RightQueryImages

open Lax342547.RawBaselines Lax342547.PrimalGramTests Lax342547.RetainedCharacters

axiom pin_key_frozen_images {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (o o' : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M))
    (ho : o ∈ P.event observation) (ho' : o' ∈ P.event observation)
    (hkey : leftTuple W o = leftTuple W o') (a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (v : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary)
    (hv : v ∈ joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a) : observation o a v = observation o' a v

    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (o o' : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M))
    (ho : o ∈ P.event observation) (ho' : o' ∈ P.event observation)
    (hkey : rightTuple W o = rightTuple W o') (a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (v : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary)
    (hv : v ∈ joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (flip W) a.1) a) : observation o a v = observation o' a v

axiom frozen_target_oriented {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M))
    (G : CrossForms (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hf : Frozen G W P Q oA oB) (a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (v w : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary)
    (hvw : v ∈ joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a ∨
      w ∈ joined Q (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (flip W) a.1) (a.1,!a.2)) :
    actualForm (leftMatrices oA a) (rightMatrices oB a) v w = orientedForms G a v w

noncomputable def leftRecord {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (Q : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (frozen o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M)) :
    ∀ a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool,
      Matrix (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H))
        (Fin (Module.finrank Binary (joined Q (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (flip W) a.1) (a.1,!a.2)))) Binary :=
  fun a => Lax342547.FrozenRecords.record (observation o a)
    (fun j => observation frozen (a.1,!a.2)
      (basisVectors (joined Q (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (flip W) a.1) (a.1,!a.2)) j))

noncomputable def rightRecord {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (frozen o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M)) :
    ∀ a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool,
      Matrix (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H))
        (Fin (Module.finrank Binary (joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a))) Binary :=
  fun a => Lax342547.FrozenRecords.record (observation o (a.1,!a.2))
    (fun j => observation frozen a (basisVectors (joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a) j))

axiom record_target_oriented {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (oA oB refA refB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M))
    (hA : oA ∈ P.event observation) (hAr : refA ∈ P.event observation)
    (hB : oB ∈ Q.event observation) (hBr : refB ∈ Q.event observation)
    (hkeyA : leftTuple W oA = leftTuple W refA) (hkeyB : rightTuple W oB = rightTuple W refB)
    (hrecA : leftRecord W Q refB oA = leftRecord W Q refB refA)
    (hrecB : rightRecord W P refA oB = rightRecord W P refA refB)
    (G : CrossForms (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hf : Frozen G W P Q refA refB) (a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (v w : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary)
    (hvw : v ∈ joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a ∨
      w ∈ joined Q (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (flip W) a.1) (a.1,!a.2)) :
    actualForm (leftMatrices oA a) (rightMatrices oB a) v w = orientedForms G a v w

end Lax342547.FrozenCellDirections

concepts.title: Exact agreement of zero quotient characters
concepts.description: A bilinear difference killing both frozen factors descends to the two quotients. Coefficient tensors annihilating every quotient form therefore have identical actual and target pairings.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators
import Lax342547.ResidualRealization
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Defs

/-!
---
title: Exact agreement of zero quotient characters
type: lemma
---
A bilinear difference killing both frozen factors descends to the two quotients. Coefficient tensors annihilating every quotient form therefore have identical actual and target pairings.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenCharacters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

axiom quotient_bilinear {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W]
    (D : Submodule Binary V) (E : Submodule Binary W)
    (F : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hD : ∀ v ∈ D, ∀ w, F v w = 0) (hE : ∀ v w, w ∈ E → F v w = 0) :
    ∃ Q : (V ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (W ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      Q.compl₁₂ D.mkQ E.mkQ = F

axiom zero_quotient_frozen_agreement {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (F G : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hC : PureAnnihilates C D E)
    (hD : ∀ v ∈ D, ∀ w, F v w = G v w)
    (hE : ∀ v w, w ∈ E → F v w = G v w) :
    by
      classical
      exact matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' F) C =
        matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' G) C

end Lax342547.FrozenCharacters

  (∀ (v : V),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem D v → ∀ (w : W), Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe F v) w) 0) →

import Lax342547.FrozenAssembly
import Lax342547.PairedRecipes

/-!
---
title: Whole-space gradient realization preserving the actual frozen entries
type: lemma
---
Under the genuine scalar recipe, injecting table, matched keys, sparse covers and the explicit degree and channel margins, the bounded baseline and both reciprocal recipe solutions assemble into cross forms that preserve every frozen entry and satisfy all four gradients. The original small table may change away from its frozen rows and columns, as permitted by Theorem 6.3.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenGradients

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

open Lax342547.ResidualRealization
open Lax342547.CompressedResidual

axiom frozen_gradients {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {K : ℕ} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (hB : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers Q B (2 * K + 28))
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU' : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel Q j (e, true)) (U' e j))
    (hV' : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel Q j (e, false)) (V' e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hF : Extends F T) (hbounded : Bounded F K)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms W i) (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP W oB i))
    (hgradients' : ∀ z, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) z)
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) oA z))
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree)
    (hmargin : 28 * copies * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) +
      quotientBound k b degree K (14 * K + 140) + 2 * K + 4 * (3 * K + 28) < 970 * r)
    (hchannels : 1000 * r ≤ Fintype.card H) :
    ∃ G : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H,
      Frozen G W P Q oA oB ∧
      (∀ i z x, fullContraction G (Profile k n b degree) i z x =
        (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x) ∧
      (∀ i z x, fullContraction G.flip (Profile k n b degree) z i x =
        (D.role + gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z)) x)

end Lax342547.FrozenGradients

concepts.title: Unary records determine every frozen cross entry
concepts.description: Pairings of nominal columns with already fixed frozen image vectors require only nominal dimension times frozen-vector count bits. Separate unary records determine all cross entries with a frozen factor.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrozenCharacters
import Lax342547.RawFrames

/-!
---
title: Unary records determine every frozen cross entry
type: lemma
---
Pairings of nominal columns with already fixed frozen image vectors require only nominal dimension times frozen-vector count bits. Separate unary records determine all cross entries with a frozen factor.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenRecords

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

noncomputable def record {I X N : Type} [Fintype N]
    (A : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (frozen : X → N → Binary) : Matrix I X Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun i x => dotProduct (A (Pi.single i 1)) (frozen x)

axiom record_count {I X : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype X] : by
    classical
    exact Fintype.card (Matrix I X Binary) = 2 ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card X)

axiom record_evaluation {I X N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (A : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (frozen : X → N → Binary)
    (v : I → Binary) (x : X) :
    dotProduct (A v) (frozen x) = ∑ i, v i * record A frozen i x

axiom records_determine_frozen {I X N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (A A' : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (frozen : X → N → Binary)
    (hrec : record A frozen = record A' frozen) (v : I → Binary)
    (w : Submodule.span Binary (Set.range frozen)) :
    dotProduct (A v) w.val = dotProduct (A' v) w.val

axiom two_records_cross_agreement {I J X Y N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    (A A' : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (B B' : (J → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))

concepts.title: Baseline contractions on the selected atoms
concepts.description:
Freezing both signs of an atom's key retains its actual contraction.
Matched keys then give zero toward the atom's matched endpoint and the
opposite own-unit contraction toward the other endpoint. These are the

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawBaselines

/-!
---
title: Baseline contractions on the selected atoms
type: lemma
---
Freezing both signs of an atom's key retains its actual contraction.
Matched keys then give zero toward the atom's matched endpoint and the
opposite own-unit contraction toward the other endpoint. These are the
values prescribed by the binary recipe.
-/

namespace Lax342547.FrozenValues

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.RawBaselines

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
  {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}

axiom frozen_atom (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (i z z' : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z')) :
    fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z (W.left i z' t).profile =
      fullContraction (rawForms oA oB) (Profile k n b degree) i z (W.left i z' t).profile

axiom selected_values (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (i z z' : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z')) :
    fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z (W.left i z' t).profile =
      if z = z' then 0 else ownContraction oB z' (W.right i z' t).profile

end Lax342547.FrozenValues

concepts.title: A good sample from the explicit container budget
concepts.description: The vertex and disjoint pair exception tails sum over the finite container family. If their explicit total budget is less than one, a sample avoiding every terminal exception event exists.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.DisjointSampling

/-!
---
title: A good sample from the explicit container budget
type: lemma
---
The vertex and disjoint pair exception tails sum over the finite container family. If their explicit total budget is less than one, a sample avoiding every terminal exception event exists.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GoodSamples

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CellAveraging
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def Bad {Ω : Type} {m : ℕ} (S : Ω → Prop) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (k : ℕ)
    (sample : Fin m → Ω) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact k ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => S (sample i))).card ∨
    ∃ a : Fin k × Bool ↪ Fin m, ∀ j, E (sample (a (j,false))) (sample (a (j,true)))

axiom cell_mass_or {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (S T : Ω → Prop) (hρ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) :
    cellMass ρ (fun x => S x ∨ T x) ≤ cellMass ρ S+cellMass ρ T

axiom bad_sample_bound {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ) (S : Ω → Prop) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (m k : ℕ) (M κ : ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ) (_hM : 0 < M) (_hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hS : cellMass μ S < 1/M) (hE : pairEventMass μ μ E < 1/κ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin m => μ)) (Bad S E k) ≤
      (m.choose k : ℝ)*(1/M)^k+(m : ℝ)^(2*k)*(1/κ)^k

axiom mass_less_one_exists_complement {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → Prop) (hρ : Probability ρ) (hA : cellMass ρ A < 1) : ∃ x, ¬ A x

axiom exists_good_sample {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Finset J) (S : J → Ω → Prop) (E : J → Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (m k : ℕ) (M κ : ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ) (hM : 0 < M) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hS : ∀ c ∈ C, cellMass μ (S c) < 1/M)
    (hE : ∀ c ∈ C, pairEventMass μ μ (E c) < 1/κ)
    (hbudget : (C.card : ℝ)*((m.choose k : ℝ)*(1/M)^k+(m : ℝ)^(2*k)*(1/κ)^k) < 1) :
    ∃ sample : Fin m → Ω, ∀ c ∈ C, ¬ Bad (S c) (E c) k sample

end Lax342547.GoodSamples

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 M →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 κ →
        Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ S) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 M) →
          Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ E) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 κ) →
            Real.instLE.le
              (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
                (Lax342547.GoodSamples.Bad S E k))
              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (m.choose k).cast (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 M) k))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow m.cast (instHMul.hMul 2 k)) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 κ) k)))

  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ x)) →
    Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ fun x => Or (S x) (T x))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ S) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ T))

  (M κ : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 M →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 κ →
        (∀ (c : J),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem C c →
              Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (S c)) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 M)) →
          (∀ (c : J),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem C c →
                Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ (E c)) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 κ)) →
            Real.instLT.lt
                (instHMul.hMul C.card.cast
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (m.choose k).cast (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 M) k))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow m.cast (instHMul.hMul 2 k)) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 1 κ) k))))
                1 →
              Exists fun sample =>
                ∀ (c : J), SetLike.instMembership.mem C c → Not (Lax342547.GoodSamples.Bad (S c) (E c) k sample)

    Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ A) 1 → Exists fun x => Not (A x)

concepts.title: All four whole-space gradient equations from assembled channel changes
concepts.description: Expanding the actual nonlinear contractions identifies their changes with the pure-plus-derivative response. The actual recipe residual cancels the baseline contraction. Opposite-endpoint and reciprocal-role assembly then gives all four gradient equations on the entire profile space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ChannelAssembly

/-!
---
title: All four whole-space gradient equations from assembled channel changes
type: lemma
---
Expanding the actual nonlinear contractions identifies their changes with the pure-plus-derivative response. The actual recipe residual cancels the baseline contraction. Opposite-endpoint and reciprocal-role assembly then gives all four gradient equations on the entire profile space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GradientAssembly

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.ChannelChanges
open Lax342547.ResponseMatrices Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.PairedKeys
open Lax342547.ResidualRealization Lax342547.NonlinearChannels

axiom contraction_expansion {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F G : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (hplus : ∀ e i, fullPlus G e i z = fullPlus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ e) i)
    (hminus : ∀ e i, fullMinus G e i z = fullMinus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε e) i)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ i, fullContraction G (Profile k n b degree) i z (x i)) =
      (∑ i, fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z (x i)) +
        fullResponse W P Q U V F z (extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε) δ ε x

axiom corrected_gradients {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F G : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (hplus : ∀ e i, fullPlus G e i z = fullPlus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ e) i)
    (hminus : ∀ e i, fullMinus G e i z = fullMinus F e i z +
      restriction (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε e) i)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (hsolution : fullResponse W P Q U V F z (extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε) δ ε =
      ∑ i, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)) :
    ∀ i x, fullContraction G (Profile k n b degree) i z x =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x

axiom simultaneous_gradients {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V U' V' : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (δ : ∀ z, PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : ∀ z, MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (δ' : ∀ i, PlusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' i) (ε' : ∀ i, MinusParameters (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P V' i)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (hA : ∀ z, fullResponse W P Q U V F z (extraFamily W P Q U V z (δ z) (ε z)) (δ z) (ε z) =
      ∑ i, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i))
    (hB : ∀ i, fullResponse (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' V' F.flip i
      (extraFamily (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) Q P U' V' i (δ' i) (ε' i)) (δ' i) (ε' i) =
      ∑ z, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) D L R F.flip z i).comp (LinearMap.proj z)) :
    (∀ i z x, fullContraction (Lax342547.ChannelAssembly.assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε')
      (Profile k n b degree) i z x = (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x) ∧
    (∀ i z x, fullContraction (Lax342547.ChannelAssembly.assemble W P Q U V U' V' F δ ε δ' ε').flip
      (Profile k n b degree) z i x = (D.role + gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z)) x)

end Lax342547.GradientAssembly

concepts.title: The symmetric binary gradient form
concepts.description:
The form in (2.8)–(2.10): $a\otimes a$, the symmetric tester terms,
and the symmetrization of the mixer form. Its diagonal is $a$.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.HoleRelation
import Lax342547.MomentSpace

/-!
---
title: The symmetric binary gradient form
type: lemma
---
The form in (2.8)–(2.10): $a\otimes a$, the symmetric tester terms,
and the symmetrization of the mixer form. Its diagonal is $a$.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GradientForm

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

variable {X Tag : Type} [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [Fintype Tag]

def rankOne (a b : X →ₗ[Binary] Binary) : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary X := a.smulRight b

def form (a : X →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (aTag bTag : Tag → X →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary X) : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary X :=
  rankOne a a + (∑ t, (rankOne (aTag t) (bTag t) + rankOne (bTag t) (aTag t))) + B + B.flip

axiom form_properties (a : X →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (aTag bTag : Tag → X →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary X) :
    (∀ x y, form a aTag bTag B x y = form a aTag bTag B y x) ∧
      ∀ x, form a aTag bTag B x x = a x

end Lax342547.GradientForm

concepts.description: Construct the bounded frozen baseline from the admissible injecting small table and sparse pin exclusions. Choose actual private channel complements, solve both reciprocal recipes, and assemble one pair of cross forms satisfying all four whole-space gradients while retaining every actual pin and key entry.

import Lax342547.FrozenGradients
import Lax342547.RawBaselines

/-!
---
title: Deterministic whole-space gradient realization from the genuine recipe hypotheses
type: lemma
---
Construct the bounded frozen baseline from the admissible injecting small table and sparse pin exclusions. Choose actual private channel complements, solve both reciprocal recipes, and assemble one pair of cross forms satisfying all four whole-space gradients while retaining every actual pin and key entry.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GradientRealization

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ChannelChanges Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.ResponseMatrices Lax342547.RawBaselines
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.BaseCompression Lax342547.QuotientCompression
open Lax342547.ResidualRealization
open Lax342547.CompressedResidual

axiom gradient_realization {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {K : ℕ} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (hB : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers Q B (2 * K + 28))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms W i) (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP W oB i))
    (hgradients' : ∀ z, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) z)
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) oA z))
    (hadmissible : Lax342547.SmallTables.Admissible T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation
      Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation oA oB)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree)
    (hmargin : 28 * copies * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) +
      quotientBound k b degree K (14 * K + 140) + 2 * K + 4 * (3 * K + 28) < 970 * r)
    (hchannels : 1000 * r ≤ Fintype.card H) :
    ∃ G : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H,
      Frozen G W P Q oA oB ∧
      (∀ i z x, fullContraction G (Profile k n b degree) i z x =
        (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x) ∧
      (∀ i z x, fullContraction G.flip (Profile k n b degree) z i x =
        (D.role + gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z)) x)

end Lax342547.GradientRealization

concepts.title: Gram-conditioned columns and their rank-failure probability
concepts.description:
At an injective plus frame, a prescribed Gram matrix has probability
exactly 2^(-pq). Its completions are independent affine columns parallel
to the plus annihilator. Their failure of injectivity costs at most
2^(p+q-N), uniformly in the prescribed Gram values.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AffineImages

/-!
---
title: Gram-conditioned columns and their rank-failure probability
type: lemma
---
At an injective plus frame, a prescribed Gram matrix has probability
exactly 2^(-pq). Its completions are independent affine columns parallel
to the plus annihilator. Their failure of injectivity costs at most
2^(p+q-N), uniformly in the prescribed Gram values.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GramColumns

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

variable {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]

def gramMap (A : Matrix N I Binary) : Matrix N J Binary →ₗ[Binary] Matrix I J Binary where
  toFun B := A.transpose * B
  map_add' B C := by simp [Matrix.mul_add]
  map_smul' c B := by simp [Matrix.mul_smul]

abbrev GramFiber (A : Matrix N I Binary) (G : Matrix I J Binary) :=
  {B : Matrix N J Binary // A.transpose * B = G}

noncomputable instance (A : Matrix N I Binary) (G : Matrix I J Binary) : Fintype (GramFiber A G) := by
  classical exact Subtype.fintype _

axiom gram_uniform [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N]
    (A : Matrix N I Binary) (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N J Binary)).map (gramMap A) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I J Binary)

axiom gram_probability [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N]
    (A : Matrix N I Binary) (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) (G : Matrix I J Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N J Binary)).toOuterMeasure {B | A.transpose * B = G} =
      1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J)

axiom conditional_failure [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N]
    (A : Matrix N I Binary) (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    [Nonempty (GramFiber A G)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (GramFiber A G)).toOuterMeasure {B | ¬ Function.Injective B.val.mulVec} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N

axiom extension_failure {K : Type} [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N]
    (P : Matrix N K Binary) (hP : Function.Injective P.mulVec)
    (A : Matrix N I Binary) (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    [Nonempty (GramFiber A G)] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (GramFiber A G)).toOuterMeasure
      {X | ¬ Function.Injective (fun z : (K → Binary) × (J → Binary) =>
        P.mulVec z.1 + X.val.mulVec z.2)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card K + Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N

end Lax342547.GramColumns

concepts.title: Two-sided Gram normalization for individually injective frames
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GramColumns

/-!
---
title: Two-sided Gram normalization for individually injective frames
type: lemma
---
Lemma 4.2, stated with exact finite probabilities and ratios of powers of
two. Subtraction in the extended nonnegative reals is truncated at zero;
when p+q≤N this is the displayed lower bound in the paper.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GramNormalization

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def probability {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N I Binary × Matrix N J Binary)).toOuterMeasure
    {z | Function.Injective z.1.mulVec ∧ Function.Injective z.2.mulVec ∧ z.1.transpose * z.2 = G}

axiom column_failure {J N : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N J Binary)).toOuterMeasure {A | ¬ Function.Injective A.mulVec} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card J / 2 ^ Fintype.card N

axiom normalization_upper {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) :
    probability (N := N) G ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J)

axiom normalization_lower {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) :
    (1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J)) *
      (1 - (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card I / 2 ^ Fintype.card N) *
      (1 - (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J) / 2 ^ Fintype.card N) ≤
        probability (N := N) G

axiom normalization_quarter {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    (hN : Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J + 2) ≤ probability (N := N) G

end Lax342547.GramNormalization

concepts.title: Actual reference-batch laws for mutual Gram tests
concepts.description:
Flatten both signs of a paired Gram orbit into one batch. Its independent-bit
density denominator is explicit; arbitrary tests retain the reciprocal
mutual-Gram comparison with no independence assumption inside either batch.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameTuples
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws
import Lax342547.CrossGramBasis

/-!
---
title: Actual reference-batch laws for mutual Gram tests
type: lemma
---
Flatten both signs of a paired Gram orbit into one batch. Its independent-bit
density denominator is explicit; arbitrary tests retain the reciprocal
mutual-Gram comparison with no independence assumption inside either batch.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.RealCellLaws

def batchEquiv {I J N : Type} :
    (Matrix N I Binary × Matrix N J Binary) ≃ (N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) where
  toFun z p := match p.2 with
    | Sum.inl i => z.1 p.1 i
    | Sum.inr j => z.2 p.1 j
  invFun x := (fun n i => x (n,Sum.inl i),fun n j => x (n,Sum.inr j))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv x := by funext p; rcases p with ⟨n,i|j⟩ <;> rfl

noncomputable def batchLaw {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) [Nonempty (Orbit N G)] :
    (N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) → ℝ :=
  weights ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N G)).map (fun z => batchEquiv z.val))

axiom batch_probability {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N G)] : Probability (batchLaw (N := N) G)

axiom batch_point_cap {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N G)] (hN : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (x : N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) :
    batchLaw G x ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2)/
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card N*(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J))

axiom mutual_gram_comparison {I J K L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Fintype K] [Fintype L] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L]
    (N : ℕ) (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin N) G)] [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin N) H)]
    (f : (Fin N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (Fin N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (target : Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L → Binary)
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ N)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ N)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)) :
    |Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass (fun xy => batchLaw G xy.1*batchLaw H xy.2*(f xy.1*g xy.2))
        (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N) target /
      Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass (fun xy => batchLaw G xy.1*batchLaw H xy.2)
        (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N) target -
      (∑ x,batchLaw G x*f x)*(∑ y,batchLaw H y*g y)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+2)*
        (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
          ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N))

end Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity

  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) 1) N →
    instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card L)) 1) N →
      (∀ (x : Prod (Fin N) (Sum I J) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Real.instLE.le (abs (f x)) 1) →
        (∀ (y : Prod (Fin N) (Sum K L) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Real.instLE.le (abs (g y)) 1) →
          Real.instLE.le
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) 2))
                  (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card L)) 2)))
                (instHPow.hPow 2 N).sqrt)
              (instHDiv.hDiv 1
                (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)) 1))) →
            Real.instLE.le
              (abs
                (instHSub.hSub
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass
                      (fun xy =>
                        instHMul.hMul

                      (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N) target)
                    (Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass
                      (fun xy =>
                        instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity.batchLaw G xy.fst)
                          (Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity.batchLaw H xy.snd))
                      (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests N) target))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun x => instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity.batchLaw G x) (f x))
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun y => instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity.batchLaw H y) (g y)))))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)) 2))
                (instHDiv.hDiv
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) 2))
                    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card K) (Fintype.card L)) 2)))

concepts.description: The .95 image exponent gives the .45 Walsh exponent. Exact zero quotient characters and bounded nonzero characters give simultaneous scalar agreement with the full binary Fourier cost.

import Lax342547.RetainedImages
import Lax342547.FourierTests

/-!
---
title: Scalar agreement after quotient character estimates
type: lemma
---
The .95 image exponent gives the .45 Walsh exponent. Exact zero quotient characters and bounded nonzero characters give simultaneous scalar agreement with the full binary Fourier cost.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GramTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open Lax342547.FourierTests

axiom paper_walsh_factor (d : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^d * (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*d) * (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*d)) =
      (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*d)

axiom paper_image_walsh {ΩA ΩB I : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (imageA : ΩA → I → Binary) (imageB : ΩB → I → Binary)
    (f : ΩA → ℝ) (g : ΩB → ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b)
    (hαsum : ∑ a, α a ≤ 1) (hβsum : ∑ b, β b ≤ 1)
    (hcapA : ∀ x, push α imageA x ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card I))
    (hcapB : ∀ y, push β imageB y ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card I))
    (hf : ∀ a, |f a| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ b, |g b| ≤ 1) :
    |∑ a, ∑ b, α a * β b * f a * g b * phase (imageA a) (imageB b)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card I)

axiom zero_or_biased_agreement {Ω I : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (bits : Ω → I → Binary) (target : I → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hρ : ∑ ω, ρ ω = 1)
    (hchar : ∀ t : I → Binary, t ≠ 0 →
      characterMean ρ bits target t = 1 ∨ |characterMean ρ bits target t| ≤ ε)
    (hsmall : ε ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1)) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1) ≤ patternMass ρ bits target

end Lax342547.GramTests

import Lax342547.RawToGraph

/-!
---
title: Sampled graph failure bound
type: lemma
---
The actual container exception tails bound the probability of a large connected matching under raw supersaturation.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GraphFailure

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.UnitLaws Lax342547.ContainerLaws
open Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CellAveraging Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open Lax342547.GoodSamples Lax342547.MatchingSamples Lax342547.SampledGraph Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
open Lax342547.RawToGraph
open scoped BigOperators

axiom graph_from_container_exceptions {Ω : Type}
    (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) (hloop : ∀ x, ¬ hole x x)
    (C : Finset (Finset (Ω × Ω))) (S : Finset (Ω × Ω) → Ω → Prop)
    (E : Finset (Ω × Ω) → Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hcover : ∀ I : Finset (Ω × Ω), (∀ x ∈ I, ∀ y ∈ I, ¬ fourConflict hole x y) → ∃ R ∈ C, I ⊆ R)
    (hcuts : ∀ R ∈ C, ∀ x y, ¬ hole x y → (x,y) ∈ R → S R x ∨ S R y ∨ E R x y)
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (k : ℕ) (hscale : 200*(k-1) < m)
    (hgood : ∀ R ∈ C, ¬ Bad (S R) (E R) k sample) :
    100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) < m

axiom sample_failure_bound {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) (hloop : ∀ x, ¬ hole x x)
    (M κ ε : ℝ) (m k L : ℕ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hμpos : ∀ x, 0 < μ x)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1)
    (hL : Real.log κ/(-Real.log (1-ε))+1 ≤ L)
    (hscale : 200*(k-1) < m)
    (hsuper : ∀ ρ, Feasible μ (fun x y => ¬ hole x y) M κ ρ →
      ε ≤ conflictMass ρ (fourConflict hole)) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin m => μ))
      (fun sample => m ≤ 100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample)) ≤
        (((Fintype.card Ω^2+1)^L : ℕ) : ℝ)*exceptionBudget m k M κ

end Lax342547.GraphFailure

                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.log κ) (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log (instHSub.hSub 1 ε)))) 1)
                      L.cast →
                    instLTNat.lt (instHMul.hMul 200 (instHSub.hSub k 1)) m →
                      (∀ (ρ : Prod Ω Ω → Real),
                          Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ (fun x y => Not (hole x y)) M κ ρ →
                            Real.instLE.le ε
                              (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.conflictMass ρ (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.fourConflict hole))) →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
                            fun sample =>
                            instLENat.le m
                              (instHMul.hMul 100
                                (Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.connectedMatchingNumber
                                  (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample))))
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (Fintype.card Ω) 2) 1) L).cast
                            (Lax342547.RawToGraph.exceptionBudget m k M κ))

concepts.description: Disjointness from accumulated pin spans constructs independent subspaces with an explicit cumulative dimension budget.

import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DFinsupp
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic

/-!
---
title: Greedy independence of subspaces
type: lemma
---
Disjointness from accumulated pin spans constructs independent subspaces with an explicit cumulative dimension budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GreedySpaces

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped BigOperators

axiom independent_snoc {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V)
    (hU : iSupIndep U) (hW : Disjoint W (⨆ i,U i)) : iSupIndep (Fin.snoc U W)

axiom finite_span_dimension {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (U : ι → Submodule K V) (S : Finset ι) :
    Module.finrank K ↥(S.sup U) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S,Module.finrank K (U i)

axiom accumulated_dimension {K V Ω : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (U : Ω → Submodule K V) (r n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → Ω)
    (hU : ∀ x,Module.finrank K (U x) ≤ r) :
    Module.finrank K ↥(⨆ i : Fin n,U (s i)) ≤ r*n

end Lax342547.GreedySpaces

    instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => U (s i)) x))
      (instHMul.hMul r n)

  instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S.sup U) x))

concepts.title: Greedy mode space exposure
concepts.description: Finite greedy ordering of actual subspaces has nonnegative decreasing span increments; tails retain the greedy property and their increment sum equals the dimension increase.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SpanDeficits
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

/-!
---
title: Greedy mode space exposure
type: lemma
---
Finite greedy ordering of actual subspaces has nonnegative decreasing span increments; tails retain the greedy property and their increment sum equals the dimension increase.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GreedySpans

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def gain {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (W S : Submodule K V) : ℝ :=
  (Module.finrank K (W ⊔ S : Submodule K V) : ℝ)-Module.finrank K W

def Greedy {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) : Submodule K V → List ι → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | W, i::l => (∀ j ∈ l, gain W (S j) ≤ gain W (S i)) ∧ Greedy S (W ⊔ S i) l

axiom gain_nonneg {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (W S : Submodule K V) : 0 ≤ gain W S

axiom gain_le_rank {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (W S : Submodule K V) : gain W S ≤ Module.finrank K S

axiom gain_antitone {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] {W U : Submodule K V} (hWU : W ≤ U) (S : Submodule K V) :
    gain U S ≤ gain W S

axiom exists_greedy_order {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (I : Finset ι) (W : Submodule K V) :
    ∃ l : List ι, l.Nodup ∧ l.toFinset = I ∧ Greedy S W l

noncomputable def spanAfter {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) : Submodule K V → List ι → Submodule K V
  | W, [] => W
  | W, i::l => spanAfter S (W ⊔ S i) l

noncomputable def increments {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) : Submodule K V → List ι → List ℝ
  | _, [] => []
  | W, i::l => gain W (S i)::increments S (W ⊔ S i) l

axiom increments_length {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) :
    (increments S W l).length = l.length

axiom span_after_eq {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) :
    spanAfter S W l = W ⊔ l.toFinset.sup S

axiom increments_sum {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) :
    (increments S W l).sum = (Module.finrank K (spanAfter S W l) : ℝ)-Module.finrank K W

axiom increments_le {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) (a : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ l, gain W (S i) ≤ a) : ∀ x ∈ increments S W l, x ≤ a

axiom increments_nonneg {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) :
    ∀ x ∈ increments S W l, 0 ≤ x

axiom greedy_decreasing {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)
    (h : Greedy S W l) : (increments S W l).Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a)

axiom greedy_drop {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)
    (h : Greedy S W l) (n : ℕ) : Greedy S (spanAfter S W (l.take n)) (l.drop n)

axiom increments_drop {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) (n : ℕ) :
    (increments S W l).drop n = increments S (spanAfter S W (l.take n)) (l.drop n)

end Lax342547.GreedySpans

exists_greedy_order : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [inst_4 : FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (I : Finset ι) (W : Submodule K V),
  Exists fun l => And l.Nodup (And (Eq l.toFinset I) (Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l))

gain_antitone : ∀ {K V : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  {W U : Submodule K V},
  Submodule.instPartialOrder.le W U →
    ∀ (S : Submodule K V), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain U S) (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain W S)

  (W S : Submodule K V),
  Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain W S)
    (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)).cast

gain_nonneg : ∀ {K V : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (W S : Submodule K V), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain W S)

greedy_decreasing : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l →
    List.Pairwise (fun a b => Real.instLE.le b a) (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l)

greedy_drop : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l →
    ∀ (n : Nat), Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W (List.take n l)) (List.drop n l)

increments_drop : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) (n : Nat),
  Eq (List.drop n (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l))
    (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W (List.take n l)) (List.drop n l))

increments_le : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) (a : Real),
  (∀ (i : ι), List.instMembership.mem l i → Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain W (S i)) a) →
    ∀ (x : Real), List.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l) x → Real.instLE.le x a

increments_length : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι), Eq (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l).length l.length

increments_nonneg : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) (x : Real),
  List.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l) x → Real.instLE.le 0 x

increments_sum : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Eq (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l).sum
    (instHSub.hSub
      (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W l) x)).cast
      (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem W x)).cast)

span_after_eq : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Eq (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W l) (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max W (l.toFinset.sup S))

concepts.title: Small actual greedy exposure tails
concepts.description: Greedy exposure bounds the actual sum of projected mode dimensions minus their span increase by a dyadic tail deficit, yielding a small tail at an explicit scale.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GreedySpans
import Lax342547.ListTails
import Lax342547.DyadicScale
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.List

/-!
---
title: Small actual greedy exposure tails
type: lemma
---
Greedy exposure bounds the actual sum of projected mode dimensions minus their span increase by a dyadic tail deficit, yielding a small tail at an explicit scale.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GreedyTails

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.ListTails Lax342547.DyadicTails
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def deficit {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι) : ℝ :=
    (l.map (fun i => gain W (S i))).sum-(increments S W l).sum

axiom greedy_deficit_bound {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)
    (hg : Greedy S W l) (hl : l ≠ []) :
    deficit S W l ≤ (l.length : ℝ)*value (increments S W l) 0-(increments S W l).sum

axiom greedy_tail_bound {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)
    (hg : Greedy S W l) (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hbl : b ≤ l.length) :
    deficit S (spanAfter S W (l.take (l.length-b))) (l.drop (l.length-b)) ≤
      (b : ℝ)*tailDeficit (value (increments S W l)) l.length b

axiom small_greedy_tail {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι)
    (hg : Greedy S W l) (r : ℝ) (hr : ∀ i ∈ l, (Module.finrank K (S i) : ℝ) ≤ r)
    (k n : ℕ) (hlen : l.length = 2^k) (hnk : n ≤ k) (hn : 8*r < n) :
    ∃ j < n, deficit S (spanAfter S W (l.take (l.length-2^(k-j))))
      (l.drop (l.length-2^(k-j))) < (2^(k-j) : ℝ)/4

end Lax342547.GreedyTails

statements.signature:
greedy_deficit_bound : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l →
    Ne l List.nil →
      Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.GreedyTails.deficit S W l)
        (instHSub.hSub
          (instHMul.hMul l.length.cast (Lax342547.ListTails.value (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l) 0))
          (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l).sum)

greedy_tail_bound : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l →
    ∀ (b : Nat),
      instLTNat.lt 0 b →
        instLENat.le b l.length →
          Real.instLE.le
            (Lax342547.GreedyTails.deficit S
              (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W (List.take (instHSub.hSub l.length b) l))
              (List.drop (instHSub.hSub l.length b) l))
            (instHMul.hMul b.cast
              (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailDeficit (Lax342547.ListTails.value (Lax342547.GreedySpans.increments S W l))
                l.length b))

small_greedy_tail : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V) (W : Submodule K V) (l : List ι),
  Lax342547.GreedySpans.Greedy S W l →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      (∀ (i : ι),
          List.instMembership.mem l i →
            Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x)).cast r) →
        ∀ (k n : Nat),
          Eq l.length (instHPow.hPow 2 k) →
            instLENat.le n k →
              Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 8 r) n.cast →
                Exists fun j =>
                  And (instLTNat.lt j n)
                    (Real.instLT.lt
                      (Lax342547.GreedyTails.deficit S
                        (Lax342547.GreedySpans.spanAfter S W
                          (List.take (instHSub.hSub l.length (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k j))) l))
                        (List.drop (instHSub.hSub l.length (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k j))) l))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k j)) 4))

concepts.description: Original target counting and selected endpoint-channel density costs are paid separately in the explicit phase margin.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentBudgets

/-!
---
title: Phase density budgets for selected channel groups
type: lemma
---
Original target counting and selected endpoint-channel density costs are paid separately in the explicit phase margin.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GroupPhaseScale



axiom group_phase_density_budget (r h m N Γ E G : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcap : L ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(m+N)) (hΓ : 2*r+10 ≤ Γ)
    (hN : m+r*E+G*(h*h+2) ≤ N) :
    L*((r+1 : ℝ)^E*(2 : ℝ)^(2*N*r)*(2 : ℝ)^(G*(h*h+2))/(2 : ℝ)^(Γ*N)) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(8*N)

end Lax342547.GroupPhaseScale

statements.signature:
group_phase_density_budget : ∀ (r h m N Γ E G : Nat) (L : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 L →
    Real.instLE.le L (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd m N)) →
      instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 r) 10) Γ →
        instLENat.le
            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd m (instHMul.hMul r E))
              (instHMul.hMul G (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul h h) 2)))
            N →
          Real.instLE.le
            (instHMul.hMul L
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd r.cast 1) E)
                    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 N) r)))
                  (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul G (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul h h) 2))))
                (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul Γ N))))
            (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul 8 N)))

concepts.title: Two-batch comparison across independent component groups
concepts.description:
Replacing one independent group at a time adds its bounded separate-test
error. The global tests may depend arbitrarily on all groups, and the two
observations inside each group retain their full joint dependence. Different
groups may have different finite state spaces and column counts.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawFrameComparison

/-!
---
title: Two-batch comparison across independent component groups
type: lemma
---
Replacing one independent group at a time adds its bounded separate-test
error. The global tests may depend arbitrarily on all groups, and the two
observations inside each group retain their full joint dependence. Different
groups may have different finite state spaces and column counts.
-/

namespace Lax342547.GroupTensorComparison
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators
variable {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {X Y : ι → Type} [∀ i,Fintype (X i)] [∀ i,Fintype (Y i)]

def mean (ρ : ∀ i,X i × Y i → ℝ) (f : (∀ i,X i) → ℝ) (g : (∀ i,Y i) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ z : ∀ i,X i × Y i,(∏ i,ρ i (z i))*f (fun i => (z i).1)*g (fun i => (z i).2)

axiom product_comparison (ρ σ : ∀ j,X j × Y j → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ j,Probability (ρ j)) (hσ : ∀ j,Probability (σ j)) (ε : ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i,∀ f : X i → ℝ,∀ g : Y i → ℝ,(∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) → (∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1) →
      |(∑ z : X i × Y i,ρ i z*f z.1*g z.2)-(∑ z : X i × Y i,σ i z*f z.1*g z.2)| ≤ ε i)
    (f : (∀ j,X j) → ℝ) (g : (∀ j,Y j) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1) :
    |mean ρ f g-mean σ f g| ≤ ∑ i,ε i

axiom reference_product_comparison (ρ : ∀ i,X i × Y i → ℝ)
    (α : ∀ i,X i → ℝ) (β : ∀ i,Y i → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i,Probability (ρ i)) (hα : ∀ i,Probability (α i)) (hβ : ∀ i,Probability (β i))
    (ε : ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i,∀ f : X i → ℝ,∀ g : Y i → ℝ,(∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) → (∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1) →
      |(∑ z : X i × Y i,ρ i z*f z.1*g z.2)-
        (∑ x,α i x*f x)*(∑ y,β i y*g y)| ≤ ε i)
    (f : (∀ i,X i) → ℝ) (g : (∀ i,Y i) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1) :
    |mean ρ f g-(∑ x,(∏ i,α i (x i))*f x)*(∑ y,(∏ i,β i (y i))*g y)| ≤ ∑ i,ε i

end

concepts.description: Rank-factor expansions prove the entrywise product rank bound and the actual binary incompatibility obstruction.

import Lax342547.RankFactors
import Lax342547.RankedProjection
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hadamard

/-!
---
title: Entrywise product rank and incompatible tuples
type: lemma
---
Rank-factor expansions prove the entrywise product rank bound and the actual binary incompatibility obstruction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.HadamardRank

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped BigOperators Matrix

axiom hadamard_rank {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A B : Matrix I J Binary) : (A ⊙ B).rank ≤ A.rank*B.rank

axiom all_one_rank {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] :
    (Matrix.of (fun _ : I => fun _ : J => (1 : Binary))).rank ≤ 1

axiom one_add_rank {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix I J Binary) :
    ((Matrix.of (fun _ : I => fun _ : J => (1 : Binary)))+A).rank ≤ 1+A.rank

axiom incompatible_tuple_bound {Ω ι : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (x : ι → Ω) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0)
    (hinc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ (F (x i) (x j) = 0 ∧ F (x j) (x i) = 0)) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ (1+F.rank)^2

axiom compatible_pair_in_tuple {Ω ι : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (x : ι → Ω) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0)
    (hsize : (1+F.rank)^2 < Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ F (x i) (x j) = 0 ∧ F (x j) (x i) = 0

end Lax342547.HadamardRank

concepts.title: Uniform relative Gram normalization errors
concepts.description:
The actual injective Gram event differs from its independent-bit factor
by at most twice the column-rank exception. Independent groups multiply
with an additive relative error budget, including growing slot batches.

import Lax342547.GramNormalization

/-!
---
title: Uniform relative Gram normalization errors
type: lemma
---
The actual injective Gram event differs from its independent-bit factor
by at most twice the column-rank exception. Independent groups multiply
with an additive relative error budget, including growing slot batches.
-/

namespace Lax342547.HistogramGram

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def normalized {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J)*(Lax342547.GramNormalization.probability (N := N) G).toReal

axiom normalized_bounds {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    (hN : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    0 ≤ normalized (N := N) G ∧ normalized (N := N) G ≤ 1 ∧
      1-2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N) ≤ normalized (N := N) G

axiom normalized_error {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    (hN : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    |normalized (N := N) G-1| ≤
      2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)

axiom product_error {D : Type} (S : Finset D) (q ε : D → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ S,0 ≤ q d ∧ q d ≤ 1) (hε : ∀ d ∈ S,0 ≤ ε d)
    (herr : ∀ d ∈ S,1-ε d ≤ q d) :
    |(∏ d ∈ S,q d)-1| ≤ ∑ d ∈ S,ε d

axiom independent_groups_error {S N : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    {I J : S → Type} [∀ s,Fintype (I s)] [∀ s,Fintype (J s)]
    [∀ s,DecidableEq (I s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (J s)]
    (G : ∀ s,Matrix (I s) (J s) Binary)
    (hN : ∀ s,Fintype.card (I s)+Fintype.card (J s) ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    |(∏ s,normalized (N := N) (G s))-1| ≤
      ∑ s,2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (I s)+Fintype.card (J s))/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)

axiom half_ambient_error {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary)
    (hN : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J ≤ Fintype.card N/2) :
    |normalized (N := N) G-1| ≤ 2/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card N/2)

end Lax342547.HistogramGram

        instHMul.hMul 2

concepts.title: The binary hole relation
concepts.description:
Fix binary vector spaces $X,V$, a functional $a:X\to\mathbb F_2$, and a
symmetric bilinear form $T$ on $X$. For each raw vertex $i$, let
$U_i:X\to V$ be injective and $u_i:V\to\mathbb F_2$ linear.

A hole between $i,j$ has witnesses $x,y\in X$ satisfying
$U_i x=U_j y$, $u_jU_i=a+T(x,\cdot)$,
$u_iU_j=a+T(y,\cdot)$, and $a(x)+a(y)=1$.
These are the equations of Definition 2.1.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Basic

/-!
---
title: The binary hole relation
type: definition
---
Fix binary vector spaces $X,V$, a functional $a:X\to\mathbb F_2$, and a
symmetric bilinear form $T$ on $X$. For each raw vertex $i$, let
$U_i:X\to V$ be injective and $u_i:V\to\mathbb F_2$ linear.

A hole between $i,j$ has witnesses $x,y\in X$ satisfying
$U_i x=U_j y$, $u_jU_i=a+T(x,\cdot)$,
$u_iU_j=a+T(y,\cdot)$, and $a(x)+a(y)=1$.
These are the equations of Definition 2.1.
-/

namespace Lax342547.HoleRelation

universe u v w

structure HoleData (Ω : Type u) (X : Type v) (V : Type w)
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V] where
  a : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2
  T : LinearMap.BilinForm (ZMod 2) X
  symmetric : ∀ x y, T x y = T y x
  U : Ω → X →ₗ[ZMod 2] V
  injective : ∀ i, Function.Injective (U i)
  u : Ω → V →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2

variable {Ω : Type u} {X : Type v} {V : Type w}
variable [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]

def Hole (D : HoleData Ω X V) (i j : Ω) : Prop :=
  ∃ x y : X, D.U i x = D.U j y ∧
    (∀ z, D.u j (D.U i z) = D.a z + D.T x z) ∧
    (∀ z, D.u i (D.U j z) = D.a z + D.T y z) ∧
    D.a x + D.a y = 1

end Lax342547.HoleRelation

concepts.title: Holes are symmetric, loopless, and triangle-free
concepts.description:
The hole relation of Definition 2.1 is symmetric, has no loops, and has
no triangle. This is Lemma 2.2: the six functional identities around a
triangle cancel in characteristic two, leaving $0=1$.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.HoleRelation

/-!
---
title: Holes are symmetric, loopless, and triangle-free
type: lemma
---
The hole relation of Definition 2.1 is symmetric, has no loops, and has
no triangle. This is Lemma 2.2: the six functional identities around a
triangle cancel in characteristic two, leaving $0=1$.
-/

namespace Lax342547.HoleTriangleFree

open HoleRelation

universe u v w

axiom hole_properties
    {Ω : Type u} {X : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    (D : HoleData Ω X V) :
    (∀ ⦃i j⦄, Hole D i j → Hole D j i) ∧ (∀ i, ¬ Hole D i i) ∧
      ∀ i j k, Hole D i j → Hole D j k → ¬ Hole D k i

end Lax342547.HoleTriangleFree

  And (∀ ⦃i j : Ω⦄, Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D i j → Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D j i)
    (And (∀ (i : Ω), Not (Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D i i))

        Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D i j →
          Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D j k → Not (Lax342547.HoleRelation.Hole D k i)))

concepts.title: Paying the reference-image conditioning and dimension costs
concepts.description:
The finite two-endpoint cap has prefactor 16 per component and loses
2(d+h) dimensions on minus images. Both costs are paid uniformly over
every positive total rank by choosing the ambient scale sufficiently
large. A single scale works for every positive n and every tested rank.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ReferenceImages
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NNReal

/-!
---
title: Paying the reference-image conditioning and dimension costs
type: lemma
---
The finite two-endpoint cap has prefactor 16 per component and loses
2(d+h) dimensions on minus images. Both costs are paid uniformly over
every positive total rank by choosing the ambient scale sufficiently
large. A single scale works for every positive n and every tested rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ImageScale

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ReferenceImages
open scoped ENNReal

axiom cost_bound (c p N a b : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hN : 2 * p ≤ N) (ht : 1 ≤ a + b)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * p ≤ ε * N) (hc : (8 : ℝ) * c ≤ ε * N) :

concepts.title: Independent leaf mixtures preserve actual pair-event masses
concepts.description: The product of two actual finite leaf mixtures is exactly the mixture of their independent leaf-pair laws, weighted by the original mass product. The same identity holds for every pair event.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PairRecovery
import Lax342547.MixtureRecovery

/-!
---
title: Independent leaf mixtures preserve actual pair-event masses
type: lemma
---
The product of two actual finite leaf mixtures is exactly the mixture of their independent leaf-pair laws, weighted by the original mass product. The same identity holds for every pair event.
-/

namespace Lax342547.IndependentMixtures

open Lax342547.PairRecovery
open scoped ENNReal

axiom independent_pair_mixture {ΩA ΩB J K : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (p : J → PMF ΩA) (q : K → PMF ΩB) (p₀ : PMF ΩA) (q₀ : PMF ΩB)
    (w : J → ℝ≥0∞) (v : K → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ a, p₀ a = ∑ j, w j * p j a) (hq : ∀ b, q₀ b = ∑ k, v k * q k b)
    (ab : ΩA × ΩB) :
    independentPair p₀ q₀ ab = ∑ jk : J × K, (w jk.1 * v jk.2) * independentPair (p jk.1) (q jk.2) ab

axiom independent_mixture_event {ΩA ΩB J K : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (p : J → PMF ΩA) (q : K → PMF ΩB) (p₀ : PMF ΩA) (q₀ : PMF ΩB)
    (w : J → ℝ≥0∞) (v : K → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ a, p₀ a = ∑ j, w j * p j a) (hq : ∀ b, q₀ b = ∑ k, v k * q k b)
    (H : Set (ΩA × ΩB)) :
    (independentPair p₀ q₀).toOuterMeasure H =
      ∑ jk : J × K, (w jk.1 * v jk.2) * (independentPair (p jk.1) (q jk.2)).toOuterMeasure H

end Lax342547.IndependentMixtures

concepts.description: Actual sequential failure tests produce independent pin spaces and retain a uniform amplified lower probability.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SequentialTests
import Lax342547.GreedySpaces
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DFinsupp
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic

/-!
---
title: Greedy independent failure samples
type: lemma
---
Actual sequential failure tests produce independent pin spaces and retain a uniform amplified lower probability.
-/

namespace Lax342547.IndependentSampling

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

axiom accepted_spaces_independent {K V Ω : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (U : Ω → Submodule K V) (F : Ω → Prop) (n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → Ω)
    (hs : Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts
      (fun j t x => F x ∧ Disjoint (U x) (⨆ i : Fin j,U (t i))) n s) :
    iSupIndep (fun i => U (s i))

axiom greedy_failure_lower_probability {K V Ω : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Fintype Ω] (U : Ω → Submodule K V) (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Ω → Prop)
    (η δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hμ : Probability μ) (hgap : δ ≤ η)
    (hF : η ≤ cellMass μ F)
    (havoid : ∀ j,j < n → ∀ t : Fin j → Ω,
      cellMass μ (fun x => ¬ Disjoint (U x) (⨆ i : Fin j,U (t i))) ≤ δ) :
    (η-δ)^n ≤ cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
      (fun s => Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts
        (fun j t x => F x ∧ Disjoint (U x) (⨆ i : Fin j,U (t i))) n s)

end Lax342547.IndependentSampling

    iSupIndep fun i => U (s i)

          Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub η δ) n)
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ) fun s =>

import Lax342547.AdaptiveProtection
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.DFinsupp

/-!
---
title: Amplified channel failures on independent pinned spaces
type: lemma
---
Nonzero choices from actual independent pinned spaces form independent witnesses; counting all choices and adaptive protected spaces gives the amplified failure exponent.
-/

namespace Lax342547.IndependentWitnesses

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators

axiom independent_witness_matrix {I N : Type} [Fintype I]
    (V : I → Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) (hV : iSupIndep V)
    (v : ∀ i,V i) (hv : ∀ i,(v i).val ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.of (fun n i => (v i).val n)).mulVec

axiom nonzero_witness_card {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (V : I → Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) (K : ℕ) (hK : ∀ i,Module.finrank Binary (V i) ≤ K) :
    Nat.card (∀ i,{v : V i // v.val ≠ 0}) ≤ 2^(K*Fintype.card I)

axiom adaptive_independent_witness_probability {I H N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (V : I → Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) (hV : iSupIndep V)
    (S : Matrix N H Binary → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (K : ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ i,Module.finrank Binary (V i) ≤ K) (hS : ∀ Y,Module.finrank Binary (S Y) ≤ K) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)))
      (fun Y => ∀ i,∃ v : V i,v.val ≠ 0 ∧ Y.transpose.mulVec v.val ∈ S Y) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*K+2*K*Fintype.card I)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*Fintype.card I)

end Lax342547.IndependentWitnesses
