concepts.description: The componentwise no-cover bound depends on the finite sample cardinality and applies to any index type of the prescribed dyadic size, including even moment samples.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.NoCoverRank
import Lax342547.ComponentDuals

/-!
---
title: No-cover rank growth on arbitrary finite indices
type: lemma
---
The componentwise no-cover bound depends on the finite sample cardinality and applies to any index type of the prescribed dyadic size, including even moment samples.
-/

namespace Lax342547.IndexedRankGrowth

open Lax342547.ComponentSpaces Lax342547.ComponentDuals Lax342547.CoverProjection
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom component_no_cover_rank_indexed {K e Ω ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype e] [DecidableEq e] [Fintype Ω] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {V W : e → Type} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)] [∀ i, Module K (V i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (V i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (W i)]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (M : Ω → ∀ i, V i →ₗ[K] W i) (r k : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hM : ∀ x, ∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M x i)) ≤ r)
    (hk : 100*r+10 ≤ k) (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 2^k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule K (∀ i, W i), ∀ T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K (∀ i, V i)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank K S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*Fintype.card ι →
      (Module.finrank K T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*Fintype.card ι →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (M x)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ j : ι, M (sample j) i))) : ℝ) <
        (2^(k-(100*r+10)) : ℝ)/4) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))

end Lax342547.IndexedRankGrowth

            instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 100 r) 10) k →

import Lax342547.InjectionBudgets
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed

/-!
---
title: Relative injection loss for polynomial accepting mass
type: lemma
---
Dyadic exceptions with the actual floor exponent vanish against every fixed polynomial, and finite test unions retain arbitrary relative error.
-/

namespace Lax342547.InjectionAsymptotics

open Filter

axiom polynomial_dyadic_floor_tends_zero (c d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ)^c/(2 : ℝ)^(N/d)) atTop (nhds 0)

axiom eventually_relative_exception (c d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (J ε : ℝ)
    (hJ : 0 ≤ J) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,J*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/d)+1/(2 : ℝ)^N) ≤ ε/(N : ℝ)^c

axiom relative_union_budget (J : ℕ) (ε a τ bad : ℝ) (hJ : 0 < J) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hbad : bad ≤ J*((ε/(2*J))*a+τ)) (htail : J*τ ≤ (ε/2)*a) :
    bad ≤ ε*a

end Lax342547.InjectionAsymptotics

  instLTNat.lt 0 d →
    ∀ (J ε : Real),

            (fun N =>
              Real.instLE.le

                    (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 N))))

            Filter.atTop

    Filter.Tendsto (fun N => instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow N.cast c) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv N d))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds 0)

import Lax342547.MomentBudgets

/-!
---
title: Early channel choice and injection exponent budgets
type: lemma
---
The channel dimension chosen before unit laws pays the accepting-family union, while actual conditioned primal avoidance retains an exponential margin.
-/

namespace Lax342547.InjectionBudgets



axiom amplified_ratio_budget (h K ℓ t m c N : ℕ) (L gap count : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hg : 1/(2 : ℝ)^t ≤ gap)
    (hLc : L ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m) (hc : count ≤ (2 : ℝ)^c) (hcount : 0 ≤ count)
    (hb : m+c+h*K+(2*K+t)*ℓ+N ≤ h*ℓ) :
    count*((L*((2 : ℝ)^(h*K+2*K*ℓ)/(2 : ℝ)^(h*ℓ)))/gap^ℓ) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^N

axiom quotient_probe_length (K N : ℕ) (hN : 20*(K+1) ≤ N) :
    N ≤ 20*(K+1)*(N/(10*(K+1)))

axiom early_channel_margin (K t Cs m h N : ℕ)
    (hh : 2*K+t+20*(K+1)*(Cs+3) ≤ h)
    (hN : 20*(K+1) ≤ N) (hm : m+h*K ≤ N) :
    (m+N)+Cs*N+h*K+(2*K+t)*(N/(10*(K+1)))+N ≤ h*(N/(10*(K+1)))

axiom accepting_family_exponential_budget (K t Cs m h N : ℕ) (L gap count : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hcount : 0 ≤ count) (hg : 1/(2 : ℝ)^t ≤ gap)
    (hLc : L ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(m+N)) (hc : count ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(Cs*N))
    (hh : 2*K+t+20*(K+1)*(Cs+3) ≤ h)
    (hN : 20*(K+1) ≤ N) (hm : m+h*K ≤ N) :
    count*((L*((2 : ℝ)^(h*K+2*K*(N/(10*(K+1))))/(2 : ℝ)^(h*(N/(10*(K+1))))))/gap^(N/(10*(K+1)))) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^N

axiom primal_avoidance_exponent (K b h m N : ℕ)
    (hb : b ≤ N/8) (hm : m+h+1 ≤ N/10) :
    m+N/100+b+h+K*(N/(10*(K+1)))+1+N/2 ≤ N

axiom conditioned_avoidance_budget (K b h m N : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hMc : M ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m)
    (hb : b ≤ N/8) (hm : m+h+1 ≤ N/10) :
    (M/(1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/100)))*(2*((2 : ℝ)^(b+h+K*(N/(10*(K+1))))/(2 : ℝ)^N)) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/2)

end Lax342547.InjectionBudgets

concepts.description: Actual product-pair event masses and finite injection tests retain accepting probability; the exponential tail gives arbitrary relative error under inverse-polynomial accepting mass.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.InjectionAsymptotics
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling

/-!
---
title: Accepting-pair test unions and relative loss
type: lemma
---
Actual product-pair event masses and finite injection tests retain accepting probability; the exponential tail gives arbitrary relative error under inverse-polynomial accepting mass.
-/

namespace Lax342547.InjectionUnion

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom pair_event_mass {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ)
    (E : A → B → Prop) :
    cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => E p.1 p.2) =
      ∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => E a b)

axiom finite_injection_union {A B J : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype J]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (accept : A → B → Prop) (F : J → A → B → Prop)
    (η τ : ℝ) (hα : ∀ a,0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b,0 ≤ β b)
    (hF : ∀ j,(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => accept a b ∧ F j a b)) ≤
      η*(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => accept a b))+τ) :
    cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => accept p.1 p.2 ∧ ∃ j,F j p.1 p.2) ≤
      Fintype.card J*(η*cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => accept p.1 p.2)+τ)

axiom inverse_polynomial_relative_union {A B J : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype J]
    (α : A → ℝ) (β : B → ℝ) (accept : A → B → Prop) (F : J → A → B → Prop)
    (N c : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hJ : 0 < Fintype.card J) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hα : ∀ a,0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b,0 ≤ β b)
    (haccept : 1/(N : ℝ)^c ≤ cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => accept p.1 p.2))
    (hF : ∀ j,(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => accept a b ∧ F j a b)) ≤
      (ε/(2*Fintype.card J))*(∑ b,β b*cellMass α (fun a => accept a b))+
        (1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/100)+1/(2 : ℝ)^N))
    (htail : (Fintype.card J : ℝ)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/100)+1/(2 : ℝ)^N) ≤ (ε/2)/(N : ℝ)^c) :
    cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => accept p.1 p.2 ∧ ∃ j,F j p.1 p.2) ≤
      ε*cellMass (fun p : A × B => α p.1*β p.2) (fun p => accept p.1 p.2)

end Lax342547.InjectionUnion

  (accept : A → B → Prop) (F : J → A → B → Prop) (η τ : Real),
  (∀ (a : A), Real.instLE.le 0 (α a)) →

          (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun p => instHMul.hMul (α p.fst) (β p.snd)) fun p =>
            And (accept p.fst p.snd) (Exists fun j => F j p.fst p.snd))
          (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card J).cast
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul η
                (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun p => instHMul.hMul (α p.fst) (β p.snd)) fun p =>
                  accept p.fst p.snd))
              τ))

  (accept : A → B → Prop) (F : J → A → B → Prop) (N c : Nat) (ε : Real),
  instLTNat.lt 0 (Fintype.card J) →
    Real.instLE.le 0 ε →
      (∀ (a : A), Real.instLE.le 0 (α a)) →
        (∀ (b : B), Real.instLE.le 0 (β b)) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow N.cast c))

                accept p.fst p.snd) →
            (∀ (j : J),
                Real.instLE.le
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
                    instHMul.hMul (β b) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a => And (accept a b) (F j a b)))
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv ε (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card J).cast))
                      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
                        instHMul.hMul (β b) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a => accept a b)))
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv N 100)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 N))))) →
              Real.instLE.le
                  (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card J).cast
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv N 100)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 N))))
                  (instHDiv.hDiv (instHDiv.hDiv ε 2) (instHPow.hPow N.cast c)) →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun p => instHMul.hMul (α p.fst) (β p.snd)) fun p =>
                    And (accept p.fst p.snd) (Exists fun j => F j p.fst p.snd))
                  (instHMul.hMul ε
                    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun p => instHMul.hMul (α p.fst) (β p.snd)) fun p =>
                      accept p.fst p.snd))

pair_event_mass : ∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (α : A → Real) (β : B → Real) (E : A → B → Prop),
  Eq (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun p => instHMul.hMul (α p.fst) (β p.snd)) fun p => E p.fst p.snd)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => instHMul.hMul (β b) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass α fun a => E a b))

import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns

/-!
---
title: Uniform injective-matrix density
type: lemma
---
Exact raw endpoint channel marginals have density at most two over uniform full matrices.
-/

namespace Lax342547.InjectiveDensity

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameSymmetry Lax342547.RawFrames
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped ENNReal

axiom injective_matrix_point_cap {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty (Injection H N)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N) (Y : Matrix N H Binary) :
    push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection H N))) Subtype.val Y ≤
      2*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) Y

axiom raw_minus_channel_point_cap {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [Nonempty (Injection H N)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N) (Y : Matrix N H Binary) :
    push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E))) (fun F => F.Y) Y ≤
      2*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) Y

axiom raw_plus_channel_point_cap {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [Nonempty (Injection H N)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N) (Y : Matrix N H Binary) :
    push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E))) (fun F => F.X) Y ≤
      2*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)) Y

end Lax342547.InjectiveDensity

concepts.title: Uniform injective frames and channel transpose failure
concepts.description:
Injectivity of an h-column frame has probability at least one half when
N≥h+1, so conditioning costs at most a factor of two on every event.
The transpose evaluation on any prescribed independent q-tuple is
therefore noninjective with probability at most 2^(q+1-h), as in (4.2).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
import Lax342547.GramNormalization

/-!
---
title: Uniform injective frames and channel transpose failure
type: lemma
---
Injectivity of an h-column frame has probability at least one half when
N≥h+1, so conditioning costs at most a factor of two on every event.
The transpose evaluation on any prescribed independent q-tuple is
therefore noninjective with probability at most 2^(q+1-h), as in (4.2).
-/

namespace Lax342547.InjectiveFrames

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
open scoped ENNReal

axiom injective_mass_half {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] (hN : Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {A | Function.Injective A.mulVec}

axiom injection_event_bound {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty (Injection H N)]
    (hN : Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) (S : Set (Matrix N H Binary)) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection H N)).toOuterMeasure {A | A.val ∈ S} ≤
      2 * (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)).toOuterMeasure S

axiom transpose_uniform {I H N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)).map (fun X => X.transpose * D) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix H I Binary)

axiom transpose_failure {I H N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty (Injection H N)]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (hN : Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Injection H N)).toOuterMeasure
      {X | ¬ Function.Injective (X.val.transpose * D).mulVec} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1) / 2 ^ Fintype.card H

axiom raw_transpose_failures {B I H N : Type}
    [Fintype B] [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (RawFrames.Frame B H N E)]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (hN : Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
        {F | ¬ Function.Injective (F.X.transpose * D).mulVec} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1) / 2 ^ Fintype.card H ∧
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
        {F | ¬ Function.Injective (F.Y.transpose * D).mulVec} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I + 1) / 2 ^ Fintype.card H

end Lax342547.InjectiveFrames

concepts.title: Exact joining of two prescribed Gram orbits
concepts.description:
A combined Gram orbit is precisely two separate orbits conditioned on their
reciprocal Gram entries and injectivity of both concatenated column lists.
The exact uniform and filtered laws retain these injectivity conditions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameTuples

/-!
---
title: Exact joining of two prescribed Gram orbits
type: lemma
---
A combined Gram orbit is precisely two separate orbits conditioned on their
reciprocal Gram entries and injectivity of both concatenated column lists.
The exact uniform and filtered laws retain these injectivity conditions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.JoinedGramOrbits

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameTuples

variable {I J K L N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] [Fintype N]

def joined {G : Matrix I J Binary} {H : Matrix K L Binary} (z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H) :=
  (Matrix.fromCols z.1.val.1 z.2.val.1,Matrix.fromCols z.1.val.2 z.2.val.2)

def Compatible (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary)
    (z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (joined z).1.mulVec ∧ Function.Injective (joined z).2.mulVec ∧
    z.1.val.1.transpose*z.2.val.2 = A ∧ z.2.val.1.transpose*z.1.val.2 = B

noncomputable instance (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary) :
    Fintype {z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H // Compatible G H A B z} := by
  classical exact Subtype.fintype _

axiom joined_gram (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H) :
    (joined z).1.transpose*(joined z).2 =
      Matrix.fromBlocks G (z.1.val.1.transpose*z.2.val.2) (z.2.val.1.transpose*z.1.val.2) H

axiom union_uniform (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))]
    [Nonempty {z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H // Compatible G H A B z}] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))).map Subtype.val =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype {z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H // Compatible G H A B z}).map
        (fun z => joined z.val)

axiom compatible_filter (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N G)] [Nonempty (Orbit N H)]
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))]
    [Nonempty {z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H // Compatible G H A B z}]
    (h : ∃ z ∈ {z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H | Compatible G H A B z},
      z ∈ (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N G × Orbit N H)).support) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N G × Orbit N H)).filter
        {z | Compatible G H A B z} h).map joined =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))).map Subtype.val

end Lax342547.JoinedGramOrbits

concepts.title: Frozen pin and key records with nominal column budgets
concepts.description: Joined pin/key spaces have total dimension bounded by the original pin rank plus the key rank. Unary pairings with their known images cost only nominal columns times that rank, and determine all frozen cross entries. The concrete coordinate count is linear in n.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrozenRecords
import Lax342547.RawQueryImages

/-!
---
title: Frozen pin and key records with nominal column budgets
type: lemma
---
Joined pin/key spaces have total dimension bounded by the original pin rank plus the key rank. Unary pairings with their known images cost only nominal columns times that rank, and determine all frozen cross entries. The concrete coordinate count is linear in n.
-/

namespace Lax342547.JoinedRecords

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.FrozenRecords
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TagGeometry

noncomputable def joined {Axis I N : Type} {U : Axis → Type}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (U a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (U a)]
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (keys : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary)) (a : Axis) :
    Submodule Binary (I → Binary) := P.space a ⊔ LinearMap.range (keys a)

axiom joined_rank_budget {Axis I N : Type} {U : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (U a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (U a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (U a)]
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (keys : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary)) :
    (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (joined P keys a)) ≤ P.rank + ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a)

abbrev RecordType (Axis I : Type) (dims : Axis → ℕ) (Status : Type) :=
  (∀ a, Matrix I (Fin (dims a)) Binary) × Status

axiom joined_record_count {Axis I Status : Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype Status] (dims : Axis → ℕ) : by
    classical
    exact Fintype.card (RecordType Axis I dims Status) = 2 ^ (Fintype.card I * ∑ a, dims a) * Fintype.card Status

axiom joined_record_bound {Axis I N Status : Type} {U : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype Status]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (U a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (U a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (U a)]
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (keys : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (K k s : ℕ) (hP : P.rank ≤ K) (hkeys : (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a)) ≤ k)
    (hstatus : Fintype.card Status ≤ 2^s) : by
    classical
    exact Fintype.card (RecordType Axis I (fun a => Module.finrank Binary (joined P keys a)) Status) ≤
      2 ^ (Fintype.card I * (K+k) + s)

axiom nominal_column_count {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] :
    Fintype.card (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) = 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)

axiom coordinate_linear_budget (k n b degree : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) ≤
      Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * (Fintype.card (Tag k)^2 + 4) * n

noncomputable def basisVectors {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (S : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) : Fin (Module.finrank Binary S) → I → Binary :=
  fun i => (Module.finBasis Binary S i).val

axiom basis_vectors_span {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (S : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) : Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (basisVectors S)) = S

axiom basis_records_cross_agreement {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (A A' B B' : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (leftImages : Fin (Module.finrank Binary D) → N → Binary)
    (rightImages : Fin (Module.finrank Binary E) → N → Binary)
    (hleft : ∀ x, A (basisVectors D x) = leftImages x ∧ A' (basisVectors D x) = leftImages x)
    (hright : ∀ y, B (basisVectors E y) = rightImages y ∧ B' (basisVectors E y) = rightImages y)
    (hrecA : record A rightImages = record A' rightImages)
    (hrecB : record B leftImages = record B' leftImages) :
    (∀ v ∈ D, ∀ w, dotProduct (A v) (B w) = dotProduct (A' v) (B' w)) ∧
    (∀ v w, w ∈ E → dotProduct (A v) (B w) = dotProduct (A' v) (B' w))

end Lax342547.JoinedRecords

  instLENat.le 1 n →
    instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree))
      (instHMul.hMul
        (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree))

concepts.title: Joint-injectivity loss for two actual reference batches
concepts.description:
Concatenating both column lists turns the ambient reference experiment into
a uniform matrix pair. The separate Gram-orbit caps transfer column failure
to the actual product law; Fourier normalization also bounds that loss after
conditioning on reciprocal Gram entries.

import Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity

/-!
---
title: Joint-injectivity loss for two actual reference batches
type: lemma
---
Concatenating both column lists turns the ambient reference experiment into
a uniform matrix pair. The separate Gram-orbit caps transfer column failure
to the actual product law; Fourier normalization also bounds that loss after
conditioning on reciprocal Gram entries.
-/

variable {I J K L N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] [Fintype N]
  [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq N]

def ambientEquiv :
    ((N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary)) ≃
      (Matrix N (I ⊕ K) Binary × Matrix N (J ⊕ L) Binary) where
  toFun z := (Matrix.fromCols (batchEquiv.symm z.1).1 (batchEquiv.symm z.2).1,
    Matrix.fromCols (batchEquiv.symm z.1).2 (batchEquiv.symm z.2).2)
  invFun z := (batchEquiv (z.1.submatrix id Sum.inl,z.2.submatrix id Sum.inl),
    batchEquiv (z.1.submatrix id Sum.inr,z.2.submatrix id Sum.inr))
  left_inv z := by apply Prod.ext <;> funext (n,s) <;> cases s <;> rfl
  right_inv z := by apply Prod.ext <;> ext n (i | k) <;> rfl

def Good (z : (N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary)) :=
  Function.Injective (ambientEquiv z).1.mulVec ∧ Function.Injective (ambientEquiv z).2.mulVec

axiom ambient_failure [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq N] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary))).toOuterMeasure
        {z | ¬ Good z} ≤
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card K)+(2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(Fintype.card J+Fintype.card L))/
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^Fintype.card N

axiom reference_failure [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N G)] [Nonempty (Orbit N H)]
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    cellMass (fun z : (N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) =>
        batchLaw (N := N) G z.1*batchLaw (N := N) H z.2) (fun z => ¬ Good z) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))*
        (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card K)+(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card J+Fintype.card L))/
          (2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)

axiom conditioned_reference_failure {I J K L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Fintype K] [Fintype L] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L]
    (n : ℕ) (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) G)] [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) H)]
    (target : Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L → Binary)
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ n)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)) :
    cellMass (fun z : (Fin n × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (Fin n × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) =>
        batchLaw G z.1*batchLaw H z.2)
      (fun z => Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests n z = target ∧ ¬ Good z)/
      Lax342547.FourierTests.patternMass (fun z => batchLaw G z.1*batchLaw H z.2)
        (Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests n) target ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)*
        (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
          ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))*
          (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card K)+(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card J+Fintype.card L))/(2 : ℝ)^n))

end
end Lax342547.JointGramInjection

concepts.title: Exact leaf entropy bounds joint key and additional images
concepts.description: The full key plus additional tuple has the sum of the two ranks. Applying the actual old-pin leaf cap before any cell conditioning bounds every specified joint image event.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.JointDirections

/-!
---
title: Exact leaf entropy bounds joint key and additional images
type: lemma
---
The full key plus additional tuple has the sum of the two ranks. Applying the actual old-pin leaf cap before any cell conditioning bounds every specified joint image event.
-/

namespace Lax342547.JointKeyCap

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open scoped ENNReal

axiom leaf_key_fresh_image_cap {Ω Axis I N : Type} {U V : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (U a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (U a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (U a)]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (V a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (V a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (V a)]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (keys : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (fresh : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hkeys : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (keys a)))
    (hfresh : ∀ a, Function.Injective (((P.space a) ⊔ LinearMap.range (keys a)).mkQ.comp (fresh a)))
    (yk : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (yf : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (hr : 1 ≤ (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a)) + ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a)) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {ω | ∀ a, (A ω a).comp (keys a) = yk a ∧ (A ω a).comp (fresh a) = yf a} ≤
      α ^ ((∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a)) + ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a))

end Lax342547.JointKeyCap

concepts.title: Joint binary projections for commuting idempotents
concepts.description:
The simultaneous splitting used in Lemma 5.2, with both dimension bounds.
The projections are indexed by all binary labels; at most dim(V) are nonzero.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Finite

/-!
---
title: Joint binary projections for commuting idempotents
type: lemma
---
The simultaneous splitting used in Lemma 5.2, with both dimension bounds.
The projections are indexed by all binary labels; at most dim(V) are nonzero.
-/

namespace Lax342547.JointProjectors

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom exists_joint_decomposition {ι V : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (M : ι → Module.End Binary V)
    (hid : ∀ i, M i * M i = M i) (hcomm : ∀ i j, M i * M j = M j * M i) :
    ∃ P : (ι → Binary) → Module.End Binary V,
      (∑ s, P s) = 1 ∧ (∀ s, P s * P s = P s) ∧
      (∀ s t, s ≠ t → P s * P t = 0) ∧
      (∀ i s, M i * P s = s i • P s) ∧
      (∑ s, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (P s))) = Module.finrank Binary V ∧
      Nat.card {s // P s ≠ 0} ≤ Module.finrank Binary V

end Lax342547.JointProjectors

  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  (M : ι → Module.End Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V),
  (∀ (i : ι), Eq (instHMul.hMul (M i) (M i)) (M i)) →
    (∀ (i j : ι), Eq (instHMul.hMul (M i) (M j)) (instHMul.hMul (M j) (M i))) →
      Exists fun P =>
        And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun s => P s) 1)
          (And (∀ (s : ι → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Eq (instHMul.hMul (P s) (P s)) (P s))
            (And (∀ (s t : ι → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Ne s t → Eq (instHMul.hMul (P s) (P t)) 0)
              (And
                (∀ (i : ι) (s : ι → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                  Eq (instHMul.hMul (M i) (P s)) (instHSMul.hSMul (s i) (P s)))
                (And
                  (Eq
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun s =>
                      Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (LinearMap.range (P s)) x))
                    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V))
                  (instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun s => Ne (P s) 0))
                    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V))))))

concepts.title: Bounded descriptions of large matrix kernels
concepts.description:
A large sum of kernel dimensions has a certificate using a bounded
number of coefficient columns per component. Enumerating these matrices

import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Basic

/-!
---
title: Bounded descriptions of large matrix kernels
type: lemma
---
A large sum of kernel dimensions has a certificate using a bounded
number of coefficient columns per component. Enumerating these matrices
costs only an exponential in their coefficient dimensions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.KernelWitness

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

axiom exists_kernel_witness {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (A : Matrix N I Binary) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : Matrix I (Fin q) Binary, A * C = 0 ∧
      min q (Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin)) ≤ C.rank

axiom exists_family_witness {Comp I N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (A : Comp → Matrix N I Binary) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : q ≤ ∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.ker (A e).mulVecLin)) :
    ∃ C : Comp → Matrix I (Fin q) Binary, (∀ e, A e * C e = 0) ∧ q ≤ ∑ e, (C e).rank

axiom coefficient_count {Comp I : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype I] (q : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (Comp → Matrix I (Fin q) Binary) = 2 ^ (Fintype.card Comp * Fintype.card I * q)

axiom kernel_event_bound {Ω Comp I N : Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Comp → Matrix N I Binary) (q : ℕ) (cap : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ C : Comp → Matrix I (Fin q) Binary, q ≤ (∑ e, (C e).rank) →
      p.toOuterMeasure {o | ∀ e, A o e * C e = 0} ≤ cap) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | q ≤ ∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.ker (A o e).mulVecLin)} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card Comp * Fintype.card I * q) * cap

end Lax342547.KernelWitness

    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Comp) (Fintype.card I)) q))

  (A : Comp → Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (q : Nat),
  instLENat.le q
      (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
        Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (A e).mulVecLin.ker x)) →
    Exists fun C =>
      And (∀ (e : Comp), Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (A e) (C e)) 0)
        (instLENat.le q (Finset.univ.sum fun e => (C e).rank))

  Exists fun C =>
    And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A C) 0)
      (instLENat.le
        (instMinNat.min q
          (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem A.mulVecLin.ker x)))
        C.rank)

  (A : Ω → Comp → Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (q : Nat) (cap : ENNReal),
  (∀ (C : Comp → Matrix I (Fin q) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      instLENat.le q (Finset.univ.sum fun e => (C e).rank) →
        ENNReal.instLE.le
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
            (Set.ofPred fun o => ∀ (e : Comp), Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (A o e) (C e)) 0))
          cap) →
    ENNReal.instLE.le
      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
        (Set.ofPred fun o =>
          instLENat.le q
            (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
              Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (A o e).mulVecLin.ker x))))

concepts.title: Accepted key subprobabilities and uniform overlap
concepts.description: Accepted queries retain their original mass. Uniform reference overlap is exactly the number of keys times independent accepted collision probability.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PrimalRecords

/-!
---
title: Accepted key subprobabilities and uniform overlap
type: lemma
---
Accepted queries retain their original mass. Uniform reference overlap is exactly the number of keys times independent accepted collision probability.
-/

namespace Lax342547.KeyMeasures



noncomputable def keyMass {Ω Q : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop) (q : Q) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ω, if accepted ω ∧ key ω = q then ρ ω else 0

axiom key_mass_nonneg {Ω Q : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop) (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (q : Q) :
    0 ≤ keyMass ρ key accepted q

axiom key_mass_total {Ω Q : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Q]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ q, keyMass ρ key accepted q) = ∑ ω, if accepted ω then ρ ω else 0

axiom key_mass_subprobability {Ω Q : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Q]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (hsum : ∑ ω, ρ ω ≤ 1) :
    (∑ q, keyMass ρ key accepted q) ≤ 1

axiom key_collision_identity {ΩA ΩB Q : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Q]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (keyA : ΩA → Q) (keyB : ΩB → Q)
    (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ q, keyMass α keyA acceptA q * keyMass β keyB acceptB q) =
        ∑ a, ∑ b, if acceptA a ∧ acceptB b ∧ keyA a = keyB b then α a * β b else 0

noncomputable def uniformDensity {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] (mass : Q → ℝ) : Q → ℝ :=
  fun q => Fintype.card Q * mass q

noncomputable def uniformOverlap {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] (a b : Q → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ q, uniformDensity a q * uniformDensity b q) / Fintype.card Q

axiom uniform_overlap_collision {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [Nonempty Q] (a b : Q → ℝ) :
    uniformOverlap a b = Fintype.card Q * ∑ q, a q * b q

end Lax342547.KeyMeasures

  (keyA : ΩA → Q) (keyB : ΩB → Q) (acceptA : ΩA → Prop) (acceptB : ΩB → Prop),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass α keyA acceptA q) (Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass β keyB acceptB q))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (And (acceptA a) (And (acceptB b) (Eq (keyA a) (keyB b)))) (instHMul.hMul (α a) (β b)) 0)

key_mass_nonneg : ∀ {Ω Q : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) → ∀ (q : Q), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass ρ key accepted q)

key_mass_subprobability : ∀ {Ω Q : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] (ρ : Ω → Real) (key : Ω → Q) (accepted : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => ρ ω) 1 →
      Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun q => Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass ρ key accepted q) 1

  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass ρ key accepted q)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => ite (accepted ω) (ρ ω) 0)

  Eq (Lax342547.KeyMeasures.uniformOverlap a b)
    (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Q).cast (Finset.univ.sum fun q => instHMul.hMul (a q) (b q)))

concepts.title: Fresh point-ray spans are disjoint from the nominal table spaces
concepts.description:
The finite-set sparse exclusions give independence for arbitrary indexed
families of at most fourteen rays per endpoint. In particular the span
of all selected rays intersects each table space only at zero.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FreshKeys
import Lax342547.NominalPrimal

/-!
---
title: Fresh point-ray spans are disjoint from the nominal table spaces
type: lemma
---
The finite-set sparse exclusions give independence for arbitrary indexed
families of at most fourteen rays per endpoint. In particular the span
of all selected rays intersects each table space only at zero.
-/

namespace Lax342547.KeySpans

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces

variable {Base Comp H N : Type} {b degree : ℕ}

def Excludes
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (c : Fin 2 → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (z : Fin 2 → (Fin b → Binary) → Base → Binary),
    (∀ i, (L i).card ≤ 14) → (∀ i, Disjoint (L i) (A i)) →
    (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ s ∈ L i, c i s •
      primalEmbedding i (point (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (z i s))) ∈ tableSpace P a →
    ∀ i s, s ∈ L i → c i s = 0

def ray {I : Fin 2 → Type} (label : ∀ i, I i → Fin b → Binary)
    (base : ∀ i, I i → Base → Binary) (x : Σ i, I i) :
    (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) → Binary :=
  primalEmbedding x.1 (point (selectorEval (degree := degree)) (label x.1 x.2) (base x.1 x.2))

axiom exclusions_exists [Fintype Base] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype H] {K R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hdegree : (K + 1) * (R + 14) ≤ degree + 1) :
    ∃ A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
      (∀ i, (A i).card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Comp * K * (R + 14)) ∧ Excludes P A

axiom independent_sum {I : Fin 2 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (I i)]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (label : ∀ i, I i → Fin b → Binary) (base : ∀ i, I i → Base → Binary)
    (hlabel : ∀ i, Function.Injective (label i)) (hcard : ∀ i, Fintype.card (I i) ≤ 14)
    (hfresh : ∀ i x, label i x ∉ A i) (a : Comp × Bool) (c : (Σ i, I i) → Binary)
    (h : (∑ x, c x • ray (H := H) label base x) ∈ tableSpace P a) : ∀ x, c x = 0

axiom span_disjoint {I : Fin 2 → Type} [∀ i, Fintype (I i)]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (label : ∀ i, I i → Fin b → Binary) (base : ∀ i, I i → Base → Binary)
    (hlabel : ∀ i, Function.Injective (label i)) (hcard : ∀ i, Fintype.card (I i) ≤ 14)
    (hfresh : ∀ i x, label i x ∉ A i) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Disjoint (tableSpace P a) (Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (ray (H := H) label base)))

end Lax342547.KeySpans

  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      Exists fun A =>
        And
          (∀ (i : Fin 2),
            instLENat.le (A i).card
              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card Comp)) K) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)))
          (Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes P A)

      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)) H)) N)
  (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes P A →
    ∀ (label : (i : Fin 2) → I i → Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (base : (i : Fin 2) → I i → Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      (∀ (i : Fin 2), Function.Injective (label i)) →

                (Submodule.span Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Set.range (Lax342547.KeySpans.ray label base)))

concepts.title: Low-rank Boolean moments have bounded label support
concepts.description:
Lemma 5.2, with the sufficient selector-degree hypothesis used in its proof.
Every rank-at-most-R moment matrix splits over at most R labels. The base
blocks obey the binary moment identities and their ranks sum to at most R.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BaseMoments
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Low-rank Boolean moments have bounded label support
type: lemma
---
Lemma 5.2, with the sufficient selector-degree hypothesis used in its proof.
Every rank-at-most-R moment matrix splits over at most R labels. The base
blocks obey the binary moment identities and their ranks sum to at most R.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LabelDecomposition

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.BaseMoments

axiom low_rank_label_decomposition {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree R : ℕ}
    (w : Matrix (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base)
      (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) Binary)
    (hw : w ∈ momentSpace (selectorEval (degree := degree)) Set.univ)
    (hrank : w.rank ≤ R) (hdegree : 6 * R + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∃ L : Finset (Fin b → Binary),
    ∃ Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary,
      L.card ≤ R ∧ (∀ s ∈ L, IsBaseMoment (Z s)) ∧
      (∑ s ∈ L, (Z s).rank) ≤ R ∧
      ∀ i k, w i k = ∑ s ∈ L, selectorEval s i.1 * selectorEval s k.1 * Z s i.2 k.2

end Lax342547.LabelDecomposition

statements.signature:
low_rank_label_decomposition : ∀ {Base : Type} [inst : Fintype Base] {b degree R : Nat}
  (w :
    Matrix (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base))
      (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.MomentSpace.momentSpace Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval Set.univ) w →
    instLENat.le w.rank R →
      instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 6 R) 4) degree →
        Exists fun L =>
          Exists fun Z =>
            And (instLENat.le L.card R)
              (And
                (∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem L s → Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment (Z s))
                (And (instLENat.le (L.sum fun s => (Z s).rank) R)
                  (∀ (i k : Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)),
                    Eq (w i k)
                      (L.sum fun s =>
                        instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s i.fst)
                            (Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s k.fst))
                          (Z s i.snd k.snd)))))

concepts.title: Triangle relations separate into individual label blocks
concepts.description:
Selector interpolation makes bounded-support block expansions unique.
The union of three component supports has size at most 3R, so a triangle
relation holds separately for every label, including absent labels.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorBlocks
import Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation
import Lax342547.ConcreteCut

/-!
---
title: Triangle relations separate into individual label blocks
type: lemma
---
Selector interpolation makes bounded-support block expansions unique.
The union of three component supports has size at most 3R, so a triangle
relation holds separately for every label, including absent labels.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LabelRelations

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TensorBlocks
open Lax342547.CutProfiles

def supported {Label Base : Type} [DecidableEq Label] (L : Finset Label)
    (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Binary) (s : Label) : Matrix Base Base Binary :=
  if s ∈ L then Z s else 0

def edge {Tag : Type} [DecidableEq Tag] (a b : Tag) (h : a ≠ b) : Component Tag :=
  ⟨{a, b}, Finset.card_pair h⟩

axiom blocks_unique {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree : ℕ}
    (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix Base Base Binary)
    (hdegree : L.card ≤ degree + 1) (h : (∑ s ∈ L, block (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (Z s)) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ L, Z s = 0

axiom triangle_blocks {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree R : ℕ}
    (L : Fin 3 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (Z : Fin 3 → (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix Base Base Binary)
    (hL : ∀ i, (L i).card ≤ R) (hdegree : 3 * R ≤ degree + 1)
    (h : (∑ i, ∑ s ∈ L i, block (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (Z i s)) = 0) :
    ∀ s, (∑ i, supported (L i) (Z i) s) = 0

axiom cut_triangle {Tag V : Type} [DecidableEq Tag] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (w : Tag → V) (a b c : Tag) (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    cutMap w (edge a b hab) + cutMap w (edge b c hbc) + cutMap w (edge a c hac) = 0

end Lax342547.LabelRelations

blocks_unique : ∀ {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree : Nat} (L : Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (Z : (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Matrix Base Base Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  instLENat.le L.card (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
    Eq
        (L.sum fun s =>
          LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s) (Z s))
        0 →
      ∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), SetLike.instMembership.mem L s → Eq (Z s) 0

  (w : Tag → V) (a b c : Tag) (hab : Ne a b) (hbc : Ne b c) (hac : Ne a c),
  Eq
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w (Lax342547.LabelRelations.edge a b hab))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w (Lax342547.LabelRelations.edge b c hbc)))
      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Lax342547.CutProfiles.cutMap w (Lax342547.LabelRelations.edge a c hac)))
    0

triangle_blocks : ∀ {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree R : Nat} (L : Fin 3 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (Z : Fin 3 → (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) → Matrix Base Base Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), instLENat.le (L i).card R) →
    instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 3 R) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
            (L i).sum fun s =>
              LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s) (Z i s))
          0 →
        ∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
          Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Lax342547.LabelRelations.supported (L i) (Z i) s) 0

concepts.title: Joint matrix-image caps for retained leaf laws
concepts.description: Joint fresh linear images flatten to the rank-factor matrix tuples used by Walsh characters. Exact leaf caps give all-rank component image bounds on original retained cells, including the rank-zero normalization case.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafCellImages
import Lax342547.ComponentCharacters
import Lax342547.PairedFrames

/-!
---
title: Joint matrix-image caps for retained leaf laws
type: lemma
---
Joint fresh linear images flatten to the rank-factor matrix tuples used by Walsh characters. Exact leaf caps give all-rank component image bounds on original retained cells, including the rank-zero normalization case.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafBlockCaps

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.LeafCellImages Lax342547.ComponentCharacters
open Lax342547.CoefficientPhase
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def decodedImages {Axis N : Type} {R : Axis → Type} [∀ _a, Fintype (R _a)]
    (y : ((Σ a, R a) × N) → Binary) : ∀ a, (R a → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) :=
  fun a => Matrix.mulVecLin (fun n i => y (⟨a,i⟩,n))

axiom block_image_fiber {Axis I N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [∀ _a, Fintype (R _a)]
    (F : ∀ a, Matrix I (R a) Binary) (X : ∀ _a, Matrix N I Binary)
    (y : ((Σ a, R a) × N) → Binary) : by
      classical
      exact blockImage F X = y ↔ ∀ a, (X a).mulVecLin.comp (F a).mulVecLin = decodedImages y a

axiom block_image_push {Ω Axis I N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [∀ _a, Fintype (R _a)]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (F : ∀ a, Matrix I (R a) Binary) (X : Ω → ∀ _a, Matrix N I Binary)
    (y : ((Σ a, R a) × N) → Binary) : by
      classical
      exact push ρ (fun ω => blockImage F (X ω)) y =

import Lax342547.JointKeyCap
import Lax342547.RealCellLaws

/-!
---
title: Joint fresh-image entropy on original retained leaf cells
type: lemma
---
Exact all-rank leaf caps combine known key directions with fresh directions. Conditioning on the original retained cell gives the paper .95 rank exponent, for tuples of arbitrary rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafCellImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def freshImage {Ω Axis I N : Type} {V : Axis → Type}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (V a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (V a)]
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (fresh : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (ω : Ω) : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) := fun a => (A ω a).comp (fresh a)

axiom original_leaf_cell_image_cap {Ω Axis I N : Type} {U V : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (U a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (U a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (U a)]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (V a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (V a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (V a)]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (keys : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (fresh : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hkeys : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (keys a)))
    (hfresh : ∀ a, Function.Injective (((P.space a) ⊔ LinearMap.range (keys a)).mkQ.comp (fresh a)))
    (yk : ∀ a, U a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (C : Ω → Prop)
    (hCkey : ∀ ω, C ω → ∀ a, (A ω a).comp (keys a) = yk a)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (hζsmall : ζ ≤ 1 / 1000)
    (hk : 2 * ζ * (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a)) ≤ (1 / 500 : ℝ))
    (ht : 1 ≤ ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a))
    (hC : (2 : ℝ)^(-(((∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U a) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 100) * Fintype.card N) ≤
      (p.toOuterMeasure {ω | C ω}).toReal)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(-(1 - 2 * ζ) * Fintype.card N)) ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (y : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact push (subtypeWeights (weights p) C) (fun ω => freshImage A fresh ω.val) y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*(∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a))*Fintype.card N)

end Lax342547.LeafCellImages

concepts.title: Actual independent leaf averaging and original-law collision cost
concepts.description: Finite PMF mixtures preserve the actual leaf masses. Affine collision bounds average over independent leaves without renormalization, skipped pairs remain valid, and squared restriction recovery gives the explicit original-law exponential lower bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.IndependentMixtures
import Lax342547.ParameterCellAveraging
import Lax342547.CollisionCosts
import Lax342547.CellAveraging

/-!
---
title: Actual independent leaf averaging and original-law collision cost
type: lemma
---
Finite PMF mixtures preserve the actual leaf masses. Affine collision bounds average over independent leaves without renormalization, skipped pairs remain valid, and squared restriction recovery gives the explicit original-law exponential lower bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafCollision

open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PairRecovery Lax342547.ParameterCellAveraging
open scoped ENNReal

axiom mixture_real_weights {Ω J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (p : J → PMF Ω) (p₀ : PMF Ω) (w : J → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw : ∀ j, w j ≠ ⊤) (hp : ∀ a, p₀ a = ∑ j, w j * p j a) (a : Ω) :
    weights p₀ a = ∑ j, (w j).toReal * weights (p j) a

axiom real_pair_mixture {ΩA ΩB J K : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (p : J → PMF ΩA) (q : K → PMF ΩB) (p₀ : PMF ΩA) (q₀ : PMF ΩB)
    (w : J → ℝ≥0∞) (v : K → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw : ∀ j, w j ≠ ⊤) (hv : ∀ k, v k ≠ ⊤)
    (hp : ∀ a, p₀ a = ∑ j, w j * p j a) (hq : ∀ b, q₀ b = ∑ k, v k * q k b)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) :
    pairMass (weights p₀) (weights q₀) H =
      average (fun j => (w j).toReal) (fun k => (v k).toReal)
        (fun j k => pairMass (weights (p j)) (weights (q k)) H)

axiom weighted_collision_lower {ΩA ΩB J K : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    (p : J → PMF ΩA) (q : K → PMF ΩB) (p₀ : PMF ΩA) (q₀ : PMF ΩB)
    (w : J → ℝ≥0∞) (v : K → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw : ∀ j, w j ≠ ⊤) (hv : ∀ k, v k ≠ ⊤)
    (hwsum : ∑ j, (w j).toReal = 1) (hvsum : ∑ k, (v k).toReal = 1)
    (hp : ∀ a, p₀ a = ∑ j, w j * p j a) (hq : ∀ b, q₀ b = ∑ k, v k * q k b)
    (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) (overlap : J → K → ℝ) (keys error agreement : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ j k, agreement*(overlap j k-error)/keys ≤
      pairMass (weights (p j)) (weights (q k)) H) :
    agreement*(average (fun j => (w j).toReal) (fun k => (v k).toReal) overlap-error)/keys ≤
      pairMass (weights p₀) (weights q₀) H

axiom skipped_collision_bound {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (p : PMF ΩA) (q : PMF ΩB) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop)
    (use : Prop) (overlap keys error agreement : ℝ)
    (hkeys : 0 < keys) (herror : 0 ≤ error) (hagreement : 0 ≤ agreement)
    (hbound : use → agreement*(overlap-error)/keys ≤ pairMass (weights p) (weights q) H) : by
    classical
    exact agreement*((if use then overlap else 0)-error)/keys ≤ pairMass (weights p) (weights q) H

axiom original_law_exponential_collision {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype J]
    (σ : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ σ.support)
    (p : J → PMF Ω) (w : J → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : ∀ j, w j ≠ ⊤)
    (hwsum : ∑ j, (w j).toReal = 1)
    (hp : ∀ a, (σ.filter S hS) a = ∑ j, w j * p j a)
    (H : Ω → Ω → Prop) (overlap : J → J → ℝ) (k η N keys error agreement : ℝ)
    (hkeys : 0 < keys) (hkeybound : keys ≤ (2:ℝ)^(k*N))
    (hoverlap : (2:ℝ)^(-η*N) ≤ average (fun j => (w j).toReal) (fun j => (w j).toReal) overlap)
    (herror : error ≤ (2:ℝ)^(-N/200)) (hscale : 1 ≤ (1/200-η)*N)
    (hagreement : (2:ℝ)^(-N/50) ≤ agreement)
    (hmass : (2:ℝ)^(-η*N) ≤ (σ.toOuterMeasure S).toReal)
    (hbound : ∀ j l, agreement*(overlap j l-error)/keys ≤ pairMass (weights (p j)) (weights (p l)) H) :
    (2:ℝ)^(-((k+1/50+3*η)*N)-1) ≤
      ((independentPair σ σ).toOuterMeasure {ab | H ab.1 ab.2}).toReal

end Lax342547.LeafCollision

concepts.title: Extracting a leaf with all remaining exact-image caps
concepts.description:
Among pin extensions that retain enough of the original mass, choose one
of maximal rank. A remaining unusually likely positive-rank constraint
would produce a larger candidate, so every such image test obeys the cap.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ExactPins
import Mathlib.Probability.ProbabilityMassFunction.Constructions

/-!
---
title: Extracting a leaf with all remaining exact-image caps
type: lemma
---
Among pin extensions that retain enough of the original mass, choose one
of maximal rank. A remaining unusually likely positive-rank constraint
would produce a larger candidate, so every such image test obeys the cap.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafExtraction

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open scoped ENNReal

def Good {Ω Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] (p : PMF Ω)
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (S : Set Ω) (α : ℝ≥0∞) : Prop :=
  ∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
    p.toOuterMeasure (S ∩ Q.event A) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q) * p.toOuterMeasure S

axiom exists_leaf {Ω Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (R : Set Ω) (hR : R ⊆ P₀.event A)
    (δ α : ℝ≥0∞) (hα₀ : α ≠ 0) (hαtop : α ≠ ⊤) (hmass : δ < p.toOuterMeasure R) :
    ∃ P : Pin Axis I N, P₀.Extends P ∧
      δ * α ^ (P.rank - P₀.rank) < p.toOuterMeasure (R ∩ P.event A) ∧
      Good p A P (R ∩ P.event A) α

end Lax342547.LeafExtraction

  (A :
    Ω →
      Axis →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (P₀ : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N) (R : Set Ω),
  Set.instLE.le R (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P₀) →
    ∀ (δ α : ENNReal),
      Ne α 0 →
        Ne α ENNReal.instTop.top →

            Exists fun P =>

import Lax342547.ExactPins
import Lax342547.LeafExtraction

/-!
---
title: All-rank tuple image caps from exact-pin leaf entropy
type: lemma
---
A tuple independent modulo the actual old pin defines an exact image pin of its full relative rank. The checked leaf cap therefore bounds any specified joint tuple image, uniformly over every tuple rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def imagePin {Ω Axis I N : Type}
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (o : Ω) : Pin Axis I N :=
  ⟨S, fun a => (A o a).comp (S a).subtype⟩

axiom image_pin_event {Ω Axis I N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (R a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (R a)]
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (f : ∀ a, R a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary)) (o : Ω) :
    (imagePin A (fun a => LinearMap.range (f a)) o).event A =
      {ω | ∀ a, (A ω a).comp (f a) = (A o a).comp (f a)}

axiom image_pin_relative_rank {Ω Axis I N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (R a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (R a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (R a)]
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (f : ∀ a, R a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hf : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (f a))) (o : Ω) :
    P.relativeRank (imagePin A (fun a => LinearMap.range (f a)) o) =
      ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (R a)

axiom leaf_tuple_image_cap {Ω Axis I N : Type} {R : Axis → Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (R a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (R a)] [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (R a)]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (f : ∀ a, R a →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hf : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (f a)))
    (y : ∀ a, R a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (hr : 1 ≤ ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (R a)) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {ω | ∀ a, (A ω a).comp (f a) = y a} ≤

concepts.title: Finite peeling into disjoint exact-pin leaves
concepts.description:
Repeated leaf extraction partitions the retained support, leaving mass at
most delta. Every leaf retains its original mass lower bound, exact pins,
and all positive-rank relative image caps.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafExtraction
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Union

/-!
---
title: Finite peeling into disjoint exact-pin leaves
type: lemma
---
Repeated leaf extraction partitions the retained support, leaving mass at
most delta. Every leaf retains its original mass lower bound, exact pins,
and all positive-rank relative image caps.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafPartition

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.LeafExtraction
open scoped ENNReal

def Partition {Ω Axis I N : Type} [DecidableEq Ω] [Fintype Axis]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (R : Finset Ω) (δ α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (L : Finset (Finset Ω × Pin Axis I N)) : Prop :=
  (∀ z ∈ L, z.1 ⊆ R ∧ P₀.Extends z.2 ∧ (z.1 : Set Ω) ⊆ z.2.event A ∧
    δ * α ^ (z.2.rank - P₀.rank) < p.toOuterMeasure z.1 ∧ Good p A z.2 z.1 α) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ L, ∀ w ∈ L, z ≠ w → Disjoint z.1 w.1) ∧
  p.toOuterMeasure (R \ L.biUnion Prod.fst : Finset Ω) ≤ δ

axiom exists_partition {Ω Axis I N : Type}
    [DecidableEq Ω] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (R : Finset Ω) (hR : (R : Set Ω) ⊆ P₀.event A)
    (δ α : ℝ≥0∞) (hα₀ : α ≠ 0) (hαtop : α ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ L : Finset (Finset Ω × Pin Axis I N), Partition p A P₀ R δ α L

end Lax342547.LeafPartition

  (A :
    Ω →
      Axis →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)

    ∀ (δ α : ENNReal),

concepts.title: Quantitative trimming after restrictions of a leaf mixture
concepts.description:
Small retained fractions are discarded with their actual mixture weights.
The normalized surviving leaves preserve image bounds with an explicit
loss, while marginal bounds are tracked on the restricted mixed law.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Conditioning
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NNReal

/-!
---
title: Quantitative trimming after restrictions of a leaf mixture
type: lemma
---
Small retained fractions are discarded with their actual mixture weights.
The normalized surviving leaves preserve image bounds with an explicit
loss, while marginal bounds are tracked on the restricted mixed law.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LeafTrimming

open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def discardedMass {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (w q : J → ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑ j, if q j < δ then w j * q j else 0

axiom weighted_discard {J : Type} [Fintype J] (w q : J → ℝ≥0∞)
    (δ : ℝ≥0∞) (hw : ∑ j, w j ≤ 1) : discardedMass w q δ ≤ δ

axiom restricted_discard {J : Type} [Fintype J] (w q : J → ℝ≥0∞)
    (ζ η : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hw : ∑ j, w j ≤ 1)
    (hq : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(η * N)) ≤ ∑ j, w j * q j) :
    discardedMass w q ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * N))) / (∑ j, w j * q j) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((ζ - η) * N))

axiom event_after_restriction {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω)
    (S T : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (τ b : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hτ : τ ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S) (hb : p.toOuterMeasure T ≤ b) :
    (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T ≤ b / τ

axiom minentropy_after_restriction {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω)
    (S T : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (ζ : ℝ) (N t : ℕ)
    (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hSbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * N)) ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S)
    (hTbound : p.toOuterMeasure T ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * t * N))) :
    (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - 2 * ζ) * t * N))

axiom density_after_restriction {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω)
    (S : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (C ζ : ℝ) (N : ℕ)
    (hSbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * N)) ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S)
    (hp : ∀ o, p o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (C * N) * μ o) :
    ∀ o, (p.filter S hS) o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((C + ζ) * N) * μ o

axiom filtered_marginal {Ω V : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (μ : PMF V)
    (f : Ω → V) (S : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (M : ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ v, p.map f v ≤ M * μ v) :
    ∀ v, (p.filter S hS).map f v ≤ (M / p.toOuterMeasure S) * μ v

axiom combined_restriction {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (hT : ∃ o ∈ T, o ∈ (p.filter S hS).support)
    (hST : ∃ o ∈ S ∩ T, o ∈ p.support) :
    (p.filter S hS).filter T hT = p.filter (S ∩ T) hST

end Lax342547.LeafTrimming

statements.signature:
combined_restriction : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o))
  (hT : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem T o) (Set.instMembership.mem (p.filter S hS).support o))
  (hST : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem (Set.instInter.inter S T) o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)),
  Eq ((p.filter S hS).filter T hT) (p.filter (Set.instInter.inter S T) hST)

density_after_restriction : ∀ {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (C ζ : Real) (N : Nat),
  ENNReal.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul ζ N.cast)))
      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S) →
    (∀ (o : Ω),
        ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe p o)
          (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul C N.cast)) (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))) →
      ∀ (o : Ω),
        ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (p.filter S hS) o)
          (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd C ζ) N.cast)) (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))

event_after_restriction : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (τ b : ENNReal),
  ENNReal.instLE.le τ (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S) →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure T) b →
      ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T)
        (instHDiv.hDiv b τ)

filtered_marginal : ∀ {Ω V : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (μ : PMF V) (f : Ω → V) (S : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (M : ENNReal),
  (∀ (v : V), ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (PMF.map f p) v) (instHMul.hMul M (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ v))) →
    ∀ (v : V),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe (PMF.map f (p.filter S hS)) v)
        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv M (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S))
          (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ v))

minentropy_after_restriction : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (ζ : Real) (N t : Nat),
  Real.instLE.le 0 ζ →
    instLENat.le 1 t →
      ENNReal.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul ζ N.cast)))
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S) →
        ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure T)
            (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub 1 ζ) t.cast) N.cast))) →
          ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T)
            (instHPow.hPow 2
              (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHMul.hMul 2 ζ)) t.cast) N.cast)))

restricted_discard : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : Fintype J] (w q : J → ENNReal) (ζ η : Real) (N : Nat),
  ENNReal.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun j => w j) 1 →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul η N.cast)))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHMul.hMul (w j) (q j)) →
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (instHDiv.hDiv
          (Lax342547.LeafTrimming.discardedMass w q (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul ζ N.cast))))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHMul.hMul (w j) (q j)))
        (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub ζ η) N.cast)))

weighted_discard : ∀ {J : Type} [inst : Fintype J] (w q : J → ENNReal) (δ : ENNReal),
  ENNReal.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun j => w j) 1 → ENNReal.instLE.le (Lax342547.LeafTrimming.discardedMass w q δ) δ

import Lax342547.BlockDeficits

/-!
---
title: Identification of the lifted tensor sum
type: lemma
---
The abstract block addition map is exactly the sum of the individually included tensors with their actual dual restrictions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LiftedSum

open Lax342547.SpanDeficits Lax342547.BlockDeficits
open scoped BigOperators

axiom lifted_sum_apply {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K V)
    (M : ∀ i, Module.Dual K (T i) →ₗ[K] S i) (f : Module.Dual K V) :
    liftedSum S T M f = ∑ i, (M i ((T i).subtype.dualMap f)).val

end Lax342547.LiftedSum

import Lax342547.SumEnvelope
import Lax342547.MappedSpans

/-!
---
title: Actual deficits indexed by a distinct list
type: lemma

For distinct remaining indices, the finite family dimension deficit is exactly the mapped list deficit used by greedy exposure.

namespace Lax342547.ListDeficits

axiom finset_span_eq {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (I : Finset ι) :
    (⨆ i : I, S i.val) = I.sup S

axiom list_mapped_deficit {K V U ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (f : V →ₗ[K] U) (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    dimensionDeficit (fun i : l.toFinset => (S i.val).map f) = mappedDeficit S f l

concepts.title: Finite list tail statistics
concepts.description: Nonnegative decreasing finite lists extend by zero to decreasing sequences; their finite sums and dyadic tail sums agree with the actual list tails.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GreedySpans
import Lax342547.DyadicTails
import Mathlib.Data.List.Sort

/-!
---
title: Finite list tail statistics
type: lemma
---
Nonnegative decreasing finite lists extend by zero to decreasing sequences; their finite sums and dyadic tail sums agree with the actual list tails.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ListTails

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def value (l : List ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ := l[t]?.getD 0

axiom value_in_range (l : List ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < l.length) : value l t = l[t]

axiom value_out_of_range (l : List ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : l.length ≤ t) : value l t = 0

axiom value_nonneg (l : List ℝ) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 ≤ x) (t : ℕ) : 0 ≤ value l t

axiom value_antitone (l : List ℝ) (h : l.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a))
    (h0 : ∀ x ∈ l, 0 ≤ x) : Antitone (value l)

axiom value_drop (l : List ℝ) (n t : ℕ) : value (l.drop n) t = value l (n+t)

axiom sum_values (l : List ℝ) : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range l.length, value l t) = l.sum

axiom tail_sum_list (l : List ℝ) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ l.length) :
    Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailSum (value l) l.length b = (l.drop (l.length-b)).sum

end Lax342547.ListTails

  instLENat.le b l.length →
    Eq (Lax342547.DyadicTails.tailSum (Lax342547.ListTails.value l) l.length b)
      (List.drop (instHSub.hSub l.length b) l).sum

  List.Pairwise (fun a b => Real.instLE.le b a) l →
    (∀ (x : Real), List.instMembership.mem l x → Real.instLE.le 0 x) → Antitone (Lax342547.ListTails.value l)

  Eq (Lax342547.ListTails.value (List.drop n l) t) (Lax342547.ListTails.value l (instHAdd.hAdd n t))

  Eq (Lax342547.ListTails.value l t) (List.instGetElemNatLtLength.getElem l t ht)

  (∀ (x : Real), List.instMembership.mem l x → Real.instLE.le 0 x) →
    ∀ (t : Nat), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.ListTails.value l t)

concepts.title: Factorization and counting of low-rank binary matrices
concepts.description:
A rank-at-most-r matrix factors through r coordinates. Counting the two
factors gives the rectangular low-rank estimate used for binary mixer
tests, including the alternating off-diagonal block argument.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

/-!
---
title: Factorization and counting of low-rank binary matrices
type: lemma
---
A rank-at-most-r matrix factors through r coordinates. Counting the two
factors gives the rectangular low-rank estimate used for binary mixer
tests, including the alternating off-diagonal block argument.
-/

namespace Lax342547.LowRankCounting

axiom factorization {K I J : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (M : Matrix I J K) (r : ℕ) (hr : M.rank ≤ r) :
    ∃ X : Matrix I (Fin r) K, ∃ Y : Matrix (Fin r) J K, X * Y = M

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

axiom card_low_rank {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (r : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {M : Matrix I J Binary // M.rank ≤ r} ≤ 2 ^ ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J) * r)

    (r : ℕ) : (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I J Binary)).toOuterMeasure {M | M.rank ≤ r} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J) * r) / 2 ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card J)

import Lax342547.ActualDeficits

/-!
---
title: Dimension deficits after an arbitrary mode map
type: lemma
---
Actual mapped mode dimensions equal their increments modulo the map kernel; mapped span deficits therefore equal the corresponding exposure deficits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MappedSpans

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.GreedyTails
open scoped BigOperators

axiom mapped_dimension_gain {K V U : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] U) (S : Submodule K V) :
    (Module.finrank K (S.map f) : ℝ) = gain (LinearMap.ker f) S

noncomputable def mappedDeficit {K V U ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (f : V →ₗ[K] U) (l : List ι) : ℝ :=
    (l.map (fun i => (Module.finrank K ((S i).map f) : ℝ))).sum-
      Module.finrank K (l.toFinset.sup (fun i => (S i).map f) : Submodule K U)

axiom mapped_deficit_eq {K V U ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (f : V →ₗ[K] U) (l : List ι) :
    mappedDeficit S f l = deficit S (LinearMap.ker f) l

end Lax342547.MappedSpans

  (f : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V U) (l : List ι),
  Eq (Lax342547.MappedSpans.mappedDeficit S f l) (Lax342547.GreedyTails.deficit S f.ker l)

  [inst_4 : Module K U] [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional K V] (f : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V U) (S : Submodule K V),

    (Lax342547.GreedySpans.gain f.ker S)

import Lax342547.PhaseAverages

/-!
---
title: No-cover phases with whole-unit marks
type: lemma

Uniform raw channel tails transfer through an arbitrary finite unit-to-orientation marginal map, permitting tensor marks to depend on both unit endpoints while retaining the true marginal density cap.
-/

axiom no_cover_marked_unit_phase {e B N Ω U : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype Ω] [Fintype U]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix N N Binary) (ψ : (e → Matrix N N Binary) → Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p θ : ℝ)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ S, (∑ i, (S i).rank) ≤ r → ∀ x, |ψ S x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (β : U → ℝ) (image : U → e → Frame B (Fin h) N E) (L : ℝ)
    (S : U → e → Matrix N N Binary)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hβcap : ∀ o, push β image o ≤ L*weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E) o)
    (hS : ∀ o, (∑ i, (S o i).rank) ≤ r)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → N → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → N → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    |∑ o, β o*(∑ x, μ x*ψ (S o) x*tensorCharacter h (A x) (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (image o a))))| ≤
      θ+L*((r+1 : ℝ)^Fintype.card e*(2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card N*r)*
        (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card e*(h*h+2))*
        (((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(100*r+12))))/θ^(2*t)))

end Lax342547.MarkedPhase
