concepts.title: Count matching occurrences covered by terminal exceptions
concepts.description: Disjoint matching endpoints inject edges meeting the vertex exception into exceptional positions. Every remaining edge gives an ordered pair exception; the absence of k disjoint pair exceptions bounds the actual connected matching number.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MatchingSamples
import Lax342547.DisjointSampling

/-!
---
title: Count matching occurrences covered by terminal exceptions
type: lemma
---
Disjoint matching endpoints inject edges meeting the vertex exception into exceptional positions. Every remaining edge gives an ordered pair exception; the absence of k disjoint pair exceptions bounds the actual connected matching number.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MatchingCoverage

open Lax342547.ConnectedMatching Lax342547.SampledGraph Lax342547.MatchingSamples

noncomputable def meets {Ω : Type} {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (S : Ω → Prop)
    (e : Finset (Fin m)) : Prop := ∃ v ∈ e, S (sample v)

axiom matching_meets_bound {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → Ω) (S : Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M) : by
      classical
      exact (M.filter (meets sample S)).card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => S (sample v))).card

axiom matching_pair_embedding {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → Ω) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M)
    (hE : ∀ e : M, E (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).1
      (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ M.card) :
    ∃ a : Fin k × Bool ↪ Fin m, ∀ j, E (sample (a (j,false))) (sample (a (j,true)))

axiom matching_exception_bound {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → Ω) (S : Ω → Prop) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M) (k : ℕ)
    (hcover : ∀ e : M,
      S (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).1 ∨
      S (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).2 ∨
      E (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).1 (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).2)
    (hS : by classical exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => S (sample v))).card < k)
    (hE : ¬ ∃ a : Fin k × Bool ↪ Fin m, ∀ j, E (sample (a (j,false))) (sample (a (j,true)))) :
    M.card ≤ 2*(k-1)

axiom connected_matching_exception_bound {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : ℕ}
    (sample : Fin m → Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (hgood : ∀ M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)), IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M →
      M.card ≤ 2*(k-1)) (hscale : 200*(k-1) < m) :
    100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) < m

end Lax342547.MatchingCoverage

statements.signature:
connected_matching_exception_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y : Ω⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : Nat} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (k : Nat),
  (∀ (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
      Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.IsTouchingMatching (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M →
        instLENat.le M.card (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHSub.hSub k 1))) →
    instLTNat.lt (instHMul.hMul 200 (instHSub.hSub k 1)) m →
      instLTNat.lt
        (instHMul.hMul 100
          (Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.connectedMatchingNumber (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample)))
        m

matching_exception_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y : Ω⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : Nat} (sample : Fin m → Ω)
  (S : Ω → Prop) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
  (hM : Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.IsTouchingMatching (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M)
  (k : Nat),
  (∀ (e : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem M x),
      Or (S (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).fst)
        (Or (S (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).snd)
          (E (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).fst
            (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).snd))) →
    instLTNat.lt (Finset.filter (fun v => S (sample v)) Finset.univ).card k →
      Not
          (Exists fun a =>
            ∀ (j : Fin k),
              E (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.false }))
                (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.true }))) →
        instLENat.le M.card (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHSub.hSub k 1))

matching_meets_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y : Ω⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : Nat} (sample : Fin m → Ω)
  (S : Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m))),
  Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.IsTouchingMatching (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M →
    instLENat.le (Finset.filter (Lax342547.MatchingCoverage.meets sample S) M).card
      (Finset.filter (fun v => S (sample v)) Finset.univ).card

matching_pair_embedding : ∀ {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y : Ω⦄, hole x y → hole y x) {m : Nat} (sample : Fin m → Ω)
  (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
  (hM : Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.IsTouchingMatching (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M),
  (∀ (e : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem M x),
      E (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).fst
        (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.unitType sample e.val ⋯).snd) →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      instLENat.le k M.card →
        Exists fun a =>
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            E (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.false }))
              (sample (Function.instFunLikeEmbedding.coe a { fst := j, snd := Bool.true }))

import Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
import Lax342547.CliqueMinor

/-!
---
title: Clique minors from connected matchings
type: theorem
---
Every finite graph satisfies $3h(G)\le |V(G)|+4\mathrm{cm}(G)+2$.
This is Proposition 3.5 of the source paper, written with integer coefficients.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MatchingMinorBound

open ConnectedMatching CliqueMinor

axiom hadwiger_matching_bound {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    3 * hadwigerNumber G ≤ Fintype.card V + 4 * connectedMatchingNumber G + 2

end Lax342547.MatchingMinorBound

  instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 3 (Lax342547.CliqueMinor.hadwigerNumber G))

concepts.title: Matching occurrences and raw unit types
concepts.description: Every touching matching has an injective orientation on sample positions. Its raw unit types form an independent conflict set even when different matching edges have identical raw types.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SampledGraph
import Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin

/-!
---
title: Matching occurrences and raw unit types
type: lemma
---
Every touching matching has an injective orientation on sample positions. Its raw unit types form an independent conflict set even when different matching edges have identical raw types.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MatchingSamples

open Lax342547.ConnectedMatching Lax342547.SampledGraph

noncomputable def oriented {V : Type} (e : Finset V) (he : e.card = 2) : Bool → V :=
  fun b => ((e.equivFinOfCardEq he).symm (if b then 1 else 0)).val

axiom oriented_mem {V : Type} (e : Finset V) (he : e.card = 2) (b : Bool) : oriented e he b ∈ e

axiom oriented_injective {V : Type} (e : Finset V) (he : e.card = 2) : Function.Injective (oriented e he)

axiom oriented_covers {V : Type} (e : Finset V) (he : e.card = 2) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ e) :
    ∃ b, oriented e he b = v

axiom matching_orientation_injective {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (M : Finset (Finset V))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching G M) :
    Function.Injective (fun eb : M × Bool => oriented eb.1.val (hM.1 _ eb.1.property).1 eb.2)

axiom matching_unit_independence {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) (hloop : ∀ x, ¬ hole x x)
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M) :
    ∀ e f : M, ¬ (∀ i j : Bool,
      hole (sample (oriented e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1 i))
        (sample (oriented f.val (hM.1 _ f.property).1 j)))

noncomputable def unitType {Ω : Type} {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω)
    (e : Finset (Fin m)) (he : e.card = 2) : Ω × Ω :=
  (sample (oriented e he false),sample (oriented e he true))

def fourConflict {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (u v : Ω × Ω) : Prop :=
  hole u.1 v.1 ∧ hole u.1 v.2 ∧ hole u.2 v.1 ∧ hole u.2 v.2

axiom matching_unit_is_unit {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x)
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M) (e : M) :
    ¬ hole (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).1
      (unitType sample e.val (hM.1 _ e.property).1).2

axiom unit_types_independent {Ω : Type} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) (hloop : ∀ x, ¬ hole x x)
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) (M : Finset (Finset (Fin m)))
    (hM : IsTouchingMatching (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) M) : by

        (∀ u ∈ I, ¬ hole u.1 u.2) ∧ (∀ u ∈ I, ∀ v ∈ I, ¬ fourConflict hole u v)

concepts.title: Finite metadata and exact-image records for additional pins
concepts.description:
A coefficient choice determines finitely many nominal subspaces. A split
record contains that choice and all prescribed images on those spaces.
Its fiber fixes the new pins and can be joined to the previous pins.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ExactPins
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Finite.Matrix
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite

/-!
---
title: Finite metadata and exact-image records for additional pins
type: lemma
---
A coefficient choice determines finitely many nominal subspaces. A split
record contains that choice and all prescribed images on those spaces.
Its fiber fixes the new pins and can be joined to the previous pins.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MetadataPins

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins

def Images {Axis I : Type} (N : Type) (S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) :=
  ∀ a, S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)

noncomputable instance {Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) : Fintype (Images N S) := by
  classical
  let : ∀ a, Finite (S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) := fun a =>
    Finite.of_injective (fun f : S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) => (f : S a → N → Binary))
      DFunLike.coe_injective
  exact Fintype.ofFinite (∀ a, S a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))

def Key {J Axis I : Type} (N : Type) (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) :=
  Σ j, Images N (S j)

noncomputable instance {J Axis I N : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) : Fintype (Key N S) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Σ j, Images N (S j)))

def record {Ω J Axis I N : Type}
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (choice : Ω → J)
    (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (o : Ω) : Key N S :=
  ⟨choice o, fun a => (A o a).comp (S (choice o) a).subtype⟩

def pin {J Axis I N : Type} {S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)}
    (k : Key N S) : Pin Axis I N := ⟨S k.1, k.2⟩

axiom image_count {Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (S : Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) :
    Nat.card (Images N S) = 2 ^ ((∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (S a)) * Fintype.card N)

axiom key_count {J Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype J] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (S j a) ≤ u) :
    Nat.card (Key N S) ≤ Fintype.card J * 2 ^ (u * Fintype.card N)

axiom refined_fiber {Ω J Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (choice : Ω → J)
    (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (S j a) ≤ u)
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (R : Set Ω) (hR : R ⊆ P₀.event A) (o : Ω) (ho : o ∈ R) :
    ∃ P : Pin Axis I N, P₀.Extends P ∧ (pin (record A choice S o)).Extends P ∧
      P.rank ≤ P₀.rank + u ∧
      R ∩ {x | record A choice S x = record A choice S o} ⊆ P.event A

end Lax342547.MetadataPins

image_count : ∀ {Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  (S : Axis → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (Nat.card (Lax342547.MetadataPins.Images N S))
    (instHPow.hPow 2
      (instHMul.hMul
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S a) x))
        (Fintype.card N)))

key_count : ∀ {J Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [inst_3 : Fintype N]
  (S : J → Axis → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)) (u : Nat),
  (∀ (j : J),
      instLENat.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S j a) x))
        u) →
    instLENat.le (Nat.card (Lax342547.MetadataPins.Key N S))
      (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card J) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul u (Fintype.card N))))

refined_fiber : ∀ {Ω J Axis I N : Type} [inst : Fintype Axis] [Fintype I]
  (A :
    Ω →
      Axis →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (choice : Ω → J) (S : J → Axis → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)) (u : Nat),
  (∀ (j : J),
      instLENat.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
          Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S j a) x))
        u) →
    ∀ (P₀ : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin Axis I N) (R : Set Ω),
      Set.instLE.le R (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P₀) →
        ∀ (o : Ω),
          Set.instMembership.mem R o →
            Exists fun P =>
              And (P₀.Extends P)
                (And ((Lax342547.MetadataPins.pin (Lax342547.MetadataPins.record A choice S o)).Extends P)
                  (And (instLENat.le P.rank (instHAdd.hAdd P₀.rank u))
                    (Set.instLE.le
                      (Set.instInter.inter R
                        (Set.ofPred fun x =>
                          Eq (Lax342547.MetadataPins.record A choice S x) (Lax342547.MetadataPins.record A choice S o)))
                      (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P))))

concepts.title: Compatibility and codimension of forward/reverse matrix restrictions
concepts.description:
The overlap calculation in Lemma 5.5: prescribing ZᵀL and LW imposes
exactly the common ZᵀLW block of compatibility conditions when Z and W
have independent columns. This statement includes zero column ranks.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions

/-!
---
title: Compatibility and codimension of forward/reverse matrix restrictions
type: lemma
---
The overlap calculation in Lemma 5.5: prescribing ZᵀL and LW imposes
exactly the common ZᵀLW block of compatibility conditions when Z and W
have independent columns. This statement includes zero column ranks.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MixerCompatibility

variable {K I E F : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I] [Fintype E] [Fintype F]

def restrictions (Z : Matrix I E K) (W : Matrix I F K) :
    Matrix I I K →ₗ[K] Matrix E I K × Matrix I F K where
  toFun L := (Z.transpose * L, L * W)
  map_add' L M := by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  map_smul' c L := by simp [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

def compatibility (Z : Matrix I E K) (W : Matrix I F K) :
    (Matrix E I K × Matrix I F K) →ₗ[K] Matrix E F K where
  toFun p := p.1 * W - Z.transpose * p.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, add_sub_add_comm]
  map_smul' c x := by simp [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_sub]

axiom compatible_extensions (Z : Matrix I E K) (W : Matrix I F K)
    (hZ : Function.Injective Z.mulVec) (hW : Function.Injective W.mulVec)
    (A : Matrix E I K) (B : Matrix I F K) :
    (∃ L : Matrix I I K, Z.transpose * L = A ∧ L * W = B) ↔ A * W = Z.transpose * B

axiom restrictions_codimension (Z : Matrix I E K) (W : Matrix I F K)
    (hZ : Function.Injective Z.mulVec) (hW : Function.Injective W.mulVec) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (restrictions Z W)) + Fintype.card E * Fintype.card F =
      Fintype.card E * Fintype.card I + Fintype.card I * Fintype.card F

end Lax342547.MixerCompatibility

statements.signature:
compatible_extensions : ∀ {K I E F : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype E] [inst_3 : Fintype F] (Z : Matrix I E K)
  (W : Matrix I F K),
  Function.Injective Z.mulVec →
    Function.Injective W.mulVec →
      ∀ (A : Matrix E I K) (B : Matrix I F K),
        Iff
          (Exists fun L =>
            And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul Z.transpose L) A)
              (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul L W) B))
          (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A W)
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul Z.transpose B))

restrictions_codimension : ∀ {K I E F : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype E] [inst_3 : Fintype F] (Z : Matrix I E K)
  (W : Matrix I F K),
  Function.Injective Z.mulVec →
    Function.Injective W.mulVec →
      Eq
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (Module.finrank K
            (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.MixerCompatibility.restrictions Z W).range x))
          (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card E) (Fintype.card F)))
        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card E) (Fintype.card I))
          (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card F)))

concepts.title: The distribution of mixer rows on free directions
concepts.description:
For a uniform matrix L, the joint observations ZᵀLD and DᵀLW have
density at most 2^(rank(Z) rank(W)) relative to the completely uniform
list, when Z,W,D have independent columns. This is the single-matrix
domination bound in the proof of Lemma 5.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MixerCompatibility
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

/-!
---
title: The distribution of mixer rows on free directions
type: lemma
---
For a uniform matrix L, the joint observations ZᵀLD and DᵀLW have
density at most 2^(rank(Z) rank(W)) relative to the completely uniform
list, when Z,W,D have independent columns. This is the single-matrix
domination bound in the proof of Lemma 5.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MixerRowLaw

variable {K I E F N : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I]

def directions (D : Matrix I N K) :
    (Matrix E I K × Matrix I F K) →ₗ[K] (Matrix E N K × Matrix N F K) where
  toFun p := (p.1 * D, D.transpose * p.2)
  map_add' x y := by simp [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add]
  map_smul' c x := by simp [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul]

def observations (Z : Matrix I E K) (W : Matrix I F K) (D : Matrix I N K) :
    Matrix I I K →ₗ[K] (Matrix E N K × Matrix N F K) :=
  (directions D).comp (MixerCompatibility.restrictions Z W)

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped ENNReal

axiom row_law_bound {I E F N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq E] [DecidableEq F] [DecidableEq N]
    (Z : Matrix I E Binary) (W : Matrix I F Binary) (D : Matrix I N Binary)
    (hZ : Function.Injective Z.mulVec) (hW : Function.Injective W.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (y : Matrix E N Binary × Matrix N F Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Binary)).map (observations Z W D) y ≤
      2 ^ (Fintype.card E * Fintype.card F) * PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix E N Binary × Matrix N F Binary) y

end Lax342547.MixerRowLaw

statements.signature:
row_law_bound : ∀ {I E F N : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [inst_3 : Fintype N]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq E] [inst_6 : DecidableEq F] [inst_7 : DecidableEq N]
  (Z : Matrix I E Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (W : Matrix I F Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D : Matrix I N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective Z.mulVec →
    Function.Injective W.mulVec →
      Function.Injective D.mulVec →
        ∀ (y : Prod (Matrix E N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N F Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
          ENNReal.instLE.le
            (PMF.instFunLike.coe
              (PMF.map (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.MixerRowLaw.observations Z W D))
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
              y)
            (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card E) (Fintype.card F)))
              (PMF.instFunLike.coe
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype
                  (Prod (Matrix E N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix N F Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
                y))

concepts.title: Actual-mass recovery and residual bounds through finite splits
concepts.description:
Finite mixture event masses retain their original weights. Successive
conditional parts recover the combined restriction exactly. Relative
residual budgets on split fibers sum to the same global budget.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Conditioning

/-!
---
title: Actual-mass recovery and residual bounds through finite splits
type: lemma
---
Finite mixture event masses retain their original weights. Successive
conditional parts recover the combined restriction exactly. Relative
residual budgets on split fibers sum to the same global budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MixtureRecovery

open scoped ENNReal

axiom mixture_event {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype J]
    (p : J → PMF Ω) (q : PMF Ω) (w : J → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hq : ∀ o, q o = ∑ j, w j * p j o) (S : Set Ω) :
    q.toOuterMeasure S = ∑ j, w j * (p j).toOuterMeasure S

axiom nested_weighted_filter {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (hT : ∃ o ∈ T, o ∈ (p.filter S hS).support) (o : Ω) :
    p.toOuterMeasure S * (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T * ((p.filter S hS).filter T hT) o =
      (S ∩ T).indicator p o

axiom conditional_event_mass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω)
    (S T : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (hT : T ⊆ S)
    (δ : ℝ≥0∞) (hb : (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T ≤ δ) :
    p.toOuterMeasure T ≤ δ * p.toOuterMeasure S

axiom fiber_residual {Ω K : Type} [Fintype K] (p : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → K)
    (R : K → Set Ω) (τ δ : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hr : ∀ k, τ ≤ p.toOuterMeasure {o | f o = k} →
      p.toOuterMeasure (R k) ≤ δ * p.toOuterMeasure {o | f o = k}) :
    p.toOuterMeasure ({o | p.toOuterMeasure {x | f x = f o} < τ} ∪
        {o | τ ≤ p.toOuterMeasure {x | f x = f o} ∧ o ∈ R (f o)}) ≤
      p.toOuterMeasure {o | p.toOuterMeasure {x | f x = f o} < τ} + δ

end Lax342547.MixtureRecovery

statements.signature:
conditional_event_mass : ∀ {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)),
  Set.instLE.le T S →
    ∀ (δ : ENNReal),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T) δ →
        ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure T)
          (instHMul.hMul δ (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S))

fiber_residual : ∀ {Ω K : Type} [Fintype K] (p : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → K) (R : K → Set Ω) (τ δ : ENNReal),
  (∀ (k : K),
      ENNReal.instLE.le τ
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Set.ofPred fun o => Eq (f o) k)) →
        ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (R k))
          (instHMul.hMul δ
            (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Set.ofPred fun o => Eq (f o) k)))) →
    ENNReal.instLE.le
      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
        (Set.instUnion.union
          (Set.ofPred fun o =>
            ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
              (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
                (Set.ofPred fun x => Eq (f x) (f o)))
              τ)
          (Set.ofPred fun o =>
            And
              (ENNReal.instLE.le τ
                (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
                  (Set.ofPred fun x => Eq (f x) (f o))))
              (Set.instMembership.mem (R (f o)) o))))
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
          (Set.ofPred fun o =>
            ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
              (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
                (Set.ofPred fun x => Eq (f x) (f o)))
              τ))
        δ)

mixture_event : ∀ {Ω J : Type} [Fintype Ω] [inst : Fintype J] (p : J → PMF Ω) (q : PMF Ω) (w : J → ENNReal),
  (∀ (o : Ω),
      Eq (PMF.instFunLike.coe q o) (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHMul.hMul (w j) (PMF.instFunLike.coe (p j) o))) →
    ∀ (S : Set Ω),
      Eq (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe q.toOuterMeasure S)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
          instHMul.hMul (w j) (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p j).toOuterMeasure S))

nested_weighted_filter : ∀ {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o))
  (hT : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem T o) (Set.instMembership.mem (p.filter S hS).support o)) (o : Ω),
  Eq
    (instHMul.hMul
      (instHMul.hMul (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S)
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T))
      (PMF.instFunLike.coe ((p.filter S hS).filter T hT) o))
    ((Set.instInter.inter S T).indicator (PMF.instFunLike.coe p) o)

concepts.title: Exposed mode dimension budget
concepts.description: The span of any subset of rank-bounded mode spaces has dimension at most the single-space budget times the full sample size.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ListDeficits

/-!
---
title: Exposed mode dimension budget
type: lemma
---
The span of any subset of rank-bounded mode spaces has dimension at most the single-space budget times the full sample size.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ModeBudgets

open scoped BigOperators

axiom mode_span_budget {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hS : ∀ i, (Module.finrank K (S i) : ℝ) ≤ r) (I : Finset ι) :
    (Module.finrank K (I.sup S : Submodule K V) : ℝ) ≤ r*Fintype.card ι

end Lax342547.ModeBudgets

mode_span_budget : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_4 : Module K V]

Natural-number power identities prove the finite exponential moment budget and fixed dyadic parameter choices, retaining the ambient sample-size margin.

    (hP : (2+a)*s+Γ*N+1 ≤ P*q) (hh : a*s+Γ*N+1 ≤ h*R) :

import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Recovery of low-rank Boolean moments from low degrees
type: lemma
---
The rank obstruction in the second half of Lemma 5.2. A first nonzero
selector moment of degree d produces an identity submatrix of size
binomial(d, floor(d/2)). Consequently a Boolean moment matrix of rank at
most r vanishes if all its moments of degree at most r vanish.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MomentRecovery

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def IsSelectorHankel {Base : Type} {b degree : ℕ}
    (w : Matrix (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base)
      (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base) Binary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (S T U V : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (i j : Base),
    S.val ∪ T.val = U.val ∪ V.val → w (S, i) (T, j) = w (U, i) (V, j)

axiom eq_zero_of_rank_le {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree r : ℕ}
    (w : Matrix (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base)
      (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base) Binary)
    (hH : IsSelectorHankel w) (hrank : w.rank ≤ r)
    (hlow : ∀ (S T : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (i j : Base),
      (S.val ∪ T.val).card ≤ r → w (S, i) (T, j) = 0) : w = 0

axiom eq_of_agree_low {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] {b degree r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
    (w v : Matrix (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base)
      (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base) Binary)
    (hw : IsSelectorHankel w) (hv : IsSelectorHankel v)
    (hrw : w.rank ≤ r₁) (hrv : v.rank ≤ r₂)
    (hlow : ∀ (S T : SelectorCoordinates b degree) (i j : Base),
      (S.val ∪ T.val).card ≤ r₁ + r₂ → w (S, i) (T, j) = v (S, i) (T, j)) : w = v

end Lax342547.MomentRecovery

  (w v :
    Matrix (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) Base)
      (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) Base) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Lax342547.MomentRecovery.IsSelectorHankel w →
    Lax342547.MomentRecovery.IsSelectorHankel v →
      instLENat.le w.rank r₁ →
        instLENat.le v.rank r₂ →
          (∀ (S T : Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (i j : Base),
              instLENat.le (Finset.instUnion.union S.val T.val).card (instHAdd.hAdd r₁ r₂) →
                Eq (w { fst := S, snd := i } { fst := T, snd := j })
                  (v { fst := S, snd := i } { fst := T, snd := j })) →
            Eq w v

  (w :
    Matrix (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) Base)
      (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) Base) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

concepts.title: Boolean point moments with restricted base coordinates
concepts.description:
The selector evaluations and the constant/base coordinates of §2.3.
Keeping the selector evaluation map as a parameter lets the coordinate
projection arguments apply at every selector degree.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.BilinearForm
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset

/-!
---
title: Boolean point moments with restricted base coordinates
type: definition
---
The selector evaluations and the constant/base coordinates of §2.3.
Keeping the selector evaluation map as a parameter lets the coordinate
projection arguments apply at every selector degree.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MomentSpace

abbrev Binary := ZMod 2

def SelectorCoordinates (b degree : ℕ) :=
  {S : Finset (Fin b) // S.card ≤ degree}

instance (b degree : ℕ) : Fintype (SelectorCoordinates b degree) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype {S : Finset (Fin b) // S.card ≤ degree})

instance (b degree : ℕ) : DecidableEq (SelectorCoordinates b degree) :=
  inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq {S : Finset (Fin b) // S.card ≤ degree})

def selectorEval {b degree : ℕ} (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (c : SelectorCoordinates b degree) : Binary := ∏ i ∈ c.val, s i

variable {Label Coord Base : Type}

def baseEval (z : Base → Binary) : Option Base → Binary
  | none => 1
  | some i => z i

def point (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) (z : Base → Binary)
    (i : Coord × Option Base) : Binary := p s i.1 * baseEval z i.2

def pointMoment (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) (z : Base → Binary) :
    Matrix (Coord × Option Base) (Coord × Option Base) Binary :=
  fun i j => point p s z i * point p s z j

def momentSpace (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (A : Set Base) :
    Submodule Binary (Matrix (Coord × Option Base) (Coord × Option Base) Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary {w | ∃ s z, (∀ i, i ∉ A → z i = 0) ∧ w = pointMoment p s z}

def allowed (A : Set Base) (i : Coord × Option Base) : Prop :=
  match i.2 with
  | none => True
  | some b => b ∈ A

noncomputable def mask (A : Set Base) (i : Coord × Option Base) : Binary :=
  by classical exact if allowed A i then 1 else 0

noncomputable def project (A : Set Base) :
    Matrix (Coord × Option Base) (Coord × Option Base) Binary →ₗ[Binary]
      Matrix (Coord × Option Base) (Coord × Option Base) Binary where
  toFun w i j := mask A i * w i j * mask A j
  map_add' w v := by
    ext i j
    change mask A i * (w i j + v i j) * mask A j =
      mask A i * w i j * mask A j + mask A i * v i j * mask A j
    simp [mul_add, add_mul]
  map_smul' c w := by
    ext i j
    change mask A i * (c * w i j) * mask A j = c * (mask A i * w i j * mask A j)
    simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

noncomputable def eraseBase (A : Set Base) (z : Base → Binary) (i : Base) : Binary :=
  by classical exact if i ∈ A then z i else 0

end Lax342547.MomentSpace

concepts.description: Finite Markov bounds and the low-rank/high-rank decomposition preserve the actual sample masses and explicit channel rank exponent.

import Lax342547.FiniteMoments

/-!
---
title: Finite moment probability and rank split
type: lemma
---
Finite Markov bounds and the low-rank/high-rank decomposition preserve the actual sample masses and explicit channel rank exponent.
-/

namespace Lax342547.MomentTails

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom finite_moment_markov {C : Type} [Fintype C] (ν : C → ℝ) (f : C → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hν : ∀ c, 0 ≤ ν c) (ha : 0 < a) :
    cellMass ν (fun c => a ≤ |f c|) ≤ (∑ c, ν c*|f c|^n)/a^n

axiom rank_moment_split {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (rank : Ω → ℕ) (h R : ℕ) (hμ : Probability μ) :
    (∑ x, μ x/(2 : ℝ)^(h*rank x)) ≤
      cellMass μ (fun x => rank x < R)+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*R)

end Lax342547.MomentTails

    Real.instLT.lt 0 a →
      Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ν fun c => Real.instLE.le a (abs (f c)))
        (instHDiv.hDiv (Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (ν c) (instHPow.hPow (abs (f c)) n)) (instHPow.hPow a n))

  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →

      (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x => instLTNat.lt (rank x) R)
        (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul h R))))

concepts.title: A low rank sum supplies an actual adaptive cover
concepts.description: The complete deterministic greedy exposure proof turns a low rank sum into disjoint exposed and covered index sets, with the cover determined by the exposed column and row spans.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedCounts
import Lax342547.ExposedSums
import Lax342547.FilterOccurrences
import Lax342547.CoverCounts

/-!
---
title: A low rank sum supplies an actual adaptive cover
type: lemma
---
The complete deterministic greedy exposure proof turns a low rank sum into disjoint exposed and covered index sets, with the cover determined by the exposed column and row spans.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NoCoverCertificate

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.GreedyTails Lax342547.CoverProjection
open scoped BigOperators

axiom low_rank_cover_certificate {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (r : ℝ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hM : ∀ i, (Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M i)) : ℝ) ≤ r)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 2^k) (hnk : n ≤ k) (hn : 16*r < n)
    (hlow : (Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ i, M i)) : ℝ) < (2^(k-n) : ℝ)/4) :
    ∃ E J : Finset ι, Disjoint E J ∧ 2^(k-n) ≤ J.card ∧
      ∀ j ∈ J, projection (M j) (E.sup (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i)))
        (E.sup (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap)) = 0

end Lax342547.NoCoverCertificate

  [inst_5 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_6 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
  (M : ι → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W) (r : Real) (k n : Nat),
  (∀ (i : ι), Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M i).range x)).cast r) →
    Eq (Fintype.card ι) (instHPow.hPow 2 k) →
      instLENat.le n k →
        Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 16 r) n.cast →
          Real.instLT.lt
              (Module.finrank K
                  (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i).range x)).cast
              (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k n)) 4) →
            Exists fun E =>
              Exists fun J =>
                And (Disjoint E J)
                  (And (instLENat.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k n)) J.card)
                    (∀ (j : ι),
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem J j →
                        Eq
                          (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection (M j) (E.sup fun i => (M i).range)
                            (E.sup fun i => (M i).dualMap.range))
                          0))

import Lax342547.ComponentMoments
import Lax342547.IndexedRankGrowth

/-!
---
title: No-cover phase moments
type: lemma
---
Actual componentwise binary channel moments and phase-tail bounds from finite rank growth, under the explicit small-cover exclusion.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NoCoverMoments

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.ChannelCharacters Lax342547.TensorCharacters Lax342547.ComponentSpaces
open Lax342547.ComponentDuals Lax342547.CoverProjection
open scoped BigOperators

axiom sum_matrix_rank {I J ι : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix I J Binary) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (∑ i, (A i).mulVecLin)) = (∑ i, A i).rank

axiom no_cover_even_moment {e I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → I → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → J → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw) c*
      |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (A x) c|^(2*t)) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(100*r+12)))

axiom no_cover_phase_tail {e I J Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix I J Binary) (ψ : Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → I → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → J → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw))
      (fun c => θ ≤ |∑ x, μ x*ψ x*tensorCharacter h (A x) c|) ≤
      ((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(100*r+12))))/θ^(2*t)

end Lax342547.NoCoverMoments

import Lax342547.PhaseAverages

/-!

title: Actual no-cover phase cancellation under marginal density
type: lemma
---
Averaging over the actual opposite orientation and its bounded-rank tensor target combines the uniform raw tail and density cap to give the full finite no-cover correlation bound.
-/

axiom no_cover_phase_average {e B N Ω : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix N N Binary) (ψ : (e → Matrix N N Binary) → Ω → ℝ) (r h t k : ℕ) (p θ : ℝ)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ S, (∑ i, (S i).rank) ≤ r → ∀ x, |ψ S x| ≤ 1)
    (hsize : 2*t = 2^k) (hk : 100*r+12 ≤ k) (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (β : (e → Frame B (Fin h) N E) → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (S : (e → Frame B (Fin h) N E) → e → Matrix N N Binary)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hβcap : ∀ o, β o ≤ L*weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E) o)
    (hS : ∀ o, (∑ i, (S o i).rank) ≤ r)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → N → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → N → Binary)),
      Componentwise S → DualComponentwise T →
      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(2*t) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    |∑ o, β o*(∑ x, μ x*ψ (S o) x*tensorCharacter h (A x) (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (o a))))| ≤
      θ+L*((r+1 : ℝ)^Fintype.card e*(2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card N*r)*
        (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card e*(h*h+2))*
        (((4 : ℝ)^(2*t)*p^(2^(k-(100*r+10)))+1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*2^(k-(100*r+12))))/θ^(2*t)))

end Lax342547.NoCoverPhase

concepts.title: Rank growth without an adaptive mode cover
concepts.description: Actual low rank sums force a cover based on exposed indices; conditioning on those indices and taking the finite union yields a checked no-cover probability bound for any join-stable cover classes.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.NoCoverCertificate
import Lax342547.CoverClasses
import Lax342547.AdaptiveUnion

/-!
---
title: Rank growth without an adaptive mode cover
type: lemma
---
Actual low rank sums force a cover based on exposed indices; conditioning on those indices and taking the finite union yields a checked no-cover probability bound for any join-stable cover classes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NoCoverRank

open Lax342547.CoverProjection Lax342547.CoverClasses
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

axiom no_cover_rank_probability {K V W ι Ω : Type} [Field K]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype Ω]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (M : Ω → V →ₗ[K] W) (P : Submodule K W → Prop)
    (Q : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V) → Prop) (r p : ℝ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hM : ∀ x, (Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M x)) : ℝ) ≤ r)
    (hP : JoinClosed P) (hQ : JoinClosed Q)
    (hPC : ∀ x, P (LinearMap.range (M x))) (hQR : ∀ x, Q (LinearMap.range (M x).dualMap))
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 2^k) (hnk : n ≤ k) (hn : 16*r < n)
    (hcover : ∀ S T, P S → Q T →
      (Module.finrank K S : ℝ) ≤ r*Fintype.card ι →
      (Module.finrank K T : ℝ) ≤ r*Fintype.card ι →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (M x) S T = 0) ≤ p) :
    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ))
      (fun sample => (Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ i, M (sample i))) : ℝ) < (2^(k-n) : ℝ)/4) ≤
      (4 : ℝ)^Fintype.card ι*p^(2^(k-n))

end Lax342547.NoCoverRank

concepts.title: The 3K+28 baseline bound in the actual nominal coordinates
concepts.description:
For the two stored pin spaces and independent primal key spaces, complete
one cross form while retaining all frozen entries and the whole table.
Both reciprocal primal-to-channel maps have rank at most 3K+28. The same
form satisfies both bounds, so no independent completions are silently
used for its two endpoint roles.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.NominalPrimal
import Lax342547.SmallTables

/-!
---
title: The 3K+28 baseline bound in the actual nominal coordinates
type: lemma
---
For the two stored pin spaces and independent primal key spaces, complete
one cross form while retaining all frozen entries and the whole table.
Both reciprocal primal-to-channel maps have rank at most 3K+28. The same
form satisfies both bounds, so no independent completions are silently
used for its two endpoint roles.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NominalBaselines

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.FrozenBaselines

axiom nominal_baseline {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a b : Comp × Bool)
    (Keys Keys' : Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary)) (K : ℕ)
    (hP : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K)
    (hkey : Keys ≤ primal) (hkey' : Keys' ≤ primal)
    (hcard : Module.finrank Binary Keys ≤ 28) (hcard' : Module.finrank Binary Keys' ≤ 28)
    (hfresh : Disjoint (tableSpace P a) Keys) (hfresh' : Disjoint (tableSpace Q b) Keys')
    (A : ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary]
      ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (T : tableSpace P a →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace Q b →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (h : Compatible (tableSpace P a) (P.space a) (tableSpace Q b) (Q.space b) A T) :
    ∃ F : ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary]
        ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      ExtendsFrozen (P.space a) Keys (Q.space b) Keys' A F ∧
      (∀ v : tableSpace P a, ∀ w : tableSpace Q b, F v.val w.val = T v w) ∧
      ∀ z : Fin 2,
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range
          (F.compl₁₂ (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range
          (F.flip.compl₁₂ (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28

end Lax342547.NominalBaselines

concepts.title: Primal blocks of the nominal spaces and their bounded table part
concepts.description:
The combined primal space has zero channel coordinates. Its intersection
with a table space has dimension at most twice the total pin rank, while
the table together with the primal space spans every nominal coordinate.
A family of at most twenty-eight key directions costs at most twenty-eight
more dimensions, independently of the ambient channel dimension.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TableSpaces
import Lax342547.BaselineRank

/-!
---
title: Primal blocks of the nominal spaces and their bounded table part
type: lemma
---
The combined primal space has zero channel coordinates. Its intersection
with a table space has dimension at most twice the total pin rank, while
the table together with the primal space spans every nominal coordinate.
A family of at most twenty-eight key directions costs at most twenty-eight
more dimensions, independently of the ambient channel dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NominalPrimal

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces

variable {Comp B H N : Type}

def primal : Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) where
  carrier := {v | ∀ i h, v (i, Sum.inr h) = 0}
  zero_mem' := by intro i h; rfl
  add_mem' := by intro v w hv hw i h; change v (i, Sum.inr h) + w (i, Sum.inr h) = 0; rw [hv, hw, add_zero]
  smul_mem' := by intro c v hv i h; change c * v (i, Sum.inr h) = 0; rw [hv, mul_zero]

def keySpace {I : Type} (endpoint : I → Fin 2) (ray : I → B → Binary) :
    Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (fun x => primalEmbedding (endpoint x) (ray x)))

axiom table_spans (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    tableSpace P a ⊔ primal = ⊤

axiom table_primal_dimension [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Module.finrank Binary ↥(tableSpace P a ⊓ primal) ≤ 2 * P.rank

axiom key_space_bound {I : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (endpoint : I → Fin 2) (ray : I → B → Binary) :
    keySpace (H := H) endpoint ray ≤ primal ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (keySpace (H := H) endpoint ray) ≤ Fintype.card I

end Lax342547.NominalPrimal

  (ray : I → B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  And (Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.NominalPrimal.keySpace endpoint ray) Lax342547.NominalPrimal.primal)
    (instLENat.le
      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.NominalPrimal.keySpace endpoint ray) x))
      (Fintype.card I))

  (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N) (a : Prod Comp Bool),
  instLENat.le
    (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
      (Subtype fun x =>
        SetLike.instMembership.mem
          (Submodule.instMin.min (Lax342547.TableSpaces.tableSpace P a) Lax342547.NominalPrimal.primal) x))
    (instHMul.hMul 2 P.rank)

  Eq (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max (Lax342547.TableSpaces.tableSpace P a) Lax342547.NominalPrimal.primal)
    Submodule.instTop.top

concepts.title: Pure corrections realized by actual nonlinear channel products
concepts.description: Low-rank baseline values use the combined primal space. Orthogonal private factors add the desired pure form to the channel product while retaining the entire derivative response. The paper margin provides sufficient channel capacity. These changes retain their barred domains and permitted perpendicular outputs.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TargetMatrices

/-!
---
title: Pure corrections realized by actual nonlinear channel products
type: lemma
---
Low-rank baseline values use the combined primal space. Orthogonal private factors add the desired pure form to the channel product while retaining the entire derivative response. The paper margin provides sufficient channel capacity. These changes retain their barred domains and permitted perpendicular outputs.
-/

namespace Lax342547.NonlinearChannels

open Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.ChannelChanges
open Lax342547.ResponseMatrices Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

noncomputable def primalValues {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Nominal B H)) (z : Fin 2) :
    primal (B := B) (H := H) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact dualCoordinates.comp (F.compl₁₂ primal.subtype (channelEmbedding z))

axiom primal_values_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Nominal B H)) (z : Fin 2) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (primalValues F z)) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (F.compl₁₂ primal.subtype (channelEmbedding z)))

def liftPrimal {B H : Type} (i : Fin 2) : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] primal (B := B) (H := H) :=
  (primalEmbedding i).codRestrict primal (by intro v a h; simp [primalEmbedding])

axiom primal_plus_values {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) (v : B → Binary) :
    primalValues (F.forward e) z (liftPrimal i v) = fullPlus F e i z v

axiom primal_minus_values {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) (v : B → Binary) :
    primalValues (F.reverse e).flip z (liftPrimal i v) = fullMinus F e i z v

axiom extra_product_add {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ f : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε g : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T)
    (hfg : ∀ x y, dotProduct (f x).val (ε y).val = 0)
    (hgf : ∀ x y, dotProduct (g y).val (δ x).val = 0) :
    extraProduct D E S T (δ + f) (ε + g) =
      extraProduct D E S T δ ε + extraProduct D E S T f g

axiom ambient_add_left {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f df g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient (f + df) g =
      Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f g + Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient df g

axiom ambient_add_right {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g dg : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f (g + dg) =
      Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f g + Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f dg

axiom ambient_orthogonal_zero {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (h : ∀ v w, dotProduct (f v) (g w) = 0) :
    Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f g = 0

axiom restriction_add {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ f : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (i : Fin 2) :
    restriction D S (δ + f) i = restriction D S δ i + restriction D S f i

axiom component_response_unchanged {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (z : Fin 2)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ f : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε g : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T)
    (hf : ∀ x (v : primal (B := B) (H := H)),
      dotProduct (f x).val (primalValues (F.reverse e).flip z v) = 0)
    (hg : ∀ y (v : primal (B := B) (H := H)),
      dotProduct (g y).val (primalValues (F.forward e) z v) = 0) :
    componentResponse F e z D E S T (δ + f) (ε + g) =
      componentResponse F e z D E S T δ ε

axiom nonlinear_component_correction {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (z : Fin 2)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T)
    (β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    {K R : ℕ} (hS : Module.finrank Binary S ≤ K) (hT : Module.finrank Binary T ≤ K)
    (hplus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.forward e).compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R)
    (hminus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.reverse e).flip.compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R)
    (hδ : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range δ) ≤ R)
    (hε : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ε) ≤ R)
    (hcapacity : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) + 2 * K + 4 * R ≤ Fintype.card H) :
    ∃ δ' ε', componentResponse F e z D E S T δ' ε' = componentResponse F e z D E S T δ ε ∧
      extraProduct D E S T δ' ε' = β + extraProduct D E S T δ ε

axiom paper_channel_capacity {r J components Dquo K R h rank : ℕ}
    (hrank : rank ≤ 30 * r + 28 * J * components + Dquo)
    (hmargin : 28 * J * components + Dquo + 2 * K + 4 * R < 970 * r)
    (hchannels : 1000 * r ≤ h) : rank + 2 * K + 4 * R ≤ h

axiom ambient_add_expansion {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g df dg : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient (f + df) (g + dg) =
      Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f g + Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f dg +
      Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient df g + Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient df dg

end Lax342547.NonlinearChannels

          (LinearMap.compl₁₂ F Lax342547.NominalPrimal.primal.subtype (Lax342547.TableSpaces.channelEmbedding z)).range
          x))

restriction_add : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype H]
  (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H))
  (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (δ f :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H) D)
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ChannelChanges.perpendicular S) x))
  (i : Fin 2),
  Eq (Lax342547.DerivativeResponses.restriction D S (instHAdd.hAdd δ f) i)
    (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.DerivativeResponses.restriction D S δ i)
      (Lax342547.DerivativeResponses.restriction D S f i))

concepts.title: Exact reference Gram-orbit marginals under injective affine restrictions
concepts.description:
An injective coefficient restriction of a uniform full paired Gram orbit
has exactly the uniform prescribed slice law. The simultaneous ambient
action preserves the full Gram and transports every restriction fiber.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrameTuples

/-!
---
title: Exact reference Gram-orbit marginals under injective affine restrictions
type: lemma
---
An injective coefficient restriction of a uniform full paired Gram orbit
has exactly the uniform prescribed slice law. The simultaneous ambient
action preserves the full Gram and transports every restriction fiber.
-/

namespace Lax342547.OrbitSliceLaw
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameSymmetry Lax342547.FrameTuples
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false


def restrictOrbit {B H I J N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N] (G : Matrix B H Binary)
    (C : Matrix B I Binary) (D : Matrix H J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (z : Orbit N G) : Orbit N (C.transpose*G*D) :=
  ⟨(z.val.1*C,z.val.2*D),by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro x y hh
      apply hC
      apply z.property.1
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hh
    · intro x y hh
      apply hD
      apply z.property.2.1
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hh
    · simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc z.val.1.transpose,z.property.2.2]⟩

def changeOrbit {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (c : Change N) (G : Matrix B H Binary) (z : Orbit N G) : Orbit N G :=
  ⟨(c.C*z.val.1,c.D.transpose*z.val.2),by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro x y hh
      apply z.property.1
      apply c.injective
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hh
    · intro x y hh
      apply z.property.2.1
      apply c.dual_injective
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using hh
    · have he : c.C.transpose*c.D.transpose = 1 := by simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc,← Matrix.mul_assoc c.C.transpose,
        he,Matrix.one_mul,z.property.2.2]⟩

def orbitEquiv {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (c : Change N) (G : Matrix B H Binary) : Orbit N G ≃ Orbit N G where
  toFun := changeOrbit c G
  invFun := changeOrbit c.inv G
  left_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have he : c.C.transpose*c.D.transpose = 1 := by simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.DC
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [changeOrbit,Change.inv,← Matrix.mul_assoc,c.DC,he]
  right_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have he : c.D.transpose*c.C.transpose = 1 := by simpa using congrArg Matrix.transpose c.CD
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [changeOrbit,Change.inv,← Matrix.mul_assoc,c.CD,he]

axiom slice_uniform {B H I J N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (G : Matrix B H Binary) [Nonempty (Orbit N G)]
    (C : Matrix B I Binary) (D : Matrix H J Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    [Nonempty (Orbit N (C.transpose*G*D))] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N G)).map (restrictOrbit G C D hC hD) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orbit N (C.transpose*G*D))

end
end Lax342547.OrbitSliceLaw

  [inst_4 : Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix B H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  [inst_6 : Nonempty (Lax342547.FrameTuples.Orbit N G)] (C : Matrix B I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D : Matrix H J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
  [inst_7 :
    Nonempty
      (Lax342547.FrameTuples.Orbit N
        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C.transpose G) D))],
  Eq
    (PMF.map (Lax342547.OrbitSliceLaw.restrictOrbit G C D hC hD)
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.FrameTuples.Orbit N G)))
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype
      (Lax342547.FrameTuples.Orbit N
        (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C.transpose G) D)))

concepts.title: Independent ordered mixer blocks at distinct labels
concepts.description:
Two direction spaces with independent combined columns can receive any
prescribed forward and reverse bilinear blocks. A uniform ambient matrix
therefore induces a uniform pair of blocks; any nonzero ordered parity
is itself uniform. This applies to the free Z directions of distinct
selector labels in Lemma 5.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AtomDirections
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Lax342547.LowRankCounting

/-!
---
title: Independent ordered mixer blocks at distinct labels
type: lemma
---
Two direction spaces with independent combined columns can receive any
prescribed forward and reverse bilinear blocks. A uniform ambient matrix
therefore induces a uniform pair of blocks; any nonzero ordered parity
is itself uniform. This applies to the free Z directions of distinct
selector labels in Lemma 5.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw

variable {K I N P : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I]

def orders (D : Matrix I N K) (E : Matrix I P K) :
    Matrix I I K →ₗ[K] (Matrix N P K × Matrix P N K) where
  toFun L := (D.transpose * L * E, E.transpose * L * D)
  map_add' L M := by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  map_smul' a L := by simp [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

def parity (a b : K) : (Matrix N P K × Matrix P N K) →ₗ[K] Matrix N P K where
  toFun x := a • x.1 + b • x.2.transpose
  map_add' x y := by simp [smul_add, add_add_add_comm]
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul, mul_comm]

def familyParity {F : Type} [Fintype F] (D : Matrix I N K) (E : Matrix I P K) (a b : F → K) :
    (F → Matrix I I K) →ₗ[K] Matrix N P K :=
  ∑ j, ((parity (a j) (b j)).comp (orders D E)).comp (LinearMap.proj j)

axiom orders_surjective [Fintype N] [Fintype P]
    (D : Matrix I N K) (E : Matrix I P K)
    (hDE : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D E).mulVec) :
    Function.Surjective (orders D E)

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.AtomDirections

axiom orders_uniform {I N P : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype P]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P]
    (D : Matrix I N Binary) (E : Matrix I P Binary)
    (hDE : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D E).mulVec) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Binary)).map (orders D E) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Binary × Matrix P N Binary)

axiom ordered_parity_uniform {I N P : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype P]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P]
    (D : Matrix I N Binary) (E : Matrix I P Binary)
    (hDE : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D E).mulVec)
    (a b : Binary) (hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Binary)).map ((parity a b).comp (orders D E)) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Binary)

axiom atom_orders_uniform {k n b degree : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (s t : Fin b → Binary) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Moment k n b degree)).map
      (orders (blockDirections s free) (blockDirections t free)) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)

axiom family_parity_uniform {I N P F : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype P] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq F]
    (D : Matrix I N Binary) (E : Matrix I P Binary)
    (hDE : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D E).mulVec)
    (a b : F → Binary) (hab : ∃ j, a j ≠ 0 ∨ b j ≠ 0) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (F → Matrix I I Binary)).map (familyParity D E a b) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Binary)

open scoped ENNReal

axiom family_parity_low_rank_bound {I N P F : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype P] [Fintype F]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P] [DecidableEq F]
    (D : Matrix I N Binary) (E : Matrix I P Binary)
    (hDE : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D E).mulVec)
    (a b : F → Binary) (hab : ∃ j, a j ≠ 0 ∨ b j ≠ 0) (r : ℕ) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (F → Matrix I I Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {L | (familyParity D E a b L).rank ≤ r} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((Fintype.card N + Fintype.card P) * r) / 2 ^ (Fintype.card N * Fintype.card P)

end Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw

atom_orders_uniform : ∀ {k n b degree : Nat},
  instLENat.le 1 degree →
    ∀ (s t : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Ne s t →
        Eq
          (PMF.map
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
              (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.orders
                (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections s Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free)
                (Lax342547.AtomDirections.blockDirections t Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.free)))
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)))
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype
            (Prod (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
              (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))

family_parity_low_rank_bound : ∀ {I N P F : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype P] [inst_3 : Fintype F]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P] [inst_7 : DecidableEq F]
  (D : Matrix I N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (E : Matrix I P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective (D.fromCols E).mulVec →
    ∀ (a b : F → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      (Exists fun j => Or (Ne (a j) 0) (Ne (b j) 0)) →
        ∀ (r : Nat),
          ENNReal.instLE.le
            (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
              (PMF.uniformOfFintype (F → Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)).toOuterMeasure
              (Set.ofPred fun L =>
                instLENat.le (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.familyParity D E a b) L).rank r))
            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card N) (Fintype.card P)) r))
              (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) (Fintype.card P))))

family_parity_uniform : ∀ {I N P F : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype P] [inst_3 : Fintype F]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq N] [inst_6 : DecidableEq P] [inst_7 : DecidableEq F]
  (D : Matrix I N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (E : Matrix I P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective (D.fromCols E).mulVec →
    ∀ (a b : F → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      (Exists fun j => Or (Ne (a j) 0) (Ne (b j) 0)) →
        Eq
          (PMF.map (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.familyParity D E a b))
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (F → Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

ordered_parity_uniform : ∀ {I N P : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype P] [inst_3 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq P] (D : Matrix I N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (E : Matrix I P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective (D.fromCols E).mulVec →
    ∀ (a b : Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Or (Ne a 0) (Ne b 0) →
        Eq
          (PMF.map
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
              ((Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.parity a b).comp (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.orders D E)))
            (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

orders_surjective : ∀ {K I N P : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype N] [inst_3 : Fintype P] (D : Matrix I N K)
  (E : Matrix I P K),
  Function.Injective (D.fromCols E).mulVec →
    Function.Surjective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.orders D E))

orders_uniform : ∀ {I N P : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype P] [inst_3 : DecidableEq I]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq P] (D : Matrix I N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (E : Matrix I P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective (D.fromCols E).mulVec →
    Eq
      (PMF.map (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.OrderedMixerLaw.orders D E))
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Prod (Matrix N P Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Matrix P N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))

concepts.title: Endpoint projections of paired pure-response annihilators
concepts.description:
A shared bilinear response on the two nominal quotient spaces still
tests each endpoint separately: project onto its primal block before
choosing the bilinear form. This is the first step of the §6 obstruction
argument, with channel and mixed pin coordinates retained.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators
import Lax342547.TableSpaces

/-!
---
title: Endpoint projections of paired pure-response annihilators
type: lemma
---
A shared bilinear response on the two nominal quotient spaces still
tests each endpoint separately: project onto its primal block before
choosing the bilinear form. This is the first step of the §6 obstruction
argument, with channel and mixed pin coordinates retained.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

abbrev Nominal (B H : Type) := (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary

noncomputable def pureResponse {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary) :
    (Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary := by
  classical
  exact ∑ i, (matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix'
    (β.compl₁₂ (D.mkQ.comp (primalEmbedding i))
      (E.mkQ.comp (primalEmbedding i))))).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

def PairedAnnihilates {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) : Prop :=
  ∀ β, pureResponse D E β M = 0

axiom endpoint_projection {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M D E) (i : Fin 2)
    (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary))
    (hD : D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ S) (hE : E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ T) :
    PureAnnihilates (M i) S T

axiom endpoint_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M D E) (i : Fin 2)
    (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary))
    (hD : D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ S) (hE : E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ T) :
    (M i).rank ≤ Module.finrank Binary S + Module.finrank Binary T

end Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators

endpoint_projection : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype B] (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H)),
  Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates M D E →
    ∀ (i : Fin 2) (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) D) S →
        Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) E) T →
          Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates (M i) S T

endpoint_rank : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H)),
  Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates M D E →
    ∀ (i : Fin 2) (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) D) S →
        Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) E) T →
          instLENat.le (M i).rank
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x))
              (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)))

concepts.title: Paired-frame orbit under the primal and dual actions
concepts.description:
Lemma 4.1: two individually injective pairs of frames with equal Gram
pairings differ by one ambient linear automorphism, acting contragrediently
on the dual frame. No nondegeneracy of the prescribed Gram is needed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin

/-!
---
title: Paired-frame orbit under the primal and dual actions
type: lemma
---
Lemma 4.1: two individually injective pairs of frames with equal Gram
pairings differ by one ambient linear automorphism, acting contragrediently
on the dual frame. No nondegeneracy of the prescribed Gram is needed.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairedFrames

universe u v w z

variable {K : Type u} {U : Type v} {V : Type w} {W : Type z} [Field K]
  [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [hVdim : FiniteDimensional K V]
  [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]

axiom paired_frame_orbit {K : Type u} {U : Type v} {V : Type w} {W : Type z} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A A' : U →ₗ[K] V) (B B' : W →ₗ[K] Module.Dual K V)
    (hA : Function.Injective A) (hA' : Function.Injective A')
    (hB : Function.Injective B) (hB' : Function.Injective B')
    (hgram : ∀ u w, B w (A u) = B' w (A' u)) :
    ∃ L : V ≃ₗ[K] V, (∀ u, L (A u) = A' u) ∧
      ∀ w v, B w (L.symm v) = B' w v

axiom paired_matrix_orbit {I J N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq N] (A A' : Matrix N I K) (B B' : Matrix N J K)
    (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec) (hA' : Function.Injective A'.mulVec)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) (hB' : Function.Injective B'.mulVec)
    (hgram : A.transpose * B = A'.transpose * B') :
    ∃ C D : Matrix N N K, C * D = 1 ∧ D * C = 1 ∧
      C * A = A' ∧ D.transpose * B = B'

end Lax342547.PairedFrames

statements.signature:
paired_frame_orbit : ∀ {K : Type u} {U : Type v} {V : Type w} {W : Type z} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup U] [inst_2 : Module K U]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_4 : Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [inst_6 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_7 : Module K W] (A A' : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) U V) (B B' : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) W (Module.Dual K V)),
  Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A) →
    Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A') →
      Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B) →
        Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B') →
          (∀ (u : U) (w : W),
              Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B w) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A u))
                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B' w) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A' u))) →
            Exists fun L =>
              And
                (∀ (u : U),
                  Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe L (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A u)) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A' u))
                (∀ (w : W) (v : V),
                  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B w) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe L.symm v))
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B' w) v))

paired_matrix_orbit : ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] {I J N : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : Fintype N]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq N] (A A' : Matrix N I K) (B B' : Matrix N J K),
  Function.Injective A.mulVec →
    Function.Injective A'.mulVec →
      Function.Injective B.mulVec →
        Function.Injective B'.mulVec →
          Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A.transpose B)
              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A'.transpose B') →
            Exists fun C =>
              Exists fun D =>
                And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C D) 1)
                  (And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul D C) 1)
                    (And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul C A) A')
                      (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul D.transpose B) B')))

concepts.title: Actual paired-witness key spaces satisfy the baseline hypotheses
concepts.description:
At a component keep precisely the nominal primal rays belonging to
incident selected atoms. Their span has dimension at most twenty-eight,
is contained in the combined primal space, and is disjoint from every
table space when the labels avoid the sparse exclusions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PairedRecipes
import Lax342547.KeySpans

/-!
---
title: Actual paired-witness key spaces satisfy the baseline hypotheses
type: lemma
---
At a component keep precisely the nominal primal rays belonging to
incident selected atoms. Their span has dimension at most twenty-eight,
is contained in the combined primal space, and is disjoint from every
table space when the labels avoid the sparse exclusions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairedKeys

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.KeySpans

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

abbrev Positions (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) := Σ i, Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)

def labels (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) (x : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) :=
  (W.left i x.1 x.2).label

def bases (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) (x : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) :=
  (W.left i x.1 x.2).base

noncomputable def direction (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k))
    (x : Positions W) : (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary := by
  classical
  exact if (W.left x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2).tag ∈ e.val then ray (labels W) (bases W) x else 0

def keys (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (direction (H := H) W e))

axiom key_bounds [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    keys (H := H) W e ≤ primal ∧ Module.finrank Binary (keys (H := H) W e) ≤ 28

axiom fresh_spans [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A) (hB : Excludes Q B)
    (hfresh : FreshAgainst W A B) :
    (∀ a, Disjoint (tableSpace P a) (keys (H := H) W a.1)) ∧
      ∀ a, Disjoint (tableSpace Q a) (keys (H := H) (flip W) a.1)

end Lax342547.PairedKeys
