  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P Q :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes P A →
    Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes Q B →
      Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.FreshAgainst W A B →
        And
          (∀ (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool),
            Disjoint (Lax342547.TableSpaces.tableSpace P a) (Lax342547.PairedKeys.keys W a.fst))
          (∀ (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool),
            Disjoint (Lax342547.TableSpaces.tableSpace Q a)
              (Lax342547.PairedKeys.keys (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) a.fst))

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  And (Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.PairedKeys.keys W e) Lax342547.NominalPrimal.primal)
    (instLENat.le
      (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.PairedKeys.keys W e) x))
      28)

concepts.title: Binary prescriptions at all endpoints of a paired scalar recipe
concepts.description:
Swapping the units preserves the full scalar recipe. At each endpoint,
its two role equations and the opposite unit's coupled equation give
formal ordered mixer bits realizing the required selected-atom gradients.
These are prescriptions; their occurrence is a separate probability problem.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
import Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes

/-!
---
title: Binary prescriptions at all endpoints of a paired scalar recipe
type: lemma
---
Swapping the units preserves the full scalar recipe. At each endpoint,
its two role equations and the opposite unit's coupled equation give
formal ordered mixer bits realizing the required selected-atom gradients.
These are prescriptions; their occurrence is a separate probability problem.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairedRecipes

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.WitnessAtoms
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.TableContractions

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}

def flip (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : Lists k n b degree r hr where
  length i z := W.length z i
  positive i z := W.positive z i
  short i z := W.short z i
  left i z := W.right z i
  right i z := W.left z i
  same_tag i z t := (W.same_tag z i t).symm
  same_diagonal i z t := (W.same_diagonal z i t).symm
  left_fresh := W.right_fresh
  right_fresh := W.left_fresh

abbrev Position (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) :=
  Fin (W.length i 0) ⊕ Fin (W.length i 1)

def endpointAtoms (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) :
    Position W i → PointAtom k n b degree := Sum.elim (W.left i 0) (W.left i 1)

variable {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}

noncomputable def oppositeP (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (i : Fin 2) : Position W i → Binary :=
  Sum.elim (fun t => ownContraction oB 0 (W.right i 0 t).profile)
    (fun t => ownContraction oB 1 (W.right i 1 t).profile)

def Prescriptions (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (copies : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ∃ lbits rbits : Position W i → Position W i → ProductIndex k copies → Binary,
    (∀ x y t, ¬ allowedIndex ((endpointAtoms W i x).numerical hr)
      ((endpointAtoms W i y).numerical hr) t → lbits x y t = 0 ∧ rbits x y t = 0) ∧
    ∀ L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree,
      (∀ x y, x ≠ y → ∀ t, allowedIndex ((endpointAtoms W i x).numerical hr)
        ((endpointAtoms W i y).numerical hr) t →
        (L t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (endpointAtoms W i x).vector
          (endpointAtoms W i y).vector = lbits x y t ∧
        (R t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2).toBilin' (endpointAtoms W i x).vector
          (endpointAtoms W i y).vector = rbits x y t) →
      RecipeGradients D L R (endpointAtoms W i) (oppositeP W oB i)

axiom endpoint_fresh (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) :
    Function.Injective (fun x : Position W i => (endpointAtoms W i x).label)

axiom flip_recipe (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    {P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (h : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B) :
    ScalarRecipe (flip W) D L R oB oA (flipTable T) B A

axiom paired_prescriptions (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hcopies : 0 < copies)
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    {P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (h : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B) :
    Prescriptions W D oB copies ∧ Prescriptions (flip W) D oA copies

end Lax342547.PairedRecipes

  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr) {copies : Nat}
  (L R :
    Fin copies →
      Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
  (oA oB : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit)
  {P Q :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N}
  (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B →
    Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.ScalarRecipe (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) D L R oB oA
      (Lax342547.TableContractions.flipTable T) B A

  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr) {copies : Nat},
  instLTNat.lt 0 k →
    instLTNat.lt 0 copies →
      ∀
        (L R :
          Fin copies →
            Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
              Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
                Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree)
        (oA oB : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit)
        {P Q :
          Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
            (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N}
        (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
        Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B →
          And (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.Prescriptions W D oB copies)
            (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.Prescriptions (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) D oA copies)

concepts.title: Full paired witness lists and scalar recipe equations
concepts.description:
Four cross pairs carry matched lists of one to seven actual point atoms.
Freshness holds across both lists at each endpoint. The scalar recipe
records odd diagonal sums, role parity, both effective-space equations,
and both coupled endpoint equations, using the actual contractions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.WitnessAtoms
import Lax342547.RawContractions
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sigma

/-!
---
title: Full paired witness lists and scalar recipe equations
type: lemma
---
Four cross pairs carry matched lists of one to seven actual point atoms.
Freshness holds across both lists at each endpoint. The scalar recipe
records odd diagonal sums, role parity, both effective-space equations,
and both coupled endpoint equations, using the actual contractions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairedWitnesses

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.WitnessAtoms
open Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.TableContractions

def diagonalBit {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (x : PointAtom k n b degree) : Binary :=
  eta hr (pointMoment (selectorEval (degree := degree)) x.label x.base)

structure Lists (k n b degree r : ℕ) (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) where
  length : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ i z, 1 ≤ length i z
  short : ∀ i z, length i z ≤ 7
  left : ∀ i z, Fin (length i z) → PointAtom k n b degree
  right : ∀ i z, Fin (length i z) → PointAtom k n b degree
  same_tag : ∀ i z t, (left i z t).tag = (right i z t).tag
  same_diagonal : ∀ i z t, diagonalBit hr (left i z t) = diagonalBit hr (right i z t)
  left_fresh : ∀ i, Function.Injective (fun t : Σ z, Fin (length i z) => (left i t.1 t.2).label)
  right_fresh : ∀ z, Function.Injective (fun t : Σ i, Fin (length i z) => (right t.1 z t.2).label)

def other (i : Fin 2) : Fin 2 := ⟨1 - i.val, by omega⟩

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}

noncomputable def leftRepresentation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) :
    Representation k n b degree :=
  ∑ t, atomRepresentation (W.left i z t).tag (W.left i z t).label
    (W.left i z t).base (W.left i z t).supported

noncomputable def rightRepresentation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) :
    Representation k n b degree :=
  ∑ t, atomRepresentation (W.right i z t).tag (W.right i z t).label
    (W.right i z t).base (W.right i z t).supported

noncomputable def leftWitness (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) : Profile k n b degree :=
  ∑ t, (W.left i z t).profile

noncomputable def rightWitness (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) : Profile k n b degree :=
  ∑ t, (W.right i z t).profile

def FreshAgainst (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) : Prop :=
  (∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i) ∧ (∀ i z t, (W.right i z t).label ∉ B z)

variable {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
  {E : Moment k n b degree}

abbrev Unit := Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H N E

noncomputable def ownContraction (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (i : Fin 2) :
    Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  (profileContraction (o (other i))).comp ((profileMap (o i)).comp (Profile k n b degree).subtype)

def MatchedKeys (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i z t (e : Component (Tag k)), (W.left i z t).tag ∈ e.val →
    (oA i e).P.mulVec (W.left i z t).vector = (oB z e).P.mulVec (W.right i z t).vector ∧
    (oA i e).Q.mulVec (W.left i z t).vector = (oB z e).Q.mulVec (W.right i z t).vector

structure ScalarRecipe (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    {P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) : Prop where
  fresh : FreshAgainst W A B
  odd : ∀ i z, (∑ t, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z t)) = 1
  roles : ∀ i z, D.role (leftWitness W i z) + D.role (rightWitness W i z) = 1
  effectiveLeft : ∀ i z (x : effective (Profile k n b degree) P i),
    gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z) x.val = D.role x.val +
      starContraction T (Profile k n b degree) i z x
  effectiveRight : ∀ i z (x : effective (Profile k n b degree) Q z),
    gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z) x.val = D.role x.val +
      starContraction (flipTable T) (Profile k n b degree) z i x
  coupledLeft : ∀ i z,
    (ownContraction oA i + D.role) (leftWitness W i z) =
      (ownContraction oA (other i) + D.role) (leftWitness W (other i) z)
  coupledRight : ∀ i z,
    (ownContraction oB z + D.role) (rightWitness W i z) =
      (ownContraction oB (other z) + D.role) (rightWitness W i (other z))

axiom list_budgets (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    (∀ i, Fintype.card (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) ≤ 14) ∧
      ∀ z, Fintype.card (Σ i, Fin (W.length i z)) ≤ 14

axiom diagonal_sums (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) :
    chiStar hr (leftRepresentation W i z) = ∑ t, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z t) ∧
    chiStar hr (rightRepresentation W i z) = ∑ t, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z t)

axiom tensor_sharing (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB) (i z : Fin 2) :
    profileMap (oA i) (leftWitness W i z).val = profileMap (oB z) (rightWitness W i z).val

end Lax342547.PairedWitnesses

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2),
  And
    (Eq
      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.chiStar hr)
        (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.leftRepresentation W i z))

  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (oA oB : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit),
  Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.MatchedKeys W oA oB →
    ∀ (i z : Fin 2),
      Eq
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.RawFrames.profileMap (oA i))
          (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.leftWitness W i z).val)

          (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.rightWitness W i z).val)

concepts.title: Tiny-cover pairing matrix rank
concepts.description: The actual pairing matrix factors through the covered tensor space; its rank is bounded by the two mode dimensions times their ambient dimensions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoverSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LSum

/-!
---
title: Tiny-cover pairing matrix rank
type: lemma
---
The actual pairing matrix factors through the covered tensor space; its rank is bounded by the two mode dimensions times their ambient dimensions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairingRank

open Lax342547.CoverProjection
open scoped BigOperators

axiom pairing_matrix_rank_le {K V Ω : Type} [Field K] [Fintype Ω]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : Submodule K V) (v : Ω → V) (hv : ∀ a, v a ∈ S) (φ : Ω → Module.Dual K V) :
    (Matrix.of (fun a b => φ b (v a))).rank ≤ Module.finrank K S

axiom covered_pairing_rank {K V W Ω : Type} [Field K] [Fintype Ω]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (Δ : Ω → V →ₗ[K] W) (φ : Ω → Module.Dual K (V →ₗ[K] W))
    (hΔ : ∀ a, projection (Δ a) S T = 0) :
    (Matrix.of (fun a b => φ b (Δ a))).rank ≤
      Module.finrank K V*Module.finrank K S+Module.finrank K T*Module.finrank K W

end Lax342547.PairingRank

  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W] (S : Submodule K W)
  (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (Δ : Ω → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W)
  (φ : Ω → Module.Dual K (LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W)),
  (∀ (a : Ω), Eq (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection (Δ a) S T) 0) →
    instLENat.le (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.of fun a b => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (φ b) (Δ a)).rank
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHMul.hMul (Module.finrank K V) (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)))
        (instHMul.hMul (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)) (Module.finrank K W)))

  [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : Submodule K V) (v : Ω → V),
  (∀ (a : Ω), SetLike.instMembership.mem S (v a)) →
    ∀ (φ : Ω → Module.Dual K V),
      instLENat.le (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe Matrix.of fun a b => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (φ b) (v a)).rank
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x))

concepts.description: The product law at two distinct positions and a finite union bound turn an unavoidable compatible pair into a weighted probability lower bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.DisjointSampling

/-!

title: Weighted compatibility from inevitable sample pairs
type: lemma
---
The product law at two distinct positions and a finite union bound turn an unavoidable compatible pair into a weighted probability lower bound.

    cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : ι => μ)) (fun x => E (x i) (x j)) = pairEventMass μ μ E

axiom inevitable_pair_mass {ι Ω : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (E : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hμ : Probability μ)
    (hevery : ∀ x : ι → Ω, ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ E (x i) (x j)) :
    1 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)^2*pairEventMass μ μ E

end Lax342547.PairPositions

import Lax342547.RealCellLaws
import Lax342547.Conditioning

/-!
---
title: Squared restriction cost for independent unit events
type: lemma
---
A normalized restriction is dominated pointwise by its original PMF after multiplication by the retained mass. Independent pair events therefore lose precisely the square of that mass.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PairRecovery

open Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def pairMass {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ a, ∑ b, if H a b then α a * β b else 0

axiom pair_mass_domination {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (α ρ : ΩA → ℝ) (β σ : ΩB → ℝ) (mA mB : ℝ) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop)
    (hmA : 0 ≤ mA) (hmB : 0 ≤ mB) (hρ : ∀ a, 0 ≤ ρ a) (hσ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ σ b)
    (hα : ∀ a, mA * ρ a ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, mB * σ b ≤ β b) :
    mA * mB * pairMass ρ σ H ≤ pairMass α β H

axiom real_filter_domination {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (ω : Ω) :
    (p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal * weights (p.filter S hS) ω ≤ weights p ω

axiom restriction_pair_recovery {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (H : Ω → Ω → Prop) :
    ((p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal)^2 * pairMass (weights (p.filter S hS)) (weights (p.filter S hS)) H ≤
      pairMass (weights p) (weights p) H

noncomputable def independentPair {ΩA ΩB : Type} (p : PMF ΩA) (q : PMF ΩB) : PMF (ΩA × ΩB) :=
  p.bind (fun a => q.map (fun b => (a,b)))

axiom independent_pair_apply {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (p : PMF ΩA) (q : PMF ΩB) (ab : ΩA × ΩB) :
    independentPair p q ab = p ab.1 * q ab.2

axiom pair_mass_pmf_event {ΩA ΩB : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    (p : PMF ΩA) (q : PMF ΩB) (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop) :
    pairMass (weights p) (weights q) H =
      ((independentPair p q).toOuterMeasure {ab | H ab.1 ab.2}).toReal

axiom restriction_pair_event_recovery {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support) (H : Ω → Ω → Prop) :
    ((p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal)^2 *
      ((independentPair (p.filter S hS) (p.filter S hS)).toOuterMeasure {ab | H ab.1 ab.2}).toReal ≤
        ((independentPair p p).toOuterMeasure {ab | H ab.1 ab.2}).toReal

end Lax342547.PairRecovery

  Eq (PMF.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.PairRecovery.independentPair p q) ab)
    (instHMul.hMul (PMF.instFunLike.coe p ab.fst) (PMF.instFunLike.coe q ab.snd))

  (H : ΩA → ΩB → Prop),
  Real.instLE.le 0 mA →
    Real.instLE.le 0 mB →
      (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ a)) →
        (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le 0 (σ b)) →
          (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul mA (ρ a)) (α a)) →
            (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul mB (σ b)) (β b)) →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul mA mB) (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass ρ σ H))
                (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass α β H)

  Eq (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights p) (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights q) H)
    (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (Lax342547.PairRecovery.independentPair p q).toOuterMeasure
        (Set.ofPred fun ab => H ab.fst ab.snd)).toReal

  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (ω : Ω),
  Real.instLE.le
    (instHMul.hMul (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal
      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (p.filter S hS) ω))
    (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights p ω)

  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (H : Ω → Ω → Prop),
  Real.instLE.le
    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal 2)
      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
          (Lax342547.PairRecovery.independentPair (p.filter S hS) (p.filter S hS)).toOuterMeasure
          (Set.ofPred fun ab => H ab.fst ab.snd)).toReal)
    (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (Lax342547.PairRecovery.independentPair p p).toOuterMeasure
        (Set.ofPred fun ab => H ab.fst ab.snd)).toReal

restriction_pair_recovery : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (S : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o)) (H : Ω → Ω → Prop),
  Real.instLE.le
    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S).toReal 2)
      (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (p.filter S hS))
        (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (p.filter S hS)) H))
    (Lax342547.PairRecovery.pairMass (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights p) (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights p) H)

concepts.title: Paper parameter graph probability
concepts.description: The failure probability of the connected matching bound is eventually at most two to minus half the sample size, assuming actual raw supersaturation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GraphFailure
import Lax342547.ProbabilityScales

/-!
---
title: Paper parameter graph probability
type: lemma
---
The failure probability of the connected matching bound is eventually at most two to minus half the sample size, assuming actual raw supersaturation.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PaperGraphProbability

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.UnitLaws Lax342547.ContainerLaws
open Lax342547.MatchingSamples Lax342547.SampledGraph Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
open Lax342547.FingerprintScales Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Filter

axiom paper_graph_failure_probability {Ω : ℕ → Type} [∀ N, Fintype (Ω N)] [∀ N, Nonempty (Ω N)]
    (μ : ∀ N, Ω N → ℝ) (hole : ∀ N, Ω N → Ω N → Prop) (A g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hsymm : ∀ N, ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole N x y → hole N y x)
    (hloop : ∀ N x, ¬ hole N x x)
    (hμ : ∀ N, Probability (μ N)) (hμpos : ∀ N x, 0 < μ N x)
    (hcard : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Fintype.card (Ω N) ≤ 2^(A*N^2))
    (hsuper : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ ρ,
      Feasible (μ N) (fun x y => ¬ hole N x y) ((2 : ℝ)^1000) ((2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N)) ρ →
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(100*g*N) ≤ conflictMass ρ (fourConflict (hole N))) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin (sampleSize g N) => μ N))
        (fun sample => sampleSize g N ≤ 100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph (hole N) (hsymm N) sample)) ≤
          1/(2 : ℝ)^(sampleSize g N/2)

end Lax342547.PaperGraphProbability

statements.signature:
paper_graph_failure_probability : ∀ {Ω : Nat → Type} [inst : (N : Nat) → Fintype (Ω N)] [∀ (N : Nat), Nonempty (Ω N)] (μ : (N : Nat) → Ω N → Real)
  (hole : (N : Nat) → Ω N → Ω N → Prop) (A g : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 0 g →
    ∀ (hsymm : ∀ (N : Nat) ⦃x y : Ω N⦄, hole N x y → hole N y x),
      (∀ (N : Nat) (x : Ω N), Not (hole N x x)) →
        (∀ (N : Nat), Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability (μ N)) →
          (∀ (N : Nat) (x : Ω N), Real.instLT.lt 0 (μ N x)) →
            Filter.Eventually
                (fun N => instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Ω N)) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul A (instHPow.hPow N 2))))
                Filter.atTop →
              Filter.Eventually
                  (fun N =>
                    ∀ (ρ : Prod (Ω N) (Ω N) → Real),
                      Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible (μ N) (fun x y => Not (hole N x y)) (instHPow.hPow 2 1000)
                          (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4000 g) N)) ρ →
                        Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 100 g) N)))
                          (Lax342547.ContainerLaws.conflictMass ρ (Lax342547.MatchingSamples.fourConflict (hole N))))
                  Filter.atTop →
                Filter.Eventually
                  (fun N =>
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ N)
                        fun sample =>
                        instLENat.le (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N)
                          (instHMul.hMul 100
                            (Lax342547.ConnectedMatching.connectedMatchingNumber
                              (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph (hole N) ⋯ sample))))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv 1
                        (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N) 2))))
                  Filter.atTop

import Lax342547.SampleScales

/-!
---
title: Supersaturation to sampled graphs at the paper parameters
type: lemma
---
For any finite raw family with a uniform quadratic logarithmic alphabet bound and the actual raw-unit supersaturation property, the paper parameter choices give good sampled graphs for every sufficiently large ambient dimension. This conditional transfer permits repeated raw samples and bounds the actual connected matching number.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PaperGraphTransfer

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.UnitLaws Lax342547.ContainerLaws
open Lax342547.MatchingSamples Lax342547.SampledGraph Lax342547.ConnectedMatching
open Lax342547.FingerprintScales Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics
open Filter

axiom paper_graph_transfer {Ω : ℕ → Type} [∀ N, Fintype (Ω N)] [∀ N, Nonempty (Ω N)]
    (μ : ∀ N, Ω N → ℝ) (hole : ∀ N, Ω N → Ω N → Prop) (A g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hsymm : ∀ N, ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole N x y → hole N y x)
    (hloop : ∀ N x, ¬ hole N x x)
    (htriangle : ∀ N x y z, hole N x y → hole N y z → ¬ hole N z x)
    (hμ : ∀ N, Probability (μ N)) (hμpos : ∀ N x, 0 < μ N x)
    (hcard : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Fintype.card (Ω N) ≤ 2^(A*N^2))
    (hsuper : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ ρ,
      Feasible (μ N) (fun x y => ¬ hole N x y) ((2 : ℝ)^1000) ((2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N)) ρ →
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(100*g*N) ≤ conflictMass ρ (fourConflict (hole N))) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∃ sample : Fin (sampleSize g N) → Ω N,
      (sampleGraph (hole N) (hsymm N) sample).indepNum ≤ 2 ∧
      100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph (hole N) (hsymm N) sample) < sampleSize g N

end Lax342547.PaperGraphTransfer

import Lax342547.CellAveraging

/-!
---
title: Independent parameter averaging with opposite-dependent original cells
type: lemma
---
Record partitions may depend on opposite parameters. Average each unchanged retained cell pair under the independent parameter laws, and recover a lower bound for the original orientation-pair event.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ParameterCellAveraging

open Lax342547.CellAveraging Lax342547.RetainedImages

noncomputable def average {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (f : A → B → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ x, ∑ y, p x * q y * f x y

axiom average_mono {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (f g : A → B → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hq : ∀ y, 0 ≤ q y) (h : ∀ x y, f x y ≤ g x y) :
    average p q f ≤ average p q g

axiom average_const {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (hp : ∑ x, p x = 1) (hq : ∑ y, q y = 1) (c : ℝ) :
    average p q (fun _ _ => c) = c

axiom average_cell_pair_lower {A B ΩA ΩB C D : Type}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (p : A → ℝ) (q : B → ℝ) (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)

title: Rank and density budgets for exact-image peeling

The comparison bounds the cumulative new rank, including a single large

    (hupper : m ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * N) * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ε) * N))) ^ u) :
    (ζ - ε) * u < D + ζ

    (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) (hε : ε ≤ ζ / 4)
    (h : (ζ - ε) * u < D + ζ) : (u : ℝ) < 4 * (D + 1) / ζ

    (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * N) / m ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K + 1) * N)

concepts.title: Sparse pin exclusions with arbitrary base coefficients
concepts.description:
The annihilator argument needs more than independence of fresh point
rays: an expansion may mix selected fresh labels with other labels in
the exclusion. The uniform cover bounds every nonzero base-vector label
coefficient of every short projected pin expansion.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.KeySpans
import Lax342547.SparsePins

/-!
---
title: Sparse pin exclusions with arbitrary base coefficients
type: lemma
---
The annihilator argument needs more than independence of fresh point
rays: an expansion may mix selected fresh labels with other labels in
the exclusion. The uniform cover bounds every nonzero base-vector label
coefficient of every short projected pin expansion.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.SparsePins Lax342547.KeySpans

variable {Base Comp H N : Type} {b degree : ℕ}

def Covers
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (R : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (v : (Fin b → Binary) → Option Base → Binary),
    L.card ≤ R + 14 →
    (∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (v s)) ∈ projected P i a →
    ∀ s ∈ L, v s ≠ 0 → s ∈ A i

axiom covers_exists [Fintype Base] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype H] {K R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hdegree : (K + 1) * (R + 14) ≤ degree + 1) :
    ∃ A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
      (∀ i, (A i).card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Comp * K * (R + 14)) ∧ Covers P A R

axiom fresh_coefficient {R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (v : (Fin b → Binary) → Option Base → Binary) (hL : L.card ≤ R + 14)
    (hmem : (∑ t ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) t (v t)) ∈ projected P i a)
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (hs : s ∈ L) (hfresh : s ∉ A i) : v s = 0

axiom keys_exclusion {R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R) : Excludes P A

end Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions

  (P :

      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) (Option Base)) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      Exists fun A =>
        And

            instLENat.le (A i).card

concepts.title: Exact-pin leaf entropy is invariant under nominal axis reindexing
concepts.description: Pull back exact pins along a finite axis equivalence. Relative ranks and specified image events agree exactly, so the original all-rank leaf cap applies to the opposite cross orientation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafBlockCaps

/-!
---
title: Exact-pin leaf entropy is invariant under nominal axis reindexing
type: lemma
---
Pull back exact pins along a finite axis equivalence. Relative ranks and specified image events agree exactly, so the original all-rank leaf cap applies to the opposite cross orientation.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PinReindexing

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def pull {Axis Axis' I N : Type} (e : Axis' ≃ Axis) (P : Pin Axis I N) : Pin Axis' I N :=
  ⟨fun a => P.space (e a), fun a => P.value (e a)⟩

axiom relative_rank_reindex {Axis Axis' I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype Axis'] [Fintype I]
    (e : Axis' ≃ Axis) (P : Pin Axis I N) (Q : Pin Axis' I N) :
    (pull e P).relativeRank Q = P.relativeRank (pull e.symm Q)

axiom event_reindex {Ω Axis Axis' I N : Type}
    (e : Axis' ≃ Axis) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (Q : Pin Axis' I N) :
    Q.event (fun ω a => A ω (e a)) = (pull e.symm Q).event A

axiom leaf_cap_reindex {Ω Axis Axis' I N : Type} [Fintype Axis] [Fintype Axis'] [Fintype I]
    (e : Axis' ≃ Axis) (p : PMF Ω)
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : Pin Axis I N) (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin Axis I N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (Q : Pin Axis' I N) (hr : 1 ≤ (pull e P).relativeRank Q) :
    p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event (fun ω a => A ω (e a))) ≤ α ^ ((pull e P).relativeRank Q)

noncomputable def opposite {Comp : Type} : (Comp × Bool) ≃ (Comp × Bool) where
  toFun a := (a.1,!a.2)
  invFun a := (a.1,!a.2)
  left_inv a := by simp
  right_inv a := by simp

end Lax342547.PinReindexing

  (A :

import Lax342547.CommonExactification
import Lax342547.PointQuadratics
import Lax342547.BooleanWeight

/-!
---
title: Common predictions from actual point tensors
type: lemma
---
Degree-two actual point-tensor evaluations yield an exact common marked prediction after an explicitly bounded mass loss.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PointPrediction

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators

axiom marked_point_degree {b : ℕ} {Label Coord : Type} [Fintype Coord]
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Matrix (Coord × Option (Fin b)) (Coord × Option (Fin b)) Binary))
    (α : Binary) (q : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) (hq : q ∈ selectorSpan b 2) :
    (fun x => φ (pointMoment p s x)+α*q x) ∈ selectorSpan b 2

axiom retained_point_prediction {U Label Coord : Type} [Fintype U] [Fintype Coord] {b : ℕ}
    (β : U → ℝ) (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label)
    (φ : U → Module.Dual Binary (Matrix (Coord × Option (Fin b)) (Coord × Option (Fin b)) Binary))
    (α : U → Binary) (q : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary) (ε : ℝ)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hq : q ∈ selectorSpan b 2) (hε : ε < 1/16)
    (herror : (∑ u, β u*cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b)
      (fun x => φ u (pointMoment p s x)+α u*q x ≠ f x)) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ u₀ : U, 1-16*ε ≤ cellMass β (fun u =>
      (fun x => φ u (pointMoment p s x)+α u*q x) =
      (fun x => φ u₀ (pointMoment p s x)+α u₀*q x))

end Lax342547.PointPrediction

import Lax342547.QuadraticDegree

/-!
---
title: Polynomial degree of actual tensor evaluations
type: lemma
---
Linear tensor evaluations retain the sum of coordinate degrees, including the exact twice-selector-degree bound for point tensors.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PolynomialTensors

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation

axiom linear_outer_product_degree_bound {b d : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Matrix I I Binary)) (z : I → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ selectorSpan b d) :
    (fun x => φ (Matrix.of (fun i j => z i x*z j x))) ∈ selectorSpan b (d+d)

    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Matrix (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base)
      (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) Binary)) (z : Base → Binary) :
    (fun s => φ (pointMoment selectorEval s z)) ∈ selectorSpan b (degree+degree)

end Lax342547.PolynomialTensors

import Lax342547.TableInjection

/-!

Adaptive nominal pins and the actual admissible small tables retain
accepting mass under all sixteen component tests. Exponential errors are
paid relative to inverse-polynomial pair mass before any conditioning.
-/

abbrev Test (Comp : Type) := Comp × (Fin 2 × Fin 2) × (Bool × Bool)

def testFailure {Comp B H N U : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (P : U → Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : U → Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (j : Test Comp) (a b : U) : Prop :=
  Failed (P a) (P b) (A a) (A b) j.1 j.2.1.1 j.2.1.2 j.2.2.1 j.2.2.2

structure Budget (K m t Cs p h N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : Prop where
  gap : 1/(2 : ℝ)^t ≤ η/2
  ambient : p+h+1 ≤ N
  primal : p ≤ N/8
  density : m+h+1 ≤ N/10
  channel : 2*K+t+20*(K+1)*(Cs+3) ≤ h
  probes : 20*(K+1) ≤ N
  constant : m+h*K ≤ N
  small : 1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/2) ≤ η/2

  [Fintype U] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]

    (P : U → Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : U → Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (accept : U → U → Prop) (CL CR : I → U → Prop) (keyL keyR : U → I)
    (T : ∀ a b,Table (P a) (P b)) (K m t Cs : ℕ) (M η : ℝ)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbudget : Budget K m t Cs (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card N) η)
    (hcapM : M ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m) (hcapMB : 2*M ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(m+Fintype.card N))
    (hcount : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(Cs*Fintype.card N))
    (hP : ∀ u,(P u).rank ≤ K)
    (hcap : ∀ i e f,push ρ (fun u => A u i e) f ≤
      M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)) f)
    (hleft : ∀ a b,accept a b ↔ CL (keyL b) a)

    (hT : ∀ a b,accept a b → Admissible (T a b)
      Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation (A a) (A b)) :
    cellMass (fun ab : U × U => ρ ab.1*ρ ab.2)
      (fun ab => accept ab.1 ab.2 ∧ ¬ Injecting (T ab.1 ab.2)) ≤
      (16*Fintype.card Comp : ℕ)*(η*cellMass (fun ab : U × U => ρ ab.1*ρ ab.2)
        (fun ab => accept ab.1 ab.2)+
        (1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card N/100)+1/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N))

    (P : U → Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : U → Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)

    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hbudget : Budget K m t Cs (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H) (Fintype.card N) η)
    (hcapM : M ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m) (hcapMB : 2*M ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(m+Fintype.card N))
    (hcount : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(Cs*Fintype.card N))
    (hP : ∀ u,(P u).rank ≤ K)
    (hcap : ∀ i e f,push ρ (fun u => A u i e) f ≤
      M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)) f)
    (hleft : ∀ a b,accept a b ↔ CL (keyL b) a)
    (hright : ∀ a b,accept b a ↔ CR (keyR b) a)
    (hT : ∀ a b,accept a b → Admissible (T a b)
      Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation (A a) (A b))
    (c : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < 16*Fintype.card Comp) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)

    (haccept : 1/(Fintype.card N : ℝ)^c ≤ cellMass (fun ab : U × U => ρ ab.1*ρ ab.2)
      (fun ab => accept ab.1 ab.2))
    (htail : (16*Fintype.card Comp : ℕ)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card N/100)+1/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N) ≤
      (ε/2)/(Fintype.card N : ℝ)^c) :
    cellMass (fun ab : U × U => ρ ab.1*ρ ab.2)
      (fun ab => accept ab.1 ab.2 ∧ ¬ Injecting (T ab.1 ab.2)) ≤
      ε*cellMass (fun ab : U × U => ρ ab.1*ρ ab.2) (fun ab => accept ab.1 ab.2)

concepts.description:
Choose channel size before the ambient dimension, density law, or accepting
mass exponent. The later onset pays every fixed polynomial loss; a density
exponent at most N/100 and primal dimension at most N/8 suffice.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PreparedInjection

/-!
---
title: Early channel choice for prepared accepting-pair injection
type: lemma
---
Choose channel size before the ambient dimension, density law, or accepting
mass exponent. The later onset pays every fixed polynomial loss; a density
exponent at most N/100 and primal dimension at most N/8 suffice.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PreparedInjectionScale

open Lax342547.PreparedInjection

axiom exists_prepared_parameters (K Cs J : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hJ : 0 < J) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t h : ℕ,∀ c : ℕ,∃ N₀ : ℕ,∀ N : ℕ,N₀ ≤ N → ∀ p m : ℕ,
      p ≤ N/8 → m ≤ N/100 →
      Budget K m t Cs p h N (ε/(2*J)) ∧
      (J : ℝ)*(1/(2 : ℝ)^(N/100)+1/(2 : ℝ)^N) ≤ (ε/2)/(N : ℝ)^c

end Lax342547.PreparedInjectionScale

  instLTNat.lt 0 J →

            Exists fun N₀ =>
              ∀ (N : Nat),
                instLENat.le N₀ N →
                  ∀ (p m : Nat),
                    instLENat.le p (instHDiv.hDiv N 8) →
                      instLENat.le m (instHDiv.hDiv N 100) →
                        And
                          (Lax342547.PreparedInjection.Budget K m t Cs p h N (instHDiv.hDiv ε (instHMul.hMul 2 J.cast)))
                          (Real.instLE.le
                            (instHMul.hMul J.cast
                              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHDiv.hDiv N 100)))
                                (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 N))))
                            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHDiv.hDiv ε 2) (instHPow.hPow N.cast c)))

concepts.title: Uniform primal-span avoidance
concepts.description: Exact random matrix vector laws and finite subspace counts bound intersections of the complete primal image with a fixed space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns
import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames
import Lax342547.PhaseAverages

/-!
---
title: Uniform primal-span avoidance
type: lemma
---
Exact random matrix vector laws and finite subspace counts bound intersections of the complete primal image with a fixed space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PrimalAvoidance

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

noncomputable def evalMatrix {B N : Type} [Fintype B] (c : B → Binary) :
    Matrix N B Binary →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) where
  toFun A := A.mulVec c
  map_add' A D := Matrix.add_mulVec A D c
  map_smul' a A := by simp [Matrix.smul_mulVec]

axiom evalMatrix_surjective {B N : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (c : B → Binary) (hc : c ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective (evalMatrix (N := N) c)

axiom matrix_vector_uniform {B N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq N] (c : B → Binary) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Binary)).map (fun A : Matrix N B Binary => A.mulVec c) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (N → Binary)

axiom uniform_subspace_mass {N : Type} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (N → Binary))) (fun v => v ∈ W) =
      (2 : ℝ)^Module.finrank Binary W/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N

axiom fixed_vector_subspace_mass {B N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq N] (c : B → Binary) (hc : c ≠ 0) (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Binary))) (fun A => A.mulVec c ∈ W) =
      (2 : ℝ)^Module.finrank Binary W/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N

axiom matrix_span_hit_mass {B N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq N] (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Binary)))
      (fun A => ∃ c : B → Binary,c ≠ 0 ∧ A.mulVec c ∈ W) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card B+Module.finrank Binary W)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N

axiom capped_matrix_span_hit {B N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq N] (μ : Matrix N B Binary → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcap : ∀ A,μ A ≤ L*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Binary)) A)
    (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) :
    cellMass μ (fun A => ∃ c : B → Binary,c ≠ 0 ∧ A.mulVec c ∈ W) ≤
      L*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card B+Module.finrank Binary W)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)

end Lax342547.PrimalAvoidance

capped_matrix_span_hit : ∀ {B N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq N]
  (μ : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary → Real) (L : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 L →
    (∀ (A : Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
        Real.instLE.le (μ A)
          (instHMul.hMul L
            (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)) A))) →
      ∀ (W : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
        Real.instLE.le
          (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun A =>
            Exists fun c => And (Ne c 0) (SetLike.instMembership.mem W (A.mulVec c)))
          (instHMul.hMul L
            (instHDiv.hDiv
              (instHPow.hPow 2
                (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B)
                  (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem W x))))
              (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N))))

evalMatrix_surjective : ∀ {B N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (c : B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Ne c 0 → Function.Surjective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.PrimalAvoidance.evalMatrix c))

fixed_vector_subspace_mass : ∀ {B N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq N]
  (c : B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Ne c 0 →
    ∀ (W : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      Eq
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
          (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))) fun A =>
          SetLike.instMembership.mem W (A.mulVec c))
        (instHDiv.hDiv
          (instHPow.hPow 2
            (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem W x)))
          (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N)))

matrix_span_hit_mass : ∀ {B N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq N]
  (W : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Real.instLE.le
    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))) fun A =>
      Exists fun c => And (Ne c 0) (SetLike.instMembership.mem W (A.mulVec c)))
    (instHDiv.hDiv
      (instHPow.hPow 2
        (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B)
          (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem W x))))
      (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N)))

matrix_vector_uniform : ∀ {B N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : DecidableEq B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq N]
  (c : B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Ne c 0 →
    Eq (PMF.map (fun A => A.mulVec c) (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

uniform_subspace_mass : ∀ {N : Type} [inst : Fintype N] [inst_1 : DecidableEq N]
  (W : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
      (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))) fun v =>
      SetLike.instMembership.mem W v)
    (instHDiv.hDiv
      (instHPow.hPow 2 (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem W x)))
      (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card N)))

concepts.title: Sparse residual contractions belong to the actual primal pins
concepts.description:
Pure nominal quotient responses put a tested individual contraction in
the barred space. Unselected sparse labels eliminate its key and private
terms, so the contraction lies in the actual primal pin intersection.
`DerivativeResponses` pairs this membership with the actual derivative
tests and table injection flags in both reciprocal modes.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BarredElimination
import Lax342547.TensorBlocks

/-!
---
title: Sparse residual contractions belong to the actual primal pins
type: lemma
---
Pure nominal quotient responses put a tested individual contraction in
the barred space. Unselected sparse labels eliminate its key and private
terms, so the contraction lies in the actual primal pin intersection.
`DerivativeResponses` pairs this membership with the actual derivative
tests and table injection flags in both reciprocal modes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PrimalContractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.SparsePins
open Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ResidualLabels

noncomputable def coordinates {B : Type} (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (B → Binary)) : B → Binary := by
  classical
  exact dualCoordinates ψ

axiom endpoint_vector {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M D E) (i : Fin 2)
    (T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)) (hE : E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ T)
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (B → Binary)) (hψ : T ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    primalEmbedding i ((M i).mulVecLin (coordinates ψ)) ∈ D

axiom sparse_contraction {Label Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (L : Finset Label)
    (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Binary)
    (v : Coord × Base → Binary) :
    (∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s (Z s)).mulVecLin v =
      ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p s
        (fun a => ∑ c, p s c.1 * Z s a c.2 * v c)

axiom unselected_pin_contraction {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (e : Component (Tag k))
    (hU : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U j))
    (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M (barred W P U (e, true)) (barred W P V (e, false)))
    (i : Fin 2) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : M i = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s))
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : projected P i (e, false) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    (M i).mulVecLin (coordinates ψ) ∈ pinnedPrimal P i (e, true)

axiom unselected_pin_contraction_mode {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (p : Bool) (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (e : Component (Tag k))
    (hU : ∀ j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, p)) (U j))
    (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M (barred W P U (e, p)) (barred W P V (e, !p)))
    (i : Fin 2) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (chosenLabels W i))
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : M i = ∑ s ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval s (Z s))
    (ψ : Module.Dual Binary (Vector k n b degree))
    (hψ : projected P i (e, !p) ⊔ individualKeys W i e ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    (M i).mulVecLin (coordinates ψ) ∈ pinnedPrimal P i (e, p)

end Lax342547.PrimalContractions

endpoint_vector : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype B] (M : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.Nominal B H)),
  Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates M D E →
    ∀ (i : Fin 2) (T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Submodule.map (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.primalProjection i) E) T →

sparse_contraction : ∀ {Label Coord Base : Type} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Fintype Base]
  (p : Label → Coord → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (L : Finset Label)
  (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (v : Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
      (L.sum fun s => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s) (Z s)).mulVecLin v)
    (L.sum fun s =>
      LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p s) fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun c => instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (p s c.fst) (Z s a c.snd)) (v c))

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A R →
    (∀ (i z : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z)), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (A i) (W.left i z t).label)) →
      ∀ (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
        (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
        (∀ (j : Fin 2), IsCompl (Lax342547.TableSpaces.protectedChannel P j { fst := e, snd := Bool.true }) (U j)) →
          ∀ (M : Fin 2 → Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree),
            Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates M
                (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P U { fst := e, snd := Bool.true })
                (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P V { fst := e, snd := Bool.false }) →
              ∀ (i : Fin 2) (L : Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
                instLENat.le L.card R →

                    ∀

                        (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) →
                          Matrix (Option (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n)) (Option (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n))
                            Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                      Eq (M i)
                          (L.sum fun s =>
                            LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                              (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s) (Z s)) →
                        ∀
                          (ψ :
                            Module.Dual Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Vector k n b degree)),
                          Submodule.instPartialOrder.le
                              (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max
                                (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i { fst := e, snd := Bool.false })
                                (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.individualKeys W i e))
                              (LinearMap.ker ψ) →
                            SetLike.instMembership.mem
                              (Lax342547.TableSpaces.pinnedPrimal P i { fst := e, snd := Bool.true })
                              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Matrix.mulVecLin (M i))
                                (Lax342547.PrimalContractions.coordinates ψ))

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)

concepts.title: Actual primal-channel scalar tests and retained-cell four-hole probability
concepts.description: The two nominal orientations of every raw component realize the actual cross forms. The paper primal-channel entry records are linear Gram tests, and their joint Fourier agreement implies all four actual holes under the constructed target gradients.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ComponentTests
import Lax342547.PrimalRecords
import Lax342547.PairedFrames
import Lax342547.PairRecovery

/-!
---
title: Actual primal-channel scalar tests and retained-cell four-hole probability
type: lemma
---
The two nominal orientations of every raw component realize the actual cross forms. The paper primal-channel entry records are linear Gram tests, and their joint Fourier agreement implies all four actual holes under the constructed target gradients.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PrimalGramTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.ReferencePins
open Lax342547.ProductImages Lax342547.RetainedCharacters Lax342547.CoefficientPhase
open Lax342547.ComponentTests Lax342547.PrimalRecords Lax342547.RawFrames

noncomputable def orientedForms {Comp B H : Type} (F : CrossForms Comp B H)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) :=
  if a.2 then F.forward a.1 else (F.reverse a.1).flip

noncomputable def leftMatrices {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : Matrix N (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) Binary := observationMatrix o a

noncomputable def rightMatrices {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : Matrix N (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) Binary := observationMatrix o (a.1,!a.2)

axiom gram_form_evaluation {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (X Y : Matrix N I Binary) (u v : I → Binary) :
    actualForm X Y u v = dotProduct (X.mulVec u) (Y.mulVec v)

axiom raw_oriented_forms {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (a : Comp × Bool) :
    actualForm (leftMatrices oA a) (rightMatrices oB a) = orientedForms (rawForms oA oB) a

axiom matrix_pair_outer {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary)) (u v : I → Binary) : by
      classical
      exact matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) (Matrix.vecMulVec u v) = T u v

noncomputable def entryAxis {Comp B H : Type} (t : EntryIndex Comp B H) : Comp × Bool :=
  (t.2.2.1, decide ((t.1 = 0) ↔ (t.2.1 = 0)))

noncomputable def entryLeft {Comp B H : Type} (t : EntryIndex Comp B H) : (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary := by
  classical
  exact if t.1 = 0 then primalEmbedding t.2.2.2.1 (Pi.single t.2.2.2.2.2.1 1)
    else channelEmbedding t.2.2.2.2.1 (Pi.single t.2.2.2.2.2.2 1)

noncomputable def entryRight {Comp B H : Type} (t : EntryIndex Comp B H) : (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary := by
  classical
  exact if t.1 = 0 then channelEmbedding t.2.2.2.2.1 (Pi.single t.2.2.2.2.2.2 1)
    else primalEmbedding t.2.2.2.1 (Pi.single t.2.2.2.2.2.1 1)

noncomputable def entryTests {Comp B H : Type} (t : EntryIndex Comp B H)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : Matrix (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) Binary := by
  classical
  exact if a = entryAxis t then Matrix.vecMulVec (entryLeft t) (entryRight t) else 0

axiom entry_target_bits {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) : targetBits entryTests (orientedForms F) = entries F

axiom entry_actual_bits {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    actualBits entryTests (leftMatrices oA) (rightMatrices oB) = entries (rawForms oA oB)

axiom primal_entry_agreement {ΩA ΩB Comp B H N : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {M : Matrix B B Binary}

concepts.title: Finite primal-channel records with the paper bit count and four-hole implication
concepts.description: Recording both modes and reciprocal roles takes exactly 16|E|h dimB bits. Equality of these records fixes every actual primal-to-channel evaluation and hence every contraction. Matched keys, witness parity and the constructed gradients then force all four actual cross pairs to be holes.

import Lax342547.FourHoles

/-!
---
title: Finite primal-channel records with the paper bit count and four-hole implication
type: lemma
---
Recording both modes and reciprocal roles takes exactly 16|E|h dimB bits. Equality of these records fixes every actual primal-to-channel evaluation and hence every contraction. Matched keys, witness parity and the constructed gradients then force all four actual cross pairs to be holes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PrimalRecords

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.HoleRelation

abbrev EntryIndex (Comp B H : Type) := Fin 2 × Fin 2 × Comp × Fin 2 × Fin 2 × B × H

noncomputable def entries {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype H] (F : CrossForms Comp B H) :
    EntryIndex Comp B H → Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun t =>
    let G := if t.1 = 0 then F else F.flip
    let m := if t.2.1 = 0 then fullPlus G t.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.2.1
      else fullMinus G t.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.2.1
    m (Pi.single t.2.2.2.2.2.1 1) t.2.2.2.2.2.2

axiom entry_count {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] :
    Fintype.card (EntryIndex Comp B H) = 16 * Fintype.card Comp * Fintype.card H * Fintype.card B

def Agreement {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype H] (F G : CrossForms Comp B H) : Prop :=
  (∀ e i z, fullPlus F e i z = fullPlus G e i z ∧ fullMinus F e i z = fullMinus G e i z) ∧
  (∀ e i z, fullPlus F.flip e i z = fullPlus G.flip e i z ∧ fullMinus F.flip e i z = fullMinus G.flip e i z)

axiom coordinate_map_ext {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact (∀ b h, f (Pi.single b 1) h = g (Pi.single b 1) h) → f = g

axiom entries_determine {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F G : CrossForms Comp B H) (heq : entries F = entries G) : Agreement F G

axiom agreement_contractions {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F G : CrossForms Comp B H) (h : Agreement F G)
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) :
    (∀ i z, fullContraction F X i z = fullContraction G X i z) ∧
    (∀ i z, fullContraction F.flip X i z = fullContraction G.flip X i z)

axiom entries_give_four_holes {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (holes : HoleData (Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H N E)
      (Profile k n b degree) (Component (Tag k) → Matrix N N Binary))
    (hrole : holes.a = D.role) (hgradient : holes.T = gradient D L R)
    (hU : ∀ o, holes.U o = (profileMap o).comp (Profile k n b degree).subtype)
    (hu : ∀ o, holes.u o = profileContraction o)
    (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hroles : ∀ i z, D.role (leftWitness W i z) + D.role (rightWitness W i z) = 1)
    (G : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (heq : entries (rawForms oA oB) = entries G)
    (hleft : ∀ i z x, fullContraction G (Profile k n b degree) i z x =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x)
    (hright : ∀ i z x, fullContraction G.flip (Profile k n b degree) z i x =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (rightWitness W i z)) x) :
    ∀ i z, Hole holes (oA i) (oB z)

axiom record_count {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] :
    by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (EntryIndex Comp B H → Binary) =
        2 ^ (16 * Fintype.card Comp * Fintype.card H * Fintype.card B)

end Lax342547.PrimalRecords

      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
        Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H N E)
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x)
      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) → Matrix N N Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq holes.a D.role →

concepts.title: Retractions with bounded rank on the primal inputs
concepts.description:
When the table together with the primal space spans the nominal space,
one can retract onto table plus keys while preserving the primal space.
The rank on primal inputs costs only table-primal directions and keys,
and does not count the channel dimension.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrozenBaselines
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

/-!
---
title: Retractions with bounded rank on the primal inputs
type: lemma
---
When the table together with the primal space spans the nominal space,
one can retract onto table plus keys while preserving the primal space.
The rank on primal inputs costs only table-primal directions and keys,
and does not count the channel dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PrimalRetractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom bounded_retraction {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary V] (J Keys U : Submodule Binary V)
    (hspan : J ⊔ U = ⊤) (hKeys : Keys ≤ U) :
    ∃ p : V →ₗ[Binary] V,
      (∀ v, p v ∈ J ⊔ Keys) ∧ (∀ v ∈ J ⊔ Keys, p v = v) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ U, p v ∈ U) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (p.comp U.subtype)) ≤
        Module.finrank Binary ↥(J ⊓ U) + Module.finrank Binary Keys

end Lax342547.PrimalRetractions

statements.signature:
bounded_retraction : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] (J Keys U : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V),
  Eq (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J U) Submodule.instTop.top →
    Submodule.instPartialOrder.le Keys U →
      Exists fun p =>
        And (∀ (v : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J Keys) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe p v))
          (And
            (∀ (v : V),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (SemilatticeSup.toMax.max J Keys) v → Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe p v) v)
            (And
              (∀ (v : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem U v → SetLike.instMembership.mem U (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe p v))
              (instLENat.le
                (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                  (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (p.comp U.subtype).range x))
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
                    (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Submodule.instMin.min J U) x))

concepts.title: Exact images mixing independent injective frames
concepts.description:
Nominal directions are measured in the direct sum of all source frames.
Before conditioning, every independent tuple has an exactly uniform
ambient image. Conditioning each source frame to be injective costs at
most two per frame, uniformly over every possible tuple rank.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Exact images mixing independent injective frames
type: lemma
---
Nominal directions are measured in the direct sum of all source frames.
Before conditioning, every independent tuple has an exactly uniform
ambient image. Conditioning each source frame to be injective costs at
most two per frame, uniformly over every possible tuple rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProductImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameSymmetry Lax342547.RawFrames
open scoped ENNReal

def jointMatrix {Draw I N : Type} (A : Draw → Matrix N I Binary) : Matrix N (Draw × I) Binary :=
  fun n j => A j.1 n j.2

def jointEquiv {Draw I N : Type} : (Draw → Matrix N I Binary) ≃ Matrix N (Draw × I) Binary where
  toFun := jointMatrix
  invFun M i n j := M n (i, j)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def rightMap {I T N : Type} [Fintype I] (C : Matrix I T Binary) :
    Matrix N I Binary →ₗ[Binary] Matrix N T Binary where
  toFun A := A * C
  map_add' A B := Matrix.add_mul A B C
  map_smul' c A := Matrix.smul_mul c A C

axiom rank_restriction {I T : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype T]
    (C : Matrix I T Binary) :
    ∃ D : Matrix T (Fin C.rank) Binary, Function.Injective (C * D).mulVec

axiom right_uniform {I T N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype T] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
    (C : Matrix I T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N I Binary)).map (fun A => A * C) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N T Binary)

axiom joint_uniform {Draw I T N : Type} [Fintype Draw] [Fintype I] [Fintype T] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
    (C : Matrix (Draw × I) T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Matrix N I Binary)).map (fun A => jointMatrix A * C) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N T Binary)

axiom injective_image_bound {Draw I T N : Type}
    [Fintype Draw] [Fintype I] [Fintype T] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
    [Nonempty (Injection I N)] (hN : Fintype.card I + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : Matrix (Draw × I) T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (y : Matrix N T Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Injection I N)).map
      (fun A => jointMatrix (fun i => (A i).val) * C) y ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card Draw / 2 ^ (Fintype.card N * Fintype.card T)

axiom raw_plus_image_bound {Draw B H T N : Type}
    [Fintype Draw] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype T] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec)
    (y : Matrix N T Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Frame B H N E)).map
      (fun o => jointMatrix (fun i => (plus (o i)).val) * C) y ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card Draw / 2 ^ (Fintype.card N * Fintype.card T)

end Lax342547.ProductImages

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
  [inst_8 : Nonempty (Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.Injection I N)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card I) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (C : Matrix (Prod Draw I) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Function.Injective C.mulVec →
        ∀ (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
          ENNReal.instLE.le
            (PMF.instFunLike.coe
              (PMF.map
                (fun A =>
                  Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                    (Lax342547.ProductImages.jointMatrix fun i => (A i).val) C)
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.Injection I N)))
              y)

              (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) (Fintype.card T))))

  (C : Matrix (Prod Draw I) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective C.mulVec →
    Eq
      (PMF.map (fun A => Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Lax342547.ProductImages.jointMatrix A) C)
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

  [inst_4 : Fintype N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} [inst_10 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H)) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (C : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Function.Injective C.mulVec →
        ∀ (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
          ENNReal.instLE.le
            (PMF.instFunLike.coe
              (PMF.map
                (fun o =>
                  Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                    (Lax342547.ProductImages.jointMatrix fun i => (Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.plus (o i)).val) C)
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)))
              y)
            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card Draw))
              (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) (Fintype.card T))))

  [inst_4 : DecidableEq T] [inst_5 : DecidableEq N] (C : Matrix I T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective C.mulVec →
    Eq
      (PMF.map (fun A => Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A C)
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)))
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))

concepts.title: Joint minus images after exposing several plus frames
concepts.description:
After exposing all plus frames, their common annihilator loses at most
one full-frame dimension per draw. Every affine minus column contains
this translation space. Independent nominal tuples mixing all draws
therefore retain the stated number of uniform image bits, at any rank.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProductImages
import Lax342547.ConditionalMinus

/-!
---
title: Joint minus images after exposing several plus frames
type: lemma
---
After exposing all plus frames, their common annihilator loses at most
one full-frame dimension per draw. Every affine minus column contains
this translation space. Independent nominal tuples mixing all draws
therefore retain the stated number of uniform image bits, at any rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProductMinusImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConditionalMinus Lax342547.ProductImages
open scoped ENNReal

variable {Draw B H T N : Type} [Fintype Draw] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype T] [Fintype N]

def images {E : Matrix B B Binary} {P : Draw → Matrix N B Binary} {X : Draw → Matrix N H Binary}
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (z : ∀ i, ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i)) : Matrix N T Binary :=
  jointMatrix (fun i => Matrix.fromCols (z i).1.val (z i).2.val) * C

axiom affine_image_bound [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Draw → Matrix N B Binary) (X : Draw → Matrix N H Binary)
    (hPX : ∀ i, Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (P i) (X i)).mulVec)
    [∀ i, Nonempty (ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))]
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (y : Matrix N T Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ i, ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))).map (images C) y ≤
      1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card T *
        (Fintype.card N - Fintype.card Draw * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)))

axiom completion_image_bound [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (E : Matrix B B Binary) (P : Draw → Matrix N B Binary) (X : Draw → Matrix N H Binary)
    (hPX : ∀ i, Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (P i) (X i)).mulVec)
    [∀ i, Nonempty (ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))] [∀ i, Nonempty (Completion E (P i) (X i))]
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (y : Matrix N T Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (∀ i, Completion E (P i) (X i))).map
      (fun z => images C (fun i => (z i).val)) y ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card Draw / 2 ^ (Fintype.card T *
        (Fintype.card N - Fintype.card Draw * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)))

end Lax342547.ProductMinusImages

  [inst_4 : Fintype N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
  (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (P : Draw → Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (X : Draw → Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (i : Draw), Function.Injective ((P i).fromCols (X i)).mulVec) →
    ∀ [inst_9 : ∀ (i : Draw), Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))]
      (C : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Function.Injective C.mulVec →
        ∀ (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
          ENNReal.instLE.le
            (PMF.instFunLike.coe
              (PMF.map (Lax342547.ProductMinusImages.images C)
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((i : Draw) → Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))))
              y)

              (instHPow.hPow 2
                (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card T)
                  (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card N)
                    (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H)))))))

  [inst_4 : Fintype N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
  (E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (P : Draw → Matrix N B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (X : Draw → Matrix N H Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (i : Draw), Function.Injective ((P i).fromCols (X i)).mulVec) →
    ∀ [∀ (i : Draw), Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.ColumnProduct E (P i) (X i))]
      [inst_10 : ∀ (i : Draw), Nonempty (Lax342547.ConditionalMinus.Completion E (P i) (X i))],
      instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))) 1)
          (Fintype.card N) →

            ∀ (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
              ENNReal.instLE.le
                (PMF.instFunLike.coe

                        (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H)))))))

concepts.title: Counting tuples of symmetric matrices with bounded total rank
concepts.description:
Separate the component rank tuple from the symmetric factorizations.
There are at most (K+1)^|E| rank tuples, and each permitted tuple uses
at most dK+K² binary entries. This is the finite profile count underlying
the low-rank profile bound in Lemma 5.5, before substituting the concrete
coordinate dimension.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SymmetricFactorization
import Lax342547.ConcreteCut

/-!
---
title: Counting tuples of symmetric matrices with bounded total rank
type: lemma
---
Separate the component rank tuple from the symmetric factorizations.
There are at most (K+1)^|E| rank tuples, and each permitted tuple uses
at most dK+K² binary entries. This is the finite profile count underlying
the low-rank profile bound in Lemma 5.5, before substituting the concrete
coordinate dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProfileCounting

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom card_symmetric_profiles {I E : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype E] (K : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {x : E → Matrix I I Binary //
      (∀ e, (x e).transpose = x e) ∧ ∑ e, (x e).rank ≤ K} ≤
      (K + 1) ^ Fintype.card E * 2 ^ (Fintype.card I * K + K * K)

open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.TagGeometry

axiom card_concrete_profiles (k n b degree K : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {x : Profile k n b degree // ∑ e, (x.val e).rank ≤ K} ≤
      (K + 1) ^ Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) *
        2 ^ (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) * K + K * K)

end Lax342547.ProfileCounting

  instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun x => instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun e => Matrix.rank (x.val e)) K))
    (instHMul.hMul
      (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (Fintype.card (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))))
      (instHPow.hPow 2
        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree)) K)
          (instHMul.hMul K K))))
