  instLENat.le
    (Nat.card
      (Subtype fun x =>
        And (∀ (e : E), Eq (x e).transpose (x e)) (instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun e => (x e).rank) K)))
    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (Fintype.card E))
      (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) K) (instHMul.hMul K K))))

concepts.title: Split quotient projections preserve coefficient characters
concepts.description: Choose projections with the actual frozen space as kernel. Removing the projected coefficient matrix leaves a tensor annihilating every form on the two frozen quotients.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrozenCharacters
import Lax342547.TargetMatrices

/-!
---
title: Split quotient projections preserve coefficient characters
type: lemma
---
Choose projections with the actual frozen space as kernel. Removing the projected coefficient matrix leaves a tensor annihilating every form on the two frozen quotients.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProjectedCoefficients

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

axiom exists_quotient_projection {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (D : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) :
    ∃ p : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary),
      D.mkQ.comp p = D.mkQ ∧ LinearMap.ker p = D ∧ p.comp p = p

axiom projection_preserves_quotient_pairing {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (p q : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hp : D.mkQ.comp p = D.mkQ) (hq : E.mkQ.comp q = E.mkQ) : by
      classical
      exact PureAnnihilates (C - p.toMatrix' * C * q.toMatrix'.transpose) D E

end Lax342547.ProjectedCoefficients

statements.signature:
exists_quotient_projection : ∀ {I : Type} [Fintype I] (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Exists fun p => And (Eq (D.mkQ.comp p) D.mkQ) (And (Eq p.ker D) (Eq (p.comp p) p))

  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (p q :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (D.mkQ.comp p) D.mkQ →
    Eq (E.mkQ.comp q) E.mkQ →
      Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates
        (instHSub.hSub C
          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' p) C)
            (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' q).transpose))
        D E

concepts.description: The rank-deficit inequality applied to actual column quotients and row restrictions bounds nonzero remaining terms by the projected sum rank and both original-space exposure deficits.

import Lax342547.ListDeficits
import Lax342547.CoverProjection

/-!
---
title: Projected nonzero terms in the actual remaining sum
type: lemma
---
The rank-deficit inequality applied to actual column quotients and row restrictions bounds nonzero remaining terms by the projected sum rank and both original-space exposure deficits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProjectedCounts

open Lax342547.CoverProjection Lax342547.GreedyTails
open scoped BigOperators

axiom projected_nonzero_count {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) : by
      classical
      exact ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i : l.toFinset => projection (M i.val) S T ≠ 0)).card : ℝ) ≤

        deficit (fun i => LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap) T l

concepts.description: The actual shared projected endpoint tensor supplies its own minimal factorization; its covered offsets have total dimension at most twice the projected rank.

import Lax342547.QuotientFactorLifts

/-!
---
title: Offsets constructed from the actual common projection
type: lemma
---
The actual shared projected endpoint tensor supplies its own minimal factorization; its covered offsets have total dimension at most twice the projected rank.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProjectedOffsets



axiom actual_common_projection_offsets {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (M₁ M₂ : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hS₁ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₁) S) (hT₁ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₁.dualMap) T)
    (hS₂ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₂) S) (hT₂ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₂.dualMap) T)
    (hcommon : Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₁ S T = Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₂ S T) :
    ∃ P₁ P₂ : LinearMap.range (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₁ S T) →ₗ[K] W,
    ∃ Q₁ Q₂ : V →ₗ[K] LinearMap.range (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₁ S T),
      P₁.comp Q₁ = M₁ ∧ P₂.comp Q₂ = M₂ ∧
      LinearMap.range (P₁-P₂) ≤ S ∧ LinearMap.range (Q₁-Q₂).dualMap ≤ T ∧
      Disjoint (LinearMap.range P₁) S ∧ Disjoint (LinearMap.range Q₂.dualMap) T ∧
      M₁-M₂ = (P₁-P₂).comp Q₂+P₁.comp (Q₁-Q₂) ∧
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (P₁-P₂))+
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (Q₁-Q₂).dualMap) ≤
        2*Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₁ S T))

axiom nonzero_difference_has_offset {K U V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (P₁ P₂ : U →ₗ[K] W) (Q₁ Q₂ : V →ₗ[K] U)
    (hne : P₁.comp Q₁ ≠ P₂.comp Q₂) : P₁-P₂ ≠ 0 ∨ Q₁-Q₂ ≠ 0

end Lax342547.ProjectedOffsets

  (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (M₁ M₂ : LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W),
  Disjoint M₁.range S →
    Disjoint M₁.dualMap.range T →
      Disjoint M₂.range S →

                                  (Eq (instHSub.hSub M₁ M₂)
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd ((instHSub.hSub P₁ P₂).comp Q₂) (P₁.comp (instHSub.hSub Q₁ Q₂))))

concepts.title: Primal projections and preservation of effective spaces
concepts.description:
Pins can mix endpoints and channels. Their endpoint primal spaces are
therefore projections. Enlarging pins preserves these spaces and the
cut profiles supported in their tensor products.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ExactPins
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul

/-!
---
title: Primal projections and preservation of effective spaces
type: lemma
---
Pins can mix endpoints and channels. Their endpoint primal spaces are
therefore projections. Enlarging pins preserves these spaces and the
cut profiles supported in their tensor products.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProjectedPins

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins

def primalProjection {B H : Type} (i : Fin 2) :
    ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary) where
  toFun v b := v (i, Sum.inl b)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def projected {Comp B H N : Type} (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) : Submodule Binary (B → Binary) :=
  (P.space a).map (primalProjection i)

def tensorSpace {B : Type} (S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)) :
    Submodule Binary (Matrix B B Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary {M | ∃ v ∈ S, ∃ w ∈ T, M = Matrix.vecMulVec v w}

def effective {Comp B H N : Type} (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary))
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) : Submodule Binary X where
  carrier := {x | ∀ e, x.val e ∈ tensorSpace (projected P i (e, true)) (projected P i (e, false))}
  zero_mem' := fun _e => (tensorSpace _ _).zero_mem
  add_mem' := fun hx hy e => (tensorSpace _ _).add_mem (hx e) (hy e)
  smul_mem' := fun c _ hx e => (tensorSpace _ _).smul_mem c (hx e)

axiom projected_rank {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) :
    (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (projected P i a)) ≤ P.rank

axiom projected_mono {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (h : P.Extends Q) (i : Fin 2) :
    ∀ a, projected P i a ≤ projected Q i a

axiom effective_mono {Comp B H N : Type} (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary))
    (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (h : P.Extends Q) (i : Fin 2) :
    effective X P i ≤ effective X Q i

end Lax342547.ProjectedPins

  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N),
  P.Extends Q →
    ∀ (i : Fin 2),
      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.effective X P i) (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.effective X Q i)

      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i a) (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected Q i a)

        (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.projected P i a) x))
    P.rank

concepts.description: An actual independent witness tuple has uniform transpose images, giving the exact probability that every image lies in a prescribed protected coefficient space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw

/-!
---
title: Exact probabilities for independent protected channel images
type: lemma
---
An actual independent witness tuple has uniform transpose images, giving the exact probability that every image lies in a prescribed protected coefficient space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ProtectedChannels

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal

noncomputable def columnSpaceEquiv {I H : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype H]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :
    {Z : Matrix H I Binary // ∀ i,(fun h => Z h i) ∈ S} ≃ (I → S) where
  toFun Z := fun i => ⟨fun h => Z.val h i,Z.property i⟩
  invFun v := ⟨fun h i => (v i).val h,fun i => (v i).property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

axiom protected_columns_card {I H : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype H]
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :
    Nat.card {Z : Matrix H I Binary // ∀ i,(fun h => Z h i) ∈ S} =
      2^(Module.finrank Binary S*Fintype.card I)

axiom independent_protected_probability {I H N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)))
      (fun Y => ∀ i,(fun h => (Y.transpose*D) h i) ∈ S) =
      (2 : ℝ)^(Module.finrank Binary S*Fintype.card I)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*Fintype.card I)

axiom protected_probability_rank_bound {I H N : Type}
    [Fintype I] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    (D : Matrix N I Binary) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (K : ℕ) (hS : Module.finrank Binary S ≤ K) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N H Binary)))
      (fun Y => ∀ i,(fun h => (Y.transpose*D) h i) ∈ S) ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(K*Fintype.card I)/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card H*Fintype.card I)

end Lax342547.ProtectedChannels

concepts.title: Pure obstructions on the actual pair of cut profiles
concepts.description:
The independent component responses on barred nominal quotients define
functionals on the pair of actual cut profiles. Annihilation gives the
2K+28 component-rank bound and hence a bounded label decomposition.
Derivative responses and the final obstruction-space reduction remain
separate obligations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BarredSpaces
import Lax342547.LabelDecomposition

/-!
---
title: Pure obstructions on the actual pair of cut profiles
type: lemma
---
The independent component responses on barred nominal quotients define
functionals on the pair of actual cut profiles. Annihilation gives the
2K+28 component-rank bound and hence a bounded label decomposition.
Derivative responses and the final obstruction-space reduction remain
separate obligations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PureObstructions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.BarredSpaces
open Lax342547.BaseMoments

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

abbrev Parameters (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) :=
  ∀ e, (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (U e) (e, true)) →ₗ[Binary]
    (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P (V e) (e, false)) →ₗ[Binary] Binary

def endpointComponent (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree) where
  toFun x i := (x i).val e
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

noncomputable def response (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (β : Parameters W P U V) : (Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ e, (pureResponse (barred W P (U e) (e, true))
    (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (β e)).comp (endpointComponent e)

def Annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) : Prop := ∀ β, response W P U V β x = 0

axiom component_annihilation (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P U V x)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    PairedAnnihilates (endpointComponent e x)
      (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (barred W P (V e) (e, false))

axiom component_rank [Fintype H] {K : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P U V x) :
    ∀ i e, ((x i).val e).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28

axiom component_labels [Fintype H] {K : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P U V x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∀ i e, ∃ L : Finset (Fin b → Binary),
    ∃ Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary,
      L.card ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧ (∀ s ∈ L, IsBaseMoment (Z s)) ∧
      (∑ s ∈ L, (Z s).rank) ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
      ∀ a c, (x i).val e a c = ∑ s ∈ L, selectorEval s a.1 * selectorEval s c.1 * Z s a.2 c.2

end Lax342547.PureObstructions

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (U V :
    Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
      Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (x : Fin 2 → Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
  Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x →
    ∀ (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
      Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators.PairedAnnihilates
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.PureObstructions.endpointComponent e) x)
        (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P (U e) { fst := e, snd := Bool.true })
        (Lax342547.BarredSpaces.barred W P (V e) { fst := e, snd := Bool.false })

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    ∀
      (U V :
        Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
          Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
      (x : Fin 2 → Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x →
        instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 6 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28)) 4) degree →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2) (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
            Exists fun L =>
              Exists fun Z =>
                And (instLENat.le L.card (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28))
                  (And
                    (∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                      SetLike.instMembership.mem L s → Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment (Z s))

                      (∀ (a c : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree),
                        Eq ((x i).val e a c)
                          (L.sum fun s =>
                            instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s a.fst)
                                (Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s c.fst))
                              (Z s a.snd c.snd)))))

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram

/-!
---
title: Exact pure-flavor tester room and a law-uniform Gram mass floor
type: lemma
---
The paper's pure flavor retains exactly k*(2k+1-|T0|)*r tester pairs.
Prescribing their affine coefficients gives a positive Gram mass floor
uniform over tags and excluded sets and independent of the free dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PureTesterRoom
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.Atoms
open Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false


def pureOutside {k : ℕ} (T₀ : Finset (Tag k)) : Flavor k := by
  classical
  exact .pure (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Tag k × Tag k => p.2 ∉ T₀))

def retainedBlocksEquiv {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k)) :
    {q : TesterBlock k // blockRetained l (pureOutside T₀) q} ≃
      ({d : Tag k // l ∈ interval k d} × {t : Tag k // t ∉ T₀}) where
  toFun q := by
    rcases q with ⟨q,hq⟩
    cases q with
    | none => simp [blockRetained,pureOutside] at hq
    | some q =>
      have hh : l ∈ interval k q.1 ∧ q.2 ∉ T₀ := by simpa [blockRetained,pureOutside] using hq
      exact (⟨q.1,hh.1⟩,⟨q.2,hh.2⟩)
  invFun p := ⟨some (p.1.val,p.2.val),by simpa [blockRetained,pureOutside] using And.intro p.1.property p.2.property⟩
  left_inv q := by
    rcases q with ⟨q,hq⟩
    cases q with
    | none => simp [blockRetained,pureOutside] at hq
    | some q => rfl
  right_inv p := by rfl

def uniformFloor (k r : ℕ) (D : Type) [Fintype D] : ℝ :=
  1/(2 : ℝ)^(2*k*(2*k+1)*r*Fintype.card (Option D))

axiom allowed_drivers_card (k : ℕ) (l : Tag k) :
    by classical exact Fintype.card {d : Tag k // l ∈ interval k d} = k

axiom pure_pairs_card {k r : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k)) :
    Fintype.card (Pairs l (pureOutside T₀) r) = k*(2*k+1-T₀.card)*r

axiom pure_gram_cell_mass {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k))
    (hroom : Fintype.card (Option D) ≤ k*(2*k+1-T₀.card)*r)
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    massFloor l (pureOutside T₀) r D ≤ cellMass
      (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l (pureOutside T₀) D)))
      (fun V => (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) = G)

axiom slots_card {k r : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) :
    Fintype.card (Slots l f r) = 2*Fintype.card (Pairs l f r)

axiom uniformFloor_pos (k r : ℕ) (D : Type) [Fintype D] :
    0 < uniformFloor k r D

axiom uniform_floor_bound {k r : ℕ} (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k))
    (D : Type) [Fintype D] : uniformFloor k r D ≤ massFloor l (pureOutside T₀) r D

axiom uniform_pure_gram_mass {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D : Type} [Fintype D]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k))
    (hroom : Fintype.card (Option D) ≤ k*(2*k+1-T₀.card)*r)
    (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Binary) :
    uniformFloor k r D ≤ cellMass
      (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l (pureOutside T₀) D)))
      (fun V => (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) = G)

end
end Lax342547.PureTesterRoom

    ∀ (G : Matrix (Option D) (Option D) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

concepts.title: Walsh bounds for independent image laws and separated phases
concepts.description: Image pushforwards and conditional bounded weights translate the finite Walsh bound to arbitrary orientation laws, preserving separate phases from frozen vectors.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Walsh

/-!
---
title: Walsh bounds for independent image laws and separated phases
type: lemma
---
Image pushforwards and conditional bounded weights translate the finite Walsh bound to arbitrary orientation laws, preserving separate phases from frozen vectors.
-/

namespace Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh

noncomputable def push {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) (x : X) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ω, if image ω = x then ρ ω else 0

axiom push_nonneg {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (x : X) : 0 ≤ push ρ image x

axiom push_total {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype X] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) :
    ∑ x, push ρ image x = ∑ ω, ρ ω

axiom push_integral {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype X]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) (f : X → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, push ρ image x * f x = ∑ ω, ρ ω * f (image ω)

axiom signed_push_bound {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ w : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (hw : ∀ ω, |w ω| ≤ 1) (x : X) :
    |push (fun ω => ρ ω * w ω) image x| ≤ push ρ image x

noncomputable def conditionalWeight {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ w : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  push (fun ω => ρ ω * w ω) image x / push ρ image x

axiom conditional_weight_bound {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ w : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω)
    (hw : ∀ ω, |w ω| ≤ 1) (x : X) : |conditionalWeight ρ w image x| ≤ 1

axiom conditional_weight_reconstruction {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ w : Ω → ℝ) (image : Ω → X) (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω)
    (hw : ∀ ω, |w ω| ≤ 1) (x : X) :
    push ρ image x * conditionalWeight ρ w image x =
      push (fun ω => ρ ω * w ω) image x

axiom image_walsh_bound {ΩA ΩB I : Type} [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ) (imageA : ΩA → I → Binary) (imageB : ΩB → I → Binary)
    (f : ΩA → ℝ) (g : ΩB → ℝ) (pA pB : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b)
    (hαsum : ∑ a, α a ≤ 1) (hβsum : ∑ b, β b ≤ 1)
    (hcapA : ∀ x, push α imageA x ≤ pA) (hcapB : ∀ y, push β imageB y ≤ pB)
    (hf : ∀ a, |f a| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ b, |g b| ≤ 1) :
    |∑ a, ∑ b, α a * β b * f a * g b * phase (imageA a) (imageB b)| ≤
      Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card I * pA * pB)

end Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh

statements.signature:
conditional_weight_bound : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ w : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le (abs (w ω)) 1) →
      ∀ (x : X), Real.instLE.le (abs (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.conditionalWeight ρ w image x)) 1

conditional_weight_reconstruction : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ w : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le (abs (w ω)) 1) →
      ∀ (x : X),
        Eq
          (instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push ρ image x)
            (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.conditionalWeight ρ w image x))
          (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push (fun ω => instHMul.hMul (ρ ω) (w ω)) image x)

image_walsh_bound : ∀ {ΩA ΩB I : Type} [inst : Fintype ΩA] [inst_1 : Fintype ΩB] [inst_2 : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (α : ΩA → Real)
  (β : ΩB → Real) (imageA : ΩA → I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (imageB : ΩB → I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (f : ΩA → Real) (g : ΩB → Real) (pA pB : Real),
  (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le 0 (α a)) →
    (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le 0 (β b)) →
      Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun a => α a) 1 →
        Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun b => β b) 1 →
          (∀ (x : I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push α imageA x) pA) →
            (∀ (y : I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary), Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push β imageB y) pB) →
              (∀ (a : ΩA), Real.instLE.le (abs (f a)) 1) →
                (∀ (b : ΩB), Real.instLE.le (abs (g b)) 1) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (abs
                      (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
                        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
                          instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (α a) (β b)) (f a)) (g b))
                            (Lax342547.Walsh.phase (imageA a) (imageB b))))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (Fintype.card I)) pA) pB).sqrt

push_integral : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype X] (ρ : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X) (f : X → Real),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun x => instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push ρ image x) (f x))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => instHMul.hMul (ρ ω) (f (image ω)))

push_nonneg : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) → ∀ (x : X), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push ρ image x)

push_total : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype X] (ρ : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun x => Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push ρ image x) (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => ρ ω)

signed_push_bound : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ w : Ω → Real) (image : Ω → X),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le (abs (w ω)) 1) →
      ∀ (x : X),
        Real.instLE.le (abs (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push (fun ω => instHMul.hMul (ρ ω) (w ω)) image x))
          (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push ρ image x)

concepts.title: Quadratic character bias on affine subspaces
concepts.description: Translation and character orthogonality give the actual quadratic sign bias from polar rank and its affine-subspace restriction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.Walsh
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Lax342547.FormalQuadratic

/-!
---
title: Quadratic character bias on affine subspaces
type: lemma
---
Translation and character orthogonality give the actual quadratic sign bias from polar rank and its affine-subspace restriction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuadraticBias

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh
open scoped BigOperators

axiom square_translation {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Fintype V]
    (f : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, f x)^2 = ∑ h, ∑ x, f x*f (x+h)

axiom polar_sign_product {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x) (x h : V) :
    sign (Q x)*sign (Q (x+h)) = sign (Q h+Q 0)*sign (B h x)

axiom quadratic_sign_square {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [Fintype V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x) :
    by
      classical
      exact (∑ x, sign (Q x))^2 = (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h => B h = 0),sign (Q h+Q 0)

axiom quadratic_bias_square_bound {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [Fintype V] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x) :
    ((∑ x, sign (Q x))/(Fintype.card V : ℝ))^2 ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range B)

axiom quadratic_bias_rank_bound {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [Fintype V] [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V) (r : ℕ)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x)
    (hrank : 2*r ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range B)) :
    |(∑ x, sign (Q x))/(Fintype.card V : ℝ)| ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^r

axiom affine_restricted_polar {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x)
    (S : Submodule Binary V) (w : V) (x h : S) :
    Q (w+(x+h).val)+Q (w+x.val)+Q (w+h.val)+Q w = (B.restrict S) h x

axiom affine_subspace_bias {V : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary V]
    (Q : V → Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary V) (S : Submodule Binary V) [Fintype S]
    (w : V) (r c : ℕ)
    (hpolar : ∀ x h, Q (x+h)+Q x+Q h+Q 0 = B h x)
    (hrank : 2*r ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range B))
    (hcodim : Module.finrank Binary V ≤ Module.finrank Binary S+c) :
    |(∑ x : S, sign (Q (w+x.val)))/(Fintype.card S : ℝ)| ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^(r-c)

end Lax342547.QuadraticBias

affine_restricted_polar : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V]
  (Q : V → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V),
  (∀ (x h : V),
      Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Q (instHAdd.hAdd x h)) (Q x)) (Q h)) (Q 0))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B h) x)) →
    ∀ (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V) (w : V) (x h : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x),
      Eq
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (Q (instHAdd.hAdd w (instHAdd.hAdd x h).val)) (Q (instHAdd.hAdd w x.val)))
            (Q (instHAdd.hAdd w h.val)))
          (Q w))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (B.restrict S) h) x)

  [FiniteDimensional Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] (Q : V → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (B : LinearMap.BilinForm Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V) (S : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V)
  [inst_3 : Fintype (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)] (w : V) (r c : Nat),

concepts.title: Linear point-tensor evaluations are Boolean quadratics
concepts.description: Actual outer-product tensors evaluated by an arbitrary linear functional have Boolean degree at most two; the checked nonvanishing bound exactifies error below one quarter.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BooleanWeight
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basis

/-!
---
title: Linear point-tensor evaluations are Boolean quadratics
type: lemma
---
Actual outer-product tensors evaluated by an arbitrary linear functional have Boolean degree at most two; the checked nonvanishing bound exactifies error below one quarter.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuadraticDegree

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation
open scoped BigOperators

axiom quadratic_function_degree {b : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (A : Matrix I I Binary) (z : I → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ selectorSpan b 1) :
    (fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j*z i x*z j x) ∈ selectorSpan b 2

axiom linear_outer_product_degree {b : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Matrix I I Binary)) (z : I → (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ selectorSpan b 1) :
    (fun x => φ (Matrix.of (fun i j => z i x*z j x))) ∈ selectorSpan b 2

axiom quadratic_error_exactification {b : ℕ} (f : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary)
    (hf : f ∈ selectorSpan b 2)
    (herr : Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (fun _ : Fin b → Binary => 1/(2 : ℝ)^b)
      (fun x => f x ≠ 0) < 1/4) : f = 0

end Lax342547.QuadraticDegree

concepts.title: Actual query keys independent modulo old pins
concepts.description: The incident selected rays in the actual four witness lists are independent modulo the combined nominal pins. The proof uses the existing indexed fresh-label exclusion, with fourteen distinct rays per endpoint.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QueryReference
import Lax342547.PairedKeys
import Lax342547.KeySpans
import Lax342547.TableSpaces

/-!
---
title: Actual query keys independent modulo old pins
type: lemma
---
The incident selected rays in the actual four witness lists are independent modulo the combined nominal pins. The proof uses the existing indexed fresh-label exclusion, with fourteen distinct rays per endpoint.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QueryIndependence

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QueryReference Lax342547.QuerySlots
open Lax342547.PairedKeys Lax342547.KeySpans Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

noncomputable def keyMap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (ComponentPosition W e → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] ((Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun c => ∑ p, c p • ray (H := H) (degree := degree) (labels W) (bases W) p.val
      map_add' := by intro c d; simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by intro s c; simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul] }

axiom actual_key_independence {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) :
    Function.Injective ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (keyMap (H := H) W a.1))

end Lax342547.QueryIndependence

actual_key_independence : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes P A →
    (∀ (i z : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z)), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (A i) (W.left i z t).label)) →
      ∀ (a : Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool),
        Function.Injective
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe ((P.space a).mkQ.comp (Lax342547.QueryIndependence.keyMap W a.fst)))

concepts.title: Actual query frozen spaces and linear record exponents
concepts.description: The actual key-map range is precisely the selected incident key span. Joined pin/key dimensions and the concrete nominal column budget give a record exponent linear in n, with no ambient-image charge.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.JoinedRecords
import Lax342547.RawQueryImages

/-!
---
title: Actual query frozen spaces and linear record exponents
type: lemma
---
The actual key-map range is precisely the selected incident key span. Joined pin/key dimensions and the concrete nominal column budget give a record exponent linear in n, with no ambient-image charge.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QueryRecordBounds

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QueryReference Lax342547.QueryIndependence
open Lax342547.JoinedRecords Lax342547.PairedKeys Lax342547.KeySpans

axiom key_map_range {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) :
    LinearMap.range (keyMap (H := H) W e) = keys (H := H) W e

axiom record_linear_bound {Axis I Status : Type}
    [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype Status]
    (dims : Axis → ℕ) (columnCoef n K k s : ℕ)
    (hcolumns : Fintype.card I ≤ columnCoef*n) (hdims : (∑ a, dims a) ≤ K+k)
    (hstatus : Fintype.card Status ≤ 2^(s*n)) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (RecordType Axis I dims Status) ≤ 2^((columnCoef*(K+k)+s)*n)

axiom actual_nominal_column_linear_bound {H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (k n b degree hcoef : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hH : Fintype.card H ≤ hcoef*n) :
    Fintype.card (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) ≤
      (2 * (Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) * (Fintype.card (Tag k)^2+4) + hcoef)) * n

axiom actual_joined_rank_budget {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool,
        Module.finrank Binary (joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a)) ≤
          P.rank + Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)

end Lax342547.QueryRecordBounds

statements.signature:
actual_joined_rank_budget : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
  instLENat.le
    (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
      Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
        (Subtype fun x =>
          SetLike.instMembership.mem
            (Lax342547.JoinedRecords.joined P (fun a => Lax342547.QueryIndependence.keyMap W a.fst) a) x))
    (instHAdd.hAdd P.rank (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)))

actual_nominal_column_linear_bound : ∀ {H : Type} [inst : Fintype H] (k n b degree hcoef : Nat),
  instLENat.le 1 n →
    instLENat.le (Fintype.card H) (instHMul.hMul hcoef n) →
      instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)))
        (instHMul.hMul
          (instHMul.hMul 2
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree))
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (Fintype.card (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) 2) 4))
              hcoef))
          n)

key_map_range : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H : Type}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  Eq (Lax342547.QueryIndependence.keyMap W e).range (Lax342547.PairedKeys.keys W e)

record_linear_bound : ∀ {Axis I Status : Type} [inst : Fintype Axis] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype Status] (dims : Axis → Nat)
  (columnCoef n K k s : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Fintype.card I) (instHMul.hMul columnCoef n) →
    instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun a => dims a) (instHAdd.hAdd K k) →
      instLENat.le (Fintype.card Status) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul s n)) →
        instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Lax342547.JoinedRecords.RecordType Axis I dims Status))
          (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul columnCoef (instHAdd.hAdd K k)) s) n))

concepts.title: Reference keys and matched keys for actual paired lists
concepts.description: Global key tuples contain both nominal signs of every actual incident witness direction. Their equality gives matched keys; the constrained reference space has the exact slot cardinality bound and a dimension-independent positive density.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QuerySlots
import Lax342547.ReferenceKeys
import Lax342547.PairedWitnesses

/-!
---
title: Reference keys and matched keys for actual paired lists
type: lemma
---
Global key tuples contain both nominal signs of every actual incident witness direction. Their equality gives matched keys; the constrained reference space has the exact slot cardinality bound and a dimension-independent positive density.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QueryReference

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QuerySlots Lax342547.ReferenceKeys
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open scoped ENNReal

abbrev ComponentPosition {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) :=
  {p : Lax342547.QuerySlots.Position W // (W.left p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2).tag ∈ e.val}

noncomputable def groupedSlots {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    Slot W ≃ (Σ e : Component (Tag k), ComponentPosition W e × Bool) where
  toFun x := ⟨x.2.1.val, ⟨⟨x.1, x.2.1.property⟩, x.2.2⟩⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.2.1.val, ⟨⟨x.1, x.2.1.property⟩, x.2.2⟩⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

noncomputable def gram {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    Matrix (ComponentPosition W e) (ComponentPosition W e) Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun p q => if p.val = q.val then diagonalBit hr (W.left p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2) else 0

noncomputable def leftTuple {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) :
    Tuples (Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N := fun e =>
  ⟨fun n p => (o p.val.1 e).P.mulVec (W.left p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).vector n,
    fun n p => (o p.val.1 e).Q.mulVec (W.left p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).vector n⟩

noncomputable def rightTuple {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) :
    Tuples (Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N := fun e =>
  ⟨fun n p => (o p.val.2.1 e).P.mulVec (W.right p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).vector n,
    fun n p => (o p.val.2.1 e).Q.mulVec (W.right p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).vector n⟩

axiom tuple_equality_matched_keys {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (h : leftTuple W oA = rightTuple W oB) : MatchedKeys W oA oB

axiom component_position_budget {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Component (Tag k)) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (ComponentPosition W e) ≤ 28

axiom grouped_slot_count {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (Slot W) = 2 * ∑ e, Fintype.card (ComponentPosition W e)

axiom key_space_size {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {N : Type} [Fintype N]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (space (ComponentPosition W) N (gram W)) ≤
        2 ^ (Fintype.card (Slot W) * Fintype.card N)

axiom key_space_density {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {N : Type} [Fintype N]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (hN : 57 ≤ Fintype.card N) : by
      classical
      exact (∏ e, 1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^
        (Fintype.card (ComponentPosition W e) * Fintype.card (ComponentPosition W e) + 2)) ≤
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Tuples (Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)).toOuterMeasure
          (space (ComponentPosition W) N (gram W))

end Lax342547.QueryReference

        instHDiv.hDiv 1

              (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W e))
                (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W e)))

      (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype
            (Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))
              (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W) N)).toOuterMeasure
        (Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.space (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W) N
          (Lax342547.QueryReference.gram W)))

    (Fintype.card
      (Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.space (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W) N
          (Lax342547.QueryReference.gram W)).Elem)
    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)) (Fintype.card N)))

concepts.title: The actual paired-list key slot budget
concepts.description: Counting both signs and every incident component in all four bounded witness lists gives at most 56(g-1) ambient vector slots.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.StarRouting
import Lax342547.PairedWitnesses

/-!
---
title: The actual paired-list key slot budget
type: lemma
---
Counting both signs and every incident component in all four bounded witness lists gives at most 56(g-1) ambient vector slots.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuerySlots

open Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.StarRouting

abbrev Position {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :=
  Σ i : Fin 2, Σ z : Fin 2, Fin (W.length i z)

abbrev Slot {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :=
  Σ p : Position W, {e : Component (Tag k) // (W.left p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2).tag ∈ e.val} × Bool

axiom incident_count {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) :
    Fintype.card {e : Component (Tag k) // l ∈ e.val} = 2 * k

axiom position_count {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    Fintype.card (Position W) = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ z : Fin 2, W.length i z

axiom position_budget {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    Fintype.card (Position W) ≤ 28

axiom slot_count {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    Fintype.card (Slot W) = Fintype.card (Position W) * (4 * k)

axiom slot_budget {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) :
    Fintype.card (Slot W) ≤ 56 * (Fintype.card (Tag k) - 1)

end Lax342547.QuerySlots

incident_count : ∀ {k : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k),
  Eq (Fintype.card (Subtype fun e => SetLike.instMembership.mem e.val l)) (instHMul.hMul 2 k)

slot_budget : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr),
  instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W))
    (instHMul.hMul 56 (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) 1))

slot_count : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr),
  Eq (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W))
    (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Position W)) (instHMul.hMul 4 k))

concepts.title: Compression on the actual barred nominal quotients
concepts.description: Base compression fixes frozen pins, selected keys, and private channels. It descends through the actual barred spaces with the paper quotient-rank bound, and precomposition bounds a pure bilinear form while retaining its response on compressed component matrices.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BaseCompression
import Lax342547.ResidualRealization

/-!
---
title: Compression on the actual barred nominal quotients
type: lemma
---
Base compression fixes frozen pins, selected keys, and private channels. It descends through the actual barred spaces with the paper quotient-rank bound, and precomposition bounds a pure bilinear form while retaining its response on compressed component matrices.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuotientCompression

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.BaseCompression
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces
open Lax342547.CutProfiles

def nominalLift {B H : Type} (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) :
    Nominal B H →ₗ[Binary] Nominal B H where
  toFun v q := match q.2 with
    | Sum.inl b => f q.1 (primalProjection q.1 v) b
    | Sum.inr h => v (q.1, Sum.inr h)
  map_add' v w := by
    ext ⟨i, b | h⟩
    · exact congrFun ((f i).map_add _ _) b
    · rfl
  map_smul' c v := by
    ext ⟨i, b | h⟩
    · exact congrFun ((f i).map_smul c _) b
    · rfl

axiom nominalLift_primal {B H : Type}
    (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (i : Fin 2) (v : B → Binary) :
    nominalLift (H := H) f (primalEmbedding i v) = primalEmbedding i (f i v)

axiom nominalLift_fix {B H : Type}
    (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (v : Nominal B H)
    (h : ∀ i, f i (primalProjection i v) = primalProjection i v) : nominalLift f v = v

axiom nominalLift_sum {B H : Type}
    (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary)) (v : Nominal B H) :
    nominalLift f v = ∑ i, (primalEmbedding i (f i (primalProjection i v)) +
      channelEmbedding i (channelProjection i v))

axiom barred_fixed {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (f : Fin 2 → Vector k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Vector k n b degree)
    (hfix : ∀ i v, v ∈ projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1 → f i v = v) :
    ∀ v ∈ barred W P U a, nominalLift f v = v

axiom quotient_lift_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary))
    (hD : D ≤ D.comap (nominalLift f))
    (S U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hcompl : ∀ i, IsCompl (S i) (U i))
    (hprivate : ∀ i, (U i).map (channelEmbedding (B := B) i) ≤ D) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (D.mapQ D (nominalLift f) hD)) ≤
      ∑ i, (Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (f i)) + Module.finrank Binary (S i))

axiom barred_compression {k n b degree r K Dblk : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool)
    (U : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hcompl : ∀ i, IsCompl (protectedChannel P i a) (U i))
    (A : Fin 2 → Block k → (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Fin n → Binary))
    (hA : ∀ i q, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (A i q)) ≤ Dblk)
    (hfix : ∀ i v, v ∈ projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1 →
      liftBase (blockMap (A i)) v = v) :
    ∃ q : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P U a) →ₗ[Binary]
        (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P U a),
      (∀ v, q ((barred W P U a).mkQ v) = (barred W P U a).mkQ
        (nominalLift (fun i => liftBase (blockMap (A i))) v)) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range q) ≤
        2 * Fintype.card (SelectorCoordinates b degree) *
          (1 + ((2 * k + 1)^2 + 3) * Dblk) + 2 * K

axiom compressed_bilinear_rank {A B : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module Binary B] [FiniteDimensional Binary A]
    (β : A →ₗ[Binary] B →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (q : A →ₗ[Binary] A) (p : B →ₗ[Binary] B) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (β.compl₁₂ q p)) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range q)

axiom pure_compressed {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H))
    (β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (f : Fin 2 → (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (B → Binary))
    (qD : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ D))
    (qE : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E))
    (hD : ∀ v, qD (D.mkQ v) = D.mkQ (nominalLift f v))
    (hE : ∀ v, qE (E.mkQ v) = E.mkQ (nominalLift f v))
    (x : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary) :
    pureResponse D E (β.compl₁₂ qD qE) x =
      pureResponse D E β (fun i => tensorMap (f i) (x i))

end Lax342547.QuotientCompression

concepts.title: Extracting fresh label coefficients through pin quotients
concepts.description:
The stronger sparse exclusion permits a selected coefficient to be read
from the quotient by a projected pin. This is a first ingredient for
isolating selected blocks in the §6 annihilator argument. The extractor
also descends through selected key spans after quotienting its output
by the corresponding base ray. Applying it to the actual label summands
remains a separate step.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
---
title: Extracting fresh label coefficients through pin quotients
type: lemma
---
The stronger sparse exclusion permits a selected coefficient to be read
from the quotient by a projected pin. This is a first ingredient for
isolating selected blocks in the §6 annihilator argument. The extractor
also descends through selected key spans after quotienting its output
by the corresponding base ray. Applying it to the actual label summands
remains a separate step.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuotientExtractors

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.SparsePins Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions

axiom quotient_factor {C V W : Type}
    [AddCommGroup C] [Module Binary C] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W] (D : Submodule Binary V)
    (f : C →ₗ[Binary] V) (g : C →ₗ[Binary] W)
    (h : ∀ c, f c ∈ D → g c = 0) :
    ∃ q : (V ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] W, q.comp (D.mkQ.comp f) = g

axiom pin_extractor {Base Comp H N : Type} {b degree R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hL : L.card ≤ R + 14) (s : Fin b → Binary) (hs : s ∈ L) (hfresh : s ∉ A i) :
    ∃ q : ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base → Binary) ⧸ projected P i a) →ₗ[Binary]
        (Option Base → Binary),
      ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ v : Option Base → Binary,
        q ((projected P i a).mkQ (labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) t v)) =
          if t = s then v else 0

axiom key_extractor {Base Comp H N I : Type} {b degree R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hL : L.card ≤ R + 14) (s : Fin b → Binary) (hs : s ∈ L) (hfresh : s ∉ A i)
    (label : I → Fin b → Binary) (base : I → Option Base → Binary)
    (hlabels : ∀ j, label j ∈ L) (Ray : Submodule Binary (Option Base → Binary))
    (hmatch : ∀ j, label j = s → base j ∈ Ray) :
    ∃ q : ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base → Binary) ⧸
        (projected P i a ⊔ Submodule.span Binary
          (Set.range (fun j => labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) (label j) (base j))))) →ₗ[Binary]

      ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ v : Option Base → Binary,
        q (Submodule.Quotient.mk (labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) t v)) =
          if t = s then Ray.mkQ v else 0

end Lax342547.QuotientExtractors

concepts.description: Common minimal quotient factors lift to actual endpoint factors, with covered differences, independent companion spaces, and the precise offset dimension budget.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CoverAvoidance
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
---
title: Actual factor lifts and covered offsets
type: lemma
---
Common minimal quotient factors lift to actual endpoint factors, with covered differences, independent companion spaces, and the precise offset dimension budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuotientFactorLifts



axiom lift_common_factor {K D U V W X : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup D] [Module K D] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (π : W →ₗ[K] X) (C : U →ₗ[K] X) (M : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (B : D →ₗ[K] V) (R : D →ₗ[K] U)
    (hC : Function.Injective C) (hR : Function.Surjective R)
    (hπ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M) (LinearMap.ker π))
    (hrange : LinearMap.range (M.comp B) = LinearMap.range M)
    (hcommon : π.comp (M.comp B) = C.comp R) :
    ∃ P : U →ₗ[K] W, ∃ Q : V →ₗ[K] U,
      P.comp Q = M ∧ π.comp P = C ∧ Q.comp B = R

axiom restriction_range_of_avoidance {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (hT : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M.dualMap) T) :
    LinearMap.range (M.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype) = LinearMap.range M

axiom lift_quotient_factor {K U V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (C : U →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S)) (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (R : T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] U)
    (hC : Function.Injective C) (hR : Function.Surjective R)
    (hS : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M) S) (hT : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M.dualMap) T)
    (hfactor : Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M S T = C.comp R) :
    ∃ P : U →ₗ[K] W, ∃ Q : V →ₗ[K] U,
      P.comp Q = M ∧ S.mkQ.comp P = C ∧ Q.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype = R

axiom column_difference_in_cover {K U W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (C : U →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S)) (P₁ P₂ : U →ₗ[K] W)
    (h₁ : S.mkQ.comp P₁ = C) (h₂ : S.mkQ.comp P₂ = C) :
    LinearMap.range (P₁-P₂) ≤ S

axiom row_difference_in_cover {K U V : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (R : T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] U)
    (Q₁ Q₂ : V →ₗ[K] U)
    (h₁ : Q₁.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype = R)
    (h₂ : Q₂.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype = R) :
    LinearMap.range (Q₁-Q₂).dualMap ≤ T

axiom factor_difference_identity {K U V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (P₁ P₂ : U →ₗ[K] W) (Q₁ Q₂ : V →ₗ[K] U) :
    P₁.comp Q₁-P₂.comp Q₂ = (P₁-P₂).comp Q₂+P₁.comp (Q₁-Q₂)

axiom lifted_column_avoids_cover {K U W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (C : U →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S)) (P : U →ₗ[K] W)
    (hC : Function.Injective C) (hP : S.mkQ.comp P = C) :
    Disjoint (LinearMap.range P) S

axiom offset_dimension_budget {K U V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    (P : U →ₗ[K] W) (Q : V →ₗ[K] U) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range P)+Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range Q.dualMap) ≤
      2*Module.finrank K U

axiom lifted_row_avoids_cover {K U V : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)) (R : T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] U)
    (Q : V →ₗ[K] U) (hR : Function.Surjective R)
    (hQ : Q.comp T.dualCoannihilator.subtype = R) :
    Disjoint (LinearMap.range Q.dualMap) T

axiom common_quotient_offsets {K U V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (C : U →ₗ[K] (W ⧸ S)) (R : T.dualCoannihilator →ₗ[K] U)
    (M₁ M₂ : V →ₗ[K] W) (hC : Function.Injective C) (hR : Function.Surjective R)
    (hS₁ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₁) S) (hT₁ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₁.dualMap) T)
    (hS₂ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₂) S) (hT₂ : Disjoint (LinearMap.range M₂.dualMap) T)
    (h₁ : Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₁ S T = C.comp R)
    (h₂ : Lax342547.CoverProjection.projection M₂ S T = C.comp R) :
    ∃ P₁ P₂ : U →ₗ[K] W, ∃ Q₁ Q₂ : V →ₗ[K] U,
      P₁.comp Q₁ = M₁ ∧ P₂.comp Q₂ = M₂ ∧
      LinearMap.range (P₁-P₂) ≤ S ∧ LinearMap.range (Q₁-Q₂).dualMap ≤ T ∧
      Disjoint (LinearMap.range P₁) S ∧ Disjoint (LinearMap.range Q₂.dualMap) T ∧
      M₁-M₂ = (P₁-P₂).comp Q₂+P₁.comp (Q₁-Q₂) ∧
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (P₁-P₂))+
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (Q₁-Q₂).dualMap) ≤ 2*Module.finrank K U

end Lax342547.QuotientFactorLifts

concepts.description: Projecting the coefficient tensor to complements of the frozen spaces gives rank factors whose quotient images are injective. This is the exact independence needed for conditional image entropy.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedCoefficients
import Lax342547.RankFactors

/-!
---
title: Rank factors independent modulo the actual frozen spaces
type: lemma
---
Projecting the coefficient tensor to complements of the frozen spaces gives rank factors whose quotient images are injective. This is the exact independence needed for conditional image entropy.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuotientFactors

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom factor_range {I J R : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype R]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (A : Matrix I R Binary) (B : Matrix J R Binary)
    (hC : A * B.transpose = C) (hA : Function.Injective A.mulVec)
    (hr : Fintype.card R = C.rank) : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range C.mulVecLin

axiom projection_range_quotient_injective {V U : Type}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [AddCommGroup U] [Module Binary U]
    (D : Submodule Binary V) (p : V →ₗ[Binary] V)
    (hp : LinearMap.ker p = D) (hpid : p.comp p = p)
    (A : U →ₗ[Binary] V) (hA : Function.Injective A)
    (hrange : LinearMap.range A ≤ LinearMap.range p) : Function.Injective (D.mkQ.comp A)

axiom quotient_independent_factors {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (p q : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hp : LinearMap.ker p = D) (hq : LinearMap.ker q = E)
    (hpid : p.comp p = p) (hqid : q.comp q = q) : by
      classical
      let Z := p.toMatrix' * C * q.toMatrix'.transpose
      exact ∃ A : Matrix I (Fin Z.rank) Binary, ∃ B : Matrix I (Fin Z.rank) Binary,
        A * B.transpose = Z ∧ Function.Injective (D.mkQ.comp A.mulVecLin) ∧
          Function.Injective (E.mkQ.comp B.mulVecLin)

end Lax342547.QuotientFactors

factor_range : ∀ {I J R : Type} [Fintype I] [inst : Fintype J] [inst_1 : Fintype R] (C : Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (A : Matrix I R Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B : Matrix J R Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A B.transpose) C →
    Function.Injective A.mulVec → Eq (Fintype.card R) C.rank → Eq A.mulVecLin.range C.mulVecLin.range

projection_range_quotient_injective : ∀ {V U : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup U]
  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary U] (D : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V)
  (p : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V V),
  Eq p.ker D →
    Eq (p.comp p) p →
      ∀ (A : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) U V),
        Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A) →
          Submodule.instPartialOrder.le A.range p.range → Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (D.mkQ.comp A))

quotient_independent_factors : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Fintype I] (C : Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (D E : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (p q :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq p.ker D →
    Eq q.ker E →
      Eq (p.comp p) p →
        Eq (q.comp q) q →
          let Z :=
            Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' p) C)
              (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.toMatrix' q).transpose;
          Exists fun A =>
            Exists fun B =>
              And (Eq (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A B.transpose) Z)
                (And (Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (D.mkQ.comp A.mulVecLin)))
                  (Function.Injective (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (E.mkQ.comp B.mulVecLin))))

concepts.title: Rank of a tensor killed in two quotient spaces
concepts.description:
The component-rank step in the annihilator argument of §6. Killing a
matrix after projecting both factors loses at most the sum of the two
kernel dimensions.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas

/-!
---
title: Rank of a tensor killed in two quotient spaces
type: lemma
---
The component-rank step in the annihilator argument of §6. Killing a
matrix after projecting both factors loses at most the sum of the two
kernel dimensions.
-/

namespace Lax342547.QuotientRank

axiom killed_composition_rank {K U V W X : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : W →ₗ[K] X) (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : U →ₗ[K] V)
    (h : A.comp (M.comp B) = 0) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A) +
        (Module.finrank K V - Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B))

axiom killed_matrix_rank {K I J P Q : Type} [Field K]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    (A : Matrix P I K) (M : Matrix I J K) (B : Matrix Q J K)
    (h : A * M * B.transpose = 0) :
    M.rank ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) +
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin)

axiom killed_quotients_rank {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : Module.Dual K V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K V)
    (h : S.mkQ.comp (M.comp T.mkQ.dualMap) = 0) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M) ≤ Module.finrank K S + Module.finrank K T

end Lax342547.QuotientRank

    instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem M.range x))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem A.ker x))
        (instHSub.hSub (Module.finrank K V) (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem B.range x))))

      (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A M)
        B.transpose)

    instLENat.le M.rank
      (instHAdd.hAdd (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem A.mulVecLin.ker x))

        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)))

concepts.title: Rank-controlled pure forms on the actual barred quotients
concepts.description: Projection away from the actual pin/key spaces yields pure quotient forms whose bilinear rank is at most the sum of the two individual target-matrix ranks. The projection loss remains at most 2K+28 per individual. This supplies the initial pure-form rank needed when restoring the compressed residual correction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ResponseMatrices

/-!
---
title: Rank-controlled pure forms on the actual barred quotients
type: lemma
---
Projection away from the actual pin/key spaces yields pure quotient forms whose bilinear rank is at most the sum of the two individual target-matrix ranks. The projection loss remains at most 2K+28 per individual. This supplies the initial pure-form rank needed when restoring the compressed residual correction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RankedProjection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.ResponseMatrices
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces

axiom bilinear_comp_rank {A B V X : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module Binary B] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary B]
    (β : A →ₗ[Binary] B →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (f : V →ₗ[Binary] A) (g : X →ₗ[Binary] B) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (β.compl₁₂ f g)) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β)

axiom matrix_bilinear_rank {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M : Matrix B B Binary) :
    by
      classical
      exact Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toBilin' M)) ≤ M.rank

axiom linear_add_rank {V X : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (f g : V →ₗ[Binary] X) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (f + g)) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f) + Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range g)

axiom linear_sum_rank {I V X : Type} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X] [FiniteDimensional Binary X]
    (f : I → V →ₗ[Binary] X) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (∑ i, f i)) ≤
      ∑ i, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (f i))

axiom projected_endpoint_response {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (i : Fin 2) (M A C : Matrix B B Binary)
    (hD : D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin)
    (hE : E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker C.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      pureResponse D E β = (matrixPair (A.transpose * M * C)).comp (LinearMap.proj i) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) ≤ M.rank

axiom projected_paired_response {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (M A C : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary)
    (hD : ∀ i, D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker (A i).mulVecLin)
    (hE : ∀ i, E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker (C i).mulVecLin) :
    ∃ β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      pureResponse D E β = ∑ i, (matrixPair ((A i).transpose * M i * C i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) ≤ ∑ i, (M i).rank

axiom actual_pure_projection {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree) :
    ∃ (A C : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
      (β : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P U (e, true)) →ₗ[Binary]
        (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P V (e, false)) →ₗ[Binary] Binary),
      pureResponse (barred W P U (e, true)) (barred W P V (e, false)) β =
        ∑ i, (matrixPair ((A i).transpose * M i * C i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i) ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range β) ≤ ∑ i, (M i).rank ∧
      ∀ i, (M i - (A i).transpose * M i * C i).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        ((A i).transpose * M i * C i).rank ≤ (M i).rank

end Lax342547.RankedProjection

                (∀ (i : Fin 2),
                  And

import Lax342547.ProductImages

/-!
---
title: Full rank coefficient factorizations
type: lemma
---
Every binary coefficient matrix factors into two independently injective tuples of exactly its rank. These tuples supply the independent image directions in the nonzero quotient character test.
-/

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom independent_rank_factors {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) :
    ∃ A : Matrix I (Fin C.rank) Binary, ∃ B : Matrix J (Fin C.rank) Binary,
      A * B.transpose = C ∧ Function.Injective A.mulVec ∧ Function.Injective B.mulVec

end Lax342547.RankFactors

concepts.title: Rank loss under two restrictions
concepts.description: A composition loses at most the output kernel dimension and the input range codimension, including the two quotient modes of a tensor.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Lax342547.QuotientRank

/-!
---
title: Rank loss under two restrictions
type: lemma
---
A composition loses at most the output kernel dimension and the input range codimension, including the two quotient modes of a tensor.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RankLoss



axiom composition_rank_loss {K U V W X : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (A : W →ₗ[K] X) (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (B : U →ₗ[K] V) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (A.comp (M.comp B))) +
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A) +
        (Module.finrank K V-Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B))

axiom matrix_sandwich_rank_loss {K I J P Q : Type} [Field K]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    (A : Matrix P I K) (M : Matrix I J K) (B : Matrix Q J K) :
    M.rank ≤ (A*M*B.transpose).rank +
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) +
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin)

axiom quotient_tensor_rank_loss {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : Module.Dual K V →ₗ[K] W) (S : Submodule K W) (T : Submodule K V) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (S.mkQ.comp (M.comp T.mkQ.dualMap))) +
      Module.finrank K S+Module.finrank K T

end Lax342547.RankLoss

concepts.description: Actual raw primal frames and channel images discharge the finite sampling hypotheses; an early channel margin gives an exponential absolute accepting-pair loss.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AcceptingInjection
import Lax342547.InjectionBudgets
import Lax342547.InjectiveDensity

/-!
---
title: Raw accepting-family injection with exponential loss
type: lemma
---
Actual raw primal frames and channel images discharge the finite sampling hypotheses; an early channel margin gives an exponential absolute accepting-pair loss.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawAcceptingInjection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.FiniteInjection
open Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
open scoped BigOperators

axiom capped_frame_channel {B P N H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype P] [Fintype N] [Fintype H]
    [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq H] (E : Matrix P P Binary) [Nonempty (Frame P H N E)]
    (β : B → ℝ) (image : B → Frame P H N E) (channel : Frame P H N E → Matrix N H Binary)
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hcap : ∀ f,push β image f ≤ M*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E)) f)
    (hraw : ∀ y,push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame P H N E))) channel y ≤

concepts.title: Bounded baselines for both actual cross orientations
concepts.description:
For admissible tables and fresh paired lists, construct the two full
nominal cross forms simultaneously. Each retains the actual pin/key
entries, extends the whole table, and has the paper's 3K+28 bound in
both reciprocal primal-to-channel orientations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PairedKeys
import Lax342547.NominalBaselines

/-!
---
title: Bounded baselines for both actual cross orientations
type: lemma
---
For admissible tables and fresh paired lists, construct the two full
nominal cross forms simultaneously. Each retains the actual pin/key
entries, extends the whole table, and has the paper's 3K+28 bound in
both reciprocal primal-to-channel orientations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawBaselines

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes Lax342547.PairedKeys
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.SmallTables
open Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.ReferencePins
open Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.FrozenBaselines Lax342547.KeySpans

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
  {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}

def Frozen (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) : Prop :=
  ∀ e,
    ExtendsFrozen (P.space (e, true)) (keys W e) (Q.space (e, false)) (keys (flip W) e)
      ((rawForms oA oB).forward e) (F.forward e) ∧
    ExtendsFrozen (Q.space (e, true)) (keys (flip W) e) (P.space (e, false)) (keys W e)
      ((rawForms oA oB).reverse e) (F.reverse e)

def Bounded (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (K : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ e z,
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.forward e).compl₁₂ primal.subtype
      (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.forward e).flip.compl₁₂ primal.subtype
      (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.reverse e).compl₁₂ primal.subtype
      (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.reverse e).flip.compl₁₂ primal.subtype
      (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ 3 * K + 28

axiom raw_baselines (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A) (hB : Excludes Q B)
    (hfresh : FreshAgainst W A B) (K : ℕ) (hP : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (T : Table P Q)
    (hadmissible : Admissible T observation observation oA oB) :
    ∃ F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H,
      Extends F T ∧ Frozen F W P Q oA oB ∧ Bounded F K

end Lax342547.RawBaselines
