concepts.title: Bounded tests under the actual two-batch Gram law
concepts.description:
The union orbit is exactly the product of its separate orbit laws conditioned
on reciprocal Gram entries and joint column injectivity. Removing only the
joint-injectivity event costs its actual conditional mass; the remaining
comparison uses the separately capped batch laws and independent Gram characters.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.JoinedGramOrbits
import Lax342547.JointGramInjection

/-!
---
title: Bounded tests under the actual two-batch Gram law
type: lemma
---
The union orbit is exactly the product of its separate orbit laws conditioned
on reciprocal Gram entries and joint column injectivity. Removing only the
joint-injectivity event costs its actual conditional mass; the remaining
comparison uses the separately capped batch laws and independent Gram characters.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawBatchComparison
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity Lax342547.RetainedImages
open scoped BigOperators

variable {I J K L N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] [Fintype N]
  [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq N]

def flat (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (z : Orbit N G × Orbit N H) :
    (N × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (N × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) :=
  (batchEquiv z.1.val,batchEquiv z.2.val)
def target (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary) :
    Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L → Binary
  | Sum.inl (i,l) => A i l
  | Sum.inr (j,k) => B k j

axiom union_conditional_integral (n : ℕ) (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) G)] [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) H)]
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))]
    (test : ((Fin n × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) × (Fin n × (K ⊕ L) → Binary)) → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : Orbit (Fin n) (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H),
      weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) z*test (Lax342547.JointGramInjection.ambientEquiv.symm z.val)) =
    ∑ x,conditionalLaw (fun x => batchLaw G x.1*batchLaw H x.2)
      (fun x => Lax342547.CrossBatchMixing.crossBits Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.tests n x = target A B ∧
        Lax342547.JointGramInjection.Good x) x*test x

axiom union_test_comparison (n : ℕ) (G : Matrix I J Binary) (H : Matrix K L Binary)
    (A : Matrix I L Binary) (B : Matrix K J Binary)
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) G)] [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) H)]
    [Nonempty (Orbit (Fin n) (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H))]
    (f : (Fin n × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ n)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)) :
    |(∑ z : Orbit (Fin n) (Matrix.fromBlocks G A B H),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) z*
        (f (Lax342547.JointGramInjection.ambientEquiv.symm z.val).1*
          g (Lax342547.JointGramInjection.ambientEquiv.symm z.val).2))-
      (∑ x,batchLaw G x*f x)*(∑ y,batchLaw H y*g y)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+2)*

concepts.title: Both actual cross orientations have retained-cell image entropy
concepts.description: Actual query-key independence and the exact leaf caps give all-rank matrix-image bounds on the original retained cells. Reindexing the second nominal orientation preserves ranks and uses the same key-slot exponent.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafBlockCaps
import Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions
import Lax342547.FrozenCellDirections
import Lax342547.PinReindexing

/-!
---
title: Both actual cross orientations have retained-cell image entropy
type: lemma
---
Actual query-key independence and the exact leaf caps give all-rank matrix-image bounds on the original retained cells. Reindexing the second nominal orientation preserves ranks and uses the same key-slot exponent.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawCellEntropy

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TagGeometry
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QueryReference Lax342547.QueryIndependence
open Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.JoinedRecords Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.KeySpans
open Lax342547.RawQueryImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.ComponentCharacters
open Lax342547.PrimalGramTests
open scoped ENNReal

axiom left_cell_block_cap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (p : PMF (Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M)))
    (P : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (C : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M) → Prop) (hCkey : ∀ o, C o → leftTuple W o = q)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (hζsmall : ζ ≤ 1/1000)
    (hk : 2*ζ*Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) ≤ (1/500 : ℝ))
    (hCmass : (2 : ℝ)^(-((Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) : ℝ)+1/100)*Fintype.card N) ≤
      (p.toOuterMeasure {o | C o}).toReal)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event observation) ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(-(1-2*ζ)*Fintype.card N))^(P.relativeRank Q))
    (ranks : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool → ℕ)
    (F : ∀ a, Matrix (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) (Fin (ranks a)) Binary)
    (hF : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((joined P (fun a => keyMap (H := H) W a.1) a).mkQ.comp (F a).mulVecLin))
    (y : ((Σ a, Fin (ranks a)) × N) → Binary) : by
      classical
      exact Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push (subtypeWeights (weights p) C)
        (fun o => blockImage F (leftMatrices o.val)) y ≤
          (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, ranks a)*Fintype.card N))

axiom right_cell_block_cap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {M : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (p : PMF (Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M)))
    (P : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.right i z t).label ∉ A z)
    (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (C : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := M) → Prop) (hCkey : ∀ o, C o → rightTuple W o = q)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (hζsmall : ζ ≤ 1/1000)
    (hk : 2*ζ*Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) ≤ (1/500 : ℝ))
    (hCmass : (2 : ℝ)^(-((Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) : ℝ)+1/100)*Fintype.card N) ≤
      (p.toOuterMeasure {o | C o}).toReal)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N, 1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q →
      p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event observation) ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)^(-(1-2*ζ)*Fintype.card N))^(P.relativeRank Q))
    (ranks : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool → ℕ)
    (F : ∀ a, Matrix (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) (Fin (ranks a)) Binary)
    (hF : ∀ a, Function.Injective ((joined (Lax342547.PinReindexing.pull Lax342547.PinReindexing.opposite P)
      (fun a => keyMap (H := H) (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) a.1) a).mkQ.comp (F a).mulVecLin))
    (y : ((Σ a, Fin (ranks a)) × N) → Binary) : by
      classical
      exact Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push (subtypeWeights (weights p) C)
        (fun o => blockImage F (rightMatrices o.val)) y ≤
          (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*((∑ a, ranks a)*Fintype.card N))

end Lax342547.RawCellEntropy

concepts.title: Actual frame observations realize the nominal channel contractions
concepts.description:
The full cross forms of two raw units are their actual plus/minus Gram
pairings. Their primal/channel contractions agree with the original trace
contraction of frame tensors, on the whole profile space and hence on
every effective profile where a table is extended.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TableContractions

/-!
---
title: Actual frame observations realize the nominal channel contractions
type: lemma
---
The full cross forms of two raw units are their actual plus/minus Gram
pairings. Their primal/channel contractions agree with the original trace
contraction of frame tensors, on the whole profile space and hence on
every effective profile where a table is extended.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawContractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.ReferencePins

variable {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Matrix B B Binary}

def rawForms (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) : CrossForms Comp B H :=
  ⟨fun e => (dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ (observation oA (e, true))
      (observation oB (e, false)),
    fun e => (dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ (observation oB (e, true))
      (observation oA (e, false))⟩

axiom observation_blocks (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) (s : Bool) (i : Fin 2)
    (v : B → Binary) (w : H → Binary) :
    observation o (e, s) (primalEmbedding i v) =
      (if s then (o i e).P.mulVec v else (o i e).Q.mulVec v) ∧
    observation o (e, s) (channelEmbedding i w) =
      (if s then (o i e).X.mulVec w else (o i e).Y.mulVec w)

axiom raw_contraction [Fintype Comp] (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (i z : Fin 2) (x : X) :
    fullContraction (rawForms oA oB) X i z x =
      profileContraction (oB z) (profileMap (oA i) x.val)

axiom raw_star_contraction [Fintype Comp] (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (hT : TableContractions.Extends (rawForms oA oB) T)
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (i z : Fin 2) (x : effective X P i) :
    starContraction T X i z x = profileContraction (oB z) (profileMap (oA i) x.val.val)

end Lax342547.RawContractions

concepts.description:
Independent combined coefficient columns give a comparison for arbitrary
separate bounded tests under the actual raw frame law, or under the full

import Lax342547.RawBatchComparison

/-!
---
title: Actual raw frame observations with uniform two-batch decay
type: lemma
---
Independent combined coefficient columns give a comparison for arbitrary
separate bounded tests under the actual raw frame law, or under the full
self-channel Gram fiber law. The explicit threshold and error constants
depend only on the four fixed column counts and not on their Gram entries.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawFrameComparison
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity Lax342547.RawFrames
open scoped BigOperators

def errorBound (n : ℕ) (I J K L : Type) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+2)*
    ((((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
      ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n))+
      (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))*
        (((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card K)+(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card J+Fintype.card L))/(2 : ℝ)^n)))

def scale (I J K L : Type) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+2)*
    ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
    ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))*
    (1+((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I+Fintype.card K)+(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card J+Fintype.card L)))

axiom errorBound_half_decay (n : ℕ) (I J K L : Type)
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] :
    errorBound n I J K L ≤ scale I J K L/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n)

axiom eventually_valid (I J K L : Type) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L] :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ,∀ n ≥ n₀,Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ n ∧
      Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ n ∧
      ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
        1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)

variable {I J K L : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
variable {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]

axiom primal_test_comparison [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] (n : ℕ) (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H (Fin n) E)]
    (C₁ : Matrix B I Binary) (D₁ : Matrix B J Binary)
    (C₂ : Matrix B K Binary) (D₂ : Matrix B L Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols C₁ C₂).mulVec)
    (hD : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D₁ D₂).mulVec)
    (f : (Fin n × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ n)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card K*Fintype.card L+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots I J K L)+1)) :
    |(∑ F : Frame B H (Fin n) E,weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) F*
        (f (batchEquiv (F.P*C₁,F.Q*D₁))*g (batchEquiv (F.P*C₂,F.Q*D₂))))-
      (∑ F : Frame B H (Fin n) E,weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) F*f (batchEquiv (F.P*C₁,F.Q*D₁)))*
      (∑ F : Frame B H (Fin n) E,weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) F*g (batchEquiv (F.P*C₂,F.Q*D₂)))| ≤
        errorBound n I J K L

axiom full_test_comparison [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] (n : ℕ) (E : Matrix B B Binary) (S : Matrix H H Binary)
    [Nonempty (ChannelFiber (N := Fin n) E S)]
    (C₁ : Matrix (B ⊕ H) I Binary) (D₁ : Matrix (B ⊕ H) J Binary)
    (C₂ : Matrix (B ⊕ H) K Binary) (D₂ : Matrix (B ⊕ H) L Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols C₁ C₂).mulVec)
    (hD : Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols D₁ D₂).mulVec)
    (f : (Fin n × (I ⊕ J) → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n × (K ⊕ L) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hN₁ : Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : Fintype.card K+Fintype.card L+1 ≤ n)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)

concepts.title: Raw matrix frames and their tensor realization
concepts.description:
The four matrices $P,Q,X,Y$ satisfy the full-frame injectivity and
Gram constraints (2.13). The tensor embedding is $Z\mapsto PZQ^T$.
The channel contraction is $\operatorname{tr}(XY^T\xi)$, equal to
the entrywise pairing $\langle YX^T,\xi\rangle$ in (2.15).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace

/-!
---
title: Raw matrix frames and their tensor realization
type: lemma
---
The four matrices $P,Q,X,Y$ satisfy the full-frame injectivity and
Gram constraints (2.13). The tensor embedding is $Z\mapsto PZQ^T$.
The channel contraction is $\operatorname{tr}(XY^T\xi)$, equal to
the entrywise pairing $\langle YX^T,\xi\rangle$ in (2.15).
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawFrames

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

variable (B H N : Type) [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

structure Frame (E : Matrix B B Binary) where
  P : Matrix N B Binary
  Q : Matrix N B Binary
  X : Matrix N H Binary
  Y : Matrix N H Binary
  plus_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) => P.mulVec z.1 + X.mulVec z.2)
  minus_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun z : (B → Binary) × (H → Binary) => Q.mulVec z.1 + Y.mulVec z.2)
  gram : P.transpose * Q = E
  plus_annihilator : X.transpose * Q = 0
  minus_annihilator : P.transpose * Y = 0

variable {B H N}

abbrev FrameData := Matrix N B Binary × Matrix N B Binary × Matrix N H Binary × Matrix N H Binary

def frameData {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) : FrameData (B := B) (H := H) (N := N) :=
  (F.P, F.Q, F.X, F.Y)

theorem frameData_injective {E : Matrix B B Binary} :
    Function.Injective (frameData (E := E) (H := H) (N := N)) := by
  intro F G h
  cases F
  cases G
  simp only [frameData, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨hP, hQ, hX, hY⟩ := h
  cases hP
  cases hQ
  cases hX
  cases hY
  rfl

noncomputable instance {E : Matrix B B Binary} : Fintype (Frame B H N E) :=
  by classical exact Fintype.ofInjective frameData frameData_injective

def sandwich (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) : Matrix B B Binary →ₗ[Binary] Matrix N N Binary where
  toFun Z := P * Z * Q.transpose
  map_add' Z W := by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  map_smul' c Z := by simp [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

def contraction {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E) :
    Matrix N N Binary →ₗ[Binary] Binary where
  toFun Z := Matrix.trace (F.X * F.Y.transpose * Z)
  map_add' Z W := by simp [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.trace_add]
  map_smul' c Z := by simp [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul]

variable {Comp : Type}

def profileMap {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    (Comp → Matrix B B Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Comp → Matrix N N Binary) where
  toFun x e := sandwich (F e).P (F e).Q (x e)
  map_add' x y := by ext e i j; simp
  map_smul' c x := by ext e i j; simp

def profileContraction [Fintype Comp] {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    (Comp → Matrix N N Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ e, (contraction (F e)).comp (LinearMap.proj e)

axiom tensor_realization {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Comp → Frame B H N E) [Fintype Comp] :
    Function.Injective (profileMap F) ∧
      ∀ x, profileContraction F (profileMap F x) = 0

end Lax342547.RawFrames

import Lax342547.GroupTensorComparison

/-!
---
title: Actual grouped raw observations with arbitrary common tests
type: lemma
---
Nominal joint independence is checked separately in every component and
sign. Independent raw frame groups then compare arbitrary common tests of
the separate observed arrays, with the sum of their explicit two-batch
errors. Both Gram matrices and column dimensions may vary by group.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawGroupedComparison

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.GramOrbitDensity
open Lax342547.FrameTuples Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.RawFrameComparison
open scoped BigOperators

variable {S B H : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
  {I J K L : S → Type} [∀ s,Fintype (I s)] [∀ s,Fintype (J s)]
  [∀ s,Fintype (K s)] [∀ s,Fintype (L s)]

axiom primal_groups [∀ s,DecidableEq (I s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (J s)]
    [∀ s,DecidableEq (K s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (L s)] (n : ℕ) (E : S → Matrix B B Binary)
    [∀ s,Nonempty (Frame B H (Fin n) (E s))]
    (C₁ : ∀ s,Matrix B (I s) Binary) (D₁ : ∀ s,Matrix B (J s) Binary)
    (C₂ : ∀ s,Matrix B (K s) Binary) (D₂ : ∀ s,Matrix B (L s) Binary)
    (hC : ∀ s,Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (C₁ s) (C₂ s)).mulVec)
    (hD : ∀ s,Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (D₁ s) (D₂ s)).mulVec)
    (f : (∀ s,Fin n × (I s ⊕ J s) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (g : (∀ s,Fin n × (K s ⊕ L s) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hN₁ : ∀ s,Fintype.card (I s)+Fintype.card (J s)+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : ∀ s,Fintype.card (K s)+Fintype.card (L s)+1 ≤ n)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : ∀ s,((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (I s)*Fintype.card (J s)+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (K s)*Fintype.card (L s)+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (I s) (J s) (K s) (L s))+1)) :
    |(∑ o : ∀ s,Frame B H (Fin n) (E s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        (f (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C₁ s,(o s).Q*D₁ s))*
          g (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C₂ s,(o s).Q*D₂ s))))-
      (∑ o : ∀ s,Frame B H (Fin n) (E s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        f (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C₁ s,(o s).Q*D₁ s)))*
      (∑ o : ∀ s,Frame B H (Fin n) (E s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        g (fun s => batchEquiv ((o s).P*C₂ s,(o s).Q*D₂ s)))| ≤
      ∑ s,errorBound n (I s) (J s) (K s) (L s)

axiom full_groups [∀ s,DecidableEq (I s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (J s)]
    [∀ s,DecidableEq (K s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (L s)] (n : ℕ) (E : S → Matrix B B Binary) (T : S → Matrix H H Binary)
    [∀ s,Nonempty (ChannelFiber (N := Fin n) (E s) (T s))]
    (C₁ : ∀ s,Matrix (B ⊕ H) (I s) Binary) (D₁ : ∀ s,Matrix (B ⊕ H) (J s) Binary)
    (C₂ : ∀ s,Matrix (B ⊕ H) (K s) Binary) (D₂ : ∀ s,Matrix (B ⊕ H) (L s) Binary)
    (hC : ∀ s,Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (C₁ s) (C₂ s)).mulVec)
    (hD : ∀ s,Function.Injective (Matrix.fromCols (D₁ s) (D₂ s)).mulVec)
    (f : (∀ s,Fin n × (I s ⊕ J s) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (g : (∀ s,Fin n × (K s ⊕ L s) → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hN₁ : ∀ s,Fintype.card (I s)+Fintype.card (J s)+1 ≤ n)
    (hN₂ : ∀ s,Fintype.card (K s)+Fintype.card (L s)+1 ≤ n)
    (hf : ∀ x,|f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y,|g y| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : ∀ s,((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (I s)*Fintype.card (J s)+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (K s)*Fintype.card (L s)+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^n) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (I s) (J s) (K s) (L s))+1)) :
    |(∑ o : ∀ s,ChannelFiber (N := Fin n) (E s) (T s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        (f (fun s => batchEquiv ((Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.plus (o s).val).val*C₁ s,(Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.minus (o s).val).val*D₁ s))*
          g (fun s => batchEquiv ((Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.plus (o s).val).val*C₂ s,(Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.minus (o s).val).val*D₂ s))))-
      (∑ o : ∀ s,ChannelFiber (N := Fin n) (E s) (T s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        f (fun s => batchEquiv ((Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.plus (o s).val).val*C₁ s,(Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.minus (o s).val).val*D₁ s)))*
      (∑ o : ∀ s,ChannelFiber (N := Fin n) (E s) (T s),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
        g (fun s => batchEquiv ((Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.plus (o s).val).val*C₂ s,(Lax342547.FrameSymmetry.minus (o s).val).val*D₂ s)))| ≤
      ∑ s,errorBound n (I s) (J s) (K s) (L s)

end

concepts.title: Exponential bound for the raw intersection exception
concepts.description:
A fixed-size kernel certificate describes any large collection of common
primal images. The reference image cap and a joint density bound give an
explicit exceptional probability after paying the coefficient count.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ImageScale
import Lax342547.TensorIntersections
import Lax342547.KernelWitness

/-!
---
title: Exponential bound for the raw intersection exception
type: lemma
---
A fixed-size kernel certificate describes any large collection of common
primal images. The reference image cap and a joint density bound give an
explicit exceptional probability after paying the coefficient count.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawIntersections

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
open Lax342547.ProductImages Lax342547.TensorIntersections
open scoped ENNReal

variable {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

def jointPlus {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) :
    Matrix N (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) Binary := jointMatrix (fun i => (plus (o i e)).val)

noncomputable def intersectionDimension {E : Matrix B B Binary}
    (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) : ℕ :=
  ∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (intersectionSpace (o 0 e).P (o 1 e).P)

axiom intersection_kernel_bound {E : Matrix B B Binary}
    (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    intersectionDimension o ≤ ∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.ker (jointPlus o e).mulVecLin)

axiom reference_kernel_bound
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Fintype.card N)
    (hc : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Comp ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Fintype.card N) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
      {o | q ≤ intersectionDimension o} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card Comp * (2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)) * q) *
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((3 / 4 : ℝ) * q * Fintype.card N))

axiom capped_intersection_bound
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (D : ℕ) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Fintype.card N)
    (hc : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Comp ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Fintype.card N)
    (hcount : (Fintype.card Comp * (2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)) * (2 * D) : ℕ) ≤
      (D : ℝ) * Fintype.card N / 4)
    (σ : PMF (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E))
    (hσ : ∀ o, σ o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * Fintype.card N) * PMF.uniformOfFintype _ o) :
    σ.toOuterMeasure {o | 2 * D < intersectionDimension o} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((D : ℝ) * Fintype.card N / 4))

axiom exists_intersection_scale (a b c : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      2 * (a * n + b) + 1 ≤ M * n ∧
      (4 : ℝ) * (a * n + b : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) ∧
      (8 : ℝ) * c ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) ∧
      ∀ D : ℕ, (c * (2 * (a * n + b)) * (2 * D) : ℕ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) / 4

axiom exists_paper_intersection_scale (pStar g h c : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      2 * (pStar * (1 + (g * g + 3) * n) + h) + 1 ≤ M * n ∧
      (4 : ℝ) * (pStar * (1 + (g * g + 3) * n) + h : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) ∧
      (8 : ℝ) * c ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) ∧
      ∀ D : ℕ, (c * (2 * (pStar * (1 + (g * g + 3) * n) + h)) * (2 * D) : ℕ) ≤
        (D : ℝ) * (M * n : ℕ) / 4

end Lax342547.RawIntersections

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawQueryImages
import Lax342547.JointKeyCap

/-!
---
title: Actual joint key and fresh image caps
type: lemma
---
The actual selected query tuples and arbitrary fresh directions have one leaf cap, with all component and sign ranks summed. Their dependence within a sampled unit is retained.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawJointImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QueryReference Lax342547.QueryIndependence
open Lax342547.RawQueryImages Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.KeySpans
open scoped ENNReal

axiom actual_left_key_fresh_cap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    {V : (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool) → Type}
    [∀ a, AddCommGroup (V a)] [∀ a, Module Binary (V a)]
    [∀ a, FiniteDimensional Binary (V a)]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (p : PMF (Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)))
    (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (fresh : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H) → Binary))
    (hf : ∀ a, Function.Injective
      (((P.space a) ⊔ LinearMap.range (keyMap (H := H) W a.1)).mkQ.comp (fresh a)))
    (yf : ∀ a, V a →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N,
      1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q → p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event observation) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (hrank : 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) + ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a)) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | leftTuple W o = q ∧ ∀ a, (observation o a).comp (fresh a) = yf a} ≤
      α ^ (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W) + ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (V a))

end Lax342547.RawJointImages

concepts.title: The finite uniform raw-vertex law
concepts.description:
A raw vertex chooses one valid frame in every component. The reference
law is uniform on this finite product. Counting all matrix quadruples
gives $|\Omega|\le 2^{2|\mathcal E|N(d+h)}$, the bound behind (2.14).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawFrames
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform

/-!
---
title: The finite uniform raw-vertex law
type: lemma
---
A raw vertex chooses one valid frame in every component. The reference
law is uniform on this finite product. Counting all matrix quadruples
gives $|\Omega|\le 2^{2|\mathcal E|N(d+h)}$, the bound behind (2.14).
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawLaw

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames

variable {B H N Comp : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N] [Fintype Comp]
variable [DecidableEq Comp]

noncomputable def uniformLaw (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] :
    PMF (Comp → Frame B H N E) := PMF.uniformOfFintype _

axiom raw_card_bound (E : Matrix B B Binary) :
    Fintype.card (Comp → Frame B H N E) ≤
      2 ^ (2 * Fintype.card Comp * Fintype.card N * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H))

axiom uniformLaw_product (E : Matrix B B Binary) [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (o : Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    uniformLaw E o = ∏ e, PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E) (o e)

end Lax342547.RawLaw

import Lax342547.BoundedPeeling
import Lax342547.ReferencePins

/-!
---
title: Exact-pin peeling for the actual raw frame law
type: lemma
---
Apply the finite bounded peeling procedure to both endpoints and both
signs of the concrete raw frames. The absolute density bound is always
relative to the unconditioned reference law, including when initial pins
are retained for a subsequent peeling.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawPeeling

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.LeafPartition Lax342547.BoundedPeeling
open scoped ENNReal

axiom raw_peeling {Comp B H N : Type}
    [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [DecidableEq (Frame B H N E)]
    (σ : PMF (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E))
    (P₀ : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (R : Finset (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E))
    (hR : (R : Set (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)) ⊆ P₀.event observation)
    (D ζ ε : ℝ) (K : ℕ)
    (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεζ : ε ≤ ζ / 4)
    (hK : 4 * (D + 1) / ζ ≤ K)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H : ℕ) ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (hc : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Comp ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (hσ : ∀ o, σ o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * Fintype.card N) * PMF.uniformOfFintype _ o) :
    ∃ L : Finset (Finset (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) × Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N),
      Partition σ observation P₀ R ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * Fintype.card N)))
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * Fintype.card N))) L ∧
      ∀ z ∈ L, z.2.rank ≤ P₀.rank + K ∧
        LawBound σ (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) observation z.2 z.1
          ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * Fintype.card N)))
          ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K + 1) * Fintype.card N))

end Lax342547.RawPeeling

  [inst_9 : DecidableEq (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)]

                              (instHPow.hPow 2
                                (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub 1 ζ) (Fintype.card N).cast)))
                              L)

concepts.title: Actual raw primal-span avoidance
concepts.description: Uniform raw frames inherit a complete primal-span intersection bound from their combined injective plus matrix.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.InjectiveDensity
import Lax342547.PrimalAvoidance
import Lax342547.InjectiveFrames
import Lax342547.ChannelColumns
import Lax342547.PhaseAverages

/-!
---
title: Actual raw primal-span avoidance
type: lemma
---
Uniform raw frames inherit a complete primal-span intersection bound from their combined injective plus matrix.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawPrimalAvoidance

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped BigOperators

axiom plus_matrix_point_cap {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] (hN : Fintype.card B+Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (Z : Matrix N (B ⊕ H) Binary) :
    push (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E))) (fun F => (plus F).val) Z ≤
      2*weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N (B ⊕ H) Binary)) Z

axiom raw_primal_span_hit_mass {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] (hN : Fintype.card B+Fintype.card H+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (W : Submodule Binary (N → Binary)) :
    cellMass (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Frame B H N E)))
      (fun F => ∃ c : B → Binary,c ≠ 0 ∧ F.P.mulVec c ∈ W) ≤
      2*((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card B+Fintype.card H+Module.finrank Binary W)/(2 : ℝ)^Fintype.card N)

end Lax342547.RawPrimalAvoidance

concepts.title: Actual query-key image caps on raw leaves
concepts.description: The raw paired-frame observation maps realize the selected query tuples. Their independence modulo old pins transfers exact leaf caps to actual key events.

import Lax342547.QueryIndependence
import Lax342547.ReferencePins
import Lax342547.LeafImages

/-!
---
title: Actual query-key image caps on raw leaves
type: lemma
---
The raw paired-frame observation maps realize the selected query tuples. Their independence modulo old pins transfers exact leaf caps to actual key events.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawQueryImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ReferencePins
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.ProductImages Lax342547.TagGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.QueryReference
open Lax342547.QueryIndependence Lax342547.PairedKeys Lax342547.KeySpans
open scoped ENNReal

axiom observation_primal_plus {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (e : Comp) (i : Fin 2) (v : B → Binary) :
    observation o (e,true) (primalEmbedding i v) = (o i e).P.mulVec v

axiom observation_primal_minus {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (e : Comp) (i : Fin 2) (v : B → Binary) :
    observation o (e,false) (primalEmbedding i v) = (o i e).Q.mulVec v

axiom key_map_coordinate {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k))
    (p : ComponentPosition W e) : by
      classical
      exact keyMap (H := H) W e (Pi.single p 1) =
        primalEmbedding p.val.1 (W.left p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).vector

axiom key_observations_left {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (mode : Bool) : by
      classical
      exact LinearMap.toMatrix' ((observation o (e,mode)).comp (keyMap (H := H) W e)) =
        if mode then (leftTuple W o e).1 else (leftTuple W o e).2

noncomputable def tupleMaps {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples
      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool) :
    (ComponentPosition W a.1 → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact (if a.2 then (q a.1).1 else (q a.1).2).mulVecLin

axiom left_tuple_event {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples
      (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) :
    leftTuple W o = q ↔ ∀ a, (observation o a).comp (keyMap (H := H) W a.1) = tupleMaps W q a

axiom key_dimension {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ a : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool,
        Module.finrank Binary (ComponentPosition W a.1 → Binary)) =
        Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)

axiom actual_left_key_cap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (p : PMF (Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)))
    (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Excludes P A)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (q : Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N,
      1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q → p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event observation) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (hr : 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | leftTuple W o = q} ≤ α ^ Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)

end Lax342547.RawQueryImages

            instLENat.le 1 (P.relativeRank Q) →
              ENNReal.instLE.le
                (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure

                (instHPow.hPow α (P.relativeRank Q))) →
          instLENat.le 1 (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)) →
            ENNReal.instLE.le
              (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure

import Lax342547.RawCellEntropy
import Lax342547.CellRepresentatives
import Lax342547.GradientRealization

/-!
---
title: Four actual holes inside an original retained cell pair
type: lemma
---
The original PMF leaf laws supply both block image caps. Separate unary records freeze the target directions, and the checked gradient realization constructs a target whose primal agreement implies all four actual holes.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawRetainedCells

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.QueryReference Lax342547.QueryIndependence

concepts.title: Second exact-pin peeling for the actual raw frame law
concepts.description:
After a retained restriction of an old leaf, split by bounded coefficient
metadata and exact images. Discard exponentially small mass and apply a
fresh peeling on every retained fiber, within the paper's final budget.

import Lax342547.SecondPeeling
import Lax342547.ReferencePins

/-!
---
title: Second exact-pin peeling for the actual raw frame law
type: lemma
---
After a retained restriction of an old leaf, split by bounded coefficient
metadata and exact images. Discard exponentially small mass and apply a
fresh peeling on every retained fiber, within the paper's final budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawSecondPeeling

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.MetadataPins Lax342547.SecondPeeling
open scoped ENNReal

axiom raw_second_peeling {J Comp B H N : Type}
    [Fintype J] [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)] [DecidableEq (Frame B H N E)]
    (p : PMF (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E))
    (P₀ : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (S : Set (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (choice : (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) → J)
    (U : J → (Comp × Bool) → Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary))
    (D ζ ε : ℝ) (K₁ u a n : ℕ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεζ : ε ≤ ζ / 4)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hcoeff : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H : ℕ) ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (hcomp : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Comp ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (hP : p.support ⊆ P₀.event observation) (hPbudget : P₀.rank ≤ K₁)
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ b, Module.finrank Binary (U j b) ≤ u)
    (hchoices : Fintype.card J ≤ 2 ^ (a * n)) (hscale : 2 * a * n ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hSbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * Fintype.card N)) ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S)
    (hp : ∀ o, p o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K₁ + 1) * Fintype.card N) * PMF.uniformOfFintype _ o) :
    (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure {o |
      (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure {x | record observation choice U x = record observation choice U o} <
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * Fintype.card N))} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(Fintype.card N : ℝ) / 2) ∧
    ∀ k : Key N U,
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * Fintype.card N)) ≤
        (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure {o | record observation choice U o = k} →
      RepeeledPart (p.filter S hS) (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) observation P₀ choice U D ζ K₁ u k

end Lax342547.RawSecondPeeling

concepts.title: Finite supersaturation implies an actual sampled graph
concepts.description: The exact admissible raw-unit supersaturation property, together with the explicit entropy, counting and sampling margins, produces a graph on sampled positions with independence number at most two and 100 times its actual connected matching number less than its order.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.UnitContainers
import Lax342547.GoodSamples
import Lax342547.MatchingCoverage

/-!
---
title: Finite supersaturation implies an actual sampled graph
type: lemma
---
The exact admissible raw-unit supersaturation property, together with the explicit entropy, counting and sampling margins, produces a graph on sampled positions with independence number at most two and 100 times its actual connected matching number less than its order.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RawToGraph

open Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.UnitLaws Lax342547.ContainerLaws
open Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CellAveraging Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open Lax342547.GoodSamples Lax342547.MatchingSamples Lax342547.SampledGraph Lax342547.ConnectedMatching

noncomputable def exceptionBudget (m k : ℕ) (M κ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (m.choose k : ℝ)*(1/M)^k+(m : ℝ)^(2*k)*(1/κ)^k

axiom exception_budget_nonneg (m k : ℕ) (M κ : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    0 ≤ exceptionBudget m k M κ

axiom supersaturation_to_sample {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, hole x y → hole y x) (hloop : ∀ x, ¬ hole x x)
    (htriangle : ∀ x y z, hole x y → hole y z → ¬ hole z x)
    (M κ ε : ℝ) (m k L : ℕ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hμpos : ∀ x, 0 < μ x)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1)
    (hL : Real.log κ/(-Real.log (1-ε))+1 ≤ L)
    (hscale : 200*(k-1) < m)
    (hbudget : (((Fintype.card Ω^2+1)^L : ℕ) : ℝ)*exceptionBudget m k M κ < 1)
    (hsuper : ∀ ρ, Feasible μ (fun x y => ¬ hole x y) M κ ρ →
      ε ≤ conflictMass ρ (fourConflict hole)) :
    ∃ sample : Fin m → Ω,
      (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample).indepNum ≤ 2 ∧
      100*connectedMatchingNumber (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample) < m

end Lax342547.RawToGraph

        Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →

            Real.instLT.lt 0 M →

                Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →

                    Real.instLE.le
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.log κ) (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log (instHSub.hSub 1 ε)))) 1)

                        Real.instLT.lt

                              (Lax342547.RawToGraph.exceptionBudget m k M κ))
                            1 →
                          (∀ (ρ : Prod Ω Ω → Real),
                              Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ (fun x y => Not (hole x y)) M κ ρ →

concepts.title: Original retained-cell laws from finite PMFs
concepts.description: Finite PMF events convert to real weights and normalized laws supported on the original retained cell. Joint image caps yield the paper conditional exponent without intersecting or changing that cell.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RetainedImages
import Lax342547.Conditioning
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.NNReal

/-!
---
title: Original retained-cell laws from finite PMFs
type: lemma
---
Finite PMF events convert to real weights and normalized laws supported on the original retained cell. Joint image caps yield the paper conditional exponent without intersecting or changing that cell.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RealCellLaws

open Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def weights {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => (p ω).toReal

axiom weights_nonneg {Ω : Type} (p : PMF Ω) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ weights p ω

axiom weights_total {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) : ∑ ω, weights p ω = 1

axiom event_mass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) (C : Ω → Prop) :
    cellMass (weights p) C = (p.toOuterMeasure {ω | C ω}).toReal

noncomputable def subtypeWeights {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) :
    {ω // C ω} → ℝ := fun ω => ρ ω.val / cellMass ρ C

axiom subtype_integral {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ ω : {ω // C ω}, subtypeWeights ρ C ω * f ω.val) =
        ∑ ω, conditionalLaw ρ C ω * f ω

axiom subtype_weights_total {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) (hC : 0 < cellMass ρ C) : by
      classical
      exact (∑ ω : {ω // C ω}, subtypeWeights ρ C ω) = 1

concepts.title: Compact real-capacity flows and a maximizing flow
concepts.description: Skew real flows satisfy directed capacity bounds and interior conservation. Their feasible set is closed and bounded in a finite product, so a maximum source divergence exists for every nonnegative finite capacity network.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.Real.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.StdSimplex
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function

/-!
---
title: Compact real-capacity flows and a maximizing flow
type: lemma
---
Skew real flows satisfy directed capacity bounds and interior conservation. Their feasible set is closed and bounded in a finite product, so a maximum source divergence exists for every nonnegative finite capacity network.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RealFlows

open scoped BigOperators Topology

noncomputable def divergence {V : Type} [Fintype V] (f : V → V → ℝ) (a : V) : ℝ := ∑ b, f a b

def Feasible {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ a b, f a b = -f b a) ∧ (∀ a b, f a b ≤ c a b) ∧
    (∀ a, a ≠ s → a ≠ t → divergence f a = 0)

def Residual {V : Type} (c f : V → V → ℝ) (a b : V) : Prop := f a b < c a b

axiom zero_feasible {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hc : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ c a b) : Feasible c (fun _ _ => 0) s t

axiom feasible_closed {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V) :
    IsClosed {f | Feasible c f s t}

axiom feasible_compact {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V) :
    IsCompact {f | Feasible c f s t}

axiom maximal_flow {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V)
    (hc : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ c a b) :
    ∃ f, Feasible c f s t ∧ ∀ g, Feasible c g s t → divergence g s ≤ divergence f s

end Lax342547.RealFlows

  IsClosed (Set.ofPred fun f => Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t)

feasible_compact : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  IsCompact (Set.ofPred fun f => Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t)

maximal_flow : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  (∀ (a b : V), Real.instLE.le 0 (c a b)) →
    Exists fun f =>
      And (Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t)
        (∀ (g : V → V → Real),
          Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c g s t →
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence g s) (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s))

import Lax342547.NonlinearChannels

/-!
---
title: Nonlinear channel realization of the actual whole-space recipe residual
type: lemma
---
Explicit low-rank targets and the compressed actual recipe solution fit through the protected channel complements under the paper margin. The final allowed derivative families realize the full residual using their actual dot product, retaining the exact combined-primal baseline ranks and both pin-rank bounds.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RecipeChannels

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.BaseCompression Lax342547.QuotientCompression
open Lax342547.ResidualRealization
open Lax342547.CompressedResidual

axiom nonlinear_recipe {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {K : ℕ} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hF : Extends F T) (hbounded : Bounded F K)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms W i) (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP W oB i))
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) (z : Fin 2)
    (hmargin : 28 * copies * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) +
      quotientBound k b degree K (14 * K + 140) + 2 * K + 4 * (3 * K + 28) < 970 * r)
    (hchannels : 1000 * r ≤ Fintype.card H) :
    ∃ (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z),
      fullResponse W P Q U V F z (extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε) δ ε =
        ∑ i, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

end Lax342547.RecipeChannels

concepts.title: Gradient residuals vanish on effective profiles and selected atoms
concepts.description:
The scalar recipe and binary prescriptions make the target difference
zero on the effective space and the span of every selected atom at an
endpoint. This is the domain on which correctness is already established
before the whole-space annihilator argument.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FrozenValues

/-!
---
title: Gradient residuals vanish on effective profiles and selected atoms
type: lemma
---
The scalar recipe and binary prescriptions make the target difference
zero on the effective space and the span of every selected atom at an
endpoint. This is the domain on which correctness is already established
before the whole-space annihilator argument.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RecipeResiduals

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.SmallTables
open Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.RawBaselines Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}

noncomputable def residual {H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    {copies : ℕ} (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (i z : Fin 2) :
    Profile k n b degree →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z) - fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z

def correctSpace {H N : Type} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) :
    Submodule Binary (Profile k n b degree) :=
  effective (Profile k n b degree) P i ⊔
    Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (fun x : Position W i => (endpointAtoms W i x).profile))

variable {H N : Type} [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}

axiom selected_gradients (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) (i : Fin 2)
    (h : RecipeGradients D L R (endpointAtoms W i) (oppositeP W oB i))
    (z z' : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z')) :
    D.role (W.left i z' t).profile +
      gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z) (W.left i z' t).profile =
      if z = z' then 0 else ownContraction oB z' (W.right i z' t).profile

axiom residual_correct (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    {P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (h : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B) (htable : Extends F T)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, RecipeGradients D L R (endpointAtoms W i) (oppositeP W oB i)) :
    ∀ i z, correctSpace W P i ≤ LinearMap.ker (residual W D L R F i z)

end Lax342547.RecipeResiduals

    Fin copies →

concepts.title: Coupled scalar recipes give consistent atom gradients
concepts.description:
At one endpoint, a and the opposite matched a-values satisfy the two
role equations. The opposite p-values satisfy the coupled equation.
These numerical data determine compatible row sums on the two lists,

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SymmetricPrescriptions
import Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions

/-!
---
title: Coupled scalar recipes give consistent atom gradients
type: lemma
---
At one endpoint, a and the opposite matched a-values satisfy the two
role equations. The opposite p-values satisfy the coupled equation.
These numerical data determine compatible row sums on the two lists,
and hence formal ordered product prescriptions for the desired gradients.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RecipeRows

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions

axiom recipe_matrix {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J]
    (a opposite p : I ⊕ J → Binary)
    (hrole₁ : (∑ i : I, a (Sum.inl i)) + (∑ i : I, opposite (Sum.inl i)) = 1)
    (hrole₂ : (∑ j : J, a (Sum.inr j)) + (∑ j : J, opposite (Sum.inr j)) = 1)
    (hcoupled : (∑ i : I, (p (Sum.inl i) + opposite (Sum.inl i))) =
      ∑ j : J, (p (Sum.inr j) + opposite (Sum.inr j))) :
    ∃ M : Matrix (I ⊕ J) (I ⊕ J) Binary, (∀ x y, M x y = M y x) ∧
      (∀ x, M x x = a x) ∧
      (∀ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) + ∑ t : I, M (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inl i) = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) + ∑ t : I, M (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inr j) = p (Sum.inr j)) ∧
      (∀ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) + ∑ t : J, M (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inr j) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) + ∑ t : J, M (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inl i) = p (Sum.inl i))

axiom recipe_bits {I J Term : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype Term]
    [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J]
    (a opposite p : I ⊕ J → Binary)
    (hrole₁ : (∑ i : I, a (Sum.inl i)) + (∑ i : I, opposite (Sum.inl i)) = 1)
    (hrole₂ : (∑ j : J, a (Sum.inr j)) + (∑ j : J, opposite (Sum.inr j)) = 1)
    (hcoupled : (∑ i : I, (p (Sum.inl i) + opposite (Sum.inl i))) =
      ∑ j : J, (p (Sum.inr j) + opposite (Sum.inr j)))
    (allowed : (I ⊕ J) → (I ⊕ J) → Term → Prop) (hallowed : ∀ x y, ∃ t, allowed x y t)
    (T₀ : Matrix (I ⊕ J) (I ⊕ J) Binary) (hsym : ∀ x y, T₀ x y = T₀ y x)
    (hdiag : ∀ x, T₀ x x = a x) :
    ∃ L R : (I ⊕ J) → (I ⊕ J) → Term → Binary,
      (∀ x y t, ¬ allowed x y t → L x y t = 0 ∧ R x y t = 0) ∧
      let T := fun x y => T₀ x y + productSum L R x y + productSum L R y x
      (∀ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) + ∑ t : I, T (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inl i) = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) + ∑ t : I, T (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inr j) = p (Sum.inr j)) ∧
      (∀ j : J, a (Sum.inr j) + ∑ t : J, T (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inr j) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : I, a (Sum.inl i) + ∑ t : J, T (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inl i) = p (Sum.inl i))

end Lax342547.RecipeRows

recipe_bits : ∀ {I J Term : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : Fintype Term] [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J]
  (a opposite p : Sum I J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun i => a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun i => opposite (Sum.inl i))) 1 →
    Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun j => a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun j => opposite (Sum.inr j))) 1 →
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inl i)) (opposite (Sum.inl i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inr j)) (opposite (Sum.inr j))) →
        ∀ (allowed : Sum I J → Sum I J → Term → Prop),
          (∀ (x y : Sum I J), Exists fun t => allowed x y t) →
            ∀ (T₀ : Matrix (Sum I J) (Sum I J) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
              (∀ (x y : Sum I J), Eq (T₀ x y) (T₀ y x)) →
                (∀ (x : Sum I J), Eq (T₀ x x) (a x)) →
                  Exists fun L =>
                    Exists fun R =>
                      And (∀ (x y : Sum I J) (t : Term), Not (allowed x y t) → And (Eq (L x y t) 0) (Eq (R x y t) 0))
                        (let T := fun x y =>
                          instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (T₀ x y) (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum L R x y))
                            (Lax342547.BinaryPrescriptions.productSum L R y x);
                        And
                          (∀ (i : I),
                            Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => T (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inl i))) 0)
                          (And
                            (∀ (j : J),
                              Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => T (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inr j)))
                                (p (Sum.inr j)))
                            (And
                              (∀ (j : J),
                                Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => T (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inr j)))
                                  0)
                              (∀ (i : I),
                                Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => T (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inl i)))
                                  (p (Sum.inl i))))))

recipe_matrix : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [Nonempty I] [Nonempty J]
  (a opposite p : Sum I J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun i => a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun i => opposite (Sum.inl i))) 1 →
    Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun j => a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun j => opposite (Sum.inr j))) 1 →
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inl i)) (opposite (Sum.inl i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHAdd.hAdd (p (Sum.inr j)) (opposite (Sum.inr j))) →
        Exists fun M =>
          And (∀ (x y : Sum I J), Eq (M x y) (M y x))
            (And (∀ (x : Sum I J), Eq (M x x) (a x))
              (And
                (∀ (i : I), Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => M (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inl i))) 0)
                (And
                  (∀ (j : J),
                    Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => M (Sum.inl t) (Sum.inr j)))
                      (p (Sum.inr j)))
                  (And
                    (∀ (j : J),
                      Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inr j)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => M (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inr j))) 0)
                    (∀ (i : I),
                      Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (a (Sum.inl i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => M (Sum.inr t) (Sum.inl i)))
                        (p (Sum.inl i)))))))

concepts.title: Key-indexed original record cells
concepts.description: Refining a key by a unary record preserves accepted key mass. Matching retained record cells sum to the retained collision mass, with nonnegative subprobability weights.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.KeyMeasures
import Lax342547.CellAveraging
import Lax342547.CollisionPruning

/-!
---
title: Key-indexed original record cells
type: lemma
---
Refining a key by a unary record preserves accepted key mass. Matching retained record cells sum to the retained collision mass, with nonnegative subprobability weights.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RecordCollision

open Lax342547.KeyMeasures Lax342547.CellAveraging Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CollisionPruning

noncomputable def keyRecordMass {Ω Q C : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop) (q : Q) (c : C) : ℝ :=
  recordMass ρ (fun ω => (key ω,record ω)) accept (q,c)

axiom key_record_mass_total {Ω Q C : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype C]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop) (q : Q) :
    (∑ c, keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c) = keyMass ρ key accept q

axiom retained_key_record_identity {Q C D : Type} [Fintype Q] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (a : Q → C → ℝ) (b : Q → D → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) :
    retainedPairs (fun qc : Q × C => a qc.1 qc.2) (fun qd : Q × D => b qd.1 qd.2)
      (fun qc qd => qc.1 = qd.1) τ = ∑ q, retained (a q) τ * retained (b q) τ

axiom key_record_mass_nonneg {Ω Q C : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (q : Q) (c : C) : 0 ≤ keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c

axiom key_record_mass_subprobability {Ω Q C : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Q] [Fintype C]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (hsum : ∑ ω, ρ ω ≤ 1) :
    (∑ q, ∑ c, keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c) ≤ 1

end Lax342547.RecordCollision

statements.signature:
key_record_mass_nonneg : ∀ {Ω Q C : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    ∀ (q : Q) (c : C), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.RecordCollision.keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c)

key_record_mass_subprobability : ∀ {Ω Q C : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Q] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (ρ : Ω → Real) (key : Ω → Q)
  (record : Ω → C) (accept : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => ρ ω) 1 →
      Real.instLE.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun c => Lax342547.RecordCollision.keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c)
        1

key_record_mass_total : ∀ {Ω Q C : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (ρ : Ω → Real) (key : Ω → Q) (record : Ω → C)
  (accept : Ω → Prop) (q : Q),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun c => Lax342547.RecordCollision.keyRecordMass ρ key record accept q c)
    (Lax342547.KeyMeasures.keyMass ρ key accept q)

retained_key_record_identity : ∀ {Q C D : Type} [inst : Fintype Q] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : Fintype D] (a : Q → C → Real) (b : Q → D → Real)
  (τ : Real),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.CellAveraging.retainedPairs (fun qc => a qc.fst qc.snd) (fun qd => b qd.fst qd.snd)
      (fun qc qd => Eq qc.fst qd.fst) τ)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.CollisionPruning.retained (a q) τ) (Lax342547.CollisionPruning.retained (b q) τ))

concepts.title: Joint reference image caps across both signs and all draws
concepts.description:
Expose the plus frames, then integrate the uniform conditional minus
estimate over the plus prescription. Nominal ranks are taken in the
direct sum over all draws. The finite bound retains every conditioning
factor and the complete common-annihilator dimension loss.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProductMinusImages

/-!
---
title: Joint reference image caps across both signs and all draws
type: lemma
---
Expose the plus frames, then integrate the uniform conditional minus
estimate over the plus prescription. Nominal ranks are taken in the
direct sum over all draws. The finite bound retains every conditioning
factor and the complete common-annihilator dimension loss.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ReferenceImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry Lax342547.ProductImages
open scoped ENNReal

variable {Draw B H T U N : Type} [Fintype Draw] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
  [Fintype T] [Fintype U] [Fintype N]

def plusImages {E : Matrix B B Binary} (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary)
    (o : Draw → Frame B H N E) : Matrix N T Binary :=
  jointMatrix (fun i => (plus (o i)).val) * C

def minusImages {E : Matrix B B Binary} (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) U Binary)
    (o : Draw → Frame B H N E) : Matrix N U Binary :=
  jointMatrix (fun i => (minus (o i)).val) * C

axiom joint_cap [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H]
    [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (D : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) U Binary)
    (hC : Function.Injective C.mulVec) (hD : Function.Injective D.mulVec)
    (y : Matrix N T Binary) (z : Matrix N U Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
      {o | plusImages C o = y ∧ minusImages D o = z} ≤
      (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card Draw /
        2 ^ (Fintype.card N * Fintype.card T + Fintype.card U *
          (Fintype.card N - Fintype.card Draw * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)))

axiom joint_rank_cap [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H]
    [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) T Binary) (D : Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) U Binary)
    (y : Matrix N T Binary) (z : Matrix N U Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
      {o | plusImages C o = y ∧ minusImages D o = z} ≤
      (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ Fintype.card Draw /
        2 ^ (Fintype.card N * C.rank + D.rank *
          (Fintype.card N - Fintype.card Draw * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)))

axiom all_components_cap {Comp : Type} [Fintype Comp] [DecidableEq Comp]
    {K L : Comp → Type} [∀ e, Fintype (K e)] [∀ e, Fintype (L e)]
    [DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (C : ∀ e, Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) (K e) Binary)
    (D : ∀ e, Matrix (Draw × (B ⊕ H)) (L e) Binary)
    (y : ∀ e, Matrix N (K e) Binary) (z : ∀ e, Matrix N (L e) Binary) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Comp → Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
      {o | ∀ e, plusImages (C e) (fun i => o i e) = y e ∧ minusImages (D e) (fun i => o i e) = z e} ≤
      (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card Draw * Fintype.card Comp) /
        2 ^ (Fintype.card N * ∑ e, (C e).rank +
          (Fintype.card N - Fintype.card Draw * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H)) * ∑ e, (D e).rank)

end Lax342547.ReferenceImages

  [inst_4 : Fintype Comp] [inst_5 : DecidableEq Comp] {K L : Comp → Type} [inst_6 : (e : Comp) → Fintype (K e)]
  [inst_7 : (e : Comp) → Fintype (L e)] [inst_8 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary} [inst_12 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (C : (e : Comp) → Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) (K e) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (D : (e : Comp) → Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) (L e) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (y : (e : Comp) → Matrix N (K e) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (z : (e : Comp) → Matrix N (L e) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Comp → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
          (Set.ofPred fun o =>
            ∀ (e : Comp),
              And (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.plusImages (C e) fun i => o i e) (y e))
                (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.minusImages (D e) fun i => o i e) (z e))))
        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 4 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (Fintype.card Comp)))
          (instHPow.hPow 2
            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) (Finset.univ.sum fun e => (C e).rank))
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card N)
                  (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))))

  [inst_4 : Fintype U] [inst_5 : Fintype N] [inst_6 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq T]
  [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq N] {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  [inst_12 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (C : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (D : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) U Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Function.Injective C.mulVec →
        Function.Injective D.mulVec →
          ∀ (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (z : Matrix N U Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
            ENNReal.instLE.le
              (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
                (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
                (Set.ofPred fun o =>
                  And (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.plusImages C o) y)
                    (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.minusImages D o) z)))
              (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 4 (Fintype.card Draw))
                (instHPow.hPow 2
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) (Fintype.card T))
                    (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card U)
                      (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card N)
                        (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))))))))

  [inst_4 : Fintype U] [inst_5 : Fintype N] [inst_6 : DecidableEq Draw] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq T]
  [DecidableEq U] [DecidableEq N] {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  [inst_12 : Nonempty (Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)],
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))) 1) (Fintype.card N) →
    ∀ (C : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (D : Matrix (Prod Draw (Sum B H)) U Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (y : Matrix N T Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (z : Matrix N U Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      ENNReal.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe
          (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Draw → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure
          (Set.ofPred fun o =>
            And (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.plusImages C o) y) (Eq (Lax342547.ReferenceImages.minusImages D o) z)))
        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow 4 (Fintype.card Draw))
          (instHPow.hPow 2
            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card N) C.rank)
              (instHMul.hMul D.rank
                (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card N)
                  (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card Draw) (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))))))))

concepts.title: Constrained key reference spaces have positive density
concepts.description: Independent component Gram constraints have an explicit product lower bound independent of ambient dimension once the slot count fits. The constrained key space has at most two to the number of ambient key bits elements.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.GramNormalization

/-!
---
title: Constrained key reference spaces have positive density
type: lemma
---
Independent component Gram constraints have an explicit product lower bound independent of ambient dimension once the slot count fits. The constrained key space has at most two to the number of ambient key bits elements.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ReferenceKeys

abbrev Tuples (Comp : Type) (Pos : Comp → Type) (N : Type) :=
  ∀ e, Matrix N (Pos e) Binary × Matrix N (Pos e) Binary

noncomputable def space {Comp : Type} (Pos : Comp → Type) (N : Type)
    [∀ e, Fintype (Pos e)] [Fintype N] (G : ∀ e, Matrix (Pos e) (Pos e) Binary) :
    Set (Tuples Comp Pos N) := {x | ∀ e, (x e).1.transpose * (x e).2 = G e}

axiom space_card_upper {Comp N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype N]
    (Pos : Comp → Type) [∀ e, Fintype (Pos e)]
    (G : ∀ e, Matrix (Pos e) (Pos e) Binary) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (space Pos N G) ≤
        2 ^ ((2 * ∑ e, Fintype.card (Pos e)) * Fintype.card N)

axiom block_reference_lower {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] (G : Matrix I I Binary)
    (hN : 2 * Fintype.card I + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card I * Fintype.card I + 2) ≤
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N I Binary × Matrix N I Binary)).map
        (fun x => x.1.transpose * x.2)) G

axiom reference_density_lower {Comp N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq N]
    (Pos : Comp → Type) [∀ e, Fintype (Pos e)] [∀ e, DecidableEq (Pos e)]
    (G : ∀ e, Matrix (Pos e) (Pos e) Binary)
    (hN : ∀ e, 2 * Fintype.card (Pos e) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    (∏ e, 1 / (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (Fintype.card (Pos e) * Fintype.card (Pos e) + 2)) ≤
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Tuples Comp Pos N)).toOuterMeasure (space Pos N G)

end Lax342547.ReferenceKeys

concepts.title: The full reference cap for exact pin events
concepts.description:
Component/sign pins use the direct sum of both endpoints' primal and
channel coefficients. Their stored basis images form precisely the
arbitrary-rank tuples covered by the reference image theorem.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ExactPins
import Lax342547.ImageScale

/-!
---
title: The full reference cap for exact pin events
type: lemma
---
Component/sign pins use the direct sum of both endpoints' primal and
channel coefficients. Their stored basis images form precisely the
arbitrary-rank tuples covered by the reference image theorem.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ReferencePins

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.FrameSymmetry
open Lax342547.ProductImages Lax342547.ExactPins
open scoped ENNReal

variable {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

def observationMatrix {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : Matrix N (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) Binary :=
  if a.2 then jointMatrix (fun i => (plus (o i a.1)).val)
  else jointMatrix (fun i => (minus (o i a.1)).val)

def observation {E : Matrix B B Binary} (o : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)
    (a : Comp × Bool) : ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary) :=
  (observationMatrix o a).mulVecLin

axiom reference_pin_cap [Fintype Comp]
    [DecidableEq Comp] [DecidableEq B] [DecidableEq H] [DecidableEq N]
    {E : Matrix B B Binary} [Nonempty (Frame B H N E)]
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H : ℕ) ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (hc : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card Comp ≤ ε * Fintype.card N)
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E)).toOuterMeasure (P.event observation) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ε) * P.rank * Fintype.card N))

end Lax342547.ReferencePins

concepts.title: Finite relative entropy and support costs
concepts.description: Finite probability weights have nonnegative relative entropy on their common support. Continuous entropy has compact minimizers, pointwise density caps give an upper budget, and support restriction costs the negative logarithm of its mass.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.InformationTheory.KullbackLeibler.KLFun
import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.Real.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.StdSimplex
import Lax342547.RetainedImages

/-!
---
title: Finite relative entropy and support costs
type: lemma
---
Finite probability weights have nonnegative relative entropy on their common support. Continuous entropy has compact minimizers, pointwise density caps give an upper budget, and support restriction costs the negative logarithm of its mass.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def entropy {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, (ρ x * Real.log (ρ x) - ρ x * Real.log (q x))

def Probability {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧ ∑ x, ρ x = 1

axiom entropy_nonneg {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → ℝ)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hq : Probability q) (hsupport : ∀ x, 0 < ρ x → 0 < q x) :
    0 ≤ entropy ρ q

axiom entropy_density_bound {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → ℝ) (cap : ℝ)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) (_hcap : 0 < cap)
    (hbound : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ cap*q x) : entropy ρ q ≤ Real.log cap

axiom continuous_entropy {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (q : Ω → ℝ) : Continuous (fun ρ : Ω → ℝ => entropy ρ q)

axiom compact_entropy_minimizer {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (P : Set (Ω → ℝ)) (q : Ω → ℝ) (hP : IsCompact P) (hne : P.Nonempty) :
    ∃ ρ ∈ P, ∀ ρ' ∈ P, entropy ρ q ≤ entropy ρ' q

axiom entropy_decomposition {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → ℝ)
    (_hsupport : ∀ x, 0 < ρ' x → 0 < ρ x)
    (_hρ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) (_hρ' : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ' x) :
    entropy ρ' q - entropy ρ q = entropy ρ' ρ +
      ∑ x, (ρ' x-ρ x)*(Real.log (ρ x)-Real.log (q x))

axiom probability_compact {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] : IsCompact {ρ : Ω → ℝ | Probability ρ}

axiom probability_convex {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] : Convex ℝ {ρ : Ω → ℝ | Probability ρ}

axiom entropy_support_cost {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → ℝ) (S : Ω → Prop)
    (hρ : Probability ρ) (hq : Probability q)
    (hsupport : ∀ x, 0 < ρ x → 0 < q x) (hS : ∀ x, ¬ S x → ρ x = 0)
    (hmass : 0 < Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass q S) :
    -Real.log (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass q S) ≤ entropy ρ q

end Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
