  IsCompact P →
    P.Nonempty →
      Exists fun ρ =>
        And (Set.instMembership.mem P ρ)
          (∀ (ρ' : Ω → Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem P ρ' →
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ' q))
continuous_entropy : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (q : Ω → Real), Continuous fun ρ => Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q

entropy_decomposition : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ ρ' q : Ω → Real),
  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ' x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x)) →
    (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ x)) →
      (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ' x)) →
        Eq (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ' q) (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q))
          (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ' ρ)
            (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
              instHMul.hMul (instHSub.hSub (ρ' x) (ρ x)) (instHSub.hSub (Real.log (ρ x)) (Real.log (q x)))))

entropy_density_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → Real) (cap : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (q x)) →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 cap →
        (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le (ρ x) (instHMul.hMul cap (q x))) →
          Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q) (Real.log cap)

entropy_nonneg : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability q →
      (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (q x)) →
        Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q)

entropy_support_cost : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ q : Ω → Real) (S : Ω → Prop),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ →
    Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability q →
      (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLT.lt 0 (ρ x) → Real.instLT.lt 0 (q x)) →
        (∀ (x : Ω), Not (S x) → Eq (ρ x) 0) →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass q S) →
            Real.instLE.le (Real.instNeg.neg (Real.log (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass q S)))
              (Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.entropy ρ q)
probability_compact : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω], IsCompact (Set.ofPred fun ρ => Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ)
probability_convex : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω], Convex Real (Set.ofPred fun ρ => Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability ρ)

concepts.title: Residual walk augmentation for real-capacity flows
concepts.description: Every residual walk supplies a skew direction with the correct source and sink divergences. A sufficiently small positive real perturbation respects every capacity, so a maximum flow has no residual source-to-sink walk.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RealFlows
import Mathlib.Logic.Relation

/-!
---
title: Residual walk augmentation for real-capacity flows
type: lemma
---
Every residual walk supplies a skew direction with the correct source and sink divergences. A sufficiently small positive real perturbation respects every capacity, so a maximum flow has no residual source-to-sink walk.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ResidualFlows

open Lax342547.RealFlows
open scoped BigOperators Topology
open Filter

noncomputable def edgeDirection {V : Type} (u v : V) (a b : V) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact (if a=u ∧ b=v then 1 else 0) - (if a=v ∧ b=u then 1 else 0)

def Direction {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f d : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact (∀ a b, d a b = -d b a) ∧
  (∀ a, divergence d a = (if a=u then 1 else 0)-(if a=v then 1 else 0)) ∧
  (∀ a b, ¬ Residual c f a b → d a b ≤ 0)

axiom edge_direction {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V)
    (huv : Residual c f u v) : Direction c f (edgeDirection u v) u v

axiom residual_walk_direction {V : Type} [Fintype V] (c f : V → V → ℝ) (u v : V)
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (Residual c f) u v) :
    ∃ d, Direction c f d u v

axiom feasible_augmentation {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (c f d : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V) (hfeasible : Feasible c f s t)
    (hdir : Direction c f d s t) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Feasible c (fun a b => f a b+δ*d a b) s t

axiom maximal_no_residual_path {V : Type} [Fintype V]
    (c f : V → V → ℝ) (s t : V) (hst : s ≠ t) (hf : Feasible c f s t)
    (hmax : ∀ g, Feasible c g s t → divergence g s ≤ divergence f s) :
    ¬ Relation.ReflTransGen (Residual c f) s t

end Lax342547.ResidualFlows

  Lax342547.RealFlows.Residual c f u v →
    Lax342547.ResidualFlows.Direction c f (Lax342547.ResidualFlows.edgeDirection u v) u v

feasible_augmentation : ∀ {V : Type} [inst : Fintype V] (c f d : V → V → Real) (s t : V),
  Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t →
    Lax342547.ResidualFlows.Direction c f d s t →
      Exists fun δ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 δ)
          (Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c (fun a b => instHAdd.hAdd (f a b) (instHMul.hMul δ (d a b))) s t)

  Ne s t →
    Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c f s t →
      (∀ (g : V → V → Real),
          Lax342547.RealFlows.Feasible c g s t →
            Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence g s) (Lax342547.RealFlows.divergence f s)) →
        Not (Relation.ReflTransGen (Lax342547.RealFlows.Residual c f) s t)

    Exists fun d => Lax342547.ResidualFlows.Direction c f d u v

concepts.description:
Freshness identifies the finite sum of selected atoms with exactly the
selected label blocks. Subtracting that sum deletes those blocks. The
remaining supports are subsets of the original bounded supports and

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SelectedRemoval

/-!
---
title: Removing selected atoms leaves only unselected component labels
type: lemma
---
Freshness identifies the finite sum of selected atoms with exactly the
selected label blocks. Subtracting that sum deletes those blocks. The
remaining supports are subsets of the original bounded supports and
retain the original Boolean moment and sum-of-block-ranks budgets.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ResidualLabels

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.BaseMoments
open Lax342547.LabelRelations Lax342547.TensorBlocks Lax342547.SelectedRemoval

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

noncomputable def chosenLabels (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2) : Finset (Fin b → Binary) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z) => (W.left i u.1 u.2).label)

axiom residual_reconstruction (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree)
    (L : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (Z : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) →
      Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary)
    (hM : ∀ i e, (x i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L i e, block selectorEval s (Z i e s))
    (hc : ∀ i u e, supported (L i e) (Z i e) (W.left i u.1 u.2).label =
      if (W.left i u.1 u.2).tag ∈ e.val then c i u • baseMoment (W.left i u.1 u.2).base else 0) :
    ∀ i e, ((x - selectedPart W c) i).val e =
      ∑ s ∈ L i e \ chosenLabels W i, block selectorEval s (Z i e s)

axiom unselected_obstruction {K : ℕ} [Fintype H] (hk : 0 < k)
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28)) (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∃ c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary,
    ∃ L : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
    ∃ Z : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) →
        Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary,
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V (x - selectedPart W c) ∧
      ∀ i e, (L i e).card ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        (∀ s ∈ L i e, s ∉ chosenLabels W i ∧ IsBaseMoment (Z i e s)) ∧
        (∑ s ∈ L i e, (Z i e s).rank) ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        ((x - selectedPart W c) i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L i e, block selectorEval s (Z i e s)

end Lax342547.ResidualLabels

  instLTNat.lt 0 k →
    ∀ (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
      (P :
        Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
          (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
      instLENat.le P.rank K →
        ∀ (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
          Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28) →
            (∀ (i z : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z)), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (A i) (W.left i z t).label)) →
              ∀
                (U V :
                  Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) →
                    Fin 2 → Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
                (x :
                  Fin 2 → Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
                Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x →
                  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 6 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28)) 4) degree →
                    Exists fun c =>
                      Exists fun L =>
                        Exists fun Z =>
                          And
                            (Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V
                              (instHSub.hSub x (Lax342547.SelectedRemoval.selectedPart W c)))
                            (∀ (i : Fin 2) (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
                              And (instLENat.le (L i e).card (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28))
                                (And

                                    SetLike.instMembership.mem (L i e) s →
                                      And
                                        (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ResidualLabels.chosenLabels W i) s))
                                        (Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment (Z i e s)))
                                  (And
                                    (instLENat.le ((L i e).sum fun s => (Z i e s).rank)
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) 28))
                                    (Eq ((instHSub.hSub x (Lax342547.SelectedRemoval.selectedPart W c) i).val e)
                                      ((L i e).sum fun s =>
                                        LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
                                          (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s)
                                          (Z i e s))))))

concepts.title: The bounded pure remainder of an actual scalar recipe
concepts.description:

the actual recipe solution on the entire cut-profile pair space. The
remaining pure response has per-individual matrix rank at most 14K+140.
Compression and final channel factorization are separate obligations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RankedProjection

/-!
---
title: The bounded pure remainder of an actual scalar recipe
type: lemma
---
Projected target forms and the bounded derivative product are removed from
the actual recipe solution on the entire cut-profile pair space. The
remaining pure response has per-individual matrix rank at most 14K+140.
Compression and final channel factorization are separate obligations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ResidualRealization

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators
open Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.ChannelChanges Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.ResponseMatrices Lax342547.RawBaselines
open Lax342547.TableSpaces

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]

noncomputable def matrixResponse {Comp B : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B]
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (M : Fin 2 → Comp → Matrix B B Binary) :
    Module.Dual Binary (Fin 2 → X) :=
  ∑ i, (∑ e, (matrixPair (M i e)).comp ((LinearMap.proj e).comp X.subtype)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom matrixPair_sub {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M Q : Matrix B B Binary) :
    matrixPair (M - Q) = matrixPair M - matrixPair Q

axiom matrix_response_sub {Comp B : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B]
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (M Q : Fin 2 → Comp → Matrix B B Binary) :
    matrixResponse X (M - Q) = matrixResponse X M - matrixResponse X Q

axiom projected_target [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    {K : ℕ} (hK : P.rank ≤ K)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (M : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree) :
    ∃ (Q : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
      (β : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V),
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) Q ∧
      (∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (β e)) ≤ ∑ i, (M i e).rank) ∧
      ∀ i e, (M i e - Q i e).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧ (Q i e).rank ≤ (M i e).rank

noncomputable def baselineMatrices
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2) :
    Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree :=
  fun i e => coefficients (fullPlus F e i z) (fullMinus F e i z)

axiom baseline_response
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2) :
    matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) (baselineMatrices F z) =
      ∑ i, (fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

noncomputable def derivativeMatrices (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree :=
  fun i e => coefficients
    (restriction (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ e) i)
    (fullMinus F e i z) + coefficients (fullPlus F e i z)
    (restriction (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε e) i)

axiom derivative_response (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) (derivativeMatrices W P Q U V F z δ ε) =
      response W P Q U V F z δ ε

noncomputable def extraFamily (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V :=
  fun e => extraProduct (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (barred W P (V e) (e, false))
    (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (δ e) (ε e)

noncomputable def productMatrices (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree :=
  fun i e => coefficients
    (restriction (barred W P (U e) (e, true)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, false)) (δ e) i)
    (restriction (barred W P (V e) (e, false)) (protectedChannel Q z (e, true)) (ε e) i)

axiom product_response (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V (extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε) =
      matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) (productMatrices W P Q U V z δ ε)

axiom pure_response_sub (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (β γ : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V) :
    Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V (β - γ) =
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β - Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V γ

axiom bounded_remainder {K : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Bounded F K) (z : Fin 2)
    (M : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (β : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z)
    (hδ : ∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (δ e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28)
    (hsol : fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) M -
      ∑ i, (fullContraction F (Profile k n b degree) i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)) :
    ∃ (M0 R0 : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
      (β0 β1 : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V),
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β0 = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) M0 ∧
      (∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (β0 e)) ≤ ∑ i, (M i e).rank) ∧
      (∀ i e, (M0 i e).rank ≤ (M i e).rank) ∧
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β1 = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) R0 ∧
      (∀ i e, (R0 i e).rank ≤ 14 * K + 140) ∧
      β0 + β1 + extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε = β

axiom paired_matrix_representation {Comp B : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B]
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (t : Fin 2 → Module.Dual Binary X) :
    ∃ M : Fin 2 → Comp → Matrix B B Binary,
      matrixResponse X M = ∑ i, (t i).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom recipe_remainder [Fintype N] {K : ℕ} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions.Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H)
    (hF : Extends F T) (hbounded : Bounded F K)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R
      (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.endpointAtoms W i) (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.oppositeP W oB i))
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) (z : Fin 2)
    (M : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (hM : matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) M =
      ∑ i, (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)) :
    ∃ (M0 R0 : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
      (β0 β1 : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
      (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z),
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β0 = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) M0 ∧
      (∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (β0 e)) ≤ ∑ i, (M i e).rank) ∧
      (∀ i e, (M0 i e).rank ≤ (M i e).rank) ∧
      Lax342547.PureObstructions.response W P U V β1 = matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) R0 ∧
      (∀ i e, (R0 i e).rank ≤ 14 * K + 140) ∧
      (∀ e, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (δ e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28 ∧
        Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (ε e)) ≤ 3 * K + 28) ∧
      fullResponse W P Q U V F z (β0 + β1 + extraFamily W P Q U V z δ ε) δ ε =
        ∑ i, (Lax342547.RecipeResiduals.residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

end Lax342547.ResidualRealization

concepts.title: Matrix representations and the bounded residual rank ingredients
concepts.description:
Actual cut-profile functionals have component matrix representations.
Projected forms descend through the actual barred nominal quotients, with
a per-individual removal cost at most 2K+28. Baseline and derivative
contractions have bounded rank, and the derivative product is a permitted
pure quotient response. These ingredients give the paper residual matrix
rank estimate before the remaining compression and channel realization.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BoundedDerivatives
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Matrix representations and the bounded residual rank ingredients
type: lemma
---
Actual cut-profile functionals have component matrix representations.
Projected forms descend through the actual barred nominal quotients, with
a per-individual removal cost at most 2K+28. Baseline and derivative
contractions have bounded rank, and the derivative product is a permitted
pure quotient response. These ingredients give the paper residual matrix
rank estimate before the remaining compression and channel realization.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ResponseMatrices

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.TensorContractions
open Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.TableSpaces
open Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.CutProfiles
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.BarredSpaces
open Lax342547.DerivativeResponses Lax342547.ChannelChanges Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.NominalPrimal Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

noncomputable def coefficients {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) : Matrix B B Binary := by
  classical
  exact LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' ((dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ f g)

noncomputable def extraProduct {B H : Type} [Fintype H]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T) :
    (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  (dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ ((perpendicular S).subtype.comp δ)
    ((perpendicular T).subtype.comp ε)

noncomputable def residualCoefficients {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (M Q : Matrix B B Binary) (f g df dg : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    Matrix B B Binary :=
  M - Q - coefficients f g - coefficients df g - coefficients f dg - coefficients df dg

axiom coefficients_product {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact coefficients f g = (LinearMap.toMatrix' f).transpose * LinearMap.toMatrix' g

axiom toMatrix_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact (LinearMap.toMatrix' f).rank = Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f)

axiom coefficients_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    (coefficients f g).rank ≤ min (Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f))
      (Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range g))

axiom projection_difference {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (A M C : Matrix B B Binary) :
    M - A.transpose * M * C = (1 - A).transpose * M + A.transpose * M * (1 - C)

axiom projection_difference_rank {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (A M C : Matrix B B Binary) :
    (M - A.transpose * M * C).rank ≤ (1 - A).rank + (1 - C).rank

axiom quotient_projection {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (S : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact ∃ A : Matrix B B Binary, S ≤ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin ∧
        (1 - A).rank ≤ Module.finrank Binary S

axiom projected_endpoint_response {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (i : Fin 2) (M A C : Matrix B B Binary)
    (hD : D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin)
    (hE : E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker C.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      pureResponse D E β = (matrixPair (A.transpose * M * C)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom projected_paired_response {B H : Type} [Fintype B]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (M A C : Fin 2 → Matrix B B Binary)
    (hD : ∀ i, D.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker (A i).mulVecLin)
    (hE : ∀ i, E.map (primalProjection i) ≤ LinearMap.ker (C i).mulVecLin) :
    ∃ β : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] Binary,
      pureResponse D E β = ∑ i, (matrixPair ((A i).transpose * M i * C i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom projected_pin_key_dimension {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (i : Fin 2) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) :
    Module.finrank Binary ↥(projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1) ≤ K + 14

axiom actual_pure_projection {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    {H N : Type} [Fintype H] (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree) :
    ∃ (A C : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
      (β : (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P U (e, true)) →ₗ[Binary]
        (Nominal (Coordinate k n b degree) H ⧸ barred W P V (e, false)) →ₗ[Binary] Binary),
      pureResponse (barred W P U (e, true)) (barred W P V (e, false)) β =
        ∑ i, (matrixPair ((A i).transpose * M i * C i)).comp (LinearMap.proj i) ∧
      ∀ i, (M i - (A i).transpose * M i * C i).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        ((A i).transpose * M i * C i).rank ≤ (M i).rank

axiom ambient_matrix_representation {Comp B : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B]
    (t : (Comp → Matrix B B Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Binary) :
    ∃ M : Comp → Matrix B B Binary, ∀ x, t x = ∑ e, matrixPair (M e) (x e)

axiom matrix_representation {Comp B : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B]
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (t : X →ₗ[Binary] Binary) :
    ∃ M : Comp → Matrix B B Binary, ∀ x : X, t x = ∑ e, matrixPair (M e) (x.val e)

axiom comp_left_rank {A V X : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary X] (f : A →ₗ[Binary] X) (g : V →ₗ[Binary] A) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (f.comp g)) ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f)

axiom comp_right_rank {A V X : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module Binary A]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    [FiniteDimensional Binary A] (f : A →ₗ[Binary] X) (g : V →ₗ[Binary] A) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (f.comp g)) ≤ Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range g)

axiom restriction_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (D : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S) (i : Fin 2) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (restriction D S δ i)) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range δ)

axiom baseline_coordinate_rank {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (z : Fin 2) (R : ℕ)
    (hplus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.forward e).compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R)
    (hminus : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range ((F.reverse e).flip.compl₁₂
      (primal (B := B) (H := H)).subtype (channelEmbedding z))) ≤ R) :
    ∀ i, Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (fullPlus F e i z)) ≤ R ∧
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (fullMinus F e i z)) ≤ R

axiom extra_product_response {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (D E : Submodule Binary (Nominal B H)) (S T : Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (δ : (Nominal B H ⧸ D) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular S)
    (ε : (Nominal B H ⧸ E) →ₗ[Binary] perpendicular T) :
    pureResponse D E (extraProduct D E S T δ ε) =
      ∑ i, (matrixPair (coefficients (restriction D S δ i) (restriction E T ε i))).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom rank_sub_le {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M C : Matrix B B Binary) :
    (M - C).rank ≤ M.rank + C.rank

axiom bounded_residual_rank {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] (K : ℕ)
    (M Q : Matrix B B Binary) (hM : (M - Q).rank ≤ 2 * K + 28)
    (f g df dg : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (hf : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range f) ≤ 3 * K + 28)
    (hdf : Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range df) ≤ 3 * K + 28) :
    (residualCoefficients M Q f g df dg).rank ≤ 14 * K + 140

end Lax342547.ResponseMatrices

concepts.description:

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.EffectiveObstructions
import Lax342547.RecipeResiduals

/-!
---
title: Unrestricted linearized solutions for actual scalar recipes
type: lemma
---
The actual pure and allowed derivative response families are linear in their
parameters. The proved full obstruction decomposition and finite-dimensional
annihilator duality construct unrestricted solutions on the whole cut-profile
pair space. Bounded derivative ranks are treated separately; compression
and private-channel factorization remain further obligations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ResponseSolvability


open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.BarredSpaces
open Lax342547.ChannelChanges Lax342547.TableContractions Lax342547.DerivativeResponses
open Lax342547.TableSpaces

open Lax342547.SelectedRemoval Lax342547.PairedRecipes Lax342547.RecipeResiduals
open Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.RawBaselines

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type} [Fintype H]

abbrev Parameters (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (z : Fin 2) :=
  Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V ×
    (PlusParameters W P Q U z × MinusParameters W P Q V z)

axiom full_add (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (β β' : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
    (δ δ' : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε ε' : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    fullResponse W P Q U V F z (β + β') (δ + δ') (ε + ε') =
      fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε + fullResponse W P Q U V F z β' δ' ε'

axiom full_smul (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (a : Binary) (β : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Parameters W P U V)
    (δ : PlusParameters W P Q U z) (ε : MinusParameters W P Q V z) :
    fullResponse W P Q U V F z (a • β) (a • δ) (a • ε) =
      a • fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε

axiom dual_range {K A X : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup A] [Module K A]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [FiniteDimensional K X]
    (R : A →ₗ[K] Module.Dual K X) (t : Module.Dual K X)
    (h : ∀ x, (∀ a, R a x = 0) → t x = 0) : ∃ a, R a = t

axiom solvable_of_annihilator_zero (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (z : Fin 2)
    (t : Module.Dual Binary (Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree))
    (h : ∀ x, Annihilates W P Q U V F z x → t x = 0) :
    ∃ β δ ε, fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε = t

axiom selected_part_correct (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) (i : Fin 2) :
    selectedPart W c i ∈ correctSpace W P i

axiom obstruction_correct {K : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P Q U V F z x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) :
    ∀ i, x i ∈ correctSpace W P i

axiom unrestricted_solution {K : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T) (z : Fin 2)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree)
    (t : Fin 2 → Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree))
    (ht : ∀ i, correctSpace W P i ≤ LinearMap.ker (t i)) :
    ∃ β δ ε, fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε = ∑ i, (t i).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

axiom recipe_solution [Fintype N] {K : ℕ} {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) {copies : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin copies → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (oA oB : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (P Q : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (hU : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, true)) (U e j))
    (hV : ∀ e j, IsCompl (protectedChannel P j (e, false)) (V e j))
    (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q) (hT : Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
    (F : CrossForms (Component (Tag k)) (Coordinate k n b degree) H) (hF : Extends F T)
    (hrecipe : ScalarRecipe W D L R oA oB T A B)
    (hfrozen : Frozen F W P Q oA oB) (hkeys : MatchedKeys W oA oB)
    (hgradients : ∀ i, Lax342547.ConcreteRecipes.RecipeGradients D L R (endpointAtoms W i) (oppositeP W oB i))
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) (z : Fin 2) :
    ∃ β δ ε, fullResponse W P Q U V F z β δ ε =
      ∑ i, (residual W D L R F i z).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

end Lax342547.ResponseSolvability

concepts.title: Trimming a restricted family of exact-pin leaves
concepts.description:
Retained fractions are weighted by the actual original leaf masses.
A bound on their combined cost suffices to keep every surviving leaf's
image and density estimates, with a uniform explicit discarded fraction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafTrimming
import Lax342547.BoundedPeeling

/-!
---
title: Trimming a restricted family of exact-pin leaves
type: lemma
---
Retained fractions are weighted by the actual original leaf masses.
A bound on their combined cost suffices to keep every surviving leaf's
image and density estimates, with a uniform explicit discarded fraction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RestrictedLeaves

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.LeafTrimming Lax342547.BoundedPeeling
open scoped ENNReal

axiom restricted_family {Ω J Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [Fintype J] [Fintype Axis]
    (p : J → PMF Ω) (μ : PMF Ω)
    (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P : J → Pin Axis I N) (S : J → Set Ω) (w : J → ℝ≥0∞)
    (C ζ η : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (hw : ∑ j, w j ≤ 1)
    (hq : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(η * n)) ≤ ∑ j, w j * (p j).toOuterMeasure (S j))
    (hcap : ∀ j (Q : Pin Axis I N), 1 ≤ (P j).relativeRank Q →
      (p j).toOuterMeasure (Q.event A) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * n))) ^ (P j).relativeRank Q)
    (hdensity : ∀ j o, p j o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (C * n) * μ o) :
    discardedMass w (fun j => (p j).toOuterMeasure (S j)) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * n))) /
        (∑ j, w j * (p j).toOuterMeasure (S j)) ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((ζ - η) * n)) ∧
    ∀ j, (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * n)) ≤ (p j).toOuterMeasure (S j) →
      LawBound (p j) μ A (P j) (S j)
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - 2 * ζ) * n))) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((C + ζ) * n))

axiom weighted_residual {J : Type} [Fintype J] (w r : J → ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hw : ∑ j, w j ≤ 1) (hr : ∀ j, r j ≤ δ) : ∑ j, w j * r j ≤ δ

end Lax342547.RestrictedLeaves

concepts.title: Rank loss under restriction of a bilinear form
concepts.description:
Restricting both arguments to a subspace of codimension c loses at
most 2c in rank. No symmetry, positivity, or characteristic assumption
is needed. Applied to the polar form, this is the rank-loss step in
the unary mixer estimate of Lemma 5.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Properties
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

/-!
---
title: Rank loss under restriction of a bilinear form
type: lemma
---
Restricting both arguments to a subspace of codimension c loses at
most 2c in rank. No symmetry, positivity, or characteristic assumption
is needed. Applied to the polar form, this is the rank-loss step in
the unary mixer estimate of Lemma 5.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RestrictionRank

axiom bilinear_restriction_rank {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (S : Submodule K V) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (B.restrict S)) +
      2 * (Module.finrank K V - Module.finrank K S)

axiom bilinear_pullback_rank {K V W : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V) (A : W →ₗ[K] V) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range B) ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (B.comp A A)) +
      2 * (Module.finrank K V - Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range A))

end Lax342547.RestrictionRank

import Lax342547.QuotientFactors
import Lax342547.CoefficientPhase
import Lax342547.FrozenRecords

/-!
---
title: Actual cross Gram characters on frozen unary cells
type: lemma
---
Frozen agreement removes every frozen-factor coefficient term. Quotient rank factors and conditional image caps give the exact zero-character versus .45N bias alternative for actual cross Gram characters.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RetainedCharacters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

noncomputable def actualForm {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (X Y : Matrix N I Binary) : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact (X.transpose * Y).toBilin'

axiom coefficient_pair_form {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) (X Y : Matrix N I Binary) : by
      classical
      exact coefficientPair C X Y = matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (actualForm X Y)) C

axiom binary_self_add (z : Binary) : z + z = 0

axiom disagreement_projection {I N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (p q : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary))
    (hp : D.mkQ.comp p = D.mkQ) (hq : E.mkQ.comp q = E.mkQ)
    (X Y : Matrix N I Binary) (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary))
    (hD : ∀ v ∈ D, ∀ w, actualForm X Y v w = T v w)
    (hE : ∀ v w, w ∈ E → actualForm X Y v w = T v w) : by
      classical
      let Z := p.toMatrix' * C * q.toMatrix'.transpose
      exact coefficientPair C X Y + matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) C =
        coefficientPair Z X Y + matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) Z

axiom sign_abs (z : Binary) : |sign z| = 1

axiom rank_zero_matrix {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (h : C.rank = 0) : C = 0

    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (X : ΩA → Matrix N I Binary) (Y : ΩB → Matrix N I Binary)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary))
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b)
    (hαsum : ∑ a, α a = 1) (hβsum : ∑ b, β b = 1)
    (hD : ∀ a b v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, actualForm (X a) (Y b) v w = T v w)
    (hE : ∀ a b v w, w ∈ E → actualForm (X a) (Y b) v w = T v w)
    (hcapA : ∀ r (A : Matrix I (Fin r) Binary), Function.Injective (D.mkQ.comp A.mulVecLin) →
      ∀ x, push α (fun a => factorImage A (X a)) x ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*(r * Fintype.card N)))
    (hcapB : ∀ r (B : Matrix I (Fin r) Binary), Function.Injective (E.mkQ.comp B.mulVecLin) →
      ∀ y, push β (fun b => factorImage B (Y b)) y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*(r * Fintype.card N)))
    (C : Matrix I I Binary) : by
      classical
      let mean := ∑ a, ∑ b, α a * β b *
        sign (coefficientPair C (X a) (Y b) + matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) C)
      exact mean = 1 ∨ |mean| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card N)

concepts.description: The aggregate generic parameter error gives an explicit discarded-mass bound, while the actual whole cut-space residual and common diagonal coefficient vanish exactly on retained units.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.EmptyPredictions
import Lax342547.MomentTails

/-!
---
title: Actual vanishing predictions on a retained population
type: lemma
---
The aggregate generic parameter error gives an explicit discarded-mass bound, while the actual whole cut-space residual and common diagonal coefficient vanish exactly on retained units.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RetainedEmptyPredictions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open Lax342547.AtomParameters
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def predictionError {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary) (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) : ℝ :=
  cellMass (fun _ : Fin (ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic) → Binary =>
    1/(2 : ℝ)^(ParameterSize n l Flavor.generic))
    (fun x => φ (parameterAtom (degree := degree) l s Flavor.generic x)+
      γ*eta (b := b) (degree := degree) hr (pointMoment selectorEval s (parameterBase l Flavor.generic x)) ≠ 0)

noncomputable def totalPredictionError {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary) (E : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ l : Tag k,∑ s : Fin b → Binary,if s ∈ E then 0 else predictionError hr φ γ l s

axiom prediction_error_nonneg {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary) (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) :
    0 ≤ predictionError hr φ γ l s

axiom prediction_error_le_total {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n)
    (φ : Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : Binary) (E : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (hs : s ∉ E) :
    predictionError hr φ γ l s ≤ totalPredictionError hr φ γ E

axiom retained_vanishing_predictions {U : Type} [Fintype U] {k n b degree r : ℕ}
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hr0 : 0 < r) (β : U → ℝ)
    (φ : U → Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree)) (γ : U → Binary)
    (E : U → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (ε : ℝ) (hβ : Probability β)
    (hE : ∀ u,2^(degree+degree)*(E u).card < 2^b)
    (herr : (∑ u,β u*totalPredictionError hr (φ u) (γ u) (E u)) ≤ ε) :
    1-4*ε ≤ cellMass β (fun u => γ u = 0 ∧ φ u = 0)

end Lax342547.RetainedEmptyPredictions

  (φ :

      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x))
  (γ : Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (E : Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),

concepts.title: Image caps inside original retained cells
concepts.description: Conditioning an original unary record cell costs only its own mass. The joint key and fresh-image cap gives the .95tN exponent, without intersecting cells over opposite parameters.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

/-!
---
title: Image caps inside original retained cells
type: lemma
---
Conditioning an original unary record cell costs only its own mass. The joint key and fresh-image cap gives the .95tN exponent, without intersecting cells over opposite parameters.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RetainedImages

open Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh

noncomputable def cellMass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ω, if C ω then ρ ω else 0

noncomputable def conditionalLaw {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) : Ω → ℝ := by
  classical
  exact fun ω => (if C ω then ρ ω else 0) / cellMass ρ C

axiom conditional_law_nonneg {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop)
    (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ conditionalLaw ρ C ω

axiom conditional_law_total {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop)
    (hC : 0 < cellMass ρ C) : ∑ ω, conditionalLaw ρ C ω = 1

axiom conditional_image_cap {Ω X : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) (image : Ω → X) (joint : Ω → Prop)
    (τ cap : ℝ) (hρ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ρ ω) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hC : τ ≤ cellMass ρ C) (hCJ : ∀ ω, C ω → joint ω)
    (hcap : ∀ x, cellMass ρ (fun ω => joint ω ∧ image ω = x) ≤ cap) (x : X) :
    push (conditionalLaw ρ C) image x ≤ cap / τ

axiom paper_cell_exponent (ζ k t : ℝ) (_hζ : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hζsmall : ζ ≤ 1 / 1000) (hk : 2 * ζ * k ≤ 1 / 500) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    -(1 - 2 * ζ) * (k + t) + (k + 1 / 100) ≤ -(95 / 100 : ℝ) * t

axiom paper_conditional_cap (ζ k t N : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hζsmall : ζ ≤ 1 / 1000) (hk : 2 * ζ * k ≤ 1 / 500) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : 0 ≤ N) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 - 2 * ζ) * (k + t) * N) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k + 1 / 100) * N) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(95 / 100 : ℝ) * t * N)

end Lax342547.RetainedImages

conditional_image_cap : ∀ {Ω X : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (ρ : Ω → Real) (C : Ω → Prop) (image : Ω → X) (joint : Ω → Prop) (τ cap : Real),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 τ →
      Real.instLE.le τ (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C) →
        (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → joint ω) →
          (∀ (x : X),
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ fun ω => And (joint ω) (Eq (image ω) x)) cap) →
            ∀ (x : X),
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh.push (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw ρ C) image x)
                (instHDiv.hDiv cap τ)

  (∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (ρ ω)) → ∀ (ω : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw ρ C ω)

  Real.instLT.lt 0 (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass ρ C) →
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun ω => Lax342547.RetainedImages.conditionalLaw ρ C ω) 1

concepts.title: Right endpoint query-key caps via paired-list reindexing
concepts.description: The flipped paired lists reindex the same incident positions and slots. Their actual left-key cap therefore gives the right-key cap with exactly the original exponent.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawQueryImages
import Lax342547.PairedRecipes

/-!
---
title: Right endpoint query-key caps via paired-list reindexing
type: lemma
---
The flipped paired lists reindex the same incident positions and slots. Their actual left-key cap therefore gives the right-key cap with exactly the original exponent.
-/

namespace Lax342547.RightQueryImages

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.PairedRecipes Lax342547.QueryReference
open Lax342547.ReferenceKeys Lax342547.ReferencePins Lax342547.KeySpans
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable def flippedPosition {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) :
    ComponentPosition (flip W) e ≃ ComponentPosition W e where
  toFun p := ⟨⟨p.val.2.1,p.val.1,p.val.2.2⟩, by
    have h := p.property
    change (W.right p.val.2.1 p.val.1 p.val.2.2).tag ∈ e.val at h
    rwa [W.same_tag]⟩
  invFun p := ⟨⟨p.val.2.1,p.val.1,p.val.2.2⟩, by
    change (W.right p.val.1 p.val.2.1 p.val.2.2).tag ∈ e.val
    rw [← W.same_tag]
    exact p.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

noncomputable def reindexTuple {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (q : Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N) :
    Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition (flip W)) N :=
  fun e => ⟨fun n p => (q e).1 n (flippedPosition W e p),
    fun n p => (q e).2 n (flippedPosition W e p)⟩

axiom reindex_injective {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {N : Type}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : Function.Injective (reindexTuple (N := N) W)

axiom left_flip_right_tuple {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)) :
    leftTuple (flip W) o = reindexTuple W (rightTuple W o)

axiom right_tuple_event {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (o : Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E))
    (q : Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N) :
    rightTuple W o = q ↔ leftTuple (flip W) o = reindexTuple W q

axiom flipped_slot_count {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) : by
      classical
      exact Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot (flip W)) =
        Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)

axiom actual_right_key_cap {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] [Fintype N] {E : Moment k n b degree}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (p : PMF (Unit (H := H) (N := N) (E := E)))
    (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hB : Excludes P B)
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.right i z t).label ∉ B z)
    (q : Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k)) (ComponentPosition W) N)
    (α : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcap : ∀ Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Tag k) × Bool)
      (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N,
      1 ≤ P.relativeRank Q → p.toOuterMeasure (Q.event observation) ≤ α ^ (P.relativeRank Q))
    (hrank : 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | rightTuple W o = q} ≤ α ^ Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)

end Lax342547.RightQueryImages

actual_right_key_cap : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (p : PMF Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit)
  (P :
    Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
      (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N)
  (B : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.KeySpans.Excludes P B →
    (∀ (i z : Fin 2) (t : Fin (W.length i z)), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (B z) (W.right i z t).label)) →
      ∀
        (q :
          Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))
            (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W) N)
        (α : ENNReal),
        (∀
            (Q :
              Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)) Bool)
                (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Coordinate k n b degree) H)) N),
            instLENat.le 1 (P.relativeRank Q) →
              ENNReal.instLE.le
                (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
                  (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Q))
                (instHPow.hPow α (P.relativeRank Q))) →
          instLENat.le 1 (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)) →
            ENNReal.instLE.le
              (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
                (Set.ofPred fun o => Eq (Lax342547.QueryReference.rightTuple W o) q))
              (instHPow.hPow α (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W)))

flipped_slot_count : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n}
  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr),
  Eq (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W)))
    (Fintype.card (Lax342547.QuerySlots.Slot W))

left_flip_right_tuple : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (o : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit),
  Eq (Lax342547.QueryReference.leftTuple (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) o)
    (Lax342547.RightQueryImages.reindexTuple W (Lax342547.QueryReference.rightTuple W o))

right_tuple_event : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n} {H N : Type} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  {E : Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.Moment k n b degree} (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr)
  (o : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Unit)
  (q :
    Lax342547.ReferenceKeys.Tuples (Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k))
      (Lax342547.QueryReference.ComponentPosition W) N),
  Iff (Eq (Lax342547.QueryReference.rightTuple W o) q)
    (Eq (Lax342547.QueryReference.leftTuple (Lax342547.PairedRecipes.flip W) o)
      (Lax342547.RightQueryImages.reindexTuple W q))

concepts.title: Graphs sampled from a hole relation
concepts.description:
Given a symmetric relation of holes and a list of raw vertices, join two
distinct positions exactly when their entries have no hole. Repeated raw
vertices are permitted. If the hole relation has no triangles, every
independent set of the sampled graph has size at most two, as in (2.2).
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique

/-!
---
title: Graphs sampled from a hole relation
type: lemma
---
Given a symmetric relation of holes and a list of raw vertices, join two
distinct positions exactly when their entries have no hole. Repeated raw
vertices are permitted. If the hole relation has no triangles, every
independent set of the sampled graph has size at most two, as in (2.2).
-/

namespace Lax342547.SampledGraph

universe u

def sampleGraph {Ω : Type u} (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : (∀ ⦃i j⦄, hole i j → hole j i))
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) : SimpleGraph (Fin m) where
  Adj i j := i ≠ j ∧ ¬ hole (sample i) (sample j)
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h ↦ ⟨h.1.symm, fun h' ↦ h.2 (hsymm h')⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h ↦ h.1 rfl⟩

axiom sampleGraph_indepNum_le_two {Ω : Type u}
    (hole : Ω → Ω → Prop) (hsymm : (∀ ⦃i j⦄, hole i j → hole j i))
    (htriangle : ∀ i j k, hole i j → hole j k → ¬ hole k i)
    {m : ℕ} (sample : Fin m → Ω) :
    (sampleGraph hole hsymm sample).indepNum ≤ 2

end Lax342547.SampledGraph

  (∀ (i j k : Ω), hole i j → hole j k → Not (hole k i)) →
    ∀ {m : Nat} (sample : Fin m → Ω), instLENat.le (Lax342547.SampledGraph.sampleGraph hole hsymm sample).indepNum 2

concepts.title: Eventual sampling margins for the paper parameters
concepts.description: The raw alphabet bound and explicit fingerprint length give a strict total sampling budget for all sufficiently large ambient dimensions, uniformly over raw spaces satisfying the same quadratic logarithmic size bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FingerprintScales
import Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics

/-!
---
title: Eventual sampling margins for the paper parameters
type: lemma
---
The raw alphabet bound and explicit fingerprint length give a strict total sampling budget for all sufficiently large ambient dimensions, uniformly over raw spaces satisfying the same quadratic logarithmic size bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SampleScales

open Lax342547.RawToGraph Lax342547.FingerprintScales Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics
open Filter

axiom raw_alphabet_bound (v A N : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ 2^(A*N^2)) :
    v^2+1 ≤ 2^(2*A*N^2+1)

axiom raw_fingerprint_count_bound (v A g N : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ 2^(A*N^2)) :
    (v^2+1)^fingerprintLength g N ≤ 2^(exponentBudget A g N)

axiom paper_sampling_budget (v A g N : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hv : v ≤ 2^(A*N^2)) (he : exponentBudget A g N+2 < sampleSize g N) :
    (((v^2+1)^fingerprintLength g N : ℕ) : ℝ)*
      exceptionBudget (sampleSize g N) ((sampleSize g N+199)/200) ((2 : ℝ)^1000) ((2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N)) < 1

axiom eventually_paper_sampling_budget (A g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ v : ℕ, v ≤ 2^(A*N^2) →
      (((v^2+1)^fingerprintLength g N : ℕ) : ℝ)*
        exceptionBudget (sampleSize g N) ((sampleSize g N+199)/200)
          ((2 : ℝ)^1000) ((2 : ℝ)^(4000*g*N)) < 1

end Lax342547.SampleScales

            Real.instLT.lt
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow v 2) 1)
                    (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.fingerprintLength g N)).cast
                (Lax342547.RawToGraph.exceptionBudget (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N) 199) 200)
                  (instHPow.hPow 2 1000) (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4000 g) N))))
              1)
      Filter.atTop

    instLTNat.lt 0 N →

        instLTNat.lt (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.ContainerAsymptotics.exponentBudget A g N) 2)
            (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N) →
          Real.instLT.lt
            (instHMul.hMul
              (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow v 2) 1)
                  (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.fingerprintLength g N)).cast
              (Lax342547.RawToGraph.exceptionBudget (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N)
                (instHDiv.hDiv (instHAdd.hAdd (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.sampleSize g N) 199) 200)

      (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 A) (instHPow.hPow N 2)) 1))

  instLENat.le v (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul A (instHPow.hPow N 2))) →
    instLENat.le
      (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow v 2) 1) (Lax342547.FingerprintScales.fingerprintLength g N))

concepts.title: Simultaneous agreement of linear cross Gram tests on retained cells
concepts.description: Expand the actual family of scalar Gram tests into coefficient characters. Frozen agreement and all-rank conditional image caps imply agreement of the entire family at cost two to the number of tests plus one.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RetainedCharacters

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous agreement of linear cross Gram tests on retained cells
type: lemma
---
Expand the actual family of scalar Gram tests into coefficient characters. Frozen agreement and all-rank conditional image caps imply agreement of the entire family at cost two to the number of tests plus one.
-/

namespace Lax342547.ScalarGramAgreement

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Walsh Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CoefficientPhase Lax342547.PushforwardWalsh Lax342547.RetainedCharacters
open Lax342547.FourierTests

noncomputable def coefficient {I S : Type} [Fintype S]
    (tests : S → Matrix I I Binary) (t : S → Binary) : Matrix I I Binary :=
  ∑ s, t s • tests s

noncomputable def actualBits {I S N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (tests : S → Matrix I I Binary) (X Y : Matrix N I Binary) : S → Binary :=
  fun s => coefficientPair (tests s) X Y

noncomputable def targetBits {I S : Type} [Fintype I]
    (tests : S → Matrix I I Binary) (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary)) : S → Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun s => matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) (tests s)

axiom coefficient_character {I S N : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype S] [Fintype N]
    (tests : S → Matrix I I Binary) (t : S → Binary) (X Y : Matrix N I Binary)
    (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary)) : by
      classical
      exact phase t (actualBits tests X Y) * phase t (targetBits tests T) =
        sign (coefficientPair (coefficient tests t) X Y +
          matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' T) (coefficient tests t))

axiom scalar_gram_agreement {ΩA ΩB I S N : Type}
    [Fintype ΩA] [Fintype ΩB] [Fintype I] [Fintype S] [Fintype N]
    (α : ΩA → ℝ) (β : ΩB → ℝ)
    (X : ΩA → Matrix N I Binary) (Y : ΩB → Matrix N I Binary)
    (D E : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (T : LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (I → Binary))
    (tests : S → Matrix I I Binary)
    (hα : ∀ a, 0 ≤ α a) (hβ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ β b)
    (hαsum : ∑ a, α a = 1) (hβsum : ∑ b, β b = 1)
    (hD : ∀ a b v, v ∈ D → ∀ w, actualForm (X a) (Y b) v w = T v w)
    (hE : ∀ a b v w, w ∈ E → actualForm (X a) (Y b) v w = T v w)
    (hcapA : ∀ r (A : Matrix I (Fin r) Binary), Function.Injective (D.mkQ.comp A.mulVecLin) →
      ∀ x, push α (fun a => factorImage A (X a)) x ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*(r * Fintype.card N)))
    (hcapB : ∀ r (B : Matrix I (Fin r) Binary), Function.Injective (E.mkQ.comp B.mulVecLin) →
      ∀ y, push β (fun b => factorImage B (Y b)) y ≤
        (2 : ℝ)^(-(95/100 : ℝ)*(r * Fintype.card N)))
    (hsmall : (2 : ℝ)^(-(45/100 : ℝ)*Fintype.card N) ≤

concepts.title: Fresh peeling after restrictions and deliberate extra pins
concepts.description:
Every retained metadata fiber carries its old pins and all new prescribed
images. Its absolute density pays both preceding normalizations. A fresh
peeling fits inside the paper's final total pin budget.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SplitTrimming
import Lax342547.BoundedPeeling
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Floor.Ring

/-!
---
title: Fresh peeling after restrictions and deliberate extra pins
type: lemma
---
Every retained metadata fiber carries its old pins and all new prescribed
images. Its absolute density pays both preceding normalizations. A fresh
peeling fits inside the paper's final total pin budget.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SecondPeeling

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.MetadataPins
open Lax342547.LeafPartition Lax342547.BoundedPeeling
open scoped ENNReal

def startCost (D : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ) : ℝ := D + K₁ + u + 5

noncomputable def newBudget (D ζ : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈4 * (startCost D K₁ u + 1) / ζ⌉₊

noncomputable def finalBudget (D ζ : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ⌈10 * (D + K₁ + u + 10) / ζ⌉₊

noncomputable def supportFinset {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (p : PMF Ω) : Finset Ω := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun o => o ∈ p.support)

def RepeeledPart {Ω J Axis I N : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype N]
    (q μ : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (choice : Ω → J) (U : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (D ζ : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ) (k : Key N U) : Prop :=
  ∃ hkSupport : ∃ o ∈ {o | record A choice U o = k}, o ∈ q.support,
  let Q := q.filter {o | record A choice U o = k} hkSupport
  ∃ P : Pin Axis I N, ∃ L : Finset (Finset Ω × Pin Axis I N),
    P₀.Extends P ∧ (pin k).Extends P ∧ P.rank ≤ K₁ + u ∧
    Partition Q A P (supportFinset Q)
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * Fintype.card N)))
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * Fintype.card N))) L ∧
    q.toOuterMeasure (supportFinset Q \ L.biUnion Prod.fst) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * Fintype.card N)) *
        q.toOuterMeasure {o | record A choice U o = k} ∧
    ∀ z ∈ L, z.2.rank ≤ finalBudget D ζ K₁ u ∧
      LawBound Q μ A z.2 z.1
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ζ) * Fintype.card N)))
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((startCost D K₁ u + newBudget D ζ K₁ u + 1) * Fintype.card N))

axiom final_rank_budget (D ζ : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) :
    K₁ + u + newBudget D ζ K₁ u ≤ finalBudget D ζ K₁ u

axiom second_part {Ω J Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p μ : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (P₀ : Pin Axis I N) (S : Set Ω) (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (choice : Ω → J) (U : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (D ζ ε : ℝ) (K₁ u : ℕ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hζ₁ : ζ ≤ 1) (hε : ε ≤ ζ / 4)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card N) (hP : p.support ⊆ P₀.event A) (hPbudget : P₀.rank ≤ K₁)
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (U j a) ≤ u)
    (hSbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * Fintype.card N)) ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S)
    (hp : ∀ o, p o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K₁ + 1) * Fintype.card N) * μ o)
    (hreference : ∀ P : Pin Axis I N, μ.toOuterMeasure (P.event A) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((1 - ε) * P.rank * Fintype.card N)))
    (k : Key N U)
    (hk : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * Fintype.card N)) ≤
      (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure {o | record A choice U o = k}) :
    RepeeledPart (p.filter S hS) μ A P₀ choice U D ζ K₁ u k

end Lax342547.SecondPeeling

                            (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))) →

concepts.title: Selected tensor blocks of actual pure obstructions
concepts.description:
Freshness of the actual lists leaves one possible individual key ray at
a selected label. Extracting its block through the pin-plus-key quotients
forces a scalar point moment on its tag star and zero off that star.
Agreement of those scalars across components is a subsequent obligation.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorBlocks
import Lax342547.QuotientExtractors
import Lax342547.PureObstructions

/-!
---
title: Selected tensor blocks of actual pure obstructions
type: lemma
---
Freshness of the actual lists leaves one possible individual key ray at
a selected label. Extracting its block through the pin-plus-key quotients
forces a scalar point moment on its tag star and zero off that star.
Agreement of those scalars across components is a subsequent obligation.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SelectedBlocks

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.WitnessAtoms
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions
open Lax342547.BarredSpaces Lax342547.PairedAnnihilators Lax342547.BaseMoments

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

noncomputable def keyBase (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (t : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) : Option (Base k n) → Binary := by
  classical
  exact if (W.left i t.1 t.2).tag ∈ e.val then baseEval (W.left i t.1 t.2).base else 0

noncomputable def individualRay (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) (t : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) :
    Submodule Binary (Option (Base k n) → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact if (W.left i t.1 t.2).tag ∈ e.val then
    Submodule.span Binary {baseEval (W.left i t.1 t.2).base} else ⊥

axiom individual_extractor {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Component (Tag k) × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hL : L.card ≤ R) (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z))
    (hs : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∈ L) (hfresh : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∉ A i) :
    ∃ q : (Vector k n b degree ⧸ (projected P i a ⊔ individualKeys W i a.1)) →ₗ[Binary]
        ((Option (Base k n) → Binary) ⧸ individualRay W i a.1 u),
      ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ v, q (Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) t v)) =
          if t = (W.left i u.1 u.2).label then (individualRay W i a.1 u).mkQ v else 0

axiom selected_component {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (U V : Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary)) (e : Component (Tag k))
    (M : Fin 2 → Moment k n b degree)
    (h : PairedAnnihilates M (barred W P U (e, true)) (barred W P V (e, false)))
    (i : Fin 2) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : M i = ∑ t ∈ L, Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block selectorEval t (Z t))
    (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) (hs : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∈ L)
    (hfresh : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∉ A i)
    (hZ : IsBaseMoment (Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label)) :
    Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label =
      if (W.left i u.1 u.2).tag ∈ e.val then
        Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label none none • baseMoment (W.left i u.1 u.2).base else 0

axiom selected_obstruction {R : ℕ} (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x)
    (i : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (Z : (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hM : ∀ a c, (x i).val e a c =
      ∑ t ∈ L, selectorEval t a.1 * selectorEval t c.1 * Z t a.2 c.2)
    (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) (hs : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∈ L)
    (hfresh : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∉ A i)
    (hZ : IsBaseMoment (Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label)) :
    Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label =
      if (W.left i u.1 u.2).tag ∈ e.val then
        Z (W.left i u.1 u.2).label none none • baseMoment (W.left i u.1 u.2).base else 0

end Lax342547.SelectedBlocks

concepts.title: A selected affine ray determines its moment block
concepts.description:
An explicit projection onto the quotient by an affine point ray. The
Boolean moment diagonal identity removes the mixed first-row terms in
a symmetric tensor killed by that quotient in both factors (§6).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BaseMoments
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin

/-!
---
title: A selected affine ray determines its moment block
type: lemma
---
An explicit projection onto the quotient by an affine point ray. The
Boolean moment diagonal identity removes the mixed first-row terms in
a symmetric tensor killed by that quotient in both factors (§6).
-/

namespace Lax342547.SelectedMoments

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.BaseMoments

def rayProjection {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] [DecidableEq Base]
    (z : Base → Binary) : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary :=
  1 - Matrix.vecMulVec (baseEval z) (Pi.single none 1)

axiom projection_kernel {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] [DecidableEq Base]
    (z : Base → Binary) :
    LinearMap.ker (rayProjection z).mulVecLin =
      Submodule.span Binary {baseEval z}

axiom moment_ray {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] [DecidableEq Base]
    (z : Base → Binary) (Z : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary)
    (hZ : IsBaseMoment Z)
    (h : rayProjection z * Z * (rayProjection z).transpose = 0) :
    Z = Z none none • baseMoment z

end Lax342547.SelectedMoments

  Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment Z →

concepts.title: Subtracting selected atoms preserves pure annihilation
concepts.description:
Both factors of an incident selected atom are frozen keys. Every pure
quotient response therefore kills that atom. Linear combinations of
the selected atoms can be subtracted from the pair of cut profiles
while preserving every pure-response annihilation test.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SelectedScalars

/-!
---
title: Subtracting selected atoms preserves pure annihilation
type: lemma
---
Both factors of an incident selected atom are frozen keys. Every pure
quotient response therefore kills that atom. Linear combinations of
the selected atoms can be subtracted from the pair of cut profiles
while preserving every pure-response annihilation test.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SelectedRemoval

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PureObstructions

variable {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}

noncomputable def selectedPart (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree :=
  fun i => ∑ u, c i u • (W.left i u.1 u.2).profile

axiom atom_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (i : Fin 2) (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) :
    Annihilates W P U V (Pi.single i (W.left i u.1 u.2).profile)

axiom selected_part_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) :
    Annihilates W P U V (selectedPart W c)

axiom subtract_annihilates (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Annihilates W P U V x)
    (c : ∀ i : Fin 2, (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary) :
    Annihilates W P U V (x - selectedPart W c)

end Lax342547.SelectedRemoval
