concepts.title: Selected label coefficients agree across the cut profile
concepts.description:
The three-edge cut relation separates by label. A coefficient supported
on one tag star consequently has one scalar on the entire star. Applying
the selected-block theorem to actual pure obstructions yields a single
scalar multiple of each selected point atom.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SelectedBlocks
import Lax342547.LabelRelations

/-!
---
title: Selected label coefficients agree across the cut profile
type: lemma
---
The three-edge cut relation separates by label. A coefficient supported
on one tag star consequently has one scalar on the entire star. Applying
the selected-block theorem to actual pure obstructions yields a single
scalar multiple of each selected point atom.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SelectedScalars

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.PairedWitnesses
open Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.BaseMoments
open Lax342547.LabelRelations Lax342547.TensorBlocks

axiom profile_triangle {k n b degree R : ℕ} (x : Profile k n b degree)
    (L : Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (Z : Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hL : ∀ e, (L e).card ≤ R) (hdegree : 3 * R ≤ degree + 1)
    (hM : ∀ e, x.val e = ∑ s ∈ L e, block selectorEval s (Z e s))
    (a b c : Tag k) (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    ∀ s, supported (L (edge a b hab)) (Z (edge a b hab)) s +
      supported (L (edge b c hbc)) (Z (edge b c hbc)) s +
      supported (L (edge a c hac)) (Z (edge a c hac)) s = 0

axiom star_scalar {Tag : Type} [DecidableEq Tag] [Nontrivial Tag]
    (l : Tag) (c : Component Tag → Binary)
    (htriangle : ∀ a b d (hab : a ≠ b) (hbd : b ≠ d) (had : a ≠ d),
      c (edge a b hab) + c (edge b d hbd) + c (edge a d had) = 0)
    (hout : ∀ e, l ∉ e.val → c e = 0) :
    ∃ v : Binary, ∀ e, c e = if l ∈ e.val then v else 0

axiom selected_scalar {k n b degree R : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (x : Profile k n b degree)
    (L : Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (Z : Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hL : ∀ e, (L e).card ≤ R) (hdegree : 3 * R ≤ degree + 1)
    (hM : ∀ e, x.val e = ∑ s ∈ L e, block selectorEval s (Z e s))
    (s : Fin b → Binary) (l : Tag k) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hshape : ∀ e, supported (L e) (Z e) s = if l ∈ e.val then
      (supported (L e) (Z e) s) none none • baseMoment z else 0) :
    ∃ v : Binary, ∀ e, supported (L e) (Z e) s = if l ∈ e.val then v • baseMoment z else 0

axiom obstruction_scalar {k n b degree r R : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x)
    (i : Fin 2) (L : Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (Z : Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary)
    (hL : ∀ e, (L e).card ≤ R) (hdegree : 3 * R ≤ degree + 1)
    (hM : ∀ e, (x i).val e = ∑ s ∈ L e, block selectorEval s (Z e s))
    (hZ : ∀ e s, s ∈ L e → IsBaseMoment (Z e s))
    (u : Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) (hfresh : (W.left i u.1 u.2).label ∉ A i) :
    ∃ v : Binary, ∀ e, supported (L e) (Z e) (W.left i u.1 u.2).label =
      if (W.left i u.1 u.2).tag ∈ e.val then v • baseMoment (W.left i u.1 u.2).base else 0

axiom selected_decomposition {k n b degree r K : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n} {H N : Type}
    [Fintype H] (hk : 0 < k) (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (P : Pin (Component (Tag k) × Bool) (Fin 2 × (Coordinate k n b degree ⊕ H)) N)
    (hK : P.rank ≤ K) (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary))
    (hA : Covers P A (2 * K + 28))
    (hfresh : ∀ i z t, (W.left i z t).label ∉ A i)
    (U V : Component (Tag k) → Fin 2 → Submodule Binary (H → Binary))
    (x : Fin 2 → Profile k n b degree) (h : Lax342547.PureObstructions.Annihilates W P U V x)
    (hdegree : 6 * (2 * K + 28) + 4 ≤ degree) (i : Fin 2) :
    ∃ L : Component (Tag k) → Finset (Fin b → Binary),
    ∃ Z : Component (Tag k) → (Fin b → Binary) → Matrix (Option (Base k n)) (Option (Base k n)) Binary,
    ∃ c : (Σ z, Fin (W.length i z)) → Binary,
      (∀ e, (L e).card ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧ (∀ s ∈ L e, IsBaseMoment (Z e s)) ∧
        (∑ s ∈ L e, (Z e s).rank) ≤ 2 * K + 28 ∧
        ∀ a d, (x i).val e a d = ∑ s ∈ L e,
          selectorEval s a.1 * selectorEval s d.1 * Z e s a.2 d.2) ∧
      ∀ u e, supported (L e) (Z e) (W.left i u.1 u.2).label =
        if (W.left i u.1 u.2).tag ∈ e.val then c u • baseMoment (W.left i u.1 u.2).base else 0

end Lax342547.SelectedScalars

concepts.title: Interpolation of finitely many binary selector labels
concepts.description:
The second assertion of Lemma 5.1: any u distinct selector evaluation
vectors are linearly independent when the degree bound is at least u−1.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndependent.Defs

/-!
---
title: Interpolation of finitely many binary selector labels
type: lemma
---
The second assertion of Lemma 5.1: any u distinct selector evaluation
vectors are linearly independent when the degree bound is at least u−1.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def monomial {b : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin b)) : (Fin b → Binary) → Binary :=
  fun s => ∏ i ∈ S, s i

def selectorSpan (b degree : ℕ) : Submodule Binary ((Fin b → Binary) → Binary) :=
  Submodule.span Binary {f | ∃ S : Finset (Fin b), S.card ≤ degree ∧ f = monomial S}

axiom selectorEval_linearIndependent {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {b degree : ℕ}
    (s : ι → Fin b → Binary) (hs : Function.Injective s)
    (hdegree : Fintype.card ι ≤ degree + 1) :
    LinearIndependent Binary (fun i => selectorEval (degree := degree) (s i))

end Lax342547.SelectorInterpolation

statements.signature:
selectorEval_linearIndependent : ∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] {b degree : Nat} (s : ι → Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Function.Injective s →
    instLENat.le (Fintype.card ι) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      LinearIndependent Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary fun i => Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval (s i)

concepts.title: Finite sequential tests
concepts.description: Independent finite draws satisfy sequential lower bounds under prefix-dependent tests, including a bounded sampling horizon.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteSampling
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Basic

/-!
---
title: Finite sequential tests
type: lemma
---
Independent finite draws satisfy sequential lower bounds under prefix-dependent tests, including a bounded sampling horizon.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SequentialTests

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

def accepts {Ω : Type} (P : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) : ∀ n,(Fin n → Ω) → Prop
  | 0,_ => True
  | n+1,s => accepts P n (Fin.init s) ∧ P n (Fin.init s) (s (Fin.last n))

axiom step_probability {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (P : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (n : ℕ) :
    by
      classical
      exact cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => μ)) (accepts P (n+1)) =
      ∑ s : Fin n → Ω,productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ) s*
        (if accepts P n s then cellMass μ (P n s) else 0)

axiom sequential_lower_probability {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (P : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (c : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hstep : ∀ j s,accepts P j s → c ≤ cellMass μ (P j s)) (n : ℕ) :
    c^n ≤ cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ)) (accepts P n)

axiom bounded_sequential_lower_probability {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (P : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (c : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (n : ℕ) (hstep : ∀ j,j < n → ∀ s,accepts P j s → c ≤ cellMass μ (P j s)) :
    c^n ≤ cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ)) (accepts P n)

axiom safe_failure_mass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (F S : Ω → Prop) (hμ : ∀ x,0 ≤ μ x) :
    cellMass μ F-cellMass μ (fun x => ¬ S x) ≤ cellMass μ (fun x => F x ∧ S x)

axiom sequential_failure_lower {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (F : Ω → Prop) (S : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (η δ : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hgap : δ ≤ η) (hF : η ≤ cellMass μ F)
    (havoid : ∀ j s,accepts (fun j s x => F x ∧ S j s x) j s →
      cellMass μ (fun x => ¬ S j s x) ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) :
    (η-δ)^n ≤ cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
      (accepts (fun j s x => F x ∧ S j s x) n)

axiom bounded_sequential_failure_lower {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ)
    (F : Ω → Prop) (S : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (η δ : ℝ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hgap : δ ≤ η) (hF : η ≤ cellMass μ F)
    (n : ℕ) (havoid : ∀ j,j < n → ∀ s,accepts (fun j s x => F x ∧ S j s x) j s →
      cellMass μ (fun x => ¬ S j s x) ≤ δ) :
    (η-δ)^n ≤ cellMass (productLaw (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
      (accepts (fun j s x => F x ∧ S j s x) n)

axiom accepts_pointwise {Ω : Type} (P : ∀ j,(Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (F : Ω → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ j t x,P j t x → F x) (n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → Ω)
    (hs : accepts P n s) : ∀ i,F (s i)

end Lax342547.SequentialTests

statements.signature:
accepts_pointwise : ∀ {Ω : Type} (P : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (F : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (j : Nat) (t : Fin j → Ω) (x : Ω), P j t x → F x) →
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s : Fin n → Ω), Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P n s → ∀ (i : Fin n), F (s i)

bounded_sequential_failure_lower : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F : Ω → Prop) (S : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (η δ : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le δ η →
      Real.instLE.le η (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ F) →
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          (∀ (j : Nat),
              instLTNat.lt j n →
                ∀ (s : Fin j → Ω),
                  Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts (fun j s x => And (F x) (S j s x)) j s →
                    Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x => Not (S j s x)) δ) →
            Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub η δ) n)
              (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
                (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts (fun j s x => And (F x) (S j s x)) n))

bounded_sequential_lower_probability : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (P : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (c : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (n : Nat),
        (∀ (j : Nat),
            instLTNat.lt j n →
              ∀ (s : Fin j → Ω),
                Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P j s →
                  Real.instLE.le c (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (P j s))) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow c n)
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
              (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P n))

safe_failure_mass : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F S : Ω → Prop),
  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (μ x)) →
    Real.instLE.le
      (instHSub.hSub (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ F) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x => Not (S x)))
      (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x => And (F x) (S x))

sequential_failure_lower : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F : Ω → Prop) (S : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (η δ : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le δ η →
      Real.instLE.le η (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ F) →
        (∀ (j : Nat) (s : Fin j → Ω),
            Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts (fun j s x => And (F x) (S j s x)) j s →
              Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ fun x => Not (S j s x)) δ) →
          ∀ (n : Nat),
            Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub η δ) n)
              (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
                (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts (fun j s x => And (F x) (S j s x)) n))

sequential_lower_probability : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (P : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (c : Real),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      (∀ (j : Nat) (s : Fin j → Ω),
          Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P j s → Real.instLE.le c (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (P j s))) →
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow c n)
            (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
              (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P n))

step_probability : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (P : (j : Nat) → (Fin j → Ω) → Ω → Prop) (n : Nat),
  Eq
    (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw fun x => μ)
      (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P (instHAdd.hAdd n 1)))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun s =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw (fun x => μ) s)
        (ite (Lax342547.SequentialTests.accepts P n s) (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ (P n s)) 0))

concepts.title: An actual common point with diagonal tester one
concepts.description: A shared-only point is allowed at every tag and has tester value one whenever the tester has a pair; it removes the common diagonal predictor coefficient.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CommonAtoms
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

/-!
---
title: An actual common point with diagonal tester one
type: lemma
---
A shared-only point is allowed at every tag and has tester value one whenever the tester has a pair; it removes the common diagonal predictor coefficient.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SharedTesterPoint

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.Atoms Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open scoped BigOperators

def sharedTesterPoint {k n : ℕ} : Base k n → Binary
  | Sum.inl _ => 0
  | Sum.inr (q,i) => if q = 0 ∧ i.val < 2 then 1 else 0

axiom shared_point_allowed {k n : ℕ} (l : Tag k) :
    ∀ i,i ∉ allowedBase k n l → sharedTesterPoint (k := k) (n := n) i = 0

axiom shared_point_eta_one {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hr0 : 0 < r) (s : Fin b → Binary) :
    eta (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr (pointMoment selectorEval s sharedTesterPoint) = 1

end Lax342547.SharedTesterPoint

statements.signature:
shared_point_allowed : ∀ {k n : Nat} (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
  Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l) i) →
    Eq (Lax342547.SharedTesterPoint.sharedTesterPoint i) 0

shared_point_eta_one : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n),
  instLTNat.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Eq
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.eta hr)
          (Lax342547.MomentSpace.pointMoment Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval s
            Lax342547.SharedTesterPoint.sharedTesterPoint))
        1

concepts.title: Random sharp-block forms and their alternating parity
concepts.description:
The sharp part of the self-Gram form at distinct labels is a nonzero
linear combination of independently uniform matrices. It is uniform.
Although its sum with its transpose is alternating, any block on disjoint
row and column index sets is uniform and supplies the required rank bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.AtomDirections
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Lax342547.LowRankCounting

/-!
---
title: Random sharp-block forms and their alternating parity
type: lemma
---
The sharp part of the self-Gram form at distinct labels is a nonzero
linear combination of independently uniform matrices. It is uniform.
Although its sum with its transpose is alternating, any block on disjoint
row and column index sets is uniform and supplies the required rank bound.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SharpMixerLaw

variable {K A I N P : Type} [Field K] [Fintype A]

def weighted (c : A → K) : (A → Matrix I I K) →ₗ[K] Matrix I I K where
  toFun M := ∑ a, c a • M a
  map_add' M L := by simp [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' r M := by simp [smul_smul, Finset.smul_sum, mul_comm]

def alternatingBlock (c : N → I) (d : P → I) : Matrix I I K →ₗ[K] Matrix N P K where
  toFun M i j := M (c i) (d j) + M (d j) (c i)
  map_add' M L := by
    ext i j
    change (M (c i) (d j) + L (c i) (d j)) + (M (d j) (c i) + L (d j) (c i)) =
      (M (c i) (d j) + M (d j) (c i)) + (L (c i) (d j) + L (d j) (c i))
    exact add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
  map_smul' a M := by
    ext i j
    change a * M (c i) (d j) + a * M (d j) (c i) = a * (M (c i) (d j) + M (d j) (c i))
    exact (mul_add _ _ _).symm

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.AtomDirections
open scoped ENNReal

axiom label_weighted_uniform {b n : ℕ} (s t : Fin b → Binary) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)).map
      (weighted (fun a => s a + t a)) = PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)

axiom selfGram_sharp_block {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s t : Fin b → Binary) :
    (blockDirections (k := k) (degree := degree) s sharp).transpose * selfGram hr hd M *
      blockDirections t sharp = weighted (fun a => s a + t a) M

axiom selfGram_free_block {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s t : Fin b → Binary) :
    (blockDirections (k := k) (degree := degree) s free).transpose * selfGram hr hd M *
      blockDirections t free = (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)

axiom alternating_block_uniform {I N P : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype N] [Fintype P]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq P]
    (c : N → I) (d : P → I) (hc : Function.Injective c) (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (hcd : ∀ i j, c i ≠ d j) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix I I Binary)).map (alternatingBlock c d) =
      PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix N P Binary)

axiom alternating_low_rank_bound (n r : ℕ) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)).toOuterMeasure
      {M | (M + M.transpose).rank ≤ r} ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((n / 2 + n / 2) * r) / 2 ^ ((n / 2) * (n / 2))

concepts.title: Bit rank and Walsh bounds for global vector-slot pairings
concepts.description:
Each of N bit coordinates carries the same cross-slot coefficient
matrix. The resulting bilinear bit matrix has rank N times its rank,
so a nonzero cross pattern has correlation at most 2^(-N/2).
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BilinearWalsh

/-!
---
title: Bit rank and Walsh bounds for global vector-slot pairings
type: lemma
---
Each of N bit coordinates carries the same cross-slot coefficient
matrix. The resulting bilinear bit matrix has rank N times its rank,
so a nonzero cross pattern has correlation at most 2^(-N/2).
-/

namespace Lax342547.SlotWalsh

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

def bitMatrix {I J : Type} (C : Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ) :
    Matrix (Fin N × I) (Fin N × J) Binary :=
  fun x y => if x.1 = y.1 then C x.2 y.2 else 0

axiom bit_evaluation {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N × I → Binary) (y : Fin N × J → Binary) :
    dotProduct x ((bitMatrix C N).mulVec y) = ∑ i, ∑ j, C i j * ∑ a, x (a, i) * y (a, j)

axiom bit_rank {I J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (C : Matrix I J Binary) (N : ℕ) : (bitMatrix C N).rank = N * C.rank

axiom nonzero_pattern_bound {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (C : Matrix I J Binary) (hC : C ≠ 0) (N : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin N × I → Binary) → ℝ) (g : (Fin N × J → Binary) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) :
    |BilinearWalsh.average (bitMatrix C N) f g| ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ) ^ N)

end Lax342547.SlotWalsh

  Eq (dotProduct x ((Lax342547.SlotWalsh.bitMatrix C N).mulVec y))

import Lax342547.CombinedSpans

/-!
---
title: One exposure controls both modes
type: lemma
---
Finite greedy ordering of the product of column and row spaces supplies one dyadic exposed set with combined actual deficit less than one quarter of its remaining size.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SmallExposure

open Lax342547.GreedySpans Lax342547.GreedyTails
open scoped BigOperators

axiom simultaneous_small_exposure {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (C : ι → Submodule K V) (R : ι → Submodule K W) (r : ℝ) (k n : ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ i, (Module.finrank K (C i) : ℝ) ≤ r)
    (hR : ∀ i, (Module.finrank K (R i) : ℝ) ≤ r)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 2^k) (hnk : n ≤ k) (hn : 16*r < n) :
    ∃ l : List ι, l.Nodup ∧ l.toFinset = Finset.univ ∧ ∃ j < n,
      deficit C (spanAfter C ⊥ (l.take (l.length-2^(k-j)))) (l.drop (l.length-2^(k-j)))+
      deficit R (spanAfter R ⊥ (l.take (l.length-2^(k-j)))) (l.drop (l.length-2^(k-j))) <
        (2^(k-j) : ℝ)/4

end Lax342547.SmallExposure

  (∀ (i : ι), Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (C i) x)).cast r) →
    (∀ (i : ι), Real.instLE.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (R i) x)).cast r) →
      Eq (Fintype.card ι) (instHPow.hPow 2 k) →

                            (List.drop (instHSub.hSub l.length (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k j))) l))
                          (Lax342547.GreedyTails.deficit R

import Lax342547.FixedMultiPhase

/-!
---
title: Small phases on selected endpoint channel groups
type: lemma
---
The explicit numerical phase margin holds for arbitrary selected endpoint images and whole-unit marks while preserving the original no-cover rank parameter.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SmallMultiPhase

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ChannelDensity Lax342547.ChannelCharacters
open Lax342547.RealCellLaws Lax342547.FiniteSampling Lax342547.TensorCharacters

axiom no_cover_marked_unit_phase_small {e d B N Ω U : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype d] [Nonempty d] [Fintype U] [Fintype B] [Fintype N] [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq d] [DecidableEq N] (E : Matrix B B Binary)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (A : Ω → e → Matrix N N Binary) (ψ : (e → Matrix N N Binary) → Ω → ℝ) (r h a c P m : ℕ)
    [Nonempty (Frame B (Fin h) N E)] (hN : 2*h+1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ i, (A x i).rank ≤ r) (hψ : ∀ S, (∑ i, (S i).rank) ≤ r → ∀ x, |ψ S x| ≤ 1)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hscale : c*2^(100*r+12) ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hP : 2^(100*r+10)*(2+a+(2*r+10)*(2*c)+1) ≤ P)
    (hh : 4*2^(100*r+10)*(a+(2*r+10)*(2*c)+1) ≤ h)
    (β : U → ℝ) (image : U → (e × d) → Frame B (Fin h) N E) (L : ℝ)
    (S : U → e → Matrix N N Binary)
    (hβ : Probability β) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hLcap : L ≤ (2 : ℝ)^(m+Fintype.card N))
    (hbig : m+r*Fintype.card e+Fintype.card (e × d)*(h*h+2) ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (ha : 14 ≤ a) (hpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card N)
    (hβcap : ∀ o, push β image o ≤ L*weights (Lax342547.RawLaw.uniformLaw E) o)
    (hS : ∀ o, (∑ i, (S o i).rank) ≤ r)
    (hcover : ∀ S : Submodule Binary (e → N → Binary),
      ∀ T : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (e → N → Binary)),

      (Module.finrank Binary S : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N/c) →
      (Module.finrank Binary T : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N/c) →
      cellMass μ (fun x => projection (LinearMap.piMap (fun i => (A x i).mulVecLin)) S T = 0) ≤ 1/(2 : ℝ)^P) :
    |∑ o, β o*(∑ x, μ x*ψ (S o) x*tensorCharacter h (fun i : e × d => A x i.1) (columnsEquiv h (fun a => channels (image o a))))| < 1/200

concepts.title: Small affine slices force global cross-coefficient rank
concepts.description:
Every matrix rank has a witness on actual coordinate rows and columns. A sum
of s affine products has a cross-coefficient matrix of rank at most 2s.
The same bound on every (2s+1)-square coordinate slice forces the global
bound. Summed predictor parity then contradicts an identity matrix larger
than the sum of these ranks. This is the deterministic conclusion of Lemma 9.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RankedProjection
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.StrongRankCondition

/-!
---
title: Small affine slices force global cross-coefficient rank
type: lemma
---
Every matrix rank has a witness on actual coordinate rows and columns. A sum
of s affine products has a cross-coefficient matrix of rank at most 2s.
The same bound on every (2s+1)-square coordinate slice forces the global
bound. Summed predictor parity then contradicts an identity matrix larger
than the sum of these ranks. This is the deterministic conclusion of Lemma 9.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SmallSliceRank
open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped BigOperators

axiom independent_column_selection {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ c : Fin t → J,Function.Injective c ∧ (A.submatrix id c).rank = t

axiom rank_witness {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ A.rank) :
    ∃ r : Fin t → I,∃ c : Fin t → J,
      Function.Injective r ∧ Function.Injective c ∧ (A.submatrix r c).rank = t

axiom rank_le_of_small_slices {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J Binary) (r : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin (r+1) → I,∀ j : Fin (r+1) → J,
      Function.Injective i → Function.Injective j → (A.submatrix i j).rank ≤ r) : A.rank ≤ r

def crossCoefficients {I J : Type} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (F : (I → Binary) → (J → Binary) → Binary) : Matrix I J Binary :=
    fun i j => F (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)+F (Pi.single i 1) 0+
      F 0 (Pi.single j 1)+F 0 0

def affineValue {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (c : Binary) (a : I → Binary) (b : J → Binary) (x : I → Binary) (y : J → Binary) : Binary :=
    c+dotProduct a x+dotProduct b y

axiom cross_affine_product {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (c d : Binary) (a u : I → Binary) (b v : J → Binary) :
    crossCoefficients (fun x y => affineValue c a b x y*affineValue d u v x y) =
      Matrix.vecMulVec a v+Matrix.vecMulVec u b

axiom cross_products_rank {P I J : Type} [Fintype P] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (c d : P → Binary) (a u : P → I → Binary)
    (b v : P → J → Binary) :
    (crossCoefficients (fun x y => ∑ p,affineValue (c p) (a p) (b p) x y*
      affineValue (d p) (u p) (v p) x y)).rank ≤ 2*Fintype.card P

def liftCoordinates {T I : Type} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq I]
    (r : T → I) (x : T → Binary) : I → Binary := ∑ t,x t • Pi.single (r t) 1

def HasProducts {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (s : ℕ) (F : (I → Binary) → (J → Binary) → Binary) : Prop :=
    ∃ c d : Fin s → Binary,∃ a u : Fin s → I → Binary,∃ b v : Fin s → J → Binary,
      ∀ x y,F x y = ∑ p,affineValue (c p) (a p) (b p) x y*affineValue (d p) (u p) (v p) x y

axiom cross_rank_of_products {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (s : ℕ) (F : (I → Binary) → (J → Binary) → Binary)
    (h : HasProducts s F) : (crossCoefficients F).rank ≤ 2*s

axiom rank_from_local_products {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (s : ℕ) (F : (I → Binary) → (J → Binary) → Binary)

      HasProducts s (fun x y => F l (liftCoordinates r x) (liftCoordinates c y)))

concepts.title: Counting all bounded-dimensional protected spaces
concepts.description: Padding an actual basis gives a generator encoding of every subspace of dimension at most r and the uniform count 2 to the ambient-dimension times r.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FiniteLinearLaw
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
---
title: Counting all bounded-dimensional protected spaces
type: lemma
---
Padding an actual basis gives a generator encoding of every subspace of dimension at most r and the uniform count 2 to the ambient-dimension times r.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SmallSubspaceCount

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom padded_generators {K V : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : Submodule K V) (r : ℕ) (hr : Module.finrank K S ≤ r) :
    ∃ f : Fin r → V, Submodule.span K (Set.range f) = S

axiom small_subspace_card {H : Type} [Fintype H] (r : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {S : Submodule Binary (H → Binary) // Module.finrank Binary S ≤ r} ≤
      2^(Fintype.card H*r)

end Lax342547.SmallSubspaceCount

statements.signature:
padded_generators : ∀ {K V : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
  (S : Submodule K V) (r : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)) r →
    Exists fun f => Eq (Submodule.span K (Set.range f)) S

small_subspace_card : ∀ {H : Type} [inst : Fintype H] (r : Nat),
  instLENat.le
    (Nat.card
      (Subtype fun S =>
        instLENat.le (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)) r))
    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card H) r))

concepts.title: Numerical cross tables, injection flags, and unary admissibility
concepts.description:
A table records both cross orientations on the actual projected table
spaces. Its injection quotients use the protected channel of the same
sign as the pinned primal input, as in Definition 6.1. Admissibility on
exact-pin events separates into two filters on individual orientations.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TableSpaces
import Lax342547.ReferencePins

/-!
---
title: Numerical cross tables, injection flags, and unary admissibility
type: lemma
---
A table records both cross orientations on the actual projected table
spaces. Its injection quotients use the protected channel of the same
sign as the pinned primal input, as in Definition 6.1. Admissibility on
exact-pin events separates into two filters on individual orientations.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SmallTables

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.TableSpaces

variable {Comp B H N : Type}

structure Table (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) where
  forward : ∀ e, tableSpace P (e, true) →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace Q (e, false) →ₗ[Binary] Binary
  reverse : ∀ e, tableSpace Q (e, true) →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace P (e, false) →ₗ[Binary] Binary

def tableChannel (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    (H → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace P a where
  toFun v := ⟨channelEmbedding i v, by
    intro j
    have hz : primalProjection j (channelEmbedding (B := B) i v) = 0 := by
      ext b
      simp [primalProjection, channelEmbedding]
    rw [hz]
    exact (projected P j a).zero_mem⟩
  map_add' v w := Subtype.ext ((channelEmbedding i).map_add v w)
  map_smul' c v := Subtype.ext ((channelEmbedding i).map_smul c v)

def tablePinnedPrimal (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (a : Comp × Bool) (i : Fin 2) : pinnedPrimal P i a →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace P a where
  toFun v := ⟨primalEmbedding i v.val, fun _j => ⟨primalEmbedding i v.val, v.property, rfl⟩⟩
  map_add' v w := Subtype.ext ((primalEmbedding i).map_add v.val w.val)
  map_smul' c v := Subtype.ext ((primalEmbedding i).map_smul c v.val)

noncomputable def rowChannels (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (a b : Comp × Bool)
    (T : tableSpace P a →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace Q b →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (i z : Fin 2) :
    pinnedPrimal P i a →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun d h => T (tablePinnedPrimal P a i d) (tableChannel Q b z (Pi.single h 1))
      map_add' := by intro d d'; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c d; ext h; simp }

noncomputable def columnChannels (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (a b : Comp × Bool)
    (T : tableSpace P a →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace Q b →ₗ[Binary] Binary) (z i : Fin 2) :
    pinnedPrimal Q i b →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun d h => T (tableChannel P a z (Pi.single h 1)) (tablePinnedPrimal Q b i d)
      map_add' := by intro d d'; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c d; ext h; simp }

def Injecting {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q) : Prop :=
  ∀ e i z,
    Function.Injective (((protectedChannel Q z (e, true)).mkQ).comp
      (rowChannels P Q (e, true) (e, false) (T.forward e) i z)) ∧
    Function.Injective (((protectedChannel Q z (e, false)).mkQ).comp
      (columnChannels Q P (e, true) (e, false) (T.reverse e) z i)) ∧
    Function.Injective (((protectedChannel P z (e, true)).mkQ).comp
      (rowChannels Q P (e, true) (e, false) (T.reverse e) i z)) ∧
    Function.Injective (((protectedChannel P z (e, false)).mkQ).comp
      (columnChannels P Q (e, true) (e, false) (T.forward e) z i))

variable [Fintype N] {ΩA ΩB : Type}

def Admissible {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (A : ΩA → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (Bmap : ΩB → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (oA : ΩA) (oB : ΩB) : Prop :=
  (∀ e (v : tableSpace P (e, true)) (w : tableSpace Q (e, false)),
    v.val ∈ P.space (e, true) ∨ w.val ∈ Q.space (e, false) →
    T.forward e v w = dotProduct (A oA (e, true) v.val) (Bmap oB (e, false) w.val)) ∧
  (∀ e (v : tableSpace Q (e, true)) (w : tableSpace P (e, false)),
    v.val ∈ Q.space (e, true) ∨ w.val ∈ P.space (e, false) →
    T.reverse e v w = dotProduct (Bmap oB (e, true) v.val) (A oA (e, false) w.val))

def leftFilter {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (A : ΩA → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) : Set ΩA :=
  {oA | (∀ e (v : tableSpace P (e, true)) (w : tableSpace Q (e, false))
      (hw : w.val ∈ Q.space (e, false)),
      T.forward e v w = dotProduct (A oA (e, true) v.val) (Q.value (e, false) ⟨w.val, hw⟩)) ∧
    (∀ e (v : tableSpace Q (e, true)) (w : tableSpace P (e, false))
      (hv : v.val ∈ Q.space (e, true)),
      T.reverse e v w = dotProduct (Q.value (e, true) ⟨v.val, hv⟩) (A oA (e, false) w.val))}

def rightFilter {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (Bmap : ΩB → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary)) : Set ΩB :=
  {oB | (∀ e (v : tableSpace P (e, true)) (w : tableSpace Q (e, false))
      (hv : v.val ∈ P.space (e, true)),
      T.forward e v w = dotProduct (P.value (e, true) ⟨v.val, hv⟩) (Bmap oB (e, false) w.val)) ∧
    (∀ e (v : tableSpace Q (e, true)) (w : tableSpace P (e, false))
      (hw : w.val ∈ P.space (e, false)),
      T.reverse e v w = dotProduct (Bmap oB (e, true) v.val) (P.value (e, false) ⟨w.val, hw⟩))}

axiom admissible_iff_filters {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (A : ΩA → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (Bmap : ΩB → (Comp × Bool) → ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (oA : ΩA) (oB : ΩB) (hA : oA ∈ P.event A) (hB : oB ∈ Q.event Bmap) :
    Admissible T A Bmap oA oB ↔ oA ∈ leftFilter T A ∧ oB ∈ rightFilter T Bmap

axiom raw_admissible_iff_filters [Fintype B] [Fintype H] {E : Matrix B B Binary}
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E)
    (hA : oA ∈ P.event Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation)
    (hB : oB ∈ Q.event Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation) :
    Admissible T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation oA oB ↔
      oA ∈ leftFilter T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation ∧
      oB ∈ rightFilter T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation

end Lax342547.SmallTables

statements.signature:
admissible_iff_filters : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype N] {ΩA ΩB : Type}
  {P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N} (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q)
  (A :
    ΩA →
      Prod Comp Bool →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (Bmap :
    ΩB →
      Prod Comp Bool →
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H) → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (N → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (oA : ΩA) (oB : ΩB),
  Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event A P) oA →
    Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event Bmap Q) oB →
      Iff (Lax342547.SmallTables.Admissible T A Bmap oA oB)
        (And (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SmallTables.leftFilter T A) oA)
          (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SmallTables.rightFilter T Bmap) oB))

raw_admissible_iff_filters : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype N] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype H]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  {P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N} (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q)
  (oA oB : Fin 2 → Comp → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E),
  Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation P) oA →
    Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin.event Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Q) oB →
      Iff
        (Lax342547.SmallTables.Admissible T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation oA
          oB)
        (And (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SmallTables.leftFilter T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation) oA)
          (Set.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SmallTables.rightFilter T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation) oB))

concepts.description: Enlarging each mode space can only increase its addition-map kernel dimension and its span deficit.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SpanDeficits

/-!
---
title: Monotonicity of span deficits
type: lemma
---
Enlarging each mode space can only increase its addition-map kernel dimension and its span deficit.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SpanDeficitMono

open Lax342547.SpanDeficits
open scoped BigOperators

axiom deficit_monotone {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S T : ι → Submodule K V) (h : ∀ i, S i ≤ T i) :
    ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K V)) ≤
      ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (T i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, T i : Submodule K V))

end Lax342547.SpanDeficitMono

statements.signature:
deficit_monotone : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [FiniteDimensional K V] (S T : ι → Submodule K V),
  (∀ (i : ι), Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (S i) (T i)) →
    instLENat.le
      (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x)))
      (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (T i) x))
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => T i) x)))

concepts.title: Mode space span deficits
concepts.description: The kernel dimension of the addition map is the difference between the sum of component dimensions and the dimension of their span.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-!
---
title: Mode space span deficits
type: lemma
---
The kernel dimension of the addition map is the difference between the sum of component dimensions and the dimension of their span.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SpanDeficits

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def addition {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) : (∀ i, S i) →ₗ[K] V := by
  classical
  exact LinearMap.lsum K (fun i => S i) K (fun i => (S i).subtype)

axiom addition_single {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (i : ι) (v : S i) :
    addition S (Pi.single i v) = v.val

axiom addition_range {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) :
    LinearMap.range (addition S) = ⨆ i, S i

axiom addition_kernel_deficit {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (addition S)) =
      (∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K V)

end Lax342547.SpanDeficits

statements.signature:
addition_kernel_deficit : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V),
  Eq (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.SpanDeficits.addition S).ker x))
    (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
      (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x)))

addition_range : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  (S : ι → Submodule K V), Eq (Lax342547.SpanDeficits.addition S).range (iSup fun i => S i)

addition_single : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_4 : Module K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) (i : ι) (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.SpanDeficits.addition S) (Pi.single i v)) v.val

concepts.title: Sparse profiles from raw intersections (Lemma 4.4)
concepts.description:
The explicit exceptional-set estimate and the deterministic shared-tensor
argument combine on the actual concrete moment profiles. The normalized
representatives are unique and have the paper's support and chiStar bounds.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawIntersections
import Lax342547.SparseRepresentatives

/-!
---
title: Sparse profiles from raw intersections (Lemma 4.4)
type: lemma
---
The explicit exceptional-set estimate and the deterministic shared-tensor
argument combine on the actual concrete moment profiles. The normalized
representatives are unique and have the paper's support and chiStar bounds.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SparseIntersections

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.CutSparsity Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.RawIntersections Lax342547.SparseRepresentatives
open scoped ENNReal

axiom paper_sparse_parameters :
    let g := 10 ^ 9 + 1
    let D := 4000 * g
    1 ≤ D ∧ 8 * D < g * g ∧ 4 * D / g = 16000

axiom exists_concrete_scale (k b degree h : ℕ) :
    ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      2 * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h) + 1 ≤ M₀ * n ∧
      (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M₀ * n : ℕ) ∧
      (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (M₀ * n : ℕ) ∧
      ∀ D : ℕ, (Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) * (2 * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h)) * (2 * D) : ℕ) ≤
        (D : ℝ) * (M₀ * n : ℕ) / 4

    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hsmall : 8 * D < (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1))
    (hN : 2 * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h) + 1 ≤ N)
    (hp : (4 : ℝ) * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h : ℕ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * N)
    (hc : (8 : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * N)
    (hcount : (Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) * (2 * (Fintype.card (Coordinate k n b degree) + h)) * (2 * D) : ℕ) ≤
      (D : ℝ) * N / 4)
    (σ : PMF (Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) →
      Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M)))
    (hσ : ∀ o, σ o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (D * N) / Fintype.card (Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) →
      Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M))) :
    σ.toOuterMeasure {o | 2 * D < intersectionDimension o} ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-((D : ℝ) * N / 4)) ∧
      ∀ o : Fin 2 → Component (Tag k) →
        Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M),
        intersectionDimension o ≤ 2 * D →
        ∀ x y : Profile k n b degree, profileMap (o 0) x.val = profileMap (o 1) y.val →

          ∃ w v : Representation k n b degree, Normalized x w ∧ Normalized y v ∧
            supportSize w.val ≤ 4 * D / (2 * k + 1) ∧ supportSize v.val ≤ 4 * D / (2 * k + 1) ∧
            chiStar hr w = chiStar hr v ∧
            (∀ u : Representation k n b degree, Normalized x u → u = w) ∧
            (∀ u : Representation k n b degree, Normalized y u → u = v)

concepts.title: Unselected sparse vectors cannot conceal fresh key coefficients
concepts.description:
If an unselected sparse vector differs from a short fresh key combination
by a projected pin, each key's base-vector coefficient is zero. This
also covers inactive keys whose base vector is already zero.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QuotientExtractors

/-!
---
title: Unselected sparse vectors cannot conceal fresh key coefficients
type: lemma
---
If an unselected sparse vector differs from a short fresh key combination
by a projected pin, each key's base-vector coefficient is zero. This
also covers inactive keys whose base vector is already zero.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SparseKeyCoefficients

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.PinLabelExclusions Lax342547.SparsePins

axiom coefficients_zero {Base Comp H N I : Type} [Fintype I] {b degree R : ℕ}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × ((SelectorCoordinates b degree × Option Base) ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hA : Covers P A R)
    (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) (L : Finset (Fin b → Binary)) (hL : L.card ≤ R)
    (v : (Fin b → Binary) → Option Base → Binary)
    (label : I → Fin b → Binary) (hlabel : Function.Injective label)
    (base : I → Option Base → Binary) (hcard : Fintype.card I ≤ 14)
    (hfresh : ∀ j, label j ∉ A i)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint L (Finset.univ.image label)) (c : I → Binary)
    (h : (∑ s ∈ L, labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) s (v s)) -
      (∑ j, c j • labelTensor (selectorEval (degree := degree)) (label j) (base j)) ∈ projected P i a) :
    ∀ j, c j • base j = 0

end Lax342547.SparseKeyCoefficients

concepts.title: A uniform label budget for all sparse pin vectors
concepts.description:
Lemma 5.3. Each projected pin space has dimension at most K. A single
set of at most 2 |E| K (R + 14) labels contains the nonzero support of
every expansion on at most R + 14 labels in any of these spaces.
The hypothesis on selector degree is the one used in the paper's proof.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LSum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Finite

/-!
---
title: A uniform label budget for all sparse pin vectors
type: lemma
---
Lemma 5.3. Each projected pin space has dimension at most K. A single
set of at most 2 |E| K (R + 14) labels contains the nonzero support of
every expansion on at most R + 14 labels in any of these spaces.
The hypothesis on selector degree is the one used in the paper's proof.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SparsePins

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

variable {Label Coord Base : Type}

def labelTensor (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) :
    (Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (Coord × Base → Binary) where
  toFun z i := p s i.1 * z i.2
  map_add' z w := by ext i; exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' a z := by ext i; exact mul_left_comm _ _ _

noncomputable def expansion (p : Label → Coord → Binary) :
    (Label →₀ (Base → Binary)) →ₗ[Binary] (Coord × Base → Binary) :=
  Finsupp.lsum Binary (labelTensor p)

axiom sparse_pin_labels {Base Component : Type} [Fintype Base] [Fintype Component]
    {b degree K R : ℕ}
    (U : Bool → Component → Submodule Binary (SelectorCoordinates b degree × Base → Binary))
    (hdim : ∀ sign e, Module.finrank Binary (U sign e) ≤ K)
    (hdegree : (K + 1) * (R + 14) ≤ degree + 1) :
    ∃ B : Finset (Fin b → Binary),
      B.card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Component * K * (R + 14) ∧
      ∀ sign e (c : (Fin b → Binary) →₀ (Base → Binary)),
        c.support.card ≤ R + 14 → expansion (selectorEval (degree := degree)) c ∈ U sign e →
        c.support ⊆ B

end Lax342547.SparsePins

  (U :
    Bool →
      Component →
        Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Prod (Lax342547.MomentSpace.SelectorCoordinates b degree) Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  (∀ (sign : Bool) (e : Component),
      instLENat.le
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (U sign e) x)) K) →
    instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd K 1) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)) (instHAdd.hAdd degree 1) →
      Exists fun B =>
        And
          (instLENat.le B.card
            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card Component)) K) (instHAdd.hAdd R 14)))
          (∀ (sign : Bool) (e : Component)
            (c : Finsupp (Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
            instLENat.le c.support.card (instHAdd.hAdd R 14) →
              SetLike.instMembership.mem (U sign e)
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.SparsePins.expansion Lax342547.MomentSpace.selectorEval) c) →
                Finset.instPartialOrder.le c.support B)

concepts.title: Sparse normalized representatives of shared concrete tensors
concepts.description:
Low total component rank yields a unique representative vanishing at a
strict majority of tags, with the quantitative support bound. Shared
ambient tensors have equal chiStar values on these representatives.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CutSparsity
import Lax342547.ConcreteCut
import Lax342547.TensorIntersections

/-!
---
title: Sparse normalized representatives of shared concrete tensors
type: lemma
---
Low total component rank yields a unique representative vanishing at a
strict majority of tags, with the quantitative support bound. Shared
ambient tensors have equal chiStar values on these representatives.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SparseRepresentatives

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.CutSparsity Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.TensorIntersections

def Normalized {k n b degree : ℕ} (x : Profile k n b degree)
    (w : Representation k n b degree) : Prop :=
  representationCut k n b degree w = x.val ∧
    2 * k + 1 < 2 * valueCount w.val 0

axiom cutSize_le_rank {Tag I : Type} [Fintype Tag] [Fintype I]
    [Fintype (Component Tag)] (w : Tag → Matrix I I Binary) :
    cutSize w ≤ ∑ e : Component Tag, (cutMap w e).rank

axiom normalized_representation {k n b degree : ℕ} (R : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 4 * R < (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1)) (x : Profile k n b degree)
    (hrank : (∑ e, (x.val e).rank) ≤ R) :
    ∃! w : Representation k n b degree, Normalized x w ∧
      (2 * k + 1) * supportSize w.val ≤ 2 * R

axiom shared_chiStar {k n b degree r h N : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (F G : Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M))
    (w v : Representation k n b degree)
    (hw : 2 * k + 1 < 2 * valueCount w.val 0)
    (hv : 2 * k + 1 < 2 * valueCount v.val 0)
    (heq : profileMap F (representationCut k n b degree w) =
      profileMap G (representationCut k n b degree v)) :
    chiStar hr w = chiStar hr v

axiom shared_sparse_profiles {k n b degree r h N : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary)
    (F G : Component (Tag k) → Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin h) (Fin N) (selfGram hr hd M))
    (R : ℕ) (hsmall : 4 * R < (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1))
    (hinter : (∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (intersectionSpace (F e).P (G e).P)) ≤ R)
    (x y : Profile k n b degree) (heq : profileMap F x.val = profileMap G y.val) :
    ∃ w v : Representation k n b degree, Normalized x w ∧ Normalized y v ∧
      (2 * k + 1) * supportSize w.val ≤ 2 * R ∧
      (2 * k + 1) * supportSize v.val ≤ 2 * R ∧ chiStar hr w = chiStar hr v

end Lax342547.SparseRepresentatives

      Eq

  (R : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt (instHMul.hMul 4 R)
      (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 k) 1)) →
    instLENat.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
          Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
            (Subtype fun x =>

        R →
      ∀ (x y : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
        Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.RawFrames.profileMap F) x.val)

                      (Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.chiStar hr) w)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.chiStar hr) v)))))

concepts.title: Mass and density costs of splitting by metadata and images
concepts.description:
Discarding small fibers costs at most the number of split records times
the threshold. The remaining fibers have an absolute joint density cap
suitable for a fresh peeling, even after a preceding leaf restriction.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LeafTrimming
import Lax342547.MetadataPins

/-!
---
title: Mass and density costs of splitting by metadata and images
type: lemma
---
Discarding small fibers costs at most the number of split records times
the threshold. The remaining fibers have an absolute joint density cap
suitable for a fresh peeling, even after a preceding leaf restriction.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SplitTrimming

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.MetadataPins
open scoped ENNReal

axiom small_fibers {Ω K : Type} [Fintype K] (p : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → K) (τ : ℝ≥0∞) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | p.toOuterMeasure {x | f x = f o} < τ} ≤ Fintype.card K * τ

axiom metadata_discard {Ω J Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype J] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (choice : Ω → J) (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (a n u : ℕ)
    (hchoices : Fintype.card J ≤ 2 ^ (a * n))
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ b, Module.finrank Binary (S j b) ≤ u) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | p.toOuterMeasure {x | record A choice S x = record A choice S o} <
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * Fintype.card N))} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((a * n : ℕ) - (Fintype.card N : ℝ))

axiom exponential_discard {Ω J Axis I N : Type}
    [Fintype J] [Fintype Axis] [Fintype I] [Fintype N]
    (p : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Axis → (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (N → Binary))
    (choice : Ω → J) (S : J → Axis → Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) (a n u : ℕ)
    (hchoices : Fintype.card J ≤ 2 ^ (a * n))
    (hu : ∀ j, ∑ b, Module.finrank Binary (S j b) ≤ u)
    (hscale : 2 * a * n ≤ Fintype.card N) :
    p.toOuterMeasure {o | p.toOuterMeasure {x | record A choice S x = record A choice S o} <
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * Fintype.card N))} ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(Fintype.card N : ℝ) / 2)

axiom repinning_density {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
    (hS : ∃ o ∈ S, o ∈ p.support)
    (hT : ∃ o ∈ T, o ∈ (p.filter S hS).support)
    (D ζ : ℝ) (N K₁ u : ℕ) (hζ : ζ ≤ 1)
    (hSbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(ζ * N)) ≤ p.toOuterMeasure S)
    (hTbound : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-(((u : ℝ) + 1) * N)) ≤ (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T)
    (hp : ∀ o, p o ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K₁ + 1) * N) * μ o) :
    ∀ o, ((p.filter S hS).filter T hT) o ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ((D + K₁ + u + 5) * N) * μ o

end Lax342547.SplitTrimming

        (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul a n).cast (Fintype.card N).cast))

repinning_density : ∀ {Ω : Type} (p μ : PMF Ω) (S T : Set Ω)
  (hS : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem S o) (Set.instMembership.mem p.support o))
  (hT : Exists fun o => And (Set.instMembership.mem T o) (Set.instMembership.mem (p.filter S hS).support o))
  (D ζ : Real) (N K₁ u : Nat),
  Real.instLE.le ζ 1 →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul ζ N.cast)))
        (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure S) →
      ENNReal.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow 2 (Real.instNeg.neg (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd u.cast 1) N.cast)))
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe (p.filter S hS).toOuterMeasure T) →
        (∀ (o : Ω),
            ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe p o)
              (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd D K₁.cast) 1) N.cast))
                (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))) →
          ∀ (o : Ω),
            ENNReal.instLE.le (PMF.instFunLike.coe ((p.filter S hS).filter T hT) o)
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHPow.hPow 2
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd D K₁.cast) u.cast) 5) N.cast))
                (PMF.instFunLike.coe μ o))

small_fibers : ∀ {Ω K : Type} [inst : Fintype K] (p : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → K) (τ : ENNReal),
  ENNReal.instLE.le
    (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure
      (Set.ofPred fun o =>
        ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
          (MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.instFunLikeSetENNReal.coe p.toOuterMeasure (Set.ofPred fun x => Eq (f x) (f o)))
          τ))
    (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card K).cast τ)

concepts.title: Low-rank tester routing along tag stars
concepts.description: Ordered tester matrices have rank at most r. Summing cut moments along a tag star removes its even center multiplicity. Forbidden ordinary centers vanish, and each component receives at most two routed testers.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ChannelFactorization

/-!
---
title: Low-rank tester routing along tag stars
type: lemma
---
Ordered tester matrices have rank at most r. Summing cut moments along a tag star removes its even center multiplicity. Forbidden ordinary centers vanish, and each component receives at most two routed testers.
-/

namespace Lax342547.StarRouting

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteCut
open Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.Atoms

axiom matrix_sum_rank {I B : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype B]
    (M : I → Matrix B B Binary) :
    (∑ i, M i).rank ≤ ∑ i, (M i).rank

noncomputable def orderedTesterMatrix {k n b degree r : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n) : Moment k n b degree := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ρ, Matrix.vecMulVec
    (Pi.single (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairLeft hr ρ))) 1)
    (Pi.single (emptySelector b degree, some (c (pairRight hr ρ))) 1)

axiom ordered_tester_rank {k n b degree r : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n) :
    (orderedTesterMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr c).rank ≤ r

axiom tester_matrix_representation {k n b degree r : ℕ}
    (hr : 2 * r ≤ n) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n) :
    matrixPair (orderedTesterMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr c) = blockTester hr c

axiom interval_center_excluded {k : ℕ} (d : Tag k) : d ∉ interval k d

axiom ordinary_tester_disallowed_zero {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (d t l : Tag k) (hl : l ∉ interval k d) (w : Representation k n b degree) :
    blockTester hr (ordinary d t) (w.val l) = 0

noncomputable def incidentEquiv {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) :
    {t : Tag k // t ≠ l} ≃ {e : Component (Tag k) // l ∈ e.val} := by
  classical
  let f : {t : Tag k // t ≠ l} → {e : Component (Tag k) // l ∈ e.val} :=
    fun t => ⟨⟨{l, t.val}, Finset.card_pair t.property.symm⟩, by simp⟩
  apply Equiv.ofBijective f
  constructor
  · intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hs : ({l, u.val} : Finset (Tag k)) = {l, v.val} :=
      congrArg (fun e : {e : Component (Tag k) // l ∈ e.val} => e.val.val) h
    have hu : u.val ∈ ({l, v.val} : Finset (Tag k)) := by rw [← hs]; simp
    simpa [u.property] using hu
  · intro e
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp e.val.property
    have hl : l = a ∨ l = b := by simpa only [he, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using e.property
    rcases hl with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨⟨b, hab.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Subtype.ext he.symm
    · refine ⟨⟨a, hab⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ({l, a} : Finset (Tag k)) = e.val.val
      rw [he, Finset.pair_comm]

axiom star_cut_sum {k : ℕ} {X : Type} [AddCommGroup X] [Module Binary X]
    (w : Tag k → X) (l : Tag k) :
    (∑ e : {e : Component (Tag k) // l ∈ e.val}, ∑ t ∈ e.val.val, w t) =
      ∑ t : {t : Tag k // t ≠ l}, w t.val

axiom incidence_sum {k : ℕ} {X : Type} [AddCommMonoid X]
    (F : Tag k → Component (Tag k) → X) :
    (∑ e, ∑ d ∈ e.val, F d e) = ∑ d, ∑ e : {e : Component (Tag k) // d ∈ e.val}, F d e.val

noncomputable def starMatrix {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (c : Tag k → Fin n → Base k n) (coeff : Tag k → Binary) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    Moment k n b degree := ∑ d ∈ e.val, coeff d • orderedTesterMatrix hr (c d)

axiom star_matrix_representation {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (c : Tag k → Fin n → Base k n) (coeff : Tag k → Binary)
    (w : Representation k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (starMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr c coeff e)
      ((representationCut k n b degree w) e)) =
    ∑ d, coeff d * ∑ l : {l : Tag k // l ≠ d}, blockTester hr (c d) (w.val l.val)

axiom matrix_smul_rank {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M : Matrix B B Binary) (a : Binary) :
    (a • M).rank ≤ M.rank

axiom matrix_add_rank {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M Q : Matrix B B Binary) :
    (M + Q).rank ≤ M.rank + Q.rank

axiom matrix_finset_sum_rank {I B : Type} [Fintype B] (s : Finset I)
    (M : I → Matrix B B Binary) (R : ℕ) (hM : ∀ i ∈ s, (M i).rank ≤ R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, M i).rank ≤ s.card * R

axiom star_matrix_rank {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (c : Tag k → Fin n → Base k n) (coeff : Tag k → Binary) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (starMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr c coeff e).rank ≤ 2 * r

end Lax342547.StarRouting

  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun e => e.val.sum fun d => F d e) (Finset.univ.sum fun d => Finset.univ.sum fun e => F d e.val)

  instLENat.le (instHSMul.hSMul a M).rank M.rank

  instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i).rank (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (M i).rank)

ordered_tester_rank : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
  instLENat.le (Matrix.rank (Lax342547.StarRouting.orderedTesterMatrix hr c)) r

  Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.TagGeometry.interval k d) l) →
    ∀ (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Representation k n b degree) x),
      Eq
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.blockTester hr (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.ordinary d t))
          (w.val l))
        0

star_cut_sum : ∀ {k : Nat} {X : Type} [inst : AddCommGroup X] [Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary X]
  (w : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → X) (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun e => e.val.val.sum fun t => w t) (Finset.univ.sum fun t => w t.val)

star_matrix_rank : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
  (c : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n)
  (coeff : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  instLENat.le (Matrix.rank (Lax342547.StarRouting.starMatrix hr c coeff e)) (instHMul.hMul 2 r)

star_matrix_representation : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
  (c : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n)
  (coeff : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Representation k n b degree) x),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
      LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair (Lax342547.StarRouting.starMatrix hr c coeff e))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.representationCut k n b degree) w e))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun d =>
      instHMul.hMul (coeff d)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun l =>
          LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.blockTester hr (c d)) (w.val l.val)))

tester_matrix_representation : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n) (c : Fin n → Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),
  Eq (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair (Lax342547.StarRouting.orderedTesterMatrix hr c))
    (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.blockTester hr c)

concepts.title: Nonzero tensor count from span deficits
concepts.description: For the actual sum of maps, column and row envelopes bound the number of nonzero terms by the sum rank plus their two actual dimension deficits.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SumRank
import Lax342547.SpanDeficitMono
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

/-!
---
title: Nonzero tensor count from span deficits
type: lemma
---
For the actual sum of maps, column and row envelopes bound the number of nonzero terms by the sum rank plus their two actual dimension deficits.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SumEnvelope

open Lax342547.SpanDeficits
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def dimensionDeficit {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (S : ι → Submodule K V) : ℝ :=
    (∑ i, (Module.finrank K (S i) : ℝ))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K V)

axiom span_dimension_sum_bound {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) :
    Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K V) ≤ ∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i)

axiom natural_deficit_cast {K V ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V) :
    (((∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K V) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      dimensionDeficit S

axiom nonzero_sum_envelope {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))
    (hS : ∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i) ≤ S i) (hT : ∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap ≤ T i) : by
      classical
      exact ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => M i ≠ 0)).card : ℝ) ≤
        Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ i, M i))+dimensionDeficit S+dimensionDeficit T

end Lax342547.SumEnvelope

natural_deficit_cast : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [inst_4 : FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V),
  Eq
    (instHSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
        (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x))).cast
    (Lax342547.SumEnvelope.dimensionDeficit S)

nonzero_sum_envelope : ∀ {K V W ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional K V] [inst_7 : FiniteDimensional K W]
  (M : ι → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W) (S : ι → Submodule K W) (T : ι → Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)),
  (∀ (i : ι), Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (M i).range (S i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (M i).dualMap.range (T i)) →
      Real.instLE.le (Finset.filter (fun i => Ne (M i) 0) Finset.univ).card.cast
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i).range x)).cast
            (Lax342547.SumEnvelope.dimensionDeficit S))
          (Lax342547.SumEnvelope.dimensionDeficit T))

span_dimension_sum_bound : ∀ {K V ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [FiniteDimensional K V] (S : ι → Submodule K V),
  instLENat.le (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))

concepts.title: Rank of an actual linear map sum
concepts.description: Stacking maps identifies the joint row span, and addition loses at most the actual mode-space deficit. This gives the rank-deficit inequality for the actual sum.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SpanDeficits
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Lax342547.BlockDeficits

/-!
---
title: Rank of an actual linear map sum
type: lemma
---
Stacking maps identifies the joint row span, and addition loses at most the actual mode-space deficit. This gives the rank-deficit inequality for the actual sum.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SumRank

open Lax342547.SpanDeficits
open scoped BigOperators

axiom stacked_rank {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (S : ι → Submodule K W) (hS : ∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i) ≤ S i) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.pi (fun i => (M i).codRestrict (S i)
      (fun v => hS i (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ v))))) =
      Module.finrank K (⨆ i, LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V))

axiom sum_rank_deficit {K V W ι : Type} [Field K] [Fintype ι]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (M : ι → V →ₗ[K] W) (S : ι → Submodule K W) (hS : ∀ i, LinearMap.range (M i) ≤ S i) :
    (∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M i))) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (∑ i, M i))+
      ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (S i))-Module.finrank K (⨆ i, S i : Submodule K W))+
      ((∑ i, Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap))-
        Module.finrank K (⨆ i, LinearMap.range (M i).dualMap : Submodule K (Module.Dual K V)))

end Lax342547.SumRank

  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
  (M : ι → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W) (S : ι → Submodule K W)
  (hS : ∀ (i : ι), Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (M i).range (S i)),
  Eq
    (Module.finrank K
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (LinearMap.pi fun i => LinearMap.codRestrict (S i) (M i) ⋯).range x))
    (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => (M i).dualMap.range) x))

sum_rank_deficit : ∀ {K V W ι : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module K V]
  [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
  (M : ι → LinearMap (RingHom.id K) V W) (S : ι → Submodule K W),
  (∀ (i : ι), Submodule.instPartialOrder.le (M i).range (S i)) →
    instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M i).range x))
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M i).range x))
          (instHSub.hSub
            (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (S i) x))
            (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => S i) x))))
        (instHSub.hSub
          (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
            Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (M i).dualMap.range x))
          (Module.finrank K (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (iSup fun i => (M i).dualMap.range) x))))

concepts.title: Symmetric low-rank factorization, including characteristic two
concepts.description:
A symmetric rank-r matrix has a factorization Z H Zᵀ with Z injective
and H symmetric and nonsingular. No assumption on the diagonal is made.
Counting these factors gives the symmetric-matrix estimate in Lemma 5.5.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LowRankCounting

/-!
---
title: Symmetric low-rank factorization, including characteristic two
type: lemma
---
A symmetric rank-r matrix has a factorization Z H Zᵀ with Z injective
and H symmetric and nonsingular. No assumption on the diagonal is made.
Counting these factors gives the symmetric-matrix estimate in Lemma 5.5.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SymmetricFactorization

axiom symmetric_factorization {K I : Type} [Field K] [Fintype I]
    (M : Matrix I I K) (hM : M.transpose = M) :
    ∃ Z : Matrix I (Fin M.rank) K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin M.rank) (Fin M.rank) K,
      Function.Injective Z.mulVec ∧ H.transpose = H ∧ Function.Bijective H.mulVec ∧
      Z * H * Z.transpose = M

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom card_symmetric_rank {I : Type} [Fintype I] (r : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {M : Matrix I I Binary // M.transpose = M ∧ M.rank = r} ≤
      2 ^ (Fintype.card I * r + r * r)

end Lax342547.SymmetricFactorization

statements.signature:
card_symmetric_rank : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Fintype I] (r : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Nat.card (Subtype fun M => And (Eq M.transpose M) (Eq M.rank r)))
    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Fintype.card I) r) (instHMul.hMul r r)))

symmetric_factorization : ∀ {K I : Type} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype I] (M : Matrix I I K),
  Eq M.transpose M →
    Exists fun Z =>
      Exists fun H =>
        And (Function.Injective Z.mulVec)
          (And (Eq H.transpose H)
            (And (Function.Bijective H.mulVec)
              (Eq
                (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                  (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul Z H) Z.transpose)
                M)))

concepts.title: Consistent symmetric binary prescriptions on two witness lists
concepts.description:
The two lists are nonempty and disjoint, represented by a sum type.
Prescribed list sums of every row of a symmetric binary matrix are
compatible with its fixed diagonal precisely through the two self-sum
conditions and the equality of the cross totals. The sufficiency proof
constructs the matrix explicitly.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.MomentSpace
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block

/-!
---
title: Consistent symmetric binary prescriptions on two witness lists
type: lemma
---
The two lists are nonempty and disjoint, represented by a sum type.
Prescribed list sums of every row of a symmetric binary matrix are
compatible with its fixed diagonal precisely through the two self-sum
conditions and the equality of the cross totals. The sufficiency proof
constructs the matrix explicitly.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SymmetricPrescriptions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

axiom diagonal_rows {I : Type} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (a c : I → Binary) (h : ∑ i, c i = ∑ i, a i) :

concepts.title: Positive pure-flavor mass for the actual synthetic parity slice Grams
concepts.description:
The ordered Gram for synthetic parity on q selected coordinates in each
half is a sum of q active products. Routing these products into retained
pure tester pairs proves its positive mass and the full slice variance
bound with an explicit mass floor independent of n and the unit law.

import Lax342547.PureTesterRoom
import Lax342547.TesterProductRouting

/-!
---
title: Positive pure-flavor mass for the actual synthetic parity slice Grams
type: lemma
---
The ordered Gram for synthetic parity on q selected coordinates in each
half is a sum of q active products. Routing these products into retained
pure tester pairs proves its positive mass and the full slice variance
bound with an explicit mass floor independent of n and the unit law.
-/

def sliceGram {q m : ℕ} (R C : Fin q → Fin m) :
    Matrix (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) Binary
  | some (Sum.inl i),some (Sum.inr j) => if R i = C j then 1 else 0
  | _,_ => 0

def leftFactor (q : ℕ) (p : Fin q) : Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q) → Binary
  | some (Sum.inl i) => if p = i then 1 else 0
  | _ => 0

def rightFactor {q m : ℕ} (R C : Fin q → Fin m) (p : Fin q) :
    Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q) → Binary
  | some (Sum.inr j) => if R p = C j then 1 else 0
  | _ => 0

axiom slice_gram_products {q m : ℕ} (R C : Fin q → Fin m) :
    sliceGram R C = fun i j => ∑ p : Fin q,leftFactor q p i*rightFactor R C p j

axiom pure_slice_gram_mass {k n b degree r q m : ℕ}
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (sel : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k))
    (hroom : q ≤ k*(2*k+1-T₀.card)*r) (R C : Fin q → Fin m) :
    uniformFloor k r (Fin q ⊕ Fin q) ≤ cellMass
      (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l (pureOutside T₀) (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))))
      (fun V => (pointColumns sel (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns sel (value V) = sliceGram R C)

    [Fintype H] {k n b degree r q m : ℕ}
    (l : Tag k) (T₀ : Finset (Tag k))
    (N : ℕ) (sel : Fin b → Binary)
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (R C : Fin q → Fin m)
    (hroom : q ≤ k*(2*k+1-T₀.card)*r)
    (E : S → Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Coordinate k n b degree) Binary)
    (G : S → Matrix (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) Binary)
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i))]
    [∀ i,Nonempty (Orbit (Fin N) (G i))]
    (hE : ∀ i,E i = selfGram hr hd M) (hG : ∀ i,G i = sliceGram R C)
    (test : (S → (Fin N × (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q) ⊕ Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) → Binary)) → ℝ) (htest : ∀ z,|test z| ≤ 1)
    (hN : Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))+Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))+1 ≤ N)
    (hsmall : ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))*Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))+2))*
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))*Fintype.card (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))+2))/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^N) ≤
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Lax342547.CrossGramBasis.Slots (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)))+1)) :
    (∑ o : ∀ i,Frame (Coordinate k n b degree) H (Fin N) (E i),weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _) o*
      ((∑ V : Coefficients n l (pureOutside T₀) (Fin q ⊕ Fin q),
        conditionalLaw (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype _)) (fun V : Coefficients n l (pureOutside T₀) (Fin q ⊕ Fin q) => GramEvent sel E G (value V)) V*
          test (fun i => batchEquiv ((o i).P*pointColumns (k := k) (n := n) (b := b) (degree := degree) sel (value V),(o i).Q*pointColumns (k := k) (n := n) (b := b) (degree := degree) sel (value V))))-
            referenceMean N G test)^2) ≤
      (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*Lax342547.RawFrameComparison.errorBound N (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)) (Option (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))+
        4*(((2 : ℝ)^(2*Fintype.card (Fin q ⊕ Fin q)+1)/(2 : ℝ)^n)/(uniformFloor k r (Fin q ⊕ Fin q))^2)


end
end Lax342547.SyntheticGramSlices

concepts.title: Quantitative common-test error obstruction for synthetic parity
concepts.description:
On one common reference law, parity and all small coordinate-slice tests
are incompatible once the synthetic identity exceeds the sum of local ranks.
Separate empirical density caps and variance bounds transfer every test.
Their total prediction and comparison errors must then be at least one.
This is a conditional finite transfer theorem; constructing the actual
synthetic reference law and its empirical test couplings remains necessary.
