import Lax342547.SmallSliceRank
import Lax342547.CommonTestTransfer

/-!
---
title: Quantitative common-test error obstruction for synthetic parity
type: lemma
---
On one common reference law, parity and all small coordinate-slice tests
are incompatible once the synthetic identity exceeds the sum of local ranks.
Separate empirical density caps and variance bounds transfer every test.
Their total prediction and comparison errors must then be at least one.
This is a conditional finite transfer theorem; constructing the actual
synthetic reference law and its empirical test couplings remains necessary.
-/

namespace Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SmallSliceRank Lax342547.RelativeEntropy
open scoped BigOperators
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def indicator {Ω : Type} (C : Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if C ω then 1 else 0

def eventMean {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → Prop) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ω,μ ω*indicator C ω

abbrev Points (m : ℕ) := Fin m → Binary

abbrev Tests (T : Type) (s m : ℕ) :=
  (Points m × Points m) ⊕ (T × (Fin (2*s+1) → Fin m) × (Fin (2*s+1) → Fin m))

def testCondition {T : Type} [Fintype T] (s m : ℕ)
    (F : T → Points m → Points m → Binary) : Tests T s m → Prop
  | Sum.inl (x,y) => (∑ l,F l x y) = dotProduct x y
  | Sum.inr (l,r,c) => Function.Injective r → Function.Injective c →
      HasProducts s (fun x y => F l (liftCoordinates r x) (liftCoordinates c y))

axiom incompatible_events {J Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ) (C : J → Ω → Prop)
    (hincompatible : ∀ ω,¬∀ j,C j ω) : 1 ≤ ∑ j : J,(1-eventMean μ (C j))

axiom transferred_incompatible_events {J Ω : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype Ω]
    (A : J → Type) [∀ j,Fintype (A j)]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ) (C : J → Ω → Prop)
    (hincompatible : ∀ ω,¬∀ j,C j ω)
    (ρ σ F : ∀ j,A j → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ j,Probability (σ j))
    (L ε η : J → ℝ) (hL : ∀ j,0 ≤ L j)
    (hcap : ∀ j o,σ j o ≤ L j*ρ j o)
    (hvar : ∀ j,(∑ o,ρ j o*(F j o-eventMean μ (C j))^2) ≤ ε j)
    (hsuccess : ∀ j,1-η j ≤ ∑ o,σ j o*F j o) :
    1 ≤ ∑ j : J,(η j+Real.sqrt (L j*ε j))

axiom rank_tests_incompatible {T : Type} [Fintype T] (s m : ℕ)
    (F : T → Points m → Points m → Binary) (hm : 2*s*Fintype.card T < m) :
    ¬∀ j,testCondition s m F j

axiom prediction_error_budget {T Ω : Type} [Fintype T] [Fintype Ω]
    (s m : ℕ) (hm : 2*s*Fintype.card T < m)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ)
    (pred : Ω → T → Points m → Points m → Binary)
    (A : Tests T s m → Type) [∀ j,Fintype (A j)]
    (ρ σ F : ∀ j,A j → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ j,Probability (σ j))
    (L ε η : Tests T s m → ℝ) (hL : ∀ j,0 ≤ L j)
    (hcap : ∀ j o,σ j o ≤ L j*ρ j o)
    (hvar : ∀ j,(∑ o,ρ j o*(F j o-eventMean μ (fun ω => testCondition s m (pred ω) j))^2) ≤ ε j)
    (hsuccess : ∀ j,1-η j ≤ ∑ o,σ j o*F j o) :
    1 ≤ ∑ j : Tests T s m,(η j+Real.sqrt (L j*ε j))

axiom uniform_prediction_error {T Ω : Type} [Fintype T] [Fintype Ω]
    (s m : ℕ) (hm : 2*s*Fintype.card T < m)
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (hμ : Probability μ)
    (pred : Ω → T → Points m → Points m → Binary)
    (A : Tests T s m → Type) [∀ j,Fintype (A j)]
    (ρ σ F : ∀ j,A j → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ j,Probability (σ j))
    (L ε η : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcap : ∀ j o,σ j o ≤ L*ρ j o)
    (hvar : ∀ j,(∑ o,ρ j o*(F j o-eventMean μ (fun ω => testCondition s m (pred ω) j))^2) ≤ ε)
    (hsuccess : ∀ j,1-η ≤ ∑ o,σ j o*F j o) :
    1 ≤ (Fintype.card (Tests T s m) : ℝ)*(η+Real.sqrt (L*ε))

axiom exists_error_margin (J : Type) [Fintype J] (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ η : ℝ,0 < η ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ,0 < ε ∧
      (Fintype.card J : ℝ)*(η+Real.sqrt (L*ε)) < 1

end
end Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer

          (ρ σ F : (j : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m) → A j → Real),
          (∀ (j : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m), Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability (σ j)) →
            ∀ (L ε η : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m → Real),

                (∀ (j : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m) (o : A j),
                    Real.instLE.le (σ j o) (instHMul.hMul (L j) (ρ j o))) →
                  (∀ (j : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m),
                      Real.instLE.le
                        (Finset.univ.sum fun o =>
                          instHMul.hMul (ρ j o)
                            (instHPow.hPow
                              (instHSub.hSub (F j o)
                                (Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.eventMean μ fun ω =>
                                  Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.testCondition s m (pred ω) j))
                              2))
                        (ε j)) →
                    (∀ (j : Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Tests T s m),
                        Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub 1 (η j))
                          (Finset.univ.sum fun o => instHMul.hMul (σ j o) (F j o))) →
                      Real.instLE.le 1 (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHAdd.hAdd (η j) (instHMul.hMul (L j) (ε j)).sqrt)

rank_tests_incompatible : ∀ {T : Type} [inst : Fintype T] (s m : Nat)
  (F :
    T →
      Lax342547.SyntheticRankTransfer.Points m →

            ∀ (L ε η : Real),

                          instHMul.hMul (ρ j o)

concepts.title: Table contractions on effective profiles and their full extensions
concepts.description:
The starred contraction is a linear functional on the actual effective
cut profiles. It uses both cross orientations of the table. Every full
nominal cross form extending the whole table has that same contraction
on effective profiles; admissibility alone is not asserted to suffice.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SmallTables
import Lax342547.TensorContractions

/-!
---
title: Table contractions on effective profiles and their full extensions
type: lemma
---
The starred contraction is a linear functional on the actual effective
cut profiles. It uses both cross orientations of the table. Every full
nominal cross form extending the whole table has that same contraction
on effective profiles; admissibility alone is not asserted to suffice.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TableContractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.SmallTables

structure CrossForms (Comp B H : Type) where
  forward : Comp → LinearMap.BilinForm Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary)
  reverse : Comp → LinearMap.BilinForm Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary)

def CrossForms.flip {Comp B H : Type} (F : CrossForms Comp B H) : CrossForms Comp B H :=
  ⟨F.reverse, F.forward⟩

def flipTable {Comp B H N : Type} {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) : Table Q P := ⟨T.reverse, T.forward⟩

def Extends {Comp B H N : Type} {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (T : Table P Q) : Prop :=
  (∀ e (v : tableSpace P (e, true)) (w : tableSpace Q (e, false)),
    F.forward e v.val w.val = T.forward e v w) ∧
  (∀ e (v : tableSpace Q (e, true)) (w : tableSpace P (e, false)),
    F.reverse e v.val w.val = T.reverse e v w)

def primalToTable {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    projected P i a →ₗ[Binary] tableSpace P a where
  toFun v := ⟨primalEmbedding i v.val, by
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [primalProjection, primalEmbedding]
    · have hz : primalProjection j (primalEmbedding (H := H) i v.val) = 0 := by
        ext b
        simp [primalProjection, primalEmbedding, hji]
      rw [hz]
      exact (projected P j a).zero_mem⟩
  map_add' v w := Subtype.ext ((primalEmbedding i).map_add v.val w.val)
  map_smul' c v := Subtype.ext ((primalEmbedding i).map_smul c v.val)

noncomputable def plus {Comp B H N : Type} {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) : projected P i (e, true) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun v h => T.forward e (primalToTable P (e, true) i v)
        (tableChannel Q (e, false) z (Pi.single h 1))
      map_add' := by intro v w; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c v; ext h; simp }

noncomputable def minus {Comp B H N : Type} {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N}
    (T : Table P Q) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) : projected P i (e, false) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun v h => T.reverse e (tableChannel Q (e, true) z (Pi.single h 1))
        (primalToTable P (e, false) i v)
      map_add' := by intro v w; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c v; ext h; simp }

noncomputable def fullPlus {Comp B H : Type} (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) :
    (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun v h => F.forward e (primalEmbedding i v) (channelEmbedding z (Pi.single h 1))
      map_add' := by intro v w; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c v; ext h; simp }

noncomputable def fullMinus {Comp B H : Type} (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) :
    (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := by
  classical
  exact
    { toFun := fun v h => F.reverse e (channelEmbedding z (Pi.single h 1)) (primalEmbedding i v)
      map_add' := by intro v w; ext h; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c v; ext h; simp }

def component {Comp B H N : Type} (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary))
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (e : Comp) :
    effective X P i →ₗ[Binary] tensorSpace (projected P i (e, true)) (projected P i (e, false)) where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val.val e, x.property e⟩
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

noncomputable def starContraction {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    effective X P i →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ e, (TensorContractions.contraction (plus T e i z) (minus T e i z)).comp (component X P i e)

noncomputable def fullContraction {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (i z : Fin 2) :
    X →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  ∑ e, (TensorContractions.ambient (fullPlus F e i z) (fullMinus F e i z)).comp
    ((LinearMap.proj e).comp X.subtype)

axiom star_extension {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    {P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N} (T : Table P Q)
    (F : CrossForms Comp B H) (hF : Extends F T)
    (X : Submodule Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Binary)) (i z : Fin 2) (x : effective X P i) :
    starContraction T X i z x = fullContraction F X i z x.val

end Lax342547.TableContractions

statements.signature:
star_extension : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype Comp] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype H]
  {P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N} (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q)
  (F : Lax342547.TableContractions.CrossForms Comp B H),
  Lax342547.TableContractions.Extends F T →
    ∀ (X : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Comp → Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)) (i z : Fin 2)
      (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.effective X P i) x),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TableContractions.starContraction T X i z) x)
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TableContractions.fullContraction F X i z) x.val)

concepts.title: Bounded table data and linear-size nominal coefficient records
concepts.description:
For fixed pin and channel budgets, the number of small tables is bounded
independently of the primal dimension. Nominal pin bases can be padded to
a fixed number of coefficient vectors; their bit count grows linearly in
the primal dimension.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.SmallTables
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Finite.Matrix
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite

/-!
---
title: Bounded table data and linear-size nominal coefficient records
type: lemma
---
For fixed pin and channel budgets, the number of small tables is bounded
independently of the primal dimension. Nominal pin bases can be padded to
a fixed number of coefficient vectors; their bit count grows linearly in
the primal dimension.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TableCounts

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.SmallTables

abbrev CoefficientCode (Comp B H : Type) (K : ℕ) :=
  (Comp × Bool) → Fin K → (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary

axiom table_count {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (K : ℕ)
    (hP : P.rank ≤ K) (hQ : Q.rank ≤ K) :
    Nat.card (Table P Q) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * Fintype.card Comp * (2 * K + 2 * Fintype.card H) ^ 2)

axiom coefficient_code {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (K : ℕ) (hP : P.rank ≤ K) :
    ∃ code : CoefficientCode Comp B H K,
      ∀ a, Submodule.span Binary (Set.range (code a)) = P.space a

axiom coefficient_count {Comp B H : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H] (K : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (CoefficientCode Comp B H K) =
      2 ^ (4 * Fintype.card Comp * K * (Fintype.card B + Fintype.card H))

end Lax342547.TableCounts

statements.signature:
coefficient_code : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
  (P : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N) (K : Nat),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    Exists fun code =>
      ∀ (a : Prod Comp Bool), Eq (Submodule.span Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Set.range (code a))) (P.space a)

coefficient_count : ∀ {Comp B H : Type} [inst : Fintype Comp] [inst_1 : Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype H] (K : Nat),
  Eq (Nat.card (Lax342547.TableCounts.CoefficientCode Comp B H K))
    (instHPow.hPow 2
      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 (Fintype.card Comp)) K)
        (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card B) (Fintype.card H))))

table_count : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [inst_2 : Fintype H]
  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N) (K : Nat),
  instLENat.le P.rank K →
    instLENat.le Q.rank K →
      instLENat.le (Nat.card (Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q))
        (instHPow.hPow 2
          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card Comp))
            (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 K) (instHMul.hMul 2 (Fintype.card H))) 2)))

concepts.title: Actual table injection and ambient pin failures
concepts.description:
Restrict the actual cross Gram forms to the numerical table spaces. Each
of the sixteen component tests is precisely an ambient primal-image
injection modulo the opposite unit's same-sign protected channels.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawContractions
import Lax342547.FiniteInjection

/-!
---
title: Actual table injection and ambient pin failures
type: lemma
---
Restrict the actual cross Gram forms to the numerical table spaces. Each
of the sixteen component tests is precisely an ambient primal-image
injection modulo the opposite unit's same-sign protected channels.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TableInjection

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ExactPins
open Lax342547.TableSpaces Lax342547.SmallTables Lax342547.TableContractions
open Lax342547.RawContractions Lax342547.FiniteInjection

variable {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Binary}

def rawTable (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) : Table P Q where
  forward e := ((rawForms A Bmap).forward e).compl₁₂
    (tableSpace P (e, true)).subtype (tableSpace Q (e, false)).subtype
  reverse e := ((rawForms A Bmap).reverse e).compl₁₂
    (tableSpace Q (e, true)).subtype (tableSpace P (e, false)).subtype

def primalMatrix (A : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) (i : Fin 2)
    (s : Bool) : Matrix N B Binary := if s then (A i e).P else (A i e).Q

def oppositeChannel (A : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) (i : Fin 2)
    (s : Bool) : Matrix N H Binary := if s then (A i e).Y else (A i e).X

def primalImage (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) (i : Fin 2) (s : Bool) :
    Submodule Binary (N → Binary) :=
  (pinnedPrimal P i (e, s)).map (primalMatrix A e i s).mulVecLin

def Failed (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2)
    (s role : Bool) : Prop :=
  if role then
    pinFailure (primalImage Q Bmap e i s) (oppositeChannel A e z s)
      (protectedChannel P z (e, s))
  else
    pinFailure (primalImage P A e i s) (oppositeChannel Bmap e z s)
      (protectedChannel Q z (e, s))

axiom actual_table_injecting_iff (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) :
    Injecting (rawTable P Q A Bmap) ↔ ∀ e i z s role,¬ Failed P Q A Bmap e i z s role

axiom admissible_injection_iff (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N)
    (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Frame B H N E) (T : Table P Q)
    (hT : Admissible T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation A Bmap) :
    Injecting T ↔ Injecting (rawTable P Q A Bmap)

end Lax342547.TableInjection

statements.signature:
actual_table_injecting_iff : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N)
  (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E),
  Iff (Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting (Lax342547.TableInjection.rawTable P Q A Bmap))
    (∀ (e : Comp) (i z : Fin 2) (s role : Bool), Not (Lax342547.TableInjection.Failed P Q A Bmap e i z s role))

admissible_injection_iff : ∀ {Comp B H N : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H] [inst_2 : Fintype N]
  {E : Matrix B B Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary}
  (P Q : Lax342547.ExactPins.Pin (Prod Comp Bool) (Prod (Fin 2) (Sum B H)) N)
  (A Bmap : Fin 2 → Comp → Lax342547.RawFrames.Frame B H N E) (T : Lax342547.SmallTables.Table P Q),
  Lax342547.SmallTables.Admissible T Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation Lax342547.ReferencePins.observation A Bmap →
    Iff (Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting T)
      (Lax342547.SmallTables.Injecting (Lax342547.TableInjection.rawTable P Q A Bmap))

concepts.title: Table coordinates and private channel complements
concepts.description:
The table space contains the full channel blocks and the endpoint
projections of the stored primal pins. Protected channels are projections
of the pins, not intersections with the channel blocks.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedPins
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Constructions

/-!
---
title: Table coordinates and private channel complements
type: lemma
---
The table space contains the full channel blocks and the endpoint
projections of the stored primal pins. Protected channels are projections
of the pins, not intersections with the channel blocks.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TableSpaces

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ExactPins Lax342547.ProjectedPins

def primalEmbedding {B H : Type} (i : Fin 2) :
    (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) where
  toFun v x := if x.1 = i then Sum.elim v (fun _ => 0) x.2 else 0
  map_add' v w := by ext ⟨j, b | h⟩ <;> by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
  map_smul' c v := by ext ⟨j, b | h⟩ <;> by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]

def channelProjection {B H : Type} (i : Fin 2) :
    ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) where
  toFun v h := v (i, Sum.inr h)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def channelEmbedding {B H : Type} (i : Fin 2) :
    (H → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) where
  toFun v x := if x.1 = i then Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) v x.2 else 0
  map_add' v w := by ext ⟨j, b | h⟩ <;> by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
  map_smul' c v := by ext ⟨j, b | h⟩ <;> by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]

def protectedChannel {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Submodule Binary (H → Binary) := (P.space a).map (channelProjection i)

def tableSpace {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Submodule Binary ((Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) → Binary) where
  carrier := {v | ∀ i, primalProjection i v ∈ projected P i a}
  zero_mem' := fun i => (projected P i a).zero_mem
  add_mem' := fun hv hw i => (projected P i a).add_mem (hv i) (hw i)
  smul_mem' := fun c _ hv i => (projected P i a).smul_mem c (hv i)

def pinnedPrimal {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Submodule Binary (B → Binary) := (P.space a).comap (primalEmbedding i)

axiom pin_le_table {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    P.space a ≤ tableSpace P a

axiom table_mono {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P Q : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (h : P.Extends Q) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    tableSpace P a ≤ tableSpace Q a

axiom protected_rank {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) :
    (∑ a, Module.finrank Binary (protectedChannel P i a)) ≤ P.rank

axiom private_complement {Comp B H N : Type}
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (i : Fin 2) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    ∃ U : Submodule Binary (H → Binary), IsCompl (protectedChannel P i a) U

axiom table_dimension {Comp B H N : Type} [Fintype Comp] [Fintype B] [Fintype H]
    (P : Pin (Comp × Bool) (Fin 2 × (B ⊕ H)) N) (a : Comp × Bool) :
    Module.finrank Binary (tableSpace P a) ≤ 2 * P.rank + 2 * Fintype.card H

end Lax342547.TableSpaces

concepts.title: Majority intersections in the cyclic tag geometry
concepts.description:
For $g=2k+1$, the tag $l$ allows the block $O_{d,t}$ exactly when
$l\in\{d+1,\ldots,d+k\}$. The other three blocks are unrestricted.
The intersection over more than $k$ tags is the all-$O$-zero moment
space, as asserted in the first part of Lemma 2.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.CutProfiles
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic

/-!
---
title: Majority intersections in the cyclic tag geometry
type: lemma
---
For $g=2k+1$, the tag $l$ allows the block $O_{d,t}$ exactly when
$l\in\{d+1,\ldots,d+k\}$. The other three blocks are unrestricted.
The intersection over more than $k$ tags is the all-$O$-zero moment
space, as asserted in the first part of Lemma 2.3.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TagGeometry

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

abbrev Tag (k : ℕ) := ZMod (2 * k + 1)

def interval (k : ℕ) (d : Tag k) : Finset (Tag k) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin k => d + (i.val + 1 : ℕ))

abbrev Base (k n : ℕ) := ((Tag k × Tag k) × Fin n) ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin n)

def allowedBase (k n : ℕ) (l : Tag k) : Set (Base k n)
  | Sum.inl ((d, _), _) => l ∈ interval k d
  | Sum.inr _ => True

def commonBase (k n : ℕ) : Set (Base k n)
  | Sum.inl _ => False
  | Sum.inr _ => True

axiom majority_intersection {Label Coord : Type} (k n : ℕ)
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (S : Finset (Tag k)) (hS : k < S.card) :
    (⨅ l : {l // l ∈ S}, momentSpace p (allowedBase k n l.val)) =
      momentSpace p (commonBase k n)

end Lax342547.TagGeometry

statements.signature:
majority_intersection : ∀ {Label Coord : Type} (k n : Nat) (p : Label → Coord → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (S : Finset (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  instLTNat.lt k S.card →
    Eq (iInf fun l => Lax342547.MomentSpace.momentSpace p (Lax342547.TagGeometry.allowedBase k n l.val))
      (Lax342547.MomentSpace.momentSpace p (Lax342547.TagGeometry.commonBase k n))

concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TargetTesters

/-!
---
title: Explicit low-rank matrices for the whole-space gradient target
type: lemma
---
The adjoints of the concrete mixer sandwiches have ranks bounded by the witness component ranks. Combining both orientations with the routed tester matrices constructs the actual target matrices, proves the rank 15r+14J|E|, and represents the whole profile-pair target exactly.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TargetMatrices

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.Atoms
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.WitnessAtoms Lax342547.TargetTesters

axiom sandwich_adjoint {B : Type} [Fintype B] (M W L R : Matrix B B Binary) :
    matrixPair M (L * W * R.transpose) = matrixPair (L.transpose * M * R) W

noncomputable def mixerMatrix {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (v : Profile k n b degree) (e : Component (Tag k)) : Moment k n b degree :=
  (∑ j, ∑ f, (L j f e).transpose * v.val f * R j f e) +
    ∑ j, ∑ f, L j e f * v.val f * (R j e f).transpose

axiom mixer_matrix_representation {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (v x : Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (mixerMatrix L R v e) (x.val e)) = mixingForm L R v x + mixingForm L R x v

axiom witness_component_rank {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    ((leftWitness W i z).val e).rank ≤ 7

axiom mixer_matrix_rank {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (v : Profile k n b degree) (S : ℕ) (hS : ∀ f, (v.val f).rank ≤ S)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) : (mixerMatrix L R v e).rank ≤
      2 * J * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k)) * S

noncomputable def targetMatrix {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (i z : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) : Moment k n b degree :=
  witnessTesterMatrix W D i z e + mixerMatrix L R (leftWitness W i z) e

axiom target_matrix_rank {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (i z : Fin 2) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (targetMatrix W D L R i z e).rank ≤ 15 * r + 14 * J * Fintype.card (Component (Tag k))

axiom target_matrix_representation {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (i z : Fin 2) (hodd : (∑ j, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z j)) = 1)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (targetMatrix W D L R i z e) (x.val e)) =
      (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)) x

axiom target_family_representation {k n b degree r J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (z : Fin 2) (hodd : ∀ i, (∑ j, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z j)) = 1) :
    Lax342547.ResidualRealization.matrixResponse (Profile k n b degree) (fun i => targetMatrix W D L R i z) =
      ∑ i, (D.role + gradient D L R (leftWitness W i z)).comp (LinearMap.proj i)

end Lax342547.TargetMatrices

concepts.title: The fifteen-rank witness tester target
concepts.description: Odd witness lists turn the ordinary target coefficients into the shared moment at each witness tag. Their at most seven atoms route at most fourteen ordered ordinary testers to any component. All shared stars consolidate into one ordered shared tester. The resulting rank at most 15r represents the exact tester target on the entire profile space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.StarRouting

/-!
---
title: The fifteen-rank witness tester target
type: lemma
---
Odd witness lists turn the ordinary target coefficients into the shared moment at each witness tag. Their at most seven atoms route at most fourteen ordered ordinary testers to any component. All shared stars consolidate into one ordered shared tester. The resulting rank at most 15r represents the exact tester target on the entire profile space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TargetTesters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.ConcreteCut Lax342547.CutProfiles Lax342547.Atoms
open Lax342547.PairedWitnesses Lax342547.WitnessAtoms Lax342547.StarRouting

axiom ordinary_star_representation {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (t : Tag k)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (starMatrix hr (fun d => ordinary d t) (fun _ => 1) e) (x.val e)) = D.aTag t x

noncomputable def sharedMatrix {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (coeff : Tag k → Binary) (e : Component (Tag k)) : Moment k n b degree :=
  (∑ t ∈ e.val, coeff t) • orderedTesterMatrix hr shared

axiom shared_matrix_rank {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (coeff : Tag k → Binary) (e : Component (Tag k)) :
    (sharedMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr coeff e).rank ≤ r

axiom shared_matrix_representation {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (coeff : Tag k → Binary)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (sharedMatrix (b := b) (degree := degree) hr coeff e) (x.val e)) =
      ∑ t, coeff t * D.bTag t x

axiom tester_coefficient {k n b degree r : ℕ} (hr : 2 * r ≤ n)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (v : Representation k n b degree) (hv : chiStar hr v = 1) (t : Tag k) :
    1 + D.role ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v) +
      D.bTag t ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v) =
      blockTester hr shared (v.val t)

noncomputable def testerTarget {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (v : Profile k n b degree) :
    Module.Dual Binary (Profile k n b degree) :=
  D.role + (Lax342547.GradientForm.form D.role D.aTag D.bTag 0) v

axiom tester_target_formula {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (v : Representation k n b degree) (hv : chiStar hr v = 1) (x : Profile k n b degree) :
    testerTarget D ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v) x =
      (∑ t, blockTester hr shared (v.val t) * D.aTag t x) +
      ∑ t, D.aTag t ((representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v) * D.bTag t x

axiom left_witness_cut {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) :
    (representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict (leftRepresentation W i z) = leftWitness W i z

axiom left_shared_sum {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2) (f : Tag k → Binary) :
    (∑ t, blockTester hr shared ((leftRepresentation W i z).val t) * f t) =
      ∑ j, ((W.left i z j).numerical hr).summary none * f (W.left i z j).tag

noncomputable def witnessTesterMatrix {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (i z : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) : Moment k n b degree :=
  (∑ j, ((W.left i z j).numerical hr).summary none •
    starMatrix hr (fun d => ordinary d (W.left i z j).tag) (fun _ => 1) e) +
  sharedMatrix hr (fun t => D.aTag t (leftWitness W i z)) e

axiom witness_tester_rank {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (i z : Fin 2)
    (e : Component (Tag k)) : (witnessTesterMatrix W D i z e).rank ≤ 15 * r

axiom witness_tester_representation {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (W : Lists k n b degree r hr)
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) (i z : Fin 2)
    (hodd : (∑ j, diagonalBit hr (W.left i z j)) = 1) (x : Profile k n b degree) :
    (∑ e, matrixPair (witnessTesterMatrix W D i z e) (x.val e)) =
      testerTarget D (leftWitness W i z) x

end Lax342547.TargetTesters

  (W : Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.Lists k n b degree r hr) (i z : Fin 2)
  (f : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t =>
      instHMul.hMul
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.blockTester hr Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.shared)

      (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.leftRepresentation W i z))
    (Lax342547.PairedWitnesses.leftWitness W i z)

  (t : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)
  (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
      LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
        (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair
          (Lax342547.StarRouting.starMatrix hr (fun d => Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.ordinary d t) (fun x => 1) e))
        (x.val e))
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (D.aTag t) x)

shared_matrix_rank : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
  (coeff : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (e : Lax342547.CutProfiles.Component (Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k)),
  instLENat.le (Matrix.rank (Lax342547.TargetTesters.sharedMatrix hr coeff e)) r

shared_matrix_representation : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n) (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
  (coeff : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (x : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Profile k n b degree) x),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
      LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
        (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair (Lax342547.TargetTesters.sharedMatrix hr coeff e)) (x.val e))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun t => instHMul.hMul (coeff t) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (D.bTag t) x))

tester_coefficient : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n) (D : Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Testers hr)
  (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.Representation k n b degree) x),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.chiStar hr) v) 1 →
    ∀ (t : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k),
      Eq
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd 1
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe D.role
              (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v)))
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (D.bTag t)
            (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.representationCut k n b degree).rangeRestrict v)))
        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.blockTester hr Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.shared)
          (v.val t))

concepts.title: Pure bilinear responses detect quotient tensors
concepts.description:
Vanishing against every bilinear form on two quotient spaces implies the
component-rank bound used in §6. The selected affine-ray case gives
exactly a scalar point moment, rather than an arbitrary low-rank block.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.QuotientRank
import Lax342547.SelectedMoments
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

/-!
---
title: Pure bilinear responses detect quotient tensors
type: lemma
---
Vanishing against every bilinear form on two quotient spaces implies the
component-rank bound used in §6. The selected affine-ray case gives
exactly a scalar point moment, rather than an arbitrary low-rank block.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.BaseMoments Lax342547.SelectedMoments

def dualCoordinates {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] :
    Module.Dual Binary (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (I → Binary) where
  toFun φ i := φ (Pi.single i 1)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

noncomputable def pureContraction {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (S T : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (β : ((I → Binary) ⧸ S) →ₗ[Binary] ((I → Binary) ⧸ T) →ₗ[Binary] Binary) :
    Matrix I I Binary →ₗ[Binary] Binary := by
  classical
  exact matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (β.compl₁₂ S.mkQ T.mkQ))

def PureAnnihilates {I : Type} [Fintype I] (M : Matrix I I Binary)
    (S T : Submodule Binary (I → Binary)) : Prop :=
  ∀ β, pureContraction S T β M = 0

axiom pure_rank {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : Matrix I I Binary) (S T : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (h : PureAnnihilates M S T) :
    M.rank ≤ Module.finrank Binary S + Module.finrank Binary T

axiom pure_sandwich {I P Q : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype P] [Fintype Q]
    [DecidableEq I] (M : Matrix I I Binary) (S T : Submodule Binary (I → Binary))
    (h : PureAnnihilates M S T) (A : Matrix P I Binary) (B : Matrix Q I Binary)
    (hA : S ≤ LinearMap.ker A.mulVecLin) (hB : T ≤ LinearMap.ker B.mulVecLin) :
    A * M * B.transpose = 0

axiom selected_block {Base : Type} [Fintype Base] [DecidableEq Base]
    (z : Base → Binary) (Z : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Binary)
    (hZ : IsBaseMoment Z)
    (h : PureAnnihilates Z (Submodule.span Binary {baseEval z})
      (Submodule.span Binary {baseEval z})) :
    Z = Z none none • baseMoment z

end Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

pure_rank : ∀ {I : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (M : Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates M S T →
    instLENat.le M.rank
      (instHAdd.hAdd (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x))
        (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)))

pure_sandwich : ∀ {I P Q : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [Fintype P] [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq I]
  (M : Matrix I I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates M S T →
    ∀ (A : Matrix P I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B : Matrix Q I Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Submodule.instPartialOrder.le S A.mulVecLin.ker →
        Submodule.instPartialOrder.le T B.mulVecLin.ker →
          Eq
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul A M)
              B.transpose)
            0

selected_block : ∀ {Base : Type} [inst : Fintype Base] [DecidableEq Base] (z : Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (Z : Matrix (Option Base) (Option Base) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Lax342547.BaseMoments.IsBaseMoment Z →
    Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates Z
        (Submodule.span Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (Lax342547.MomentSpace.baseEval z)))
        (Submodule.span Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (Lax342547.MomentSpace.baseEval z))) →
      Eq Z (instHSMul.hSMul (Z Option.none Option.none) (Lax342547.BaseMoments.baseMoment z))

concepts.title: Quotient extractors isolate individual tensor label blocks
concepts.description:
A label block is the tensor lift of a base matrix. Bilinear contraction
commutes with this lift. Extractors that read one label and kill the
others therefore transfer pure annihilation to that base block.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators
import Lax342547.SparsePins

/-!
---
title: Quotient extractors isolate individual tensor label blocks
type: lemma
---
A label block is the tensor lift of a base matrix. Bilinear contraction
commutes with this lift. Extractors that read one label and kill the
others therefore transfer pure annihilation to that base block.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TensorBlocks

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.SparsePins Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
open Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators

def block {Label Coord Base : Type} (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) :
    Matrix Base Base Binary →ₗ[Binary] Matrix (Coord × Base) (Coord × Base) Binary where
  toFun Z i j := p s i.1 * p s j.1 * Z i.2 j.2
  map_add' Z W := by ext i j; exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' c Z := by
    ext i j
    change p s i.1 * p s j.1 * (c * Z i.2 j.2) = c * (p s i.1 * p s j.1 * Z i.2 j.2)
    ring

axiom block_contraction {Label Coord Base V W : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module Binary V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module Binary W]
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (s : Label) (Z : Matrix Base Base Binary)
    (q : (Coord × Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] V)
    (r : (Coord × Base → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] W)
    (β : V →ₗ[Binary] W →ₗ[Binary] Binary) : by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Coord × Base) := Classical.decEq _
  exact matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (β.compl₁₂ q r)) (block p s Z) =
      matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix'
        (β.compl₁₂ (q.comp (labelTensor p s)) (r.comp (labelTensor p s)))) Z

axiom quotient_isolation {Label Coord Base : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Fintype Base]
    [DecidableEq Label]
    (p : Label → Coord → Binary) (L : Finset Label) (s : Label) (hs : s ∈ L)
    (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Binary)
    (S T : Submodule Binary (Coord × Base → Binary))
    (A B : Submodule Binary (Base → Binary))
    (q : ((Coord × Base → Binary) ⧸ S) →ₗ[Binary] ((Base → Binary) ⧸ A))
    (r : ((Coord × Base → Binary) ⧸ T) →ₗ[Binary] ((Base → Binary) ⧸ B))
    (hq : ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ v, q (S.mkQ (labelTensor p t v)) = if t = s then A.mkQ v else 0)
    (hr : ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ v, r (T.mkQ (labelTensor p t v)) = if t = s then B.mkQ v else 0)
    (h : PureAnnihilates (∑ t ∈ L, block p t (Z t)) S T) :
    PureAnnihilates (Z s) A B

end Lax342547.TensorBlocks

statements.signature:
block_contraction : ∀ {Label Coord Base V W : Type} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Fintype Base] [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V]
  [inst_3 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary V] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W]
  [inst_5 : Module Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary W] (p : Label → Coord → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (s : Label)
  (Z : Matrix Base Base Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (q : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V)
  (r : LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) W)
  (β :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) V
      (LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) W Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
      (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' (β.compl₁₂ q r)))
      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p s) Z))
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe
      (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.matrixPair
        (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix'
          (β.compl₁₂ (q.comp (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p s)) (r.comp (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p s)))))
      Z)

quotient_isolation : ∀ {Label Coord Base : Type} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Fintype Base] [inst_2 : DecidableEq Label]
  (p : Label → Coord → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (L : Finset Label) (s : Label),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem L s →
    ∀ (Z : Label → Matrix Base Base Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
      (A B : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
      (q :
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) S)
          (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) A))
      (r :
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
          (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Prod Coord Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) T)
          (Submodule.hasQuotient.Quotient (Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) B)),
      (∀ (t : Label),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem L t →
            ∀ (v : Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
              Eq
                (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe q
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe S.mkQ
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p t) v)))
                (ite (Eq t s) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe A.mkQ v) 0)) →
        (∀ (t : Label),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem L t →
              ∀ (v : Base → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
                Eq
                  (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe r
                    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T.mkQ
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.SparsePins.labelTensor p t) v)))
                  (ite (Eq t s) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe B.mkQ v) 0)) →
          Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates
              (L.sum fun t => LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorBlocks.block p t) (Z t)) S T →
            Lax342547.TensorAnnihilators.PureAnnihilates (Z s) A B

concepts.title: Characters of all independent tensor channels
concepts.description: Multiplication over actual component channel pairs yields the exact exponent given by the sum of component ranks, including the actual sampled componentwise tensor sum.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ChannelMoments

/-!
---
title: Characters of all independent tensor channels
type: lemma
---
Multiplication over actual component channel pairs yields the exact exponent given by the sum of component ranks, including the actual sampled componentwise tensor sum.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TensorCharacters

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ChannelCharacters Lax342547.FiniteSampling
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def tensorCharacter {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (h : ℕ)
    (A : e → Matrix I J Binary) (c : e × Fin h → (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) : ℝ :=
    ∏ i, character (A i.1) (c i)

axiom tensor_character_average {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (A : e → Matrix I J Binary) (h : ℕ) :
    (∑ c, productLaw (fun _ : e × Fin h => channelLaw) c*tensorCharacter h A c) =
      1/(2 : ℝ)^(h*∑ i, (A i).rank)

axiom product_tensor_characters {e I J ι : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → e → Matrix I J Binary) (h : ℕ) (c : e × Fin h → (I → Binary) × (J → Binary)) :
    (∏ i, tensorCharacter h (A i) c) = tensorCharacter h (fun e => ∑ i, A i e) c

end Lax342547.TensorCharacters

statements.signature:
product_tensor_characters : ∀ {e I J ι : Type} [inst : Fintype e] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : Fintype ι]
  (A : ι → e → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (h : Nat)
  (c : Prod e (Fin h) → Prod (I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (J → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.prod fun i => Lax342547.TensorCharacters.tensorCharacter h (A i) c)
    (Lax342547.TensorCharacters.tensorCharacter h (fun e => Finset.univ.sum fun i => A i e) c)

tensor_character_average : ∀ {e I J : Type} [inst : Fintype e] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq e]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] (A : e → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (h : Nat),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun c =>
      instHMul.hMul (Lax342547.FiniteSampling.productLaw (fun x => Lax342547.ChannelCharacters.channelLaw) c)
        (Lax342547.TensorCharacters.tensorCharacter h A c))
    (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul h (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (A i).rank))))

concepts.title: Well-defined channel contractions on projected tensor spaces
concepts.description:
Two channel evaluation maps on the tensor factors determine a unique
linear contraction on their matrix tensor space. Its value is independent
of how the maps are extended to the ambient coefficient space.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.ProjectedPins
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
---
title: Well-defined channel contractions on projected tensor spaces
type: lemma
---
Two channel evaluation maps on the tensor factors determine a unique
linear contraction on their matrix tensor space. Its value is independent
of how the maps are extended to the ambient coefficient space.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TensorContractions

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.ProjectedPins Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

variable {B H : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H]

noncomputable def ambient (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    Matrix B B Binary →ₗ[Binary] Binary := by
  classical
  exact matrixPair (LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix' ((dotProductBilin Binary Binary).compl₁₂ f g))

noncomputable def extend {S : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)} (f : S →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary) := Classical.choose f.exists_extend

def tensor {S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)} (v : S) (w : T) : tensorSpace S T :=
  ⟨Matrix.vecMulVec v.val w.val, Submodule.subset_span ⟨v.val, v.property, w.val, w.property, rfl⟩⟩

noncomputable def contraction {S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)}
    (f : S →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (g : T →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) :
    tensorSpace S T →ₗ[Binary] Binary :=
  (ambient (extend f) (extend g)).comp (tensorSpace S T).subtype

axiom ambient_outer (f g : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (v w : B → Binary) :
    ambient f g (Matrix.vecMulVec v w) = dotProduct (f v) (g w)

axiom contraction_outer {S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)}
    (f : S →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (g : T →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (v : S) (w : T) :
    contraction f g (tensor v w) = dotProduct (f v) (g w)

axiom extension_agreement {S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)}
    (f : S →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (g : T →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (f' g' : (B → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (hf : f'.comp S.subtype = f) (hg : g'.comp T.subtype = g) (M : tensorSpace S T) :
    contraction f g M = ambient f' g' M.val

axiom contraction_unique {S T : Submodule Binary (B → Binary)}
    (f : S →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary)) (g : T →ₗ[Binary] (H → Binary))
    (c : tensorSpace S T →ₗ[Binary] Binary)
    (hc : ∀ (v : S) (w : T), c (tensor v w) = dotProduct (f v) (g w)) :
    c = contraction f g

end Lax342547.TensorContractions

  (f g :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (v w : B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f g) (Matrix.vecMulVec v w))
    (dotProduct (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe f v) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe g w))

  {S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)}
  (f :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (g :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x) (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x),
  Eq
    (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorContractions.contraction f g) (Lax342547.TensorContractions.tensor v w))
    (dotProduct (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe f v) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe g w))

contraction_unique : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H]
  {S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)}
  (f :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (g :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (c :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.tensorSpace S T) x)
      Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  (∀ (v : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x) (w : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x),
      Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe c (Lax342547.TensorContractions.tensor v w))
        (dotProduct (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe f v) (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe g w))) →
    Eq c (Lax342547.TensorContractions.contraction f g)

extension_agreement : ∀ {B H : Type} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : Fintype H]
  {S T : Submodule Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)}
  (f :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem S x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (g :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem T x)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary))
  (f' g' :
    LinearMap (RingHom.id Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (B → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
      (H → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)),
  Eq (f'.comp S.subtype) f →
    Eq (g'.comp T.subtype) g →
      ∀ (M : Subtype fun x => SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax342547.ProjectedPins.tensorSpace S T) x),
        Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorContractions.contraction f g) M)
          (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.TensorContractions.ambient f' g') M.val)

concepts.title: Rank and trace of shared frame tensors
concepts.description:
Injective primal frame maps preserve coefficient-matrix rank. A tensor
shared by two endpoints has its column space in their primal-span
intersection. Its trace is the entrywise pairing with the self-Gram matrix.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.RawFrames
import Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Rank

/-!
---
title: Rank and trace of shared frame tensors
type: lemma
---
Injective primal frame maps preserve coefficient-matrix rank. A tensor
shared by two endpoints has its column space in their primal-span
intersection. Its trace is the entrywise pairing with the self-Gram matrix.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TensorIntersections

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RawFrames Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry

variable {B H N : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype H] [Fintype N]

def intersectionSpace (P Q : Matrix N B Binary) : Submodule Binary (N → Binary) :=
  LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin ⊓ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin

axiom sandwich_rank {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E)
    (w : Matrix B B Binary) : (sandwich F.P F.Q w).rank = w.rank

axiom shared_rank {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F G : Frame B H N E)
    (w v : Matrix B B Binary) (h : sandwich F.P F.Q w = sandwich G.P G.Q v) :
    w.rank = v.rank ∧ w.rank ≤ Module.finrank Binary (intersectionSpace F.P G.P)

axiom shared_total_rank {Comp : Type} [Fintype Comp] {E : Matrix B B Binary}
    (F G : Comp → Frame B H N E) (w v : Comp → Matrix B B Binary)
    (h : profileMap F w = profileMap G v) :
    (∑ e, (w e).rank) = ∑ e, (v e).rank ∧
      (∑ e, (w e).rank) ≤ ∑ e, Module.finrank Binary (intersectionSpace (F e).P (G e).P)

axiom trace_sandwich {E : Matrix B B Binary} (F : Frame B H N E)
    (w : Matrix B B Binary) : Matrix.trace (sandwich F.P F.Q w) = matrixPair E w

end Lax342547.TensorIntersections

concepts.title: Terminal exceptions from real capacity cuts
concepts.description: A residual pair set admitting no probability law with the marginal and pair caps is covered by a small raw vertex exception and a small product-law pair exception. This proves the finite content of Lemma 3.3.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.BipartiteFlows
import Lax342547.UnitLaws
import Lax342547.CellAveraging

/-!
---
title: Terminal exceptions from real capacity cuts
type: lemma
---
A residual pair set admitting no probability law with the marginal and pair caps is covered by a small raw vertex exception and a small product-law pair exception. This proves the finite content of Lemma 3.3.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TerminalCuts

open Lax342547.BipartiteFlows Lax342547.FlowCuts Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.CellAveraging
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable def pairCapacity {Ω : Type} (μ : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) (κ : ℝ) : Ω → Ω → ℝ := by
  classical
  exact fun x y => if R x y then κ*(μ x*μ y) else 0

axiom law_iff_masked {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M κ : ℝ) (ρ : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) :
    Law (fun x => M*μ x) (fun y => M*μ y) (pairCapacity μ R κ) ρ ↔
      Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ R M κ (fun xy => ρ xy.1 xy.2)

axiom bipartite_cut_capacity {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (a : A → ℝ) (b : B → ℝ) (p : A → B → ℝ) (Z : Finset (Vertex A B))
    (hs : source ∈ Z) (ht : sink ∉ Z) : by
      classical
      exact cutCapacity (capacity a b p) Z =
        (∑ x, if left x ∉ Z then a x else 0)+(∑ y, if right y ∈ Z then b y else 0)+
        (∑ x, ∑ y, if left x ∈ Z ∧ right y ∉ Z then p x y else 0)

axiom terminal_cut {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M κ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) (hM : 0 < M) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hn : ¬ ∃ ρ, Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ R M κ ρ) :
    ∃ S : Ω → Prop, ∃ E : Ω → Ω → Prop,
      cellMass μ S < 1/M ∧ pairEventMass μ μ E < 1/κ ∧
      (∀ x y, R x y → S x ∨ S y ∨ E x y)

end Lax342547.TerminalCuts

statements.signature:
bipartite_cut_capacity : ∀ {A B : Type} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (a : A → Real) (b : B → Real) (p : A → B → Real)
  (Z : Finset (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Vertex A B)),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem Z Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.source →
    Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.sink) →
      Eq (Lax342547.FlowCuts.cutCapacity (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.capacity a b p) Z)
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
              ite (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x))) (a x) 0)
            (Finset.univ.sum fun y => ite (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y)) (b y) 0))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun x =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun y =>
              ite
                (And (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.left x))
                  (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.right y))))
                (p x y) 0))

law_iff_masked : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M κ : Real) (ρ : Ω → Ω → Real),
  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (μ x)) →
    Real.instLE.le 0 κ →
      Iff
        (Lax342547.BipartiteFlows.Law (fun x => instHMul.hMul M (μ x)) (fun y => instHMul.hMul M (μ y))
          (Lax342547.TerminalCuts.pairCapacity μ R κ) ρ)
        (Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ R M κ fun xy => ρ xy.fst xy.snd)

terminal_cut : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (R : Ω → Ω → Prop) (M κ : Real),
  (∀ (x : Ω), Real.instLE.le 0 (μ x)) →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 M →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 κ →
        Not (Exists fun ρ => Lax342547.UnitLaws.Feasible μ R M κ ρ) →
          Exists fun S =>
            Exists fun E =>
              And (Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass μ S) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 M))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ E) (instHDiv.hDiv 1 κ))
                  (∀ (x y : Ω), R x y → Or (S x) (Or (S y) (E x y))))

concepts.title: Prescribed Gram products routed into distinct retained tester pairs
concepts.description:
Each prescribed Gram product is routed to a distinct retained tester
pair. The exact uniform tester restriction law then supplies a positive
real conditioning mass without restricting the growing free coefficients.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram

/-!
---
title: Prescribed Gram products routed into distinct retained tester pairs
type: lemma
---
Each prescribed Gram product is routed to a distinct retained tester
pair. The exact uniform tester restriction law then supplies a positive
real conditioning mass without restricting the growing free coefficients.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TesterProductRouting
noncomputable section
open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.TagGeometry Lax342547.Atoms
open Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence
open Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry Lax342547.RetainedImages Lax342547.RealCellLaws
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false


def productRouting {k r : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D I : Type}
    (c : I → Pairs l f r) (a b : I → Option D → Binary) :
    Matrix (Slots l f r) (Option D) Binary := by
  classical
  exact fun u j => if u.2.2 then Function.extend c (fun i => b i j) 0 (u.1,u.2.1)
    else Function.extend c (fun i => a i j) 0 (u.1,u.2.1)

axiom sum_extended_product {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (c : I → J) (hc : Function.Injective c) (a b : I → Binary) :
    (∑ j,Function.extend c a 0 j*Function.extend c b 0 j) = ∑ i,a i*b i

axiom routed_product_gram {k r : ℕ} {l : Tag k} {f : Flavor k} {D I : Type}
    [Fintype I] (c : I → Pairs l f r) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (a b : I → Option D → Binary) :
    restrictedGram (productRouting c a b) = fun x y => ∑ i,a i x*b i y

axiom product_gram_cell_mass {k n b degree r : ℕ} {D I : Type} [Fintype D] [Fintype I]
    (hr : 2*r ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ degree)
    (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Binary) (s : Fin b → Binary)
    (l : Tag k) (f : Flavor k) (c : I → Pairs l f r) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (a b' : I → Option D → Binary) :
    massFloor l f r D ≤ cellMass
      (weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Coefficients n l f D)))
      (fun V => (pointColumns s (value V)).transpose*selfGram hr hd M*pointColumns s (value V) =
        fun x y => ∑ i,a i x*b' i y)

end
end Lax342547.TesterProductRouting

statements.signature:
product_gram_cell_mass : ∀ {k n b degree r : Nat} {D I : Type} [inst : Fintype D] [inst_1 : Fintype I] (hr : instLENat.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r) n)
  (hd : instLENat.le 1 degree) (M : Fin b → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (s : Fin b → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary) (l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k) (f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k)
  (c : I → Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram.Pairs l f r),
  Function.Injective c →
    ∀ (a b' : I → Option D → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Real.instLE.le (Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram.massFloor l f r D)
        (Lax342547.RetainedImages.cellMass
          (Lax342547.RealCellLaws.weights (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices.Coefficients n l f D)))
          fun V =>
          Eq
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
              (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul
                (Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence.pointColumns s (Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices.value V)).transpose
                (Lax342547.ConcreteGeometry.selfGram hr hd M))
              (Lax342547.AffineSliceIndependence.pointColumns s (Lax342547.FlavorAffineSlices.value V)))
            fun x y => Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (a i x) (b' i y))

routed_product_gram : ∀ {k r : Nat} {l : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Tag k} {f : Lax342547.Atoms.Flavor k} {D I : Type} [inst : Fintype I]
  (c : I → Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram.Pairs l f r),
  Function.Injective c →
    ∀ (a b : I → Option D → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Eq (Lax342547.FixedSelectorGram.restrictedGram (Lax342547.TesterProductRouting.productRouting c a b)) fun x y =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (a i x) (b i y)

sum_extended_product : ∀ {I J : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] (c : I → J),
  Function.Injective c →
    ∀ (a b : I → Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun j => instHMul.hMul (Function.extend c a 0 j) (Function.extend c b 0 j))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun i => instHMul.hMul (a i) (b i))

concepts.title: Inverse-polynomial tiny-cover compatibility
concepts.description: The actual binary pairing kernel of rank at most d*N has compatible pair mass at least 1/(4*(1+d*N)^4) under any finite probability law with zero diagonal.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.HadamardRank
import Lax342547.PairPositions

/-!
---
title: Inverse-polynomial tiny-cover compatibility
type: lemma
---
The actual binary pairing kernel of rank at most d*N has compatible pair mass at least 1/(4*(1+d*N)^4) under any finite probability law with zero diagonal.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TinyCompatibility

open Lax342547.MomentSpace Lax342547.RelativeEntropy Lax342547.CellAveraging

axiom tiny_compatible_mass {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (hμ : Probability μ) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0) :
    1/(((1+F.rank)^2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 ≤ pairEventMass μ μ (fun a b => F a b = 0 ∧ F b a = 0)

axiom tiny_compatible_mass_rank_bound {Ω : Type} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (μ : Ω → ℝ) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Binary) (d N : ℕ)
    (hμ : Probability μ) (hdiag : ∀ a, F a a = 0) (hrank : F.rank ≤ d*N) :
    1/(4*(1+(d : ℝ)*N)^4) ≤ pairEventMass μ μ (fun a b => F a b = 0 ∧ F b a = 0)

end Lax342547.TinyCompatibility

statements.signature:
tiny_compatible_mass : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    (∀ (a : Ω), Eq (F a a) 0) →
      Real.instLE.le
        (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd 1 F.rank) 2) 1).cast 2))
        (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ fun a b => And (Eq (F a b) 0) (Eq (F b a) 0))

tiny_compatible_mass_rank_bound : ∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (μ : Ω → Real) (F : Matrix Ω Ω Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary)
  (d N : Nat),
  Lax342547.RelativeEntropy.Probability μ →
    (∀ (a : Ω), Eq (F a a) 0) →
      instLENat.le F.rank (instHMul.hMul d N) →
        Real.instLE.le
          (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHMul.hMul 4 (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHMul.hMul d.cast N.cast)) 4)))
          (Lax342547.CellAveraging.pairEventMass μ μ fun a b => And (Eq (F a b) 0) (Eq (F b a) 0))

concepts.title: Counting component tensors with bounded total rank
concepts.description: Actual rank budgets and matrix factors give the uniform candidate count with ambient exponent (dim I+dim J)*r, rather than paying r for each component separately.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.LowRankCounting
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-!
---
title: Counting component tensors with bounded total rank
type: lemma
---
Actual rank budgets and matrix factors give the uniform candidate count with ambient exponent (dim I+dim J)*r, rather than paying r for each component separately.
-/

namespace Lax342547.TotalRankCount

open Lax342547.MomentSpace
open scoped BigOperators

abbrev RankBudgets (e : Type) [Fintype e] (r : ℕ) :=
  {a : e → Fin (r+1) // ∑ i, (a i).val ≤ r}

abbrev Factors {e : Type} [Fintype e] (I J : Type) (r : ℕ) (a : RankBudgets e r) :=
  (∀ i : e, Matrix I (Fin (a.val i).val) Binary) ×
    (∀ i : e, Matrix (Fin (a.val i).val) J Binary)

noncomputable def reconstruct {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] (r : ℕ) :
    (Σ a : RankBudgets e r, Factors I J r a) → e → Matrix I J Binary :=
  fun z i => z.2.1 i*z.2.2 i

axiom exists_rank_factors {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (r : ℕ) (A : e → Matrix I J Binary) (hA : ∑ i, (A i).rank ≤ r) :
    ∃ z : Σ a : RankBudgets e r, Factors I J r a, reconstruct r z = A

axiom factor_card_bound {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (r : ℕ) (a : RankBudgets e r) :
    Fintype.card (Factors I J r a) ≤ 2^((Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J)*r)

axiom total_rank_card {e I J : Type} [Fintype e] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {A : e → Matrix I J Binary // ∑ i, (A i).rank ≤ r} ≤
      (r+1)^Fintype.card e*2^((Fintype.card I+Fintype.card J)*r)

end Lax342547.TotalRankCount

statements.signature:
exists_rank_factors : ∀ {e I J : Type} [inst : Fintype e] [Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] (r : Nat)
  (A : e → Matrix I J Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary),
  instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (A i).rank) r → Exists fun z => Eq (Lax342547.TotalRankCount.reconstruct r z) A

factor_card_bound : ∀ {e I J : Type} [inst : Fintype e] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq e]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] (r : Nat) (a : Lax342547.TotalRankCount.RankBudgets e r),
  instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Lax342547.TotalRankCount.Factors I J r a))
    (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) r))

total_rank_card : ∀ {e I J : Type} [inst : Fintype e] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype J] [inst_3 : DecidableEq e]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq I] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] (r : Nat),
  instLENat.le (Fintype.card (Subtype fun A => instLENat.le (Finset.univ.sum fun i => (A i).rank) r))
    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd r 1) (Fintype.card e))
      (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) r)))

concepts.title: Formal forward and reverse rows of a unary mixer test
concepts.description:
For a fixed rank profile, each forward and reverse product receives
its own pair of formal row vectors. The substitution map records the
actual mixer restrictions. Its restriction to the Z direction matrix
is chosen before any non-Z coordinates or flavor are fixed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax342547.FormalQuadratic
import Lax342547.RestrictionRank
import Lax342547.AtomDirections
import Lax342547.Atoms

/-!
---
title: Formal forward and reverse rows of a unary mixer test
type: lemma
---
For a fixed rank profile, each forward and reverse product receives
its own pair of formal row vectors. The substitution map records the
actual mixer restrictions. Its restriction to the Z direction matrix
is chosen before any non-Z coordinates or flavor are fixed.
-/

namespace Lax342547.UnaryMixer

open Lax342547.MomentSpace

variable {E I : Type} [Fintype E] [Fintype I]

abbrev Block (inc : Finset E) (J : ℕ) :=
  (Fin J × E × {f : E // f ∈ inc}) ⊕ (Fin J × {e : E // e ∈ inc} × E)

def blockRank (r : E → ℕ) {inc : Finset E} {J : ℕ} : Block inc J → ℕ
  | .inl (_, e, _) => r e
  | .inr (_, _, f) => r f

abbrev Rows (r : E → ℕ) (inc : Finset E) (J : ℕ) :=
  FormalQuadratic.Rows (fun t : Block inc J => Fin (blockRank r t) → Binary)

noncomputable def middle {r : E → ℕ} {inc : Finset E} {J : ℕ}
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary) :
    ∀ t : Block inc J, LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Fin (blockRank r t) → Binary)
  | .inl (_, e, _) => (H e).toBilin'
  | .inr (_, _, f) => (H f).toBilin'

noncomputable def rowMap {r : E → ℕ} (inc : Finset E) {J : ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix I (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → E → E → Matrix I I Binary) : (I → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Rows r inc J :=
  LinearMap.pi fun t => match t with
    | .inl (j, e, f) =>
        ((Z e).transpose * L j e f.val).mulVecLin.prod
          ((Z e).transpose * R j e f.val).mulVecLin
    | .inr (j, e, f) =>
        ((L j e.val f * Z f).transpose).mulVecLin.prod
          ((R j e.val f * Z f).transpose).mulVecLin

noncomputable def formalQuadratic {r : E → ℕ} (inc : Finset E) (J : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary) : QuadraticForm Binary (Rows r inc J) :=
  FormalQuadratic.quadratic (middle H)

axiom formal_rank {r : E → ℕ} (inc : Finset E) (J : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hH : ∀ e, Function.Injective (H e).mulVec) :
    Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range (formalQuadratic inc J H).polarBilin) =
      4 * J * inc.card * ∑ e, r e

axiom substitution_rank {r : E → ℕ} (inc : Finset E) (J : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hH : ∀ e, Function.Injective (H e).mulVec)
    {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U] [Module Binary U]
    (A : U →ₗ[Binary] Rows r inc J) (s : ℕ)
    (hA : Module.finrank Binary (Rows r inc J) ≤
      Module.finrank Binary (LinearMap.range A) + s) :

noncomputable def incident {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) : Finset (Component (Tag k)) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun e => l ∈ e.val)

axiom incident_card {k : ℕ} (l : Tag k) : (incident l).card = 2 * k

noncomputable def zRows {k n b degree J : ℕ} {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) : (Fin n → Binary) →ₗ[Binary] Rows r (incident l) J :=
  (rowMap (incident l) Z L R).comp (AtomDirections.blockDirections s free).mulVecLin

noncomputable def zRowSpace {k n b degree J : ℕ} {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) : Submodule Binary (Module.Dual Binary (Fin n → Binary)) :=
  LinearMap.range (zRows Z L R l s).dualMap

axiom row_space_dimension {k n b degree J K : ℕ} {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (hrank : ∑ e, r e ≤ K) :
    Module.finrank Binary (zRowSpace Z L R l s) ≤ 4 * J * (2 * k) * K

def testerTerm {k n b degree r : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr) :
    LinearMap.BilinForm Binary (Profile k n b degree) :=
  GradientForm.form D.role D.aTag D.bTag 0

noncomputable def atomAlongZ {k n b degree : ℕ}
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0)
    (v : Fin n → Binary) : Profile k n b degree :=
  atom l s (AtomDirections.varyBlock z free v) (by
    classical
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | inl i => simpa [AtomDirections.varyBlock, free] using hz (.inl i) hi
    | inr i => exact False.elim (hi trivial))

axiom unary_affine_quadratic {k n b degree r₀ J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r₀ ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hfactor : ∀ e, Z e * H e * (Z e).transpose = x.val e)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) (v : Fin n → Binary) :
    gradient D L R x (atomAlongZ l s z hz v) =
      testerTerm D x (atom l s z hz) + formalQuadratic (incident l) J H
        (rowMap (incident l) Z L R (point selectorEval s z) + zRows Z L R l s v)

axiom unary_polar {k n b degree r₀ J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r₀ ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hfactor : ∀ e, Z e * H e * (Z e).transpose = x.val e)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) (u v : Fin n → Binary) :
    FormalQuadratic.affinePolar (fun w => gradient D L R x (atomAlongZ l s z hz w)) u v =
      (formalQuadratic (incident l) J H).polarBilin (zRows Z L R l s u) (zRows Z L R l s v)

axiom unary_depends_on_rows {k n b degree r₀ J : ℕ} {hr : 2 * r₀ ≤ n}
    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hfactor : ∀ e, Z e * H e * (Z e).transpose = x.val e)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)
    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) (u v : Fin n → Binary)
    (hrows : ∀ a ∈ zRowSpace Z L R l s, a u = a v) :
    gradient D L R x (atomAlongZ l s z hz u) = gradient D L R x (atomAlongZ l s z hz v)

axiom mixer_atom_expansion {k n b degree J : ℕ}
    (x : Profile k n b degree) {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (hfactor : ∀ e, Z e * H e * (Z e).transpose = x.val e)
    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)

    (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ allowedBase k n l → z i = 0) :
    mixingForm L R x (atom l s z hz) + mixingForm L R (atom l s z hz) x =
      formalQuadratic (incident l) J H (rowMap (incident l) Z L R (point selectorEval s z))

    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)
    (x : Profile k n b degree) {r : Component (Tag k) → ℕ}
    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)

    (L R : Fin J → Component (Tag k) → Component (Tag k) → Moment k n b degree)
    (l : Tag k) (s : Fin b → Binary) (z : Base k n → Binary)

    (D : Testers (k := k) (b := b) (degree := degree) hr)

    (Z : ∀ e, Matrix (Coordinate k n b degree) (Fin (r e)) Binary)
    (H : ∀ e, Matrix (Fin (r e)) (Fin (r e)) Binary)

        (hz :
          ∀ (i : Lax342547.TagGeometry.Base k n),

        (s₀ : Nat),
        instLENat.le
            (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary
              (Lax342547.UnaryMixer.Rows r (Lax342547.UnaryMixer.incident l) J))
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (Module.finrank Lax342547.MomentSpace.Binary

              s₀) →

              (Finset.univ.sum fun e => r e))

              (Lax342547.FormalQuadratic.polarMatrix fun w =>
                  LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe (Lax342547.ConcreteCut.gradient D L R) x)
                    (Lax342547.UnaryMixer.atomAlongZ l s z hz w)).rank
              (instHMul.hMul 2 s₀))

concepts.description:
